In contrast to the large wealth changes, most countries so far did not benefit much in welfare terms. This is because they did not rebalance their portfolios and realize their gains. In contrast, direct welfare effects from the dollar appreciation on import and export prices are an order of magnitude larger.
records.abstract_cn: 美国股市的优异表现和美元的持续升值，导致世界其他地区在美国外部头寸上获得了巨大的估值收益。我构建了这些收益的全球分布，并仔细考虑了避税天堂的作用。估值收益集中在发达国家且规模巨大，而发展中国家大多未能受益。为评估这些资本收益的福利影响，我采用了充分统计量方法。与巨大的财富变化相比，迄今为止大多数国家在福利方面并未获得太多好处。这是因为它们没有重新平衡其投资组合并实现收益。相比之下，美元升值对进口和出口价格的直接福利效应要大一个数量级。

records.title_en: Paper tiger? Chinese science and home bias in citations
records.title_cn: 纸老虎？中国科学及引用中的本土偏好
records.abstract_en: We investigate the phenomenon of home bias in scientific citations, where researchers disproportionately cite work from their own country. We develop a benchmark for expected citations based on the relative size of countries, defining home bias as deviations from this norm. Our findings reveal that China exhibits the largest home bias across all major countries and in nearly all scientific fields studied. This stands in contrast to the pattern of home bias for China’s trade in goods and services, where China does not stand out from most industrialized countries. After adjusting citation counts for home bias, we demonstrate that China’s apparent rise in citation rankings is overstated. Our adjusted ranking places China fourth globally, behind the US, the UK, and Germany, tempering the perception of China’s scientific dominance.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了科学引用中的本土偏好现象，即研究人员不成比例地引用本国的工作。我们基于国家相对规模制定了一个预期引用的基准，将本土偏好定义为偏离此基准的情况。我们的发现表明，在所有主要国家和几乎所有研究的科学领域中，中国表现出最大的本土偏好。这与中国的商品和服务贸易中的本土偏好模式形成对比，在该模式中，中国并不比大多数工业化国家突出。在调整引用次数以消除本土偏好后，我们证明中国在引用排名中的表面上升被夸大了。我们的调整排名将中国置于全球第四位，仅次于美国、英国和德国，从而缓和了对中国科学主导地位的看法。

records.title_en: Tickets to the global market: First US patent award and Chinese firm exports
records.title_cn: 通往全球市场的门票：首次美国专利授权与中国企业出口
records.abstract_en: We investigate how international patent activity enables firms from emerging economies to thrive in the global marketplace. We match Chinese customs data to US patent records, and leverage the quasi-random assignment of USPTO patent examiners to identify the causal effect of a US patent grant on the subsequent export performance of Chinese firms. Successful first-time patent applicants achieve significantly higher export growth, compared to otherwise similar first-time applicants that failed. This effect operates only in small part through market protection for technologically patent-related products in the US, and is largely driven by expansion in other markets. The response across destinations and products reveals that a US patent award signals the Chinese firm’s capacity to produce high-quality products and credibility to honor contracts, mitigating information frictions in international trade. There is little evidence for the relaxation of financial constraints or the promotion of follow-on innovation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了国际专利活动如何使新兴经济体的企业在全球市场中蓬勃发展。我们将中国海关数据与美国专利记录相匹配，并利用美国专利商标局（USPTO）专利审查员的准随机分配来识别美国专利授权对中国企业后续出口绩效的因果效应。与首次申请失败但其他方面相似的申请人相比，成功的首次专利申请人实现了显著更高的出口增长。这种效应仅在小部分程度上通过美国对技术相关专利产品的市场保护发挥作用，而主要驱动力来自其他市场的扩张。不同目的地和产品的反应表明，美国专利授权信号传递了中国企业生产高质量产品的能力和履行合同的信誉，从而减轻了国际贸易中的信息摩擦。几乎没有证据表明财务约束得到缓解或后续创新得到促进。

records.title_en: Measuring foreign exposure
records.title_cn: 衡量外部敞口
records.abstract_en: We introduce a model-based approximation for assessing foreign exposure via direct and indirect trade. In the model, exposure can be approximated by the fraction of production sold abroad, either directly or indirectly. Simulations show that this ratio accurately reflects the responses of value added to foreign supply shocks across most of the parameter space. It also effectively captures the responses of value added to foreign demand or trade shocks for a more restricted range of parameters. Conversely, other well-known metrics of foreign exposure do not perform well in the simulations. Data show that our measure of foreign exposure correlates significantly with various measures of economic activity, even in service sectors generally thought to be insulated from foreign influences. In contrast, these correlations are either insignificant or incorrectly signed when alternative measures of foreign exposure are used.
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一种基于模型的近似方法，通过直接和间接贸易来评估外部敞口。在该模型中，敞口可以近似为生产中被直接或间接销售到国外的比例。模拟显示，该比率在大部分参数空间内能准确反映增加值对外国供给冲击的反应。它也能在更有限的参数范围内有效捕捉增加值对外国需求或贸易冲击的反应。相反，其他知名的外部敞口指标在模拟中表现不佳。数据显示，我们的外部敞口衡量指标与各种经济活动指标显著相关，即使在通常被认为不受外国影响的服务业也是如此。相比之下，当使用替代的外部敞口指标时，这些相关性要么不显著，要么符号错误。

records.title_en: Demographics and real interest rates across countries and over time
records.title_cn: 各国及跨时期的人口结构与实际利率
records.abstract_en: We explore implications of demographic trends for real interest rates across countries and over time in a tractable multicountry model with imperfect capital mobility. We calibrate it to examine how the interaction of international financial integration and both domestic and foreign demographics shapes low-frequency movements in a country’s real rate. In more financially integrated countries, real rates are more sensitive to global developments than to domestic factors. We estimate panel error-correction models relating real rates to various drivers, imposing some structure informed by the model. Empirical results confirm global factors and domestic demographics are robust determinants of real rates. Alternative specifications highlight the importance of accounting for time-varying financial integration and a broad set of real rate drivers. Both model and empirical results suggest demographic trends explain a meaningful share of the global decline in real rates. Given projections, demographics should continue to exert downward pressure on real rates.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个具有不完全资本流动性的可处理多国模型中，探讨人口结构趋势对各国及跨时期实际利率的影响。我们校准该模型，以考察国际金融一体化与国内外人口结构的相互作用如何塑造一国实际利率的低频变动。在金融一体化程度更高的国家，实际利率对全球动态的敏感度高于对国内因素的敏感度。我们估计了将实际利率与各种驱动因素联系起来的面板误差修正模型，并施加了由模型提供的一些结构约束。实证结果证实，全球因素和国内人口结构是实际利率的稳健决定因素。替代规格强调了考虑时变金融一体化和广泛实际利率驱动因素的重要性。模型和实证结果均表明，人口结构趋势解释了全球实际利率下降的相当大一部分。根据预测，人口结构应继续对实际利率施加下行压力。

records.title_en: Skill-biased imports, skill acquisition, and migration
records.title_cn: 技能偏向型进口、技能获取与迁移
records.abstract_en: Imported capital goods, which embody skill-complementary technologies, can increase the supply of skills in developing countries. Focusing on China and using a shift-share design, we show that city-level capital goods import growth increases the local skill share and that both skill acquisition and migration play a role. We develop and quantify a spatial equilibrium model with these two mechanisms to examine the aggregate effects of capital goods imports, accounting for trade and migration linkages between cities. Counterfactual experiments suggest that the growth in capital goods imports in China between 2000 and 2010 led to a 3.1–7.3 million increase in the stock of college graduates, representing 4.4–10.4% of the total increase over this period, with the increase disproportionately occurring in coastal regions. These endogenous skill supply responses reduce by half the increase in the aggregate skill premium due to capital goods imports.
records.abstract_cn: 进口资本品，其内含技能互补技术，可以增加发展中国家的技能供给。以中国为研究对象，并采用偏移-份额设计，我们表明城市层面的资本品进口增长提高了本地技能份额，且技能获取和迁移均发挥作用。我们构建并量化了一个包含这两种机制的空间均衡模型，以考察资本品进口的总体效应，同时考虑城市间的贸易和迁移联系。反事实实验表明，中国在2000年至2010年间资本品进口的增长导致大学毕业生存量增加了3.1万至7.3万，占该时期总增量的4.4至10.4%，且这一增长不成比例地集中在沿海地区。这些内生的技能供给反应使资本品进口导致的总体技能溢价增幅减少了一半。

records.title_en: The Real effects of Brexit on labor demand: Evidence from firm-level data
records.title_cn: 英国脱欧对劳动力需求的真实影响：来自企业层面数据的证据
records.abstract_en: Using the distance to the Irish border of UK firms that have not changed their location since the 2016 Referendum to isolate the effects of Brexit at the firm level, we find that Brexit implementation in 2020 caused exposed firms to cut their workforce by up to 15.7% on average relative to non-exposed firms. These exposed firms are also more likely to have lower growth expectations and more likely to increase their research and development (R&D) expenditure. In addition, having ex-ante trade exposure, either with or outside the EU, can help alleviate such negative effects of Brexit. Such results highlight the role of trade exposure and the expectation channel, and support the hypothesis that firms prioritize innovations in response to Brexit.
records.abstract_cn: 利用自2016年公投以来未改变所在地的英国企业距离爱尔兰边境的远近，来隔离英国脱欧在企业层面的影响，我们发现2020年英国脱欧的实施导致受影响企业相对于未受影响企业平均裁员高达15.7%。这些受影响企业也更可能具有较低的增长预期，并更可能增加其研发（R&D）支出。此外，事先具有与欧盟内部或外部的贸易暴露，有助于缓解英国脱欧的这些负面影响。这些结果凸显了贸易暴露和预期渠道的作用，并支持了企业为应对英国脱欧而优先进行创新的假设。

records.title_en: The bank-lending channel of macroprudential policy: Evidence from cross-border bank flows
records.title_cn: 宏观审慎政策的银行信贷渠道：来自跨境银行流动的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the transmission of foreign macroprudential policy to domestic bank loan issuance in emerging markets via cross-border bank flows. We use the universe of bilateral cross-border bank credit transactions to destination countries matched to the macroprudential policy stance in source countries combined with bank balance sheet data in destination markets to document that a tightening of macroprudential policy in source countries reduces the positive impact of cross-border flows on the credit supply of banks in the destination. We show that the negative spillover effect of foreign macroprudential policy is operational only for capital-based and international-exposure policy tools. We also find evidence that macroprudential regulation in source countries shifts credit demand by borrowing firms and households across banks in the destination, whereas regulation performed by destination countries does not change the inward spillovers associated with cross-border flows.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了外国宏观审慎政策通过跨境银行流动对新兴市场国内银行贷款发放的传导。我们使用了目的地国家的双边跨境银行信贷交易全样本，这些交易与来源国的宏观审慎政策立场相匹配，并结合目的地市场的银行资产负债表数据，记录了来源国宏观审慎政策的收紧降低了跨境流动对目的地银行信贷供给的正面影响。我们表明，外国宏观审慎政策的负面溢出效应仅对基于资本和国际敞口的政策工具起作用。我们还发现证据表明，来源国的宏观审慎监管将借款企业和家庭的信贷需求在目的地的银行之间转移，而目的地国实施的监管并未改变与跨境流动相关的向内溢出效应。

records.title_en: Multinational production, technology diffusion, and economic growth
records.title_cn: 跨国生产、技术扩散与经济增长
records.abstract_en: We develop a tractable growth model to study the dynamic macroeconomic effects of multinational production (MP) across countries. In this framework, MP serves as the channel of international idea diffusion: when firms operate in a foreign country, they contribute to the local stock of knowledge. By embedding this mechanism into a quantitative model of trade and MP, we characterize the evolution of bilateral MP flows, trade flows, and technology dynamics across 54 economies. Counterfactual analysis reveals that reduction in MP costs boosted economic growth, especially in developing economies. We show that a 10-year MP sanction on Russia would reduce the welfare by 9.11%, although the immediate effect is small. We find that increasing outward MP costs for U.S. firms has immediate positive wage effects but negative growth implications. Additionally, a 10% increase in U.S. inward trade costs results in a 0.2% decline in the country’s present value of welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个易处理的增长模型，以研究跨国生产（MP）在各国间的动态宏观经济效应。在此框架中，跨国生产作为国际思想扩散的渠道：当企业在外国运营时，它们对当地知识存量做出贡献。通过将此机制嵌入一个包含贸易和跨国生产的定量模型，我们刻画了54个经济体中双边跨国生产流动、贸易流动和技术动态的演变。反事实分析显示，跨国生产成本的降低促进了经济增长，尤其是在发展中经济体。我们表明，对俄罗斯实施为期10年的跨国生产制裁将使其福利减少9.11%，尽管即时效应较小。我们发现，提高美国企业的对外跨国生产成本具有即时的正向工资效应，但带来负面的增长影响。此外，美国进口贸易成本增加10%将导致该国福利现值下降0.2%。

records.title_en: Making America great again? The economic impacts of Liberation Day tariffs
records.title_cn: 让美国再次伟大？解放日关税的经济影响
records.abstract_en: On April 2, 2025, President Trump declared “Liberation Day,” announcing broad tariffs to reduce trade deficits and revive U.S. industry. We analyze the long-term economic impacts of these tariffs. If trading partners do not retaliate, the tariffs could decrease the U.S. trade deficit and improve its terms of trade, yielding modest welfare gains when tariff revenues reduce the income tax burden for American workers. However, reciprocal retaliation results in net welfare losses for the U.S. economy. We derive the unilaterally optimal tariff policy and find that the USTR proposed tariffs, based on bilateral trade deficits, diverge markedly from the optimal design. The optimal tariff is 19%, uniformly applied across all trading partners, and determined solely by the aggregate trade deficit, rather than bilateral imbalances. Under optimal foreign retaliation to the USTR tariffs, U.S. welfare declines by up to 3.38% when accounting for input–output linkages, while global employment contracts by 0.58%.
records.abstract_cn: 2025年四月2日，特朗普总统宣布“解放日”，宣布广泛关税以减少贸易逆差并重振美国工业。我们分析了这些关税的长期经济影响。如果贸易伙伴不进行报复，关税可能减少美国贸易逆差并改善其贸易条件，当关税收入减轻美国工人的所得税负担时，带来适度的福利收益。然而，对等报复导致美国经济净福利损失。我们推导出单边最优关税政策，并发现基于双边贸易逆差的USTR提议关税与最优设计显著偏离。最优关税为19%，统一适用于所有贸易伙伴，仅由总贸易逆差决定，而非双边失衡。在外国对USTR关税的最优报复下，考虑投入产出关联时，美国福利下降高达3.38%，而全球就业收缩0.58%。

records.title_en: Has globalization changed the international transmission of U.S. monetary policy?
records.title_cn: 全球化是否改变了美国货币政策的国际传导？
records.abstract_en: We estimate a time-varying parameter vector autoregression to examine the evolution of international spillovers of U.S. monetary policy in light of increasing globalization in real and financial markets. We find that the adverse international effects of a U.S. tightening have substantially increased over the past three decades, peaking during the Great Recession before stabilizing – a timing that aligns well with observed trends in globalization and slowbalization dynamics. Cross-country analysis and counterfactual simulations suggest that the estimated amplification of the spillover effects over time has been primarily driven by the surge in trade integration, while rising financial integration has contributed only modestly.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了一个时变参数向量自回归模型，以考察在实体和金融市场日益全球化的背景下，美国货币政策国际溢出效应的演变。我们发现，美国紧缩政策的负面国际影响在过去三十年中显著增加，在大衰退期间达到顶峰，随后趋于稳定——这一时间点与观察到的全球化和缓慢全球化动态趋势高度吻合。跨国分析和反事实模拟表明，随时间推移估计的溢出效应放大主要受到贸易一体化激增的驱动，而金融一体化的上升仅贡献了适度的影响。

records.title_en: Chinese roads in India: The effect of transport infrastructure on economic development
records.title_cn: 印度境内的中国道路：交通基础设施对经济发展的影响
records.abstract_en: India and China followed different strategies in the design of their recent highway networks. India first focused on connecting the four largest economic centers of the country, the Golden Quadrilateral, while China had the explicit strategy of connecting intermediate-sized cities. This paper analyzes the aggregate and distributional effects of transport infrastructure in India based on a general equilibrium trade framework. I compare the effect of the Golden Quadrilateral to a counterfactual network that connects India’s intermediate-sized cities. To construct the counterfactual network, I propose a heuristic network design algorithm to maximize aggregate real income net of road construction costs in the general equilibrium model, and I show that the heuristic algorithm provides a good approximation of the optimal network. The results suggest that the actual network led to sizable aggregate gains but unequal effects across regions. The income-maximizing counterfactual network is substantially larger than the actual Indian network, would imply further aggregate gains, and would benefit the lagging regions of India.
records.abstract_cn: 印度和中国在近期高速公路网络的设计上采取了不同的策略。印度首先聚焦于连接国内四大经济中心，即“黄金四边形”，而中国则明确采取了连接中等规模城市的策略。本文基于一般均衡贸易框架，分析了印度交通基础设施的总体及分配效应。我将“黄金四边形”的效果与一个连接印度中等规模城市的反事实网络进行了比较。为构建该反事实网络，我提出了一种启发式网络设计算法，以在一般均衡模型中最大化扣除道路建设成本后的总实际收入，并证明该启发式算法能很好地近似最优网络。结果表明，实际网络带来了可观的总体收益，但各地区间效应不均。以收入最大化为目标的反事实网络规模远大于印度实际网络，将带来进一步的总体收益，并惠及印度落后地区。

records.title_en: Real exchange rate and net trade dynamics: Financial and trade shocks
records.title_cn: 实际汇率与净贸易动态：金融冲击与贸易冲击
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the drivers of the US real exchange rate (RER), with a particular focus on its comovement with net trade (NT) flows. We consider the entire spectrum of frequencies, as the low-frequency variation accounts for 62 and 64 percent of the unconditional variance of the RER and NT, respectively. We develop a generalization of the standard international business cycle model that successfully rationalizes the joint dynamics of the RER and NT while accounting for the major puzzles of the RER. We find that, while financial shocks are necessary to capture high frequency variation in the RER, trade shocks are essential for the lower frequency fluctuations.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了美国实际汇率（RER）的驱动因素，特别关注其与净贸易（NT）流动的联动性。我们考虑了整个频率谱，因为低频变动分别占RER和NT无条件方差的62和64%。我们开发了标准国际商业周期模型的推广形式，该模型成功解释了RER与NT的联合动态，同时考虑了RER的主要谜题。我们发现，虽然金融冲击对于捕捉RER的高频变动是必要的，但贸易冲击对于低频波动至关重要。

records.title_en: Household responses to trade shocks
records.title_cn: 家庭对贸易冲击的反应
records.abstract_en: We study the impact of Chinese import competition in the 2000s on workers and their households in England and Wales. We document both the direct employment changes of individuals affected by trade exposure, as well as the employment response of individuals whose partner is exposed to trade. We find substantial differences by gender. Men respond to import competition by increasing labour force participation at older ages, and by moving into self-employment. This is true both in response to their own trade exposure, and as an ‘added worker effect’ when their partner is exposed to the shock. By contrast, we find no such response for women, who do not increase labour supply following shocks affecting their partners. Male workers exposed to import competition largely enter self-employed jobs in historically male-dominated occupations, as do men reacting to shocks affecting their partners.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了2000年中国进口竞争对英格兰和威尔士工人及其家庭的影响。我们记录了受贸易暴露影响的个人直接就业变化，以及其伴侣受贸易暴露影响的个人的就业反应。我们发现性别之间存在显著差异。男性通过提高老年时的劳动力参与率以及转向自雇来应对进口竞争。这既体现在他们自身贸易暴露的反应中，也体现在当伴侣受到冲击时的‘附加工人效应’中。相比之下，我们发现女性没有这样的反应，她们在伴侣受到冲击后不会增加劳动力供给。受进口竞争影响的男性工人主要进入历史上以男性为主的职业中的自雇工作，对伴侣受到冲击作出反应的男性也是如此。

records.title_en: The tails of gravity: Using expectiles to quantify the trade-margins effects of economic integration agreements
records.title_cn: 引力模型的尾部：利用期望分位数量化经济一体化协定对贸易边际的影响
records.abstract_en: Although there is evidence suggesting that the effects of trade liberalizations likely vary across the distribution of trade flows, trade economists have focused almost entirely on conditional mean estimates of their trade elasticities. We propose the novel use of Poisson-based expectile regressions to estimate the heterogeneous effects of trade liberalizations across the entire conditional distribution. Like standard Poisson regression, this method does not need the dependent variable to be logged, accommodates a mass of observations at zero, and is easy to implement, allowing the estimation of gravity equations with the standard three-way fixed effects specification. Using the proposed estimator, we find systematic evidence that trade liberalizations have larger effects at the lower tail of the conditional distribution. We then use the proposed method to investigate the causes of this heterogeneity, and our results suggest that the success of trade liberalizations strongly depends on potential for expansions along the extensive margin.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管有证据表明贸易自由化的效应可能随贸易流分布的不同而变化，但贸易经济学家几乎完全集中于其贸易弹性的条件均值估计。我们提出了一种新颖的方法，即基于泊松的期望分位数回归，来估计贸易自由化在整个条件分布中的异质性效应。与标准泊松回归类似，此方法无需对因变量取对数，能容纳大量零值观测，且易于实施，允许使用标准的三维固定效应设定来估计引力方程。利用所提出的估计量，我们发现了系统性证据，表明贸易自由化在条件分布的下尾部分具有更大的效应。随后，我们使用所提出的方法探究这种异质性的原因，结果表明贸易自由化的成功在很大程度上取决于扩展边际上的扩张潜力。

records.title_en: Quantitative easing and the supply of safe assets: Evidence from international bond safety premia
records.title_cn: 量化宽松与安全资产供给：来自国际债券安全溢价的证据
records.abstract_en: Through large-scale asset purchases, widely known as quantitative easing (QE), central banks around the world have affected the supply of safe assets by buying quasi-safe bonds in exchange for truly safe reserves. We examine the pricing effects of the European Central Bank’s bond purchases in the 2015–2021 period on an international panel of bond safety premia from four highly rated countries: Denmark, Germany, Sweden, and Switzerland. We find statistically significant negative effects for all four countries, highlighting an international spillover channel through which QE programs reduce bond safety premia by expanding the supply of truly safe assets.
records.abstract_cn: 通过大规模资产购买，即广为人知的量化宽松（QE），世界各地的中央银行通过购买准安全债券以换取真正安全的准备金，影响了安全资产的供给。我们考察了欧洲央行在2015-2021年期间的债券购买对来自四个高评级国家（丹麦、德国、瑞典和瑞士）的国际债券安全溢价面板数据的定价效应。我们发现对所有四个国家都有统计上显著的负面效应，突显了一种国际溢出渠道，通过该渠道，量化宽松计划通过扩大真正安全资产的供给来降低债券安全溢价。

records.title_en: A search and learning model of export dynamics
records.title_cn: 出口动态的搜索与学习模型
records.abstract_en: Exporting is harder than selling at home, and overcoming barriers takes time. We identify key obstacles to exporting and measure their importance by developing a model of firm-level export dynamics with costly customer search, visibility effects, and learning about product appeal. Fitting the model to U.S. import data on Colombian manufactures, we replicate patterns of exporter maturation. A firm’s customer base and market knowledge are valuable intangible assets: losing both through “market amnesia” would cost Colombian exporters US$14.2 billion, over twice annual exports to the U.S. About a quarter of this reflects lost future sales to current customers; the rest stems from the cost of relearning product appeal and regaining visibility. The frictions we estimate slow trade’s response to shocks: the 10-year export sales response to an exchange rate shock is 48 percent larger than the 1-year response.
records.abstract_cn: 出口比在国内销售更为困难，克服这些障碍需要时间。我们识别了出口的关键障碍，并通过构建一个包含昂贵客户搜索、可见性效应和产品吸引力学习的企业层面出口动态模型来衡量其重要性。将该模型拟合至美国进口哥伦比亚制成品的贸易数据，我们复现了出口商成熟化的模式。企业的客户基础和市场知识是有价值的无形资产：因“市场失忆”而失去这两者将使哥伦比亚出口商损失14.2亿美元，超过其对美国年出口额的两倍。其中约四分之一反映了当前客户未来销售的损失；其余部分则源于重新学习产品吸引力和恢复可见性的成本。我们估计的摩擦减缓了贸易对冲击的响应：汇率冲击后10年的出口销售响应比48%年的响应大1。

records.title_en: Beyond the spike at zero: Understanding nominal wage rigidity through empirical and model-based approaches
records.title_cn: 超越零点的尖峰：通过实证与模型方法理解名义工资刚性
records.abstract_en: I examine the cyclical properties of nominal wage change distributions across time and US states using nationally representative household surveys from 1979 to 2018. The novel finding is that the share of workers with no wage changes, which accounts for the large spike at zero in the nominal wage change distribution, is more countercyclical than the share of workers with wage cuts. I analyze heterogeneous agent models with six alternative wage-setting schemes and conclude that the model with downward nominal wage rigidity is the most consistent with empirical findings regarding the shape and cyclicality of wage change distributions.
records.abstract_cn: 我利用1979年至2018年间具有全国代表性的家庭调查数据，考察了美国各州及不同时期名义工资变化分布的周期性特征。新发现是，无工资变化的工人比例（这解释了名义工资变化分布中零点的巨大尖峰）比工资削减的工人比例更具逆周期性。我分析了六种不同工资设定方案的异质性主体模型，并得出结论，具有向下名义工资刚性的模型在工资变化分布的形状和周期性方面与实证发现最为一致。

records.title_en: Can trade policy change gender equality? Evidence from Chile
records.title_cn: 贸易政策能否改变性别平等？来自智利的证据
records.abstract_en: Do firms reorganize gender composition of their employment in response to trade shocks? Using novel data on gender composition of employment across several occupational groups for Chilean manufacturing firms matched with customs data for 1995–2007, a developing country with low gender equality, and utilizing the 1998 Chile–Mexico Free Trade Agreement (FTA) as the quasi-natural shock, we document the first evidence that the share of female white-collar workers increased by 10% for new exporters exporting to Mexico due to the FTA. This happened through a substitution effect from male to female high-skilled workers due to higher use of technology (both domestic and foreign), high-skilled non-production tasks, and reduction in discrimination. We also show that this increase in this share of white-collar female workers is due to a demand- rather than supply-side effect. Overall, we emphasize that trade policy can play an important role in addressing the gender gap in employment.
records.abstract_cn: 企业是否会因贸易冲击而重组其就业的性别构成？利用智利制造业企业多个职业群体就业性别构成的新数据，结合1995-2007年的海关数据，以及一个性别平等程度较低的发展中国家，并利用1998年智利-墨西哥自由贸易协定（FTA）作为准自然冲击，我们记录了首个证据：由于该自由贸易协定，向墨西哥出口的新出口商中，女性白领工人的比例增加了10%。这一变化是通过从男性高技能工人向女性高技能工人的替代效应实现的，原因是技术（国内和国外）使用增加、高技能非生产性任务增多以及歧视减少。我们还表明，白领女性工人比例的增加是由于需求侧而非供给侧效应。总体而言，我们强调贸易政策在解决就业性别差距方面可以发挥重要作用。

records.title_en: Lost in the net? Broadband internet and youth mental health
records.title_cn: 迷失在网络中？宽带互联网与青少年心理健康
records.abstract_en: How does the internet affect young people’s mental health? We study this question using administrative data on the universe of cases of mental disorders diagnosed in Italian hospitals between 2001 and 2013, which we combine with broadband internet availability at the municipal level. Broadband internet access raises the prevalence of mental disorders among younger cohorts (born between 1985 and 1995) by 0.08 standard deviation units, but it does not impact older individuals (1974 and 1984). The adverse effects are driven by individuals who were exposed early in their lives (before the age of 20). These effects persist when examining instances of self-harm and urgent or compulsory hospitalizations, indicating that the negative outcomes are not merely a result of increased awareness and detection of these conditions. The detrimental impacts span across different pathologies, including depression, anxiety, drug abuse, and personality disorders for both genders, in addition to eating disorders for females.
records.abstract_cn: 互联网如何影响年轻人的心理健康？我们利用意大利医院在2001年至2013年间诊断的所有精神障碍病例的行政数据，并结合市级宽带互联网可用性来研究这一问题。宽带互联网接入使较年轻群体（出生于1985年至1995年间）的精神障碍患病率提高了0.08个标准差单位，但对较年长个体（出生于1974年至1984年间）没有影响。不利影响主要由早年（20岁之前）接触互联网的个体驱动。在检查自残和紧急或强制住院案例时，这些影响依然存在，表明负面结果不仅仅是由于对这些情况的认知和检测增加所致。不利影响涵盖多种病理，包括抑郁症、焦虑症、药物滥用和人格障碍，对两性均如此，此外还包括女性的饮食失调。

records.title_en: The effect of housing wealth on health care spending
records.title_cn: 住房财富对医疗支出的影响
records.abstract_en: The U.S. healthcare system requires substantial out-of-pocket payments by most consumers, which can prevent some from receiving needed medical services. At the same time, housing wealth comprises a significant proportion of household wealth that could be used to pay for medical care. We analyze the effects of housing wealth on out-of-pocket medical expenditures among older homeowners. Using data from the Health and Retirement Study and various measures of home price changes, we find no evidence that housing wealth impacts out-of-pocket medical spending. The estimates are universally small and precise, allowing us to rule out even modest-sized effects. Effects are zero across the expenditure distribution, for specific categories of expenditure, and for different types of homeowners split by health insurance status and SES. We present suggestive evidence that our results represent a mix of homeowners not needing to access their housing wealth for additional medical care and being unwilling or unable to access their home equity.
records.abstract_cn: 美国医疗体系要求大多数消费者承担大量的自付费用，这可能阻止一些人获得所需的医疗服务。同时，住房财富构成家庭财富的重要部分，可用于支付医疗费用。我们分析了住房财富对老年房主自付医疗支出的影响。利用健康与退休研究的数据以及多种房价变动指标，我们未发现住房财富影响自付医疗支出的证据。估计值普遍较小且精确，使我们能够排除即使是中等程度的影响。在支出分布、特定支出类别以及按医疗保险状况和社会经济地位划分的不同类型房主中，影响均为零。我们提供了提示性证据，表明我们的结果反映了部分房主无需动用住房财富来支付额外医疗费用，以及部分房主不愿或无法动用其房屋净值的情况。

records.title_en: Effects of informal caring on labour market outcomes of carers: Evidence from HILDA
records.title_cn: 非正式照护对照护者劳动力市场结果的影响：来自HILDA的证据
records.abstract_en: This study examines the causal impact of informal caregiving on labour market outcomes and well-being using data from the Household, Income and Labour Dynamics in Australia (HILDA) survey. We combine an event study design with an instrumental variable (IV) strategy, leveraging exogenous variation from serious illness or injury to a family member. Event study results show that health shocks significantly increase informal caregiving, with particularly large effects for women and older individuals. These shocks also lead to reductions in employment among these groups, as well as declines in hours worked, worsening mental health, and increased reliance on government support and early retirement. To isolate the causal effect of caregiving, we instrument caregiving with the timing of the health shock. IV estimates indicate that assuming caregiving responsibilities leads to large reductions in labour supply—weekly work hours fall by 9.7 h for main carers and up to 22.5 h for carers of partners. Our findings highlight the substantial economic costs of informal caregiving, with important implications for labour force participation in an ageing society.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究利用澳大利亚家庭、收入与劳动力动态（HILDA）调查数据，考察非正式照护对劳动力市场结果和福祉的因果影响。我们将事件研究设计与工具变量（IV）策略相结合，利用家庭成员重病或受伤带来的外生变异。事件研究结果显示，健康冲击显著增加了非正式照护，对女性和年长个体的影响尤为显著。这些冲击还导致这些群体的就业减少，以及工作小时数下降、心理健康恶化、对政府支持依赖增加和提前退休。为隔离照护的因果效应，我们使用健康冲击的时间作为照护的工具变量。IV估计表明，承担照护责任导致劳动力供给大幅减少——主要照护者的每周工作小时数下降9.7小时，照护伴侣的照护者下降高达22.5小时。我们的研究结果凸显了非正式照护的巨大经济成本，对老龄化社会中的劳动力参与具有重要启示。

records.title_en: Explaining the long-term care insurance puzzle: The role of preferences for correlation and for quality of life over wealth
records.title_cn: 解释长期护理保险之谜：相关性偏好与生活质量相对于财富的偏好的作用
records.abstract_en: The paper investigates the role of two demand-side determinants of long-term care insurance: correlation preference and relative preference for quality of life over wealth. We model the effect of those preferences on the joint decision to buy long-term care and long-term care insurance contract. We test the model using data from a laboratory experiment in France. While the experimental results offer only partial support for the theoretical predictions—specifically, correlation aversion does not account for over-insurance, our analysis provides evidence that correlation seeking and the relative preference for quality of life over wealth explain the limited uptake of long-term care insurance.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了长期护理保险的两个需求侧决定因素的作用：相关性偏好和相对于财富的生活质量偏好。我们模拟了这些偏好对购买长期护理和长期护理保险合同联合决策的影响。我们使用法国实验室实验的数据来检验该模型。虽然实验结果仅为理论预测提供了部分支持——具体而言，相关性厌恶并不能解释过度保险，但我们的分析提供了证据表明，相关性寻求和相对于财富的生活质量偏好解释了长期护理保险的有限购买率。

records.title_en: Abortion access and child protective services involvement
records.title_cn: 堕胎可及性与儿童保护服务介入
records.abstract_en: Existing evidence has found that abortion restrictions result in fewer and delayed abortions. Such restrictions may indirectly affect child wellbeing both through changes in births and for existing children in the home through mechanisms including substantial financial strains, negative health consequences, and intra-household power dynamics. Following the Dobbs decision, state-level abortion decisions have led to significantly greater abortion restrictions. We investigate the effects of abortion access on child welfare involvement using data from the National Child Abuse & Neglect Data System (NCANDS). We utilize pre- and post-Dobbs data from 2017-2023, and estimate both difference-in-differences and event study methods, using both distance changes and policy changes. We find that increased distance to nearest abortion care is associated with higher rates of CPS referrals. Our findings provide critical insights into the broader social and health implications of abortion restrictions in post-Dobbs.
records.abstract_cn: 现有证据发现，堕胎限制导致堕胎数量减少和延迟。此类限制可能通过出生变化及对家中现有儿童的影响，间接影响儿童福祉，其机制包括重大经济压力、负面健康后果和家庭内部权力动态。在Dobbs裁决之后，州级堕胎决策导致了显著的更严格的堕胎限制。我们利用国家儿童虐待与忽视数据系统（NCANDS）的数据，研究堕胎可及性对儿童福利介入的影响。我们使用2017-2023年的Dobbs前后数据，并采用双重差分和事件研究法，同时利用距离变化和政策变化。我们发现，到最近堕胎护理机构的距离增加与更高的儿童保护服务（CPS）转介率相关。我们的发现为Dobbs后堕胎限制的更广泛社会与健康影响提供了关键见解。

records.title_en: The effects of state paid sick leave mandates on parental childcare time
records.title_cn: 州级带薪病假规定对父母育儿时间的影响
records.abstract_en: The U.S. lacks a federal paid sick leave policy. To date, 18 states and the District of Columbia have adopted or announced paid sick leave mandates that require employers to provide up to seven days of paid leave per year that can be used for family responsibilities and healthcare. Using time diaries from the 2004–2023 American Time Use Survey and difference-in-differences methods, we estimate the effects of these state paid sick leave mandates on parents’ time spent providing childcare. We find that post-mandate, parental time spent providing primary childcare time increases by 5.8%, with effects being driven by women with younger children. Parents also increase their total time with children by 3.4%, and fathers living with school-aged children only increase their time supervising children while participating in leisure activities by 11.9%. Overall, our findings suggest that paid sick leave mandates allow working parents to better balance work and childcare responsibilities.
records.abstract_cn: 美国缺乏联邦带薪病假政策。迄今为止，已有18个州和哥伦比亚特区采纳或宣布了带薪病假规定，要求雇主每年提供最多七天的带薪假期，可用于家庭责任和医疗保健。利用2004-2023年美国时间使用调查的时间日记和双重差分方法，我们估计了这些州级带薪病假规定对父母提供育儿时间的影响。我们发现，规定实施后，父母提供主要育儿的时间增加了5.8%，这一效应主要由有年幼子女的女性驱动。父母与子女共处的总时间也增加了3.4%，而与学龄子女同住的父亲仅在参与休闲活动时监督子女的时间增加了11.9%。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，带薪病假规定使在职父母能够更好地平衡工作与育儿责任。

records.title_en: The effects of restricted abortion access on IUDs and vasectomies: Evidence from Texas
records.title_cn: 限制堕胎获取对宫内节育器和输精管切除术的影响：来自德克萨斯州的证据
records.abstract_en: Both contraception and abortion result in fertility reductions, but whether they are substitutes remains an open question. In 2013, Texas passed House Bill 2 (HB2), a policy that imposed strict regulations on abortion providers. Using administrative outpatient records from Texas, we exploit the passage of HB2 to identify the effects of restricted abortion access on the timing and demand for intrauterine devices (IUDs) and vasectomies using an event study design. We find evidence that expectations of limited abortion access significantly increase the demand for IUDs, with no effect on the incidence of vasectomies. These findings support the hypothesis that abortion and contraception are substitutes, particularly for individuals with the capacity to become pregnant.
records.abstract_cn: 避孕和堕胎都会导致生育率下降，但它们是否是替代品仍是一个悬而未决的问题。2013年，德克萨斯州通过了众议院法案2（HB2），该政策对堕胎服务提供者实施了严格规定。利用德克萨斯州的行政门诊记录，我们利用HB2的通过，采用事件研究设计来识别限制堕胎获取对宫内节育器（IUDs）和输精管切除术时机及需求的影响。我们发现，预期堕胎获取受限会显著增加对宫内节育器的需求，但对输精管切除术的发生率没有影响。这些发现支持了堕胎和避孕是替代品的假设，特别是对于有能力怀孕的个体而言。

records.title_en: Nursing home payroll subsidies and the trade-off between staffing and access to care for Medicaid enrollees
records.title_cn: 疗养院工资补贴以及医疗补助参与者的人员配备和护理机会之间的权衡
records.abstract_en: Payroll subsidies are a promising tool for increasing nursing home staffing levels. However, promoting increased staffing may come at the expense of access to care for Medicaid enrollees if it enables nursing homes to attract more lucrative, non-Medicaid residents. In this study, I examine a set of payroll subsidies offered by state Medicaid programs between 1998 and 2010, using nursing home-level variation in subsidy generosity to identify subsidy effects. I find that each additional (2010) dollar of subsidies offered per resident-day increased staffing by just over 10 min per resident-day, but decreased the Medicaid share of new nursing home admissions by about 1.8 percentage points. These figures translate into overall average treatment effects equivalent to an increase in staffing by approximately 7.4% of pre-subsidy average staffing, and a decrease in the Medicaid-share of admissions by 11.5% relative to the pre-subsidy baseline. The subsidies also increased nursing home resident turnover and decreased the average care needs of newly admitted residents. Overall, these results highlight that while nursing home payroll subsidies are effective tools for encouraging increased staffing levels, the subsidies also can lead to changes in nursing home admissions and the characteristics of admitted residents.
records.abstract_cn: 工资补贴是提高疗养院人员配备水平的一个很有前景的工具。然而，如果促进疗养院能够吸引更多利润丰厚的非医疗补助居民，那么促进增加人员配备可能会以牺牲医疗补助参与者获得护理的机会为代价。在这项研究中，我研究了1998和2010之间州医疗补助计划提供的一组工资补贴，利用养老院补贴慷慨程度的变化来确定补贴效果。我发现，每个住院日提供的每额外 (2010) 美元的补贴都会使每个住院日的人员配备增加略多于 10 分钟，但会降低医疗补助在新疗养院入院人数中所占的比例约 1.8 个百分点。这些数字转化为总体平均治疗效果，相当于相对于补贴前基线，人员配置增加了大约 7.4% 的补贴前平均人员配置，以及医疗补助入院份额相对于补贴前基线减少了 11.5%。补贴还增加了疗养院居民的流动率，并降低了新入住居民的平均护理需求。总体而言，这些结果强调，虽然疗养院工资补贴是鼓励增加人员配备水平的有效工具，但补贴也可能导致疗养院入院情况和入院居民特征的变化。

records.title_en: Overcoming medical overuse with AI assistance: An experimental investigation
records.title_cn: 借助人工智能辅助克服医疗过度使用：一项实验研究
records.abstract_en: This study examines the role of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in reducing medical overtreatment, a critical healthcare challenge that increases costs and patient risks. In two experiments – with 196 physicians at a hospital and 120 students at a medical school in Wuhan – we use a novel medical prescription task under three incentive schemes: flat (constant pay), progressive (pay increases with treatment quantity), and regressive (penalties for overtreatment) to estimate receptivity to AI assistance and its effects on overtreatment and treatment accuracy, and test whether effects vary with incentives. AI recommendation of a treatment is estimated to increase the probability a physician prescribes it by 25.7–28.4 percentage points (pp), with the largest effect under the flat scheme. Physicians are more receptive to AI recommendations in medical domains with which they are less familiar. We estimate that AI assistance reduces the probability a physician overtreats by 10.9–25.7 pp (15.2–80.3%), with significantly larger absolute and relative effects under the flat scheme compared to progressive and regressive schemes. AI assistance improves physicians’ treatment accuracy by 9.8–13.3 pp (14.6–19.9%), with the largest absolute effect under the regressive scheme. These findings are corroborated by the medical school experiment, which reveals that factors indicative of insufficient ability account for 34% of the explained variation in overtreatment, monetary incentives account for 22%, patient welfare considerations account for 20%, and factors related to defensive medicine for 10%. These results provide valuable insights for healthcare administrators considering AI integration into healthcare systems.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了人工智能（AI）在减少医疗过度治疗中的作用，这是一个增加成本和患者风险的关键医疗挑战。在两项实验中——一家医院的196名医生和武汉一所医学院的120名学生——我们使用一种新颖的医疗处方任务，在三种激励方案下进行：固定（恒定薪酬）、递增（薪酬随治疗数量增加）和递减（对过度治疗进行惩罚），以估计对AI辅助的接受度及其对过度治疗和治疗准确性的影响，并测试这些影响是否随激励而变化。估计AI推荐治疗会使医生开具该处方的概率增加25.7-28.4个百分点（pp），在固定方案下效果最大。医生在不太熟悉的医疗领域对AI推荐更为接受。我们估计，AI辅助使医生过度治疗的概率降低10.9-25.7个百分点（15.2-80.3%），与递增和递减方案相比，固定方案下的绝对和相对效应显著更大。AI辅助使医生的治疗准确性提高9.8-13.3个百分点（14.6-19.9%），在递减方案下绝对效应最大。这些发现得到了医学院实验的证实，该实验显示，表明能力不足的因素占过度治疗解释变异的34%，货币激励占22%，患者福利考虑占20%，与防御性医疗相关的因素占10%。这些结果为考虑将AI整合到医疗系统中的医疗管理者提供了宝贵的见解。

records.title_en: The impact of nurse practitioner scope-of-practice laws on preventable hospitalizations
records.title_cn: 执业护士执业范围法律对可预防住院的影响
records.abstract_en: The increased use of nurse practitioners (NPs) to provide healthcare represents an important policy option to expand access to care. However, restrictive scope-of-practice laws limit NPs’ ability to deliver care in about half of all states. I examine the effect of relaxing these laws (by granting NPs full practice authority) on hospital discharges for conditions classified as prevention quality indicators (PQIs) across 22 states between 2010 and 2019. PQIs measure hospital admissions that may be avoidable with timely outpatient care. I find that full practice authority reduces avoidable hospitalizations for diabetes and other chronic conditions, with particularly consistent effects among privately insured patients. Hospital stays for PQI conditions become longer on average, suggesting that relatively healthier patients are more likely to avoid hospitalization. These results indicate that full practice authority improves access to outpatient care and allows for more efficient use of inpatient resources.
records.abstract_cn: 增加使用执业护士（NPs）提供医疗服务是扩大医疗服务可及性的重要政策选择。然而，大约一半的州存在限制性执业范围法律，限制了NPs提供护理的能力。我研究了放宽这些法律（授予NPs完全执业权）对2010年至2019年间22个州中按预防质量指标（PQIs）分类的住院出院的影响。PQIs衡量的是通过及时的门诊护理可能避免的住院。我发现，完全执业权减少了糖尿病和其他慢性病的可避免住院，尤其是在私人保险患者中效果一致。PQI条件下的住院时间平均延长，这表明相对更健康的患者更可能避免住院。这些结果表明，完全执业权改善了门诊护理的可及性，并允许更有效地利用住院资源。

records.title_en: Firm quality and health maintenance
records.title_cn: 坚定品质，维护健康
records.abstract_en: We estimate the impact of firm quality – primarily measured by the firm-level wage premium – on the health maintenance of employees. Using linked employer–employee administrative panel data from Hungary, we analyze the dynamics of healthcare use before and after moving to a new firm. We show that moving to a higher-paying firm leads to higher consumption of drugs for cardiovascular conditions and more diagnostic and primary care visits, without evidence of deteriorating physical health, and, among men and older workers, to lower consumption of medications for mental health conditions. The results are robust to using alternative firm quality indicators based on productivity and worker flows, and to controlling for firm size, individual wage, and possible peer effects. The results suggest that higher-paying firms provide beneficial health-related amenities via the detection of previously undiagnosed chronic physical illnesses and improved mental health. Plausible mechanisms include higher-quality occupational health check-ups and less stressful working conditions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计公司质量（主要通过公司层面的工资溢价来衡量）对员工健康维护的影响。使用来自匈牙利的关联雇主-雇员管理小组数据，我们分析了搬到新公司之前和之后的医疗保健使用动态。我们发现，在没有证据表明身体健康状况恶化的情况下，跳槽到薪酬更高的公司会导致心血管疾病药物的消耗量增加，并导致更多的诊断和初级保健就诊，并且在男性和老年工人中，治疗心理健康疾病的药物消耗量会减少。结果对于使用基于生产率和工人流动的替代公司质量指标以及控制公司规模、个人工资和可能的同伴效应来说是稳健的。结果表明，高薪公司通过检测以前未诊断的慢性身体疾病和改善心理健康来提供有益的健康相关设施。合理的机制包括更高质量的职业健康检查和压力较小的工作条件。

records.title_en: Impacts of health checkup programs standardization on working-age self-employed and unemployed: Insights from Japan’s local government response to national policy
records.title_cn: 健康检查项目标准化对劳动年龄自雇者和失业者的影响：来自日本地方政府对国家政策回应的见解
records.abstract_en: This study analyzes the effects of the expansion of municipal per capita expenses on health checkup programs, following the introduction of the Specific Health Checkups and Specific Health Guidance (SHC-SHG), on the health outcomes and behaviors of self-employed and unemployed populations, which have been largely overlooked by previous research. To address this, we applied a dosing difference-in-differences (DID) estimation method, exploiting variation in treatment intensity across municipalities. The DID estimation reveals that the SHC-SHG introduction led to a reduction in the proportion of people diagnosed with lifestyle-related diseases in the municipalities that required significant increases in per-capita health checkup program expenses to comply with the new program, with a more pronounced impact on those with multiple diagnoses compared to those with a single diagnosis. A subgroup analysis indicates that health improvements following the SHC-SHG introduction were observed among self-employed workers and homeowners, whereas such improvements were not evident among the unemployed and renters. Moreover, we identify significant behavioral changes among the population in the high-expansion municipalities following the policy introduction. A back-of-the-envelope calculation demonstrates the municipal response to the SHC-SHG introduction is cost-effective.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了在引入特定健康检查和特定健康指导（SHC-SHG）后，市政人均健康检查项目支出的扩大对自雇和失业人群健康结果和行为的影响，这些人群在很大程度上被以往研究忽视。为此，我们采用了剂量双重差分（DID）估计方法，利用各市町村治疗强度的差异。DID估计显示，在需要显著增加人均健康检查项目支出以符合新项目的市町村中，SHC-SHG的引入导致被诊断患有生活方式相关疾病的人口比例下降，且对多重诊断者的影响比单一诊断者更为显著。亚组分析表明，SHC-SHG引入后的健康改善在自雇工人和房主中观察到，而在失业者和租房者中则不明显。此外，我们识别出政策引入后高扩张市町村人口中显著的行为变化。一项粗略计算表明，市政对SHC-SHG引入的回应具有成本效益。

records.title_en: Intergenerational effects of sick leave on child human capital
records.title_cn: 病假对子女人力资本的代际影响
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the intergenerational consequences of parental participation in government social insurance programs, using one of the largest social insurance programs in the world: sick leave. We exploit quasi-random assignment of patients to general practitioners (GPs) in Norway, who vary in their propensity to certify sick leave of different lengths, to estimate the effects of access to longer sick leave for the marginal individual. Linking administrative data on patients and their children, we show that assignment to a more lenient GP lowers children’s GPA in adolescence, reduces the likelihood of completing upper secondary education, and decreases enrollment in higher education. These effects appear to operate through changes in parental trajectories: more sick leave leads to lower long-term earnings, greater reliance on welfare, and deterioration in mental health.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用世界上最大的社会保险项目之一——病假，考察了父母参与政府社会保险项目的代际后果。我们利用挪威患者被准随机分配给全科医生（GPs）的情况，这些医生在开具不同长度病假证明的倾向上存在差异，以估计边缘个体获得更长病假的影响。通过关联患者及其子女的行政数据，我们表明，被分配给更宽松的全科医生会降低子女在青春期的平均绩点（GPA），降低完成高中教育的可能性，并减少高等教育入学率。这些效应似乎通过父母轨迹的变化起作用：更多的病假导致长期收入降低、对福利的依赖增加以及心理健康恶化。

records.title_en: The effects of earned income tax credits on intergenerational health mobility in the United States
records.title_cn: 劳动所得税抵免对美国代际健康流动性的影响
records.abstract_en: Intergenerational health mobility is an important marker of health opportunity and equity, yet empirical research in this field remains sparse, particularly concerning the effects of public policies. We present the first empirical evidence of the effects of the Earned Income Tax Credits (EITC), one of the largest and most effective anti-poverty programs in the US, on intergenerational health mobility. We use self-reported health status from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics and explore temporal, geographic, and family structure variations in childhood exposure to maximum EITC benefits. We find that the EITC generally improved intergenerational health mobility, especially upward health mobility.
records.abstract_cn: 代际健康流动性是健康机会和平等的重要标志，然而该领域的实证研究仍然稀少，尤其是关于公共政策影响的研究。我们首次提供了劳动所得税抵免（EITC）——美国规模最大且最有效的反贫困项目之一——对代际健康流动性影响的实证证据。我们使用收入动态面板研究中的自报健康状况，并探讨童年时期暴露于最高EITC福利的时间、地理和家庭结构差异。我们发现EITC总体上改善了代际健康流动性，尤其是向上的健康流动性。

records.title_en: Nonlinear reimbursement rules for preventive and curative medical care
records.title_cn: 预防性与治疗性医疗服务的非线性报销规则
records.abstract_en: This study examines nonlinear reimbursement rules for secondary preventive and therapeutic care. Individuals may be healthy or ill, with illness severity determining their ex post type. Preventive care is chosen beforehand, while curative care is decided after health status is known.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了二级预防性和治疗性护理的非线性报销规则。个体可能处于健康或患病状态，疾病严重程度决定其事后类型。预防性护理事先选择，而治疗性护理则在健康状况已知后决定。

records.title_en: Prescribing power and equitable access to care: Evidence from pharmacists in Ontario, Canada
records.title_cn: 处方权与医疗服务的公平可及性：来自加拿大安大略省药剂师的证据
records.abstract_en: Allowing pharmacists to directly treat patients may increase equitable access to healthcare and improve patient outcomes, but raises concerns about supply-side moral hazard or patient substitution away from regular physician-based care. We study the effects of a 2023 policy allowing pharmacists to prescribe for minor ailments in Ontario, Canada. We use Advan foot traffic data to measure how this policy affected visits to pharmacies and generated spillover effects on visits to non-pharmacy medical facilities (Research, 2022). Allowing pharmacists to prescribe led to a 16% increase in total visits to pharmacies and a 3% increase in visits to other providers. These increases were concentrated in materially deprived neighborhoods and benefited non-minority, non-immigrant populations the most. We use the policy as exogenous variation to identify substitution elasticities between pharmacy visits and traffic to other medical facilities. Overall, 20% of the increase in traffic to pharmacies spills over into increased use of outpatient-based care. Pharmacy traffic is a substitute for visits to hospitals and emergency departments, potentially as patients rely on pharmacists for triaging rather than emergency care.
records.abstract_cn: 允许药剂师直接治疗患者可能会增加医疗服务的公平可及性并改善患者预后，但也引发了对供给侧道德风险或患者从常规医生护理转向其他服务的担忧。我们研究了加拿大安大略省一项2023政策的影响，该政策允许药剂师为轻微疾病开具处方。我们使用Advan人流量数据来衡量该政策如何影响药房访问量，并评估其对非药房医疗机构访问量的溢出效应（研究，2022）。允许药剂师开处方导致药房总访问量增加了16%%，其他医疗服务提供者的访问量增加了3%%。这些增长集中在物质匮乏的社区，且对非少数族裔、非移民群体的受益最大。我们利用该政策作为外生变异来识别药房访问与其他医疗机构人流量之间的替代弹性。总体而言，药房人流量增加的20%%溢出为门诊护理使用的增加。药房人流量是医院和急诊科访问的替代品，这可能是因为患者依赖药剂师进行分诊而非急诊护理。

records.title_en: Longevity, Education, and Income: How large is the triangle?
records.title_cn: 长寿、教育和收入：三角形有多大？
records.abstract_en: While health affects economic development and wellbeing through a variety of pathways, one commonly suggested channel is a “horizon” mechanism in which increased longevity induces additional education. A recent literature devotes much attention to how much education responds to increasing longevity, while this study asks instead what impact this specific channel has on wellbeing (welfare). I note that death is like a tax on human-capital investments, which suggests using a standard tool of introductory economics: triangles. I estimate the (triangular) gain from reoptimization when education adjusts to lower adult mortality. Even for implausibly large responses of education to survival differences, almost all of today’s low-human-development countries, if switched instantaneously to Japan’s survival curve, would place a value on this channel of less than 3% of income. (This contrasts with a 40% ‘rectangle’ that they would gain even if education were held fixed.) Calibrating the model instead with well identified studies, I find that the horizon triangle for the typical low-income country is less than a percent of lifetime income.
records.abstract_cn: 虽然健康通过多种途径影响经济发展和福祉，但通常建议的一个渠道是“地平线”机制，其中寿命的延长会带来额外的教育。最近的一篇文献非常关注教育对寿命延长的影响有多大，而这项研究则询问这个特定渠道对福祉（福利）有什么影响。我注意到死亡就像对人力资本投资征税，这建议使用入门经济学的标准工具：三角形。我估计当教育根据较低的成人死亡率进行调整时，重新优化会带来（三角）收益。即使教育对生存差异的反应大得令人难以置信，几乎所有当今人类发展水平较低的国家，如果立即转向日本的生存曲线，也会对这一收入渠道给予低于3%的价值。 （这与即使教育水平保持不变，他们也会获得的40%“矩形”形成鲜明对比。）通过明确的研究来校准模型，我发现典型低收入国家的地平线三角形不到终生收入的百分之一。

records.title_en: Using stock price movements to estimate the harm from collusive drug patent litigation settlements
records.title_cn: 利用股价变动估计合谋性药品专利诉讼和解造成的损害
records.abstract_en: The tradeoff between incentives to invest in R&D and efficient pricing takes a special form in the pharmaceutical sector. Brand drugs command high prices until generic competition begins, the timing of which usually depends on the outcome of patent infringement litigation. One potential outcome is a collusive agreement between the brand and a potential generic competitor that delays competition, with the brand sharing the profits from the delay by paying the generic challenger. Collusive patent settlements have plagued competition in pharmaceutical markets globally and especially in the U.S., the world’s largest market. This paper estimates the cost of these collusive settlements to U.S. drug purchasers using stock price movements. If the brand firm’s increase in profits from collusion is capitalized into stock prices, the change in value upon a settlement announcement can be used to estimate the new profit flows from higher prices to purchasers. We assembled data on 64 settlements reached during 2014–2023 and used the announcement descriptions and information that surfaced later to identify 17 potentially collusive settlements. We applied event study methods and found, consistent with prior research, that settlement announcements with no indication of collusion had no significant effect on the stock prices of brand firms implying that they tended to meet traders’ expectations. Stock prices increased by approximately 3.5 %, on average, after settlements with an indication of collusion, implying they increased brand profits by delaying generic entry. These increases correspond to a total increase in U.S. purchaser spending of $3.1-$3.2 billion per year during 2014–2023. Factoring up our estimate to the entire industry implies the increase in spending may be closer to $12 billion per year.
records.abstract_cn: 研发投资激励与有效定价之间的权衡在制药行业呈现出特殊形式。品牌药在仿制药竞争开始前维持高价，而仿制药进入的时机通常取决于专利侵权诉讼的结果。一种可能的结果是品牌药企与潜在仿制药竞争者之间达成合谋协议，延迟竞争，品牌药企通过向仿制药挑战者支付费用来分享延迟带来的利润。合谋性专利和解已困扰全球药品市场竞争，尤其是在全球最大的市场——美国。本文利用股价变动估计这些合谋性和解对美国药品购买者造成的成本。如果品牌药企因合谋而增加的利润被资本化到股价中，那么和解公告时的价值变化可用于估计因高价而流向购买者的新增利润流。我们收集了64-2014年间达成的2023项和解数据，并利用公告描述及后续披露的信息识别出17项可能具有合谋性质的和解。我们应用事件研究方法发现，与先前研究一致，无合谋迹象的和解公告对品牌药企股价无显著影响，表明这些公告往往符合交易者的预期。在具有合谋迹象的和解后，股价平均上涨约3.5%，表明这些和解通过延迟仿制药进入增加了品牌药企利润。这些涨幅对应3.1-3.2年间美国购买者支出每年总计增加2014亿至2023亿美元。将我们的估计扩展到整个行业，支出增加可能接近每年12亿美元。

records.title_en: Surviving the fintech disruption
records.title_cn: 在金融科技颠覆中生存
records.abstract_en: We examine the impact of fintech on firm labor demand, job turnover, and firm performance. Occupations with higher exposure to fintech experience a net decline in job postings and employment, though both complementary and substitutive effects emerge across different sectors. Fintech blurs traditional industry boundaries, creating demand for workers with a combination of finance and technology skills. In response, firms upskill through hiring, reallocate talent internally, and pivot innovation to new areas. As a result, firms are better equipped to absorb the shock than individual workers, with innovative firms even experiencing growth in employment, sales, and productivity upon fintech disruption.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了金融科技对企业劳动力需求、职位流动和企业绩效的影响。金融科技暴露程度较高的职业在职位发布和就业方面经历净下降，尽管在不同部门中同时出现了互补和替代效应。金融科技模糊了传统行业边界，创造了对兼具金融和技术技能工人的需求。作为回应，企业通过招聘提升技能，内部重新配置人才，并将创新转向新领域。因此，企业比个体工人更有能力吸收冲击，创新型企业甚至在金融科技颠覆中实现了就业、销售和生产率的增长。

records.title_en: Printing away the mortgages: Fiscal inflation and the post-covid boom
records.title_cn: 通过通胀冲销抵押贷款：财政通胀与后疫情繁荣
records.abstract_en: We analyze interactions between fiscal and monetary stimulus in a new Keynesian model with nominal mortgage debt that can be inflated away. Redistributive transfers are most impactful when followed by a temporary deviation from inflation-targeting monetary policy. Unlike other fiscal policies, redistribution causes inflation even in the absence of long-run debt sustainability problems, and inflating away mortgages results in additional redistribution. In a quantitative model with mortgage refinancing frictions, transfer payments provide much more stimulus than the redistributive effects of inflation. Borrowers gradually refinance after their mortgages are inflated away, dampening their immediate consumption response and reducing their long-run labor supply.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个包含名义抵押贷款债务且可通过通胀冲销的新凯恩斯模型中，分析了财政与货币刺激之间的相互作用。再分配转移支付在随后出现偏离通胀目标货币政策的暂时性情况下影响最大。与其他财政政策不同，再分配即使在不存在长期债务可持续性问题的情况下也会引发通胀，而通过通胀冲销抵押贷款则会导致额外的再分配。在一个包含抵押贷款再融资摩擦的定量模型中，转移支付提供的刺激远大于通胀的再分配效应。借款人在其抵押贷款被通胀冲销后逐渐进行再融资，这抑制了他们的即时消费反应，并减少了他们的长期劳动供给。

records.title_en: CRISK: Measuring the climate risk exposure of the financial system
records.title_cn: CRISK：衡量金融体系的气候风险暴露
records.abstract_en: We develop a market-based methodology to assess banks’ resilience to climate-related risks and study the climate-related risk exposure of large global banks. We introduce a new measure, CRISK, which is the expected capital shortfall of a bank in a climate stress scenario. To estimate CRISK, we construct climate risk factors and dynamically measure banks’ stock return sensitivity (that is, climate beta) to the climate risk factor. We validate the climate risk factor empirically and the climate beta estimates by using granular data on large US banks’ loan portfolios. The measure is useful in quantifying banks’ climate-related risk exposure through the market risk and the credit risk channels.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种基于市场的方法来评估银行对气候相关风险的韧性，并研究大型全球银行的气候相关风险暴露。我们引入了一个新指标，即CRISK，它是在气候压力情景下银行的预期资本短缺。为了估计CRISK，我们构建了气候风险因子，并动态衡量银行股票收益率对气候风险因子的敏感性（即气候贝塔）。我们通过使用美国大型银行贷款组合的微观数据，实证验证了气候风险因子和气候贝塔估计。该指标通过市场风险和信用风险渠道，在量化银行的气候相关风险暴露方面具有实用性。

records.title_en: Differential access to dark markets and execution outcomes
records.title_cn: 暗市场准入差异与执行结果
records.abstract_en: Dark pools can restrict access for specific trader types. We compare execution outcomes between dark pools that restrict high frequency trader access and those that do not. We find that trades executed in dark pools with more access restrictions have less order flow information leakage, adverse selection risk and post-trade order imbalances than trades in less restricted pools. Evidence from exogenous dark pool closures demonstrates that these differences are causal. The ability to segment order flow can benefit investors because it allows them to make trade-offs between execution risk and information leakage across different dark venues.
records.abstract_cn: 暗池可以限制特定交易者类型的准入。我们比较了限制高频交易者准入的暗池与不限制的暗池之间的执行结果。我们发现，在准入限制更多的暗池中执行的交易，其订单流信息泄露、逆向选择风险及交易后订单不平衡程度均低于限制较少的暗池。来自外生暗池关闭的证据表明，这些差异具有因果性。分割订单流的能力可以使投资者受益，因为它允许他们在不同暗交易场所之间权衡执行风险与信息泄露。

records.title_en: The economics of “Buy Now, Pay Later”: A merchant’s perspective
records.title_cn: “先买后付”的经济学：商家视角
records.abstract_en: “Buy Now, Pay Later” (BNPL) is a key innovation in consumer payments. It bundles the sale of a product with a subsidized loan, effectively offering lower prices to low-creditworthiness customers. BNPL thereby allows merchants to price-discriminate among customers with different willingness-to-pay. Consistent with a price-discrimination mechanism, we show that BNPL increases sales by 20%, driven by low-creditworthiness customers and products where market power is larger. We find that the benefits of offering BNPL significantly outweigh the costs for the merchant. Our findings help to explain the surge in popularity of BNPL in e-commerce around the world.
records.abstract_cn: “先买后付”（BNPL）是消费者支付领域的一项关键创新。它将产品销售与补贴贷款捆绑在一起，实际上为信用度较低的客户提供了更低的价格。因此，BNPL使商家能够在具有不同支付意愿的客户之间进行价格歧视。与价格歧视机制一致，我们显示BNPL使销售额增加了20%，这一增长主要由信用度较低的客户和市场力量较大的产品驱动。我们发现，提供BNPL的收益显著超过商家的成本。我们的发现有助于解释BNPL在全球电子商务中迅速流行的现象。

records.title_en: The impact of prices on analyst cash flow expectations: Reconciling subjective beliefs data with rational discount rate variation
records.title_cn: 价格对分析师现金流预期的影响：调和主观信念数据与理性贴现率变动
records.abstract_en: I show that prices impact analyst cash flow expectations and argue this impact can partially reconcile subjective beliefs data with asset pricing models in which investors have rational expectations and discount rate variation drives prices. Previous work argues that correlations of biased analyst cash flow expectations with prices and future returns contradict rational models and imply biased investor expectations distort prices. However, using two instrumental variables for price, I find increases in price unrelated to cash flow news raise analyst cash flow expectations. Based on this empirical finding, I propose a model with rational investors that matches key moments in beliefs data: analysts form biased cash flow expectations by learning from prices that contain discount rate variation. Thus, while stylized facts in beliefs data can be consistent with investors having biased expectations that distort prices, these facts can also be consistent with investors having rational expectations and analysts learning from prices.
records.abstract_cn: 我展示了价格影响分析师的现金流预期，并认为这种影响可以部分地将主观信念数据与资产定价模型（其中投资者具有理性预期且贴现率变动驱动价格）相调和。先前的研究认为，有偏的分析师现金流预期与价格和未来收益的相关性与理性模型相矛盾，并暗示有偏的投资者预期扭曲了价格。然而，使用两个价格工具变量，我发现与现金流消息无关的价格上涨会提高分析师的现金流预期。基于这一实证发现，我提出了一个具有理性投资者的模型，该模型匹配了信念数据中的关键矩：分析师通过从包含贴现率变动的价格中学习，形成有偏的现金流预期。因此，虽然信念数据中的典型事实可能与投资者具有扭曲价格的有偏预期相一致，但这些事实也可以与投资者具有理性预期且分析师从价格中学习的情况相一致。

records.title_en: Bank stress testing, human capital investment and risk management
records.title_cn: 银行压力测试、人力资本投资与风险管理
records.abstract_en: This paper studies banks’ investment in risk management human capital following the Global Financial Crisis and the advent of stress testing. Our results suggest that ‘Too Big to Fail’ distortions may have weakened large banks’ incentive to invest in risk management talent. Stress testing, which focuses on the largest banks, spurred demand for skilled quantitative risk managers, but only narrowly in anticipation of a test and following poor performance on a test. Stress testing does not affect demand for the over 90 % of risk management jobs not linked to passing tests, limiting its effectiveness in improving risk management practices.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了全球金融危机及压力测试出现后银行在风险管理人力资本方面的投资。我们的结果表明，“太大而不能倒”的扭曲可能削弱了大银行投资于风险管理人才的激励。压力测试主要针对大型银行，刺激了对熟练量化风险管理人员需求的增加，但仅在预期测试及测试表现不佳后狭窄地出现。压力测试不影响与通过测试无关的超过90%的风险管理岗位需求，限制了其在改善风险管理实践方面的有效性。

records.title_en: Private equity in the hospital industry
records.title_cn: 医院行业的私募股权
records.abstract_en: We examine the survival prospects, employment profiles, and patient outcomes at private equity (PE)-acquired hospitals. Target hospitals maintain their survival rates while significantly reducing employment and wage expenditures. The number of core medical workers drops temporarily, but returns to its pre-acquisition level in the long run. However, administrative job and wage cuts persist over the long term, particularly at previously nonprofit hospitals. Using proprietary insurance claims data, we find no significant changes in patient demographics or inpatient prices at PE-acquired hospitals. While patient satisfaction declines, there is no evidence of increased patient mortality or readmission rates at PE-acquired hospitals.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了私募股权（PE）收购医院的生存前景、就业概况和患者结果。目标医院在显著减少就业和工资支出的同时，保持了其生存率。核心医疗工作者的数量暂时下降，但长期内恢复到收购前水平。然而，行政岗位和工资削减长期持续，尤其是在以前非营利性医院。使用专有的保险索赔数据，我们发现PE收购医院的患者人口统计或住院价格没有显著变化。虽然患者满意度下降，但没有证据表明PE收购医院的患者死亡率或再入院率增加。

records.title_en: Economic links from bonds and cross-stock return predictability
records.title_cn: 债券经济联系与跨股票收益可预测性
records.abstract_en: Identifying firms’ bond-market-specific economic links through credit-rating comovement of their corporate bonds, a long-short strategy for stocks based on these links generates a risk-adjusted alpha of 0.45% per month, which cannot be explained by existing economic links in the literature. Market segmentation between the equity and bond markets appears to be the underlying mechanism: (i) The cross-return predictability is muted in the bond market; (ii) The cross-return predictability is mitigated in the presence of cross-holding investors; (iii) Equity analysts slowly incorporate information from rating-comovement links to their forecasts.
records.abstract_cn: 通过公司债券的信用评级联动识别企业在债券市场特有的经济联系，基于这些联系构建的股票多空策略每月产生0.45%的风险调整后阿尔法，这一结果无法用现有文献中的经济联系来解释。股票与债券市场之间的市场分割似乎是其潜在机制：（i）债券市场中的跨收益可预测性较弱；（ii）存在交叉持股投资者时，跨收益可预测性减弱；（iii）股票分析师在预测中缓慢纳入评级联动联系的信息。

records.title_en: Conditional risk and the pricing kernel
records.title_cn: 条件风险与定价核
records.abstract_en: We propose a statistical methodology for jointly estimating the pricing kernel and conditional physical return densities from option prices. Pricing kernel estimates show that negative stock market returns are significantly more painful to investors in low-volatility periods. Density estimates reflect a significantly positive risk–return trade-off, suggest that Martin’s (2017) lower bound on the equity premium is violated in high-volatility periods, and provide new evidence on the variance premium’s predictive power for excess returns as well as the co-movement between higher return moments. Lastly, we show that leading macrofinance models are at odds with basic features of conditional stock market risks and risk pricing.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种统计方法，用于从期权价格中联合估计定价核和条件物理收益密度。定价核估计显示，在低波动时期，负的股票市场收益对投资者来说显著更为痛苦。密度估计反映了显著的正风险-收益权衡，表明Martin（2017）关于股权溢价的下降界限在高波动时期被违反，并为方差溢价对超额收益的预测能力以及更高收益矩之间的共同运动提供了新证据。最后，我们表明，领先的宏观金融模型与条件股票市场风险和风险定价的基本特征不一致。

records.title_en: New fertility patterns: The role of human versus physical capital
records.title_cn: 新型生育模式：人力资本与物质资本的作用
records.abstract_en: We use an overlapping generations model with physical and human capital, and two reproductive periods to explore how fertility decisions may differ in response to economic incentives in early and late adulthood. In particular, we analyze the interplay between fertility choices—related to career opportunities—and wages, and investigate the role played by work experience and investment in both types of capital. We show that young adults postpone parenthood above a certain wage threshold and that late fertility increases with human capital. The long run trend is either to converge to a low productivity equilibrium, involving high early fertility, investment in physical capital and relatively low income, or to a high productivity equilibrium, where households postpone parenthood to invest in their human capital and work experience, with higher late fertility and higher levels of income. A convergence to the latest state would explain the postponement of parenthood and the mitigation or slight reversal of fertility decrease in some European countries in recent decades.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用一个包含物质资本和人力资本以及两个生育期的重叠世代模型，探讨生育决策在成年早期和晚期如何因经济激励而有所不同。特别地，我们分析了与职业机会相关的生育选择与工资之间的相互作用，并考察了工作经验及对两类资本投资所扮演的角色。我们表明，超过某一工资阈值后，年轻人会推迟生育，且晚期生育率随人力资本增加而上升。长期趋势要么收敛于一个低生产率均衡，涉及高早期生育率、物质资本投资和相对较低的收入，要么收敛于一个高生产率均衡，其中家庭推迟生育以投资于人力资本和工作经验，伴随更高的晚期生育率和更高的收入水平。向最新状态的收敛可以解释近几十年来一些欧洲国家生育推迟以及生育率下降的减缓或轻微逆转现象。

records.title_en: Stationary altruism and time consistency
records.title_cn: 平稳利他主义与时间一致性
records.abstract_en: We study social intertemporal preferences constructed through the aggregation of individual preferences that differ in both time discounting and instantaneous utility. We introduce weakened forms of the Pareto condition under which the social discount and instantaneous utility functions are weighted averages of their individual counterparts. We show that if individuals are time-consistent, then society can only preserve this property without falling into dictatorship by applying the condition to comparisons involving only two periods. In such cases, the social discount factor is a weighted average of individual discount factors. When the condition is applied to longer consumption horizons, the resulting social preferences display decreasing impatience. Moreover, the longer the comparison horizon, the stronger the society's preference for patience over time becomes, under mild conditions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究通过聚合在时间贴现和瞬时效用上均存在差异的个体偏好而构建的社会跨期偏好。我们引入了弱化形式的帕累托条件，在该条件下，社会贴现函数和瞬时效用函数是其个体对应函数的加权平均。我们表明，如果个体是时间一致的，那么社会只有在将该条件应用于仅涉及两个时期的比较时，才能在不陷入独裁的情况下保持这一性质。在这种情况下，社会贴现因子是个体贴现因子的加权平均。当该条件应用于更长的消费期限时，由此产生的社会偏好表现出递减的不耐烦。此外，在温和条件下，比较期限越长，社会随时间推移对耐心的偏好就越强。

records.title_en: Never say never: Optimal exclusion and reserve prices with expectations-based loss-averse buyers
records.title_cn: 永不言败：基于预期损失厌恶买家的最优排除与保留价格
records.abstract_en: We analyze reserve prices in auctions with independent private values when bidders are expectations-based loss averse. We find that the optimal public reserve price excludes fewer bidder types than under risk neutrality. Moreover, we show that public reserve prices are not optimal as the seller can earn a higher revenue with mechanisms that better leverage the “attachment effect”. We discuss two such mechanisms: i) an auction with a secret and random reserve price, and ii) a mechanism where an auction with a public reserve price is followed by a negotiation if the reserve price is not met. Both of these mechanisms expose more bidder types to the attachment effect, thereby increasing bids and ultimately revenue.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了在竞拍者具有基于预期的损失厌恶时，独立私人价值拍卖中的保留价格。我们发现，最优公开保留价格排除的竞拍者类型少于风险中性情况下的排除数量。此外，我们表明公开保留价格并非最优，因为卖家可以通过更好地利用“依恋效应”的机制获得更高收入。我们讨论了两种这样的机制：i) 带有秘密且随机保留价格的拍卖，以及 ii) 一种机制，其中公开保留价格的拍卖若未达到保留价格，则随后进行谈判。这两种机制都使更多竞拍者类型暴露于依恋效应，从而增加出价并最终提高收入。

records.title_en: The rich are not like you and me: Income, price dispersion, and consumption
records.title_cn: 富人与你我不同：收入、价格离散与消费
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the impact of imperfect competition on life-cycle consumption profiles and consumption-risk sharing, along with its policy implications. We develop a framework by incorporating the Shapley-Shubik market game into a stochastic overlapping generations model. We characterize the inverse income-marginal price relationship under market power, where wealthy agents face lower prices for identical goods compared to a perfectly competitive economy. We present several novel findings due to the additional price effect channel arising from price dispersion. First, we show that income-dependent prices in an imperfectly competitive economy lead to a failure of consumption smoothing and generate hump-shaped consumption profiles without other frictions. We also demonstrate that the market power of agents increases consumption volatility and worsens consumption-risk sharing due to the double luck effect resulting from price dispersion caused by income shocks. The additional volatility from imperfect competition creates a complementary welfare loss. Lastly, we illustrate a severed link between fiscal and monetary policy in improving welfare in an imperfectly competitive economy, as monetary policies reinforce the inverse income-price relationship and adversely affect the poor, while fiscal policies do not.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了不完全竞争对生命周期消费曲线和消费风险分担的影响及其政策含义。我们通过将Shapley-Shubik市场博弈纳入随机重叠世代模型，构建了一个分析框架。我们刻画了市场势力下的收入-边际价格反向关系，即相对于完全竞争经济，富裕代理人面临相同商品的更低价格。由于价格离散产生的额外价格效应渠道，我们提出了若干新颖发现。首先，我们表明，在不完全竞争经济中，依赖于收入的价格会导致消费平滑失败，并在没有其他摩擦的情况下产生驼峰形消费曲线。我们还证明，代理人的市场势力增加了消费波动性，并因收入冲击引起的价格离散所产生的双重运气效应而恶化了消费风险分担。不完全竞争带来的额外波动性造成了补充性的福利损失。最后，我们说明在不完全竞争经济中，财政政策与货币政策在改善福利方面的联系被切断，因为货币政策强化了收入-价格反向关系并对穷人产生不利影响，而财政政策则不然。

records.title_en: Meritocracy versus diversity
records.title_cn: 精英主义与多样性
records.abstract_en: A college or firm makes admissions or hiring decisions for which each candidate is characterized by priority ranking and type, which might depend on race, gender, or socioeconomic status. The admissions or hiring committee faces a tradeoff between meritocracy and diversity: Although a merit-first choice rule might admit candidates of the same type, a diversity-first choice rule might be unfair because of priority violations. To formalize this tradeoff, we introduce a measure of meritocracy and a measure of diversity for choice rules. A choice rule that uses both reserves and quotas can be regarded as a compromise and as a generalization of the two extreme rules. The first result is comparative statics for this class of choice rules: We demonstrate that as parameters change and the choice rule becomes more meritorious, the rule also becomes less diverse. The second result is a characterization of the choice rule, which might help admissions or hiring committees to formulate their policies.
records.abstract_cn: 大学或企业在招生或招聘决策中，每位候选人以优先级排序和类型为特征，类型可能取决于种族、性别或社会经济地位。招生或招聘委员会面临精英主义与多样性之间的权衡：尽管优先考虑精英的选择规则可能录取同一类型的候选人，但优先考虑多样性的选择规则可能因优先级违规而不公平。为形式化这一权衡，我们为选择规则引入了精英主义度量与多样性度量。同时使用配额和储备的选择规则可被视为一种折中方案，也是两种极端规则的推广。第一个结果是这类选择规则的比较静态分析：我们证明，随着参数变化，选择规则变得更加精英化时，该规则也变得更不具多样性。第二个结果是选择规则的特征化描述，这可能有助于招生或招聘委员会制定其政策。

records.title_en: Two time-consistent Paretian solutions to the intertemporal resource allocation problem
records.title_cn: 跨期资源分配问题的两个时间一致性帕累托解
records.abstract_en: We study the problem of aggregating individual geometric discounting (GD) preferences over infinite streams of consumption profiles into a system specifying, for each consumption history, a social ranking of the streams that follow that history. Such a system is time-consistent if and only if it is generated by a single underlying preference ordering over the lifetime streams. Under the Weak Pareto Principle, Neutrality, Anonymity, and Discounting Irrelevance (individual discount factors do not affect the ranking of constant streams), lifetime streams must be ranked by applying a fixed monotonic and symmetric ordering to the profiles of range-normalized GD utilities they yield (Theorem 1). History Independence singles out the range-normalized utilitarian rule (Theorem 2) whereas the range-normalized Nash rule is characterized by Independence of Infeasible Consumptions (the ranking of streams delivering consumption profiles in an interval from the origin does not depend on individual valuations outside that interval) or Valuation Irrelevance (the ranking of pure timing streams is independent of individual valuations) (Theorem 3).
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究将个体几何贴现（GD）偏好对无限消费流序列的加总问题，即针对每个消费历史，指定一个对该历史后续消费流进行社会排序的系统。这样的系统是时间一致的，当且仅当它由对终身消费流的单一潜在偏好排序所生成。在弱帕累托原则、中立性、匿名性和贴现无关性（个体贴现因子不影响恒定消费流的排序）下，终身消费流必须通过对其产生的范围归一化GD效用的分布应用一个固定的单调且对称的排序来排序（定理1）。历史独立性单独刻画了范围归一化功利主义规则（定理2），而范围归一化纳什规则则由不可行消费独立性（对从原点出发的区间内消费流的排序不依赖于该区间外的个体估值）或估值无关性（纯时间消费流的排序独立于个体估值）所刻画（定理3）。

records.title_en: Money and imperfectly competitive credit
records.title_cn: 货币与不完全竞争信贷
records.abstract_en: We develop a monetary economy in which banks have market power emanating from search frictions. Distributions of both deposit and loan interest rates are equilibrium phenomena exhibiting dispersion consistent with new micro-level evidence on U.S. consumer loans and deposits. The theory accounts for incomplete pass-through of monetary policy to the distributions of loan and deposit rates through a novel channel. Imperfect competition links monetary policy to real consumption and welfare through its effects on interest rate spreads driven by market power and individual liquidity risk. Market power in deposits erodes the insurance banks provide against liquidity risk, while market power in lending enables banks to extract surplus from goods market trades. For a given inflation target, welfare gains arise if a central bank uses state-contingent monetary injections to reduce lenders' market power in response to fluctuations in aggregate demand.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个货币经济模型，其中银行因搜索摩擦而拥有市场势力。存款和贷款利率的分布是均衡现象，表现出与美国消费者贷款和存款的微观层面新证据一致的离散性。该理论通过一个新渠道解释了货币政策对贷款和存款利率分布的不完全传导。不完全竞争通过市场势力和个体流动性风险对利率利差的影响，将货币政策与实际消费和福利联系起来。存款方面的市场势力削弱了银行提供的流动性风险保险，而贷款方面的市场势力使银行能够从商品市场交易中提取剩余。在给定通胀目标下，如果中央银行根据总需求波动使用状态依存的货币注入来降低贷款方的市场势力，则会产生福利收益。

records.title_en: Unidirectional incentive compatibility
records.title_cn: 单向激励相容性
records.abstract_en: We study unidirectional incentive compatibility which incentivizes truth-telling by an agent who can misrepresent private information in one direction only. In the canonical setting with quasi-linear preferences and continuous, one-dimensional private information, we show that unidirectional incentive compatibility imposes no restrictions on the allocation rule and revenue equivalence fails. Moreover, unidirectional incentive compatibility holds if and only if the change of the agent's information rent respects a lower bound based on the allocation rule's monotone envelope. With strong interdependent values or countervailing incentives, optimal screening contracts differ from optimal bidirectionally incentive compatible contracts, possibly displaying non-monotone allocations.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究单向激励相容性，它激励只能在一个方向上歪曲私人信息的代理人说真话。在具有拟线性偏好和连续、一维私人信息的经典设定中，我们表明单向激励相容性对配置规则不施加任何限制，且收入等价性失效。此外，单向激励相容性成立当且仅当代理人的信息租金变化满足基于配置规则的单调包络的下界。在强相互依赖价值或反激励存在的情况下，最优筛选合同不同于最优双向激励相容合同，可能表现出非单调配置。

records.title_en: Monopoly pricing with optimal information
records.title_cn: 最优信息下的垄断定价
records.abstract_en: We analyze a monopoly pricing model where information about the buyer's valuation is endogenous. Before the seller sets a price, both the buyer and the seller receive private signals that may be informative about the buyer's valuation. The joint distribution of these signals, as a function of the valuation, is optimally chosen by the players. In general, players have conflicting incentives over the provision of information. As a modelling device, we assume that an aggregation function determines the information structure from the choices of the players, and we characterize the pure strategy equilibrium payoffs for a natural class of aggregation functions. Every equilibrium payoff can be achieved by an information structure that is the result of the seller trying to make both players uninformed while the buyer tries to learn about his valuation. Price discrimination is limited to the seller setting different prices for informed vs uninformed buyers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了一个垄断定价模型，其中关于买方估值的信息是内生的。在卖方设定价格之前，买方和卖方都会收到可能包含买方估值信息的私人信号。这些信号的联合分布，作为估值的函数，由参与者最优选择。一般来说，参与者在信息提供上存在冲突的激励。作为一种建模手段，我们假设一个聚合函数根据参与者的选择决定信息结构，并刻画了一类自然聚合函数下的纯策略均衡收益。每个均衡收益都可以通过一种信息结构实现，该结构是卖方试图使双方都不知情而买方试图了解自身估值的结果。价格歧视仅限于卖方对知情与不知情买方设定不同价格。

records.title_en: Market versus optimum allocation in open economies
records.title_cn: 开放经济中的市场与最优配置
records.abstract_en: A large body of theoretical and quantitative work concerns models of heterogeneous firms and monopolistic competition. But most of it relies on strong assumptions regarding demand structure, firm-productivity distribution, and country heterogeneity. This paper studies a general-equilibrium model with directly explicitly additive preferences, non-specified productivity distributions, and asymmetric countries, for which much less is known. We first prove the existence and uniqueness of the market equilibrium with a three-stage approach of analyzing competition intensities and wages. We then explore the market-allocation mechanism and provide a baseline comparison between the market and a utilitarian optimum from a global planner's perspective. We show that misallocation in open economies can be decomposed into two effects, driven by country asymmetry and the variable elasticity of substitution. We present two examples exhibiting constant and variable markups, respectively, to illustrate how to apply our general theorem.
records.abstract_cn: 大量理论和定量研究关注异质性企业与垄断竞争模型。但其中大部分依赖于关于需求结构、企业生产率分布和国家异质性的强假设。本文研究了一个具有直接显式可加偏好、非特定生产率分布和非对称国家的一般均衡模型，对此类模型的了解相对较少。我们首先通过一个三阶段方法分析竞争强度和工资，证明了市场均衡的存在性和唯一性。然后，我们探讨了市场配置机制，并从全球规划者的角度提供了市场与功利主义最优之间的基线比较。我们表明，开放经济中的错配可以分解为两个效应，分别由国家非对称性和替代弹性的可变性驱动。我们提供了两个分别展示恒定和可变加成的例子，以说明如何应用我们的通用定理。

records.title_en: Public goods in networks: Comparative statics results
records.title_cn: 网络中的公共品：比较静态结果
records.abstract_en: We consider public goods games with heterogeneous players interacting on a network and investigate how shocks to players' characteristics and changes in interaction patterns influence individual and total contributions. We introduce a linear system associated to the initial game, in which heterogeneity in players' characteristics is removed and interactions between players are reversed, and show that what matters in determining the effects of a shock on contributions is the sign of the coordinates of its unconstrained solution. When players are identical, we demonstrate that positive shocks on active players increase contributions, while positive shocks on strictly inactive players decrease them, contrary to intuition. We also identify a subset of players, called neutral players, who exert no influence on total contributions. Furthermore, we provide precise formulas for the change in total contributions following various types of shocks, and provide conditions to determine whether the shock will have positive or negative consequences on contributions. We show that these conditions always rely on the sign of the associated problem's unconstrained solution coordinates of the players impacted by the shock.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑异质性参与者在网络上互动的公共品博弈，并研究参与者特征冲击以及互动模式变化如何影响个体和总贡献。我们引入一个与初始博弈相关的线性系统，在该系统中，参与者特征的异质性被移除，参与者之间的互动被反转，并表明决定冲击对贡献影响的关键在于其无约束解坐标的符号。当参与者相同时，我们证明对活跃参与者的正向冲击会增加贡献，而对严格不活跃参与者的正向冲击则会减少贡献，这与直觉相反。我们还识别出一组参与者，称为中性参与者，他们对总贡献没有影响。此外，我们提供了各种类型冲击后总贡献变化的精确公式，并给出了确定冲击对贡献产生正面还是负面后果的条件。我们表明，这些条件始终依赖于受冲击影响参与者的相关问题无约束解坐标的符号。

records.title_en: Public goods, social alternatives, and the Lindahl-VCG relationship
records.title_cn: 公共物品、社会选择与林达尔-维克里-克拉克-格罗夫斯关系
records.abstract_en: Lindahl prices, set by a fictitious auctioneer with full knowledge of values and costs, are a generalization of Walrasian prices. By making the efficient allocation utility- and profit-maximizing for all players, they induce an efficient outcome in a decentralized way even in the presence of public goods.
