We study a collective choice model with quasilinear utility, which encompasses the allocation of public and private goods as special cases. We show that each agent's most favorable Lindahl payment (the smallest Lindahl price for the efficient alternative) is equal to his VCG transfer while the firm's VCG transfer is equal to its most favorable Lindahl payment (the largest sum of Lindahl prices for the efficient alternative). Thus, the VCG mechanism incurs a deficit if and only if the set of vectors of the agents' Lindahl payments is multi-valued. Unlike Walrasian prices, Lindahl prices are not restricted to be anonymous or additive. This is the reason why, when considering the allocation of private goods, the agents' smallest Walrasian payments are at least as large as their most favorable Lindahl payments, and thus their VCG transfers. It is also why Lindahl prices always exist while Walrasian prices may not.
records.abstract_cn: 林达尔价格，由一位完全了解价值和成本的中介设定，是瓦尔拉斯价格的推广。通过使有效配置对所有参与者都是效用和利润最大化的，即使在存在公共物品的情况下，它们也能以分散的方式诱导出有效结果。我们研究了一个具有拟线性效用的集体选择模型，该模型将公共和私人物品的分配作为特例包含在内。我们证明，每个代理最有利的林达尔支付（对有效替代方案的最小林达尔价格）等于其VCG转移，而企业的VCG转移等于其最有利的林达尔支付（对有效替代方案的林达尔价格之和最大）。因此，当且仅当代理的林达尔支付向量集合是多值时，VCG机制才会产生赤字。与瓦尔拉斯价格不同，林达尔价格不限于匿名或可加性。这就是为什么在考虑私人物品分配时，代理的最小瓦尔拉斯支付至少与其最有利的林达尔支付一样大，从而也至少与其VCG转移一样大。这也是为什么林达尔价格总是存在而瓦尔拉斯价格可能不存在的原因。

records.title_en: Information requirements for mechanism design
records.title_cn: 机制设计中的信息要求
records.abstract_en: Standard mechanism design begins with a statement of the problem, including knowledge on the designer's part about the distribution of the characteristics (preferences and information) of the participants who are to engage with the mechanism. There is a large literature on robust mechanism design, much of which aims to reduce the assumed information the designer has about the participants. In this paper we provide an auction mechanism for interdependent value problems that performs well when there are many buyers, even though there is no prior distribution over the accuracy of buyers' information on the part of the designer or the participants.
records.abstract_cn: 标准机制设计始于问题的陈述，包括设计者对参与机制参与者的特征（偏好和信息）分布的了解。关于稳健机制设计有大量文献，其中许多旨在减少设计者对参与者所假定的信息。在本文中，我们为相互依赖价值问题提供了一种拍卖机制，当买家众多时，该机制表现良好，即使设计者或参与者对买家信息的准确性没有先验分布。

records.title_en: Market design with deferred acceptance: A recipe for characterizations
records.title_cn: 延迟接受的市场设计：特征化的方法
records.abstract_en: In matching markets, policymakers often pursue complex distributional objectives, such as promoting diversity in student populations. To this end, they embed these objectives into the choice rules of institutions, such as schools, and implement the deferred-acceptance (DA) mechanism based on those rules. Given the institutional choice rules, we introduce a method for characterizing the corresponding DA mechanism through the properties of these choice rules. Utilizing this method, we derive novel characterizations of DA mechanisms across various settings, including matching problems with enrollment guarantees and overlapping reserves—motivated by school choice in Chile—as well as environments with matroidal feasibility constraints or objectives. Our approach provides a unified framework for characterizing DA mechanisms that accommodate policy-relevant objectives.
records.abstract_cn: 在匹配市场中，政策制定者常常追求复杂的分目标，例如促进学生群体的多样性。为此，他们将这些目标嵌入到机构（如学校）的选择规则中，并基于这些规则实施延迟接受（DA）机制。给定机构的选择规则，我们引入了一种方法，通过选择规则的性质来刻画相应的DA机制。利用这一方法，我们在多种情境下推导出DA机制的新特征，包括具有入学保障和重叠保留的匹配问题——受智利学校选择的启发——以及具有拟阵可行性约束或目标的环境。我们的方法为刻画适应政策相关目标的DA机制提供了一个统一框架。

records.title_en: Persuasion without ex-post commitment
records.title_cn: 无事后承诺的说服
records.abstract_en: We study a persuasion model with limited commitment in which the sender can commit to a signal ex ante but not to truthful reporting ex post. Sender-optimal signals exploit a key trade-off: although better-quality information allows the sender to communicate more precisely, it adversely affects the credibility of his messages. Building on this observation, we provide sufficient and necessary conditions for the sender to strictly benefit from obtaining an imperfect signal. Under linear preferences, we show that sender-optimal signals can take on a bi-pooling structure; if preferences are also convex, bi-pooling becomes necessary. Finally, we provide a full characterization of sender-optimal signals for the popular uniform-quadratic specification, which we use to quantify and compare the value of commitments.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个有限承诺的说服模型，其中发送者可以事前承诺一个信号，但不能事后承诺如实报告。发送者最优信号利用了一个关键权衡：尽管更高质量的信息使发送者能够更精确地沟通，但它对其信息的可信度产生不利影响。基于这一观察，我们提供了发送者从获得不完美信号中严格获益的充分必要条件。在线性偏好下，我们表明发送者最优信号可以采取双池化结构；如果偏好也是凸的，双池化则成为必要条件。最后，我们为流行的均匀-二次规范提供了发送者最优信号的完整刻画，并用其来量化和比较承诺的价值。

records.title_en: A model of rejection-based decision making
records.title_cn: 基于拒绝的决策模型
records.abstract_en: This paper introduces a model of decision making based on a procedure of rejection. Departing from the standard model of choice via preference maximization, the decision maker (DM) in our model rejects minimal alternatives from a menu according to a binary relation. We axiomatically study the correspondence of non-rejected alternatives with different rationality conditions on the underlying binary relation. We then generalize our model to study correspondences generated by an iterative procedure of rejection. It is observed that the classical rational choice model is a special case of this model, thus providing a procedural description of selecting the maximal set. We find that the rejection approach developed in this paper can also explain anomalies observed in decision theory, such as the two-decoy effect or the two-compromise effect.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了一种基于拒绝程序的决策模型。与通过偏好最大化进行选择的标准模型不同，我们模型中的决策者根据二元关系从菜单中拒绝最小备选方案。我们从公理上研究了未被拒绝的备选方案与底层二元关系的不同理性条件之间的对应关系。然后，我们推广我们的模型，以研究由迭代拒绝程序生成的对应关系。观察到经典理性选择模型是该模型的一个特例，从而为选择最大集提供了程序性描述。我们发现，本文开发的拒绝方法也可以解释决策理论中观察到的异常现象，如双诱饵效应或双妥协效应。

records.title_en: A revealed preference approach to approximate utility maximisation
records.title_cn: 近似效用最大化的显示偏好方法
records.abstract_en: We develop a revealed preference method for studying preferences of individuals whose choices may be inconsistent with utility maximisation. We show that acyclicity of the strict revealed preference is necessary and sufficient for the data to be rationalisable with approximate utility maximisation. In this model, an alternative is selected from a menu only if its utility is not significantly lower than that of any other available option. This allows us to test for consumer behaviour that is subject to imprecision, vagueness of judgement, or incommensurability, among others. Our results require minimal assumptions on the empirical framework, making them applicable to studies of choices over consumption bundles, state-contingent consumption, and lotteries.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种显示偏好方法，用于研究其选择可能与效用最大化不一致的个体的偏好。我们证明，严格显示偏好的无环性是数据能够通过近似效用最大化实现合理化的充分必要条件。在该模型中，只有当某个选项的效用不显著低于任何其他可用选项时，该选项才会被从菜单中选出。这使我们能够检验受不精确性、判断模糊性或不可通约性等影响的消费者行为。我们的结果对实证框架的假设要求极低，使其适用于对消费束、状态依存消费和彩票选择的研究。

records.title_en: Correlation concern
records.title_cn: 相关性担忧
records.abstract_en: In many choice problems, the interaction between several distinct variables determines the payoff of each alternative. I propose and axiomatize a model of a decision maker who recognizes that she may not accurately perceive the correlation between these variables, and who takes this into account when making her decision. She chooses as if she calculates each alternative's expected outcome under multiple possible correlation structures, and then evaluates it according to the worst expected outcome.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多选择问题中，多个不同变量之间的相互作用决定了每个备选方案的收益。我提出并公理化了一个决策者模型，该决策者认识到自己可能无法准确感知这些变量之间的相关性，并在做出决策时考虑到这一点。她表现得仿佛在多种可能的相关结构下计算每个备选方案的预期结果，然后根据最差的预期结果对其进行评估。

records.title_en: Deadlines and matching
records.title_cn: 截止日期与匹配
records.abstract_en: Deadlines and fixed end dates are pervasive in matching markets. Deadlines drive fundamental non-stationarity and complexity in behavior, generating significant departures from the steady-state equilibria usually studied in the search and matching literature. I consider a two-sided matching market with search frictions where vertically differentiated agents attempt to form bilateral matches before a deadline. I give novel proofs of existence and uniqueness of equilibria, and show that all equilibria exhibit an “anticipation effect” where less attractive agents become increasingly choosy over time, preferring to wait for the opportunity to match with attractive agents who, in turn, become less selective as the deadline approaches. When agents are patient, a sharp characterization is available: at any point in time, the market segments into a first class of matching agents and a second class of waiting agents. This points to a different interpretation of unraveling.
records.abstract_cn: 截止日期和固定结束日期在匹配市场中普遍存在。截止日期驱动了行为中的根本性非平稳性和复杂性，产生了与搜索和匹配文献中通常研究的稳态均衡显著偏离的情况。我考虑了一个具有搜索摩擦的双边匹配市场，其中垂直差异化的代理人试图在截止日期前形成双边匹配。我给出了均衡存在性和唯一性的新颖证明，并表明所有均衡都表现出一种“预期效应”，即吸引力较弱的代理人随时间推移变得越来越挑剔，倾向于等待与有吸引力的代理人匹配的机会，而这些有吸引力的代理人随着截止日期的临近则变得不那么挑剔。当代理人有耐心时，可以得到一个清晰的刻画：在任何时间点，市场分为匹配代理人的第一类和等待代理人的第二类。这指向了对“瓦解”的不同解释。

records.title_en: Climate payments: A Coase theorem
records.title_cn: 气候支付：一个科斯定理
records.abstract_en: Climate-related payments have emerged as a contentious and complex issue in climate negotiations. Major questions remain on how this will be done and how effective payments will be. The paper studies transfers under a variety of timing possibilities. It is shown that outcome-contingent payments always lead to efficiency and a particular alignment of transfer and emission timings implies that the efficient equilibrium is the only equilibrium even when the horizon is infinite. The theoretical novelty is a multi-lateral Coase Theorem in a dynamic model. The policy prescription is for an enhanced role for transfers to solve the climate problem.
records.abstract_cn: 气候相关支付已成为气候谈判中一个有争议且复杂的问题。关于如何实施以及支付效果如何，仍存在重大问题。本文研究了多种时间安排下的转移支付。研究表明，结果依存的支付总能带来效率，并且转移支付与排放时间的一种特定对齐方式意味着，即使时间跨度无限，有效均衡也是唯一均衡。理论创新在于动态模型中的多边科斯定理。政策建议是增强转移支付在解决气候问题中的作用。

records.title_en: Bargaining under liquidity constraints: Experimental evidence
records.title_cn: 流动性约束下的谈判：实验证据
records.abstract_en: Bargaining is widely used in monetary, labor and finance models to determine terms of trade. The chosen bargaining solution can matter for welfare analysis, for example when agents are liquidity constrained. Here we report on an experiment in which buyers and sellers engage in semi-structured bargaining to determine the terms of trade with the aim of evaluating the empirical relevance of two bargaining solutions, the generalized Nash bargaining solution and Kalai's proportional bargaining solution. These bargaining solutions predict different outcomes when buyers are constrained in their money holdings. We first use the case when the buyer is not liquidity constrained to estimate the bargaining power parameter, which we find to be equal to 1/2. Then, imposing liquidity constraints on buyers, we find strong evidence in support of the Kalai proportional solution. Our findings have policy implications, e.g., for the welfare cost of inflation in search-theoretic models of money.
records.abstract_cn: 谈判在货币、劳动和金融模型中广泛用于确定交易条件。所选择的谈判解决方案可能对福利分析产生影响，例如当代理人面临流动性约束时。在此，我们报告了一项实验，其中买方和卖方进行半结构化谈判以确定交易条件，旨在评估两种谈判解决方案的经验相关性：广义纳什谈判解决方案和卡莱比例谈判解决方案。当买方在货币持有方面受到约束时，这两种谈判解决方案预测的结果不同。我们首先使用买方不受流动性约束的情况来估计谈判力参数，发现其等于1/2。然后，对买方施加流动性约束，我们发现强有力的证据支持卡莱比例解决方案。我们的发现具有政策含义，例如，在货币搜寻理论模型中通货膨胀的福利成本方面。

records.title_en: Undominated monopoly regulation
records.title_cn: 无支配垄断规制
records.abstract_en: We study undominated mechanisms with transfers for regulating a monopolist who privately observes the marginal cost of production. A mechanism is undominated if no other mechanism gives the regulator a strictly higher payoff at some marginal cost of the monopolist without lowering the regulator's payoff at other costs. We show that an undominated mechanism has a quantity floor: whenever the monopolist is allowed to operate, it produces above a threshold quantity. Moreover, the regulator's operation decision is stochastic only if the monopolist produces at the quantity floor. We provide a near-complete characterization of the set of undominated mechanisms and use it to (a) derive a max-min optimal regulatory mechanism, (b) provide a foundation for deterministic mechanisms, and (c) show that the efficient mechanism is dominated.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在规制者私下观察边际生产成本的情况下，带有转移支付的无支配机制。如果一个机制在垄断者的某些边际成本下没有其他机制能给规制者带来严格更高的收益，而在其他成本下不降低规制者的收益，则该机制是无支配的。我们证明，无支配机制具有数量下限：每当垄断者被允许运营时，其产量高于一个阈值数量。此外，规制者的运营决策仅在垄断者生产于数量下限时才是随机的。我们提供了无支配机制集合的近乎完整的刻画，并利用它来(a)推导出最大最小最优规制机制，(b)为确定性机制提供基础，以及(c)表明有效机制是被支配的。

records.title_en: Targeting in adaptive networks
records.title_cn: 自适应网络中的目标选择
records.abstract_en: This paper studies optimal targeting policies, which consist of eliminating (preserving) a set of agents in a network and aim to minimize (maximize) aggregate effort levels. Unlike the existing literature, we allow the equilibrium network to adapt after a network intervention. We introduce a novel and tractable adjustment process. If global strategic substitution effects are sufficiently small, optimal targeting is characterized by a simple rule: eliminate a set of agents with the highest degree. However, if global strategic substitution effects are large, it may be optimal to target the least central agent or eliminate fewer agents than possible.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了最优目标选择政策，即消除（保留）网络中的一组代理，旨在最小化（最大化）总努力水平。与现有文献不同，我们允许均衡网络在网络干预后进行调整。我们引入了一种新颖且易处理的调整过程。如果全局战略替代效应足够小，最优目标选择由简单规则刻画：消除度最高的代理集合。然而，如果全局战略替代效应较大，则可能最优目标是针对最不中心的代理或消除比可能更少的代理。

records.title_en: International Migration Responses to Modern Europe’s Most Destructive Earthquake: Messina and Reggio Calabria, 1908
records.title_cn: 国际移民对现代欧洲最具破坏性地震的回应：墨西拿与雷焦卡拉布里亚，1908年
records.abstract_en: The Messina-Reggio Calabria Earthquake (1908) was one of the most devastating natural disasters in modern European history. It occurred when overseas mass emigration from southern Italy was at its peak and international borders were open, making emigration a readily available option for relief. We find that the earthquake had no large positive impact on emigration on average. There were, however, heterogeneous responses, with a more positive effect where agricultural day laborers comprised a larger share of the labor force, suggesting that attachment to the land limited an emigration response.
records.abstract_cn: 墨西拿-雷焦卡拉布里亚地震（1908年）是现代欧洲历史上最具破坏性的自然灾害之一。它发生在意大利南部海外大规模移民达到顶峰且国际边界开放的时期，使得移民成为现成的救济选择。我们发现，地震平均而言并未对移民产生大的正向影响。然而，存在异质性回应，在农业日工占劳动力比例较大的地区，正向效应更为显著，这表明对土地的依附限制了移民回应。

records.title_en: Voting Rights and Media Sentiment: Evidence from Early Suffrage States
records.title_cn: 投票权与媒体情绪：来自早期选举权州的证据
records.abstract_en: Did women’s suffrage affect media sentiment toward voting rights and narratives about women more generally? I identify pro- and anti-suffrage language using publications that explicitly argued for or against early voting reform. I then measure media sentiment using language in newspapers and topic modeling to identify common themes about either suffrage or women. Difference-in-differences estimates show that newspaper coverage of suffrage increased when women won the vote but then declined below baseline. Newspaper sentiment moved in opposition to the status quo, with average sentiment becoming more anti-suffrage. Lastly, suffrage increased discussions of women in politics for several years.
records.abstract_cn: 女性选举权是否影响了媒体对投票权的情绪以及更普遍地对女性的叙述？我通过明确支持或反对早期投票改革的出版物来识别支持和反对选举权的语言。然后，我使用报纸中的语言和主题建模来衡量媒体情绪，以识别关于选举权或女性的共同主题。双重差分估计显示，当女性赢得投票权时，报纸对选举权的报道增加，但随后降至基线以下。报纸情绪与现状相反，平均情绪变得更加反对选举权。最后，选举权增加了关于女性参与政治的讨论，持续了数年。

records.title_en: Large Fires and the Rise of Fire Insurance in Early Twentieth-Century Japan
records.title_cn: 二十世纪初日本的大火灾与火灾保险的兴起
records.abstract_en: We explore the role that large fires played in the early development of the Japanese fire insurance industry. Using a prefecture-level data set spanning 30 years, our econometric analysis shows that large fires led to an increase in new policies and policy renewals, consistent with historical narratives that insurance companies used these events to advertise their business. We also show that this subsequent surge in policies led to more small fires due to arson. Anecdotal evidence suggests that it is more likely to have been due to moral hazard rather than adverse selection.
records.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了大火灾在日本火灾保险业早期发展中所扮演的角色。利用一个覆盖30年的县级数据集，我们的计量经济学分析表明，大火灾导致了新保单和保单续保的增加，这与保险公司利用这些事件进行业务宣传的历史叙述相符。我们还表明，随后保单的激增导致了更多因纵火引起的小火灾。轶事证据表明，这更可能是由于道德风险而非逆向选择所致。

records.title_en: The Cross of Gold: Brazilian Treasure and the Decline of Portugal
records.title_cn: 黄金的十字架：巴西财富与葡萄牙的衰落
records.abstract_en: As late as 1750, Portugal had a high output per head by Western European standards. Yet just a century later, Portugal was this region’s poorest country. In this paper, we show that the discovery of massive quantities of gold in Brazil over the eighteenth century played a key role in the long-run development of Portugal. The country suffered from an economic and political resource curse. A counterfactual based on synthetic control methods suggests that by 1800 Portugal’s GDP per capita was 40 percent lower than it would have been without its endowment of Brazilian gold.
records.abstract_cn: 直到1750年，葡萄牙的人均产出仍按西欧标准处于较高水平。然而，仅一个世纪后，葡萄牙便成为该地区最贫穷的国家。在本文中，我们表明，十八世纪巴西大量黄金的发现对葡萄牙的长期发展起到了关键作用。该国遭受了经济和政治上的资源诅咒。基于合成控制法的反事实分析表明，到1800年，葡萄牙的人均GDP比没有巴西黄金禀赋的情况下低了40%。

records.title_en: Lottery-Based Elections, Power Monopolization, and Urban Development: The Case of Swiss City-States, 1666–1794
records.title_cn: 基于抽签的选举、权力垄断与城市发展：瑞士城邦的案例，1666-1794年
records.abstract_en: Early modern urban parliaments suffered an increasing monopolization of political power that hampered urban development. To combat power monopolization, some Swiss city-states reformed their election systems by randomly selecting political representatives from a pre-elected pool of candidates. We implement a difference-in-differences design and find that lottery-based election systems improved the equality of distribution of political seats within parliaments. Lottery-based elections also had positive effects on trade tax revenues, trade volumes, and infrastructure expenditures. We explain this finding by showing that lottery-based election systems fostered the election of merchants to top political positions.
records.abstract_cn: 近代早期的城市议会遭受政治权力日益垄断的困扰，这阻碍了城市发展。为对抗权力垄断，一些瑞士城邦通过从预先选出的候选人池中随机抽取政治代表来改革其选举制度。我们采用了双重差分设计，发现基于抽签的选举制度改善了议会内政治席位分配的平等性。基于抽签的选举还对贸易税收收入、贸易量和基础设施支出产生了积极影响。我们通过展示基于抽签的选举制度促进了商人被选入最高政治职位来解释这一发现。

records.title_en: Creating American Farmland: Governance Institutions and Investment in Agricultural Drainage
records.title_cn: 创建美国农田：治理机构与农业排水投资
records.abstract_en: The Corn Belt is famously responsible for the bulk of U.S. corn production, and over half of its production comes from counties that rely on artificial drainage. We trace the history of this extensive investment in farmland and document the importance of a key institutional innovation, the drainage management district, which increased the land value of naturally wet eastern U.S. counties by 20–37 percent ($16.8–18.7 billion in 2020 dollars). While dramatically increasing agricultural productivity, drainage converted more than half of the 215 million acres of wetlands estimated to have existed in the United States at the time of colonization to agriculture.
records.abstract_cn: 玉米带以承担美国玉米生产的大部分而闻名，其产量超过一半来自依赖人工排水的县。我们追溯了这一大规模农田投资的历史，并记录了一个关键制度创新——排水管理区的重要性，它使美国东部自然湿润县的土地价值增加了20-37%（按2020年美元计算，约16.8-18.7亿美元）。尽管大幅提高了农业生产力，排水将殖民时期估计存在的215百万英亩湿地中超过一半转化为农业用地。

records.title_en: Institutional Innovation and the Adoption of New Technologies: The Case of Steam
records.title_cn: 制度创新与新技术的采用：蒸汽技术的案例
records.abstract_en: This paper documents how the advent of the limited liability corporation contributed to the diffusion of steam technology during Sweden’s industrialization. Using longitudinal establishment-level data, we show that incorporation sharply raised the probability that industrial establishments adopted steam. Incorporation facilitated technology adoption partly by enabling smaller establishments to expand to a greater scale, where the use of steam became feasible. These results highlight that low barriers to incorporation may be an important lever for facilitating the diffusion of new technologies.
records.abstract_cn: 本文记录了有限责任公司的出现如何促进了瑞典工业化期间蒸汽技术的传播。利用纵向的企业层面数据，我们表明公司化显著提高了工业企业采用蒸汽技术的概率。公司化部分地通过使较小规模的企业能够扩大到更大规模，从而使蒸汽的使用变得可行，来促进技术采用。这些结果强调，低门槛的公司化可能是促进新技术传播的重要杠杆。

records.title_en: Cross-Cultural Trade and the Slave Ship the Bonne Société: Baskets of Goods, Diverse Sellers, and Time Pressure on the African Coast
records.title_cn: 跨文化贸易与奴隶船“好社会号”：非洲海岸上的商品篮子、多元卖主与时间压力
records.abstract_en: The eighteenth-century French slave ship the Bonne Société traded bundles of goods in exchange for slaves in Loango. We present detailed evidence from the ship’s trading log that decomposes the goods in the bundle and identifies the European and African merchants selling captives to the ship. Prices steadily increased throughout the captain’s stay in port, and the captain increased the bundle’s price by adding more goods and adding high-priced goods. Sellers participated both as one-shot traders and as repeat traders. These results add a nuanced picture of how this destructive trade worked in practice.
records.abstract_cn: 十八世纪的法国奴隶船“好社会号”在卢安戈以成捆的商品交换奴隶。我们提供了来自该船贸易日志的详细证据，分解了商品篮中的货物，并识别了向该船出售俘虏的欧洲和非洲商人。在整个船长停留港口期间，价格稳步上涨，船长通过增加更多商品和添加高价商品来提高篮子的价格。卖主既作为一次性交易者，也作为重复交易者参与。这些结果增添了关于这种破坏性贸易在实践中如何运作的细致图景。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Hurricanes and migration: New evidence from credit bureau microdata
records.title_cn: 飓风与迁移：来自信用局微观数据的新证据
records.abstract_en: We use credit bureau microdata containing the quarterly locations of 20 million Americans to examine migration responses to 10 hurricanes between 2005 and 2017. We find that flooding from the largest hurricanes caused small increases in migration in the 2 years following the storms, while smaller hurricanes or exposure to high winds alone have limited effects on migration patterns. The results do not vary with individual credit scores, suggesting that credit constraints do not substantially affect migration. Despite short-term increases in migration following large storms, we find that Hurricane Katrina is the only storm that caused a meaningful long-run population decline in flooded areas. Our findings show that except for the most catastrophic hurricanes, post-disaster migration is unlikely to decrease population exposure in hurricane-prone areas.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用包含20万美国人季度位置的信用局微观数据，考察了10年至2005年间对2017次飓风的迁移反应。我们发现，最大飓风造成的洪水在风暴过后的2年内导致迁移小幅增加，而较小的飓风或仅暴露于强风对迁移模式的影响有限。结果不因个人信用评分而异，表明信用约束并未实质性影响迁移。尽管大风暴后短期内迁移增加，我们发现只有卡特里娜飓风在洪水地区造成了有意义的长期人口下降。我们的研究结果表明，除最具灾难性的飓风外，灾后迁移不太可能减少飓风易发地区的人口暴露。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Anticipatory effects of regulating the commons
records.title_cn: 公共资源监管的预期效应
records.abstract_en: We study the regulation of common-pool resources under long implementation horizons. First, we show that future regulation can induce either anticipatory compliance or perverse incentives to accelerate extraction (a “Green Paradox”). Then, we evaluate the early effects of a major groundwater regulation in California that does not yet bind. We assemble new data and compare within pairs of neighboring agencies that face varying restrictions on extraction. Differences in future regulation do not affect measures of water-intensive investments or groundwater extraction today. This lack of anticipatory response in either direction can be explained by time preferences: high private discount rates and/or a long implementation horizon dissipate any anticipatory effects. Common-pool resources face a lower risk of perverse incentives than excludable resources, but private actors still may not comply in advance.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在长期实施期限下对公共池资源的监管。首先，我们表明未来的监管可以引发预期性遵从或加速开采的逆向激励（“绿色悖论”）。然后，我们评估了加利福尼亚州一项尚未生效的重大地下水监管的早期影响。我们汇编了新数据，并在面临不同开采限制的相邻机构对之间进行比较。未来监管的差异并不影响当前的水密集型投资或地下水开采指标。这种双向缺乏预期反应可以用时间偏好来解释：高私人贴现率和/或长期实施期限消散了任何预期效应。公共池资源面临逆向激励的风险低于可排他性资源，但私人行为者仍可能不会提前遵从。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Do microclimates matter? The health impacts of urban heat using fine-scale data
records.title_cn: 微气候重要吗？基于精细数据的城市热健康影响
records.abstract_en: Cities tend to be warmer than their suburban counterparts, a phenomenon known as the heat island effect. This effect varies significantly over time and across different neighborhoods. This study examines the health implications of neighborhood-level temperature variations and the role of urban heat in the temperature–health relationship. Using high-resolution satellite-derived surface temperature data and emergency medical service records from Northern California, the analysis employs fixed-effects Poisson regressions. The findings show that neighborhood-level extreme heat has significant adverse health effects. However, urban heat—a highly localized and predominantly anthropogenic component of overall temperature—is less harmful than temperature shifts on a larger geographic scale. This is likely because people can better adapt to urban heat. These results highlight the importance of considering both overall temperature exposure and adaptation potential in urban environments. The effects of urban heat also vary by season. While additional warmth can provide protection during colder periods, it poses substantial health risks on warmer days. Finally, policy simulations suggest that mitigating extreme urban heat could effectively reduce health risks, particularly during warm periods. Tree planting, especially in less vegetated areas, is a beneficial strategy for protecting urban populations.
records.abstract_cn: 城市往往比其郊区更温暖，这一现象被称为热岛效应。这种效应在时间和不同社区之间存在显著差异。本研究探讨了社区层面温度变化的健康影响，以及城市热在温度-健康关系中的作用。利用北加州高分辨率卫星反演的地表温度数据和紧急医疗服务记录，分析采用了固定效应泊松回归。研究结果表明，社区层面的极端高温具有显著的不利健康影响。然而，城市热——作为总体温度中高度局部化且主要人为因素的部分——其危害性小于更大地理尺度上的温度变化。这可能是因为人们能更好地适应城市热。这些结果强调了在城市环境中考虑总体温度暴露和适应潜力的重要性。城市热的影响也随季节变化。虽然在较冷时期额外温暖可提供保护，但在较暖日子则构成显著健康风险。最后，政策模拟表明，缓解极端城市热可有效降低健康风险，尤其是在温暖时期。植树，特别是在植被较少的地区，是保护城市人口的有益策略。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Scarcity, willingness to pay for species, and imperfect substitutability with market goods
records.title_cn: 稀缺性、物种支付意愿及与市场商品的不完全替代性
records.abstract_en: The impacts of biodiversity loss on human well-being depend on how much we value benefits from nature and the extent to which substitutes exist in the market for these benefits. The lack of markets for environmental goods and services, coupled with non-linearities and irreversibility in socio-environmental systems, presents unique challenges for understanding the consequences of biodiversity loss. We use a rationed-good framework to explore how species scarcity impacts marginal WTP for species and its income elasticity. We note that marginal WTP need not be decreasing in species abundance and may even be increasing, particularly if the associated suite of benefits contributes to real income via reductions in defensive expenditures. Using a new dataset of species abundance and species-level WTP estimates, we test our predictions that species abundance will impact marginal WTP and its income elasticity. Our point estimates of the income elasticity of WTP (η=0.44−0.51) are stable across a range of model specifications. Under the assumption of homothetic preferences, this value suggests that the species in our dataset are generally weakly substitutable with market goods (σ=1.96−2.27); however, we show that complementarity between species and market goods increases as the species’ level of threat increases: η=1.13, σ=0.88 for critically endangered species. The observed relationships cannot be captured by the functional forms for utility used in many models driving policymaking.
records.abstract_cn: 生物多样性丧失对人类福祉的影响取决于我们对自然效益的重视程度以及市场上这些效益的替代品存在程度。环境商品和服务缺乏市场，加上社会环境系统中的非线性和不可逆性，为理解生物多样性丧失的后果带来了独特挑战。我们使用配给商品框架来探讨物种稀缺性如何影响物种的边际支付意愿及其收入弹性。我们注意到，边际支付意愿不一定随物种丰富度增加而减少，甚至可能增加，特别是当相关的效益组合通过减少防御性支出而贡献于实际收入时。利用新的物种丰富度和物种层面支付意愿估计数据集，我们检验了物种丰富度将影响边际支付意愿及其收入弹性的预测。我们对支付意愿收入弹性的点估计（η=0.44−0.51）在一系列模型设定中保持稳定。在齐次偏好的假设下，该值表明我们数据集中的物种通常与市场商品呈弱替代关系（σ=1.96−2.27）；然而，我们显示物种与市场商品之间的互补性随着物种受威胁程度的增加而增强：对于极度濒危物种，η=1.13，σ=0.88。观察到的关系无法被许多驱动政策制定的模型中使用的效用函数形式所捕捉。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Individual versus group-level agglomeration bonuses to conserve biodiversity
records.title_cn: 个体与群体层面的集聚奖励以保护生物多样性
records.abstract_en: Agglomeration bonuses (ABs) are payments conditional on the contiguity of landowners’ conservation areas. We study whether differentiating the bonuses between internal (within-landholding) and external (between-landholdings) boundaries can improve biodiversity conservation. Using an ecological-economic model and game theory, our simulations on realistic landscapes consisting of several multi-plot landholdings reveal that such differentiation is key in determining AB cost-effectiveness. Undifferentiated ABs (where internal equal external bonuses) are the most cost-effective schemes when regulators’ budgets are low. Yet, when budgets increase, AB cost-effectiveness improves by increasingly prioritizing internal over external bonuses, until a budget threshold beyond which only internal bonuses remain. The complexity of compensation between plots belonging to different landowners largely explains these patterns. Given this complexity, the most cost-effective schemes are characterized by little or no cooperation between landowners. Regarding policy, we conclude that differentiated ABs are cost-effective schemes that should be part of the regulators’ toolbox.
records.abstract_cn: 集聚奖励（ABs）是依据土地所有者保护区域的连续性而支付的款项。我们研究在内部（土地持有内）和外部（土地持有间）边界之间区分奖励是否能改善生物多样性保护。通过使用生态经济模型和博弈论，我们在由多个多地块土地持有组成的现实景观上的模拟显示，这种区分是决定AB成本效益的关键。当监管者预算较低时，无差异的AB（内部奖励等于外部奖励）是最具成本效益的方案。然而，当预算增加时，通过越来越优先考虑内部奖励而非外部奖励，AB的成本效益会提高，直到一个预算阈值，超过该阈值后仅保留内部奖励。属于不同土地所有者的地块之间补偿的复杂性在很大程度上解释了这些模式。鉴于这种复杂性，最具成本效益的方案特点是土地所有者之间很少或没有合作。关于政策，我们得出结论，差异化的AB是具有成本效益的方案，应纳入监管者的工具箱。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Magnitude and decomposition of the solar rebound: Evidence from Swiss households
records.title_cn: 太阳能回弹效应的规模与分解：来自瑞士家庭的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines rebound effects in electricity consumption induced by solar photovoltaic (PV) adoption using detailed panel data of 58,104 single-family home residents (2008–2019) in Switzerland. I find that solar PV adoption increases a household’s electricity consumption by approximately 8 %–11 %, depending on specification. Part of this increase is driven by households switching to electric technologies, such as electric vehicles, as shown by a decomposition of the rebound effect using machine learning predicted counterfactual consumption. The solar rebound effect is mainly driven by a subsample of households that install relatively large installations and substantially adjust their consumption patterns. In contrast, more price-sensitive consumers and households that co-adopt battery storage show smaller increases in electricity usage. These findings have important implications for the evaluation of solar PV subsidies, the planning of future energy system capacity, as well as the environmental implications of solar rebound effects.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用瑞士58,104户独栋住宅居民在2008-2019年间的详细面板数据，考察了太阳能光伏（PV）采用所引发的电力消费回弹效应。我发现，太阳能光伏的采用使家庭的电力消费增加了约8%至11%，具体取决于模型设定。通过使用机器学习预测的反事实消费进行回弹效应分解，部分增长是由家庭转向电动汽车等电力技术所驱动的。太阳能回弹效应主要由安装相对较大规模设施并大幅调整消费模式的子样本家庭驱动。相比之下，对价格更敏感的消费者以及同时采用电池存储的家庭，其电力使用增长较小。这些发现对太阳能光伏补贴的评估、未来能源系统容量的规划以及太阳能回弹效应的环境影响具有重要意义。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: The impact of exposure to pipeline gas connection during pregnancy on child development: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 孕期接触管道天然气连接对儿童发展的影响：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: Using a pipeline gas connection program in Chinese communities, this paper estimates the long-term impact of household access to cleaner fuel during pregnancy on child development. Our difference-in-differences estimates show that in-utero exposure to pipeline gas connection increases height-for-age z-score and reduces the rates of stunting and severe stunting among children aged 0–15 years in China. We do not find statistically significant impacts on weight-related outcomes. The positive effects on child height are larger for girls, poor children, and rural children, suggesting that building public energy infrastructure during pregnancy could help reduce gender, socioeconomic, and urban-rural disparities in child development. The improvement in birth outcomes and infancy health status and the increase in household investment might be two main underlying mechanisms behind the long-term health benefits from in-utero exposure to pipeline gas connection. Our further calculations show that the pipeline gas connection program is highly cost-beneficial and should be subsidized and supported by the government to increase household access to clean energy.
records.abstract_cn: 利用中国社区的管道天然气连接项目，本文估计了孕期家庭获得更清洁燃料对儿童发展的长期影响。我们的双重差分估计显示，在中国，孕期宫内暴露于管道天然气连接增加了年龄别身高Z评分，并降低了0-15岁儿童发育迟缓和严重发育迟缓的发生率。我们没有发现对体重相关结果有统计学显著的影响。对儿童身高的积极影响在女孩、贫困儿童和农村儿童中更大，这表明孕期建设公共能源基础设施可能有助于减少儿童发展中的性别、社会经济和城乡差异。出生结局和婴儿期健康状况的改善以及家庭投资的增加可能是宫内暴露于管道天然气连接带来长期健康益处的两个主要潜在机制。我们的进一步计算表明，管道天然气连接项目具有很高的成本效益，应得到政府的补贴和支持，以增加家庭获得清洁能源的机会。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Guilty or scapegoat? Land consolidation and hedgerow decline
records.title_cn: 有罪还是替罪羊？土地整理与树篱减少
records.abstract_en: Land consolidation is a standard policy tool to reduce land fragmentation through the spatial redistribution of property rights; however, the risk of adverse effects on the landscape raises concerns about its environmental sustainability. This study investigates the landscape impacts of consolidation on the hedgerow network of Lower Normandy, France. Implementing a staggered difference-in-differences strategy on a longitudinal survey (1972–2010), we show that consolidation led to a significant reduction in hedgerow density of −14.3 m/ha (standard error: 2.33), accounting for 13.7 % of the overall decline observed in consolidated areas. We also find a diminishing impact over time of consolidation and time since consolidation, an increasing impact with higher initial hedgerow density, no spillover effect, and a negative impact on network connectivity. An outline cost-benefit analysis suggests that the social costs of uprooting hedgerows outweigh the private benefits. Overall, this paper confirms that land consolidation has significantly contributed to the decline of hedgerows with economic costs, but it challenges prevailing beliefs about the policy’s share of responsibility with respect to other landscape change factors.
records.abstract_cn: 土地整理是一种通过空间重新分配产权来减少土地碎片化的标准政策工具；然而，其对景观产生不利影响的风险引发了对环境可持续性的担忧。本研究调查了法国下诺曼底地区土地整理对树篱网络的景观影响。通过对一项纵向调查（1972-2010年）实施交错双重差分策略，我们发现土地整理导致树篱密度显著下降，降幅为−14.3米/公顷（标准误：2.33），占整理区域观察到的总体下降的13.7%。我们还发现，土地整理的影响及其整理后时间的影响随时间递减，初始树篱密度越高影响越大，无溢出效应，且对网络连通性有负面影响。一项概要成本效益分析表明，拔除树篱的社会成本超过私人收益。总体而言，本文证实土地整理显著促进了树篱的减少并带来经济成本，但挑战了关于该政策相对于其他景观变化因素责任份额的普遍看法。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Birth outcome effects of nitrate contamination in drinking water
records.title_cn: 饮用水中硝酸盐污染对出生结局的影响
records.abstract_en: Despite the prevalence of drinking water contamination in the United States, its health effects are not well understood. Unlike the extensive research on health impacts of air pollution, studies on water contamination are limited, mainly due to a lack of high-frequency water contamination data. To address this gap, I construct a novel dataset of monthly nitrate contamination levels in California’s community water systems linked with individual birth records. Nitrate contamination is a persistent issue in water systems in the United States, posing a potential threat to infant health. This study estimates the effect of prenatal exposure to nitrate contamination below current regulatory limits on birth outcomes. Using a panel fixed-effects approach with water system and time fixed effects, I compare birth outcomes across infants from the same water system who were exposed to differing levels of nitrate contamination during each trimester of gestation. I find that second-trimester exposure to nitrate concentrations below regulatory limits increases the likelihood of preterm birth and low birth weight by 1.2 and 1 percentage point, respectively. Relative to sample means, these estimates translate to a 15 % increase in the probability of preterm birth and a 17 % increase in the probability of low birth weight birth. Results further suggest that lowering the current regulatory limit below 5 mg/L (half the current limit) could prevent nitrate-related adverse birth outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管美国饮用水污染普遍存在，但其健康影响尚未得到充分理解。与空气污染对健康影响的广泛研究不同，关于水污染的研究有限，主要原因是缺乏高频水污染数据。为弥补这一空白，我构建了一个新颖的数据集，包含加利福尼亚州社区供水系统的月度硝酸盐污染水平，并与个体出生记录相关联。硝酸盐污染是美国供水系统中一个持续存在的问题，对婴儿健康构成潜在威胁。本研究估计了在现行监管限值以下产前暴露于硝酸盐污染对出生结局的影响。采用面板固定效应方法，包含供水系统和时间固定效应，我比较了来自同一供水系统、在妊娠各孕期暴露于不同硝酸盐污染水平的婴儿的出生结局。我发现，妊娠中期暴露于低于监管限值的硝酸盐浓度会使早产和低出生体重的可能性分别增加1.2和1个百分点。相对于样本均值，这些估计转化为早产概率增加15%，低出生体重出生概率增加17%。结果进一步表明，将现行监管限值降低至5毫克/升（现行限值的一半）以下，可以预防与硝酸盐相关的不良出生结局。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: The impact of air pollution on mental health: Evidence from Texas
records.title_cn: 空气污染对心理健康的影响：来自德克萨斯州的证据
records.abstract_en: I estimate the impact of air pollution on mental health employing a comprehensive population-level outpatient diagnosis dataset and a quasi-experimental design. This study uses wind direction as an instrumental variable (IV) to address endogeneity concerns associated with exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5), ensuring a robust analysis of mental health outcomes. The results indicate that a 1 μg/m3 increase in PM2.5 concentration leads to a significant increase in principal diagnoses for mental health illness in general, and specifically depression, anxiety, and stress, by 9.6, 5.3, 2.6, and 1.7 cases per 100,000 individuals, respectively. In addition, the study highlights sex-specific effects, with women more susceptible to stress and men more affected by anxiety. The findings suggest that principal diagnoses are particularly sensitive to increases in PM2.5 exposure. These results provide valuable insights for the development of public health strategies addressing the environmental determinants of mental health, particularly as air pollution levels continue to rise. In conclusion, this study presents strong empirical evidence linking PM2.5 exposure to increased mental health diagnoses, underscoring the need to consider mental health when designing policies to address air pollution.
records.abstract_cn: 我采用全面的人口水平门诊诊断数据集和准实验设计来估计空气污染对心理健康的影响。本研究使用风向作为工具变量 (IV) 来解决与接触细颗粒物 (PM2.5) 相关的内生性问题，确保对心理健康结果进行稳健的分析。结果表明，PM2.5 浓度增加 1 μg/m3 会导致一般精神健康疾病的主要诊断显着增加，特别是抑郁、焦虑和压力，每 100,000 个人分别增加 9.6、5.3、2.6 和 1.7 例。此外，该研究还强调了性别特异性的影响，女性更容易受到压力，而男性更容易受到焦虑的影响。研究结果表明，主要诊断对 PM2.5 暴露的增加特别敏感。这些结果为制定解决心理健康环境决定因素的公共卫生战略提供了宝贵的见解，特别是在空气污染水平持续上升的情况下。总之，本研究提供了强有力的经验证据，将 PM2.5 暴露与心理健康诊断增加联系起来，强调在设计解决空气污染的政策时需要考虑心理健康。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Internalizing externalities through ecological compensation: Evidence from trans-boundary water pollution in China
records.title_cn: 通过生态补偿内部化外部性：来自中国跨省水污染的证据
records.abstract_en: This study examines the effects of China's cross-provincial ecological compensation scheme (CpECS) on trans-boundary water pollution. Using a staggered difference-in-differences method, we find that the CpECS significantly reduces water pollution in terms of ammonia nitrogen (NH3-N) concentrations by 33.4 %. By linking water quality with point-source and nonpoint-source pollution control practices, we find that these improvements result from reductions in industrial wastewater discharge and pig production, and improvement in municipal sewage treatment capacity. However, the scheme does not yield a significant reduction in chemical oxygen demand (COD) concentrations, likely due to a lack of incentives to exceed contractual targets in policy areas once those targets are met.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了中国跨省生态补偿方案（CpECS）对跨省水污染的影响。采用交错双重差分方法，我们发现CpECS显著降低了氨氮（NH3-N）浓度的水污染，降幅为33.4%。通过将水质与点源和非点源污染控制实践联系起来，我们发现这些改善源于工业废水排放和生猪养殖的减少，以及城市污水处理能力的提升。然而，该方案并未显著降低化学需氧量（COD）浓度，这可能是由于政策区域在达到合同目标后缺乏超越目标的激励。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Private sector promotion of agricultural technologies: Experimental evidence from Nigeria
records.title_cn: 私营部门推广农业技术：来自尼日利亚的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Private sector agricultural businesses are critical for scaling new and potentially environmentally-friendly technologies, though much attention has focused on public agricultural investment. Working with a private firm, we conduct an experiment testing the effectiveness of alternative marketing strategies for promoting the adoption of urea super granule fertilizer (USG) among rice farmers in Nigeria. We disentangle the effects of price discount vouchers and the firm’s standard marketing package. We find that the firm’s standard marketing increases the adoption of USG fertilizer by 24 percentage points while reducing prilled urea utilization by 17 percentage points. Discount vouchers increase adoption of USG by an additional eight percentage points, but are not profitable for the firm. Although the adoption of USG leads to substantial environmental benefits by reducing nitrogen loss, farmer rice yields did not increase. Thus, despite the potential public benefits, private incentives facing firms and farmers are insufficient to drive scaling after a one-year intervention.
records.abstract_cn: 私营农业企业在推广新型且可能环境友好的技术方面至关重要，尽管大量关注集中在公共农业投资上。我们与一家私营企业合作，进行了一项实验，测试替代营销策略在尼日利亚稻农中推广尿素大颗粒肥料（USG）采用的有效性。我们区分了价格折扣券和企业标准营销包的效果。我们发现，企业的标准营销使USG肥料的采用率提高了24个百分点，同时使颗粒尿素的使用量减少了17个百分点。折扣券使USG的采用率额外增加了八个百分点，但对企业而言并不盈利。尽管采用USG通过减少氮损失带来了显著的环境效益，但农民的稻谷产量并未增加。因此，尽管存在潜在的公共效益，企业和农民面临的私人激励不足以在一年干预后推动规模化。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Fishing bans in Chinese waters: Effectiveness and spillovers
records.title_cn: 中国水域的禁渔令：有效性与溢出效应
records.abstract_en: China’s large-scale seasonal fishing bans aim to promote sustainable fisheries, yet their effectiveness remains uncertain given the challenges of monitoring vast ocean areas. Using a novel dataset of nighttime vessel detections and a regression discontinuity in time (RDiT) design, we find that the bans reduce boat detections within China’s Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) by 72 %, with a sharp increase upon lifting. Boat detections also decline in neighboring EEZs at the start of China’s bans, indicating regulatory spillovers. Data from AIS-equipped vessels reveal that Chinese boats operate in neighboring EEZs, while foreign vessels fish in the Chinese EEZ. Compliance weakens in the later stages of the bans, with more boats detected in areas with favorable conditions. My findings suggest that command-and-control approaches can be effective for fishery management in contexts where market-based alternatives may not be practical. The results also underscore the importance of addressing regulatory spillovers and strengthening complementary enforcement.
records.abstract_cn: 中国大规模的季节性禁渔令旨在促进渔业可持续发展，然而，鉴于监测广阔海域的挑战，其有效性仍不确定。利用新颖的夜间船只探测数据集和时间断点回归（RDiT）设计，我们发现禁渔令使中国专属经济区（EEZ）内的船只探测数量减少了72%，并在解禁时急剧增加。中国禁渔令开始时，邻近专属经济区的船只探测数量也有所下降，表明存在监管溢出效应。来自配备AIS船只的数据显示，中国船只在邻近专属经济区作业，而外国船只在中国专属经济区捕鱼。在禁渔令后期，合规性减弱，在条件有利的地区探测到更多船只。我的研究结果表明，在市场为基础的替代方案可能不切实际的情况下，命令控制方法可以有效用于渔业管理。结果还强调了解决监管溢出效应和加强补充执法的重要性。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Gone with the wind? Impacts of hurricanes on college enrollment and completion
records.title_cn: 随风而逝？飓风对大学入学和完成学业的影响
records.abstract_en: Hurricanes have significant and growing economic impacts. While the physical destruction is immediately visible, the disruptions to education and their long-term effects on human capital are often less apparent. This study examines the impact of hurricanes on U.S. higher education enrollment and completion using data from the Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System and a Differences-in-Differences Event Study approach. We find that two-year colleges experience an approximately 10 % decline in both enrollment and the number of degrees and certifications awarded within a decade following a hurricane, whereas four-year institutions exhibit no significant effects. The impact is more pronounced in institutions exposed to higher hurricane intensity and frequency, public two-year colleges, and those with a greater reliance on local student populations and higher admission rates. These effects appear to be driven by shifts in migration patterns, declines in high school graduates, and local labor market disruptions. Our findings suggest that targeted government disaster aid for community colleges could be more effective.
records.abstract_cn: 飓风具有显著且日益增长的经济影响。虽然物理破坏立即可见，但对教育的干扰及其对人力资本的长期影响往往不那么明显。本研究利用综合中学后教育数据系统（Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System）的数据和双重差分事件研究法（Differences-in-Differences Event Study），考察了飓风对美国高等教育入学和完成学业的影响。我们发现，在飓风发生后的十年内，两年制学院的入学人数以及授予的学位和证书数量均下降约10%，而四年制院校则没有显著影响。这种影响在飓风强度和频率较高的机构、公立两年制学院以及更依赖本地学生群体和录取率较高的机构中更为明显。这些效应似乎是由迁移模式的变化、高中毕业生人数的下降以及当地劳动力市场的干扰所驱动的。我们的研究结果表明，针对社区学院的定向政府灾害援助可能更为有效。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: How to boost countries’ climate ambitions: Turning gains from emissions trading into gains for climate
records.title_cn: 如何提升各国的气候雄心：将排放交易的收益转化为气候收益
records.abstract_en: The Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) under the Paris Agreement fall short of the emissions reductions needed to reach the 2 ∘C target. Emissions trading could be a “costless" means to reduce this gap if countries used their cost savings for additional emissions abatement. However, this requires cooperative behavior. We show that with emissions trading countries’ non-cooperative choices of emissions reduction contributions can lead to even more abatement, provided that these contributions may not be lower than their initial NDCs. Intuitively, countries with high climate damages raise their contributions if they can fulfill them partly through emissions reductions in countries with low abatement costs.
records.abstract_cn: 《巴黎协定》下的国家自主贡献（NDCs）未能达到实现2°C目标所需的减排量。如果各国将其成本节约用于额外的减排，排放交易可能是缩小这一差距的“无成本”手段。然而，这需要合作行为。我们表明，在排放交易下，各国非合作选择的减排贡献可能导致更多的减排，前提是这些贡献不得低于其初始NDCs。直观上，气候损害较高的国家如果可以通过在减排成本较低的国家进行减排来部分实现其贡献，则会提高其贡献。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Intra-firm pollution leakage and redistribution of pollution exposure: Evidence from coal-regulated plants in China
records.title_cn: 公司内部污染泄漏和污染暴露的重新分配：来自中国燃煤电厂的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the intra-firm pollution leakage and its distributional consequences on ambient PM2.5 induced by the Top 1000 energy conservation program on industrial plants in China. Using a combined data on plant-level pollution emissions, ambient PM2.5 concentration, and business ownership networks from 2001 to 2010, we identify the causal effects of the program on air pollution emissions by the plants and PM2.5 concentration in local neighborhoods affected by the emissions using a difference-in-differences strategy. The paper has two main findings. First, regulation-induced production transfer results in a leakage of 27 % in sulfur dioxide and coarse dust emissions from program-regulated plants to their affiliate plants. Second, the leakage shifts up PM2.5 near affiliate plants and results in a re-distribution of PM2.5 exposure towards socially disadvantaged rural neighborhoods where the affiliates are located in. These neighborhoods exhibit greater vulnerability due to less developed medical services and low health insurance coverage. Back-of-the-envelope calculations indicate that the leakage in pollution leads to a disproportionately higher leakage in health costs.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了中国工厂顶级1000节能计划引起的企业内部污染泄漏及其对环境PM2.5的分布影响。利用2001至2010期间工厂级污染排放、环境PM2.5浓度和企业所有权网络的综合数据，我们使用双重差分策略确定了该计划对工厂空气污染排放和受排放影响的当地社区PM2.5浓度的因果影响。该论文有两个主要发现。首先，监管引起的生产转移导致二氧化硫和粗粉尘排放从计划监管工厂到其附属工厂泄漏27%。其次，泄漏量在附属工厂附近上升PM2.5，导致PM2.5暴露重新分布到附属工厂所在的社会弱势农村社区。由于医疗服务不发达和医疗保险覆盖率低，这些社区表现出更大的脆弱性。粗略计算表明，污染的泄漏导致健康成本的泄漏不成比例地增加。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Environmental health risks, welfare and GDP
records.title_cn: 环境健康风险、福利与GDP
records.abstract_en: A seemingly overlooked impact on economic well-being is rising health risks attributed to the environment, which are impacting welfare worldwide. We modify the consumption-equivalent macroeconomic welfare measure developed by Jones and Klenow (2016) to include the impacts of these risks on life expectancy and the utility flow of the average individual. Employing the Global Burden of Disease dataset of environmentally related mortality and morbidity across 163 countries over 1990–2019, we compare welfare with and without environmental health risks to GDP per capita for each country relative to the United States. In addition, we examine the extent to which welfare in rich and poor countries converge. Across all 163 countries over 1990–2019, adjusting welfare for environmental health risks is significant when compared to income (GDP) per capita or to welfare that excludes these risks. This divergence in welfare is especially prominent among low and lower middle-income countries.
records.abstract_cn: 一个看似被忽视的对经济福祉的影响是环境导致的健康风险上升，这些风险正在影响全球福利。我们修改了Jones和Klenow（2016）提出的消费等价宏观经济福利衡量指标，以纳入这些风险对平均个体预期寿命和效用流的影响。利用全球疾病负担数据集中163个国家1990-2019年环境相关死亡率和发病率的数据，我们将考虑和不考虑环境健康风险的福利与各国相对于美国的人均GDP进行比较。此外，我们考察了富裕国家和贫穷国家福利趋同的程度。在1990-2019年间的所有163个国家中，与人均收入（GDP）或排除这些风险的福利相比，调整环境健康风险后的福利差异显著。这种福利差异在低收入和中低收入国家中尤为突出。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Real-time emissions data disclosure of Waste-to-Energy incineration plants and public risk perceptions: Evidence from the housing market
records.title_cn: 垃圾焚烧发电厂实时排放数据披露与公众风险感知：来自住房市场的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the effect of real-time corporate emissions data disclosure on housing markets, leveraging China’s 2017 “Installing, Erecting, and Networking” (IEN) policy as a quasi-natural experiment. Using a difference-in-difference-in-differences (DDD) analysis on over 35,000 housing transactions near 13 Waste-to-Energy (WtE) incineration plants, we find that the real-time emissions data disclosure significantly attenuates the housing price gradient by approximately 34.7%. This attenuation corresponds to an economic gain equivalent to around 39% of an urban resident’s annual disposable income, reflecting a substantial reduction in residents’ perceived environmental risks. Event study analysis demonstrates that the housing market response emerges rapidly after the introduction of real-time disclosure and remains persistent thereafter. Further heterogeneity analyses indicate that the positive effects of the disclosure are more pronounced in urban areas and are stronger near plants that operate in compliance with emission standards, employ advanced flue gas abatement technologies, and have smaller treatment capacities. Our findings underscore the novel role of real-time emissions data disclosure in mitigating environmental risk perceptions, offering key policy implications for enhancing public acceptance of potentially controversial environmental infrastructure.
records.abstract_cn: 本文以中国2017年“装、树、联”（IEN）政策为准自然实验，考察企业实时排放数据披露对住房市场的影响。基于对13座垃圾焚烧发电厂附近超过35,000笔住房交易的三重差分（DDD）分析，我们发现实时排放数据披露显著减弱了住房价格梯度，幅度约为34.7%。这一减弱效应对应的经济收益相当于城镇居民年人均可支配收入的约39%，反映出居民感知环境风险的显著降低。事件研究分析表明，住房市场反应在实时披露引入后迅速出现，并在此后持续存在。进一步的异质性分析显示，披露的积极效应在城市地区更为明显，并且在符合排放标准、采用先进烟气治理技术以及处理能力较小的工厂附近更强。我们的研究结果强调了实时排放数据披露在缓解环境风险感知方面的新颖作用，为提升公众对潜在争议性环境基础设施的接受度提供了关键政策启示。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Carbon pricing, compensation, and competitiveness: Lessons from UK manufacturing
records.title_cn: 碳定价、补偿与竞争力：来自英国制造业的经验
records.abstract_en: Carbon pricing is often paired with compensation to carbon-intensive firms to mitigate the risk of carbon leakage. This paper empirically examines the effects of indirect carbon cost compensation on UK manufacturing firms. Using administrative microdata, we combine difference-in-differences and fuzzy regression discontinuity designs to exploit firm-level eligibility criteria and identify the causal impact of compensation. We find that compensation reduces output contraction but also increases electricity consumption and emissions. These findings highlight a key policy trade-off – while compensation can help protect firms’ competitiveness and reduce leakage risks, it may also delay industrial decarbonization and increase the overall cost of achieving national emission targets.
records.abstract_cn: 碳定价通常与对碳密集型企业的补偿相结合，以减轻碳泄漏的风险。本文实证考察了间接碳成本补偿对英国制造业企业的影响。利用行政微观数据，我们结合双重差分和模糊断点回归设计，利用企业层面的资格标准，识别补偿的因果效应。我们发现，补偿减少了产出收缩，但也增加了电力消耗和排放。这些发现凸显了一个关键的政策权衡——虽然补偿有助于保护企业竞争力并降低泄漏风险，但也可能延迟工业脱碳，并增加实现国家排放目标的总体成本。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Nature and the ultimate resource: Sustainability with poor input substitution
records.title_cn: 自然与终极资源：投入替代性不足下的可持续性
records.abstract_en: The paper develops an endogenous growth framework to show that poor input substitution and population growth are compatible with sustainable development, once labor and knowledge are adequately taken into account. A sustainable economy with poor input substitution relies on the combination of a favorable demand effect, providing a “safe haven" for capital and knowledge, and a supply effect that is supported by the “waterbed function" of labor. Population growth promotes sustainability through innovation, but has a negative impact if it implies increased pressure on ecosystem services. Induced innovation cannot avert an economic catastrophe when the ecology is tipping. Degrowth policies protect the environment but harm welfare level and development. Knowledge is the most important economic indicator of sustainability, but measurements at sectoral and country levels must be interpreted with great care.
records.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个内生增长框架，表明在充分考虑劳动和知识的情况下，投入替代性不足与人口增长可以与可持续发展相容。投入替代性不足的可持续经济依赖于有利的需求效应（为资本和知识提供“避风港”）与由劳动的“水床功能”支撑的供给效应的结合。人口增长通过创新促进可持续性，但如果意味着对生态系统服务的压力增加，则会产生负面影响。当生态趋于临界点时，诱致性创新无法避免经济灾难。去增长政策保护环境，但损害福利水平和发展。知识是可持续性最重要的经济指标，但在部门和国家层面的测量必须谨慎解读。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Heat and experienced racial segregation
records.title_cn: 高温与经历中的种族隔离
records.abstract_en: Racial segregation remains a persistent social challenge in cities worldwide. While public spaces promote diverse encounters, recent research suggests that extreme temperatures influence how much time individuals spend in these places. We evaluate whether such behavioral responses affect racial segregation, highlighting a previously unexplored channel between global warming and social welfare. Using mobile phone data on movement patterns to millions of locations in 315 US cities between 2018 and 2020, we estimate an index of experienced segregation in visits to different destinations between whites and other ethnic groups. We then exploit week-to-week variation in temperatures and the segregation index within cities to show that heat increases segregation, especially among individuals from lower-income areas and at places for leisure activities. A week with average maximum temperatures of 33 ∘C in a city with moderate baseline segregation like Los Angeles moves the experienced segregation about 14 % closer to the level prevailing in the more segregated city of Atlanta. Climate projections demonstrate that mitigation policies can have significant co-benefits in cushioning future increases in racial segregation.
records.abstract_cn: 种族隔离在全球城市中仍然是一个持续存在的社会挑战。虽然公共空间促进了多样化的相遇，但最近的研究表明，极端温度会影响个人在这些场所花费的时间。我们评估了这种行为反应是否影响种族隔离，从而突显了全球变暖与社会福利之间一个先前未被探索的渠道。利用2018年至2020年间美国315个城市中数百万个地点的移动模式手机数据，我们估计了白人与其他族裔群体在访问不同目的地时经历隔离的指数。然后，我们利用城市内温度和周际隔离指数的周际变化来表明，高温加剧了隔离，尤其是在来自低收入地区和个人休闲活动场所。在基线隔离程度适中的城市（如洛杉矶），一周平均最高温度为33°C时，经历中的隔离会向隔离程度更高的亚特兰大市现有水平移动约14%。气候预测表明，减缓政策在缓冲未来种族隔离加剧方面可以产生显著的协同效益。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Environmental regulation, residential sorting, and pollution exposure among senior Americans
records.title_cn: 环境规制、居住分选与美国老年人的污染暴露
records.abstract_en: We investigate how environmental regulation under the U.S. Superfund program and Clean Air Act affected exposures to fine particulate air pollution and hazardous waste for Americans over age 65 during the 2000s. Our research design uses quasi-random features of how the two programs enforce regulations and provide information to estimate their causal effects on migration and pollution exposure. We show that senior Americans’ average pollution exposures declined substantially. We also show that spatially heterogeneous improvements in environmental quality had little-to-no effect on residential sorting. This led to relatively large reductions in pollution exposure for seniors living in the dirtiest areas.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了美国超级基金计划和《清洁空气法》下的环境规制如何影响65岁以上美国人在2000年期间对细颗粒物空气污染和危险废物的暴露。我们的研究设计利用了两个计划在执行法规和提供信息方面的准随机特征，以估计其对迁移和污染暴露的因果效应。我们表明，美国老年人的平均污染暴露显著下降。我们还表明，环境质量的空间异质性改善对居住分选几乎没有影响。这导致生活在最脏地区的老年人的污染暴露减少幅度相对较大。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Natural resources, demand for skills, and schooling choices
records.title_cn: 自然资源、技能需求与教育选择
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the consequences of the buildup of a new economic sector—the Norwegian petroleum industry—on investment in human capital. We assess both short- and long-term effects on educational choices by comparing individuals in oil-exposed regions with those in unexposed regions. We analyze how the effects and mechanisms change as the sector develops. Our results indicate a short-term increase in the high school dropout rate and a long-term decrease in academic high school and college enrolment, except for engineering degrees. Financial incentives are the most likely channels driving these effects on high school and university education.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了新经济部门——挪威石油工业——的发展对人力资本投资的影响。我们通过比较石油暴露地区与未暴露地区的个体，评估了教育选择的短期和长期效应。我们分析了随着部门发展，这些效应及其机制如何变化。我们的结果表明，高中辍学率在短期内上升，而学术型高中和大学入学率在长期内下降，但工程学位除外。财务激励是驱动这些对高中和大学教育影响的最可能渠道。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Optimal climate policy under exogenous and endogenous technical change: Making sense of the different approaches
records.title_cn: 外生与内生技术变迁下的最优气候政策：理解不同方法的差异
records.abstract_en: We analyse the large and diverse literature on technical change in integrated assessment models (IAMs) of climate change, with a view to understanding how different representations of technical change affect optimal climate policy. We first solve an analytical IAM that features several models of technical change from the literature, including exogenous technical change in abatement technologies, exogenous decarbonisation of the economy, endogenous technical change via learning-by-doing, and endogenous technical change via R&D (in particular, directed technical change). We show how these models of technical change impact optimal carbon prices, emissions and temperatures in often quite different ways. We then survey how technical change is currently represented in the main quantitative IAMs used to inform policy, demonstrating that a range of approaches are used. Exogenous technical change in abatement technologies and learning-by-doing are most popular, although the latter mechanism is only partially endogenous in some models. We go on to quantify technical change in these policy models using structural estimation, and simulate our analytical IAM numerically, assessing the effect of technical change on optimal climate policy. We find large quantitative effects of technical change and large quantitative differences between different representations of technical change, both under cost-benefit and cost-effectiveness objectives.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了关于气候变化综合评估模型（IAMs）中技术变迁的大量且多样的文献，旨在理解技术变迁的不同表述如何影响最优气候政策。我们首先求解了一个分析性IAM，该模型包含了文献中的几种技术变迁模型，包括减排技术的外生技术变迁、经济的外生脱碳、通过干中学的内生技术变迁，以及通过研发（特别是定向技术变迁）的内生技术变迁。我们展示了这些技术变迁模型如何以往往相当不同的方式影响最优碳价格、排放量和温度。然后，我们调查了当前用于政策制定的主要定量IAMs中技术变迁的表述方式，表明采用了多种方法。减排技术的外生技术变迁和干中学最为流行，尽管后一种机制在某些模型中仅部分内生。我们接着使用结构估计对这些政策模型中的技术变迁进行量化，并对我们的分析性IAM进行数值模拟，评估技术变迁对最优气候政策的影响。我们发现技术变迁具有较大的定量效应，且不同技术变迁表述之间存在较大的定量差异，无论是在成本效益还是成本有效性目标下。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Nudging toward climate adaptation. A field experiment on informational strategies in organic food markets
records.title_cn: 推动气候适应：有机食品市场信息策略的实地实验
records.abstract_en: We conduct a field experiment to test whether informational messages can nudge organic consumers toward purchasing “greener” products that support climate change adaptation. Leveraging data from a large Italian online shop of organic products, we use pasta as a case study to examine consumer responses to information about an ancient durum wheat variety with superior drought tolerance compared to modern wheat. We test two types of messages that frame climate adaptation as achievable through everyday choices: a colloquial information that adopts a relatable tone and a science-based message that presents evidence with visual elements. We find that the colloquial message increases the market share of “greener” pasta by 13 %, while the science-based message is effective only among highly environmentally conscious consumers. Effects persist for at least three months and are stronger among women, younger individuals, and those with higher education. The effect of colloquial messaging is amplified among consumers previously experiencing severe or extreme drought conditions. We observe a backfire effect among the greenest consumers, i.e., those who were already predominantly purchasing ancient pasta.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开展了一项实地实验，以检验信息性信息能否推动有机消费者购买支持气候变化适应的“更绿色”产品。利用一家大型意大利有机产品在线商店的数据，我们以意大利面为案例研究，考察消费者对一种古老硬粒小麦品种信息的反应，该品种与现代小麦相比具有更强的耐旱性。我们测试了两种将气候适应框定为可通过日常选择实现的信息：一种采用亲切语气、易于理解的通俗信息，以及一种以视觉元素呈现证据的基于科学的信息。我们发现，通俗信息使“更绿色”意大利面的市场份额增加了13%，而基于科学的信息仅对环保意识极强的消费者有效。效果至少持续三个月，且在女性、年轻个体和受教育程度较高者中更为显著。通俗信息的效果在先前经历过严重或极端干旱条件的消费者中被放大。我们观察到在最绿色消费者（即那些原本主要购买古老意大利面的人）中存在反噬效应。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Spilling over: The benefits of public works projects for groundwater in India
records.title_cn: 溢出效应：印度公共工程项目对地下水的益处
records.abstract_en: Depletion of groundwater is a major challenge in India. We examine how a major rural public works program (MNREGA) that financed the construction of surface water infrastructure may have plausibly increased aquifer recharge rates and impacted groundwater levels. Using a difference-in-differences approach on the staggered and heterogeneous roll-out of MNREGA, we show that groundwater levels increased after its implementation. These increases were concentrated in states that constructed the largest number of MNREGA-financed surface water projects. The increases we observe in groundwater appear to have led to increases in the irrigated area of high value crops and greater overall irrigation during the dry season.
records.abstract_cn: 地下水枯竭是印度面临的一大挑战。我们考察了一个主要农村公共工程计划（MNREGA），该计划资助建设地表水基础设施，可能合理地提高了含水层补给率并影响了地下水位。采用双重差分法，针对MNREGA的分阶段和异质性推广，我们显示其实施后地下水位有所上升。这些上升集中在建设了最多MNREGA资助的地表水项目的邦。我们观察到的地下水上升似乎导致了高价值作物灌溉面积的增加以及旱季整体灌溉的扩大。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Mobilizing credit for clean energy: De-risking and public loan provision under learning spillovers
records.title_cn: 为清洁能源动员信贷：学习溢出下的风险降低与公共贷款供给
records.abstract_en: This paper analyzes bank lending behavior toward novel clean energy technologies in the presence of high screening costs and potential learning-by-lending. In a two-period model, bank loans in the first period build up banks’ financing experience with the novel technology, which improves lending profitability and partially spills over to peers. Because of these learning externalities, such early-stage loans are either undersupplied by the market (a cooperation problem) or do not occur at all if the banking sector remains stuck in an inferior market equilibrium with no lending (a coordination problem). We propose a policy mix in which public loan provision eliminates the inferior equilibrium, thereby resolving the coordination problem, while de-risking subsidies internalize learning spillovers to peers. Our findings highlight the role of public financial policies if environmental and innovation externalities are already addressed, and we provide a numerical application to the early stage of offshore wind energy in Germany as a plausible context for our policy implications.
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了在存在高筛选成本和潜在的学习性贷款效应下，银行对新型清洁能源技术的贷款行为。在一个两期模型中，第一期的银行贷款积累了银行对新型技术的融资经验，这提高了贷款盈利能力，并部分溢出给同行。由于这些学习外部性，此类早期贷款要么由市场供给不足（合作问题），要么如果银行业部门仍停留在无贷款的低劣市场均衡中，则根本不会发生（协调问题）。我们提出了一种政策组合，其中公共贷款供给消除了低劣均衡，从而解决了协调问题，而风险降低补贴则将学习溢出内部化给同行。我们的发现强调了在环境和创新外部性已经得到解决的情况下，公共金融政策的作用，并且我们提供了一个数值应用，以德国海上风电的早期阶段作为我们政策含义的合理背景。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Environmental regulation and firms’ extensive margin decisions
records.title_cn: 环境规制与企业扩展边际决策
records.abstract_en: The paper explores the impacts of environmental regulation on Chinese firms’ extensive margin decisions and resulting changes in market structure and competitiveness. We find that environmental regulation significantly deters firm entry in pollution-intensive industries, while its impact on firm exit is negligible, revealing an asymmetric impact at the extensive margin. The theoretical model and empirical evidence suggest that regulation raises average productivity by selecting against low-productivity entrants and allowing high-productivity firms to enter at smaller scales. We also test for spatial spillovers and find no substantial firm relocation to unregulated areas. These results highlight market selection as a key mechanism through which environmental regulation reshapes industrial dynamics.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了环境规制对中国企业扩展边际决策的影响及其导致的市场结构和竞争力的变化。我们发现，环境规制显著抑制了污染密集型行业的企业进入，而对企业退出的影响则微乎其微，揭示了扩展边际上的不对称影响。理论模型和实证证据表明，规制通过筛选低生产率进入者并允许高生产率企业以较小规模进入，从而提高了平均生产率。我们还检验了空间溢出效应，未发现企业大量迁移至未受规制地区的现象。这些结果凸显了市场选择作为环境规制重塑产业动态的关键机制。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: The market for ethical goods
records.title_cn: 道德商品的市场
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how consumers and producers sort themselves in markets for ethically labeled goods, such as “organic” or “child-labor-free,” considering both extrinsic and intrinsic motives. I show how greenwashing arises from the interplay between prosocial motives and equilibrium sorting. A positive demand shock leads more producers to adopt the label, including some with weaker ethical motives. This lowers the expected environmental and social quality of labeled, but also unlabeled goods. The optimal subsidy for producing ethically labeled goods is smaller than the Pigouvian subsidy, and in some cases, it may even be optimal to tax these goods.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了消费者和生产者如何在道德标签商品市场中自我选择，如“有机”或“无童工”商品，同时考虑外在和内在动机。我展示了漂绿行为如何源于亲社会动机与均衡选择之间的相互作用。正向需求冲击导致更多生产者采用标签，包括一些道德动机较弱的。这降低了标签商品以及未标签商品的预期环境和社会质量。生产道德标签商品的最优补贴小于庇古补贴，在某些情况下，甚至可能最优的是对这些商品征税。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Effect of the interplay between comparative feedback and beliefs on climate change mitigation efforts
records.title_cn: 比较反馈与信念相互作用对气候变化减缓努力的影响
records.abstract_en: We examine the causal effect of comparative feedback (information on how an individual's carbon footprint compares to others') on costly mitigation efforts, considering beliefs in one's relative carbon footprint as a source of heterogeneity. Using a nationally representative survey experiment, we calculate respondents' carbon footprints and elicit their beliefs about their relative carbon footprint via an incentivized task. A randomly selected subset of respondents then receives comparative feedback. We measure mitigation efforts using an incentivized modified dictator game. Our results show that two-thirds of the respondents are subject to optimistic bias, i.e., underestimate their relative carbon footprints. While we find no effect of comparative feedback on average, its effect varies by respondents' relative carbon footprints and the direction of the bias. Respondents for whom comparative feedback conveys a positive signal of their prosociality—because they learn that their relative carbon footprints are small, smaller than they believed, or both—reinforce their mitigation efforts. Respondents for whom comparative feedback conveys a negative signal of their prosociality reduce or do not change their mitigation efforts. These contrasting responses result in a “divergence from the mean”, deviating from the “regression towards the mean” typically observed in studies of social norms and pro-environmental behavior.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了比较反馈（关于个人碳足迹与他人相比如何的信息）对昂贵减缓努力的因果效应，考虑个人相对碳足迹信念作为异质性来源。通过一项全国代表性的调查实验，我们计算了受访者的碳足迹，并通过激励任务引出他们对其相对碳足迹的信念。随机选择的一部分受访者随后收到比较反馈。我们使用激励性修改版独裁者游戏来衡量减缓努力。结果显示，三分之二的受访者存在乐观偏差，即低估了他们的相对碳足迹。虽然我们发现比较反馈平均没有影响，但其效果因受访者的相对碳足迹和偏差方向而异。对于比较反馈传达其亲社会性积极信号的受访者——因为他们了解到自己的相对碳足迹较小，比他们原先认为的还要小，或两者兼有——会加强他们的减缓努力。对于比较反馈传达其亲社会性消极信号的受访者，则会减少或不改变他们的减缓努力。这些对比鲜明的反应导致了“偏离均值”，偏离了在社会规范和环境行为研究中通常观察到的“向均值回归”现象。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Human capital impairment or air pollution discount? Air quality and expected job seeking
records.title_cn: 人力资本损害还是空气污染折扣？空气质量与预期求职
records.abstract_en: Air quality affects labor supply decisions through two primary channels of health impairment and compensating differentials. Our extended Roy/Borjas model, which reconciles both channels, demonstrates that poor air quality discourages high-skilled job seekers and reduces their expected wages through compensation effects. Using a unique online resume database from China in 2016, our findings support the compensation theory, revealing that high-skilled job seekers are more inclined to migrate from more polluted cities, significantly lowering wage expectations in exchange for improved air quality in the job-changing context. Conversely, those who intend to remain in polluted areas expect wage premiums to offset environmental disamenities. These findings persist across alternative specifications, various robustness tests, and rigorous endogeneity models. Furthermore, we reveal that the compensation effects are more pronounced among high-skilled job seekers with greater risk awareness and weaker wage-bargaining power. This study contributes to the literature by revealing the economic consequences of environmental quality on labor market dynamics.
records.abstract_cn: 空气质量通过健康损害和补偿性差异两个主要渠道影响劳动力供给决策。我们扩展的Roy/Borjas模型调和了这两个渠道，表明恶劣的空气质量通过补偿效应阻碍高技能求职者并降低其预期工资。利用中国2016年独特的在线简历数据库，我们的研究结果支持补偿理论，揭示高技能求职者更倾向于从污染更严重的城市迁移，在换工作背景下显著降低工资预期以换取改善的空气质量。相反，那些打算留在污染地区的人预期获得工资溢价以抵消环境不便利。这些发现在替代规格、各种稳健性检验和严格的内生性模型中持续存在。此外，我们揭示补偿效应在风险意识更强和工资议价能力较弱的高技能求职者中更为显著。本研究通过揭示环境质量对劳动力市场动态的经济后果，为文献做出贡献。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: What are the macroeconomic effects of state-dependent forward guidance?
records.title_cn: 状态依赖的前瞻指引的宏观经济效应是什么？
records.abstract_en: We examine the macroeconomic effects of the Bank of England (BoE)’s state-dependent forward guidance (SDFG). The policy’s timing permits separate identification of SDFG from QE, which is difficult in the EA and US because these policies were announced jointly. A New Keynesian model shows that SDFG reduces uncertainty about the future policy rate. We use this prediction and the timing of the BoE’s SDFG, to identify SDFG shocks with a narrative sign restriction BVAR approach. Output and prices rise in response to SDFG, despite no econometric restrictions on these variables. The effects are small and consistent with the NK model. We find that changes in expectations play a greater role in transmitting SDFG to the economy than lower retail interest rates.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了英格兰银行（BoE）的状态依赖前瞻指引（SDFG）的宏观经济效应。该政策的时机使得能够将SDFG与量化宽松（QE）分开识别，而这在欧元区和美国是困难的，因为这些政策是联合宣布的。一个新凯恩斯主义模型表明，SDFG减少了关于未来政策利率的不确定性。我们利用这一预测以及BoE的SDFG时机，通过叙事符号限制BVAR方法识别SDFG冲击。尽管对这些变量没有施加计量经济学限制，产出和价格在响应SDFG时上升。这些效应较小，且与NK模型一致。我们发现，预期变化在将SDFG传导至经济中发挥的作用大于零售利率的降低。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Accounting for the multiple sources of inflation: An agent-based model investigation
records.title_cn: 解释通货膨胀的多重来源：基于主体模型的考察
records.abstract_en: We develop a macroeconomic agent-based model to study the role of demand and supply factors in determining inflation dynamics. Local interactions of heterogeneous firms and households in the labor and goods markets characterize the model. Asymmetric information implies that firm selection is imperfect and depends both on firms' relative prices and on their size. We calibrate the model on EU data by using the method of simulated moments and show that it can generate realistic inflation dynamics and a non-linear Phillips curve in line with recent empirical evidence. We then find that the traditional demand-led explanation of inflation stemming from a tight labor market only holds when selection in the goods markets is mostly driven by relative prices in comparison to firm size. Finally, we study the response of inflation to shocks impacting consumption, labor productivity, or energy costs. The results indicate that only demand shocks lead to wage-led inflation surges. Productivity shocks are entirely passed through to prices without affecting the income distribution. Energy shocks, instead, induce sellers' inflation after changes in both firms' cost structure and profit margins. This is in line with the recent empirical evidence for the Euro Area.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个宏观经济基于主体模型，以研究需求和供给因素在决定通货膨胀动态中的作用。该模型的特征是劳动力和商品市场中异质性企业与家庭之间的局部互动。信息不对称意味着企业选择是不完美的，并且既取决于企业的相对价格，也取决于其规模。我们使用模拟矩方法在欧盟数据上校准模型，并表明该模型能够生成现实的通货膨胀动态以及一条与近期经验证据一致的非线性菲利普斯曲线。然后我们发现，源于紧张劳动力市场的传统需求主导型通货膨胀解释，仅在商品市场中的选择主要由相对价格而非企业规模驱动时才成立。最后，我们研究了通货膨胀对影响消费、劳动生产率或能源成本的冲击的反应。结果表明，只有需求冲击会导致工资主导的通货膨胀激增。生产率冲击完全传导至价格，而不影响收入分配。相反，能源冲击在企业的成本结构和利润率发生变化后引发卖方通货膨胀。这与欧元区近期的经验证据一致。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: The demographic transition and stagnation in countries vulnerable to climate change
records.title_cn: 气候变化脆弱国家的 demographic transition 与停滞
records.abstract_en: Climate change, environmental degradation, and high population growth can trap Sub-Saharan Africa in prolonged economic stagnation. We develop a novel theoretical framework showing how climate-induced resource depletion increases women's time spent collecting essentials like water and firewood, reducing investment in girls' education. This perpetuates gender inequality in education and income, slowing fertility decline and reinforcing population growth. A larger population further degrades resources, creating a feedback loop of stagnation. Empirical analysis of 44 African countries (1960 - 2017) supports these findings, revealing adverse climate effects on local resources and education gaps. Addressing these interconnected challenges is critical to breaking the stagnation cycle and fostering sustainable development.
records.abstract_cn: 气候变化、环境退化和高人口增长可能使撒哈拉以南非洲陷入长期的经济停滞。我们开发了一个新颖的理论框架，展示气候导致的资源枯竭如何增加女性收集水和柴火等必需品的时间，减少对女孩教育的投资。这加剧了教育和收入方面的性别不平等，减缓了生育率下降，并强化了人口增长。更大的人口进一步恶化资源，形成停滞的反馈循环。对44个非洲国家（1960-2017年）的实证分析支持了这些发现，揭示了气候变化对当地资源和教育差距的不利影响。解决这些相互关联的挑战对于打破停滞循环和促进可持续发展至关重要。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Mismatch unemployment during COVID-19 and the post-pandemic labor shortages
records.title_cn: COVID-19期间及疫情后劳动力短缺中的错配失业
records.abstract_en: We examine the extent to which mismatch unemployment—employment losses relative to an efficient allocation where the planner can costlessly reallocate unemployed workers across sectors to maximize output—shaped labor market dynamics during the COVID-19 pandemic and the subsequent recovery episode characterized by labor shortages. We find that, for the first time in our sample, mismatch unemployment turned negative at the onset of the pandemic. This result suggests that the efficient allocation of job seekers would involve reallocating workers toward longer-tenure and more-productive jobs, even at the expense of fewer hires. We show that sectoral differences in job separations were the main driver behind this result, while differences in vacancies caused positive mismatch unemployment during the recovery episode. We also establish an empirical link between mismatch unemployment and the surge in the labor cost during the recovery, documenting that sectors with larger mismatch unemployment experienced higher employment cost growth.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了错配失业——相对于一个计划者可以无成本地将失业工人跨部门重新分配以最大化产出的有效配置的就业损失——在COVID-19大流行及随后以劳动力短缺为特征的复苏阶段中塑造劳动力市场动态的程度。我们发现，在我们的样本中，错配失业在大流行初期首次转为负值。这一结果表明，求职者的有效配置将涉及将工人重新分配到任期更长、生产率更高的工作岗位，即使以减少招聘为代价。我们表明，部门间离职差异是这一结果的主要驱动因素，而职位空缺差异在复苏阶段导致了正的错配失业。我们还建立了错配失业与复苏期间劳动力成本激增之间的实证联系，记录了错配失业较大的部门经历了更高的就业成本增长。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: DSGE Nash: Solving Nash games in macro models
records.title_cn: DSGE纳什：求解宏观模型中的纳什博弈
records.abstract_en: This paper presents DSGE Nash, a toolkit to solve for pure strategy Nash equilibria of global games in macro models. Nash equilibria are computed with a decentralized approach: each player controls only its own policy function while other agents in the economy act independently. Although primarily designed to solve for Nash equilibria in DSGE models, the toolkit encompasses a broad range of settings, including the possibility of matching empirical data. Importantly, it allows to solve for the equilibrium in the presence of non-linearities or conditionally on shocks. When only one player is selected, the problem is re-framed as a standard optimal policy problem. We apply the algorithm to a standard two-country open-economy model, where central banks compete for rate setting. In the Nash equilibrium, central banks symmetrically trade-off inflation for output stabilization, in the presence of a zero lower bound constraint, the equilibrium becomes asymmetric: the central bank in the shock-originating economy implements a tighter policy, to reduce the zero lower bound duration, while the central bank in the other country opts for a more lenient rate setting strategy.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了DSGE纳什，一个用于求解宏观模型中全局博弈的纯策略纳什均衡的工具包。纳什均衡通过分散化方法计算：每个参与者仅控制自身的政策函数，而经济中的其他主体则独立行动。尽管该工具包主要设计用于求解DSGE模型中的纳什均衡，但它涵盖了广泛的设定，包括匹配经验数据的可能性。重要的是，它允许在存在非线性或条件于冲击的情况下求解均衡。当仅选择一个参与者时，问题被重新构建为标准的最优政策问题。我们将该算法应用于一个标准的两国开放经济模型，其中中央银行在利率设定上进行竞争。在纳什均衡中，中央银行对称地在通胀与产出稳定之间进行权衡；在存在零下限约束的情况下，均衡变得不对称：冲击起源国的中央银行实施更紧缩的政策，以减少零下限的持续时间，而另一国的中央银行则选择更宽松的利率设定策略。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
