records.abstract_cn: 在农业仍然是主要生计来源的国家，农村家庭转向非农经济是经济增长和结构转型的关键驱动力。本研究探讨了埃塞俄比亚农村地区收入多样化的趋势和模式、其决定因素及其与家庭福利的关系。我们的分析表明，尽管经济快速增长的大背景下，埃塞俄比亚农村家庭在2012-2019期间仍然主要依赖农业，收入来源只有边际多样化。农作物生产仍然是主要收入来源，其次是牲畜，而非农业活动贡献了家庭总收入17-24%。要素禀赋和当地条件（包括降雨量）在多元化决策中发挥着至关重要的作用。特别是，2015-16干旱似乎促使家庭更多地参与非农创收活动。重要的是，收入多元化与更高的家庭消费、改善的饮食多样性和更好的住房质量相关，凸显了扩大农村非农经济以提高家庭福利的潜力。

records.title_en: Economic analysis of food self-sufficiency: modeling and application to the case of Israel
records.title_cn: 粮食自给自足的经济分析：建模及在以色列案例中的应用
records.abstract_en: We develop a partial equilibrium model to assess the agro-economic implications of food self-sufficiency policies aimed at reducing a developed country’s exposure to shocks in the world food markets. We apply the model to Israel, a country with a high dependence on food imports, rapid population growth, and a vegetative agricultural sector specializing in fresh fruit and vegetable production subject to land, labor, and water constraints. We simulate different levels of self-sufficiency, measured in relation to the vegetative food products recommended for consumption by the EAT–Lancet Commission (Willett et al. 2019). We find that, under Israel’s population and agricultural production resources in 2019 (our baseline year), the country can self-supply the EAT–Lancet vegetative diet, although not all nutritional intakes (particularly fat, energy, and protein) recommended by the Institute of Medicine of the National Academies (IMNA 2005) will be met. Increasing self-sufficiency requires shifting agricultural resources from the production of fresh vegetative products to more storable—and therefore more importable—products such as cereals, oils, fats, legumes, seeds, and nuts. Because such crops consume less water and labor than fruits and vegetables, land remains the main resource constraining self-sufficiency. We show that self-supply of the vegetative dietary needs of Israel’s forecasted population over the coming decades will necessitate expanding the country’s agricultural land resources and/or maintaining large stocks of storable-food products. Achieving high levels of self-sufficiency would inflict pronounced welfare loss, particularly to the farming sector. Consequently, subsidies to incentivize self-sufficiency would entail significant governmental expenditures.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个部分均衡模型来评估旨在减少发达国家遭受世界粮食市场冲击的粮食自给自足政策对农业经济的影响。我们将该模型应用于以色列，该国高度依赖粮食进口，人口快速增长，其植物性农业部门专门生产新鲜水果和蔬菜，但受到土地、劳动力和水的限制。我们模拟了不同水平的自给自足，并根据 EAT-Lancet 委员会推荐消费的植物性食品进行测量（Willett 等人 2019）。我们发现，根据以色列2019（我们的基准年）的人口和农业生产资源，该国可以自行供应EAT-柳叶刀植物性饮食，尽管不能满足美国国家科学院医学研究所（IMNA 2005）推荐的所有营养摄入量（特别是脂肪、能量和蛋白质）。提高自给自足需要将农业资源从生产新鲜植物产品转向更容易储存（因此更容易进口）的产品，例如谷物、油、脂肪、豆类、种子和坚果。由于此类作物比水果和蔬菜消耗更少的水和劳动力，因此土地仍然是限制自给自足的主要资源。我们表明，未来几十年以色列预测人口的植物性饮食需求的自我供应将需要扩大该国的农业土地资源和/或维持大量可储存食品的库存。实现高水平的自给自足将造成明显的福利损失，特别是对农业部门。因此，激励自给自足的补贴将需要大量的政府支出。

records.title_en: Methane from cattle: facing realities in the global south
records.title_cn: 来自牛的甲烷：南半球面临的现实
records.abstract_en: •Enteric methane emissions from beef in the Global South have grown to constitute 79 percent of the global total.•Meanwhile, enteric methane emissions from beef in the Global North have fallen 32 percent since 1980.•This decline can be traced to improved feed rations, genetic improvements, and better veterinary care.•In the Global South, feed additives are not a promising short-cut to contain emissions, because most animals are still finished on pasture.•Conventional productivity improvements will bring methane abatement indirectly, and are a better place to start.
records.abstract_cn: •南半球国家牛肉的肠道甲烷排放量已占全球总量的79%。•与此同时，自1980以来，北半球国家牛肉的肠道甲烷排放量已下降32%。•这种下降可以追溯到饲料配给的改善、基因改良和更好的兽医护理。•在南半球国家，饲料添加剂并不是控制排放的一条有希望的捷径，因为大多数动物仍以饲料为原料完成加工。牧场。•传统生产力的提高将间接带来甲烷减排，并且是一个更好的起点。

records.title_en: The impact of animal welfare regulations on pork trade: evidence from European countries
records.title_cn: 动物福利法规对猪肉贸易的影响：来自欧洲国家的证据
records.abstract_en: We analyse the impact of stricter national animal welfare (AW) regulations on imports and exports of pork between 13 European countries during the period 1991–2020, a period in which EU directives and national actions related to AW regulations significantly affected pig farming practices. We exploit the fact that some countries have stronger AW regulations for pigs compared with EU’s regulations and other countries’ regulations. Our analyses utilize a new detailed dataset capturing the dynamics of pig AW regulations over time for several EU member states, taking into account multiple aspects of pig AW that can have significant cost impacts for pork producers. We focus on countries with relatively stringent AW legislation for pigs and countries that are major pork producers. Using panel regression, long-differenced IV, and event study approaches, we find that an increase in the relative stringency of pig AW regulations in a country is associated with a reduction in pork exports. We find mixed evidence suggesting that stricter AW regulations for pigs reduced pork imports. Our results have important implications for other jurisdictions that plan to mandate AW regulations for pigs in the near future.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了1991-2020期间欧洲国家之间更严格的国家动物福利（AW）法规对13猪肉进出口的影响，在此期间，与AW法规相关的欧盟指令和国家行动显着影响了养猪实践。我们利用了这样一个事实：与欧盟和其他国家的法规相比，一些国家对生猪的 AW 法规更为严格。我们的分析利用了一个新的详细数据集，捕捉了几个欧盟成员国随时间推移生猪 AW 法规的动态，同时考虑了生猪 AW 可能对猪肉生产商产生重大成本影响的多个方面。我们重点关注对生猪实行相对严格的农业法规的国家和主要猪肉生产国。使用面板回归、长差分 IV 和事件研究方法，我们发现一个国家生猪 AW 法规相对严格性的增加与猪肉出口的减少有关。我们发现混合证据表明，对生猪实施更严格的农业检疫规定减少了猪肉进口。我们的结果对于计划在不久的将来强制实施生猪 AW 法规的其他司法管辖区具有重要意义。

records.title_en: What Daniel Kahneman Thought about Economics: A Reconstruction and Critique
records.title_cn: 丹尼尔·卡尼曼对经济学的思考：重构与批判
records.abstract_en: Drawing on Kahneman’s writings, his responses in interviews and our personal recollections, we reconstruct and critically assess his view of his contributions to behavioural economics, of developments in economics that have built on those contributions, and of earlier related work by economists. Kahneman always insisted that he was a psychologist, pure and simple. He saw his primary research programme as the study of intuitive judgement. While he believed that outputs from this programme could be usefully applied in economics, he differentiated his programme from most work in behavioural economics, including that of economists such as Allais and Markowitz who had proposed alternatives to expected utility theory from the 1950s. He saw behavioural economics as distinct from his approach because it retained the fundamental maximising structure of rational choice theory and represented psychological effects in ‘one deviation at a time’ models. We argue that the two programmes have more in common than Kahneman thought, and that their respective methodologies are complementary and mutually informative. As used by many behaviourally-inclined economists, utility maximisation is a flexible modelling strategy for representing considerations that might enter a reasonable person’s decision making, rather than a commitment to the belief that individuals act on preferences that satisfy a priori axioms of normative rationality. The research method of considering one deviation at a time is used in both modelling and experimentation and in both economics and psychology, in ways that promote cumulative advances in scientific knowledge.
records.abstract_cn: 基于卡尼曼的著作、他在访谈中的回应以及我们的个人回忆，我们重构并批判性地评估了他对其行为经济学贡献的看法、对基于这些贡献的经济学发展的看法，以及对经济学家早期相关工作的看法。卡尼曼始终坚持自己是一名纯粹的心理学家。他将自己的主要研究计划视为对直觉判断的研究。虽然他相信这一计划的成果可以有效地应用于经济学，但他将自己的计划与大多数行为经济学工作区分开来，包括像阿莱和马克owitz这样的经济学家提出的预期效用理论替代方案（自1950年代起）。他认为行为经济学与他的方法不同，因为它保留了理性选择理论的基本最大化结构，并以“一次一个偏差”的模型来表现心理效应。我们认为，这两个计划之间的共同点比卡尼曼认为的要多，它们各自的方法论是互补且相互启发的。正如许多倾向行为的经济学家所使用的，效用最大化是一种灵活的建模策略，用于表示可能进入理性人决策过程的考量，而非承诺于个体依据满足规范性理性先验公理的偏好行事。一次考虑一个偏差的研究方法在建模和实验中被使用，在经济学和心理学中也是如此，这种方式促进了科学知识的累积性进展。

records.title_en: Daniel Kahneman and Contingent Valuation
records.title_cn: 丹尼尔·卡尼曼与条件价值评估
records.abstract_en: In its early days, contingent valuation (CV) seemed to offer a powerful and flexible method for generating monetary values for benefits and harms that were not directly priced by markets. However, even in those early days there were concerns that citizens’ responses to CV surveys did not correspond with the assumptions underpinning the method and too often displayed substantial systematic anomalies. In the 1980s and 1990s, Kahneman and various co-authors undertook a series of studies that raised questions about the orthodoxy of ‘true preferences’ for the sorts of goods being evaluated via CV and expressed grave doubts about the feasibility of resolving fundamental issues by refinements of study design. Some tentative suggestions were made for alternative ways in which monetary values might be obtained for use in public sector decision making, but Kahneman himself did not develop these ideas in any detail, instead deploying his 21st century research in other directions.
records.abstract_cn: 在早期，条件价值评估（CV）似乎提供了一种强大且灵活的方法，用于为市场未直接定价的收益和损害生成货币价值。然而，即使在早期，人们也担心公民对CV调查的回应不符合支撑该方法的基本假设，并且常常显示出大量系统性异常。在1980年代和1990年代，卡尼曼与多位合著者进行了一系列研究，对通过CV评估的这类商品‘真实偏好’的正统观念提出了质疑，并对通过研究设计的改进来解决根本问题的可行性表达了严重怀疑。他们提出了一些尝试性的建议，以替代方式获取货币价值用于公共部门决策，但卡尼曼本人并未详细发展这些想法，而是将他的21世纪研究转向了其他方向。

records.title_en: Nudging, Fast and Slow: Experimental Evidence from Food Choices under Time Pressure
records.title_cn: 助推，快与慢：时间压力下食物选择的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Understanding when and why nudges work is crucial for designing interventions that consistently and reliably change behaviour. This paper explores the relationship between decision-making speed and the effectiveness of two nudges – carbon footprint labelling and menu repositioning – aimed at encouraging climate-friendly food choices. Using an incentivized online randomized controlled trial with a quasi-representative sample of British consumers ( N = 3,052) ordering meals through an experimental food-delivery platform, we introduced a time-pressure mechanism to capture both fast and slow decision-making processes. Our findings suggest that menu repositioning is an effective tool for promoting climate-friendly choices when decisions are made quickly, though the effect fades when subjects have time to revise their choices. Carbon labels, in contrast, showed minimal impact overall but reduced emissions among highly educated and climate-conscious individuals when they made fast decisions. The results imply that choice architects should apply both interventions in contexts where consumers make fast decisions, such as digital platforms, canteens, or fast-food restaurants to help mitigate climate externalities. More broadly, our findings suggest that the available decision time in different contexts might at least partly explain differences in effect sizes found in previous studies of these nudges.
records.abstract_cn: 理解助推何时以及为何有效，对于设计能够持续且可靠地改变行为的干预措施至关重要。本文探讨了决策速度与两种助推措施——碳足迹标签和菜单重新定位——在鼓励气候友好型食物选择方面的有效性之间的关系。通过一项激励性的在线随机对照试验，样本为通过实验性食品配送平台订餐的英国消费者准代表性样本（N = 3,052），我们引入了时间压力机制以捕捉快速和缓慢的决策过程。我们的研究结果表明，当决策快速做出时，菜单重新定位是促进气候友好型选择的有效工具，尽管当受试者有时间修改其选择时，该效应会减弱。相比之下，碳标签总体上影响甚微，但在高学历和具有气候意识的个体快速决策时，碳标签减少了其排放。结果表明，选择架构师应在消费者做出快速决策的情境中应用这两种干预措施，例如数字平台、食堂或快餐店，以帮助缓解气候外部性。更广泛地说，我们的研究结果表明，不同情境下可用的决策时间可能至少部分解释了先前关于这些助推的研究中效应量差异的原因。

records.title_en: Targeting the Sin or the Sinner? Applying Kahneman’s Insights to Frame Environmental Messages for Better Waste Management
records.title_cn: 针对罪过还是罪人？应用卡尼曼的洞见构建环境信息以改善废物管理
records.abstract_en: Inspired from Kahneman’s seminal contributions to the theory of framing, we test the impact of noun- versus verb-based framings (e.g., do not be a polluter versus do not pollute) on individuals’ behavioral intentions towards two pro-environmental messages aiming at reducing waste. Using a non-incentivized laboratory experimental survey, we find a significant effect of messages framed as verb-based actions (i.e., do not pollute, do not waste) in driving individuals to sign a petition in favor of garbage recycling and accept to receive tips about food waste. Additionally, we also identify a significant negative influence of reactance, hampering pro-environmental behavior. We discuss our exploratory results keeping in mind the humility that characterizes Kahneman’s scholarly legacy.
records.abstract_cn: 受卡尼曼在框架理论方面开创性贡献的启发，我们测试了基于名词与基于动词的框架（例如，不要成为污染者与不要污染）对个体面向两项旨在减少废物的亲环境信息的行为意图的影响。通过一项非激励性实验室实验调查，我们发现以动词为基础的行动框架（即，不要污染，不要浪费）在促使个体签署支持垃圾回收的请愿书以及接受关于食物浪费的提示方面具有显著效果。此外，我们还识别出心理抗拒的显著负面影响，它阻碍了亲环境行为。我们讨论这些探索性结果时，铭记卡尼曼学术遗产所特有的谦逊态度。

records.title_en: The Mixed Effects of Making Contribution Behaviors Observable
records.title_cn: 使贡献行为可观察的混合效应
records.abstract_en: Voluntary contributions to public goods have been shown to increase when contribution behaviors become observable by peers. We examine the effect of social pressure on moral behavior, using a framework distinguishing explicitly between observable and non-observable forms of contribution. We show that even with moral motivation and social pressure, there is underprovision of the public good. Making some contribution behaviors observable does increase effort, but also causes misallocation of effort between observable and non-observable effort types. The latter negative effect can possibly outweigh the positive effect of increased effort on public good provision.
records.abstract_cn: 当贡献行为对同伴可见时，自愿对公共物品的贡献已被证明会增加。我们通过一个明确区分可观察和不可观察贡献形式的框架，考察社会压力对道德行为的影响。我们表明，即使存在道德动机和社会压力，公共物品的供给仍然不足。使某些贡献行为可观察确实增加了努力，但也导致了努力在可观察和不可观察努力类型之间的错配。后者的负面效应可能超过增加努力对公共物品供给的正面效应。

records.title_en: Kahneman’s Insights for Climate Risks: Lessons from Bounded Rationality, Heuristics and Biases
records.title_cn: 卡尼曼对气候风险的洞见：有限理性、启发式与偏见的启示
records.abstract_en: Daniel Kahneman’s pioneering research in behavioral economics has profoundly influenced the field of environmental economics, shaping what is now known as behavioral-environmental economics. This paper provides a scoping review of how Kahneman’s theories have been applied by environmental economists to individual decision-making for climate change risks. We focus on deviations from rational behavior that impact climate adaptation decisions, such as loss aversion, the underweighting of low-probability events and the influence of heuristic-driven System 1 thinking over analytical System 2 reasoning. Our review outlines diversity in methodologies, including household surveys and economic experiments, used to analyze actions like investments in climate resilience and the purchase of disaster insurance. We synthesize these findings showing how Kahneman’s legacy explains suboptimal preparedness behaviors and discuss policy strategies derived from these insights, such as risk communication, nudges, and financial incentives for disaster preparedness. We conclude by proposing an agenda for future research to more systematically assess Kahneman’s ideas across various climate risk contexts and to deepen the application of Kahneman’s theories in tackling broader, wicked environmental problems that require changing human behaviors.
records.abstract_cn: 丹尼尔·卡尼曼在行为经济学领域的开创性研究深刻影响了环境经济学领域，塑造了如今所称的行为-环境经济学。本文对卡尼曼理论如何被环境经济学家应用于个体对气候变化风险的决策进行了范围综述。我们关注偏离理性行为对气候适应决策的影响，如损失厌恶、对低概率事件的低估，以及启发式驱动的系统1思维优于分析式系统2推理的影响。我们的综述概述了方法的多样性，包括家庭调查和经济实验，用于分析诸如气候韧性投资和灾害保险购买等行为。我们综合这些发现，展示卡尼曼的遗产如何解释次优的备灾行为，并讨论从这些洞见中得出的政策策略，如风险沟通、助推和灾害准备的财政激励。最后，我们提出未来研究议程，以更系统地评估卡尼曼思想在不同气候风险情境中的应用，并深化卡尼曼理论在解决需要改变人类行为的更广泛、棘手的环境问题中的应用。

records.title_en: Climate Change, Intergenerational Fairness, and the Promises and Pitfalls of Artificial Intelligence
records.title_cn: 气候变化、代际公平与人工智能的承诺与陷阱
records.abstract_en: Among his many achievements, Daniel Kahneman will be remembered for his fundamental contribution to the economics of fairness with its many far-reaching applications. In this paper, I focus on intergenerational fairness and its importance in tackling climate change, a high-stakes example of an intergenerational dilemma. Drawing on recent technological advances, I explore how artificial intelligence (AI) can be applied to promoting fairness and cooperation in intergenerational dilemmas. An intergenerational dilemma is characterised by three key features: asymmetry in decision power and outcomes, no possibility for reciprocity between generations, and the global nature of the problem. Building on the literature of (contemporary) economic games, I discuss how AI has the potential to change “the rules of the game” by acting as a market participant or a market maker (i.e., social planner). I outline several directions for future research, where applying AI to the problem of intergenerational dilemmas shows promise, including intra- and intergenerational fairness, long-term preferences, and mechanism design. However, while AI holds the potential to help us tackle major societal issues like climate change, I conclude with a cautionary note that excessive use of AI today—even if well-intended to benefit future generations—could further accelerate the very problems, including climate change, that we set out to tackle.
records.abstract_cn: 在丹尼尔·卡尼曼的诸多成就中，他将因其对公平经济学的根本性贡献及其广泛深远的应用而被铭记。在本文中，我聚焦于代际公平及其在应对气候变化中的重要性，这是代际困境的一个高风险例证。借鉴近期的技术进步，我探讨了人工智能（AI）如何被应用于促进代际困境中的公平与合作。代际困境具有三个关键特征：决策权力和结果的不对称性、代际之间互惠的不可能性，以及问题的全球性。基于（当代）经济博弈的文献，我讨论了AI如何通过充当市场参与者或市场制造者（即社会计划者）来改变“游戏规则”。我概述了未来研究的几个方向，在这些方向上，将AI应用于代际困境问题显示出前景，包括代内和代际公平、长期偏好以及机制设计。然而，尽管AI有潜力帮助我们应对气候变化等重大社会问题，我最后提出一个警示：当今对AI的过度使用——即使出于造福未来世代的善意——可能进一步加速我们着手解决的那些问题，包括气候变化本身。

records.title_en: In Praise of Computation
records.title_cn: 赞颂计算
records.abstract_en: A great deal of work in behavioral science emphasizes that statistical predictions often outperform clinical predictions. Formulas tend to do better than people do, and algorithms tend to outperform human beings, including experts. One reason is that algorithms do not show inconsistency or “noise”; another reason is that they are often free from cognitive biases. These points have broad implications for risk assessment in domains that include health, safety, and the environment. Still, there is evidence that many people distrust algorithms and would prefer a human decisionmaker. We offer a set of preliminary findings about how a tested population chooses between a human being and an algorithm. In a simple choice between the two across diverse settings, people are about equally divided in their preference. We also find that that a significant number of people are willing to shift in favor of algorithms when they learn something about them, but also that a significant number of people are unmoved by the relevant information. These findings have implications for current findings about “algorithm aversion” and “algorithm appreciation.”
records.abstract_cn: 行为科学中的大量工作强调，统计预测往往优于临床预测。公式通常比人做得更好，算法往往胜过人类，包括专家。原因之一是算法不会表现出不一致性或“噪声”；另一个原因是它们通常不受认知偏差的影响。这些观点对健康、安全和环境等领域中的风险评估具有广泛意义。尽管如此，有证据表明许多人并不信任算法，更倾向于人类决策者。我们提供了一组初步发现，关于受测人群如何在人类与算法之间做出选择。在多样化的情境中，当人们在两者之间进行简单选择时，偏好大致平分。我们还发现，相当数量的人在了解算法的一些信息后愿意转向支持算法，但也有相当数量的人不受相关信息影响。这些发现对当前关于“算法厌恶”和“算法欣赏”的研究结果具有启示意义。

records.title_en: Agree to disagree? Making sense of vagueness in International Environmental Agreements
records.title_cn: 求同存异？理解国际环境协议中的模糊性
records.abstract_en: The prevailing literature on International Environmental Agreements (IEAs) commonly posits the existence of a Depth-Participation Dilemma (DPD), suggesting that while precise agreements with well-defined obligations promote deeper cooperation, their specificity often deters participation. This paper revisits this assumption and introduces the differing institutional capacities of the negotiating countries. It thus provides a theoretical framework for understanding the interplay between vagueness, institutional capacities, and, most importantly, the dynamics of the DPD. Our analysis suggests that the DPD is only relevant when institutional capacities are highly uneven across negotiating states, or when a significant number of participants have limited capacities. In contrast, we find that greater precision enhances participation when most negotiating countries possess moderate to high institutional capacities. To test these predictions, we analyze ratification behavior for five climate-related IEAs from 1995 to 2018, constructing a precision index. Our empirical findings reveal (i) a bandwagon effect, where countries are more likely to ratify agreements when others do, (ii) that greater institutional differences weaken this bandwagon effect, thereby reducing ratification rates, (iii) that vagueness in agreements generally undermines incentives to ratify, and (iv) that vague agreements, once ratified, are less binding and correlate with higher CO2 emissions. This framework and evidence provide new insights into how agreement design influences participation and effectiveness in IEAs.
records.abstract_cn: 关于国际环境协议（IEAs）的现有文献普遍假设存在深度-参与困境（DPD），即具有明确义务的精确协议虽然能促进更深层次的合作，但其具体性往往阻碍参与。本文重新审视了这一假设，并引入了谈判国家制度能力的差异性。因此，本文提供了一个理论框架，用以理解模糊性、制度能力以及最重要的DPD动态之间的相互作用。我们的分析表明，只有当谈判国家之间的制度能力高度不均衡，或当大量参与者的能力有限时，DPD才具有相关性。相反，我们发现当大多数谈判国家具备中等至较高的制度能力时，更高的精确性会促进参与。为检验这些预测，我们分析了1995年至2018年间五个与气候相关的IEAs的批准行为，构建了一个精确性指数。我们的实证结果揭示了：（i）一种从众效应，即当其他国家批准协议时，本国更可能批准；（ii）更大的制度差异削弱了这种从众效应，从而降低了批准率；（iii）协议中的模糊性通常会削弱批准激励；（iv）一旦批准，模糊协议约束力较弱，并与较高的CO2排放相关。这一框架和证据为协议设计如何影响IEAs中的参与和有效性提供了新的见解。

records.title_en: Environmental regulations and green innovation: The role of trade and technology transfer
records.title_cn: 环境规制与绿色创新：贸易与技术转移的作用
records.abstract_en: This paper presents a theoretical model that predicts an inverted U-shaped relationship between green innovation and environmental regulation under free trade. Our theory also determines the conditions under which international technology transfers increase green innovation. The predictions are tested empirically by estimating a fixed effects Poisson model with data for a panel of OECD and BRICS countries over the period 1990 to 2019. The predicted inverted U-shaped relationship is confirmed by the empirical results when using the Environmental Policy Stringency Index (EPS) and its components as proxies for environmental regulations. The empirical results also show that technology transfers increase green innovation at any given level of environmental regulation. Moreover, we allow for heterogeneous effects for OECD and non-OECD countries and find that while implementing stricter environmental regulations in non-OECD countries increases green innovation, the reverse is likely to hold for most OECD countries. When distinguishing by type of regulation, our findings show that market-based regulations are more effective in non-OECD countries for fostering green innovation, while non-market-based regulations are more effective in OECD countries. The main policy implication is that the type of environmental policies through which countries aim at achieving zero-net emissions have different implications depending on their stage of development in the presence of international trade.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个理论模型，预测在自由贸易下绿色创新与环境规制之间存在倒U型关系。我们的理论还确定了国际技术转移增加绿色创新的条件。通过使用1990年至2019年间OECD和BRICS国家面板数据的固定效应泊松模型，对这些预测进行了实证检验。当使用环境政策严格性指数（EPS）及其组成部分作为环境规制的代理变量时，实证结果证实了预测的倒U型关系。实证结果还表明，在任何给定的环境规制水平下，技术转移都会增加绿色创新。此外，我们允许OECD和非OECD国家存在异质性效应，并发现虽然在非OECD国家实施更严格的环境规制会增加绿色创新，但对大多数OECD国家而言，情况可能相反。按规制类型区分时，我们的研究结果表明，市场型规制在非OECD国家促进绿色创新方面更为有效，而非市场型规制在OECD国家更为有效。主要政策含义是，各国旨在实现零净排放所采用的环境政策类型，在国际贸易存在的情况下，其影响取决于它们的发展阶段。

records.title_en: African firms’ adaptation to Chinese shock under financial and electricity constraints
records.title_cn: 非洲企业在金融和电力约束下对中国冲击的适应
records.abstract_en: Trade relations between China and African countries have intensified in the past decade, making China Africa’s largest trading partner. This paper examines the impact of Chinese import penetration on the productivity and energy intensity of African manufacturing firms, within a business environment constrained by unreliable electricity and limited access to finance. The analysis reveals that Chinese competition has led to a decline in productivity and energy intensity. Productivity improvements, in turn, reduce energy intensity, with no significant evidence of reverse causality. Firms facing a single constraint, either financial or electricity, suffer greater productivity losses than those facing both constraints simultaneously, suggesting that the two constraints interact in a non-additive way. One constraint asymmetrically mitigates the marginal harm of the other. The results show that financial constraints are more binding, while electricity remains a critical input for large firms. Furthermore, firms facing a single constraint adapt more effectively to Chinese competition by improving their productivity, whereas those facing dual constraints are less responsive and thus suffer more from the shock. These effects are particularly pronounced among small and medium-sized enterprises. At the macroeconomic level, Chinese import penetration supports national economic growth through transport equipment and enhances energy efficiency through machinery imports. The policy implications point to the need for African governments to leverage Chinese inputs to catalyze domestic investment and adopt targeted industrial strategies to mitigate the risks posed by Chinese competition. More specifically, moderate Chinese competition is necessary to induce survival pressure among single-constrained firms to push them to perfection, while particular attention should be directed toward alleviating financial constraints among doubly constrained firms to enhance their resilience.
records.abstract_cn: 过去十年间，中国与非洲国家之间的贸易关系不断加强，使中国成为非洲最大的贸易伙伴。本文考察了在电力供应不可靠和融资渠道受限的商业环境下，中国进口渗透对非洲制造业企业生产率和能源强度的影响。分析显示，中国竞争导致生产率和能源强度下降。生产率的提高反过来降低了能源强度，且没有显著的反向因果证据。面临单一约束（金融或电力）的企业比同时面临两种约束的企业遭受更大的生产率损失，这表明两种约束以非加总的方式相互作用。一种约束不对称地减轻了另一种约束的边际损害。结果表明，金融约束更具约束力，而电力对大型企业仍是关键投入。此外，面临单一约束的企业通过提高生产率更有效地适应中国竞争，而面临双重约束的企业反应较弱，因此受冲击影响更大。这些效应在中小企业中尤为显著。在宏观经济层面，中国进口渗透通过运输设备支持国家经济增长，并通过机械进口提高能源效率。政策含义表明，非洲政府需要利用中国投入来催化国内投资，并采取有针对性的产业战略以减轻中国竞争带来的风险。更具体地说，适度的中国竞争对于促使单一约束企业产生生存压力、推动其追求完善是必要的，同时应特别关注缓解双重约束企业的金融约束，以增强其韧性。

records.title_en: Technology innovation, digital finance and renewable energy consumption: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 技术创新、数字金融与可再生能源消费：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: This research analyzes the impact of technical innovation (TI) and digital finance (DF) on renewable energy consumption (REC) utilizing panel data from Chinese regions. Leveraging advanced econometric techniques such as FMOLS and DOLS, the findings indicate that both variables are statistically and economically important determinants of REC. TI as indicated by patent applications, demonstrates a significant positive impact, with a one standard deviation increase resulting in an approximate 6.75 % rise in REC relative to its sample mean. Likewise, DF substantially enhances REC, with a one standard deviation increase correlating to an 11.16 % increase in REC. These findings highlight the essential roles of innovation and financial digitization in enabling the energy transition. Policy initiatives aimed at enhancing technology research and development and fostering digital financial inclusion are crucial for expediting the deployment of renewable energy and attaining sustainable energy objectives.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究利用中国地区的面板数据，分析了技术创新（TI）和数字金融（DF）对可再生能源消费（REC）的影响。借助FMOLS和DOLS等先进计量经济学技术，研究结果表明，这两个变量在统计和经济上都是REC的重要决定因素。以专利申请表示的TI显示出显著的积极影响，一个标准差增加导致REC相对于其样本均值上升约6.75%。同样，DF显著增强REC，一个标准差增加与REC增加11.16%相关。这些发现强调了创新和金融数字化在推动能源转型中的关键作用。旨在加强技术研发和促进数字金融包容性的政策举措，对于加快可再生能源部署和实现可持续能源目标至关重要。

records.title_en: Two-stage hybrid electricity market trading strategy optimization with renewable electricity under cap-and-trade policy
records.title_cn: 碳交易政策下含可再生能源的两阶段混合电力市场交易策略优化
records.abstract_en: With the trial operation of a two-stage electricity trading mechanism, and the pilot of cap-and-trade policy in the electricity sector, optimizing strategies within a hybrid electricity market has emerged as a hot research topic. To explore the scenario of integrating renewable electricity to form a hybrid electricity market, and to analyze the impact of cap-and-trade policy on electricity market transactions, this study employs game theory to establish a two-stage electricity market analysis framework, which encompasses transactions by traditional thermal electricity generator and renewable electricity generator in the forward and spot markets. The research findings indicate that widespread integration of renewable electricity lowers spot electricity prices but may cause forward prices to rise during significant spot market volatility. It also significantly reduces carbon emissions, while an initial surge in emissions could occur, in the early stages of renewable electricity integration with low spot market demand volatility. Two-stage trading could mitigate spot price and enhance profitability of traditional thermal electricity generators, during periods of substantial market volatility. Regarding the cap-and-trade policy, it generally leads to lower electricity prices in both forward and spot markets under conditions of loose carbon emission constraints, and the impact on generators' profitability is contingent. Specifically, the policy does not invariably negatively affect traditional thermal electricity generator. Under loose emission reduction constraints, the policy does not necessarily increase the profits of renewable electricity generator.
records.abstract_cn: 随着两阶段电力交易机制的试运行以及电力行业碳交易政策的试点，混合电力市场中的策略优化已成为研究热点。为探索可再生能源并网形成混合电力市场的场景，并分析碳交易政策对电力市场交易的影响，本研究采用博弈论建立了一个两阶段电力市场分析框架，涵盖传统火电发电商和可再生能源发电商在远期市场和现货市场的交易。研究结果表明，可再生能源的广泛并网降低了现货电价，但在现货市场波动较大时可能导致远期价格上涨。同时，它显著减少了碳排放，而在可再生能源并网初期且现货市场需求波动较低时，可能出现排放的初期激增。两阶段交易在市场大幅波动期间可以平抑现货价格并提高传统火电发电商的盈利能力。关于碳交易政策，在宽松的碳排放约束条件下，它通常导致远期和现货市场的电价均下降，而对发电商盈利能力的影响则视情况而定。具体而言，该政策并非总是对传统火电发电商不利。在宽松的减排约束下，该政策不一定增加可再生能源发电商的利润。

records.title_en: The price of flexibility in electricity markets
records.title_cn: 电力市场灵活性的价格
records.abstract_en: Electricity markets differ in the flexibility they have in meeting power imbalances on short notice in a controlled fashion. Flexible markets can adjust operations to absorb random disruptions in power generation or demand. However, in markets with energy-only trading, where the producers are compensated only based on the energy delivered but not necessarily produced, there is no explicit remuneration for this flexibility. We argue that in such markets, flexibility is implicitly priced via persistent premiums in the day-ahead market (i.e., a positive average difference between day-ahead and real-time prices). Specifically, we develop a stylized game-theoretic model to characterize day-ahead premiums in equilibrium when the market is subject to the risk of a significant but low-probability disruption. Although arbitrageurs can reduce persistent day-ahead premiums by selling in the day-ahead market and buying in real-time, this strategy carries substantial downside risk, which ultimately curtails their trading activity in equilibrium. Consequently, flexible generators exert market power by limiting their committed production in the day-ahead market. While persistent day-ahead premiums incentivize more flexible resources (e.g., battery storage capacity), it is not clear that they constitute an economically efficient incentive mechanism for increasing flexibility.
records.abstract_cn: 电力市场在应对短期功率不平衡方面的灵活性有所不同，这种灵活性是以可控方式实现的。灵活的市场可以调整运营以吸收发电或需求中的随机干扰。然而，在仅进行能量交易的市场中，生产者仅根据实际输送的能量（而非必须生产的能量）获得补偿，这种灵活性没有明确的报酬。我们认为，在这样的市场中，灵活性通过日前市场的持续溢价（即日前价格与实时价格之间的正平均差异）被隐含地定价。具体来说，我们开发了一个风格化的博弈论模型，以描述在市场面临重大但低概率中断风险时，均衡状态下的日前溢价。尽管套利者可以通过在日前市场卖出并在实时市场买入来减少持续的日前溢价，但这种策略承担了相当大的下行风险，最终在均衡中限制了他们的交易活动。因此，灵活的发电商通过限制其在日前市场的承诺产量来行使市场力量。虽然持续的日前溢价激励了更多灵活资源（例如电池储能容量），但它们是否构成一种经济上有效的激励增加灵活性的机制尚不清楚。

records.title_en: Revisiting capacity market fundamentals
records.title_cn: 重新审视容量市场的基本原理
records.abstract_en: Many liberalized electricity markets use capacity mechanisms to ensure that sufficient resources will be available in advance of operations. Recent events have called into question the ability of capacity mechanisms to provide sufficient incentives for reliability. A core challenge is that penalties for non-performance on capacity obligations are lower than what theory would suggest is economically efficient, giving suppliers an incentive to overstate their contributions to reliability. System operators mitigate the effect of weak incentives by conducting accreditation studies that limit the size of the capacity obligation taken on by suppliers. However, the technical and administrative complexity of these accreditation studies has contributed to ongoing challenges for reliability and efficiency. This paper reviews fundamental elements of capacity accreditation, developing a theoretical framework that ties optimal accreditation values to economically efficient price formation. We then describe current inefficiencies and identify several assumptions stressed by the transition to variable and fuel-constrained resources. In light of these challenges, we argue that the clearest path of reform is to reduce reliance on accreditation studies, instead working to restore economic incentives through larger non-performance penalties. Given the financial risk this implies for suppliers, accreditation studies would nevertheless remain important in order to assess credit risk and prevent the use of bankruptcy as a hedge.
records.abstract_cn: 许多自由化的电力市场使用容量机制来确保在运营之前有足够的资源可用。近期事件对容量机制提供足够可靠性激励的能力提出了质疑。一个核心挑战是，容量义务未履行的罚金低于理论所表明的经济效率水平，这给供应商提供了夸大其对可靠性贡献的激励。系统运营商通过进行认证研究来缓解弱激励的影响，这些研究限制了供应商承担的容量义务规模。然而，这些认证研究的技术和行政复杂性导致了可靠性和效率方面的持续挑战。本文回顾了容量认证的基本要素，构建了一个将最优认证价值与经济有效的价格形成联系起来的理论框架。然后，我们描述了当前的效率低下问题，并指出了向可变和燃料受限资源转型所强调的几个假设。鉴于这些挑战，我们认为最清晰的改革路径是减少对认证研究的依赖，而是通过更大的未履行罚金来恢复经济激励。考虑到这给供应商带来的财务风险，认证研究仍然很重要，以评估信用风险并防止将破产用作对冲手段。

records.title_en: Local network operators in an integrated electricity market
records.title_cn: 一体化电力市场中的本地网络运营商
records.abstract_en: Electricity market integration offers significant potential for gains from trade. However it requires that enough transfer capacity is supplied by the transmission system operators (TSOs) that manage local networks. The incentive for TSOs to allocate international interconnection capacity has long been a concern for competition authorities. For example, the European Commission has in several cases argued that withholding of interconnection capacity by TSOs may have represented abuse of dominant position.
records.abstract_cn: 电力市场一体化提供了显著的贸易收益潜力。然而，这要求管理本地网络的输电系统运营商（TSOs）提供足够的传输容量。输电系统运营商分配国际互联容量的激励长期以来一直是竞争当局关注的问题。例如，欧盟委员会在多个案例中认为，输电系统运营商扣留互联容量可能构成滥用市场支配地位。

records.title_en: Strategic bidding in pay-as-bid power reserve markets: A machine learning approach
records.title_cn: 按报价支付电力储备市场中的策略性投标：一种机器学习方法
records.abstract_en: The shift towards decentralized and renewable energy systems adds complexity to electricity grid management, where balancing economic and technical needs is critical. The Ancillary Services Market (ASM) – also referred to as power reserve market – plays a crucial role in ensuring grid stability by managing balancing reserves. However, its outcomes remain difficult to predict for participants due to technical prioritization by system operators. In this paper, we propose a machine learning approach to model pay-as-bid ASM and derive an optimal bidding strategy for market participants. Specifically, we develop a probabilistic classification pipeline to estimate the acceptance probability of individual bids based on price and other explanatory variables including bid characteristics and indicators of network conditions. Additionally, we employ eXplainable AI (XAI) techniques to interpret the underlying machine learning system and provide insights into actual market clearing mechanisms. We then show how this bid acceptance probability estimator can be used by market participants to optimally price their bids and maximize expected marginal profit. Applied to the Italian ASM over the 2018–2022 period, the results show that bid acceptance probabilities are accurately estimated and that the proposed bidding strategy enables market players to significantly increase their profits. Furthermore, the analysis partially reveals the opaque clearing apparatus of the ASM, identifying a systematic bias in favor of gas-fired generation technologies. The findings of this study are not only of interest to market participants but also to regulatory authorities.
records.abstract_cn: 向去中心化和可再生能源系统的转变增加了电网管理的复杂性，其中平衡经济和技术需求至关重要。辅助服务市场（ASM）——也称为电力储备市场——通过管理平衡储备在确保电网稳定性方面发挥着关键作用。然而，由于系统运营商的技术优先级排序，其结果对参与者而言仍难以预测。在本文中，我们提出了一种机器学习方法来模拟按报价支付的ASM，并为市场参与者推导出最优投标策略。具体来说，我们开发了一个概率分类流程，基于价格和其他解释变量（包括投标特征和网络状况指标）来估计单个投标的接受概率。此外，我们采用可解释人工智能（XAI）技术来解释底层的机器学习系统，并提供对实际市场清算机制的见解。然后，我们展示了市场参与者如何使用这个投标接受概率估计器来最优地定价其投标并最大化预期边际利润。应用于2018-2022年期间的意大利ASM，结果表明投标接受概率被准确估计，并且所提出的投标策略使市场参与者能够显著增加其利润。此外，该分析部分揭示了ASM不透明的清算机制，识别出对燃气发电技术的系统性偏向。本研究的发现不仅对市场参与者感兴趣，也对监管机构具有意义。

records.title_en: The extreme event of climate change: How digital transformation affects the performance of commercial banks?
records.title_cn: 气候变化的极端事件：数字化转型如何影响商业银行的绩效？
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates how digital transformation moderates the adverse impact of climate risks on commercial bank performance, using a panel dataset of 187 Chinese commercial banks from 2012 to 2021. The results reveal that heightened climate risks significantly reduce bank profitability and operational stability. However, digital transformation offsets these deleterious effects by lowering cost-to-income ratios and enhancing operational efficiency. A variety of robustness tests confirm the validity of the findings. Further heterogeneity analyses indicate that the mitigating role of digital transformation is more pronounced in developed regions and smaller banks. By explicitly linking climate risk and digital strategies, this study contributes to the growing literature on sustainable finance and risk management. The findings offer timely insights for policymakers and bank executives seeking to fortify financial institutions against climate disruptions, while highlighting the strategic value of digital investments for long-term resilience.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用2012年至2021年间187家中国商业银行的面板数据集，研究了数字化转型如何调节气候风险对商业银行绩效的不利影响。结果表明，气候风险的加剧显著降低了银行的盈利能力和运营稳定性。然而，数字化转型通过降低成本收入比和提高运营效率来抵消这些不利影响。多种稳健性检验证实了研究结果的有效性。进一步的异质性分析表明，在发达地区和小型银行中，数字化转型的缓解作用更为显著。通过明确联系气候风险与数字战略，本研究为可持续金融和风险管理领域的日益增长的文献做出了贡献。研究结果为政策制定者和银行高管提供了及时的见解，以加强金融机构抵御气候干扰的能力，同时强调了数字投资对长期韧性的战略价值。

records.title_en: Measuring energy and CO2 efficiency of global airlines using dynamic network DEA under natural and managerial disposability framework
records.title_cn: 基于自然可处置性与管理可处置性框架下动态网络DEA的全球航空公司能源与CO2效率测度
records.abstract_en: Despite strong demand for air transportation, airlines are experiencing profitability and environmental sustainability challenges. This study uses a dynamic network DEA model to evaluate the operational and environmental efficiency of 24 airlines from 2017 to 2019, considering natural disposability, managerial disposability, and unified efficiency. The results show efficiency level based on managerial disposability concept is higher than natural disposability, indicating proactive environmental regulation responses. In addition, high energy and CO2 efficiencies were observed, especially under managerial disposability. However, balancing operational and environmental performance remains challenging, with many airlines struggling to achieve simultaneous improvements. This study offers new perspectives for sustainable development in the industry by assessing airline performance under a unified framework.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管航空运输需求强劲，航空公司仍面临盈利能力和环境可持续性的挑战。本研究采用动态网络DEA模型，评估了2017年至2019年间24家航空公司的运营效率和环境效率，考虑了自然可处置性、管理可处置性和统一效率。结果表明，基于管理可处置性概念的效率水平高于自然可处置性，表明对主动环境法规的响应。此外，观察到高能源效率和CO2效率，尤其是在管理可处置性下。然而，平衡运营和环境绩效仍然具有挑战性，许多航空公司难以实现同步改进。本研究通过在统一框架下评估航空公司绩效，为该行业的可持续发展提供了新视角。

records.title_en: Sailing the stormy seas: Energy hedge funds strategy innovation, and market uncertainties
records.title_cn: 在风浪中航行：能源对冲基金策略创新与市场不确定性
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the relationship between idiosyncratic volatility of energy hedge funds and a range of uncertainty measures relevant to the global energy markets. Using GARCH-family models, we find a consistent negative relationship between idiosyncratic volatility and economic, climate, and energy market uncertainties. This evidence points to specialist hedge funds developing innovative hedging capabilities during energy markets transformation toward the net zero and idiosyncratic volatility associated with it, with commodity strategies demonstrating a stronger effect. Our analysis reveals non-linear interactions: increased climate policy uncertainty during high economic policy uncertainty periods is associated with larger decreases in idiosyncratic volatility. Additionally, simultaneous success of bond and commodity trend-following strategies corresponds with substantial reductions in idiosyncratic volatility, suggesting synergistic risk-management benefits.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了能源对冲基金的特质波动性与全球能源市场相关的一系列不确定性度量之间的关系。使用GARCH族模型，我们发现特质波动性与经济、气候和能源市场不确定性之间存在一致的负相关关系。这一证据表明，在能源市场向净零排放转型期间，专业对冲基金发展了创新的对冲能力，且与之相关的特质波动性下降，其中商品策略表现出更强的效应。我们的分析揭示了非线性交互作用：在高经济政策不确定性时期，气候政策不确定性的增加与特质波动性的更大下降相关。此外，债券和商品趋势跟踪策略的同时成功与特质波动性的显著减少相对应，这表明存在协同风险管理效益。

records.title_en: Renewable energy support: Pre-announced policies and efficiency
records.title_cn: 可再生能源支持：预先宣布的政策与效率
records.abstract_en: This paper is essentially based on the assumption that policies supporting investment in intermittent renewable technologies cannot be contingent on meteorological events causing this intermittence. This decision was taken by most policymakers to avoid overly complex policy prescriptions. But in doing so, the first-best energy mix may be out of reach. We compare, in a unified second-best setting, the feed-in tariff, renewable premiums and tradable green certificates policy. We consider a “two-period, S-state” model. The S states reflect intermittency. Production decisions for renewable electricity are taken prior to the resolution of the uncertainty while the fossil-fuel sector adjusts its decision in each state. Retailers buy electricity on a state-dependent wholesale market which they deliver to consumers according to a fixed-tariff or a real-time-pricing contract. All these elements matter in the efficiency assessment of these policies.
records.abstract_cn: 本文基本上基于这样一个假设：支持间歇性可再生技术投资的政策不能依赖于导致这种间歇性的气象事件。大多数政策制定者为了避免过于复杂的政策规定而做出了这一决定。但这样做，最优能源组合可能无法实现。我们在统一的次优环境中比较了上网电价补贴、可再生能源溢价和可交易绿色证书政策。我们考虑了一个“两期、S状态”模型。S状态反映了间歇性。可再生电力的生产决策在不确定性解决之前做出，而化石燃料部门则在每种状态下调整其决策。零售商在依赖于状态的批发市场上购买电力，并根据固定电价或实时定价合同将其提供给消费者。所有这些因素在评估这些政策的效率时都很重要。

records.title_en: Mutually beneficial pricing strategies for corporate power purchase agreements
records.title_cn: 企业购电协议的互利定价策略
records.abstract_en: Renewable power plant owners require new business models as governments phase out subsidy schemes. Meanwhile, the interest of corporations in renewable power procurement to reduce their carbon footprint and hedge against electricity price volatility increases. Corporate power purchase agreements (CPPAs), as direct agreements between producers and consumers, can conciliate both interests and are thus growing in number. This paper provides a formal framework to analyze the price and volumetric conditions under which a CPPA is mutually beneficial for a wind power plant (WPP) owner and a large electricity consumer considering the uncertainty of the spot market electricity prices and the wind generation. We show that although the players’ cash flows in a CPPA constitute a zero-sum game, the cash flows’ variances can be reduced mutually. This variance reduction is valuable as it can be translated into bonuses for each contracting party. To quantify these bonuses we consider either a reduced capital costs for the upfront investment on the WPP side or a reduced liquid capital need for covering the market risk on the consumer side. We use historic electricity market and wind availability data to evaluate different price-volume configurations of an exemplary CPPA with the proposed framework. We conclude that the mutually beneficial pricing strategies for CPPAs are enabled and determined by the risk aversion behavior of third parties such as shareholders and lenders.
records.abstract_cn: 随着政府逐步取消补贴计划，可再生能源发电厂所有者需要新的商业模式。与此同时，企业为减少碳足迹和对冲电价波动风险而对可再生能源采购的兴趣日益增加。企业购电协议（CPPAs）作为生产者与消费者之间的直接协议，能够调和双方利益，因此数量正在增长。本文提供了一个正式框架，分析在考虑现货市场电价和风力发电不确定性的情况下，风电发电厂（WPP）所有者与大型电力消费者之间CPPA互利的价格和容量条件。我们表明，尽管CPPA中双方的现金流构成零和博弈，但现金流的方差可以相互减少。这种方差减少是有价值的，因为它可以转化为每个签约方的奖金。为了量化这些奖金，我们考虑要么降低WPP侧前期投资的资本成本，要么减少消费者侧覆盖市场风险所需的流动资本。我们使用历史电力市场和风力可用性数据，用所提出的框架评估一个示例性CPPA的不同价格-容量配置。我们得出结论，CPPA的互利定价策略是由第三方（如股东和贷款人）的风险规避行为所促成和决定的。

records.title_en: Commodity price risk, supply chain, and lending
records.title_cn: 商品价格风险、供应链与贷款
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the effects of recurring commodity price shocks on supply chains, focusing on oil price fluctuations. We find that affected firms receive less liquidity from suppliers while extending more liquidity to customers to retain them, which further aggravates their financial conditions. We also find that firms extend more trade credit to customers when the lock-in effect is stronger that is when relationships with suppliers are more stable and long-term, and when they are more innovative. Finally, our results indicate that banks impose higher spreads on firms with greater exposure to oil price shocks. Overall, our findings suggest that firms exposed to oil price shocks face greater trade credit liquidity issues and more expensive access to the debt market.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了反复出现的商品价格冲击对供应链的影响，重点关注油价波动。我们发现，受影响的 firms 从供应商处获得的流动性减少，同时向客户提供更多流动性以留住他们，这进一步加剧了其财务状况。我们还发现，当锁定效应更强时，即与供应商的关系更稳定且长期，以及当企业更具创新性时，企业向客户提供更多的贸易信贷。最后，我们的结果表明，银行对油价冲击敞口较大的企业收取更高的利差。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，受油价冲击影响的企业面临更大的贸易信贷流动性问题和更昂贵的债务市场准入。

records.title_en: Can big data development drive green technology innovation? The spillover role of supply chain partners
records.title_cn: 大数据发展能否驱动绿色技术创新？供应链伙伴的溢出作用
records.abstract_en: The development of corporate big data has been widely recognized as a significant driver of internal green technology innovation. Moreover, supply chain networks, serving as essential channels for innovation resources, have substantial potential to facilitate green technology innovation. However, the potential spillover effects through supply chain networks remain underexplored. This study analyzes how supply chain partners' big data development affects enterprise green technology innovation. Using the data of Chinese A-share listed companies from 2012 to 2022, we employ the Word2vec model to measure supply chain partners' big data development. Our results reveal that supply chain partners' big data development significantly enhances focal firms' green technology innovation. Heterogeneity analysis demonstrates that the effect is particularly pronounced for large companies and those in low-marketization regions, with suppliers' big data development exhibiting a stronger impact than that of customers. Notably, technology integration capability weakens this relationship, whereas market competition strengthens it. These findings provide novel insights and valuable guidance for policymakers seeking to promote strategic green transformation, thereby supplementing existing literature.
records.abstract_cn: 企业大数据的发展已被广泛认为是内部绿色技术创新的重要驱动力。此外，供应链网络作为创新资源的重要渠道，具有促进绿色技术创新的巨大潜力。然而，通过供应链网络可能产生的溢出效应仍未得到充分探讨。本研究分析了供应链伙伴的大数据发展如何影响企业绿色技术创新。利用2012年至2022年中国A股上市公司的数据，我们采用Word2vec模型来衡量供应链伙伴的大数据发展。我们的结果表明，供应链伙伴的大数据发展显著增强了焦点企业的绿色技术创新。异质性分析显示，这种效应在大企业和处于低市场化地区的企业中尤为显著，且供应商的大数据发展比客户的影响更强。值得注意的是，技术整合能力削弱了这一关系，而市场竞争则加强了它。这些发现为政策制定者促进战略性绿色转型提供了新颖的见解和宝贵的指导，从而补充了现有文献。

records.title_en: The impact of reliable electricity access on agricultural income and land utilization in China
records.title_cn: 可靠电力接入对中国农业收入与土地利用的影响
records.abstract_en: Reliable electricity access is crucial for agricultural production, as it ensures a constant supply of electricity for power and automation. This study investigates the impact of reliable electricity access on agricultural income and land utilization in China. By combining household panel data from the 2012–2018 China Labor-Force Dynamics Survey with wind power data from the National Energy Administration and local geographic information, we measure the reliability of electricity supply through power outages. These outages are instrumented using feed-in tariff rates, curtailment rates of wind power, and interactions between curtailment rates and both the mean and standard deviation of a city's elevation. Our findings reveal that reliable electricity access significantly boosts grain income. Specifically, it increases estimated grain income by 5303 yuan, equivalent to approximately 13.8 % of total household income. The key mechanism driving this increase is the expansion of irrigated farmland by 4.57 mu. This study provides important insights for policymakers aiming to improve rural electrification.
records.abstract_cn: 可靠的电力接入对农业生产至关重要，因为它确保了电力和自动化的持续供电。本研究探讨了可靠电力接入对中国农业收入和土地利用的影响。通过将2012-2018年中国劳动力动态调查的家庭面板数据与国家能源管理局的风力发电数据及当地地理信息相结合，我们通过停电来衡量电力供应的可靠性。这些停电使用上网电价费率、风电弃风率以及弃风率与城市海拔均值和标准差的交互项作为工具变量。我们的研究结果显示，可靠的电力接入显著提高了粮食收入。具体而言，它使估计的粮食收入增加了5303元，相当于家庭总收入的约13.8%。推动这一增长的关键机制是灌溉农田面积扩大了4.57亩。这项研究为旨在改善农村电气化的政策制定者提供了重要见解。

records.title_en: Geopolitical risks and energy market dynamics
records.title_cn: 地缘政治风险和能源市场动态
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we examine the relationship between geopolitical risks and energy markets, focusing on how these risks impact energy consumption, trade, and the transition to renewable energy. Using the System Generalized Methods of Moments (SYS-GMM) on energy market-related data from the World Bank, we find that geopolitical risks do not have statistically significant impacts on overall energy consumption in our full sample. However, further analyses suggest that geopolitical risks have heterogeneous impacts on overall energy consumption based on the status of development and whether countries are net energy exporters or importers. Specifically, we find that geopolitical risks are associated with increased energy consumption in both developed and developing countries. However, developing countries increase not only the level but also the intensity of consumption, highlighting the need to increase energy stockpiles. This finding remains robust to alternative measurements of geopolitical risks and estimation approaches, such as the Instrumental Variable (IV) method. In addition to energy consumption, we also find that geopolitical risks positively affect renewable energy growth in developed countries while increasing reliance on fossil fuels at the same time. This finding suggests a delicate balance developing countries need to strike while maintaining current energy demands and promoting energy sovereignty by promoting renewable energy at the same time. Lastly, we find that geopolitical risks decrease both energy exports and imports. However, such a shrinkage in energy trade is followed by strong exports and imports signifying a profit seeking behavior of exporter countries and a need to rely on imported fuels to maintain domestic energy security of importers. These findings underscore the importance of geopolitical risks in understanding energy market dynamics.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究了地缘政治风险与能源市场之间的关系，重点关注这些风险如何影响能源消费、贸易和向可再生能源的过渡。使用系统广义矩量法（SYS-GMM）对世界银行能源市场相关数据进行分析，我们发现地缘政治风险对整个样本中的总体能源消耗没有统计上的显着影响。然而，进一步分析表明，根据发展状况以及各国是能源净出口国还是进口国，地缘政治风险对整体能源消费的影响存在差异。具体来说，我们发现发达国家和发展中国家的地缘政治风险都与能源消耗的增加有关。然而，发展中国家不仅提高了消费水平，而且提高了消费强度，凸显了增加能源库存的必要性。这一发现对于地缘政治风险的替代测量和估计方法（例如工具变量（IV）方法）仍然有效。除了能源消耗之外，我们还发现地缘政治风险对发达国家可再生能源的增长产生积极影响，同时增加了对化石燃料的依赖。这一发现表明，发展中国家需要在维持当前能源需求和通过推广可再生能源来促进能源主权的同时实现微妙的平衡。最后，我们发现地缘政治风险会减少能源出口和进口。然而，能源贸易萎缩之后，进出口却强劲，这表明出口国的逐利行为以及进口国需要依靠进口燃料来维持国内能源安全。这些发现强调了地缘政治风险对于理解能源市场动态的重要性。

records.title_en: Regional S&T planning and green generic technologies: A spatial differences-in-difference analysis
records.title_cn: 区域科技规划与绿色通用技术：一项空间双重差分分析
records.abstract_en: Green Generic Technologies (GGTs) are pivotal for large-scale and sustainable green transitions. Existing literature mainly focuses on policies that induce ordinary green technologies, with little attention given to GGTs, which face unique challenges like technological lock-in and pervasive spillover dilemmas. Therefore, this paper aims to explore whether regional S&T planning (RSTP), as a strategic policy framework, can promote GGTs, examining both direct and spillover effects across geographical and innovation networks. This study constructs a panel dataset of 284 cities in China from 2008 to 2020 and applies a spatial differences-in-difference (SDID) model to estimate the impacts of RSTP on GGTs. This paper uses the generalizability index of patent citations to measure GGTs, exploring the spillover effects across spatial neighbors and innovation-network collaborators. Specifically, this study adopts natural language processing (NLP) methods to extract two distinct RSTP policy goals—anticipatory and obligatory—and investigates the heterogeneous effects resulting from these goals. The results show that RSTP positively impacts local GGTs' development but has negative geographical spillovers on neighboring cities. Additionally, RSTP's anticipatory goals positively influence both GGTs and innovation-network spillovers. In contrast, its obligatory goals yield adverse effects, likely due to policy myopia, their coercive nature, and limited flexibility in fostering dynamic interactions and coordination. This study contributes to the literature on green and generic technologies, particularly regarding the policy mechanisms that drive regional green transitions. It also provides important implications for emerging economies seeking large-scale green transformation and industrial upgrading through strategic innovation governance.
records.abstract_cn: 绿色通用技术（GGTs）对于大规模和可持续的绿色转型至关重要。现有文献主要关注诱导普通绿色技术的政策，而对绿色通用技术的关注较少，后者面临技术锁定和普遍溢出困境等独特挑战。因此，本文旨在探讨区域科技规划（RSTP）作为一种战略政策框架，是否能够促进绿色通用技术的发展，并考察其在地理和创新网络中的直接效应与溢出效应。本研究构建了2008年至2020年中国284个城市的面板数据集，并应用空间双重差分（SDID）模型来估计区域科技规划对绿色通用技术的影响。本文使用专利引用的通用性指数来衡量绿色通用技术，探讨其在空间邻近城市和创新网络合作者之间的溢出效应。具体而言，本研究采用自然语言处理（NLP）方法提取区域科技规划中两种不同的政策目标——预期性和强制性——并考察这些目标所产生的异质性效应。结果表明，区域科技规划对本地绿色通用技术的发展有积极影响，但对邻近城市产生负向地理溢出效应。此外，区域科技规划的预期性目标对绿色通用技术和创新网络溢出均产生积极影响。相比之下，其强制性目标产生不利影响，这可能是由于政策短视、其强制性特征以及在促进动态互动和协调方面灵活性有限所致。本研究为绿色和通用技术的文献做出了贡献，特别是在驱动区域绿色转型的政策机制方面。同时，它为寻求通过战略创新治理实现大规模绿色转型和产业升级的新兴经济体提供了重要启示。

records.title_en: From cooperative play to multi-critical decision: The Shapley Index and the Choquet Integral in comparison
records.title_cn: 从合作博弈到多标准决策：Shapley指数与Choquet积分的比较研究
records.abstract_en: This study explores the integration of Shapley’s Index and Choquet’s Integral as a hybrid approach to improve the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP). While AHP provides a structured methodology for multi-criteria decision-making, it suffers from limitations related to subjectivity in the determination of weights. The Shapley Index, derived from game theory, introduces a rigorous analysis of the marginal contributions of criteria, while the Choquet Integral considers non-additive interactions between criteria. By combining these methodologies, the proposed model allows for the representation of synergies and trade-offs between criteria, improving the reliability and accuracy of decision-making. Applying the model to a case study, the article compares the results obtained with the two approaches, highlighting the contexts in which each method excels. This analysis provides a basis for future applications in critical areas such as strategic planning, risk management and energy sustainability.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了将Shapley指数与Choquet积分作为混合方法整合，以改进层次分析法（AHP）。尽管AHP为多标准决策提供了结构化的方法论，但在权重确定方面存在主观性相关的局限性。源自博弈论的Shapley指数引入了对标准边际贡献的严格分析，而Choquet积分则考虑了标准之间的非加性交互作用。通过结合这些方法，所提出的模型能够表示标准之间的协同效应与权衡，提高决策的可靠性和准确性。将该模型应用于案例研究，文章比较了两种方法所得结果，突出了每种方法各自擅长的情境。这一分析为未来在战略规划、风险管理和能源可持续性等关键领域的应用提供了基础。

records.title_en: An analysis of mergers in the presence of uncertainty in renewable energy integration costs
records.title_cn: 可再生能源并网成本不确定条件下的并购分析
records.abstract_en: This study examines how uncertainty in renewable integration costs affects the profitability of mergers among energy producers. As the energy sector shifts toward decentralized renewables, centralized producers face industry-wide and firm-specific cost uncertainties due to the variable and intermittent nature of distributed generation. Although previous models have examined mergers in the presence of greener energy, they have largely assumed deterministic costs and ignored the impact of the dual sources of uncertainty on merger profitability. This study incorporates both industry-wide and private shocks into renewable integration costs, using two theoretical models – without and with uncertainty – to identify how these shocks affect merger profitability. With full information, we show that mergers are unprofitable unless they consolidate a majority of firms (e.g., 90% consolidation), where a higher renewable integration cost reduces losses from mergers. This is because joint profit maximization allows merger participants to better absorb (higher) costs while non-merging firms cut production more sharply. With uncertainty, we find that the effect of the two sources of uncertainties on merger profitability depends on the average grid integration cost, merger size, and quality of private information. In particular, results suggest that mergers are more likely to be profitable when firms can effectively absorb private shocks due to the merger size, unless average grid integration costs become too high. The incentives to merge are less clear-cut in the presence of an industry-wide shock, unless the quality of private information is high enough.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了可再生能源并网成本的不确定性如何影响能源生产商之间的并购盈利能力。随着能源行业向分散式可再生能源转变，集中式生产商面临行业范围和公司特定的成本不确定性，这是由于分布式发电的可变性和间歇性所致。尽管先前的模型已经考察了在更绿色能源存在下的并购，但它们大多假设成本是确定性的，并忽略了双重不确定性来源对并购盈利能力的影响。本研究将行业范围和私人冲击纳入可再生能源并网成本中，使用两个理论模型——无不确定性和有不确定性——来识别这些冲击如何影响并购盈利能力。在完全信息下，我们表明，除非合并了大多数公司（例如，90%的整合），否则并购是无利可图的，其中更高的可再生能源并网成本减少了并购损失。这是因为联合利润最大化允许并购参与者更好地吸收（更高的）成本，而非并购公司则更大幅度地削减生产。在不确定性下，我们发现两种不确定性来源对并购盈利能力的影响取决于平均电网并网成本、并购规模和私人信息的质量。特别是，结果表明，当公司能够因并购规模而有效吸收私人冲击时，并购更有可能盈利，除非平均电网并网成本变得过高。在存在行业范围冲击的情况下，并购动机不太明确，除非私人信息的质量足够高。

records.title_en: Power Trading within an Energy Community: Applying a fair unequal sharing rule of photovoltaic energy
records.title_cn: 能源社区内的电力交易：应用光伏能源的公平不平等共享规则
records.abstract_en: Energy communities (ECs) with photovoltaic (PV) installations can reduce their collective electricity costs by sharing self-generated power among members. This paper presents a comprehensive framework to address key challenges such as rooftop sharing, heterogeneous ownership structures, and electricity trading protocols. We propose the Weighted Constrained Equal Awards (WCEA) mechanism’s proportional and fair allocation rule that distributes the benefits of internal energy trade. Unlike existing approaches, the WCEA accommodates diverse ownership arrangements and varying consumption patterns. This “fair-unequal” protocol promotes both the formation and long-term stability of ECs and is robust to strategic manipulation. We evaluate the WCEA using high-frequency metering data in a Monte Carlo simulation. Results indicate that a sufficiently large PV system can reduce median energy costs by up to 65%. Enabling peer-to-peer energy trading yields additional savings: approximately 2.5% when consumption patterns are similar, and up to 11% when they are highly heterogeneous. Moreover, shared PV generation reduces reliance on grid electricity, offering ancillary benefits to the distribution network. However, large-scale PV installations may also stress the grid due to temporal mismatches between generation and consumption. These findings suggest that policy incentives should prioritize installations that currently satisfy less than half of the prosumers’ energy demand.
records.abstract_cn: 拥有光伏（PV）装置的能源社区（ECs）可以通过成员间共享自发电来降低集体电费。本文提出了一个综合框架，以应对屋顶共享、异构所有权结构和电力交易协议等关键挑战。我们提出了加权约束等额奖励（WCEA）机制的比例和公平分配规则，以分配内部能源交易的收益。与现有方法不同，WCEA适应多样化的所有权安排和不同的消费模式。这种“公平-不平等”协议促进了ECs的形成和长期稳定性，并且对策略性操纵具有鲁棒性。我们使用高频计量数据在蒙特卡洛模拟中评估WCEA。结果表明，足够大的光伏系统可以将中位能源成本降低高达65%。启用点对点能源交易可带来额外节省：当消费模式相似时约为2.5%，当高度异质时高达11%。此外，共享光伏发电减少了对电网电力的依赖，为配电网提供了附加效益。然而，大规模光伏装置也可能因发电与消费之间的时间错配而对电网造成压力。这些发现表明，政策激励应优先考虑目前满足产消者能源需求不足一半的装置。

records.title_en: Mapping the AI landscape in buildings energy research: Temporal dynamics and global disparities using topic modeling
records.title_cn: 绘制建筑能源研究中的人工智能景观：基于主题建模的时间动态与全球差异
records.abstract_en: In increasing global efforts to enhance energy efficiency in buildings, this study employs an innovative topic modeling approach to explore the landscape of artificial intelligence and machine learning applications in building energy use. The study addresses three primary research questions: (1) What are the salient topics in AI applications for building energy use? (2) How have these topics evolved? (3) What are the differences in topics between OECD and non-OECD countries in the application of AI to building energy use? By analyzing a comprehensive dataset of scholarly articles, our findings identify key themes and trends within the field, tracking their progression and transformation over time. The findings reveal a 29 % annual growth in research, with predictive modeling, building optimization, and smart energy management emerging as the most prevalent AI-driven applications. While OECD countries focus on automation and sensor-based energy management, non-OECD nations emphasize retrofitting and urban sustainability as primary strategies for efficiency gains. These differences reflect global disparities in technological adoption and policy priorities. This study advances the understanding of the dynamic landscape of AI applications in building energy management and rationalization, identifying gaps and opportunities for future research and policy development to bridge regional divides and enhance global energy efficiency strategies.
records.abstract_cn: 在全球日益增强建筑能效的努力背景下，本研究采用创新的主题建模方法，探索人工智能和机器学习在建筑能源使用中的应用景观。研究解决了三个主要研究问题：（1）建筑能源使用中人工智能应用的显著主题是什么？（2）这些主题如何演变？（3）在将人工智能应用于建筑能源使用方面，OECD与非OECD国家之间的主题差异是什么？通过分析一个全面的学术文章数据集，我们的发现识别了该领域内的关键主题和趋势，追踪其随时间的进展和转变。研究结果显示，研究年增长率为29%，预测建模、建筑优化和智能能源管理成为最普遍的人工智能驱动应用。OECD国家侧重于自动化和基于传感器的能源管理，而非OECD国家则强调改造和城市可持续性作为提高效率的主要策略。这些差异反映了技术采用和政策优先事项上的全球差异。本研究增进了对建筑能源管理和合理化中人工智能应用动态景观的理解，识别了未来研究和政策制定中的空白与机遇，以弥合区域差距并增强全球能源效率策略。

records.title_en: Sequential game of an emissions trading scheme
records.title_cn: 排放交易计划的序贯博弈
records.abstract_en: We examine how the strategic behavior of electric utilities influences a multistage carbon emissions trading market without allowance banking. Using a sequential two-stage game model, we identify key factors that shape trading outcomes over time. In competitive carbon markets with non-excessive allowance allocation, the second-stage price is higher than the first-stage price. Heightened competition induces sales of allowances in the first stage and amplifies their prices in the second stage. Utilities' roles as buyers or sellers depend on the relative scales of the electricity and carbon markets, which mediate the broader effects of competition and technological advancement on strategic trading behavior across stages.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了电力企业的战略行为如何影响一个不允许配额银行存储的多阶段碳排放交易市场。通过使用一个序贯两阶段博弈模型，我们识别了随时间推移塑造交易结果的关键因素。在竞争性碳市场中，若配额分配不过量，第二阶段的价格高于第一阶段的价格。加剧的竞争促使第一阶段出售配额，并放大第二阶段的价格。电力企业作为买方或卖方的角色取决于电力市场和碳市场的相对规模，这调节了竞争和技术进步对跨阶段战略交易行为的更广泛影响。

records.title_en: Measuring artificial intelligence's impact on sustainable energy transition: Empirical insights and policy implications
records.title_cn: 衡量人工智能对可持续能源转型的影响：实证洞察与政策启示
records.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a transformative technology with significant potential for accelerating the transition to sustainable energy systems. This study provides novel empirical insights into the effect of AI on energy efficiency and renewable energy integration. Using econometric techniques, such as cross-sectionally augmented error correction models (CS-ECMs) and pooled mean group (PMG) models, we analyzed data from 30 countries (1995–2020). The results indicate that AI patents reduce energy intensity by 0.84 tons of oil equivalent (toe) per 1000 USD and that AI-related research increases the sustainable energy transition index by 10 points in the long term. AI-driven optimization techniques and predictive maintenance have substantial long-term effects on energy sustainability. This study also discusses the implications of AI-driven innovation on energy policies and sustainable economic growth. These findings fill a critical gap in the literature by providing robust empirical evidence of the long-term impact of AI on sustainable energy transitions and offers valuable insight for policymakers and stakeholders aiming to achieve a future with sustainable energy. These findings underscore the importance of sustained investment in AI technologies and interdisciplinary collaboration in achieving global energy sustainability goals. For now, AI's impact on the scale's energy transition is similar to the total factor productivity (TFP) effect, driving long-term sustainable energy transformation.
records.abstract_cn: 人工智能（AI）已成为一种变革性技术，在加速向可持续能源系统转型方面具有巨大潜力。本研究为人工智能对能源效率和可再生能源整合的影响提供了新颖的实证洞察。使用计量经济技术，如横截面增强误差修正模型（CS-ECMs）和混合均值组（PMG）模型，我们分析了来自30个国家（1995-2020）的数据。结果表明，人工智能专利将能源强度降低了0.84吨油当量（toe）每1000美元，且人工智能相关研究在长期内将可持续能源转型指数提高了10点。人工智能驱动的优化技术和预测性维护对能源可持续性具有显著的长期影响。本研究还讨论了人工智能驱动的创新对能源政策和可持续经济增长的影响。这些发现通过提供人工智能对可持续能源转型长期影响的稳健实证证据，填补了文献中的关键空白，并为旨在实现可持续能源未来的政策制定者和利益相关者提供了宝贵的见解。这些发现强调了持续投资人工智能技术和跨学科合作在实现全球能源可持续性目标中的重要性。目前，人工智能对规模能源转型的影响类似于全要素生产率（TFP）效应，推动长期可持续能源转型。

records.title_en: Agriculture, electrification and gendered time use in rural Bangladesh
records.title_cn: 孟加拉国农村的农业、电气化与性别时间使用
records.abstract_en: We study the linkages between local rural electrification, activity participation and time use of individuals in rural Bangladesh. We find that households’ access to grid electricity positively correlates with the likelihood of males participating in non-farm work and females participating in agriculture. In electrified households, females reallocate time from domestic work and caregiving to more leisure and farming. Household access to electricity is positively associated with increased ownership of appliances such as fans, refrigerators, televisions, and mobile phones, as well as greater use of electric pumps for irrigation. Electrification is also linked to higher employment of female household members in farm operations and greater involvement in decision-making related to agricultural activities and household expenditures. These findings suggest that in farming communities, agriculture may play a critical role in the linkages between rural household electrification, women’s workforce participation, and household bargaining power.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了孟加拉国农村地区地方性农村电气化、活动参与和个人时间使用之间的联系。我们发现，家庭接入电网电力与男性参与非农工作和女性参与农业的可能性正相关。在电气化家庭中，女性将时间从家务劳动和照护工作重新分配至更多的休闲和农业活动。家庭电力接入与风扇、冰箱、电视和手机等家电拥有量的增加以及电动灌溉泵使用的增加正相关。电气化还与女性家庭成员在农场经营中的更高就业率以及更多参与与农业活动和家庭支出相关的决策有关。这些发现表明，在农业社区中，农业可能在农村家庭电气化、女性劳动力参与和家庭议价能力之间的联系中发挥关键作用。

records.title_en: The effectiveness of China's national emissions trading scheme in mitigating firm emissions
records.title_cn: 中国国家碳排放交易体系在减少企业排放方面的有效性
records.abstract_en: China's national emissions trading scheme (ETS), announced in 2017, has become the largest carbon market worldwide, operating alongside pre-existing regional pilots. However, detailed assessments regarding the newly constructed national ETS, particularly in comparison with the regional pilots, remain limited. Using unit-level monitoring data from China's power sector and combining intermediary and moderate models, this study investigates the carbon mitigation impact of China's national ETS relative to pilot ETSs. We find that while both the national and pilot ETSs significantly reduce carbon intensities, the effect was more pronounced in pilots. A mechanism behind this reduction is the improvement in fuel quality, as evidenced by a decrease in carbon content. Regional economic growth and a higher share of industrial activity appear to offset the policy's overall effectiveness. Heterogeneity analysis shows that the mitigation effects were greater in smaller and older units compared to their larger or newer counterparts. Our unit-level empirical evaluation of China's national ETS not only advances theoretical understanding of emissions trading mechanisms but also provides actionable insights for refining or establishing carbon market policies in emerging economies.
records.abstract_cn: 中国于2017年宣布的国家碳排放交易体系（ETS）已成为全球最大的碳市场，与先前存在的区域试点并行运作。然而，针对新建国家ETS的详细评估，特别是与区域试点的比较，仍然有限。利用中国电力部门的单位级监测数据，并结合中介和调节模型，本研究探讨了相对于试点ETS，中国国家ETS的碳减排影响。我们发现，尽管国家和试点ETS均显著降低了碳强度，但试点中的效果更为明显。这一减排背后的机制是燃料质量的改善，表现为碳含量的下降。区域经济增长和较高的工业活动份额似乎抵消了政策的整体有效性。异质性分析显示，与较大或较新的机组相比，较小和较老的机组的减排效果更大。我们对中国国家ETS的单位级实证评估不仅推进了对排放交易机制的理论理解，也为新兴经济体完善或建立碳市场政策提供了可行的见解。

records.title_en: Does place-based policy encourage energy efficiency? Evidence from development zones in China
records.title_cn: 基于地方的政策是否促进能源效率？来自中国开发区的证据
records.abstract_en: Determining whether the place-based policy can spur the economy on its own to accomplish production growth and energy conservation at the same time is crucial to ensuring China meets its “dual carbon” targets in the post-epidemic era. This study investigates how China's establishment of national development zones (DZs)—a model place-based policy—affects energy efficiency at the macro-city and micro-enterprise levels using the difference-in-differences approach. Baseline studies show that DZs significantly improve both China's urban energy efficiency and the energy efficiency of the firms that operate there. Mechanism tests demonstrate that DZs increase energy efficiency through the effects of environmental regulation, technical innovation, and policy tilt. Further research indicates that the efficiency-enhancing benefits of DZs may also be enjoyed by non-DZ enterprises operating in DZ cities as well as those engaged in the direct upstream and downstream sectors of DZ enterprises. Our study has significant policy implications, allowing China to rationally and scientifically support the establishment of DZs in pursuit of the country's transition to a low-carbon economy.
records.abstract_cn: 确定基于地方的政策能否自行刺激经济，同时实现生产增长和节能，对于确保中国在后疫情时代实现“双碳”目标至关重要。本研究利用双重差分方法，考察了中国设立国家级开发区（DZs）——一种典型的基于地方的政策——如何在宏观城市和微观企业层面影响能源效率。基线研究表明，开发区显著提高了中国城市能源效率以及在其内运营企业的能源效率。机制测试表明，开发区通过环境规制、技术创新和政策倾斜的效应提高了能源效率。进一步研究表明，开发区的效率提升效益也可能惠及位于开发区城市但非开发区内的企业，以及从事开发区企业直接上下游产业的企业。我们的研究具有重要的政策含义，使中国能够合理科学地支持开发区的设立，以追求国家向低碳经济的转型。

records.title_en: Comparing designs for resource adequacy in laboratory electricity markets
records.title_cn: 实验室电力市场资源充足性设计比较
records.abstract_en: We compare generation capacity investment and unserved energy in experimental electricity markets under three designs: (1) an energy-only market serving as baseline, (2) an energy-only market with scarcity pricing where firms earn revenues from the provision of an additional product, reserves, and (3) a capacity market that rewards capacity investment and is followed by an energy-only market. Subjects in the experiments act as firms, choosing generation capacity and competing to meet electricity demand in the market. Based on simulation results from complementarity-based equilibrium models, our predictions suggest that an energy-only market incentivizes the lowest capacity investment, which is insufficient to satisfy peak electricity demand. Further, we expect the capacity market to promote more investment than the energy-only market with scarcity pricing, avoiding unserved energy across all demand scenarios. In contrast, the energy-only market with scarcity pricing experiences unserved energy during peak demand periods. In line with the predictions, we find that the experimental baseline leads to insufficient capacity investment to meet peak demand. The alternative designs encourage additional capacity investment, with firms in the capacity market generally investing in more generation capacity. Yet, both alternative designs are unable to satisfy peak electricity demand because their additional capacity falls short of expected levels. Further, unserved energy is reduced, but results are not statistically different under the alternative designs.
records.abstract_cn: 我们比较了三种设计下实验性电力市场中的发电容量投资和无服务能源：（1）作为基准的纯能源市场，（2）具有稀缺定价的纯能源市场，企业通过提供额外产品、储备来赚取收入，以及（3）奖励容量投资的容量市场，然后是纯能源市场。实验中的主体扮演企业的角色，选择发电能力并竞争以满足市场的电力需求。根据基于互补的均衡模型的模拟结果，我们的预测表明，纯能源市场会激励最低的容量投资，而这不足以满足峰值电力需求。此外，我们预计容量市场将比定价稀缺的纯能源市场促进更多投资，从而避免在所有需求场景中出现能源供应不足的情况。相比之下，定价稀缺的纯能源市场在需求高峰期会遇到得不到供应的能源。与预测一致，我们发现实验基线导致容量投资不足以满足峰值需求。替代设计鼓励额外的容量投资，容量市场上的公司通常投资更多的发电容量。然而，这两种替代设计都无法满足峰值电力需求，因为它们的额外容量未达到预期水平。此外，未提供的能量减少了，但在替代设计下，结果在统计上没有差异。

records.title_en: The impact of informed trading on liquidity in Chinese crude oil futures
records.title_cn: 知情交易对中国原油期货流动性的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper uses 1-min transaction data of Chinses crude oil futures (SC) to measure the informed trading and empirically examine its impact on liquidity. The paper finds that informed trading significantly increases liquidity of SC, and market stress plays an intermediary role in the process of informed trading affecting liquidity. Informed trading further improves liquidity by reducing market stress. In addition, the effect is more pronounced during night trading session and the period of high climate policy uncertainty. Further study finds that price fluctuation of Brent and WTI crude oil serves as a moderator in this process. Specifically, the price fluctuation of Brent crude oil has a positive moderating effect on the relationship between informed trading and liquidity, while the price fluctuation of WTI crude oil has a negative moderating effect. Robustness tests, including replace the explained and explanatory variables, using current explanatory variables, and changing the rolling window, confirm the consistency of these findings. Insights gleaned from the findings are useful for regulation policy formulation and market investment decision-making.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用中国原油期货（SC）的1分钟交易数据来衡量知情交易，并实证检验其对流动性的影响。研究发现，知情交易显著提高了SC的流动性，且市场压力在知情交易影响流动性的过程中起到中介作用。知情交易通过降低市场压力进一步改善流动性。此外，这种效应在夜盘交易时段和气候政策不确定性较高的时期更为显著。进一步研究发现，布伦特原油和WTI原油的价格波动在这一过程中起到调节作用。具体而言，布伦特原油的价格波动对知情交易与流动性之间的关系具有正向调节效应，而WTI原油的价格波动则具有负向调节效应。稳健性检验，包括替换被解释变量和解释变量、使用当期解释变量以及改变滚动窗口，均证实了这些发现的一致性。研究结果对监管政策制定和市场投资决策具有参考价值。

records.title_en: How does environmental policy shape the impact of energy innovation funding on renewable energy generation? Evidence from econometric and machine learning approaches
records.title_cn: 环境政策如何塑造能源创新资金对可再生能源发电的影响？来自计量经济学和机器学习方法的证据
records.abstract_en: Achieving sustainable development in the energy sector, particularly in renewable energy, requires substantial innovation funding, as it is essential for reaching net-zero emissions by 2050. This study explores how environmental policy influences the effect of energy innovation funding on renewable energy generation, addressing a key research gap in understanding policy impacts on energy transitions. Using both econometric and machine learning methods, the study analyzed data from 27 countries in the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) between 2001 and 2020. The findings reveal that while energy innovation funding accelerated renewable energy generation, poor environmental policies weaken this relationship, suggesting that strong environmental policies are essential to complement energy innovation funding for promoting renewable energy generation. Additionally, the results indicate that market-based policies are more effective in enhancing the impact of energy funding on accelerating the renewable energy generation compared to non-market-based policies. These insights highlight the importance of aligning energy innovation funding with stringent market-oriented environmental policies to fully harness their potential and expedite the transition to renewable energy. Policymakers should prioritize the development of the strategies that integrate energy funding with effective policy frameworks, ensuring that the transition to renewable energy is not only swift but also sustainable.
records.abstract_cn: 实现能源部门，特别是可再生能源的可持续发展，需要大量的创新资金，这对于到2050年实现净零排放至关重要。本研究探讨了环境政策如何影响能源创新资金对可再生能源发电的作用，填补了理解政策对能源转型影响的关键研究空白。通过使用计量经济学和机器学习方法，本研究分析了经济合作与发展组织（OECD）27个国家在2001年至2020年间的数据。研究结果显示，虽然能源创新资金加速了可再生能源发电，但不良的环境政策削弱了这种关系，这表明强有力的环境政策对于补充能源创新资金以促进可再生能源发电至关重要。此外，结果表明，与非市场型政策相比，市场型政策在增强能源资金对加速可再生能源发电的影响方面更为有效。这些见解强调了将能源创新资金与严格的市场导向环境政策相结合的重要性，以充分发挥其潜力并加快向可再生能源的过渡。政策制定者应优先制定将能源资金与有效政策框架相结合的战略，确保向可再生能源的过渡不仅迅速，而且可持续。

records.title_en: Do climate policies affect green patenting patterns?
records.title_cn: 气候政策是否影响绿色专利模式？
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the effect of Climate Change Policies (CCPs) on green innovation, for a sample of 40 advanced and emerging market economies, and five economic sectors, during the period 2000–2021. Our results suggest that CCPs positively affect the production of green patents, with the effect intensifying gradually over time. The effect is larger for non-market-based and technology support policies—such as emission limits, feed-in tariffs and R&D subsidies—in countries with greater competitiveness and during periods of stronger economic activity—that is, higher GDP growth, lower uncertainty and financial stress. The results based on a difference-in-differences approach suggest that the positive effect of stricter CCPs on green innovation is stronger in sectors with limited financial constraints.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了气候变化政策（CCPs）对绿色创新的影响，样本涵盖40个发达和新兴市场经济体，以及五个经济部门，时间跨度为2000-2021年。我们的结果表明，CCPs对绿色专利的产出有积极影响，且这种影响随时间逐渐增强。在竞争力更强的国家以及经济活动更强劲的时期——即GDP增长更高、不确定性和金融压力更低时，非市场型和技术支持政策（如排放限制、上网电价补贴和研发补贴）的影响更大。基于双重差分法的结果表明，更严格的气候变化政策对绿色创新的积极影响在金融约束较小的部门中更为显著。

records.title_en: From awareness to action: The role of ESG committees in driving corporate ambidextrous green innovation
records.title_cn: 从意识到行动：ESG委员会在推动企业双元绿色创新中的作用
records.abstract_en: How to transform environmental awareness into concrete green innovation (GI) actions has increasingly become a critical issue in corporate governance. As a key institutional arrangement for promoting corporate sustainability strategies, the effectiveness of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) committees in enhancing GI performance warrants further investigation. By collecting data on whether Chinese-listed companies established ESG-related committees (including CSR committees and sustainability committees) from 2010 to 2022, we find that the presence of ESG committees significantly promotes both green technological innovation (GTI) and green managerial innovation (GMI). Further analysis reveals that ESG committees drive GI through enhancing green transformation willingness and internal control quality, primarily due to their dual governance roles: advisory and supervisory. Overall, ESG committees on corporate boards are essential for driving GI and predominantly serve as a positive influence.
records.abstract_cn: 如何将环境意识转化为具体的绿色创新行动，日益成为公司治理中的关键问题。作为促进企业可持续发展战略的关键制度安排，环境、社会和治理（ESG）委员会在提升绿色创新绩效方面的有效性值得进一步探究。通过收集2010年至2022年中国上市公司是否设立ESG相关委员会（包括企业社会责任委员会和可持续发展委员会）的数据，我们发现ESG委员会的存在显著促进了绿色技术创新和绿色管理创新。进一步分析表明，ESG委员会通过增强绿色转型意愿和内部控制质量来驱动绿色创新，这主要归因于其双重治理角色：咨询与监督。总体而言，董事会中的ESG委员会对于推动绿色创新至关重要，并主要发挥积极作用。

records.title_en: Powering progress: Bridging energy inequality and energy poverty in Africa
records.title_cn: 推动进步：弥合非洲能源不平等与能源贫困
records.abstract_en: Ensuring universal access to affordable, reliable, and modern energy services is the seventh United Nations Sustainable Development Goal. However, energy poverty and unequal access to energy remain significant challenges, hindering energy transition in several African countries.
