records.title_cn: 尼日利亚的卫生营销
records.abstract_en: We evaluate the effectiveness of a sanitation marketing intervention aimed at increasing the supply of improved toilet products by local businesses and the household demand for toilets in rural Nigeria. Results from a randomized controlled trial show that treated businesses were more likely to produce and market the new toilet model and to engage in the sales of sanitation products more generally. However, we find no discernible impact on household toilet ownership rates. Evidence from interviews with sales agents employed by the business and responsible for about half of the sales suggest that inadequate incentives for sales agents and household affordability constraints may explain these results.
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估了一项旨在增加当地企业改进型厕所产品供应和农村尼日利亚家庭厕所需求的卫生营销干预措施的有效性。一项随机对照试验的结果显示，接受干预的企业更有可能生产和销售新型厕所模型，并更广泛地参与卫生产品的销售。然而，我们发现对家庭厕所拥有率没有明显影响。来自企业雇佣的销售代理（负责约一半的销售）的访谈证据表明，销售代理激励不足和家庭负担能力限制可能解释了这些结果。

records.title_en: The price of war: A cross-country analysis on the conflict-growth nexus
records.title_cn: 战争的价格：冲突与增长关系的跨国分析
records.abstract_en: With the growth in conflict around the world, the measurement of the likely economic cost of conflict is an important task in making the case for peacekeeping, peacemaking and post conflict reconstruction to prevent recurrence. Conflict is also a development issue, as most of the conflicts affect the poorest countries and are often civil wars. This paper deals with a number of issues that arise in the literature and presents a comprehensive analysis of the relationship between conflict and economic growth in the present geopolitical environment. Utilizing an extensive cross-country panel dataset and a structural growth model incorporating conflict dynamics, it offers robust estimates of the effects of conflict. It finds that they are higher for low-income countries with direct and spillover effects larger for Asia. It also showed that the spillover effects of conflict do not affect the overall damage on the GDP loss and this result does not change in the post-Cold War period.
records.abstract_cn: 随着世界各地冲突的增加，衡量冲突可能带来的经济成本是维护和平、促成和平以及冲突后重建以防止复发的重要任务。冲突也是一个发展问题，因为大多数冲突影响最贫穷的国家，且往往是内战。本文处理了文献中出现的一系列问题，并在当前地缘政治环境下对冲突与经济增长之间的关系进行了全面分析。利用广泛的跨国面板数据集和包含冲突动态的结构增长模型，本文提供了冲突影响的稳健估计。研究发现，低收入国家的冲突影响更大，且亚洲的直接和溢出效应更大。研究还表明，冲突的溢出效应并不影响GDP损失的整体损害，这一结果在冷战后时期也没有改变。

records.title_en: The role of green and non-green relatedness in the development of new green specialisations in Argentinean provinces
records.title_cn: 绿色与非绿色关联性在阿根廷各省新绿色专业化发展中的作用
records.abstract_en: As global demand for green products accelerates, emerging economies are increasingly seeking to leverage their existing capacities to support green transitions and capture high-growth market opportunities. This study examines the role of green and non-green relatedness in the development of new green specialisations across Argentine provinces, offering insights into potential pathways for green development. Using relatedness density as a measure of knowledge proximity, results show that the likelihood of developing a new green specialisation is positively associated with both green and non-green knowledge assets within a region. The findings highlight that green policies which neglect spatial disparities risk exacerbating regional imbalances in green economic opportunities. The methodology developed in this study offers a transferable framework for other developing economies aiming to assess and strengthen their regional green economy potential.
records.abstract_cn: 随着全球对绿色产品需求的加速，新兴经济体日益寻求利用其现有能力来支持绿色转型并抓住高增长的市场机会。本研究考察了绿色与非绿色关联性在阿根廷各省新绿色专业化发展中的作用，为绿色发展的潜在路径提供了见解。使用关联密度作为知识邻近性的衡量标准，结果表明，发展新绿色专业化的可能性与区域内绿色和非绿色知识资产均呈正相关。研究结果强调，忽视空间差异的绿色政策可能加剧区域间绿色经济机会的不平衡。本研究开发的方法为其他旨在评估和加强其区域绿色经济潜力的发展中经济体提供了一个可转移的框架。

records.title_en: The role of intermediaries in the implementation of sustainability standards. A case study of buyer-driven Rainforest Alliance certification in the Indonesian cocoa sector
records.title_cn: 中介在可持续标准实施中的作用：印度尼西亚可可部门买方驱动的雨林联盟认证案例研究
records.abstract_en: Voluntary Sustainability Standards (VSS) are private governance instruments that promote sustainable development in global production systems. In smallholder-dominated agricultural sectors such as cocoa, VSS often operate through group certification driven by buyers (companies or cooperatives). These buyers act as intermediaries that implement VSS through enforcement, incentives provision, and capacity-building pathways to ensure producers’ compliance with VSS rules related to sustainable production practices. Despite growing recognition of their importance, the role of these intermediaries has largely remained underexplored. This paper investigates how buyers driving certification implement VSS, how they differ in doing so, and how these differences matter for implementation performance, i.e. the extent to which producers are exposed to implementation pathways. Applying the regulatory intermediation (RIT) framework, we conduct a comparative case study of the implementation of the Rainforest Alliance by three distinct buyer companies driving group certificates in the Indonesian cocoa sector, based on 43 interviews, three focus group discussions, field observations, and survey data from 228 certified farmers. We find that buyers driving certification are crucial intermediaries in VSS implementation and engage an array of sub-intermediaries to perform different implementation functions. The resulting structures of intermediation and the capacities of (sub-)intermediaries vary and matter for implementation performance: in particular, structures with fewer intermediaries that hold operational capacities, independence, expertise, and legitimacy enhance performance. This might bring us closer to understanding why some producers might alter their behavior more than others towards compliance with VSS rules. By unpacking the “black box” of buyers driving group certification in VSS implementation, our research informs both scholarship and policy efforts aimed at enhancing the effectiveness of VSS in achieving sustainability goals, and contributes to a better understanding of the role of buyers in global sustainability governance.
records.abstract_cn: 自愿性可持续标准（VSS）是促进全球生产体系可持续发展的私人治理工具。在以小农为主的农业部门（如可可）中，VSS通常通过买方（公司或合作社）驱动的团体认证来运作。这些买方作为中介，通过执行、激励提供和能力建设路径来实施VSS，以确保生产者遵守与可持续生产实践相关的VSS规则。尽管对其重要性的认识日益增强，但这些中介的作用在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。本文研究了推动认证的买方如何实施VSS，他们在实施方式上有何不同，以及这些差异如何影响实施绩效，即生产者接触实施路径的程度。应用监管中介框架（RIT），我们基于43次访谈、三次焦点小组讨论、实地观察和来自228名认证农民的调查数据，对印度尼西亚可可部门中推动团体认证的三家不同买方公司实施雨林联盟的情况进行了比较案例研究。我们发现，推动认证的买方是VSS实施中的关键中介，并调动一系列次级中介来履行不同的实施功能。由此产生的中介结构以及（次级）中介的能力各不相同，并对实施绩效产生影响：特别是，拥有运营能力、独立性、专业知识和合法性的中介数量较少的结构能提高绩效。这可能使我们更接近于理解为什么一些生产者可能比其他人更多地改变行为以遵守VSS规则。通过打开VSS实施中推动团体认证的买方的“黑箱”，我们的研究为旨在提高VSS在实现可持续目标方面有效性的学术和政策努力提供了信息，并有助于更好地理解买方在全球可持续治理中的作用。

records.title_en: Sectoral effects of development aid on post-war violence: spatially disaggregated evidence from the Great Lakes region
records.title_cn: 发展援助对战后暴力的部门效应：来自大湖地区的空间分解证据
records.abstract_en: In the 1990s and early 2000s, Africa’s Great Lakes region experienced some of the most devastating conflicts in recent history. Following a fragile peace negotiated in the mid-2000s, international donors allocated over $38 billion in development aid to support stabilization across the region. This study evaluates the effectiveness of these efforts through a spatially and sectorally disaggregated analysis of over 100 districts and provinces in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and Burundi. To ensure robust inference, I employ a combination of negative binomial regression with coarsened exact matching on subnational administrative units and difference-in-differences estimations on locally defined buffer zones.
records.abstract_cn: 在1990年代和2000年代初期，非洲大湖地区经历了近代史上一些最具破坏性的冲突。在2000年代中期达成脆弱和平后，国际捐助者分配了超过38亿美元的发展援助，以支持该地区的稳定。本研究通过对刚果民主共和国、乌干达和布隆迪的100多个地区和省份进行空间和部门分解分析，评估这些努力的有效性。为确保推断的稳健性，我采用了负二项回归与粗化精确匹配相结合的方法，对次国家级行政单位进行分析，并在局部定义的缓冲区内进行双重差分估计。

records.title_en: Competitive and revenue‐optimal pricing with budgets
records.title_cn: 预算下的竞争性与收入最优定价
records.abstract_en: In markets with budget‐constrained buyers, competitive equilibria need not be efficient in the utilitarian sense or maximize the seller's revenue. We consider a setting with multiple divisible goods. Competitive equilibrium outcomes, and only those, are constrained utilitarian efficient, a notion of utilitarian efficiency that respects buyers' demands and budgets. Our main contribution establishes that when buyers have linear valuations, competitive equilibrium prices are unique and revenue‐optimal for a zero‐cost seller.
records.abstract_cn: 在预算受限的买家市场中，竞争均衡在功利意义上不必是有效的，也不一定能最大化卖方的收入。我们考虑一个具有多种可分商品的设定。竞争均衡结果，且仅有这些结果，是受约束的功利有效的——这是一种尊重买家需求和预算的功利效率概念。我们的主要贡献在于，当买家具有线性估值时，竞争均衡价格是唯一的，并且对零成本卖方而言是收入最优的。

records.title_en: Commonality of information and commonality of beliefs
records.title_cn: 信息的共同性与信念的共同性
records.abstract_en: A group of agents with a common prior receive informative signals about an unknown state repeatedly over time. If these signals were public, agents' beliefs would be identical and commonly known. This suggests that if signals were private, then the more correlated they are, the greater is the commonality of beliefs. We show that, in fact, the opposite may be true. In the long run, conditionally independent signals may achieve greater commonality of beliefs than correlated signals.
records.abstract_cn: 一群具有共同先验的代理人随时间重复接收关于未知状态的信息性信号。如果这些信号是公开的，代理人的信念将是相同的且为共同知识。这表明如果信号是私人的，那么它们相关性越强，信念的共同性就越大。我们表明，事实上，情况可能相反。在长期中，条件独立信号可能比相关信号实现更大的信念共同性。

records.title_en: Fostering collaboration
records.title_cn: 促进合作
records.abstract_en: We study project selection and development by a principal, interacting with two agents, each of whom wants his respective project selected. When the best choice is uncertain, keeping both projects alive gives the principal the ability to adapt her choice in the future, but implies an efficiency loss of effort being spent on the project finally not chosen. We show that a time‐varying threshold rule is uniquely optimal: the principal selects the first project to achieve a sufficient lead. The optimum entails initial competition, always followed by permanent collaboration. Our proof uses martingale time‐change methods that apply weak solutions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究一个委托人与两个代理人互动时的项目选择与开发问题，每个代理人都希望自己的项目被选中。当最佳选择不确定时，让两个项目都保持存活使委托人能够在未来调整她的选择，但意味着投入在最终未被选择的项目上的努力会造成效率损失。我们证明，一个随时间变化的阈值规则是唯一最优的：委托人选择第一个取得足够领先的项目。最优状态涉及初始竞争，随后总是永久合作。我们的证明使用了应用于弱解的鞅时间变换方法。

records.title_en: Evidence and skepticism in verifiable disclosure games
records.title_cn: 可验证披露博弈中的证据与怀疑
records.abstract_en: A key feature of communication with evidence is skepticism: a receiver will attribute any incomplete disclosure to the sender concealing unfavorable evidence. I study when a change in the receiver"s prior belief about the sender's evidence induces more skepticism, i.e., induces the receiver, regardless of his preferences, to take an equilibrium action that is less favorable for the sender following every message. I provide a definition of when one receiver's prior belief expects more evidence than another and show that this characterizes more skepticism. As an input, I fully characterize receiver optimal equilibrium outcomes in general verifiable disclosure games.
records.abstract_cn: 带有证据的沟通的一个关键特征是怀疑：接收者会将任何不完整的披露归因于发送者隐瞒不利证据。我研究了接收者关于发送者证据的先验信念何时发生变化会引发更多怀疑，即无论接收者的偏好如何，都会在每条信息之后采取对发送者较不利的均衡行动。我给出了一个定义，说明一个接收者的先验信念何时比另一个预期更多证据，并证明这表征了更多的怀疑。作为输入，我完整刻画了一般可验证披露博弈中接收者最优的均衡结果。

records.title_en: Probabilistic verification in mechanism design
records.title_cn: 机制设计中的概率验证
records.abstract_en: We introduce a model of probabilistic verification in mechanism design. The principal elicits a message from the agent and then selects a test to give the agent. The agent's true type determines the probability with which he can pass each test. We characterize whether each type has an associated test that best screens out all other types. If this condition holds, then the testing technology can be represented in a tractable reduced form. We use this reduced form to solve for profit‐maximizing mechanisms with verification. As the verification technology varies, the solution continuously interpolates between the no‐verification solution and full surplus extraction.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在机制设计中引入了一个概率验证模型。委托人从代理人处 elicits 一条消息，然后选择一个测试给代理人。代理人的真实类型决定了他能通过每个测试的概率。我们刻画了每种类型是否具有一个相关联的测试，能最好地将所有其他类型甄别出来。如果这一条件成立，那么测试技术就可以用一种易于处理的简约形式来表示。我们利用这一简约形式来求解带验证的利润最大化机制。随着验证技术的变化，解在无验证解与完全剩余抽取之间连续插值。

records.title_en: Safe implementation
records.title_cn: 安全实施
records.abstract_en: Implementation theory is concerned with the existence of mechanisms in which, at each state of the world, all equilibria result in outcomes that are within a given social choice correspondence (SCC). However, if agents make mistakes, if their preferences or the solution concept are misspecified, or if the designer is limited in what can be used as punishments, then it may be desirable to insist that also deviations result in “acceptable” outcomes. Safe implementation adds this extra requirement to standard implementation. Our primitives, therefore, also include an acceptability correspondence, which, like the SCC, maps states of the world to sets of allocations. When the underlying solution concept is Nash equilibrium, we identify necessary and sufficient conditions (namely, comonotonicity and safe no‐veto) that restrict the joint behavior of the SCC and of the acceptability correspondence, and that generalize Maskin's (1999) conditions. In relevant economic applications, these conditions can be quite permissive, but in “rich” preference domains, safe implementation is impossible, regardless of the solution concept.
records.abstract_cn: 实施理论研究的是机制的存在性，在这种机制中，在世界的每一个状态下，所有均衡结果都落在给定的社会选择对应（SCC）之内。然而，如果行为人会犯错，如果他们的偏好或解概念被错误设定，或者如果设计者在可用作惩罚的手段上受到限制，那么可能有必要坚持偏离也产生“可接受的”结果。安全实施在标准实施之上增加了这一额外要求。因此，我们的原始设定还包括一个可接受性对应，它像SCC一样，将世界状态映射到配置集合。当基础解概念是纳什均衡时，我们识别了限制SCC与可接受性对应联合行为的必要且充分条件（即共单调性和安全无否决权），这些条件推广了Maskin（1999）的条件。在相关的经济应用中，这些条件可以相当宽松，但在“丰富”的偏好域中，无论解概念如何，安全实施都是不可能的。

records.title_en: Screening for breakthroughs
records.title_cn: 筛选突破
records.abstract_en: How best to incentivize prompt disclosure? We study this question in a general model in which a technological breakthrough occurs at an uncertain time and is privately observed by an agent, and a principal must incentivize disclosure via her control of a payoff‐relevant physical allocation. We uncover a deadline structure of optimal mechanisms: they have a simple deadline form in an important special case, and a graduated deadline structure in general. We apply our results to the design of unemployment insurance schemes.
records.abstract_cn: 如何最好地激励及时披露？我们在一个一般模型中研究这个问题，其中技术突破在不确定的时间发生，并被代理人私下观察到，而委托人必须通过其对与收益相关的实物配置的控制来激励披露。我们揭示了最优机制的截止期限结构：它们在一个重要的特例中具有简单的截止期限形式，在一般情况下具有渐进式截止期限结构。我们将我们的结果应用于失业保险方案的设计。

records.title_en: Ex post approaches to prioritarianism and sufficientarianism
records.title_cn: 优先主义与充分主义的事后方法
records.abstract_en: Although sufficientarianism has been gaining interest as a theory of distributive justice in recent years, it has not been examined in the presence of risk. We propose an ex post approach to sufficientarianism that has a strong link to ex post prioritarianism. Both ex post criteria are based on an axiom that we refer to as prospect independence of the unconcerned, a natural extension of the independence axiom known from the literature that focuses on situations with no risk. We characterize a class of ex post prioritarian orderings as well as the corresponding class of ex post sufficientarian orderings. In addition, we point out some important differences between these two ex post criteria, and we examine how they fare when assessed in terms of specific ex ante Paretian axioms.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管近年来充分主义作为分配正义理论越来越受到关注，但尚未在有风险的情况下得到检验。我们提出一种事后充分主义方法，它与事后优先主义有密切联系。这两个事后标准都基于一个我们称之为“无关者前景独立性”的公理，它是文献中已知的独立性公理的自然扩展，该公理关注无风险情形。我们刻画了一类事后优先主义排序以及相应的一类事后充分主义排序。此外，我们指出了这两个事后标准之间的一些重要差异，并考察了它们在特定事前帕累托公理下的表现。

records.title_en: Existence of a non‐stationary equilibrium in search‐and‐matching models: TU and NTU
records.title_cn: 搜索匹配模型中非平稳均衡的存在性：可转移效用与不可转移效用
records.abstract_en: This paper proves the existence of a non‐stationary equilibrium in the canonical search‐and‐matching model with heterogeneous agents. Non‐stationarity entails that the number and characteristics of unmatched agents evolve endogenously over time. An equilibrium exists under minimal regularity conditions and for both paradigms considered in the literature: transferable and nontransferable utility. To address potential discontinuities in match opportunities across types, our analysis introduces a generalized Schauder fixed‐point theorem suitable for models with discontinuous value functions.
records.abstract_cn: 本文证明了具有异质性主体的经典搜索匹配模型中非平稳均衡的存在性。非平稳性意味着未匹配主体的数量及其特征随时间内生演化。在文献所考虑的两种范式下——可转移效用与不可转移效用——均衡均在最小正则条件下存在。为处理不同类型之间匹配机会的潜在不连续性，本文的分析引入了一种适用于具有不连续值函数模型的广义Schauder不动点定理。

records.title_en: Nonrecursive dynamic incentives: A rate of convergence approach
records.title_cn: 非递归动态激励：一种收敛速度方法
records.abstract_en: In repeated principal‐agent problems and games, more outcomes are implementable when performance signals are privately observed by a principal or mediator with commitment power than when the same signals are publicly observed and form the basis of a recursive equilibrium. We investigate the gains from nonrecursive equilibria (e.g., “review strategies”) based on privately observed signals. Under a pairwise identification condition, we find that the gains from nonrecursive equilibria are “small”: their inefficiency is of the same 1 − δ power order as that of recursive equilibria. Thus, while private strategies or monitoring can outperform public ones for a fixed discount factor, they cannot accelerate the power rate of convergence to the efficient payoff frontier when the folk theorem holds. An implication is that the gains from withholding performance feedback from agents are small when the parties are patient.
records.abstract_cn: 在重复委托-代理问题和博弈中，当绩效信号由具有承诺权的委托人或者中介私下观察时，可实施的结果比相同信号被公开观察并构成递归均衡基础时更多。我们研究了基于私下观察信号的非递归均衡（例如，“审查策略”）所带来的收益。在成对识别条件下，我们发现非递归均衡的收益是“小的”：其无效率与递归均衡具有相同的1 − δ 幂阶。因此，虽然私人策略或监控在固定贴现因子下可以优于公开策略，但当民间定理成立时，它们无法加速收敛到有效收益边界的幂速率。一个含义是，当各方有耐心时，不向代理人反馈绩效信息的收益是小的。

records.title_en: Finance, Advertising, and Race
records.title_cn: 金融、广告与种族
records.abstract_en: We study how bank advertising practices contribute to racial disparities in financial markets by steering minorities toward inferior products. We exploit a regulatory change that incentivizes deposit collection at the Freedman’s Savings Bank, the first institution to collect deposits from African Americans post-Emancipation, by facilitating misuse of depositor funds. After deregulation, advertising volume rises, particularly in African American newspapers, leading to increased deposits from Black depositors despite the bank’s insolvency. We identify persuasion as a key mechanism; prescriptive stereotypes and false claims likely amplify advertising’s impact on African Americans, exacerbating historically large depositor losses after the bank’s collapse.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究银行广告实践如何通过将少数族裔引导至劣质产品，从而加剧金融市场中的种族差异。我们利用一项监管变化，该变化通过便利滥用存款人资金，激励了自由民储蓄银行（第一家在内战后收集非裔美国人存款的机构）的存款收集。放松管制后，广告量上升，尤其是在非裔美国人报纸上，导致尽管银行资不抵债，黑人存款人的存款仍增加。我们识别出说服是关键机制；规定性刻板印象和虚假声明可能放大广告对非裔美国人的影响，加剧银行倒闭后历史上巨大的存款人损失。

records.title_en: The Gender Investment Gap over the Life Cycle
records.title_cn: 生命周期中的性别投资差距
records.abstract_en: Single women invest less in risky assets than do single men. This paper analyzes the determinants of the “gender investment gap” based on a structural life-cycle framework. The model can rationalize the gender investment gap without gender heterogeneity in preferences. Rather, lower deterministic income and larger household sizes shift the composition of single women toward poorer households that invest less risky (composition effect). Additionally, future outcomes of both variables (which cannot easily be controlled for in regressions) make single women more vulnerable to financial shocks and decrease their optimal equity share even conditional on state variables (policy effect).
records.abstract_cn: 单身女性在风险资产上的投资少于单身男性。本文基于结构性生命周期框架分析了“性别投资差距”的决定因素。该模型无需在偏好上引入性别异质性即可合理化性别投资差距。相反，较低的决定性收入和较大的家庭规模将单身女性的构成转向较贫困家庭，这些家庭投资风险较低（构成效应）。此外，这两个变量的未来结果（在回归中难以轻易控制）使单身女性更容易受到金融冲击的影响，并降低了其最优股权份额，即使以状态变量为条件也是如此（政策效应）。

records.title_en: When Financial Advice Leads to Positive Performance: Evidence from Repeated Client–Advisor Interactions
records.title_cn: 当财务建议带来正面表现：来自客户与顾问重复互动的证据
records.abstract_en: Does the performance of advisors’ recommendations influence investors’ propensity to seek advice again? I investigate a sample of calls between 10,063 German brokerage clients and financial advisors from 2005–2015. If advisors’ recommendations in the initial meeting led to positive (vs. negative) performance, investors are 2.1 times more likely to arrange a second meeting. This effect is driven by the performance of the recommendations the investor decided to follow. Investors with positive performance follow recommendations to a greater degree. The findings show that experiences matter in the advisory context and shape the demand for advice.
records.abstract_cn: 顾问建议的表现是否影响投资者再次寻求建议的倾向？我调查了2005-2015年间10,063名德国经纪客户与财务顾问之间的通话样本。如果初次会议中顾问的建议带来了正面（相对于负面）表现，投资者安排第二次会议的可能性是原来的2.1倍。这一效应由投资者决定遵循的建议的表现所驱动。表现正面的投资者更倾向于遵循建议。研究结果表明，在咨询情境中，经验很重要，并塑造了对建议的需求。

records.title_en: The Role of Intermediaries in Selection Markets: Evidence from Mortgage Lending
records.title_cn: 中介在选择市场中的作用：来自抵押贷款的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the role of brokers in selection markets. We find broker-clients in the Canadian mortgage market are observationally different from branch-clients. They finance larger loans with more leverage and longer amortization. We build and estimate a model of mortgage demand to disentangle three possible explanations for these riskier product choices: (1) selection on observables, (2) unobserved borrower preferences for riskier loans, and (3) a causal effect of brokers. Although we find that brokers influence product choices, the main reason borrowers choose high-leverage products is unobserved preferences. Borrowers prefer larger loans and brokers facilitate qualification for them.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了经纪人在选择市场中的作用。我们发现加拿大抵押贷款市场中的经纪人客户与分行客户在观察特征上存在差异。他们融资的贷款金额更大，杠杆率更高，摊销期更长。我们构建并估计了一个抵押贷款需求模型，以区分这些风险较高的产品选择的三种可能解释：（1）可观测特征的选择，（2）借款人未观测到的对风险较高贷款的偏好，以及（3）经纪人的因果效应。虽然我们发现经纪人影响产品选择，但借款人选择高杠杆产品的主要原因是未观测到的偏好。借款人偏好更大的贷款，而经纪人则帮助他们更容易获得资格。

records.title_en: The Financial Consequences of Pretrial Detention
records.title_cn: 审前羁押的财务后果
records.abstract_en: In the United States, a significant number of criminal defendants are held in pretrial detention and face substantial financial burdens. Matching individual-level criminal case records to household-level financial data, we exploit the quasi-random assignment of court commissioners to study how pretrial detention affects household solvency. We find that pretrial detention results in higher rates of household insolvency, driven by higher rates of chapter 7 bankruptcies and judgment liens, and higher foreclosure rates during periods of decreasing house prices. We document that the effects spill over to family members and show that home equity can cushion households from insolvency.
records.abstract_cn: 在美国，大量刑事被告被审前羁押，并面临沉重的财务负担。通过将个人层面的刑事案卷记录与家庭层面的财务数据相匹配，我们利用法院专员准随机分配来研究审前羁押如何影响家庭偿付能力。我们发现，审前羁押导致家庭破产率上升，这主要由第七章破产和判决留置权比例上升，以及房价下跌期间丧失抵押品赎回权率上升所驱动。我们记录了这些影响会波及家庭成员，并表明房屋净值可以缓冲家庭免于破产。

records.title_en: Societal Inequality and Bank Deposit Dynamics: Evidence from the Freedman’s Savings Bank
records.title_cn: 社会不平等与银行存款动态：来自弗里德曼储蓄银行的证据
records.abstract_en: We study depositor behavior and capital flight using data from the Freedman’s Savings Bank, a bank established after the U.S. Civil War to support formerly enslaved individuals. White depositors, who generally had better access to financial information, begin providing significant funding as interest terms are enhanced. They respond faster to postpanic stabilization efforts and negative bank-specific information, and are twice as likely to close accounts before failure, passing expected losses to Black depositors, who were the bank’s primary philanthropic target. Our results show how demand deposit funding of bank-like institutions can create systemic disadvantages for less experienced borrowers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用弗里德曼储蓄银行的数据研究存款人行为和资本外逃，该银行是在美国内战后为支持前被奴役者而设立的。白人存款人通常能更好地获取金融信息，在利率条件改善时开始提供大量资金。他们对恐慌后稳定措施和负面银行特定信息的反应更快，并且在银行倒闭前关闭账户的可能性是黑人的两倍，将预期损失转嫁给了作为银行主要慈善目标的黑人存款人。我们的结果显示了银行类机构的需求存款融资如何为经验较少的借款人创造系统性劣势。

records.title_en: Shared Destinies? Small Banks and Small Businesses
records.title_cn: 共同命运？小银行与小企业
records.abstract_en: We identify a new source for the declining role of small banks in the banking industry: Long-term changes in the banking sector are partially a consequence of changes in the industrial sector. Small banks are relatively more exposed to small business shocks, because small businesses compose a larger share of their customers. Lower real-side demand for small business financial services is responsible for part of the relative decline in small banks’ deposits. Rough calculations suggest that deposits at small banks would have been $280 billion higher from 2002 to 2017 if small firms had grown at the rate of larger firms.
records.abstract_cn: 我们识别出小银行在银行业中作用下降的一个新来源：银行部门的长期变化部分源于工业部门的变化。小银行相对更易受到小企业冲击的影响，因为小企业在其客户中占比较大。小企业金融服务实际需求的下降是小银行存款相对减少的部分原因。粗略计算表明，如果小企业以与大企业相同的速度增长，从280年到2002年，小银行的存款将增加2017亿美元。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: High-Pressure, High-Paying Jobs?
records.title_cn: 高压、高薪工作？
records.abstract_en: Work-related stress has reportedly increased over time. Using worker-level survey and experimental data, we investigate the labor market consequences of work pressure. We build a measure of pressure strongly associated with adverse health outcomes and show that pressure comes with a sizable earnings premium, reflecting workers’ willingness-to-pay to avoid pressure. As expected, we do not find a premium among civil servants who face strong labor market frictions. Our experimental evidence is consistent with workers sorting into high-pressure jobs and with a sizable market-level compensating differential. Differences in the prevalence and valuation of work pressure explain substantial shares of wage inequality.
records.abstract_cn: 据报道，工作相关压力随时间推移有所增加。利用工人层面的调查和实验数据，我们研究了工作压力的劳动力市场后果。我们构建了一个与不良健康结果密切相关的压力衡量指标，并表明压力伴随着可观的收入溢价，这反映了工人为避免压力而愿意支付的意愿。正如预期，我们在面临强大劳动力市场摩擦的公务员中未发现溢价。我们的实验证据与工人选择高压工作以及市场层面可观的补偿性差异相一致。工作压力的普遍性和价值评估差异解释了工资不平等的相当大份额。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Early Joiners and Startup Performance
records.title_cn: 早期加入者与初创企业绩效
records.abstract_en: We show that early joiners—nonfounder employees in the first year of a startup—play a critical role in shaping firm performance. We use administrative employer-employee matched data on U.S. startups and utilize premature death as a natural experiment that exogenously separates talent from startups. We find that losing an early joiner has large negative effects on employment and revenues that persist for at least ten years. In contrast, losing a later joiner yields only a small and temporary decline in firm performance. Our results imply that organization capital, an important driver of startup success, is embodied in early joiners.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，早期加入者——初创企业第一年的非创始人员工——在塑造企业绩效方面发挥着关键作用。我们使用美国初创企业的行政雇主-雇员匹配数据，并利用过早死亡作为自然实验，外生地分离人才与初创企业。我们发现，失去一名早期加入者对就业和收入产生显著的负面影响，且这种影响至少持续十年。相比之下，失去一名后期加入者仅导致企业绩效的小幅且暂时的下降。我们的结果表明，组织资本——初创企业成功的重要驱动因素——体现在早期加入者身上。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Women in Political Bodies as Policymakers
records.title_cn: 政治机构中的女性作为政策制定者
records.abstract_en: We investigate how female representation impacts policymaking using the example of child care and new hand-collected data on local council elections in Bavaria. RDD estimations (mixed-gender races for last party-specific council seats) show that an additional female councilor accelerates the expansion of public child care by 40%. We also document an important nonlinearity: an additional woman accelerates the expansion of child care only in councils with few women. Council meeting minutes reveal that women can be effective in councils despite being a nonpivotal minority because they change “the conversation.”
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用儿童保育的案例以及新手工收集的巴伐利亚地方议会选举数据，研究女性代表如何影响政策制定。RDD估计（混合性别竞争中政党特定最后议会席位的竞争）显示，每增加一名女性议员，公共儿童保育的扩展速度加快40%。我们还记录了一个重要的非线性关系：只有在女性议员较少的议会中，增加一名女性才会加速儿童保育的扩展。议会会议记录显示，尽管女性在议会中是非关键少数，但她们通过改变“对话”而能够发挥有效作用。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Stimulant or Depressant? Resource-Related Income Shocks and Conflict
records.title_cn: 刺激还是抑制？资源相关收入冲击与冲突
records.abstract_en: We provide evidence on the mechanisms linking resource-related income shocks to conflict, focusing on illegal crops. We hypothesize that the degree of group competition over resources and the extent of law enforcement explain whether opportunity cost or contest effects dominate. Combining temporal variation in international drug prices with spatial variation in the suitability to produce opium, we show that higher prices increase household living standards and reduce conflict in Afghanistan. Analyzing shifts in conflict tactics and using georeferenced data on drug production networks and territorial control highlight the importance of opportunity costs, and reveal heterogeneous effects consistent with our theory.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于资源相关收入冲击与冲突之间联系机制的证据，重点关注非法作物。我们假设，群体对资源的竞争程度以及执法力度解释了机会成本效应还是争夺效应占主导。结合国际毒品价格的时间变化与鸦片生产适宜性的空间变化，我们表明，更高的价格提高了阿富汗的家庭生活水平并减少了冲突。分析冲突策略的变化以及使用关于毒品生产网络和领土控制的地理参考数据，突显了机会成本的重要性，并揭示了与我们的理论一致的异质性效应。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: When Transparency Fails: Financial Incentives for Local Banking Agents in Indonesia
records.title_cn: 当透明度失效：印度尼西亚本地银行代理的财务激励
records.abstract_en: We study the effect of raising the level and transparency of financial incentives offered to local agents for acquiring clients of a new banking product on take-up. We find that paying agents higher incentives increases take-up and usage, but only when the incentives are unknown to prospective clients. When disclosed, higher incentives have no effect on take-up and usage, despite greater agent effort. This is due to the financial incentives sending a negative signal to potential clients about the reliability and trustworthiness of the product. Hence, when designing incentives, organizations should consider both their level and transparency.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了提高向本地代理提供的财务激励水平和透明度，以获取新银行产品客户对采纳率的影响。我们发现，支付给代理更高的激励会增加采纳和使用，但仅在激励对潜在客户未知的情况下。当激励被披露时，更高的激励对采纳和使用没有影响，尽管代理付出了更多努力。这是因为财务激励向潜在客户传递了关于产品可靠性和可信度的负面信号。因此，在设计激励时，组织应考虑其水平和透明度。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Biometric Monitoring, Service Delivery, and Misreporting: Evidence from Healthcare in India
records.title_cn: 生物识别监控、服务提供与虚报：来自印度医疗服务的证据
records.abstract_en: We examine the impact of biometric monitoring devices placed in tuberculosis treatment centers in Indian slums. The devices record health worker attendance and patient visits. Combining survey data, random center visits, and hospital registers, we find that patients at biometric-equipped centers are 25% less likely to interrupt treatment, reflecting increased efforts by health workers and greater daily adherence by patients. The technology also improves the quality of public data by reducing overreported patient numbers and underreported treatment interruptions. Overall, our results suggest that real-time monitoring of service delivery can strengthen the state’s capacity to serve poor and marginalized populations.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了放置在印度贫民窟结核病治疗中心的生物识别监控设备的影响。这些设备记录卫生工作者的出勤和患者就诊情况。结合调查数据、随机中心访问和医院登记记录，我们发现，配备生物识别设备的中心的患者中断治疗的可能性降低了25%，这反映了卫生工作者努力增加和患者每日依从性的提高。该技术还通过减少虚报的患者人数和漏报的治疗中断，提高了公共数据的质量。总体而言，我们的结果表明，对服务提供的实时监控可以增强国家服务贫困和边缘化人群的能力。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Regional Borders, Commuting, and Transport Network Integration
records.title_cn: 区域边界、通勤与交通网络一体化
records.abstract_en: This paper exploits spatial quasiexperimental variation around French departmental borders to provide novel evidence that regional borders disturb surrounding economic activity; namely, commuting flows, catchment areas, and residential density. The lack of integration of local transport networks at regional borders—leading to a 4.5 km travel distance penalty when crossing borders—explains the observed border effects. Using a spatial quantifiable equilibrium framework and accounting for construction costs, a policy simulation exercise shows that integrating local transport networks leads to a 6.36% average growth in real per capita residential income.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用法国省级边界周围的空间准实验变异，提供了新的证据表明区域边界扰乱了周边的经济活动；即通勤流、集水区和居住密度。区域边界上地方交通网络缺乏一体化——导致跨境旅行距离惩罚达4.5公里——解释了观察到的边界效应。使用空间可量化均衡框架并考虑建设成本，政策模拟练习表明，整合地方交通网络可使实际人均居住收入平均增长6.36%。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: An Experimental Analysis of the Prize–Probability Trade-Off in Stopping Problems
records.title_cn: 停止问题中奖赏与概率权衡的实验分析
records.abstract_en: We experimentally examine how individuals commit to a cutoff stopping rule when facing a sequence of independent lotteries. We identify two main behavior patterns: (a) a small share of participants consistently choose stopping rules whose gain bound (i.e., the accumulated gain at which the sequence stops) is larger than the loss bound, and (b) a larger share of participants consistently choose rules whose loss bound is larger than the gain bound. We introduce a procedural choice model that accounts for these patterns and show that the behavior of most of our participants is inconsistent with prominent theories of decision under risk.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过实验考察了当面对一系列独立彩票时，个体如何承诺采用截断停止规则。我们识别出两种主要行为模式：（a）一小部分参与者始终选择其收益界限（即序列停止时的累积收益）大于损失界限的停止规则，以及（b）更大一部分参与者始终选择其损失界限大于收益界限的规则。我们引入了一个程序性选择模型来解释这些模式，并表明我们大多数参与者的行为与风险决策的著名理论不一致。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Financial Constraints, Sectoral Heterogeneity, and the Cyclicality of Investment
records.title_cn: 金融约束、部门异质性与投资的周期性
records.abstract_en: While investment in most sectors declines in response to a contractionary monetary policy shock, investment in the manufacturing sector increases. Using manually digitized aggregate income and balance sheet data for the universe of US manufacturing firms, I show that this increase is driven by the types of firms which are least likely to be financially constrained. A two-sector New Keynesian model with financial frictions can match these facts; unconstrained firms take advantage of the decline in the user cost of capital caused by the monetary contraction, while constrained firms are forced to cut back. Removing firm financial constraints in the model dampens the response of manufacturing output to monetary shocks by about 25%.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管大多数部门的投资会因紧缩性货币政策冲击而下降，但制造业部门的投资却有所增加。利用手工数字化的美国制造业企业总体收入与资产负债表数据，我表明这一增长是由最不可能受到金融约束的企业类型所驱动的。一个包含金融摩擦的两部门新凯恩斯主义模型能够匹配这些事实；不受约束的企业利用货币紧缩导致的资本使用成本下降，而受约束的企业则被迫削减投资。在模型中移除企业金融约束会使制造业产出对货币冲击的响应减弱约25%。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Induced Innovation and International Environmental Agreements: Evidence from the Ozone Regime
records.title_cn: 诱导创新与国际环境协定：来自臭氧制度的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper revisits one of the rare success stories in global environmental cooperation: the Montreal Protocol and the phase-out of ozone-depleting substances. I show that the protocol increased science and innovation on alternatives to ozone-depleting substances and argue that agreements can indeed be useful in solving global public goods problems. This contrasts with game-theoretical predictions that agreements occur only when costs to the players are low and with the often-heard narrative that substitutes were readily available. I reconcile theory and empirics by discussing the role of induced innovation in models of environmental agreements.
records.abstract_cn: 本文重新审视全球环境合作中罕见的成功案例之一：《蒙特利尔议定书》及臭氧消耗物质的逐步淘汰。我表明该议定书增加了关于臭氧消耗物质替代品的科学研究和创新，并论证协定确实有助于解决全球公共物品问题。这与博弈论预测（即协定仅在参与者成本较低时达成）以及常听到的替代品现成可用的说法形成对比。我通过讨论诱导创新在环境协定模型中的作用来调和理论与实证。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Cloud Computing and Firm Growth
records.title_cn: 云计算与企业增长
records.abstract_en: Cloud computing has shifted how firms access IT away from investment in fixed capital to pay-on-demand services that facilitate remote and simultaneous use. Using firm-level data, we examine the impact of cloud adoption on firm performance and organizational geography with an IV approach that exploits cross-section and time-series variation in fiber broadband speeds as instruments. Cloud leads younger firms to increase revenue, employment, and productivity, whereas incumbent firms experience no scale effects and weaker productivity gains. Incumbents, however, undergo restructuring through establishment deaths and fewer births, while both types of firms experience geographic reorganization shifting farther from the headquarters.
records.abstract_cn: 云计算已将企业获取IT的方式从固定资本投资转向按需付费服务，这些服务促进了远程和同时使用。利用企业层面数据，我们通过工具变量方法考察了云采用对企业绩效和组织地理的影响，该方法利用光纤宽带速度的横截面和时间序列变化作为工具。云使得年轻企业增加收入、就业和生产率，而现有企业则没有规模效应，生产率提升较弱。然而，现有企业通过机构关闭和减少新设机构进行重组，而两类企业都经历了地理重组，向远离总部的方向转移。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Are Consumers (Approximately) Rational? Shifting the Burden of Proof
records.title_cn: 消费者（大致）理性吗？转移举证责任
records.abstract_en: We present a statistical test for the hypothesis of (approximate) utility maximization on the basis of nonparametric revealed preference conditions. We take as null hypothesis that the consumer behaves randomly, and we reject this hypothesis only if the data provides sufficient evidence to support the alternative hypothesis of approximate utility maximization. Our statistical test uses a permutation method to operationalize the principle of random consumption behavior. We show that our test (i) is valid for any sample size under the null and (ii) has an asymptotic power of one. We also provide simulated power results and two empirical applications.
records.abstract_cn: 我们基于非参数显示性偏好条件，对（近似）效用最大化的假设提出了一种统计检验。我们将消费者随机行为作为零假设，并且仅当数据提供充分证据支持近似效用最大化的备择假设时，才拒绝该零假设。我们的统计检验采用置换方法来实现随机消费行为原则的操作化。我们证明，该检验（i）在零假设下对任何样本量均有效，且（ii）具有渐近功效为一。我们还提供了模拟功效结果和两个实证应用。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Estimating Endogenous Effects on Ordinal Outcomes
records.title_cn: 估计有序结果的内生效应
records.abstract_en: We examine the use of instrumental variable (IV) methods to measure the effect of a ceteris paribus change in an endogenous variable on an ordered outcome. Specifically, we use these methods to investigate the effect of neighborhood characteristics on subjective well-being (SWB) among participants in the Moving to Opportunity (MTO) housing voucher experiment. We find that the estimated positive effect of a decrease in neighborhood poverty on SWB is sensitive to the specification of the first-stage auxiliary equation for endogenous neighborhood poverty. Our results highlight the influential role of control function restrictions in complete triangular models.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了使用工具变量（IV）方法来衡量内生变量的其他条件不变变化对有序结果的影响。具体而言，我们利用这些方法研究邻里特征对参与“搬向机会”（MTO）住房券实验的参与者主观幸福感（SWB）的影响。我们发现，邻里贫困减少对主观幸福感的估计正向效应，对内生邻里贫困第一阶段辅助方程的设定敏感。我们的结果强调了控制函数限制在完整三角模型中的关键作用。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Inference for Dependent Data with Learned Clusters
records.title_cn: 基于学习聚类的相依数据推断
records.abstract_en: This article presents and analyzes an approach to cluster-based inference for dependent data. The primary setting considered here is with spatially indexed data in which the dependence structure of observed random variables is characterized by a known, observed dissimilarity measure over spatial indices. Observations are partitioned into clusters with the use of an unsupervised clustering algorithm applied to the dissimilarity measure. Once the partition into clusters is learned, a cluster-based inference procedure is applied to a statistical hypothesis testing procedure. The procedure proposed in the article allows the number of clusters to depend on the data, which gives researchers a principled method for choosing an appropriate clustering level. The article gives conditions under which the proposed procedure asymptotically attains correct size. A simulation study shows that the proposed procedure attains near nominal size in finite samples in a variety of statistical testing problems with dependent data.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出并分析了一种针对相依数据的基于聚类的推断方法。本文主要考虑的空间索引数据中，观测随机变量的相依结构由已知的、观测到的空间索引间的相异性度量来刻画。通过将无监督聚类算法应用于相异性度量，将观测值划分为聚类。一旦学习到聚类划分，就将基于聚类的推断程序应用于统计假设检验过程。本文提出的程序允许聚类数量依赖于数据，这为研究者选择适当的聚类水平提供了一种有原则的方法。本文给出了所提程序渐近达到正确检验水平（size）的条件。模拟研究表明，在多种具有相依数据的统计检验问题中，所提程序在有限样本下能达到接近名义水平（nominal size）的检验水平。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Inference in High-Dimensional Regression Models without the Exact or Lp sparsity
records.title_cn: 高维回归模型中无需精确稀疏性或Lp稀疏性的推断
records.abstract_en: We propose a new inference method in high-dimensional regression models and high-dimensional IV regression models. The method is shown to be valid without requiring the exact sparsity or Lp sparsity conditions. Simulation studies demonstrate superior performance of this proposed method over those based on LASSO or random forest, especially under less sparse models. We illustrate an application to production analysis with a panel of Chilean firms.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种在高维回归模型和高维IV回归模型中的新推断方法。该方法被证明在不需要精确稀疏性或Lp稀疏性条件的情况下是有效的。模拟研究显示，该方法在稀疏性较弱的模型下，其性能优于基于LASSO或随机森林的方法。我们通过一个智利企业面板数据在生产分析中的应用进行了说明。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Heuristics in Self-Evaluation: Evidence from the Centralized College Admission System in China
records.title_cn: 自我评价中的启发式偏差：来自中国集中高考录取系统的证据
records.abstract_en: Using administrative data on the Chinese National College Entrance Examination, we study how left-digit bias affects college applications. We find strong discontinuities in students’ admission outcomes at ten-point thresholds. Students with scores just below multiples of 10 make more conservative college application choices that place them into less selective colleges and majors. In contrast, students who score at or just above multiples of 10 aim at and achieve higher but are at greater risk of overshooting. The discontinuity reveals that despite the educational and labor market consequences, students’ self-evaluation based on exam scores is subject to information-processing heuristics.
records.abstract_cn: 利用中国全国高考的行政数据，我们研究了左位数字偏差如何影响大学申请。我们发现，在十分位分数阈值处，学生的录取结果存在显著的不连续性。分数刚好低于10的倍数的学生，其大学申请选择更为保守，导致他们进入选择性较低的大学和专业。相比之下，分数达到或刚好超过10的倍数的学生，目标更高且实现更高，但面临过度冲刺的风险更大。这种不连续性揭示出，尽管存在教育和劳动力市场后果，学生基于考试分数的自我评价仍受到信息处理启发式的影响。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Smartphone Data Reveal Neighborhood-Level Racial Disparities in Police Presence
records.title_cn: 智能手机数据揭示社区层面警察存在的种族差异
records.abstract_en: Research on policing has focused on documented actions such as stops and arrests—less is known about patrols and presence. We map the neighborhood movement of nearly 10,000 officers across 21 of America’s largest cities using anonymized smartphone data. Police spend 0.36% more time in neighborhoods for each percentage point increase in Black residents. This neighborhood-level disparity persists after controlling for density, socioeconomic status, and crime-driven demand for policing, and may be lower in cities with more Black police supervisors (but not officers). Patterns of police presence statistically explain 57% of the higher arrest rate in more Black neighborhoods.
records.abstract_cn: 关于警务的研究集中于已记录的行动，如拦截和逮捕——而对巡逻和存在的了解较少。我们使用匿名智能手机数据，绘制了美国21个最大城市中近10,000名警官的社区移动情况。黑人居民比例每增加一个百分点，警察在社区中花费的时间就增加0.36%%。在控制密度、社会经济状况和犯罪驱动的警务需求后，这种社区层面的差异仍然存在，并且在黑人警察主管（而非普通警官）较多的城市中可能较低。警察存在的模式在统计上解释了黑人较多社区中较高逮捕率的57%%。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Voicing Disagreement in Science: Missing Women
records.title_cn: 在科学中表达异议：缺失的女性
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the authorship of postpublication criticisms in the scientific literature, with a focus on gender differences. Bibliometrics from journals in the natural and social sciences show that comments that criticize or correct a published study are 20% to 40% less likely than regular papers to have a female author. In preprints in the life sciences, prior to peer review, women are missing by 20% to 40% in failed replications compared to regular papers, but they are not missing in successful replications. In an experiment, I then find large gender differences in willingness to point out and penalize a mistake in someone's work.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了科学文献中发表后批评的作者身份，重点关注性别差异。来自自然科学和社会科学期刊的文献计量学显示，批评或纠正已发表研究的评论，其女性作者的可能性比常规论文低20%至40%。在生命科学的预印本中，同行评审之前，与常规论文相比，女性在失败的重复研究中缺失20%至40%，但在成功的重复研究中并未缺失。在一项实验中，我随后发现，在指出并惩罚他人工作中的错误方面存在显著的性别差异。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Does a Spoonful of Sugar Levy Help the Calories Go Down? An Analysis of the UK Soft Drinks Industry Levy
records.title_cn: 一勺糖税有助于降低卡路里摄入吗？英国软饮料行业税分析
records.abstract_en: This study evaluates the effects of the 2018 UK Soft Drinks Industry Levy. We combine novel electronic point-of-sale data with longitudinal nutritional information and a variety of event-study specifications. All but a few global soft drink brands reduced sugar content and hence avoided the tiered levy. For brands that maintained their recipes, the levy was on average overshifted, resulting in substantial retail price increases and reductions in consumption, particularly for colas. The levy is responsible for a reduction in intake of about 6,600 calories per year per UK resident, 80% of which is attributable to reformulation by manufacturers.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究评估了2018年英国软饮料行业税的效果。我们结合了新颖的电子销售点数据、纵向营养信息以及多种事件研究设定。除少数全球软饮料品牌外，所有品牌均降低了糖含量，从而避免了分级征税。对于保持配方的品牌，税收平均被过度转嫁，导致零售价格大幅上涨和消费量减少，尤其是可乐类产品。该税使得英国每位居民每年卡路里摄入量减少约6,600卡路里，其中80%归因于制造商的配方调整。

records.title_en: Valuing the Time of the Self-Employed
records.title_cn: 重视个体经营者的时间
records.abstract_en: People’s value of their own time is a key input in public policy evaluations—these evaluations should account for time taken away from work or leisure as a result of policy. Measuring this value for the self-employed is challenging, as, by definition, it is not priced by the market. Using rich choice data collected from farming households in western Kenya, we show that households exhibit non-transitive preferences. As a result, neither market wages nor standard valuation techniques correctly measure participants’ value of time. Using a structural model, we identify the behavioural wedges in participants’ choices and find that distortions appear when households exchange cash either for time or for goods. Our model estimates suggest that valuing the time of the self-employed at 60% of the market wage is a reasonable rule of thumb.
records.abstract_cn: 人们对自己时间的价值是公共政策评估的一个关键输入——这些评估应该考虑到因政策而减少的工作或休闲时间。衡量自营职业者的这一价值具有挑战性，因为根据定义，它不是由市场定价的。使用从肯尼亚西部农户收集的丰富选择数据，我们表明家庭表现出非传递性偏好。因此，市场工资和标准估值技术都无法正确衡量参与者的时间价值。使用结构模型，我们确定了参与者选择中的行为楔子，并发现当家庭用现金换取时间或商品时，就会出现扭曲。我们的模型估计表明，以市场工资的 60% 来评估自营职业者的时间是一个合理的经验法则。

records.title_en: Consumer Surplus of Alternative Payment Methods
records.title_cn: 替代支付方式的消费者剩余
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the consumer surplus from using alternative payment methods. We use evidence from Uber rides in Mexico, where riders have the option to use cash or cards to pay for rides. We design and conduct three large-scale field experiments, which involved approximately 400,000 riders. We also build a structural model which, disciplined by our new experimental data, allows us to estimate the loss of private benefits for riders when a ban on cash payments is implemented. We find that Uber riders who use cash as means of payment either sometimes or exclusively suffer an average loss of approximately 40–50% of their total trip expenditures paid in cash before the ban. The magnitude of these estimates reflects the intensity with which cash is used in the application, the shape of the demand curve for Uber rides, and the imperfect substitutability across means of payments. Welfare losses fall mostly on the least-advantaged households, who rely more heavily on the cash payment option.
records.abstract_cn: 本文估计了使用替代支付方式的消费者剩余。我们使用来自墨西哥 Uber 乘车服务的证据，乘客可以选择使用现金或银行卡支付乘车费用。我们设计并进行了三大规模现场实验，涉及约400,000名骑手。我们还建立了一个结构模型，根据新的实验数据，我们可以估计在实施现金支付禁令时乘客的私人利益损失。我们发现，有时或专门使用现金作为支付手段的 Uber 乘客平均损失了大约 40-50% 在禁令实施之前以现金支付的总行程支出。这些估计的大小反映了应用程序中现金使用的强度、优步乘车需求曲线的形状以及支付方式的不完美可替代性。福利损失主要落在最弱势的家庭身上，他们更依赖现金支付方式。

records.title_en: Simultaneous Search and Adverse Selection
records.title_cn: 同时搜索和逆向选择
records.abstract_en: We study the effect of diminishing search frictions in markets with adverse selection by presenting a model in which agents with private information can simultaneously contact multiple trading partners. We highlight a new trade-off: facilitating contacts reduces coordination frictions but also the ability to screen agents’ types. We find that, when agents can contact sufficiently many trading partners, fully separating equilibria obtain only if adverse selection is sufficiently severe. When this condition fails, equilibria feature partial pooling and multiple equilibria co-exist. We show that facilitating contacts can lead to a reduction in welfare. In the limit, as the number of contacts becomes large, some of the equilibria converge to the competitive outcomes of Akerlof, including Pareto-dominated ones; other pooling equilibria continue to feature frictional trade in the limit, where entry is inefficiently high. Our findings provide a basis to assess the effects of recent technological innovations that have made meetings easier.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过提出一个模型来研究在逆向选择的市场中减少搜索摩擦的影响，在该模型中拥有私人信息的代理可以同时联系多个贸易伙伴。我们强调一个新的权衡：促进联系可以减少协调摩擦，但也可以筛选代理类型。我们发现，当代理人可以联系足够多的贸易伙伴时，只有当逆向选择足够严重时，才能实现完全分离均衡。当这个条件失败时，平衡特征是部分池化和多重平衡并存。我们表明，促进接触可能会导致福利减少。在极限情况下，随着接触数量的增加，一些均衡会收敛到阿克洛夫的竞争结果，包括帕累托支配的均衡；其他汇集均衡仍然以摩擦贸易为特征，进入效率低下。我们的研究结果为评估最近使会议变得更容易的技术创新的影响提供了基础。

records.title_en: Melons as Lemons: Asymmetric Information, Consumer Learning and Seller Reputation
records.title_cn: 瓜如柠檬：信息不对称、消费者学习和卖家声誉
records.abstract_en: Quality provision is often low in many developing markets, and firms commonly lack a reputation for quality. This article examines this issue both theoretically and empirically in the context of retail watermelon markets in China. I first demonstrate the existence of significant asymmetric information on quality between sellers and buyers, as well as the absence of a quality premium at baseline. To explain this, I develop a theoretical model that highlights the role of consumer beliefs and costly signalling in influencing sellers’ reputation incentives. I then conduct an experiment by randomly introducing two signalling technologies into different markets: a cheap sticker label and a more expensive laser-cut label. Consistent with the theoretical predictions, the laser label induces sellers to offer higher quality, resulting in increased sales and profits, while the sticker label fails to achieve the same effect. Using the experimental variation, I estimate an empirical model of consumer learning to uncover the underlying evolution of beliefs. The results show that pessimistic beliefs under the sticker label can hinder reputation building, whereas the laser label enhances consumer learning and strengthens sellers’ reputation incentives.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多发展中市场，质量供应往往较低，企业通常缺乏质量声誉。本文以中国西瓜零售市场为背景，从理论上和实证上探讨了这个问题。我第一证明了卖方和买方之间存在明显的质量信息不对称，并且基线时不存在质量溢价。为了解释这一点，我开发了一个理论模型，强调消费者信念和昂贵的信号在影响卖家声誉激励方面的作用。然后我进行了一项实验，将二信号技术随机引入不同的市场：廉价的贴纸标签和更昂贵的激光切割标签。与理论预测一致，激光标签诱导卖家提供更高的质量，从而增加销售额和利润，而贴纸标签则未能达到相同的效果。利用实验变量，我估计了消费者学习的实证模型，以揭示信念的潜在演变。结果表明，贴纸标签下的悲观信念会阻碍声誉的建立，而激光标签可以增强消费者的学习能力并增强卖家的声誉激励。

records.title_en: Industrial Policy Implementation: Empirical Evidence from China’s Shipbuilding Industry
records.title_cn: 产业政策实施：来自中国船舶工业的经验证据
records.abstract_en: Industrial policies are widely used across the world. In practice, designing and implementing these policies is a complicated task. In this paper, we assess the long-term performance of different industrial policy instruments, which include production subsidies, investment subsidies, entry subsidies, and consolidation policies. To do so, we examine a recent industrial policy in China aiming to propel the country’s shipbuilding industry to the largest globally. Using firm-level data from 1998 to 2014 and a dynamic model of firm entry, exit, investment, and production, we find that (i) the policy boosted China’s domestic investment, entry, and international market share dramatically, but delivered low returns and led to fragmentation, idle capacity, as well as depressed world ship prices; (ii) the effectiveness of different policy instruments is mixed: production and investment subsidies can be justified by market share considerations, while entry subsidies are wasteful; (iii) counter-cyclical policies, firm-targeting, and shortening the intervention horizon can substantially reduce distortions. Our results highlight the critical role of firm heterogeneity, business cycles, and firms’ cost structure in policy design. Finally, when exploring potential rationales, we find support for nonclassical considerations, such as reducing freight rates to boost Chinese trade.
records.abstract_cn: 产业政策在世界范围内得到广泛应用。在实践中，设计和实施这些政策是一项复杂的任务。在本文中，我们评估了不同产业政策工具的长期绩效，包括生产补贴、投资补贴、进入补贴和整合政策。为此，我们研究了中国最近的一项产业政策，旨在推动中国造船业成为全球最大的造船业。利用1998至2014的企业层面数据以及企业进入、退出、投资和生产的动态模型，我们发现（i）该政策极大地提高了中国的国内投资、进入和国际市场份额，但回报率较低，并导致碎片化、运力闲置以及世界船舶价格下跌； (ii) 不同政策工具的效果参差不齐：生产和投资补贴可以通过市场份额考虑来证明其合理性，而进入补贴则是浪费； (iii) 反周期政策、坚定目标和缩短干预期限可以大幅减少扭曲。我们的结果强调了企业异质性、商业周期和企业成本结构在政策设计中的关键作用。最后，在探索潜在的理由时，我们发现了对非经典考虑的支持，例如降低运费以促进中国贸易。

records.title_en: Job Displacement, Unemployment Benefits and Domestic Violence
records.title_cn: 失业、失业救济和家庭暴力
records.abstract_en: We estimate impacts of male job loss, female job loss, and male unemployment benefits on domestic violence (DV) in Brazil. We merge individual-level employment and welfare registers with different measures of DV: judicial cases brought to criminal courts, the use of public shelters by victims, and mandatory DV notifications by health providers. Leveraging mass layoffs for identification, we first show that both male and female job loss, independently, lead to large, and pervasive increases in DV. Using a regression discontinuity design, we then show that access to unemployment benefits does not reduce DV while benefits are being paid, and it leads to higher DV risk once benefits expire. Our findings can be explained by the negative income shock brought by job loss and by increased exposure of victims to perpetrators, as partners tend to spend more time together after displacement. Although unemployment benefits partially offset the income drop following job loss, they reinforce the exposure shock as they increase unemployment duration. Since our results cannot be explained by prominent DV theories, we propose a simple model formalizing these mechanisms.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了巴西男性失业、女性失业和男性失业救济金对家庭暴力 (DV) 的影响。我们将个人层面的就业和福利登记与不同的家庭暴力措施合并起来：提交刑事法院的司法案件、受害者使用公共庇护所以及医疗服务提供者强制家庭暴力通知。利用大规模裁员进行识别，我们第一表明，男性和女性失业都会独立地导致家庭暴力大幅普遍增加。然后，我们使用断点回归设计表明，在支付福利期间，获得失业救济并不会降低家庭暴力，而且一旦福利到期，就会导致家庭暴力风险更高。我们的发现可以用失业带来的负面收入冲击以及受害者与施暴者接触的增加来解释，因为伴侣在流离失所后往往会花更多的时间在一起。尽管失业救济金部分抵消了失业后的收入下降，但随着失业持续时间的增加，它们加剧了风险敞口冲击。由于我们的结果无法用著名的 DV 理论来解释，因此我们提出了一个简单的模型来形式化这些机制。

records.title_en: Worker Mobility in Production Networks
records.title_cn: 生产网络中的工人流动性
records.abstract_en: This paper documents that production networks play an essential role in the job search and matching process. We document five facts about worker mobility in production networks using employer–employee data matched with the universe of firm-to-firm transactions for the Dominican Republic: (1) workers move between buyers and suppliers almost twice as much as predicted by standard labour market characteristics, (2) movers between buyers and suppliers experience larger earnings increases than other movers, (3) incumbent workers earnings increase when their firm hires from its buyers or suppliers, (4) firm-to-firm trade increases following supply chain hires, and (5) hiring from buyers or suppliers is associated with stronger firm growth. Survey evidence points to supply chain-specific human capital and better information about job applicants as the main reasons for hiring within the supply chain. These results reveal a new channel through which factors affecting the supply chain, such as international outsourcing or contracting frictions, impact labour markets.
records.abstract_cn: 本文证明生产网络在求职和匹配过程中发挥着重要作用。我们使用与多米尼加共和国公司对公司交易范围相匹配的雇主-雇员数据记录了五有关生产网络中工人流动的事实：(1)工人在买家和供应商之间流动几乎是标准劳动力市场特征预测的两倍，(2)买家和供应商之间的流动者比其他流动者经历了更大的收入增长，(3)当公司从买家或供应商那里雇用员工时，在职工人的收入增加， (4) 供应链雇用后公司间贸易增加，并且 (5) 从买家或供应商处雇用与公司更强劲的增长相关。调查证据表明，供应链特定的人力资本和更好的求职者信息是供应链内招聘的主要原因。这些结果揭示了影响供应链的因素（例如国际外包或合同摩擦）影响劳动力市场的新渠道。

records.title_en: State Building in a Diverse Society
records.title_cn: 多元化社会中的国家建设
records.abstract_en: Diversity can pose fundamental challenges to state building and development. The Tanzanian Ujamaa policy—one of post-colonial Africa’s largest state-building experiments—addressed these challenges by resettling a diverse population in planned villages, where children received political education. We combine differences in exposure to Ujamaa across space and age to identify long-term impacts of the policy. Analysis of contemporary surveys shows persistent, positive effects on national identity and perceived state legitimacy. Our preferred interpretation, supported by evidence that considers alternative hypotheses, is that changes to educational content drive our results. Our findings also point to trade-offs associated with state building: while the policy contributed to establishing the new state as a legitimate central authority, exposure to Ujamaa lowered demands for democratic accountability and did not increase generalized inter-ethnic trust.
records.abstract_cn: 多样性可能对国家建设和发展构成根本性挑战。坦桑尼亚的乌贾玛政策（一）是后殖民时期非洲最大的国家建设实验，通过在规划的村庄中重新安置不同的人口来应对这些挑战，孩子们在那里接受政治教育。我们结合不同空间和年龄的 Ujamaa 暴露差异来确定该政策的长期影响。对当代调查的分析表明，这对国家认同和国家合法性具有持续、积极的影响。我们首选的解释是，教育内容的变化推动了我们的结果，并得到了考虑替代假设的证据的支持。我们的研究结果还指出了与国家建设相关的权衡：虽然该政策有助于将新国家建立为合法的中央当局，但接触乌贾玛降低了对民主问责制的要求，并且没有增加普遍的种族间信任。

records.title_en: A Network Formation Model Based on Subgraphs
records.title_cn: 一种基于子图的网络形成模型
records.abstract_en: We develop a new class of random graph models for the statistical estimation of network formation—subgraph generated models (SUGMs). Various subgraphs—e.g. links, triangles, cliques, stars—are generated and their union results in a network. We show that SUGMs are identified and establish the consistency and asymptotic distribution of parameter estimators in empirically relevant cases. We show that a simple four-parameter SUGM matches basic patterns in empirical networks more closely than four standard models (with many more dimensions): (1) stochastic block models; (2) models with node-level unobserved heterogeneity; (3) latent space models; and (4) exponential random graphs. We illustrate the framework’s value via several applications using networks from rural India. We study whether network structure helps enforce risk-sharing and whether cross-caste interactions are more likely to be private. We also develop a new central limit theorem for correlated random variables, which is required to prove our results and is of independent interest.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一类新的随机图模型，用于网络形成的统计估计——子图生成模型（SUGM）。各种子图——例如链接、三角形、派系、星形——被生成，它们的结合形成一个网络。我们证明了 SUGM 是被识别的，并在经验相关的情况下建立了参数估计量的一致性和渐近分布。我们证明，简单的 四 参数 SUGM 比 四 标准模型（具有更多维度）更接近地匹配经验网络中的基本模式： (1) 随机块模型； (2) 具有节点级未观察到的异质性的模型； (3) 潜在空间模型；和 (4) 指数随机图。我们通过使用印度农村网络的几个应用程序来说明该框架的价值。我们研究网络结构是否有助于加强风险分担，以及跨种姓互动是否更有可能是私密的。我们还为相关随机变量开发了一个新的中心极限定理，这是证明我们的结果所必需的，并且具有独立的意义。

records.title_en: Assessing Racial and Educational Segmentation in Large Marriage Markets
records.title_cn: 评估大型婚姻市场中的种族和教育细分
records.abstract_en: Complementarities between partners’ characteristics are often held responsible for the patterns of assortative mating observed in marriage markets along different dimensions, such as race and education. However, when the marriage market is segmented into racially and educationally homogeneous clusters, people naturally have more match opportunities with their likes. In this paper, we build an empirically tractable dynamic matching model with endogenous separation and remarriage. In every period, agents participate in a competitive matching game with transferable utility, where mating strategies depend on both the expected match gains and search frictions in the form of meeting costs. We leverage panel data on the duration of both non-cohabiting and cohabiting relationships to jointly estimate both determinants of assortative mating with a nationally representative sample of the U.S. population. We show that, in the absence of search frictions, the share of matches between people of the same race (education) would decrease from 88.2% (49.2%) to 55.5% (40.8%), as opposed to 53.3% (33.5%) if singles were randomly matched. As a result, search frictions explain nearly all the racial homogamy observed in the data, but only approximately half of the observed educational homogamy, with the other half attributed to match complementarities. In a counterfactual exercise, we show that minority groups experiencing an unfavourable gender ratio when marriage markets are segmented, such as Hispanic men and Black women, would benefit from access to a broader and more diverse pool of partners.
records.abstract_cn: 伴侣特征之间的互补性通常是婚姻市场中不同维度（例如种族和教育）观察到的选型交配模式的原因。然而，当婚姻市场被细分为种族和教育程度同质的群体时，人们自然有更多与自己喜欢的人匹配的机会。在本文中，我们建立了一个具有内源性分离和再婚的经验上易于处理的动态匹配模型。在每个时期，智能体都会参与具有可转移效用的竞争性匹配游戏，其中交配策略取决于预期的匹配收益和以会议成本形式出现的搜索摩擦。我们利用非同居和同居关系持续时间的面板数据，以美国人口的全国代表性样本来共同估计选型交配的两个决定因素。我们发现，在没有搜索摩擦的情况下，同一种族（教育程度）的人之间的匹配比例将从 88.2% (49.2%) 下降到 55.5% (40.8%)，而如果单身人士随机匹配，则相对于 53.3% (33.5%)。因此，搜索摩擦几乎解释了数据中观察到的所有种族同质性，但仅解释了观察到的教育同质性的大约一半，另一半归因于匹配互补性。在反事实练习中，我们表明，当婚姻市场分割时，性别比例不利的少数群体（例如西班牙裔男性和黑人女性）将受益于接触更广泛和更多样化的伴侣群体。

records.title_en: “Bid Shopping” in Procurement Auctions with Subcontracting
records.title_cn: 分包采购拍卖中的“竞标”
records.abstract_en: We analyse the equilibrium effects of “bid shopping”—a contractor soliciting a subcontractor bid for part of a project prior to a procurement auction, then showing that bid to a competing subcontractor in an attempt to secure a lower price. Such conduct is widely criticized as unethical by professional organizations and has been the target of legislation at both the federal and state level but is widespread in procurement auctions in many places. We find that in equilibrium, a winning contractor’s practice of shopping her subcontractor’s bid to other subcontractors who have already submitted bids is welfare-decreasing, while shopping bids to new subcontractors who have not yet bid can be welfare-increasing, particularly when subcontractors’ bid preparation costs are sufficiently high.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了“投标购物”的均衡效应——承包商在采购拍卖之前向分包商征求部分项目的投标，然后向竞争的分包商展示该投标，以试图获得较低的价格。这种行为被专业组织广泛批评为不道德，并已成为联邦和州一级立法的目标，但在许多地方的采购拍卖中广泛存在。我们发现，在均衡状态下，中标承包商将其分包商的投标购买给其他已提交投标的分包商的做法是福利递减的，而将投标购买给尚未投标的新分包商的做法可能会增加福利，特别是当分包商的投标准备成本足够高时。

records.title_en: Arbitration with Uninformed Consumers
records.title_cn: 与不知情的消费者进行仲裁
records.abstract_en: This article studies the impact of the arbitrator selection process on consumer outcomes. Using data from consumer arbitration cases in the securities industry over the past two decades, where we observe detailed information on case characteristics, the randomly generated list of potential arbitrators presented to both parties, the selected arbitrator, and case outcomes, we establish several motivating facts. These facts suggest that firms hold an informational advantage over consumers in selecting arbitrators, resulting in industry-friendly arbitration outcomes. We then develop and calibrate a quantitative model of arbitrator selection in which firms hold an informational advantage in selecting arbitrators. Arbitrators, who are compensated only if chosen, compete with each other to be selected. The model allows us to decompose the firms’ advantage into two components: the advantage of choosing pro-industry arbitrators from a given pool and the equilibrium pro-industry tilt in the arbitration pool that arises because of arbitrator competition. Selecting arbitrators without the input of firms and consumers would increase consumer awards by $60,000 on average relative to the current system. Forty percent of this effect arises because the pool of arbitrators skews pro-industry due to competition. Even an informed consumer cannot avoid this pro-industry equilibrium effect. Counterfactuals suggest that redesigning the arbitrator selection mechanism for the benefit of consumers hinges on whether consumers are informed. Policies intended to benefit consumers, such as increasing arbitrator compensation or giving parties more choice, would benefit informed consumers but hurt the uninformed.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究仲裁员选择过程对消费者结果的影响。利用过去二几十年证券行业消费者仲裁案件的数据，我们观察了有关案件特征、随机生成的向双方提供的潜在仲裁员名单、选定的仲裁员以及案件结果的详细信息，我们建立了几个激励事实。这些事实表明，企业在选择仲裁员方面比消费者拥有信息优势，从而产生有利于行业的仲裁结果。然后，我们开发并校准了仲裁员选择的定量模型，其中企业在选择仲裁员时拥有信息优势。仲裁员只有在当选后才能获得报酬，他们之间相互竞争被选拔。该模型允许我们将企业的优势分解为二组成部分：从给定池中选择亲行业仲裁员的优势以及由于仲裁员竞争而产生的仲裁池中的均衡亲行业倾斜。相对于当前系统，在没有公司和消费者参与的情况下选择仲裁员将使消费者赔偿平均增加60,000美元。百分之四十的影响是由于仲裁员队伍因竞争而偏向于产业界而产生的。即使是知情的消费者也无法避免这种有利于行业的均衡效应。反事实表明，为了消费者的利益重新设计仲裁员选择机制取决于消费者是否知情。旨在使消费者受益的政策，例如增加仲裁员报酬或给予当事人更多选择，将使知情的消费者受益，但会伤害不知情的消费者。

records.title_en: Wealth Inequality and Asset Prices
records.title_cn: 财富不平等和资产价格
records.abstract_en: Wealthy households disproportionately invest in equity, causing equity returns to generate large and persistent fluctuations in top wealth inequality. Motivated by this observation, I study the joint dynamics of asset prices and wealth inequality in a model where a subset of agents (entrepreneurs) hold levered positions on the economy. In the model, as in the data, the wealth distribution is stochastic and it exhibits a Pareto tail, with a tail index that depends on the logarithmic average return of top households. The model features a feedback loop between asset prices and wealth inequality, which amplifies the effect of aggregate shocks on the economy. The model, calibrated to the U.S. data, can account for a substantial portion of the fluctuations in asset prices and top wealth shares over the 20th century.
records.abstract_cn: 富裕家庭过多地投资于股票，导致股票回报率导致顶级财富不平等出现大幅且持续的波动。受这一观察的启发，我在一个模型中研究了资产价格和财富不平等的联合动态，其中一部分代理人（企业家）在经济中持有杠杆头寸。在该模型中，正如在数据中一样，财富分布是随机的，并且呈现帕累托尾部，尾部指数取决于顶级家庭的对数平均回报。该模型的特点是资产价格和财富不平等之间存在反馈循环，从而放大了总体冲击对经济的影响。该模型根据美国数据进行校准，可以解释20世纪资产价格和顶级财富份额波动的很大一部分。

records.title_en: Inference with a Single Treated Cluster
records.title_cn: 使用单个处理簇进行推理
records.abstract_en: I introduce a generic method for inference about a scalar parameter in research designs with a finite number of heterogeneous clusters where only a single cluster received treatment. This situation is commonplace in difference-in-differences estimation, but the test developed here applies more broadly. I show that the test controls size and has power under asymptotics where the number of observations within each cluster is large but the number of clusters is fixed. The test combines weighted, approximately Gaussian parameter estimates with a rearrangement procedure to obtain its critical values. The weights needed for most empirically relevant situations are tabulated in the paper. Calculation of the critical values is computationally simple and does not require simulation or resampling. The rearrangement test is highly robust to situations where some clusters are much more variable than others. Examples and an empirical application are provided.
records.abstract_cn: 我介绍了一种通用方法，用于在具有有限数量的异构簇的研究设计中推断标量参数，其中只有单个簇接受处理。这种情况在双重差分估计中很常见，但这里开发的检验应用范围更广。我证明了该检验控制了大小，并且在渐进条件下具有功效，其中每个簇内的观测值数量很大，但簇的数量是固定的。该测试将加权的近似高斯参数估计与重排过程结合起来以获得其临界值。本文列出了大多数经验相关情况所需的权重。临界值的计算计算简单，不需要模拟或重采样。对于某些簇比其他簇变化更大的情况，重排测试非常稳健。提供了示例和经验应用。

records.title_en: A Theory of Cash Flow-Based Financing with Distress Resolution
records.title_cn: 基于现金流的困境融资理论
records.abstract_en: We develop a dynamic contracting theory of asset- and cash flow-based financing that demonstrates how firm, intermediary, and capital market characteristics jointly shape firms’ financing constraints. A firm with imperfect access to equity financing covers financing needs through costly sources: an intermediary and retained cash. The firm’s financing capacity is endogenously determined by either the liquidation value of assets (asset-based) or the intermediary’s going-concern valuation of the firm’s cash flows (cash flow-based). The optimal contract is implemented with defaultable debt—specifically unsecured credit lines and senior-secured debt—and features risk-sharing via bankruptcy. When the firm does well, it repays its debt in full. When it does poorly, distress resolution mirrors U.S. bankruptcy procedures (Chapters 7 and 11). Secured and unsecured debt are complements because risk-sharing via unsecured debt increases secured debt capacity. Debt and equity are dynamic complements because future access to equity financing increases current debt capacity.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种基于资产和现金流的融资的动态契约理论，该理论展示了企业、中介和资本市场特征如何共同塑造企业的融资约束。股权融资渠道不完善的公司通过昂贵的来源满足融资需求：中介机构和保留现金。公司的融资能力内生地取决于资产的清算价值（基于资产）或中介机构对公司现金流的持续经营估值（基于现金流）。最佳合同是通过可违约债务（特别是无担保信贷额度和高级担保债务）来实施的，并通过破产来分担风险。当公司表现良好时，它会全额偿还债务。当表现不佳时，困境解决办法类似于美国的破产程序（第7和11章）。有担保债务和无担保债务是互补的，因为通过无担保债务分担风险可以提高有担保债务能力。债务和股权是动态互补的，因为未来获得股权融资的机会会增加当前的债务能力。

records.title_en: The Long-Run Labour Market Effects of the Canada-U.S. Free Trade Agreement
records.title_cn: 加拿大-美国自由贸易协定对劳动力市场的长期影响
records.abstract_en: This article assesses the long-run effects of the 1989 Canada-U.S. Free Trade Agreement on the Canadian labour market using matched longitudinal administrative data for the years 1984–2004. We simultaneously examine the labour market effects of increased export expansion and import competition, generally finding adverse effects of Canadian tariff cuts and favourable effects of U.S. cuts, though both effects are small. Workers initially employed in industries that experienced larger Canadian tariff concessions exhibit a heightened probability of layoffs at large firms, but little impact on long-run cumulative earnings. Lower earnings and years worked at the initial employer are offset by gains in other manufacturing industries, construction, and services. Canadian workers quickly transitioned out of industries facing import competition, with the bilateral nature of the FTA providing import-competing workers employment options in alternative manufacturing industries benefiting from larger U.S. tariff cuts.
records.abstract_cn: 本文使用1989-1984年匹配的纵向行政数据评估2004加拿大-美国自由贸易协定对加拿大劳动力市场的长期影响。我们同时研究了出口扩张和进口竞争加剧对劳动力市场的影响，通常发现加拿大关税削减的不利影响和美国削减的有利影响，尽管这两种影响都很小。最初受雇于经历过加拿大较大关税减让的行业的工人在大公司裁员的可能性较高，但对长期累积收入影响不大。较低的收入和在原雇主的工作年限被其他制造业、建筑业和服务业的收益所抵消。加拿大工人迅速摆脱了面临进口竞争的行业，自由贸易协定的双边性质为进口竞争工人提供了替代制造业的就业选择，受益于美国大幅削减关税。

records.title_en: Voting on a Trade Agreement: Firm Networks and Attitudes Towards Openness
records.title_cn: 贸易协定投票：坚定的网络和开放态度
records.abstract_en: We exploit a unique event to study the extent to which popular attitudes towards trade are driven by economic fundamentals. In 2007, Costa Rica put a free trade agreement (FTA) to a national referendum. With a single question on the ballot, 59% of Costa Rican adult citizens cast a vote on whether they wanted an FTA with the U.S. to be ratified or not. We merge disaggregated referendum results, which break new ground on anonymity-compatible voting data, with employer–employee, customs, and firm-to-firm transactions data, and data on household composition and expenditures. We document that a firm’s exposure to the FTA, directly and via input–output linkages, significantly influences the voting behaviour of its employees. This effect dominates that of sector-level exposure and is greater for voters aligned with pro-FTA political candidates. We also show that citizens considered the expected decrease in consumer prices when exercising their vote. Overall, economic factors explain 7% of the variation in voting patterns, which cannot be accounted for by non-economic factors such as political ideology, and played a pivotal role in this vote.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用一个独特的事件来研究大众对贸易的态度在多大程度上受经济基本面驱动。 2007，哥斯达黎加对自由贸易协定（FTA）进行了全民公投。通过投票中的一个问题，59% 的哥斯达黎加成年公民就是否希望批准与美国的自由贸易协定进行了投票。我们将分类公投结果与雇主-雇员、海关、公司间交易数据以及家庭构成和支出数据合并，这在匿名兼容投票数据方面开辟了新天地。我们记录到，一家公司直接或通过投入产出联系参与自由贸易协定，会显着影响其员工的投票行为。这种影响在部门层面的影响中占主导地位，对于支持自由贸易协定的政治候选人的选民来说影响更大。我们还表明，公民在投票时考虑了消费者价格的预期下降。总体而言，经济因素可以解释7%投票模式的变化，这是政治意识形态等非经济因素无法解释的，并且在这次投票中发挥了关键作用。

records.title_en: Affiliated Common Value Auctions with Costly Entry
records.title_cn: 附属的共同价值拍卖，入场费用昂贵
records.abstract_en: Many auctions and procurement contests entail non-trivial bidding costs, which makes the bidders’ participation decisions endogenous to the auction design. We analyse the effect of different auction rules on potential bidders’ incentives to participate. We focus on first-price auctions with affiliated common values and a large pool of potential bidders. Our main interest is on auctions where the realized number of bidders is unknown at the bidding stage. In contrast to the standard case, both participation and bidding decisions are often non-monotonic in the symmetric equilibrium of our model. The expected revenue to the seller is often higher in the auction where the realized number of participating bidders is not disclosed.
records.abstract_cn: 许多拍卖和采购竞赛都需要不小的投标成本，这使得投标人的参与决策内生于拍卖设计。我们分析了不同拍卖规则对潜在投标人参与动机的影响。我们专注于具有相关共同价值和大量潜在投标人的第一价格拍卖。我们主要感兴趣的是在投标阶段实际投标人数量未知的拍卖。与标准情况相反，在我们模型的对称均衡中，参与和投标决策通常都是非单调的。在未披露实际参与投标人数量的拍卖中，卖方的预期收入通常较高。

records.title_en: Finite Sample Inference for the Maximum Score Estimand
records.title_cn: 最大分数估计的有限样本推理
records.abstract_en: We provide a finite sample inference method for the structural parameters of Manski's semiparametric binary response model under a conditional median restriction. This is achieved by exploiting distributional properties of observable outcomes conditional on the observed sequence of exogenous variables. Moment inequalities conditional on the size n sequence of exogenous covariates are constructed, and the proposed test statistic is a monotone function of violations of the corresponding sample moment inequalities. The critical value used for inference is provided by the appropriate quantile of a known function of n independent Bernoulli random variables and does not require the use of a cube root asymptotic approximation employing a point estimator of the target parameter. Simulation studies demonstrate favourable finite sample performance of the test in comparison to several existing approaches. Empirical use is illustrated with an application to the classical setting of transportation choice.
records.abstract_cn: 我们为条件中值限制下的曼斯基半参数二元响应模型的结构参数提供了有限样本推理方法。这是通过利用以观察到的外生变量序列为条件的可观察结果的分布特性来实现的。构造了以外生协变量的大小 n 序列为条件的矩不等式，并且所提出的检验统计量是违反相应样本矩不等式的单调函数。用于推理的临界值由 n 个独立伯努利随机变量的已知函数的适当分位数提供，并且不需要使用采用目标参数的点估计器的立方根渐近近似。模拟研究表明，与几种现有方法相比，该测试具有良好的有限样本性能。通过在交通选择的经典环境中的应用来说明经验的使用。

records.title_en: Institutions, Comparative Advantage, and the Environment
records.title_cn: 制度、比较优势和环境
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes that strong institutions provide comparative advantage in clean industries, and thereby improve a country’s environmental quality. I study financial, judicial, and labour market institutions. Five complementary tests evaluate and assess implications of this hypothesis. First, industries that depend on institutions are clean. Second, strong institutions increase relative exports in clean industries. Third, an industry’s complexity helps explain the link between institutions and clean goods. Fourth, cross-country differences in the composition of output between clean and dirty industries explain an important share of the global distribution of emissions. Fifth, a quantitative general equilibrium model indicates that strengthening a country’s institutions decreases its pollution through relocating dirty industries abroad, though increases pollution in other countries. The comparative advantage that strong institutions provide in clean industries gives one under-explored reason why developing countries have relatively high pollution levels.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出，强有力的制度可以提供清洁产业的比较优势，从而改善一个国家的环境质量。我研究金融、司法和劳动力市场机构。 五补充测试评估和评估该假设的含义。 第一，依赖制度的行业是干净的。 第二，强有力的机构增加了清洁行业的相对出口。 第三，行业的复杂性有助于解释机构与清洁产品之间的联系。 第四，清洁产业和污染产业产出构成的跨国差异解释了全球排放分布的重要份额。 第五，定量一般均衡模型表明，加强一个国家的制度可以通过将污染产业转移到国外来减少其污染，但会增加其他国家的污染。强有力的制度在清洁工业中提供的比较优势，使得一发展中国家污染水平相对较高的原因尚未得到充分探讨。

records.title_en: The Economics of Spatial Mobility: Theory and Evidence Using Smartphone Data
records.title_cn: 空间移动经济学：使用智能手机数据的理论和证据
records.abstract_en: We develop a tractable quantitative framework for modeling the rich patterns of spatial mobility observed in smartphone data. We show that travel is frequently undertaken as part of a travel itinerary, defined as a journey starting and ending at home that can include more than one intermediate stop on a given day. We show that these travel itineraries provide microfoundations for consumption externalities and generate both complementarity and substitutability between locations. We show that the consumption externalities implied by travel itineraries are central to matching quasi-experimental evidence from the shift to working from home. We find that these consumption externalities are key drivers of the agglomeration of economic activity in central cities and shape the relative welfare gains from alternative transport improvements in favor of investments in central cities.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个易于处理的定量框架，用于对智能手机数据中观察到的丰富空间移动模式进行建模。我们表明，旅行经常作为旅行行程的一部分进行，旅行行程被定义为在家里开始和结束的旅程，其中可以包括在给定日期超过 一 个中间停留。我们表明，这些旅行行程为消费外部性提供了微观基础，并在地点之间产生了互补性和替代性。我们表明，旅行行程所隐含的消费外部性对于匹配在家工作转变的准实验证据至关重要。我们发现，这些消费外部性是中心城市经济活动集聚的关键驱动因素，并影响了替代性交通改善带来的相对福利收益，有利于中心城市的投资。

records.title_en: Distributional Growth Accounting: Education and the Reduction of Global Poverty, 1980–2019
records.title_cn: 分配增长核算：教育与减少全球贫困，1980-2019
records.abstract_en: This article quantifies the role played by education in the reduction of global poverty. I propose tools for identifying the contribution of schooling to economic growth by income group, integrating imperfect substitution between skill groups into a macroeconomic growth decomposition. I bring this “distributional growth accounting” framework to the data by exploiting a new microdatabase representative of nearly all of the world’s population, new estimates of the private returns to schooling, and historical income distribution statistics. Education can account for about 45% of global economic growth and 60% of pretax income growth among the world’s poorest 20% from 1980 to 2019. A significant fraction of these gains was made possible by skill-biased technical change amplifying the returns to education.
