We find the states that adopt the Uniform Trade Secrets Act (UTSA), which enhances intellectual property rights, experience an overall decline in firm and establishment entry rates. This result is driven by the reduction in the establishment entry rates of start-ups and small firms. By contrast, the law increases the establishment entry rates of incumbents and larger firms. The negative impact of the UTSA is larger in industries that rely more on intellectual assets and trade secrets, as well as external-finance-dependent industries. (JEL K11, K22, L11, M13, O34, O38)
records.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了商业秘密保护对美国新企业形成的影响。我们发现，采用《统一商业秘密法》（UTSA）以增强知识产权的州，其企业和机构进入率总体下降。这一结果是由初创企业和小型企业的机构进入率降低所驱动的。相比之下，该法律提高了现有企业和大型企业的机构进入率。UTSA的负面影响在更依赖知识资产和商业秘密的行业以及依赖外部融资的行业中更为显著。（JEL K11, K22, L11, M13, O34, O38）

records.title_en: The Management of Aid and Conflict in Africa
records.title_cn: 非洲援助管理与冲突
records.abstract_en: This study investigates the relationship between the management of development aid and violent conflict in Africa. I exploit variation in World Bank project management quality driven by the assignment of project leaders of varying ability, combined with geo-coded data on all projects linked to performance report cards. I find that better project management reduces violent conflict across subnational aid receiving regions. Poorly managed projects increase conflict while well-managed projects do the opposite. Project monitoring is particularly important, and management matters most in regions with a recent history of warfare and for large projects that involve the transfer of appropriable resources. (JEL D74, F35, O17, O19, O22)
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了发展援助管理与非洲暴力冲突之间的关系。我利用世界银行项目管理质量的变化，这种变化由不同能力的项目负责人分配所驱动，并结合所有项目的地理编码数据与绩效报告卡。我发现，更好的项目管理减少了次国家级援助接收地区的暴力冲突。管理不善的项目增加了冲突，而管理良好的项目则相反。项目监测尤为重要，管理在近期有战争历史的地区以及涉及可挪用资源转移的大型项目中影响最大。(JEL D74, F35, O17, O19, O22)

records.title_en: Place Effects and Geographic Inequality in Health at Birth
records.title_cn: 出生地效应与出生健康的地理不平等
records.abstract_en: This paper uses birth records and mothers who move to quantify the absolute and relative importance of birth location for early-life health. Using a model that includes mother and location fixed effects, we find that moving from a below- to an above-median-birth-weight location leads to important improvements in child birth weight, with comparable magnitudes to policies targeting maternal health. Place effects are larger for longer-distance moves and more influential for children of non-college-educated mothers. We find that pollution is the strongest predictor of place effects on infant health. (JEL I12, I14, J13, J16, Q51, Q53)
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用出生记录和迁移母亲的数据，量化出生地点对早期健康绝对和相对的重要性。通过一个包含母亲和地点固定效应的模型，我们发现，从出生体重低于中位数的地区迁移到高于中位数的地区，会显著改善婴儿出生体重，其影响程度与针对孕产妇健康的政策相当。地点效应在长途迁移中更为显著，并且对未受过大学教育的母亲的子女影响更大。我们发现，污染是婴儿健康地点效应最强的预测因子。（JEL I12, I14, J13, J16, Q51, Q53）

records.title_en: Local Labor Market Effects of the 2002 Bush Steel Tariffs
records.title_cn: 2002年布什钢铁关税的本地劳动力市场效应
records.abstract_en: President George W. Bush imposed safeguard tariffs on steel in early 2002. Using US input-output tables and a generalized difference-in-difference methodology, we analyze the local labor market employment effects of these tariffs depending on the local labor market’s reliance on steel as an input and as part of local production. The tariffs did not boost local steel employment but substantially depressed local employment in steel-consuming industries for many years after Bush removed them. The tariffs also led to a persistent exit of steel-intensive manufacturing establishments, suggesting a role for plant-level fixed entry costs in translating the temporary shock into persistent outcomes. (JEL F13, L61, R23)
records.abstract_cn: 乔治·W·布什总统于2002年初对钢铁实施了保障性关税。利用美国投入产出表和广义双重差分法，我们分析了这些关税对本地劳动力市场就业的影响，具体取决于本地劳动力市场对钢铁作为投入品及本地生产一部分的依赖程度。这些关税并未提升本地钢铁就业，但在布什取消关税后的多年里，显著抑制了钢铁消费行业的本地就业。关税还导致钢铁密集型制造业企业持续退出，这表明工厂层面的固定进入成本在将暂时性冲击转化为持续性结果中发挥了作用。(JEL F13, L61, R23)

records.title_en: Public Financing and Racial Disparities: Does a Rising Tide Always Lift All Boats?
records.title_cn: 公共融资与种族差异：水涨船高是否总能惠及所有船只？
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the heterogeneous impact of local government spending across racial groups. An exogenous increase in spending results in significant improvement in White, but not Black or Hispanic, labor market outcomes such as employment rate, weekly hours worked, and labor income. These effects on adults translate into their children’s academic performance. White students show significant improvement in test scores, but Black or Hispanic students do not. Consequently, the achievement racial gap widens following an increase in local government spending. These results highlight the possibility that an increase in local government spending could unexpectedly increase intergenerational racial disparity. (JEL H74, H75, I22, I26, J15, J22, J31)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了地方政府支出在不同种族群体间的异质性影响。外生性支出增加导致白人劳动力市场结果显著改善，如就业率、每周工作小时数和劳动收入，但黑人或西班牙裔并未改善。这些对成年人的影响转化为其子女的学业表现。白人学生的考试成绩显著提高，但黑人或西班牙裔学生没有。因此，在地方政府支出增加后，学业种族差距扩大。这些结果凸显了地方政府支出增加可能意外加剧代际种族差异的可能性。(JEL H74, H75, I22, I26, J15, J22, J31)

records.title_en: Do Tuition Subsidies Raise Political Participation?
records.title_cn: 学费补贴能否提高政治参与？
records.abstract_en: Civic externalities motivate education expenditures, but estimates of the civic returns to large-scale education subsidies are scarce. We use 16 million financial aid applications and a regression discontinuity (RD) design to estimate how a tuition-free college program impacts political participation. We find that each of the 2.6 million awards increased a student’s voter turnout rate by 4–12 percentage points in 2020, raising total turnout and Biden’s margin of victory in the awarding state. We find evidence consistent with peer socialization, among other mechanisms, and show that the civic externalities of education spending can be large enough to sway elections. (JEL D72, D91, I22, I23)
records.abstract_cn: 公民外部性为教育支出提供了动机，但关于大规模教育补贴的公民回报的估计却很少。我们利用16万份财政援助申请和断点回归（RD）设计，估计了一项免学费大学项目对政治参与的影响。我们发现，每2.6万份奖励在4年将学生的投票率提高了12-2020个百分点，提高了该州的总体投票率和拜登的胜选优势。我们发现了与同伴社会化等机制相一致的证据，并表明教育支出的公民外部性可能大到足以左右选举。（JEL D72, D91, I22, I23）

records.title_en: Do Medical Treatments Work for Work? Evidence from Breast Cancer Patients
records.title_cn: 医疗治疗对工作有效吗？来自乳腺癌患者的证据
records.abstract_en: We investigate the effects of radiation therapy on the mortality and economic outcomes of breast cancer patients. We implement a 2SLS strategy within a difference-in-difference framework exploiting variation in treatment stemming from a medical guideline change in Denmark. We reproduce the results from an RCT showing the lifesaving benefits of radiotherapy. We show radiation therapy also has economic returns: Ten years after diagnosis, treatment increases employment by 37 percent and earnings by 45 percent. Previous work has documented a substantial employment drop after a breast cancer diagnosis. Our results imply that radiation therapy can reduce this effect by 70 percent. (JEL H51, I12, I18, J16, J22, J31)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了放射治疗对乳腺癌患者死亡率和经济结果的影响。我们在双重差分框架内实施2SLS策略，利用丹麦医疗指南变更引起的治疗变异。我们重现了随机对照试验的结果，显示放疗的救命益处。我们表明放疗也具有经济回报：诊断后十年，治疗使就业率提高37%，收入提高45%。先前的研究记录了乳腺癌诊断后就业的大幅下降。我们的结果表明，放疗可以将这种影响减少70%。（JEL H51, I12, I18, J16, J22, J31）

records.title_en: Heterogeneous Noise and Stable Miscoordination
records.title_cn: 异质性噪声与稳定失调
records.abstract_en: Coordination games feature two types of equilibria: pure equilibria, where players successfully coordinate their actions, and mixed equilibria, where players frequently experience miscoordination. We investigate learning dynamics where agents observe the actions of a random sample of their opponents. First, we show that when all agents have the same sample size, whether it is small or large, their behavior converges to one of the pure coordinated equilibria. By contrast, our main results show that stable miscoordination often persists when some agents make decisions based on small samples while others rely on large samples. (JEL C72, C73, C78)
records.abstract_cn: 协调博弈具有两类均衡：纯策略均衡，其中参与者成功协调其行动；以及混合策略均衡，其中参与者频繁经历失调。我们研究了代理人观察其对手随机样本行动的学习动态。首先，我们表明，当所有代理人具有相同的样本量时，无论样本量大小，其行为都会收敛到某个纯协调均衡。相比之下，我们的主要结果表明，当一些代理人基于小样本做出决策而其他代理人依赖大样本时，稳定失调往往持续存在。（JEL C72, C73, C78）

records.title_en: Optimal Trade Mechanisms with Adverse Selection and Inferential Naïvety
records.title_cn: 逆向选择与推断天真下的最优交易机制
records.abstract_en: We study an adverse selection environment in which a buyer's inferential ability is heterogeneous: A rational type correctly infers the value of the good from a seller's offer, whereas a naïve type is inattentive to the correlation between the seller's private information and the offer. We characterize the optimal menu mechanism that maximizes the seller's profits or trade surplus. Notably, no matter how severe the adverse selection is, all types of buyers trade. We then provide conditions under which the menu mechanism is optimal among all general mechanisms. A consumer protection policy limiting the naïve buyer's loss is also investigated. (JEL D18, D82, D86, D91)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个逆向选择环境，其中买方的推断能力是异质的：理性类型能正确地从卖方的报价中推断商品的价值，而天真类型则对卖方私人信息与报价之间的相关性不关注。我们刻画了最大化卖方利润或交易盈余的最优菜单机制。值得注意的是，无论逆向选择多么严重，所有类型的买方都会进行交易。随后，我们提供了菜单机制在所有一般机制中为最优的条件。此外，还探讨了一项限制天真买方损失的消费者保护政策。（JEL D18, D82, D86, D91）

records.title_en: Holding Platforms Liable
records.title_cn: 平台责任追究
records.abstract_en: Should platforms be liable for harms suffered by users? A platform enables interactions between firms and users. Harmful firms impose larger costs on users than safe firms. If firms have deep pockets and are fully liable for harms, platform liability is unnecessary. If firms have limited liability, holding platforms liable for residual harm increases platforms' incentives to raise interaction prices and invest in auditing to deter, detect, and block harmful firms. The social desirability and optimal level of platform liability depend on whether interactions require user consent, the degree to which users internalize harms, and the observability of platform effort. (JEL D21, K13, K22, L81, L82, L86)
records.abstract_cn: 平台是否应对用户遭受的损害负责？平台促进了企业与用户之间的互动。有害企业给用户带来的成本高于安全企业。如果企业资金雄厚且对损害承担全部责任，则平台责任并非必要。若企业承担有限责任，让平台对剩余损害负责，会增加平台提高互动价格并进行审计以威慑、发现和阻止有害企业的激励。平台责任的社会合意性和最优水平取决于互动是否需要用户同意、用户内化损害的程度以及平台努力的可观察性。（JEL D21, K13, K22, L81, L82, L86）

records.title_en: (Pro-)Social Learning and Strategic Disclosure
records.title_cn: （亲）社会学习与策略性披露
records.abstract_en: We study a sequential experimentation model with endogenous feedback. Agents choose between a safe and risky action, the latter generating stochastic rewards. When making this choice, each agent is selfishly motivated (myopic). However, agents can disclose their experiences to a public record, and when doing so are prosocially motivated (forward-looking). Disclosure is both polarized (only extreme signals are disclosed) and positively biased (no feedback is bad news). The extent of disclosure is non-monotone in prior uncertainty. Subsidizing disclosure costs can paradoxically lead to less disclosure, but more experimentation. (JEL D81, D82, D83)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个具有内生反馈的序贯实验模型。代理人选择安全行动或风险行动，后者产生随机回报。在做此选择时，每个代理人是自私动机（短视）的。然而，代理人可以将他们的经验披露到公共记录中，并且在此过程中是亲社会动机（前瞻性）的。披露既呈现极化（只有极端信号被披露）又呈现正向偏差（没有反馈是坏消息）。披露程度在先验不确定性下是非单调的。补贴披露成本可能悖论性地导致更少的披露，但更多的实验。（JEL D81, D82, D83）

records.title_en: Market Segmentation and Product Steering
records.title_cn: 市场细分与产品引导
records.abstract_en: A monopolistic seller possesses an inventory containing distinct products, each consumer wishes to buy a single product, and the seller can steer consumers' choices. We fully characterize the producer-consumer surplus pairs induced by market segmentation when the number of products is large. The same characterization holds if the seller cannot price discriminate. We also investigate the relationship between consumer surplus, social welfare, and consumer privacy. Along the Pareto frontier, points with greater consumer surplus can be reached by market segmentations that afford more privacy. (JEL D42, D83, L81)
records.abstract_cn: 一个垄断卖家拥有包含不同产品的库存，每个消费者希望购买单一产品，且卖家可以引导消费者的选择。当产品数量众多时，我们全面刻画了由市场细分所引致的生产者-消费者剩余组合。如果卖家不能进行价格歧视，同样的刻画依然成立。我们还研究了消费者剩余、社会福利与消费者隐私之间的关系。在帕累托前沿上，具有更高消费者剩余的点可以通过提供更多隐私的市场细分来实现。（JEL D42, D83, L81）

records.title_en: Social Learning and Strategic Pricing with Rating Systems
records.title_cn: 社会学习与评级体系下的战略定价
records.abstract_en: Rating systems, widely used in online transactions, often reduce buyers' diverse opinions to summary statistics. To explore the consequences of this coarse aggregation, we analyze a dynamic adverse selection model where buyers share anonymous evaluations via a rating system. With heterogeneous buyers, the seller is tempted to secretly lower prices to attract favorable ratings from price-sensitive buyers. That leads to sporadic flash sales. The seller's incentive to manipulate ratings is, however, self-defeating. Our analysis illustrates how the rating system shapes the allocation of surplus and offers insights for platform and product design. (JEL D11, D82, L11, L81)
records.abstract_cn: 评级系统广泛应用于在线交易，往往将买家的多样化意见简化为汇总统计。为探讨这种粗略聚合的后果，我们分析了一个动态逆向选择模型，其中买家通过评级系统分享匿名评价。在买家异质的情况下，卖家有动机秘密降价以吸引对价格敏感的买家给出好评，这导致了零星的限时抢购。然而，卖家操纵评级的动机是弄巧成拙的。我们的分析阐明了评级系统如何影响剩余分配，并为平台和产品设计提供了见解。(JEL D11, D82, L11, L81)

records.title_en: Optimal Voting Mechanisms on Generalized Single-Peaked Domains
records.title_cn: 广义单峰域上的最优投票机制
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the design of voting mechanisms. There are multiple alternatives, and the voters have generalized single-peaked preferences derived from median spaces as introduced in Nehring and Puppe (2007b). This class of preferences covers a wide range of economically relevant domains, and it is much larger than the well-known single-peaked preferences on a line. I characterize the welfare-maximizing voting rules among all social choice functions satisfying strategy-proofness, anonymity, and surjectivity. The optimal mechanisms are composed of binary votes on subsets of alternatives involving flexible majority requirements. (JEL D71, D72, D82)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究投票机制的设计问题。存在多个备选方案，选民具有源自中位数空间的广义单峰偏好，如Nehring和Puppe（2007b）所引入。这类偏好覆盖了广泛的经济相关领域，且远大于众所周知的直线上的单峰偏好。我在所有满足策略证明性、匿名性和满射性的社会选择函数中，刻画了福利最大化的投票规则。最优机制由对备选方案子集进行的二元投票组成，并涉及灵活多数要求。（JEL D71, D72, D82）

records.title_en: Simple Manipulations in School Choice Mechanisms
records.title_cn: 学校选择机制中的简单操纵
records.abstract_en: Market design mechanisms are often required to be strategy proof, ensuring that no misreporting is profitable. This, however, may be overly restrictive: Real-world participants may be unable to engage in complex misreporting. In the context of school choice, this paper proposes that mechanisms ought to be immune only to certain “simple” misreports. While no strategy-proof mechanism Pareto improves on the deferred acceptance (DA) mechanism, we find one under our weaker requirement: Kesten's (2010) efficiency adjusted DA (EADA). By extending our criterion to also prevent simple “collective” misreports, we obtain characterizations of Kesten's mechanism. These insights contribute to practical market design. (JEL C78, D47, D82, I21)
records.abstract_cn: 市场设计机制通常要求具备策略证明性，确保任何虚假报告都无法获利。然而，这可能过于严格：现实世界中的参与者可能无法进行复杂的虚假报告。在学校选择的背景下，本文提出机制应仅对某些“简单”的虚假报告具有免疫性。虽然没有策略证明机制能在帕累托改进上优于延迟接受（DA）机制，但我们在较弱的条件下找到了一个：Kesten（2010）的效率调整DA（EADA）。通过将我们的标准扩展到同时防止简单的“集体”虚假报告，我们得到了Kesten机制的特征描述。这些见解有助于实际的市场设计。（JEL C78, D47, D82, I21）

records.title_en: On the Alignment of Consumer Surplus and Total Surplus under Competitive Price Discrimination
records.title_cn: 论竞争性价格歧视下消费者剩余与总剩余的一致性
records.abstract_en: We study the role of information in Bertrand competition with differentiated goods and heterogeneous production costs. When producers know their costs and consumers know their values, consumer surplus and total surplus are aligned, in the sense that the information and equilibrium that maximize consumer surplus also maximize total surplus. Alignment may fail if consumers do not know their values: Partial information about values makes purchases less efficient but intensifies price competition. We illustrate this within a Hotelling duopoly framework. (JEL D11, D43, D82, D83)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在具有差异化产品和异质生产成本的伯特兰竞争中信息的作用。当生产者知道其成本且消费者知道其价值时，消费者剩余和总剩余是一致的，即最大化消费者剩余的信息和均衡也最大化总剩余。如果消费者不知道其价值，这种一致性可能失效：关于价值的部分信息使购买效率降低，但加剧了价格竞争。我们在霍特林双寡头框架内对此进行了说明。（JEL D11, D43, D82, D83）

records.title_en: Common Ownership and Market Entry: Evidence from the Pharmaceutical Industry
records.title_cn: 共同所有权与市场进入：来自制药行业的证据
records.abstract_en: Common ownership—where several firms are (partially) owned by the same investors—and its impact on product market competition has recently drawn much attention. This paper focuses on its implications for market entry. We consider the entry decisions of generic pharmaceutical firms into drug markets that are opened up by the end of regulatory protection and which were previously dominated by a single firm selling the brand name drug. We find robust evidence that an increase in common ownership leads to a significant reduction in generic entry. (JEL D22, G32, L13, L51, L65, M31)
records.abstract_cn: 共同所有权——即多家公司被同一投资者（部分）持有——及其对产品市场竞争的影响近来引起了广泛关注。本文聚焦于其对市场进入的影响。我们考虑了仿制药公司在监管保护结束而开放、且此前由单一品牌药公司主导的药品市场中的进入决策。我们发现强有力的证据表明，共同所有权的增加导致仿制药进入显著减少。（JEL D22, G32, L13, L51, L65, M31）

records.title_en: Underestimating Learning by Doing
records.title_cn: 低估干中学
records.abstract_en: Many economic decisions, such as whether to invest in developing new skills, change professions, or purchase a technology, benefit from accurate estimation of skill acquisition. We examine the accuracy of such predictions by having study participants predict the speed at which they will master unfamiliar tasks. Across three studies involving two types of tasks and two levels of difficulty, we find systematic underestimation of learning, even after receiving feedback. In a fourth study, participants predicting others' performance showed significantly less underestimation, suggesting that projection bias—overreliance on immediate perceptions of effort and difficulty—may drive prediction errors. (JEL D83, J24)
records.abstract_cn: 许多经济决策，例如是否投资于发展新技能、改变职业或购买技术，都受益于对技能获取的准确估计。我们通过让研究参与者预测他们掌握不熟悉任务的速度来检验此类预测的准确性。在涉及两种任务类型和两种难度水平的三项研究中，我们发现即使收到反馈后，学习仍被系统性低估。在第四项研究中，预测他人表现的参与者表现出的低估显著较少，这表明投射偏差——过度依赖对努力和难度的即时感知——可能是预测错误的原因。（JEL D83, J24）

records.title_en: Dynamic Screening and the Dual Roles of Monitoring
records.title_cn: 动态筛选与监督的双重角色
records.abstract_en: This paper studies monitoring in long-term, self-enforcing relationships with adverse selection and moral hazard. Monitoring is used to screen low types by incentivizing them to shirk. Once high types have been identified, monitoring is used both to incentivize effort from high types and to provide off-path (dis)incentives for low types looking to build a reputation. This results in a key trade-off: providing cost-efficient incentives to high types, versus screening low types faster. The optimal contract uses probation after screening: high types are excessively monitored to facilitate better screening. Monitoring declines as the agent's track record improves. (JEL D11, D82, D86)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在存在逆向选择和道德风险的长期自我执行关系中的监督问题。监督被用于通过激励低类型偷懒来筛选低类型。一旦高类型被识别，监督既用于激励高类型努力，也用于为寻求建立声誉的低类型提供路径外的（负）激励。这导致了一个关键的权衡：为高类型提供成本有效的激励，与更快地筛选低类型之间的权衡。最优合同在筛选后使用试用期：高类型被过度监督以促进更好的筛选。随着代理人业绩记录的改善，监督减少。（JEL D11, D82, D86）

records.title_en: Does Public Competition Crowd Out Private Investment? Evidence from Municipal Provision of Internet Access
records.title_cn: 公共竞争是否会挤出私人投资？来自市政提供互联网接入的证据
records.abstract_en: Government infrastructure investment may crowd out investment from private firms or induce them to invest preemptively. The tension between these effects underlies the policy debate over municipal provision of internet access. I estimate demand for broadband and combine these results with a dynamic oligopoly model of private and public firms' entry and investment decisions. I simulate a ban on public entry and find that municipalities crowd out more private fiber-optic investment than they induce through preemption. I estimate that this ban decreases consumer surplus and municipal profits by $27 billion while increasing private profits by $23 billion over ten years. (JEL D22, G31, H44, H57, L33, L96)
records.abstract_cn: 政府基础设施投资可能会挤出私人企业的投资，或诱导它们进行先发制人的投资。这些效应之间的张力构成了关于市政提供互联网接入的政策辩论的基础。我估计了对宽带的需求，并将这些结果与一个包含私人和公共企业进入及投资决策的动态寡头垄断模型相结合。我模拟了对公共进入的禁令，发现市政当局挤出的私人光纤投资多于其通过先发制人诱导的投资。我估计，这项禁令在十年内使消费者剩余和市政利润减少27亿美元，同时使私人利润增加23亿美元。(JEL D22, G31, H44, H57, L33, L96)

records.title_en: Foreign aid volatility and institutional development
records.title_cn: 外援波动性与制度发展
records.abstract_en: Existing explanations for why foreign aid can fail to achieve its objectives tend to highlight issues that have roots in recipient countries, e.g., corruption, misappropriation of aid funds. In this paper, I turn the focus to a source of inefficiency that is largely donor-driven: the volatility of foreign aid flows. I argue that aid volatility hinders the development of high-quality institutions in recipient countries. Unpredictable, highly variable aid flows make it difficult for recipient governments to allocate resources across government agencies, to set an efficient tax policy, and to easily coordinate with nongovernmental and civil society organizations about the specific goods and services they will provide. I conceptualize aid volatility as variability — the extent to which the aid flows a country receives vary from year to year; and unpredictability — the extent to which recipients are not able to predict the aid they should expect to receive in upcoming years. I propose measures of aid unpredictability and aid variability, leveraging both a time-series approach and the residuals of a predictive model of aid disbursements. I show evidence that the experience of greater aid volatility over time is associated with worse institutional quality outcomes. These adverse effects of aid volatility on institutional development seem to be particularly strong for more highly aid-dependent recipient countries.
records.abstract_cn: 现有关于外援为何未能实现其目标的解释往往强调源于受援国的问题，如腐败、援助资金挪用。在本文中，我将焦点转向一个主要由捐助方驱动的低效来源：外援流动的波动性。我认为，援助波动性阻碍了受援国高质量制度的发展。不可预测、高度变化的援助流动使得受援国政府难以在各政府机构间分配资源、制定有效的税收政策，并难以与非政府组织和公民社会组织就它们将提供的具体商品和服务进行协调。我将援助波动性概念化为变异性——即一个国家收到的援助流动逐年变化的程度；以及不可预测性——即受援国无法预测未来几年应预期收到的援助的程度。我提出了援助不可预测性和援助变异性的衡量方法，同时利用时间序列方法和援助支付预测模型的残差。我提供的证据表明，随着时间的推移，经历更大的援助波动性与较差的制度质量结果相关。援助波动性对制度发展的这些不利影响似乎在援助依赖程度较高的受援国中尤为显著。

records.title_en: Vernacular Modernity: The politics of the Project-Affected people in rural western India
records.title_cn: 乡土现代性：印度西部农村受项目影响人群的政治
records.abstract_en: This paper uses ethnographic fieldwork and archival records concerning seven government projects, large dams and protected areas, to study the successful mobilization by thousands of rural lower caste and other marginal groups in the western Indian state of Maharashtra. Led by their organic leaders, they first formulated and repeatedly reshaped a state policy of resettlement for project affected people due to development schemes and other state ventures since 1976, and have ensured its implementation in rural settings for nearly five decades. The paper argues that the politics and worldview of these project-affected persons, mostly illiterate and others with some education, reflects a phenomenon that I term vernacular modernity with roots in the lower-caste cultural revolt from the early colonial period that adapted the European enlightenment discourse to the local setting for questioning existing sociopolitical inequalities. Generations of left leaders thereafter have been constructively reconfiguring the contours of modernity, development, democracy and state-making at the margins along with many community leaders who have been shaping their own resettlement as a state infrastructure project. The paper also highlights the political economy of state projects and the challenges concerning forced resettlement processes including shrinking land holdings, a lackadaisical state machinery, host–guest conflicts in the new setting and related issues. This exploratory work tries to strike a conversation between two disparate sets of literature in critical social science concerning protected areas and infrastructure while it offers a fresh empirical perspective on modernity and subaltern politics in rural India.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用关于七个政府项目、大型水坝和保护区的人种学田野调查和档案记录，研究了印度西部马哈拉施特拉邦数千名农村低种姓及其他边缘群体的成功动员。在他们的有机领袖的带领下，他们首先制定并反复修改了一项关于因发展计划和其他国家事业而受项目影响人群的重新安置国家政策，自1976年以来，并确保该政策在农村环境中实施了近五十年。本文认为，这些受项目影响人群（大多为文盲或受过一些教育）的政治和世界观反映了一种我称之为乡土现代性的现象，其根源在于早期殖民时期低种姓文化反抗，该反抗将欧洲启蒙话语适应于当地环境，以质疑现有的社会政治不平等。此后几代左翼领袖一直在边缘地区建设性地重新配置现代性、发展、民主和国家构建的轮廓，同时许多社区领袖也在将自身的重新安置塑造为国家基础设施项目。本文还强调了国家项目的政治经济学以及强制重新安置过程中的挑战，包括土地持有缩减、国家机器懈怠、新环境中的主客冲突及相关问题。这项探索性工作试图在批判社会科学中关于保护区和基础设施的两套不同文献之间建立对话，同时为印度农村的现代性和底层政治提供新的实证视角。

records.title_en: Imposing innovation: How ‘innovation speak’ maintains postcolonial exclusion in Peru
records.title_cn: 强加创新：'创新话语'如何维持秘鲁的后殖民排斥
records.abstract_en: Innovation is regarded as a central driver of societal progress via its perceived role in enhancing economic growth and competitive advantage. As a result, ideals associated with innovation have long influenced development theory, policy and practice, particularly in relation to how nation-states, industries and communities might overcome structural barriers to poverty, unemployment, and more. In recent decades, development discourse has come to embrace a more individualised perspective that views business models, design-thinking and entrepreneurship as key engines of economic creativity and growth. This trend, known as innovation speak, is today a globally dominant paradigm influencing nearly every aspect of economic and social policy, from education to healthcare. In this paper, we argue that innovation speak reinforces colonial power relations, particularly the socioeconomic exclusion and cultural subordination of racialised communities. Focusing on Peru as an empirical setting, our study employs semi-structured interviews with key informants, analyses policy instruments, and draws insights from research diaries documenting a visit to an Indigenous-led innovation initiative. Through our analysis, we illuminate how innovation speak permeates development discourse, policy and tools, with the effect of reinforcing a globally dominant capitalist imaginary that posits market- and growth-centric forms of innovation as the presumed path to national development, to the exclusion of other approaches practised and prioritised by Indigenous groups. Our study thus contributes to a more nuanced understanding of innovation speak, coloniality, and the discourses that today dominate development policy and practice in many Global South nations.
records.abstract_cn: 创新被视为社会进步的核心驱动力，因其在促进经济增长和竞争优势方面的作用。因此，与创新相关的理念长期以来影响着发展理论、政策与实践，特别是在民族国家、产业和社区如何克服贫困、失业等结构性障碍方面。近几十年来，发展话语已趋向于采纳更个体化的视角，将商业模式、设计思维和创业视为经济创造力和增长的关键引擎。这一趋势，即所谓的创新话语，如今已成为全球主导范式，影响着从教育到医疗保健的几乎每一个经济和社会政策方面。在本文中，我们认为创新话语强化了殖民权力关系，特别是对种族化社区的社会经济排斥和文化从属。以秘鲁为实证背景，我们的研究采用对关键信息提供者的半结构化访谈，分析政策工具，并从记录访问一个原住民主导的创新倡议的研究日记中汲取见解。通过我们的分析，我们阐明了创新话语如何渗透发展话语、政策和工具，其效果是强化一种全球主导的资本主义想象，该想象将市场和增长中心的创新形式视为国家发展的假定路径，排斥原住民群体实践和优先考虑的其他方法。因此，我们的研究有助于更细致地理解创新话语、殖民性以及当今主导许多全球南方国家发展政策和实践的论述。

records.title_en: After war ends: Aid paradigms and post-conflict preferences
records.title_cn: 战争结束后：援助范式和冲突后偏好
records.abstract_en: This article is interested in aid preferences, or what people desire in terms of aid, in a post-conflict and post peace accord context. When examining post-conflict preferences around peace thirty years after the war in Bosnia and Herzegovina, we observe less of an emphasis on transitional justice or security-related needs and more concrete demands for traditional development-related needs such as infrastructure, jobs, improvement of public spaces and business. Using extensive and systematically collected community-generated data, we show a widespread diversity of needs and priorities related to peace depending on people’s gender, age, ethnicity or nationality and location. This diversity points to the need for peace programming that is multi-modal, flexible, and able to recognize different timelines. This is significant in that Bosnia and Herzegovina has experienced very substantial international peace support and reconciliation assistance over the past three decades, but citizens are anxious to move on and return to ‘normal.’ The research suggests a fatigue with post-conflict contexts being perennially linked to a ‘post-war’ or ‘post-conflict’ status and thus serves as a guide for future international support decades after war has ended.
records.abstract_cn: 本文感兴趣的是在冲突后和和平协议后背景下的援助偏好，或者人们对援助的期望。在审视波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那战后三十年后冲突后对和平的偏好时，我们发现，对过渡时期司法或安全相关需求的重视程度较低，而对基础设施、就业、公共空间和商业改善等传统发展相关需求的具体要求则更为具体。利用广泛且系统地收集的社区生成的数据，我们显示了与和平相关的需求和优先事项的广泛多样性，具体取决于人们的性别、年龄、种族或国籍和地点。这种多样性表明和平规划需要多模式、灵活且能够识别不同的时间表。这一点意义重大，因为波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那在过去三十年中经历了非常大量的国际和平支持与和解援助，但公民渴望继续前进并恢复“正常”。这项研究表明，对冲突后环境的疲劳始终与“战后”或“冲突后”状态联系在一起，因此可以作为战争结束几十年后未来国际支持的指南。

records.title_en: Impact of civil conflict on household energy choices: Implications for the clean energy transition
records.title_cn: 内战冲突对家庭能源选择的影响：对清洁能源转型的启示
records.abstract_en: Achieving universal access to clean energy requires a transition from high-carbon-intensive fuels to less carbon-intensive options. However, several factors can prevent countries and households from reaching this goal. One such barrier is the impact of civil conflict on households’ clean energy choices. This study looks at how Nepal’s decade-long civil conflict between 1996 and 2006 affected household access to clean lighting and cooking fuels. Our findings show that higher levels of conflict intensity decrease the likelihood of households having access to clean energy sources. Further, we propose household income loss, market and infrastructure destruction, and resource shifts towards defence are possible mechanisms through which conflict affects household clean fuel choices. This result reveals the important, but often overlooked, negative effect of civil conflict on the clean energy transition in developing countries.
records.abstract_cn: 实现普遍获得清洁能源需要从高碳密集型燃料向低碳密集型选项过渡。然而，多种因素可能阻碍国家和家庭实现这一目标。其中一个障碍是内战冲突对家庭清洁能源选择的影响。本研究考察了尼泊尔在1996年至2006年间长达十年的内战冲突如何影响家庭获得清洁照明和烹饪燃料的机会。我们的研究结果表明，冲突强度的提高降低了家庭获得清洁能源来源的可能性。此外，我们提出家庭收入损失、市场和基础设施破坏以及资源向国防转移是冲突影响家庭清洁燃料选择的可能机制。这一结果揭示了内战冲突对发展中国家清洁能源转型的重要但常被忽视的负面影响。

records.title_en: The dynamics of disappearing routine jobs in Chile: An analysis of the link between deroutinisation and informality
records.title_cn: 智利消失的常规工作的动态：去常规化与非正规性之间联系的分析
records.abstract_en: In spite of the growing literature on deroutinisation, little is known about the individual-level patterns underlying the decline of routine jobs and the link with informal employment in middle-income countries. To fill this gap, we analyse the flows of routine workers into and out of formal and informal routine and non-routine occupations over the period 1980–2015 in Chile. Using rich longitudinal data from the Social Protection Survey, we reconstruct individuals’ occupational trajectories by classifying individuals based on their ISCO-88 2-digit level occupations into different states on a monthly basis. We then estimate a series of multilevel competing risk event history models and adopt a decomposition flow approach to study the flows underlying the decline of routine occupations over time. Our findings indicate a process of displacement and occupational downgrading for routine manual workers: workers in routine manual formal employment increasingly become non-employed or use informality as a buffer against job loss, and workers in routine manual informal employment become unemployed or transit to non-routine manual informal occupations. Our decomposition analysis shows that the decline in the share of routine occupations in Chile is mostly accounted for by a decrease in the inflow transition rate from unemployment, coupled with an increase in the outflow transition rates to unemployment. Lastly, we find that, over time, a larger proportion of individuals who were formally employed in RM occupations transit to informal employment after a period of unemployment.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管关于去常规化的文献日益增多，但关于中等收入国家中常规工作下降背后的个体层面模式及其与非正规就业的联系知之甚少。为填补这一空白，我们分析了智利在1980-2015期间常规工人进出正规和非正规常规及非常规职业的流动。利用社会保障调查的丰富纵向数据，我们通过将个体基于其ISCO-88 2位职业分类为不同状态，按月重建个体的职业轨迹。然后，我们估计了一系列多水平竞争风险事件历史模型，并采用分解流动方法来研究常规职业随时间下降背后的流动。我们的发现表明，常规体力工人经历了置换和职业降级过程：正规常规体力就业中的工人越来越多地变为非就业或利用非正规性作为失业缓冲，而非正规常规体力就业中的工人则变为失业或转向非正规非常规体力职业。我们的分解分析显示，智利常规职业份额的下降主要归因于来自失业的流入转换率下降，以及流向失业的流出转换率上升。最后，我们发现，随着时间的推移，更大比例的曾在常规体力职业中正规就业的个体在经历一段失业期后转向非正规就业。

records.title_en: When the State steps down: Reduced police surveillance and gang-related deaths in Brazil
records.title_cn: 当国家退场：巴西警察监控减少与帮派相关死亡
records.abstract_en: Violent crime is prevalent in developing countries, requiring substantial investments in law enforcement. This paper shows how police surveillance is crucial to deterring homicides in violent areas. I investigate the impact of reduced law enforcement on crime by leveraging data on police strikes, violent deaths, victims’ records, and criminal groups. Following a police strike, homicides in Brazilian states increase temporarily by 45%, and 88% of deaths in neighborhoods with many criminal groups are of suspected gang members. My theoretical model describes the mechanism behind increased killings, demonstrating that police strike amplifies the expected gains from gang conflicts and retaliation. This pushes criminals to attack rivals, even when territories are evenly divided.
records.abstract_cn: 暴力犯罪在发展中国家普遍存在，需要大量的执法投入。本文展示了警察监控在遏制暴力地区凶杀案中的关键作用。我利用警察罢工、暴力死亡、受害者记录和犯罪团伙的数据，调查了执法减少对犯罪的影响。在警察罢工后，巴西各州的凶杀案暂时增加了45%，而在犯罪团伙众多的社区中，88%的死亡是疑似帮派成员。我的理论模型描述了杀戮增加背后的机制，表明警察罢工放大了帮派冲突和报复的预期收益。这促使犯罪分子攻击对手，即使领土是平均分配的。

records.title_en: The global distribution of authorship in economics journals
records.title_cn: 经济学期刊作者身份的全球分布
records.abstract_en: We assemble a dataset of the universe of economics and business journal articles published since 1980 to assess differences in the levels and trends of the global distribution of authorship in economics journals and citations by country/region, quality of journal, and fields of specialization. We document striking imbalances. While Western and Northern European authors have made substantial gains, the representation of authors based in low-income countries remains extremely low − an order of magnitude lower than the weight of their countries or regions in the global economy. Fields such as international or development economics where global diversification may have been expected have not experienced much increase in developing country authorship. Developing country representation has risen fastest at journals ranked 100th or lower, while it has barely increased in journals ranked 25th or higher. Regression analyses suggest that articles by developing country authors are far less likely to be published in top journals even when holding constant article quality (as proxied by citation counts). Similar trends are observed in citation patterns, with articles by authors in the U.S. receiving far more citations, and those by authors in developing countries receiving fewer. These results are consistent with a general increase in the relative supply of research in the rest of the world. But they also indicate authors from developing countries remain excluded from the profession’s top-rated journals and that their research receives less attention from other economists.
records.abstract_cn: 我们汇编了一个自1980年以来出版的经济学和商业期刊文章全集数据集，以评估经济学期刊中作者身份全球分布的水平和趋势差异，以及按国家/地区、期刊质量和专业领域划分的引用情况。我们记录了显著的失衡现象。尽管西欧和北欧作者取得了显著进展，但基于低收入国家的作者代表性仍然极低——比其国家或地区在全球经济中的权重低一个数量级。在国际经济学或发展经济学等领域，全球多元化可能被预期出现，但发展中国家的作者身份并未显著增加。发展中国家作者的代表性在排名100或更低的期刊中增长最快，而在排名25或更高的期刊中几乎没有增加。回归分析表明，即使保持文章质量（以引用次数为代理）不变，发展中国家作者的文章在顶级期刊上发表的可能性也远低。在引用模式中也观察到类似趋势，美国作者的文章获得更多引用，而发展中国家作者的文章获得较少引用。这些结果与全球其他地区研究相对供应量的普遍增加一致。但它们也表明，发展中国家作者仍被排除在该领域顶级期刊之外，且他们的研究受到其他经济学家的关注较少。

records.title_en: Disaster and political trust: Evidence from the 2017 Mexico city earthquake
records.title_cn: 灾难与政治信任：来自2017年墨西哥城地震的证据
records.abstract_en: Political trust is foundational to democratic legitimacy, representative governance, and the provision of effective public policy. Various shocks can influence this trust, steering countries onto positive or negative trajectories. This study examines whether natural disasters can impact general political trust and if disaster relief efforts can mitigate these effects. We investigate the relationships between disaster, trust, and aid using novel survey data collected before and after a 7.1-magnitude earthquake struck Mexico City in September 2017. Our findings reveal that the disaster resulted in an 11% decrease in general political trust. Additionally, we demonstrate that geographical proximity to disaster relief efforts may counterbalance this decline in trust. This study contributes to the scholarship on the politics of disasters and offers policy implications, highlighting the role of disaster assistance in potentially restoring general political trust after a disaster.
records.abstract_cn: 政治信任是民主合法性、代议制治理和有效公共政策提供的基础。各种冲击可以影响这种信任，将国家引向积极或消极的轨迹。本研究考察自然灾害是否能影响普遍政治信任，以及灾难救援工作是否能减轻这些影响。我们利用2017年九月墨西哥城发生7.1级地震前后收集的新调查数据，研究了灾难、信任和援助之间的关系。我们的研究结果显示，灾难导致普遍政治信任下降了11%。此外，我们证明，地理上接近灾难救援工作可能抵消这种信任下降。本研究为灾难政治学领域做出了贡献，并提供了政策启示，强调了灾难援助在灾后可能恢复普遍政治信任方面的作用。

records.title_en: Trust, hope, and collective action in fragile political settings: A qualitative comparative analysis of water user groups in Tunisia
records.title_cn: 脆弱政治环境中的信任、希望与集体行动：突尼斯水用户群体的定性比较分析
records.abstract_en: Collective action theory acknowledges that self-governing institutional arrangements, such as water user groups, can successfully develop strategies to address natural resource problems. However, studies of collective action have largely neglected the role of social, political and/or ecological fragility, where institutional trust and hope may have been eroded over time, and where natural resources are severely depleted. This paper uses Qualitative Comparative Analysis (QCA) to examine the pathways that mediate the multi-faceted relationship between trust, hope, and collective action in the context of water user groups, addressing resource scarcity challenges in post-authoritarian Tunisia. The analyses are based on data from archival sources, key informant interviews, hydrogeological models, local inventories, and semi-structured interviews with members of 15 local water user groups in the Tunisian governorate of Kairouan. Results from Qualitative Comparative Analyses shed light on dynamics of trust and hope as well as the substitutability of shared norms under given ecological conditions. Results demonstrate that water users see social trust-based systems as an alternative to the coercive power of the state. Specifically we find that: (1) social cohesion and the expectation that other water users stick to local, often informal, rules were found to increase collective action, i.e. fee recovery, under systemic fragility; (2) resource scarcity, i.e. aquifer depletion, can serve as a driver of both conflict as well as cooperation, depending on conjoint social-ecological interactions; and, finally, (3) conflict is more frequently associated with low-hope environments, where users are unable to perceive the possibility of positive system change. These insights seek to inform more realistic policy reforms that are sensitive to a fragile water governance system prone to social unrest.
records.abstract_cn: 集体行动理论承认，自我治理的制度安排，如水用户群体，能够成功制定策略以应对自然资源问题。然而，集体行动的研究在很大程度上忽视了社会、政治和/或生态脆弱性的作用，在这些环境中，制度信任和希望可能随时间推移而受到侵蚀，自然资源也严重枯竭。本文使用定性比较分析（QCA）来考察在突尼斯后威权背景下，水用户群体应对资源稀缺挑战时，信任、希望与集体行动之间多方面关系的路径。分析基于档案资料、关键知情人访谈、水文地质模型、地方清单以及对突尼斯凯鲁万省15个地方水用户群体成员进行的半结构化访谈数据。定性比较分析的结果揭示了信任和希望的动态，以及在特定生态条件下共享规范的可替代性。结果表明，水用户将基于社会信任的系统视为国家强制权力的替代方案。具体而言，我们发现：(1)社会凝聚力以及其他水用户遵守地方（通常是非正式）规则的期望，在系统性脆弱性下增加了集体行动，即费用回收；(2)资源稀缺，即含水层枯竭，可以成为冲突和合作的驱动因素，取决于联合的社会-生态互动；最后，(3)冲突更频繁地与低希望环境相关，在这种环境中，用户无法感知系统积极变化的可能性。这些见解旨在为更现实的政策改革提供信息，这些改革对易受社会动荡影响的脆弱水治理系统保持敏感。

records.title_en: A social network analysis of family and community conflicts in post-civil war Mozambique
records.title_cn: 莫桑比克内战后家庭和社区冲突的社会网络分析
records.abstract_en: The existing literature on post-civil war processes has inadequately addressed the diversity of challenges of social reconstruction and community development arising from the fragmentation of cultural practices informing the creation and maintenance of family and social networks, and a variety of locally specific risks impacting the lives of survivors and subsequent generations. This paper addresses this gap by empirically investigating how unresolved legacies of Mozambique’s civil war (1976–1992) have fueled a network of local problems in the Gorongosa district. We used network analysis of cases presented in community courts over a decade (2002–2012) to reveal the existence of entrenched disputes involving spouses, divorce cases, domestic violence incidents, financial debts, accusations of wartime violations, and a range of adverse wellbeing outcomes. The conflicts and relationship dynamics vary in intensity over time but remain closely linked to civil war-induced risks, such as disrupted practices of premature marriages and interpersonal mistrust. Taking together these results reinforce the need to address disrupted patterns of family relations, lingering accusations of wartime violations, and to enhance the capacity of local community institutions and courts as part of social reconstruction efforts and development goals.
records.abstract_cn: 关于内战后进程的现有文献没有充分解决社会重建和社区发展所面临的各种挑战，这些挑战是由于家庭和社会网络的创建和维持的文化习俗的碎片化而产生的，以及影响幸存者和后代生活的各种当地特定风险。本文通过实证调查莫桑比克内战（1976-1992）未解决的遗留问题如何助长戈龙戈萨地区的当地问题网络来解决这一差距。我们对十多年来（2002-2012）社区法院审理的案件进行网络分析，揭示了涉及配偶、离婚案件、家庭暴力事件、金融债务、战时违法行为指控以及一系列不利福祉结果的根深蒂固的纠纷的存在。随着时间的推移，冲突和关系动态的强度有所不同，但仍然与内战引发的风险密切相关，例如早婚行为的破坏和人际不信任。综合这些结果，我们更加需要解决家庭关系被破坏的模式、对战时侵犯行为的持续指控，以及增强当地社区机构和法院的能力，作为社会重建工作和发展目标的一部分。

records.title_en: Curse of low-skilled emigration on human capital formation: Evidence from the migration surge of the 2000s
records.title_cn: 低技能移民外流对人力资本形成的诅咒：来自2000年代移民潮的证据
records.abstract_en: Low-skilled emigration is generally construed as benign and even beneficial for the migrant-sending countries. However, it can also lead to a disincentive effect on human capital formation in the source countries. Using a panel bilateral migration dataset that captures the surge of low-skill migrants in OECD countries in the 2000s, we study how low-skilled emigration affects human capital formation in the migrant-sending countries. We find that the expected returns to low-skilled emigration reduce long-run human capital formation as measured by the average years of schooling and the human capital index of the migrant-sending countries in the subsequent decade. This negative effect on overall human capital formation is manifested through a substantial reduction in tertiary educational attainment, which is both statistically significant and robust to various sensitivity tests and alternative model specifications. Additionally, there is some evidence of a positive association between the expected returns to low-skilled emigration and secondary educational attainment in the subsequent decade. An important qualification is that only middle- and high-income countries are strongly affected by low-skilled emigration, while low-income countries show little to no disincentive effect.
records.abstract_cn: 低技能移民外流通常被视为对移民输出国无害甚至有益。然而，它也可能对来源国的人力资本形成产生抑制效应。利用一个捕捉2000年代OECD国家低技能移民激增的面板双边移民数据集，我们研究了低技能移民外流如何影响移民输出国的人力资本形成。我们发现，低技能移民外流的预期回报降低了长期人力资本形成，这一效应通过移民输出国随后十年的平均受教育年限和人力资本指数来衡量。这种对整体人力资本形成的负面影响表现为高等教育入学率的显著下降，该结果在统计上显著，并且对各种敏感性测试和替代模型设定均保持稳健。此外，有证据表明低技能移民外流的预期回报与随后十年的中等教育入学率之间存在正相关关系。一个重要的限定条件是，只有中等收入和高收入国家受到低技能移民外流的强烈影响，而低收入国家几乎没有表现出抑制效应。

records.title_en: The transfer of employment structure: Export expansion and the rise of lower-middle-skill occupations in China
records.title_cn: 就业结构的转移：出口扩张与中国中低技能职业的兴起
records.abstract_en: Job polarization is common in advanced countries due to routine-biased technological changes and globalization. In developing countries, however, the employment structure is left unexplored. This research finds that China has witnessed a reverse trend in the employment structure since 2000. In particular, job counter-polarization was seen due to the disproportionate rise in lower-middle-skill occupations. Further study provides evidence that export expansion increases the employment share of lower-middle-skill occupations. Mechanism analysis shows that export expansion increases routine-tasks intensive occupations, which are also lower-middle-skill occupations. This paper provides new insights into occupational structure based on typical facts in China and examines the hypotheses of routine-biased technological change and globalization from a novel perspective.
records.abstract_cn: 工作极化在发达国家中因常规偏向的技术变革和全球化而普遍存在。然而，在发展中国家中，就业结构尚未被充分探索。本研究发现在2000年以来，中国的就业结构呈现出相反的趋势。特别是，由于中低技能职业的不成比例增长，出现了工作逆极化现象。进一步的研究提供证据表明，出口扩张增加了中低技能职业的就业份额。机制分析显示，出口扩张增加了常规任务密集型职业，这些职业也属于中低技能职业。本文基于中国的典型事实为职业结构提供了新的见解，并从新颖的角度检验了常规偏向技术变革和全球化的假设。

records.title_en: Climate change, collective shocks, and intra-community cooperation: Evidence from a public good experiment with farmers and pastoralists
records.title_cn: 气候变化、集体冲击与社区内合作：来自农民和牧民公共品实验的证据
records.abstract_en: Scholars and practitioners have long debated the effects of climate change on conflict, and more specifically on its precursors and constituent elements, such as (un)cooperative behavior. While harshening conditions linked to climate change carry collective risks that simultaneously affect whole communities and societies, the underlying conditions and responses might differ between groups and affect cooperative outcomes. In this paper, we explore whether collective and individual shocks undermine or enhance cooperation within farming and pastoral communities in the increasingly difficult conditions of the Sahel. We conducted a lab-in-the-field experiment based on a public good game in a farming area and pastoral area in Senegal. This study finds that (i) on average, pastoralists show higher levels of cooperation compared to farmers, (ii) overall, collective shocks decrease cooperation, while individual shocks increase cooperation, and (iii) effects of individual versus collective shocks are only significant for pastoralists but not for farmers. We suggest that individual shocks lead to more cooperation due to risk-sharing mechanisms, while collective shocks reduce cooperation due to risk aversion. Pastoralists’ higher cooperation levels may be attributed to lower market integration, stronger reliance on social and trading networks, and greater prior exposure to collective risks. These results suggest that risk perceptions and contextual factors, in addition to the nature of the shock, influence responses to climate change. Pastoral areas, while more vulnerable to collective shocks, may also have greater potential for public good provision, which could serve as a potential entry point for climate change adaptation.
records.abstract_cn: 学者和实践者长期以来一直在争论气候变化对冲突的影响，特别是对其前兆和构成要素，如（不）合作行为的影响。虽然与气候变化相关的日益严酷的条件带来了同时影响整个社区和社会的集体风险，但潜在的状况和反应可能在不同群体之间存在差异，并影响合作结果。在本文中，我们探讨了在萨赫勒地区日益困难的条件下，集体和个人冲击是否削弱或增强了农业和牧业社区内的合作。我们在塞内加尔的一个农业区和牧区进行了一项基于公共品博弈的实地实验。本研究发现：（i）平均而言，牧民表现出比农民更高的合作水平；（ii）总体而言，集体冲击降低了合作，而个人冲击增加了合作；（iii）个人冲击与集体冲击的影响仅对牧民显著，对农民则不显著。我们认为，个人冲击通过风险分担机制导致更多合作，而集体冲击因风险规避而减少合作。牧民较高的合作水平可能归因于较低的市场整合程度、对社会和贸易网络的更强依赖，以及先前对集体风险的更大暴露。这些结果表明，风险认知和情境因素，以及冲击的性质，影响了对气候变化的反应。牧区虽然更容易受到集体冲击的影响，但也可能具有更大的公共品供给潜力，这可以作为气候变化适应的潜在切入点。

records.title_en: From development to dependency in Latin America. A critical stance on Argentina’s developmentalist experiences
records.title_cn: 从发展到依附：对阿根廷发展主义经验的批判性立场
records.abstract_en: This article evaluates the potential and limits of developmentalist policies in Latin America. It first traces how the ideas arose in a uniquely Latin American context of ECLAC structuralism and debates on dependence and how these ideas, transformed through neoliberalism, brought life to new developmentalism during the pink tide of the 2000s. Second, it evaluates the tradition’s practical and theoretical strengths and limits from the perspective of Latin American Marxist dependency theory. In this case, the analysis includes the canonical debates within the Marxist dependency theory and reflections based on new debates on value, state, feminist and ecological Marxism.
records.abstract_cn: 本文评估了拉丁美洲发展主义政策的潜力与局限。首先追溯了这些思想如何在拉美独特的ECLAC结构主义和依附争论背景下产生，以及这些思想如何通过新自由主义转型，在2000年代的粉红浪潮中催生了新发展主义。其次，从拉丁美洲马克思主义依附理论的角度，评估了这一传统的实践和理论优势与局限。在此情况下，分析包括马克思主义依附理论内部的经典辩论，以及基于价值、国家、女权主义和生态马克思主义新辩论的反思。

records.title_en: Private sunspots in games of coordinated attack
records.title_cn: 协调攻击博弈中的私人太阳黑子
records.abstract_en: I endogenize the probability of self‐fulfilling outcomes in a game where the only uncertainty comes from extrinsic sunspots. There is a group of players wishing to coordinate on the same action and another player—the regime defender—whose action affects the payoff from coordination. The coordinating players' actions can be based on a sunspot state, which, unlike in the classic sunspot approach, is observed with a small, idiosyncratic noise (a private sunspot). I show how private sunspots, combined with the action of the regime defender, can be used to derive a unique coordination probability in any equilibrium where sunspots influence actions. I show how this approach can be used to determine the probability of a sunspot‐driven bank run.
records.abstract_cn: 我在一个唯一不确定性来自外在太阳黑子的博弈中内生化了自我实现结果的可能性。有一组玩家希望协调同一行动，另一个玩家——政权捍卫者——其行动影响协调的收益。协调玩家的行动可以基于一个太阳黑子状态，与经典太阳黑子方法不同，该状态是通过一个小的、特质性噪声（私人太阳黑子）观察到的。我展示了在太阳黑子影响行动的任一均衡中，私人太阳黑子如何与政权捍卫者的行动相结合，用来推导出唯一的协调概率。我展示了如何用这种方法确定太阳黑子驱动的银行挤兑的概率。

records.title_en: Adoption epidemics and viral marketing
records.title_cn: 采纳的流行与病毒式营销
records.abstract_en: An innovation (e.g., new product or idea) spreads like a virus, transmitted by those who have previously adopted it. Agents update their beliefs about innovation quality based on private signals and when they hear about the innovation. We characterize equilibrium adoption dynamics and the resulting lifecycle of virally‐spread innovations. Herding on adoption can occur but only early in the innovation lifecycle, and adoption eventually ceases for all virally‐spread innovations. A producer capable of advertising directly to consumers finds it optimal to wait and allow awareness to grow virally initially after launch.
records.abstract_cn: 一项创新（例如新产品或新想法）像病毒一样传播，由先前采纳它的人传播。行为人根据私人信号以及他们何时听说该创新来更新其对创新质量的信念。我们刻画了均衡采纳动态以及由此产生的病毒式传播创新的生命周期。采纳中的羊群行为可能发生，但仅限于创新生命周期的早期，并且所有病毒式传播创新的采纳最终都会停止。一个能够直接向消费者做广告的生产者发现，最优的做法是等待，并在发布后的最初阶段让知晓度以病毒式方式增长。

records.title_en: Efficient and strategy‐proof mechanism under general constraints
records.title_cn: 一般约束下的高效且防策略机制
records.abstract_en: This study investigates efficient and strategy‐proof mechanisms for allocating indivisible goods under constraints. First, we examine a setting without endowments. In this setting, we introduce a class of constraints—ordered accessibility—for which the serial dictatorship (SD) mechanism is Pareto‐efficient (PE), individually rational (IR), and group strategy‐proof (GSP). Then we prove that accessibility is a necessary condition for the existence of PE, IR, and GSP mechanisms. Moreover, we show an example where the SD mechanism with a dynamically constructed order satisfies PE, IR, and GSP if one school has an arbitrary accessible constraint and each of the other schools has a capacity constraint. Second, we examine a setting with endowments. We find that the generalized matroid is a necessary and sufficient condition on the constraint structure for the existence of a mechanism that is PE, IR, and strategy‐proof. We also demonstrate that a top trading cycles mechanism satisfies PE, IR, and GSP under any generalized matroid constraint. Finally, we observe that any two out of the three properties—PE, IR, and GSP—can be achieved under general constraints.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察在约束条件下分配不可分割物品的高效且防策略机制。首先，我们研究没有初始禀赋的情形。在该情形下，我们引入一类约束——有序可达性——对于该约束，序列独裁（SD）机制是帕累托有效（PE）、个体理性（IR）且群体防策略（GSP）的。然后我们证明可达性是存在PE、IR和GSP机制的必要条件。此外，我们展示了一个例子：如果一所学校具有任意可达约束，且其他每所学校具有容量约束，则采用动态构建顺序的SD机制满足PE、IR和GSP。其次，我们研究具有初始禀赋的情形。我们发现广义拟阵是约束结构上存在满足PE、IR且防策略的机制的必要且充分条件。我们还证明，在任何广义拟阵约束下，顶层交易循环机制满足PE、IR和GSP。最后，我们观察到在一般约束下，PE、IR和GSP这三个性质中的任意两个都可以实现。

records.title_en: To infinity and beyond: A general framework for scaling economic theories
records.title_cn: 到无限及更远：扩展经济理论的一般框架
records.abstract_en: Many economic models incorporate finiteness assumptions that, while introduced for simplicity, play a real role in the analysis. We provide a principled framework for scaling results from such models by removing these finiteness assumptions. Our sufficient conditions are on the theorem statement only, and not on its proof. This results in short proofs, and even allows us to use the same argument to scale similar theorems that were proven using distinctly different tools. We demonstrate the versatility of our approach via an array of examples from revealed‐preference theory.
records.abstract_cn: 许多经济模型包含有限性假设，这些假设虽然是为了简化而引入，但在分析中起着实际作用。我们提供了一个有原则的框架，通过去除这些有限性假设来扩展此类模型的结果。我们的充分条件仅针对定理陈述，而不针对其证明。这导致证明简短，甚至允许我们使用相同的论证来扩展那些使用截然不同工具证明的类似定理。我们通过显示性偏好理论中的一系列例子展示了我们方法的通用性。

records.title_en: Optimal taxation with multiple incomes and types
records.title_cn: 多种收入与多种类型下的最优税收
records.abstract_en: We analyze the optimal nonlinear income tax schedule for taxpayers with multiple incomes and multiple unobserved characteristics. We identify smoothness assumptions and extensions of the single crossing conditions that enable the characterization of the optimum through variational calculus. Both the tax perturbation and mechanism design approaches yield identical results when the number of incomes equals the number of unobserved characteristics. Notably, the mechanism design approach requires slightly less stringent assumptions than the tax perturbation approach. Additionally, we introduce a numerical method to determine the optimal tax schedule. Applied to couples, the optimal isotax curves are nearly linear and parallel. Additional contributions include a Pareto efficiency test and a condition on primitives ensuring the sufficiency of the government's necessary conditions, thereby guaranteeing the uniqueness of the solution.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了针对具有多种收入和多种不可观测特征的纳税人的最优非线性所得税表。我们确定了光滑性假设和单交叉条件的扩展，使得能够通过变分法刻画最优解。当收入数量等于不可观测特征数量时，税收扰动法和机制设计法得出相同结果。值得注意的是，机制设计法所需的假设比税收扰动法略少。此外，我们引入了一种数值方法来确定最优税收表。应用于夫妻时，最优等税曲线几乎是线性的且相互平行。其他贡献包括帕累托效率检验和一个关于原始条件的条件，该条件确保政府必要条件的充分性，从而保证解的唯一性。

records.title_en: Random utility coordination games on networks
records.title_cn: 网络上的随机效用协调博弈
records.abstract_en: We study static binary coordination games with random utility played on networks. In equilibrium, each agent chooses an action only if a fraction of her neighbors choosing the same action is higher than an agent‐specific i.i.d. threshold. A fuzzy convention x is a profile where (almost) all agents choose the high action if their threshold is smaller than x and the low action otherwise. The random‐utility (RU) dominant outcome x * is a maximizer of an integral of the distribution of thresholds. The definition generalizes Harsanyi–Selten's risk dominance to coordination games with random utility. We show that, on each sufficiently large and fine network, there is an equilibrium that is a fuzzy convention x * . On some networks, including a city network, all equilibria are fuzzy conventions x * . Finally, fuzzy conventions x * are the only behavior that is robust to misspecification of the network structure.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究在网络上进行的具有随机效用的静态二元协调博弈。在均衡中，每个代理人选择某一行动，仅当她的邻居中选择相同行动的比例高于一个代理人特定的独立同分布阈值。一个模糊惯例 x 是一个概况，其中（几乎）所有代理人如果其阈值小于 x 则选择高行动，否则选择低行动。随机效用（RU）支配结果 x * 是阈值分布积分的一个最大化者。该定义将 Harsanyi–Selten 的风险占优推广到具有随机效用的协调博弈。我们证明，在每个足够大且足够细的网络上，存在一个均衡，它是一个模糊惯例 x *。在某些网络上，包括城市网络，所有均衡都是模糊惯例 x *。最后，模糊惯例 x * 是唯一对网络结构的误设具有稳健性的行为。

records.title_en: Queueing to learn
records.title_cn: 排队以学习
records.abstract_en: I study the efficient design of a queue to dynamically allocate a scarce resource to long‐lived agents. Agents can be served multiple times, and their valuations fluctuate over time with some persistence. Each agent privately learns whether his prevailing valuation is high or low only when served. An agent can decide anytime whether to either join a queue of his choice or renege. I show that it is efficient to elicit agents' private information by offering a simple binary menu (i.e., two customer classes): a first‐come, first‐served queue, to attract low‐value agents, and one in random order, to attract high‐value agents. When queueing is costly, offering a single queue may be optimal because of the tradeoff between allocative efficiency and the cost of screening.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了一个队列的有效设计，以将稀缺资源动态分配给长寿的代理人。代理人可以被多次服务，他们的估值随时间波动并具有一定持续性。代理人只有在被服务时才私下得知他当前估值是高还是低。代理人可以随时决定是加入他选择的队列还是退出。我表明，通过提供一个简单的二元菜单（即两类顾客）来诱导代理人的私人信息是有效的：一个先到先服务的队列，用于吸引低价值代理人；另一个随机顺序的队列，用于吸引高价值代理人。当排队成本高昂时，由于配置效率与筛选成本之间的权衡，提供单一队列可能是最优的。

records.title_en: Games with information constraints: Seeds and spillovers
records.title_cn: 信息约束下的博弈：种子与溢出
records.abstract_en: We study equilibrium behavior in incomplete‐information games under two information constraints: seeds and spillovers. The former restricts which agents can initially receive information. The latter specifies how this information spills over to other agents. Our main result characterizes the equilibrium outcomes under these constraints, without making additional assumptions about the agents' initial information. This involves deriving a “revelation‐principle” result for settings in which a mediator cannot communicate directly or privately with the agents. Our model identifies which spillovers are more restrictive and which seeds are more impactful. We apply our results to a problem of optimal organization design.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了不完全信息博弈在两种信息约束下的均衡行为：种子与溢出。前者限制哪些参与者最初能接收信息。后者规定了这些信息如何溢出到其他参与者。我们的主要结果刻画了这些约束下的均衡结果，而不需要对参与者的初始信息做额外假设。这涉及推导出一个“揭示原理”结果，适用于中介无法直接或私下与参与者沟通的设定。我们的模型识别了哪些溢出更具限制性，哪些种子更具影响力。我们将我们的结果应用于最优组织设计问题。

records.title_en: An analytical model of search and bargaining with divisible money
records.title_cn: 可分割货币下搜索与议价的分析模型
records.abstract_en: We propose a standard search and bargaining model with divisible money, in which only the random matching market opens and the generalized Nash bargaining settles each trade. Assuming fixed production costs, we analytically characterize a tractable equilibrium, called a pay‐all equilibrium , and prove its existence. Each buyer pays all the money holding as a corner solution to the bargaining problem and each seller produces a positive amount of goods as an interior solution. The bargaining power parameter affects the distribution of the money holdings and possibly induces economic inefficiency. We propose a redistributional monetary transfer that adjusts the bargaining outcome and improves the allocation efficiency. Moreover, we analyze a temporary expansion of the money supply that increases social welfare through a redistribution.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个具有可分割货币的标准搜索与议价模型，其中只有随机匹配市场开放，并且广义纳什议价解决每笔交易。假设固定生产成本，我们解析地刻画了一个易于处理的均衡，称为全额支付均衡，并证明其存在性。每个买方支付其全部货币持有，作为议价问题的角点解，而每个卖方生产正数量的商品，作为内点解。议价能力参数影响货币持有的分布，并可能引致经济无效率。我们提出一种再分配性的货币转移，调整议价结果并提高配置效率。此外，我们分析了货币供给的暂时扩张，通过再分配提高社会福利。

records.title_en: Adversarial coordination and public information design
records.title_cn: 对抗性协调与公共信息设计
records.abstract_en: We study flexible public information design in global games. In addition to receiving public information from the designer, agents are endowed with exogenous private information and must decide between two actions (invest and not invest), the profitability of which depends on unknown fundamentals and the agents' aggregate action. The designer does not trust the agents to play favorably to her and evaluates any policy under the “worst‐case scenario.” First, we show that the optimal policy removes any strategic uncertainty by inducing all agents to take the same action, but without permitting them to perfectly learn the fundamentals and/or the beliefs that rationalize other agents' actions. Second, we identify conditions under which the optimal policy is a simple “pass/fail” test. Finally, we show that when the designer cares only about the probability the aggregate investment is successful, the optimal policy need not be monotone in fundamentals but then identify conditions on payoffs and exogenous beliefs under which the optimal policy is monotone.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究全局博弈中的灵活公共信息设计。除了接收设计者提供的公共信息外，代理人还拥有外生的私人信息，并且必须在两种行动（投资和不投资）之间做出选择，这两种行动的盈利能力取决于未知的基本面和代理人的总体行动。设计者不信任代理人会以对她有利的方式行动，并在“最坏情形”下评估任何政策。首先，我们表明最优政策通过诱导所有代理人采取相同行动来消除任何策略不确定性，但不允许他们完全了解基本面和/或使其他代理人行动合理化的信念。其次，我们确定了最优政策是简单“通过/不通过”测试的条件。最后，我们表明，当设计者只关心总体投资成功的概率时，最优政策不必在基本面中是单调的，但随后我们确定了在收益和外生信念下最优政策是单调的条件。

records.title_en: The Impact of the Opioid Crisis on Firm Value and Investment
records.title_cn: 阿片类药物危机对企业价值与投资的影响
records.abstract_en: We show a negative effect of opioid prescriptions on subsequent individual employment among employers in our sample using doctor-opioid-prescribing propensity as our instrument. This finding has implications for firms that must now contend with lower local labor supply. We find a negative relationship between opioid prescriptions and subsequent establishment growth. However, firms respond to labor shortages by investing more in technology, replacing the relatively scarcer labor with capital, especially when they are not financially constrained. We find positive abnormal returns, upon the passage of state laws intended to limit opioid prescriptions, that are driven by firms more reliant on labor.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用医生阿片类药物处方倾向作为工具变量，展示了在我们的样本中，阿片类药物处方对雇主中后续个人就业的负面影响。这一发现对必须应对当地劳动力供应减少的企业具有重要意义。我们发现阿片类药物处方与后续企业建立增长之间存在负相关关系。然而，企业通过增加技术投资来应对劳动力短缺，用资本替代相对稀缺的劳动力，尤其是在它们没有财务约束的情况下。我们发现，在旨在限制阿片类药物处方的州法律通过后，出现了正向的异常回报，这主要由更依赖劳动力的企业驱动。

records.title_en: Build or Buy? Human Capital and Corporate Diversification
records.title_cn: 自建还是并购？人力资本与企业多元化
records.abstract_en: Firms enter new sectors by either building on their resources or buying existing companies. Using French administrative data, we propose a measure of human capital distance between a firm and a sector of entry. Using a shift-share instrument, we show that firms build in close sectors and buy in distant sectors in terms of human capital distance. Firms build by hiring new workers, which becomes increasingly costly in distant sectors as it requires not only hiring more workers but also having more organizational capital to integrate these workers. Hence, firms buy in distant sectors to acquire already operational human capital.
records.abstract_cn: 企业进入新行业时，要么依托自身资源进行自建，要么通过并购现有公司。利用法国行政数据，我们提出了一个衡量企业与进入行业之间人力资本距离的指标。通过使用偏移-份额工具变量，我们发现在人力资本距离较近的行业，企业倾向于自建；而在距离较远的行业，企业倾向于并购。企业通过招聘新员工进行自建，这在距离较远的行业成本日益增加，因为这不仅需要招聘更多员工，还需要拥有更多的组织资本来整合这些员工。因此，企业在距离较远的行业选择并购，以获取已经运作成熟的人力资本。

records.title_en: Financing Infrastructure in the Shadow of Expropriation
records.title_cn: 征用阴影下的基础设施融资
records.abstract_en: We examine the optimal financing of infrastructure when governments can expropriate rents from private sector firms that manage infrastructure. While private firms need incentives to implement projects well, governments need incentives to limit expropriation. This double moral hazard limits the willingness of outside investors to fund infrastructure projects. Optimal financing contracts involve government guarantees to investors against project failure to incentivize the government to agree not to expropriate, thus improving private sector incentives and project quality. The contract also reflects several other features prevalent in infrastructure financing in practice, among which are government coinvestment, tax subsidies, and development rights.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了当政府能够从管理基础设施的私营部门企业中征用租金时，基础设施的最优融资问题。虽然私营企业需要激励以良好地实施项目，但政府也需要激励以限制征用行为。这种双重道德风险限制了外部投资者为基础设施项目提供资金的意愿。最优融资合同涉及政府向投资者提供针对项目失败的担保，以激励政府同意不进行征用，从而改善私营部门的激励和项目质量。该合同还反映了基础设施融资实践中普遍存在的其他几个特征，其中包括政府共同投资、税收补贴和开发权。

records.title_en: The Shadow Cost of Collateral
records.title_cn: 抵押品的影子成本
records.abstract_en: We quantify the cost of pledging collateral for small businesses by exploiting a regulatory quirk of the SBA disaster lending program in which firms are exempt from posting collateral if their loan size is below a threshold. Firms bunch their loans below the threshold, and the resultant distortion in the loan size distribution reveals the magnitude of the collateral cost. The collateral cost is substantial and varies across collateral types, business sectors, and collateral laws in ways consistent with flexibility-based theories. Our findings have implications for firms’ borrowing constraints and disaster lending program designs.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过利用小企业管理局灾难贷款计划中的一个监管怪癖来量化小企业提供抵押品的成本，在该计划中，如果贷款规模低于阈值，企业可免于提供抵押品。企业将贷款集中在阈值以下，贷款规模分布中的这种扭曲揭示了抵押品成本的大小。抵押品成本相当可观，并且随抵押品类型、商业部门和抵押品法律的不同而变化，这与基于灵活性的理论相一致。我们的发现对企业借款约束和灾难贷款计划设计具有启示意义。

records.title_en: Cross-Subsidization of Bad Credit in a Lending Crisis
records.title_cn: 信贷危机中不良信贷的交叉补贴
records.abstract_en: We study the corporate-loan pricing decisions of a major, systemic bank during the Greek financial crisis. A unique aspect of our data set is that we observe both the actual interest rate and the “break-even rate” (BE rate) of each loan, as computed by the bank’s own loan-pricing department (in effect, the loan’s marginal cost). We document that low-BE-rate (safer) borrowers are charged significant markups, whereas high-BE-rate (riskier) borrowers are charged smaller and even negative markups. We rationalize this de facto cross-subsidization through the lens of a dynamic model featuring depressed collateral values, impaired capital-market access, and limit pricing.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了希腊金融危机期间一家主要系统性银行的企业贷款定价决策。我们数据集的一个独特之处在于，我们观察到了每笔贷款的实际利率和“盈亏平衡利率”（BE利率），后者由银行自身的贷款定价部门计算（实际上相当于贷款的边际成本）。我们记录了低BE利率（较安全）借款人被收取显著加价，而高BE利率（较风险）借款人被收取较小甚至负加价的情况。我们通过一个包含抵押品价值低迷、资本市场准入受损和限制性定价的动态模型，将这种事实上的交叉补贴合理化。

records.title_en: Effects of Credit Expansions on Stock Market Booms and Busts
records.title_cn: 信贷扩张对股市繁荣与萧条的影响
records.abstract_en: There is causal evidence that mortgage credit expansions increase house prices. Does an expansion of margin lending increase stock prices? Because unconstrained arbitrageurs are more important for pricing stocks than homes, the impact is not obvious. Tests are limited because sizable shocks to margin lending are rare. We examine a major Chinese margin-lending expansion between 2010 and 2015. Institutional holding, regression discontinuity, and event study evidence—exploiting the rollout of margin lending across stocks—shows that arbitrageurs anticipated and bought in advance of a significant causal effect of credit. We develop a model to rationalize our findings. Our estimates suggest that margin debt contributes to stock market fluctuations.
records.abstract_cn: 有因果证据表明，抵押信贷扩张会推高房价。保证金贷款扩张是否会推高股价？由于不受约束的套利者对于股票定价的重要性高于住房，其影响并不明显。由于保证金贷款的大规模冲击较为罕见，相关检验受到限制。我们考察了2010年至2015年间中国一次重大的保证金贷款扩张。利用保证金贷款在股票间的逐步推广，基于机构持股、断点回归和事件研究的证据显示，套利者预期到信贷的显著因果效应并提前买入。我们构建了一个模型来解释我们的发现。我们的估计表明，保证金债务对股市波动有所贡献。

records.title_en: Macroprudential Regulation, Quantitative Easing, and Bank Lending
records.title_cn: 宏观审慎监管、量化宽松与银行信贷
records.abstract_en: We show that widely used macroprudential regulations that rely on historical cost accounting (HCA) to insulate banks’ balance sheets from financial market volatility significantly affect the transmission of monetary policy onto bank lending. Using detailed supervisory data from Italian banks, we find that HCA mutes the transmission of quantitative easing and other monetary policies that affect the long end of the yield curve, weakening the effectiveness of interventions aimed at reducing firm credit constraints. We suggest alternative policies that have the benefits of HCA but allow monetary policy to pass through.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，广泛使用的宏观审慎监管依赖于历史成本会计（HCA）来隔离银行资产负债表免受金融市场波动的影响，这显著影响了货币政策向银行信贷的传导。利用意大利银行的详细监管数据，我们发现HCA抑制了量化宽松及其他影响收益率曲线长端的货币政策的传导，削弱了旨在缓解企业信贷约束的干预措施的有效性。我们提出了替代政策，这些政策具有HCA的优点，但允许货币政策传导。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Factorial Designs, Model Selection, and (Incorrect) Inference in Randomized Experiments
records.title_cn: 因子设计、模型选择与随机实验中的（错误）推断
records.abstract_en: Factorial designs are widely used to study multiple treatments in one experiment. Although t-tests using a fully saturated “long” model provide valid inferences, “short” model t-tests (that ignore interactions) yield higher power if interactions are zero, but incorrect inferences otherwise. Of 27 factorial experiments published in top-five journals (2007–2017), nineteen use the short model. After including interactions, more than half of their results lose significance. Based on recent econometric advances, we show that power improvements over the long model are possible. We provide practical guidance for the design of new experiments and the analysis of completed experiments.
records.abstract_cn: 因子设计广泛用于在单一实验中研究多种处理。尽管使用完全饱和的“长”模型的t检验提供了有效的推断，但“短”模型的t检验（忽略交互作用）在交互作用为零时具有更高的功效，否则会产生错误的推断。在发表于五大顶级期刊的27项因子实验中（2007-2017），有十九项使用了短模型。在加入交互作用后，超过一半的结果失去了显著性。基于最近的计量经济学进展，我们表明相对于长模型，功效改进是可能的。我们为新实验的设计和已完成实验的分析提供了实用指导。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Inaccurate Statistical Discrimination: An Identification Problem
records.title_cn: 不准确的统计歧视：一个识别问题
records.abstract_en: We study inaccurate beliefs as a source of discrimination. Economists typically characterize discrimination as stemming from a taste-based (preference) or accurate statistical (belief-based) source. Although individuals may have inaccurate beliefs about how relevant characteristics (e.g., productivity, signals) are correlated with group identity, fewer than 7% of empirical discrimination papers in economics consider the possibility of such inaccurate statistical discrimination. Using theory and a labor market experiment, we show that failing to account for inaccurate beliefs leads to a misclassification of source. We outline three methods to identify source: varying observed signals, belief elicitation, and an intervention to target inaccurate beliefs.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究不准确信念作为歧视的一个来源。经济学家通常将歧视描述为源于基于偏好（偏好型）或准确统计（信念型）的来源。尽管个人可能对相关特征（如生产力、信号）与群体身份的关联持有不准确的信念，但在经济学领域的实证歧视论文中，少于7%考虑了这种不准确统计歧视的可能性。通过理论和劳动市场实验，我们表明未能考虑不准确信念会导致来源的错误分类。我们概述了三种识别来源的方法：改变观察到的信号、信念诱导，以及针对不准确信念的干预措施。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Flight from Urban Blight: Lead Poisoning, Crime, and Suburbanization
records.title_cn: 逃离城市衰败：铅中毒、犯罪与郊区化
records.abstract_en: In this paper we study the effect of violent crime on residential and firms location decisions and their implications for segregation in cities. We do so by proposing a new instrument to exogenously predict violent crime in city centers. We base our instrument on chemical and medical evidence that links local characteristics of the soil to lead poisoning and aggression. We show that the increase in violent crime between 1960 and 1990 due to lead poisoning moved almost 8 million people to the suburbs. Firms followed by leaving the city centers. We then show that the suburbanization process was characterized by “white flight.”
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究了暴力犯罪对居民和企业选址决策的影响及其对城市隔离的启示。为此，我们提出了一种新的工具变量，用以外生地预测城市中心的暴力犯罪。我们的工具变量基于化学和医学证据，这些证据将土壤的局部特征与铅中毒和攻击性行为联系起来。我们表明，1960年至1990年间因铅中毒导致的暴力犯罪增加，促使近8万人迁往郊区。企业也随之离开城市中心。随后我们证明，这一郊区化过程以“白人逃离”为特征。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Behavioral Food Subsidies
records.title_cn: 行为食品补贴
records.abstract_en: We conduct a field experiment with low-income shoppers to study how behavioral interventions can improve the effectiveness of healthy food subsidies. Our unique design enables us to deliver subsidies both before and during grocery shopping. We examine the effects of two nonrestrictive changes to the choice environment: giving shoppers agency over the subsidy they receive and introducing a waiting period before a subsidized shopping trip to prompt deliberation about upcoming purchases. These interventions increase healthy food spending by 61% more than a healthy food subsidy alone, resulting in 199% greater healthy spending than in our unsubsidized control group.
records.abstract_cn: 我们与低收入购物者进行了一项实地实验，研究行为干预如何提高健康食品补贴的有效性。我们的独特设计使我们能够在购物前和购物过程中提供补贴。我们考察了选择环境的两种非限制性变化的影响：赋予购物者对所获补贴的自主权，以及在补贴购物行程前引入等待期以促使他们对即将进行的购买进行深思。这些干预措施使健康食品支出比仅提供健康食品补贴时增加了61%，导致健康支出比我们未补贴的对照组高出199%。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Stable Income, Stable Family
records.title_cn: 稳定收入，稳定家庭
records.abstract_en: We document the effect of unemployment insurance generosity on divorce and fertility using an identification strategy that leverages state-level changes in maximum benefits over time and comparisons across workers who have been laid off and those that have not been laid off. The results indicate that higher maximum benefit levels mitigate the effects of layoffs. In particular, they mitigate increases in divorce associated with men’s layoffs; increases in separations associated with women’s layoffs; reductions in fertility associated with men’s layoffs; and increases in fertility associated with women’s layoffs.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用一种识别策略，该策略利用州级最高福利随时间的变化以及被裁员与未被裁员工人之间的比较，来记录失业保险慷慨程度对离婚和生育的影响。结果表明，更高的最高福利水平减轻了裁员的影响。特别是，它们减轻了与男性裁员相关的离婚增加；与女性裁员相关的分居增加；与男性裁员相关的生育减少；以及与女性裁员相关的生育增加。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: What Matters for Electrification? Evidence from 70 Years of U.S. Home Heating Choices
records.title_cn: 什么因素影响电气化？来自美国70年家庭供暖选择的证据
records.abstract_en: The percentage of U.S. homes heated with electricity has increased steadily from 1% in 1950 to 40% in 2020. Energy prices, geography, climate, housing characteristics, and income are shown to explain 90% of the increase, with energy prices by far the most important factor. The paper then estimates the cost of an electrification mandate for new homes. Households in warm states tend to prefer electricity anyway, so would be made worse off by less than $350 annually on average. Households in cold states, however, tend to prefer natural gas so would be made worse off by more than $1,000 annually.
records.abstract_cn: 美国用电供暖的家庭比例从1950年的1%稳步增长至2020年的40%。能源价格、地理位置、气候、住房特征和收入被证明可以解释这一增长的90%，其中能源价格是最重要的因素。本文随后估算了新建住宅电气化强制要求的成本。温暖州的家庭通常本来就偏好电力，因此平均每年损失不到350美元。然而，寒冷州的家庭通常偏好天然气，因此平均每年损失超过1,000美元。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Influence-Seeking in U.S. Corporate Elites’ Campaign Contribution Behavior
records.title_cn: 美国企业精英竞选捐款行为中的影响力寻求
records.abstract_en: I leverage a new panel on the contributions to members of the U.S. Congress (MCs) from 401,557 corporate leaders of 14,807 U.S. corporations over 1999–2018 to show that U.S. corporate elites use contributions to political campaigns as a tool of political influence. Donations increase by 11% when a politician is assigned to a committee dealing with policy issues relevant to a corporate leader’s company. The effect is driven by donations to MCs with the greatest power in the committees. I estimate that, absent an influence motive, donations from corporate leaders during this period would have been lower by $20 million.
records.abstract_cn: 我利用一项新的面板数据，涵盖401,557-14,807年间来自1999家美国企业的2018位企业领袖对美国国会议员的捐款，表明美国企业精英将政治竞选捐款作为政治影响力的工具。当一位政治家被分配到与企业领袖所在公司相关的政策议题委员会时，捐款增加11%。这一效应主要由对在委员会中拥有最大权力的国会议员的捐款驱动。我估计，若无影响力动机，此期间企业领袖的捐款将减少20万美元。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Climate Risk and Preferences over the Size of Government: Evidence from California Wildfires
records.title_cn: 气候风险与对政府规模的偏好：来自加利福尼亚野火的证据
records.abstract_en: How does exposure to risk shape individual preferences for an expanded state? I examine this question in the context of climate change-related risk. Using variation in California wildfire activity, I show neighborhoods experiencing large fires increase support by 0.8 percentage points for ballot initiatives which expand the size of government and by 2.4 percentage points for ballot initiatives endorsed by pro-environment interest groups. The effect is stronger in Republican areas and is not driven by shifts in voter registration or turnout, suggesting the mechanism acts through changes in individual preferences rather than compositional changes in the electorate.
records.abstract_cn: 风险暴露如何塑造个人对扩大国家规模的偏好？我在气候变化相关风险的背景下考察这一问题。利用加利福尼亚野火活动的变化，我表明经历大型火灾的社区对扩大政府规模的投票倡议的支持率增加了0.8个百分点，对支持环保利益集团背书的投票倡议的支持率增加了2.4个百分点。这种效应在共和党地区更强，且并非由选民登记或投票率的变化所驱动，这表明其机制是通过个人偏好的变化而非选民构成的变化起作用。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Technology Training, Buyer-Supplier Relationship, and Quality Upgrading in an Agricultural Supply Chain
records.title_cn: 技术培训、买卖双方关系与农业供应链中的质量升级
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the impacts of technology training and buyer-supplier relationship on technology adoption and quality upgrading. We randomly varied subjects of each training group across farmer-exporter clusters—farmers, exporters, both, or none—and provided training on Good Agricultural Practices (GAP). We find that training farmers enhances technology adoption and quality upgrading. Yet, the effects are much stronger when farmers and exporters are trained together. We document a plausible mechanism to explain this finding: joint training improves buyer-supplier relationship, which facilitates contract trade between farmers and exporters. We find no effect of GAP certification eligibility on technology adoption.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了技术培训和买卖双方关系对技术采纳及质量升级的影响。我们在农民-出口商集群中随机变化每个培训组的对象——农民、出口商、两者或均不——并提供良好农业规范（GAP）培训。我们发现，培训农民能促进技术采纳和质量升级。然而，当农民和出口商一起接受培训时，效果更为显著。我们记录了一个可能的机制来解释这一发现：联合培训改善了买卖双方关系，从而促进了农民与出口商之间的合同贸易。我们发现GAP认证资格对技术采纳没有影响。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Testing for Salience Effects in Choices under Risk
records.title_cn: 风险选择中显著性效应的检验
records.abstract_en: We construct and run an experiment to test the most basic choice effect predicted by salience theory. Subjects allocate wealth between a risky and a safe investment. While we vary an apparent payoff ratio to influence salience, treatments have economically equivalent consequences. Most other theories of behavior then predict zero effect. Our experimental findings are strongly consistent with the behavioral implication of a continuous version of salience theory. We provide a novel structural estimate on the strength of salience. In our setting, increasing the relative payoff contrast by 1% is equivalent to an increased odds ratio by about 0.4%.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建并运行了一个实验来检验显著性理论预测的最基本的选择效应。受试者在风险投资和安全投资之间分配财富。当我们改变一个明显的支付比率以影响显著性时，各处理组在经济上具有等效的后果。大多数其他行为理论则预测零效应。我们的实验结果与连续性显著性理论的行为含义高度一致。我们提供了关于显著性强度的新颖的结构性估计。在我们的设定中，相对支付对比度增加1%相当于几率比增加约0.4%。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Bidding on Price and Quality: An Experiment on the Complexity of Scoring Rule Auctions
records.title_cn: 价格与质量竞标：评分规则拍卖复杂性的实验研究
records.abstract_en: We experimentally study procurement auctions when both quality and price matter. We compare two treatments where sellers compete on one dimension only (price or quality), with three treatments where sellers submit a price-quality bid and the winner is determined by a scoring rule that combines the two offers.
