Generally, public finance emerges as the most cost-effective financing structure for all CO2 transport modes; the advantages of a lower cost of capital compared to private finance options outweigh the associated operational efficiency disadvantages. While additional aspects beyond cost must be considered when selecting financing structures for new infrastructure assets, our ex-ante analysis underlines the importance of financing structures for the economic viability of CO2 transport assets, and for CCS more broadly.
records.abstract_cn: 碳捕集与封存（CCS）设施的经济运行依赖于二氧化碳运输基础设施的可用性，而新运输资产的融资结构将影响二氧化碳运输成本。基于其他部门基础设施融资的经济研究，我们在平准化运输成本模型中，通过管道、驳船、火车和船舶的二氧化碳运输方式，实证校准了不同融资结构下的资本成本和运营效率。我们的结果表明，融资结构的选择可导致管道运输成本差异高达26%，其他运输方式的影响较小。总体而言，公共融资在所有二氧化碳运输方式中表现为最具成本效益的融资结构；其较低的资本成本优势超过了与私人融资选项相关的运营效率劣势。尽管在为新的基础设施资产选择融资结构时，必须考虑成本以外的其他方面，但我们的事前分析强调了融资结构对二氧化碳运输资产经济可行性以及更广泛CCS的重要性。

records.title_en: How do fuel economy standards affect product structure and technology changes? Evidence from China's firm-level data
records.title_cn: 燃油经济性标准如何影响产品结构和技术变革？来自中国企业层面数据的证据
records.abstract_en: China's national Corporate Average Fuel Consumption (CAFC) level has decreased significantly after implementing the tightened Phase IV (2016–2020) fuel economy standard. To investigate the causal effects of this tightened standard, we specify a difference-in-differences (DID) model to estimate the effects of this standard on China's traditional internal combustion engine vehicle (ICEV) manufacturers by employing firm-level data from 2013 to 2020. We find that this tightened standard does have a significant causal effect on inducing these manufacturers to reduce their CAFC by incorporating more pure electric vehicles into their product portfolios and reducing average fuel consumption in their traditional ICEVs by adopting currently available fuel-efficiency technologies. However, this tightened standard has not induced these manufacturers to implement innovation activities in fuel efficiency. This paper not only provides new empirical evidence to the growing literature on the impacts of fuel economy standards in developing countries but also sheds light on mechanisms of the impact of fuel economy standards.
records.abstract_cn: 在实施更为严格的第四阶段（2016-2020年）燃油经济性标准后，中国的全国企业平均燃料消耗量（CAFC）水平显著下降。为了研究这一严格标准的因果效应，我们采用双重差分（DID）模型，利用2013年至2020年的企业层面数据，估计该标准对中国传统内燃机汽车（ICEV）制造商的影响。我们发现，这一严格标准确实对这些制造商产生了显著的因果效应，促使他们通过将更多纯电动汽车纳入产品组合来降低CAFC，并通过采用现有可用的燃油效率技术来降低传统内燃机汽车的平均燃料消耗。然而，这一严格标准并未促使这些制造商在燃油效率方面开展创新活动。本文不仅为关于发展中国家燃油经济性标准影响的日益增长的文献提供了新的实证证据，而且揭示了燃油经济性标准影响的作用机制。

records.title_en: The CO2 emission effects of global supply chain geographic restructuring on emerging economies
records.title_cn: 全球供应链地理重构对新兴经济体的二氧化碳排放效应
records.abstract_en: Global supply chains (GSCs) have undergone profound geographic restructuring, and the emerging economies have played an increasingly important role. A better understanding of the CO2 emission effects of GSC restructuring is essential for emerging economies to address the increasing complexity in emissions mitigation. To this end, we assess the emission effects of GSC geographic restructuring in both intermediates sourcing and final production on 204 emerging economies during 2010–2019. With the multi-regional input-output model and structural decomposition analysis technique, this study reveals that GSC geographic restructuring significantly raised emerging economies' emissions, with the relocation of intermediates sourcing and final production respectively contributing by 2695.9 Mt. and 1622.2 Mt. In particular, China, Southeast and Central Asia and Sub-Saharan Africa saw a greater emissions growth from the GSC production relocation but South Asia from the GSC sourcing relocation. On the contrary, GSC relatively shifting away from Latin America, Middle East and North Africa led to obvious emission reductions. Regional heterogeneities in the sectoral sources and technology effect of GSC emissions have further been identified. The empirical results can inform policymaking for emissions mitigation in the emerging economies during their integration into GSCs.
records.abstract_cn: 全球供应链（GSCs）经历了深刻的地理重构，新兴经济体在其中扮演了越来越重要的角色。更好地理解GSC重构的二氧化碳排放效应，对于新兴经济体应对日益复杂的减排挑战至关重要。为此，我们评估了GSC地理重构在中间品采购和最终生产两方面对204个新兴经济体在2010-2019年期间的排放影响。利用多区域投入产出模型和结构分解分析技术，本研究发现GSC地理重构显著提高了新兴经济体的排放量，其中中间品采购和最终生产的转移分别贡献了2695.9百万吨和1622.2百万吨。特别是，中国、东南亚和中亚以及撒哈拉以南非洲地区因GSC生产转移而经历了更大的排放增长，而南亚则因GSC采购转移而排放增长显著。相反，GSC相对从拉丁美洲、中东和北非转移出去导致了明显的排放减少。进一步识别了GSC排放的部门来源和技术效应的区域异质性。实证结果可为新兴经济体在融入GSC过程中的减排政策制定提供参考。

records.title_en: Characteristics of green loan users and the green policy mix
records.title_cn: 绿色贷款用户特征与绿色政策组合
records.abstract_en: We analyse the usage of government-sponsored green loans under a feed-in-tariffs scheme and document a positive link with borrower financial health. Green loan users have better credit ratings, higher sales growth, and lower leverage. The link remains stable in face of significantly changing conditions for green investments and heightened policy uncertainty. Green loan users exhibit better ex-post performance and lower default probability. Results are in line with the notion that the screening undertaken by the lender matters for efficient green loan provision and highlight the important role of public loan programs in the green policy mix.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了上网电价补贴计划下政府资助的绿色贷款的使用情况，并记录了其与借款人财务健康状况的正向关联。绿色贷款用户拥有更好的信用评级、更高的销售增长率和更低的杠杆率。在绿色投资条件显著变化和政策不确定性加剧的情况下，这一关联保持稳定。绿色贷款用户表现出更好的事后绩效和更低的违约概率。结果与贷款人进行的筛选对绿色贷款的有效提供至关重要的观点一致，并强调了公共贷款项目在绿色政策组合中的重要作用。

records.title_en: Systemic resilience of networked commodities
records.title_cn: 网络化商品系统的韧性
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a class of complex network-based models whose interconnected nodes are commodities. We assume that the considered commodities are linked on the ground of the similarities of risk profiles and correlations of their returns. In this framework, we explore the resilience of the networks — i.e., their ability to absorb exogenous microscopic shocks. To this aim, we assume that high levels of resilience are associated with small variations of the community structure of the network when an exogenous shock occurs — hence, assuming that the stability of the networked commodities is measured through the maintenance of their connection levels. Shocks are conceptualized as impulsive modifications of the links among the considered commodities. The employed methodological instrument is the clustering coefficient, which is a nodal centrality measure describing the way the adjacent of the nodes are mutually connected. The theoretical proposal is empirically tested over a large set of commodities of different nature.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一类基于复杂网络的模型，其中相互连接的节点为商品。我们假设所考虑的商品基于风险特征的相似性和收益的相关性而相互关联。在此框架下，我们探讨网络的韧性——即其吸收外生微观冲击的能力。为此，我们假设高韧性水平与外生冲击发生时网络社区结构的微小变化相关——因此，假设网络化商品的稳定性通过其连接水平的维持来衡量。冲击被概念化为所考虑商品之间链接的脉冲式修改。所采用的方法工具是聚类系数，这是一种节点中心性度量，描述节点相邻节点相互连接的方式。该理论提议在大量不同性质的商品上进行了实证检验。

records.title_en: From pro-environmental behavior to ESG fund investing: Evidence from account-level data in China
records.title_cn: 从亲环境行为到ESG基金投资：来自中国账户层面数据的证据
records.abstract_en: Utilizing the green energy collected through the “Ant Forest” project to measure investors' pro-environmental behavior (PEB), the paper finds that investors' PEB positively impacts the weighted Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) score of their mutual fund positions. Additionally, when classifying PEBs into egoistic and altruistic behaviors based on specific sources of green energy, the study reveals that altruistic PEBs have a more substantial influence than egoistic PEBs. Further analysis demonstrates that egoistic PEBs become more significantly related to ESG investing when investors face extreme weather events, poor air quality, or seek to enhance their reputation. Although ESG investing transformed from altruistic and egoistic PEBs results in negative excess returns, egoistic investors experience a significant reduction in risk through ESG fund investments. In contrast, altruistic investors are willing to pay higher costs. These findings suggest that even though altruism predominantly drives the transformation from PEB to sustainable investment, egoism can also play a role when investors seek to mitigate uncertainties, diversify their portfolios, or promote social validation. Overall, these results contribute to our understanding of the motives behind sustainable investment.
records.abstract_cn: 利用通过“蚂蚁森林”项目收集的绿色能源来衡量投资者的亲环境行为（PEB），本文发现投资者的PEB对其共同基金持仓的加权环境、社会和治理（ESG）评分产生正向影响。此外，根据绿色能源的具体来源将PEB分为利己行为和利他行为时，研究揭示利他PEB比利己PEB具有更显著的影响。进一步分析表明，当投资者面临极端天气事件、空气质量差或寻求提升声誉时，利己PEB与ESG投资的相关性变得更加显著。尽管由利他和利己PEB转化而来的ESG投资导致负的超额回报，但利己投资者通过ESG基金投资经历了风险的显著降低。相比之下，利他投资者愿意支付更高的成本。这些发现表明，尽管利他主义主要驱动从PEB到可持续投资的转化，但当投资者寻求缓解不确定性、分散投资组合或促进社会认同时，利己主义也能发挥作用。总体而言，这些结果有助于我们理解可持续投资背后的动机。

records.title_en: Alleviating energy poverty globally: Does digital government matter?
records.title_cn: 全球缓解能源贫困：数字政府是否重要？
records.abstract_en: Against the context of the global energy crisis and the digital transformation of governance, energy poverty remains a critical global issue, how to effectively leverage digitalization to address energy transitions requires further exploration. Using panel data from 91 countries spanning 2010 to 2019, the alleviating effect of digital government on energy poverty is supported. This observation remains robust even after conducting a range of robustness tests and addressing endogeneity concerns. Of special note, this alleviating effect exhibits marked nonlinear (U-shaped) and differentiated characteristics, with the former showing a diminishing marginal effect as energy poverty intensifies, and the latter showing a more pronounced effect in resource-rich OECD countries. Meanwhile, the relationship between digital government and energy poverty is moderated by government efficiency and financial development. Mechanism analysis reveals that digital government alleviates energy poverty through technological effects and informational effects rather than scale effects. The findings offer new insights into alleviating energy poverty in the context of digitalization, highlighting the importance of digital government in the global energy governance framework. In addition, it provides practical evidence for countries with different resource endowments to tailor sustainable development goals based on their specific situations.
records.abstract_cn: 在全球能源危机和治理数字化转型的背景下，能源贫困仍然是一个关键的全球性问题，如何有效利用数字化来应对能源转型需要进一步探索。利用2010至2019年间91个国家的面板数据，支持了数字政府对能源贫困的缓解作用。在进行一系列稳健性检验并处理内生性问题后，这一观察结果依然稳健。特别值得注意的是，这种缓解作用表现出显著的非线性（U形）和差异化特征，前者显示随着能源贫困加剧，边际效应递减，后者显示在资源丰富的OECD国家中效果更为显著。同时，数字政府与能源贫困之间的关系受到政府效率和金融发展的调节。机制分析揭示，数字政府通过技术效应和信息效应而非规模效应来缓解能源贫困。这些发现为数字化背景下缓解能源贫困提供了新见解，强调了数字政府在全球能源治理框架中的重要性。此外，它为不同资源禀赋的国家根据自身情况制定可持续发展目标提供了实践证据。

records.title_en: Assessing the effects of digitalization on the amenity of clean energy supply chains: Policy insights from OECD countries
records.title_cn: 评估数字化对清洁能源供应链便利性的影响：来自OECD国家的政策启示
records.abstract_en: The integration of digital solutions into existing energy infrastructure is crucial for enhancing the efficiency, reliability, and sustainability of energy systems. However, successful integration requires careful planning and implementation. Digitalization also brings efficiency, flexibility, and reliability to an energy system, which requires a strong supply chain mechanism. This paper seeks to analyze the effect of energy system digitalization on the vulnerabilities of clean energy technology value chains in the OECD countries from 2000 to 2021, controlling for ecological footprint, renewable energy consumption, non-renewable energy consumption, and economic performance. Digitalization of energy systems, renewable energy consumption and Non-renewable energy consumption are found to be inversely related to securing the supply chain. The secure supply chain of clean energy technology has a direct and positive relationship with the ecological footprint and energy system digitalization, renewable energy consumption, non-renewable energy consumption and securing supply chains for clean energy technology are interrelated. Energy system digitalization supports clean energy technology supply chain resilience by positively correlated with renewable energy consumption but negatively correlated with non-renewable energy consumption. OECD countries should set up an overarching and coordinated system for reviewing, evaluating or auditing the performance of current and proposed schemes and steps linked to sustainability, distributed generation and electricity technologies, carbon dioxide emissions, and enhancement of energy systems.
records.abstract_cn: 将数字解决方案整合到现有能源基础设施中，对于提高能源系统的效率、可靠性和可持续性至关重要。然而，成功的整合需要周密的规划和实施。数字化还为能源系统带来了效率、灵活性和可靠性，这要求有强大的供应链机制作为支撑。本文旨在分析2000年至2021年间，能源系统数字化对OECD国家清洁能源技术价值链脆弱性的影响，并控制生态足迹、可再生能源消费、非可再生能源消费和经济绩效等因素。研究发现，能源系统数字化、可再生能源消费和非可再生能源消费与供应链安全呈负相关。清洁能源技术的安全供应链与生态足迹和能源系统数字化呈直接正相关，可再生能源消费、非可再生能源消费与清洁能源技术供应链安全相互关联。能源系统数字化通过促进可再生能源消费（正相关）和抑制非可再生能源消费（负相关）来支持清洁能源技术供应链的韧性。OECD国家应建立一个总体协调的系统，用于审查、评估或审计当前和拟议的与可持续性、分布式发电和电力技术、二氧化碳排放以及能源系统增强相关的计划和措施的表现。

records.title_en: Did supply chain digitization contribute to corporate green energy innovation? The mediating role of asset receivable management and policy spillovers
records.title_cn: 供应链数字化是否促进了企业绿色能源创新？应收账款管理的中介作用与政策溢出效应
records.abstract_en: In the context of supply chain digitization and green development in full swing, it is crucial to clarify the impact of the former on green energy innovation. Using exogenous shocks deriving from supply chain innovation and application pilot events, this study examines the impact of supply chain digitization on green energy innovation based on the data of Chinese listed companies from 2012 to 2021. The findings show that supply chain digitization significantly enhances corporate green energy innovation and that receivable asset management is a path mechanism for supply chain digitization to drive green energy innovation. Moreover, there is a significant positive intra-city spillover. Supply chain digitization contributes significantly to corporate green energy innovation in state-controlled manufacturing firms with effective internal controls in the eastern region. This study has important policy implications for promoting green energy innovation and accelerating the development of modern supply chain systems.
records.abstract_cn: 在供应链数字化与绿色发展全面推进的背景下，明确前者对绿色能源创新的影响至关重要。利用供应链创新与应用试点事件作为外生冲击，本研究基于2012年至2021年中国上市公司数据，考察了供应链数字化对绿色能源创新的影响。研究发现，供应链数字化显著提升了企业绿色能源创新，且应收账款管理是供应链数字化驱动绿色能源创新的路径机制。此外，存在显著的城市内正向溢出效应。供应链数字化对东部地区、国有控股、制造业及内部控制有效的企业的绿色能源创新有显著促进作用。本研究对促进绿色能源创新和加速现代供应链体系建设具有重要的政策启示。

records.title_en: Exploring the output effects on price-induced interfuel substitution and carbon dioxide emission
records.title_cn: 探究产出效应对价格诱导的燃料间替代及二氧化碳排放的影响
records.abstract_en: This study explores how output effects influence price-induced interfuel substitution and examines its impact on CO2 emissions in the Korean industrial sector. Employing the differential fuel allocation model, which incorporates output supply decisions, we decompose the price response of energy demand to identify both substitution and output effects and simulate the resulting price-induced CO2 emissions. The results provide empirical evidence of substitutable relationships among coal, oil, and electricity, particularly showing that electrification helps substitute for coal and oil. In addition, the decomposition results reveal that the output effects strengthen own-price response but weaken cross-price response, reflecting the industrial sector's tendency to adjust output supply in response to cost pressures from rising energy prices, especially oil prices. Regarding price-induced CO2 emissions, the simulation results suggest the possibility of over- or under-estimating changes in net CO2 emissions if the output effects are not considered. Notably, they reveal that a rise in oil and gas prices can lead to a reduction in net CO2 emissions due to the output effects.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了产出效应如何影响价格诱导的燃料间替代，并考察其对韩国工业部门二氧化碳排放的影响。采用纳入产出供给决策的差分燃料分配模型，我们将能源需求的价格响应分解以识别替代效应和产出效应，并模拟由此产生的价格诱导的二氧化碳排放。结果提供了煤炭、石油和电力之间可替代关系的经验证据，特别表明电气化有助于替代煤炭和石油。此外，分解结果显示，产出效应增强了自身价格响应，但削弱了交叉价格响应，反映了工业部门倾向于根据能源价格上涨（尤其是油价）带来的成本压力调整产出供给。关于价格诱导的二氧化碳排放，模拟结果表明，如果不考虑产出效应，可能会高估或低估净二氧化碳排放的变化。值得注意的是，它们揭示，由于产出效应，石油和天然气价格的上涨可能导致净二氧化碳排放的减少。

records.title_en: Competition vs. coordination: Optimising wind, solar and batteries in renewable energy zones
records.title_cn: 竞争与协调：在可再生能源区域优化风电、太阳能和电池
records.abstract_en: Decarbonising Australia's power system requires high market shares of variable renewable energy. An important policy initiative to achieve this is the establishment of Renewable Energy Zones (REZs). As renewable market share increases, curtailment within REZs is predictable. Curtailment occurs due to low utilisation rates or high peak-to-average output ratios of intermittent renewables (being ∼3:1), largely inelastic aggregate final electricity demand, and the economic limits of REZ network transfer capacity. In an open access, multi-zonal market setup, an intuitive response by policymakers may be to undertake connection reform (i.e. priority access) and underwrite storage assets to alleviate the worst effects of curtailment. Prima facie, curtailment and lines congestion may be reduced and wind and solar capacity increased through the deployment of battery storage. However, as model results in this article reveal, priority access can make multi-zonal markets more sensitive to curtailment, and competitive batteries within a REZ can aggravate congestion. Further, early entrant batteries may oversize their MW capacity and crowd-out renewables. All these cases harm welfare within a REZ. Optimally sized and coordinated ‘portfolio’ batteries alleviate congestion because they don't compete for scarce REZ transfer capacity.
records.abstract_cn: 脱碳澳大利亚的电力系统需要可变可再生能源占据高市场份额。实现这一目标的一项重要政策举措是建立可再生能源区域（REZs）。随着可再生能源市场份额的增加，REZ内的弃电是可预测的。弃电的发生是由于间歇性可再生能源的低利用率或高峰均输出比（约为3:1）、大体上缺乏弹性的总最终电力需求，以及REZ网络传输能力的经济限制。在开放接入、多区域市场设置中，政策制定者直观的回应可能是进行连接改革（即优先接入）并为储能资产提供担保以缓解弃电的最严重影响。初步看来，通过部署电池储能可以减少弃电和线路拥堵，并增加风电和太阳能容量。然而，正如本文模型结果所示，优先接入可能使多区域市场对弃电更加敏感，而REZ内的竞争性电池可能加剧拥堵。此外，早期进入的电池可能过度扩大其兆瓦容量并排挤可再生能源。所有这些情况都会损害REZ内的福利。最优规模和协调的“组合”电池缓解拥堵，因为它们不竞争稀缺的REZ传输容量。

records.title_en: Can artificial intelligence technology improve companies' capacity for green innovation? Evidence from listed companies in China
records.title_cn: 人工智能技术能否提升企业绿色创新能力？来自中国上市公司的证据
records.abstract_en: Green innovation in the digital economy is characterized by complex adaptive systems. It is challenging to effectively improve corporate green innovation capacity (CGIC) by relying on traditional technological innovation. The integration of enterprises' green innovation and artificial intelligence technology (AIT) is becoming a significant driver for addressing global environmental challenges and promoting enterprises' energy efficiency and low-carbon development. Combining patent datasets for listed companies in China, this study explores the driving effect of AIT on CGIC from the perspective of “artificial intelligence +”. This study empirically examines how AIT affects CGIC, and further investigates AIT's impact on the duration of enterprises' green innovation. The findings reveal that AIT's intervention can effectively improve CGIC. Enterprises with different characteristics have heterogeneous effects on improving CGIC by applying AI, indicating that the application of AIT has a more prominent impact on heavily polluting, nontechnology-intensive, and highly competitive enterprises. Mechanism analysis demonstrates that AIT can improve CGIC by absorbing high-skilled labor and increasing investment in research and development. Further examination reveals that AIT application can significantly reduce the potential for enterprises interrupting green innovation activities and prolong the duration of green innovation. This study provides valuable insights concerning the effect of enterprises' AIT application on improving CGIC, empowering enterprises to improve energy efficiency and achieve low-carbon development.
records.abstract_cn: 数字经济中的绿色创新具有复杂适应系统的特征。依靠传统技术创新难以有效提升企业绿色创新能力（CGIC）。企业绿色创新与人工智能技术（AIT）的融合正成为应对全球环境挑战、促进企业能源效率和低碳发展的重要驱动力。结合中国上市公司的专利数据集，本研究从“人工智能+”的视角探讨了AIT对CGIC的驱动效应。本研究实证检验了AIT如何影响CGIC，并进一步考察了AIT对企业绿色创新持续期的影响。研究发现，AIT的介入能够有效提升CGIC。不同特征的企业在应用人工智能提升CGIC方面存在异质性效应，表明AIT的应用对重污染、非技术密集型和竞争激烈的企业影响更为显著。机制分析表明，AIT可以通过吸纳高技能劳动力和增加研发投入来提升CGIC。进一步检验发现，AIT的应用能够显著降低企业中断绿色创新活动的可能性，并延长绿色创新的持续期。本研究为企业应用AIT提升CGIC的效果提供了有价值的见解，助力企业提高能源效率并实现低碳发展。

records.title_en: Geopolitical risk and uncertainty in energy markets: Evidence from wavelet-based methods
records.title_cn: 地缘政治风险与能源市场不确定性：基于小波方法的证据
records.abstract_en: In these recent years, geopolitical studies have gained an increasing interest across mainstream arenas as well as among researchers. The pandemic outbreak in 2020 and warfare tensions in many hot spots across the globe are the prime drivers of the attraction of geopolitical studies speculating the “post-globalized” world. Geopolitical (dis)equilibria and energy markets have demonstrated a solid linking due to the interconnected global economy alongside with uncertainty over both climate and global policy. In this paper, we intend to investigate the relationship between the above-mentioned risks and the energy market, with a special focus on natural gas, coal and oil. To this purpose, we apply wavelet entropy-based measures to assess how much uncertainty indices can predict the dynamics of these three commodities and vice-versa. Both indexes and commodities time series are collected over a period that goes from January 2008 to February 2024 for a total of 195 monthly observations. The results show that the commodities are affected very differently by the risk and uncertainty indexes. Hence we believe these findings may be supportive to policy makers and regulators who are called to puzzle out the future energy mix for power generation in times of geopolitical turmoil and climate crisis. We eventually support our findings with a comprehensive dissertation over the most relevant geopolitical phenomena of last years.
records.abstract_cn: 近年来，地缘政治研究在主流领域及研究者中日益受到关注。2020年疫情爆发及全球多个热点地区的战争紧张局势，是引发关于“后全球化”世界猜测的地缘政治研究吸引力的主要驱动因素。地缘政治（非）均衡与能源市场因全球经济互联以及气候和全球政策的不确定性而展现出紧密联系。本文旨在研究上述风险与能源市场之间的关系，特别关注天然气、煤炭和石油。为此，我们应用基于小波熵的度量来评估不确定性指数在多大程度上能预测这三种商品的动态，反之亦然。指数和商品的时间序列均从2008年一月至2024年二月收集，共195个月度观测值。结果表明，商品受风险和不确定性指数的影响差异很大。因此，我们认为这些发现可能对政策制定者和监管者有所支持，他们需要在 geopolitical 动荡和气候危机时期，为未来发电的能源组合做出决策。我们最终通过全面论述近年最相关的地缘政治现象来支持我们的发现。

records.title_en: Identifying the driving forces of embodied emissions from intermediate goods export
records.title_cn: 识别中间品出口隐含排放的驱动因素
records.abstract_en: This study investigates the changes in CO2 emissions associated with intermediate exports in Japan, China, the US, and Europe from 2000 to 2021. Using a novel structural decomposition analysis (SDA) framework, we analyze the impact of intermediate goods trade structures on emissions amidst globalization, slowbalization, the COVID-19 pandemic, and geopolitical shifts. Our analysis highlights that emissions embodied in exports significantly vary by region and period. China has the highest emissions due to rapid industrial growth, while developed regions like Japan, the US, and Europe show different trends. The sectoral analysis identifies manufacturing industries as key contributors to intermediate goods export emissions. Meanwhile, SDA shows that technological improvements generally reduce emissions, and final demand and trade effects increase them. The findings emphasize the need for coordinated efforts to address the environmental impacts of globalization, and the importance of future research to refine emission accounting models and explore the effects of emerging economic trends on global carbon emissions.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究调查了2000年至2021年间日本、中国、美国和欧洲中间出口相关的二氧化碳排放变化。利用一种新颖的结构分解分析（SDA）框架，我们分析了在全球化、慢速全球化、COVID-19大流行和地缘政治转变背景下，中间品贸易结构对排放的影响。我们的分析强调，出口隐含排放因地区和时期而有显著差异。由于快速的工业增长，中国的排放量最高，而日本、美国和欧洲等发达地区则呈现出不同的趋势。部门分析确定制造业是中间品出口排放的关键贡献者。同时，SDA显示技术进步通常减少排放，而最终需求和贸易效应则增加排放。研究结果强调了协调努力以应对全球化环境影响的必要性，以及未来研究细化排放核算模型和探索新兴经济趋势对全球碳排放影响的重要性。

records.title_en: Alberta's electricity futures market: An empirical analysis of price formation
records.title_cn: 阿尔伯塔省电力期货市场：价格形成的实证分析
records.abstract_en: Alberta operates an energy-only electricity market, which allows the unilateral exercise of market power to create investment incentives and resolve the ‘missing money’ problem. This stands in contrast to other jurisdictions that have implemented administratively complex capacity markets to ensure adequate supply. A key feature of Alberta's market is its futures market, where contracts that settle against realized spot prices are exchanged. The futures market enables market participants to hedge against price volatility. It informs investment decision, enhances price transparency and aids in competitive price formation by diminishing the incentive to exercise market power in the spot market. Our empirical work explores Alberta's electricity futures market in two main areas: the relationship between futures and realized spot prices, and the evolution of futures prices influenced by expected spot market conditions. We find that (i) electricity futures prices do not provide an unbiased forecast of spot prices, (ii) a portion of the realized futures premium can be explained by information that is obtained after the futures price has been set, and (iii) futures prices appear to efficiently reflect changes in available information.
records.abstract_cn: 阿尔伯塔省运营着一个仅含能源的电力市场，允许单方面行使市场力量以创造投资激励并解决“缺失资金”问题。这与其他辖区形成对比，后者实施了行政上复杂的容量市场以确保充足供应。阿尔伯塔省市场的一个关键特征是其期货市场，其中交易以实际现货价格结算的合约。期货市场使市场参与者能够对冲价格波动。它告知投资决策，增强价格透明度，并通过减少在现货市场行使市场力量的激励来促进竞争性价格形成。我们的实证工作探讨了阿尔伯塔省电力期货市场的两个主要领域：期货价格与实际现货价格之间的关系，以及受预期现货市场条件影响的期货价格演变。我们发现（i）电力期货价格并未提供现货价格的无偏预测，（ii）已实现期货溢价的一部分可以由期货价格设定后获得的信息解释，以及（iii）期货价格似乎有效反映了可用信息的变化。

records.title_en: Can artificial intelligence technology reduce carbon emissions? A global perspective
records.title_cn: 人工智能技术能否减少碳排放？一个全球视角
records.abstract_en: Whether Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology can contribute to carbon reduction remains an issue that requires further research. We measure the level of AI technology by the number of AI patents filed in each country, and use panel data from 30 countries spanning 2005 to 2020 to examine the impact of AI technology on carbon emissions. Our findings indicate that AI technology significantly reduces carbon emission levels. This conclusion remains robust after endogeneity and various robustness tests. Mechanism tests reveal that AI technology improves energy efficiency by reducing per capita carbon emissions and the energy intensity of primary energy. Additionally, AI technology reduces carbon emissions by inducing skill-biased and routine-biased technological change. When government regulation is more flexible, the carbon-reducing effect of AI technology is stronger. Further analysis indicates that AI technology has a significant impact on reducing carbon emissions in countries that are closer to the leading country in AI technology, have lower income level, and are highly dependent on traditional fossil fuels. Moreover, the carbon reduction effects of AI technology applied to energy management are more significant. Thus, promoting the innovation and diffusion of AI technology on a global scale plays a crucial role in advancing global carbon reduction targets.
records.abstract_cn: 人工智能（AI）技术是否有助于碳减排仍是一个需要进一步研究的问题。我们通过各国申请的AI专利数量来衡量AI技术水平，并使用2005年至2020年间30个国家的面板数据来考察AI技术对碳排放的影响。我们的研究结果表明，AI技术显著降低了碳排放水平。这一结论在内生性检验及多种稳健性检验后依然成立。机制检验显示，AI技术通过降低人均碳排放和一次能源的能源强度来提高能源效率。此外，AI技术还通过引发技能偏向型和常规偏向型技术变革来减少碳排放。当政府监管更为灵活时，AI技术的碳减排效应更强。进一步分析表明，AI技术对距离AI技术领先国家较近、收入水平较低且高度依赖传统化石燃料的国家的碳减排具有显著影响。此外，应用于能源管理的AI技术的碳减排效应更为显著。因此，在全球范围内促进AI技术的创新与扩散，对推进全球碳减排目标至关重要。

records.title_en: Are CEOs judged on how cost efficient their firms are?
records.title_cn: 首席执行官是否因其公司的成本效率而受到评价？
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates whether executive boards consider firm-specific inefficiencies when they change CEOs in the Swedish electricity distribution sector. Firm-level inefficiencies are calculated using data from all Swedish electricity distributors from 2001 to 2022 and a data envelopment analysis (DEA) approach. DEA has advantages over standard financial key performance indicators since it controls for heterogeneity in inputs and outputs. It is also frequently employed by energy regulators to calculate relative cost inefficiencies. Our baseline approach uses a multilevel model and investigates the relationship between inefficiency and CEO between-effects. This analysis shows that 9–15 % of the variation in inefficiency can be attributed to the CEO effect. The second modeling approach quantifies the CEO effect using a synthetic difference-in-differences approach, focusing on firms that have changed CEOs. The results reveal that new CEOs reduce cost inefficiency more when they succeed CEOs who were forced to leave.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在瑞典电力分销行业中，执行董事会更换首席执行官时是否考虑公司特定的低效率。使用2001年至2022年间所有瑞典电力分销商的数据以及数据包络分析（DEA）方法计算公司层面的低效率。DEA相对于标准财务关键绩效指标的优势在于它控制了投入和产出的异质性。它也被能源监管机构频繁用于计算相对成本低效率。我们的基线方法使用多层次模型，研究低效率与首席执行官间效应之间的关系。该分析显示，低效率变异的9-15%可归因于首席执行官效应。第二种建模方法采用合成双重差分法量化首席执行官效应，重点关注更换了首席执行官的公司。结果表明，当新任首席执行官接替被迫离职的首席执行官时，他们更能降低成本低效率。

records.title_en: Interconnectedness among supply chain disruptions, energy crisis, and oil market volatility on economic resilience
records.title_cn: 供应链中断、能源危机与石油市场波动对经济韧性的相互关联性
records.abstract_en: Volatility in global energy markets, disruption of production and distribution networks, and the unpredictability of oil markets have had a major impact on overall economic stability, highlighting the need to review their complex interrelationships thoroughly. In this spirit, this study uses monthly data from 1998 to 2023 to investigate the causal impact of energy uncertainty, global supply chain pressures, and oil supply and demand shocks on economic stability. By using the rolling window approach, we discovered time-varying causality. Our findings reveal the causal relationship between energy uncertainty, global supply chain pressures, and economic growth, highlighting their negative impacts. In addition, the study identified the negative causal relationship between oil demand and supply shocks on economic stability, with the impact of oil supply shocks being more pronounced. Further, error prediction variance decomposition and impulse response analysis provide additional evidence for these causal relationships. Given these findings, the study advocates establishing a more resilient supply chain structure and the energy sector to enhance the sustainability of the global economy.
records.abstract_cn: 全球能源市场的波动、生产与分销网络的 disruption，以及石油市场的不可预测性，对整体经济稳定性产生了重大影响，凸显了彻底审视其复杂相互关系的必要性。基于此，本研究利用1998年至2023年的月度数据，探讨能源不确定性、全球供应链压力以及石油供需冲击对经济稳定性的因果影响。通过采用滚动窗口方法，我们发现了时变因果关系。我们的研究结果揭示了能源不确定性、全球供应链压力与经济增长之间的因果关系，强调了它们的负面影响。此外，研究还识别了石油需求与供给冲击对经济稳定性的负面因果关系，其中石油供给冲击的影响更为显著。进一步地，误差预测方差分解和脉冲响应分析为这些因果关系提供了额外证据。鉴于这些发现，研究主张建立更具韧性的供应链结构和能源部门，以增强全球经济的可持续性。

records.title_en: A critique of the inappropriate interpretation of the quantile connectedness approach by Ando et al. (2022)
records.title_cn: 对Ando等人（2022）分位数连通性方法不当解释的批评
records.abstract_en: Recently, there has been an exponential rise in the studies examining quantile connectedness across the conditional quantiles of volatility, following the seminal work of Ando et al. (2022). Our article conducts a literature review of several such studies from reputable journals that incorrectly interpret the results from volatility connectedness across the conditional quantiles. More specifically, these studies incorrectly relate lower quantiles of volatility to extreme adverse (or bearish) conditions and upper quantiles of volatility to upmarket (or bullish) conditions. Our literature review shows that, once the correct interpretation of conditional quantiles of volatility is imposed, many of these studies' novel and surprising results become consistent with the prior literature.
records.abstract_cn: 近年来，继Ando等人（2022）的开创性工作之后，研究波动率条件分位数间分位数连通性的文献呈指数级增长。本文对若干来自知名期刊的此类研究进行了文献综述，这些研究错误地解释了跨条件分位数的波动率连通性结果。具体而言，这些研究错误地将波动率的低分位数与极端不利（或熊市）条件相关联，将波动率的高分位数与市场上涨（或牛市）条件相关联。我们的文献综述表明，一旦对波动率条件分位数进行正确解释，这些研究中的许多新颖且令人惊讶的结果便与先前文献保持一致。

records.title_en: Dynamic connectedness between crude oil futures and energy industrial bond credit spread: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 原油期货与能源工业债券信用利差之间的动态关联性：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: This study utilizes a connectedness approach that is based on the quantile vector autoregressive model to analyze the level of connectedness between China's crude oil future market (INE) and the energy industrial bond credit spread across various markets. The findings of our study indicate that (1) The total connectedness index (TCI) exhibits a U-shaped pattern that changes according to conditional quantiles. This suggests that the spillover between the energy industry bond market and oil futures market is greater during extreme market conditions (bullish and bearish markets) compared to normal markets; (2) The TCI increased in size and volatility during the COVID-19 pandemic and the Russia-Ukraine conflict; (3) The electricity sector consistently transmits shocks, whereas INE consistently receives them, irrespective of the market states; (4) The credit risk of the energy sector has a significant impact on INE, particularly in bullish and bearish markets, while the former has a little impact on the latter. The coal and electricity sectors are the primary net spillover transmitters for INE in both bullish and bearish markets. Conversely, the gas sector is the largest net spillover transmitter for INE in a typical market. Lastly, our research offers novel perspectives on the information-sharing channels for the energy sector's bonds and oil futures markets, which could assist traders and investors in making more informed investment decisions.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究采用基于分位数向量自回归模型的关联性方法，分析中国原油期货市场（INE）与能源工业债券信用利差在不同市场状态下的关联程度。研究结果表明：（1）总关联性指数（TCI）呈现随条件分位数变化的U型模式，这表明在极端市场条件（牛市和熊市）下，能源行业债券市场与石油期货市场之间的溢出效应大于正常市场；（2）在COVID-19大流行和俄乌冲突期间，TCI的规模和波动性均有所增加；（3）电力部门始终传递冲击，而INE始终接收冲击，无论市场状态如何；（4）能源部门的信用风险对INE有显著影响，尤其是在牛市和熊市中，而前者对后者的影响较小。在牛市和熊市中，煤炭和电力部门是INE的主要净溢出传递者。相反，在正常市场中，天然气部门是INE的最大净溢出传递者。最后，我们的研究为能源部门债券和石油期货市场的信息共享渠道提供了新的视角，这可能有助于交易者和投资者做出更明智的投资决策。

records.title_en: Dissecting the financial impact of climate risk
records.title_cn: 剖析气候风险的金融影响
records.abstract_en: The studies on climate financial risk have gradually increased in recent years. However, there is a wide variation in the conclusions regarding the extent to which climate risk impacts individual markets or aspects of the financial system. This study dissects the impacts of climate risk on the financial market, investment behaviour and financial stability using a meta-analysis, incorporating 1389 estimates from 70 primary studies. The findings indicate that, firstly, climate risk has a weak to moderate positive impact on the stock and bond markets, while it has a weak negative impact on the real estate market. Meanwhile, it has a weak negative impact on investment behaviour and financial stability. Secondly, in comparison to climate physical risk, climate transition risk has a greater influence on financial markets (except for real estate) and investment behaviour, with no discernible distinctions in their impact on financial stability. Lastly, the results of heterogeneity source analysis suggest that the primary contributors to the heterogeneity observed in climate finance literature are variations in key variable measures, the methodologies used in literature studies, and temporal characteristics (year of publication and sample period). These findings remain robust, accounting for publication bias.
records.abstract_cn: 近年来，关于气候金融风险的研究逐渐增多。然而，关于气候风险对个别市场或金融体系各方面影响程度的结论存在广泛差异。本研究通过元分析，整合了来自70项主要研究的1389个估计值，剖析了气候风险对金融市场、投资行为和金融稳定的影响。研究结果表明，首先，气候风险对股票和债券市场具有弱到中等的正向影响，而对房地产市场具有弱负向影响。同时，它对投资行为和金融稳定具有弱负向影响。其次，与气候物理风险相比，气候转型风险对金融市场（房地产除外）和投资行为的影响更大，而它们对金融稳定的影响没有明显区别。最后，异质性来源分析的结果表明，气候金融文献中观察到的异质性的主要贡献因素是关键变量测量的差异、文献研究中使用的方法以及时间特征（出版年份和样本期）。这些发现在考虑出版偏倚后依然稳健。

records.title_en: Does urban agglomeration reduce carbon emissions in Chinese cities? New perspective on factor mobility
records.title_cn: 城市集聚是否降低了中国城市的碳排放？要素流动的新视角
records.abstract_en: Urbanization in developing countries is often associated with high carbon emissions, mainly due to substantial fossil energy consumption in cities. However, only few studies have addressed how population concentration and factor mobility within urban agglomeration can reduce carbon emissions. Using a novel perspective on factor mobility, we delve into the impact of urban agglomeration on carbon emissions using a panel dataset of 284 Chinese cities spanning from 2004 to 2022. The results obtained using the two-stage least squares method indicate that urban agglomeration has a significant impact on reducing carbon emission intensity. Specifically, for every standard deviation increase in the clustering indicators of population, freight transport, and passenger transport, the carbon emission intensity decreased by 0.257 %, 0.317 %, and 0.147 %, respectively. The carbon emission reduction effect of urban agglomeration varies considerably across resource- and nonresource-based cities as well as population-inflowing and -outflowing cities. We also discovered that urban agglomeration reduces carbon emission intensity by enhancing energy efficiency and fostering technological innovation. This study provides a fresh perspective on urban agglomeration and proposes a new pathway to achieve sustainable development goals, emphasizing the importance of accelerating factor mobility to form high-quality urban agglomeration.
records.abstract_cn: 发展中国家的城市化往往伴随着高碳排放，主要源于城市中大量的化石能源消耗。然而，仅有少数研究探讨了城市集聚中的人口集中和要素流动如何能够减少碳排放。利用要素流动的新视角，我们使用2004年至2022年间284个中国城市的面板数据集，深入研究了城市集聚对碳排放的影响。采用两阶段最小二乘法得到的结果表明，城市集聚对降低碳排放强度具有显著影响。具体而言，人口、货运和客运集聚指标每增加一个标准差，碳排放强度分别下降0.257%、0.317%和0.147%。城市集聚的碳减排效应在资源型与非资源型城市以及人口流入与流出城市之间存在显著差异。我们还发现，城市集聚通过提高能源效率和促进技术创新来降低碳排放强度。本研究为城市集聚提供了新视角，并提出了实现可持续发展目标的新路径，强调了加速要素流动以形成高质量城市集聚的重要性。

records.title_en: Fundamentals of carbon emissions scaling: Implications for sector peer comparisons and carbon efficient indexing
records.title_cn: 碳排放规模化的基础：对行业同行比较与碳效率指数化的启示
records.abstract_en: We show that carbon intensity metrics, used to assess emissions efficiency across firms, vary significantly depending on the financial metric used to scale emissions. This variation—driven by within-sector differences in profit margins, asset and labor utilization, and valuation multiples—results in substantial reshuffling of firms' carbon intensity rankings relative to their peers. At the market level, the choice of scaling variable shapes the composition of carbon-efficient indices, which overweight (underweight) firms with lower (higher) carbon intensity within each sector. While carbon-efficient indices deliver returns comparable to the standard market index, they differ in carbon footprints and transaction costs. Indices scaled by market cap or enterprise value achieve lower carbon footprints by overweighting lower-emitting firms with higher valuation multiples but exhibit higher turnover. These findings underscore the critical role of scaling variable selection in carbon efficiency comparisons and highlight a tradeoff between carbon savings and transaction costs for emissions-focused investors.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，用于评估企业排放效率的碳强度指标，根据用于规模化排放的财务指标不同而显著变化。这种变化——由行业内利润率、资产和劳动力利用率以及估值倍数的差异驱动——导致企业相对于同行的碳强度排名发生实质性重新洗牌。在市场层面，规模化变量的选择塑造了碳效率指数的构成，这些指数在行业内超配（低配）碳强度较低（较高）的企业。虽然碳效率指数提供的回报与标准市场指数相当，但它们在碳足迹和交易成本上有所不同。按市值或企业价值规模化的指数通过超配具有较高估值倍数的低排放企业来实现较低的碳足迹，但表现出更高的换手率。这些发现强调了规模化变量选择在碳效率比较中的关键作用，并突出了排放导向投资者在碳节约与交易成本之间的权衡。

records.title_en: Dynamic risk spillover in green financial markets: A wavelet frequency analysis from China
records.title_cn: 绿色金融市场的动态风险溢出：来自中国的 wavelet 频率分析
records.abstract_en: This paper focuses on China's green stock market, green bond market, carbon trading market, and crude oil futures market, using return data from 2018 to 2024. By combing a time-varying parameter vector autoregression model (TVP-VAR) with the Diebold-Yilmaz spillover index, the research investigates the dynamic risk spillover effects in the green financial markets. The empirical results reveal the following findings: (i) There is cyclical risk transmission across green financial markets, significantly influenced by major risk events such as the pandemic and extreme climate occurrences. (ii) The green stock market exhibits the strongest risk contagion within the green financial system, with a greater capacity for transmitting risk than receiving it. (iii) From a multiscale frequency perspective, risk contagion pathways differ notably. Weekly data show heightened sensitivity, while monthly and quarterly data provide a more robust representation of long-term systemic risk. (iv) In the short term, market sentiment significantly impacts the overall spillover effect of risk in green financial markets while the long-term effect of the fear sentiment is more significant. This research makes several contributions: it expands the cross-market view of risk contagion in green finance; introduces wavelet analysis to capture the multiscale dynamics of financial risk spillovers; and assesses the influence of market sentiment and fear sentiment on total risk spillovers in green financial markets. The findings are highly relevant for improving the structure of green financial markets, advancing regulatory innovation in green finance, and mitigating systemic financial risks.
records.abstract_cn: 本文聚焦于中国的绿色股票市场、绿色债券市场、碳交易市场和原油期货市场，使用从2018年到2024年的收益率数据。通过将时变参数向量自回归模型（TVP-VAR）与Diebold-Yilmaz溢出指数相结合，研究调查了绿色金融市场中的动态风险溢出效应。实证结果揭示了以下发现：（i）绿色金融市场之间存在周期性的风险传递，显著受到如疫情和极端气候事件等重大风险事件的影响。（ii）绿色股票市场在绿色金融体系中表现出最强的风险传染性，其传递风险的能力大于接收风险的能力。（iii）从多尺度频率的角度看，风险传染路径存在显著差异。周度数据显示出更高的敏感性，而月度和季度数据则更稳健地代表了长期系统性风险。（iv）在短期内，市场情绪显著影响绿色金融市场风险的整体溢出效应，而恐惧情绪的长期影响更为显著。本研究做出了多项贡献：扩展了绿色金融中风险传染的跨市场视角；引入小波分析以捕捉金融风险溢出的多尺度动态；并评估了市场情绪和恐惧情绪对绿色金融市场总风险溢出的影响。这些发现对于改善绿色金融市场的结构、推进绿色金融的监管创新以及缓解系统性金融风险具有高度相关性。

records.title_en: How do green supply chain management and renewable energy consumption influence carbon emissions in China and India? A comparative analysis
records.title_cn: 绿色供应链管理与可再生能源消费如何影响中国和印度的碳排放？一项比较分析
records.abstract_en: Green supply chain management involves integrating eco-friendly practices into supply chain operations to curb carbon emissions and promote sustainability. This study explores the impact of green supply chain management and renewable energy on carbon emissions while also considering financial development and foreign direct investment roles. It presents a comparative analysis of China and India using data from 1990 to 2022. Due to the data's non-stationarity, nonlinearity, and non-normal distribution, the study employs the Kernel Regularized Least Squares approach. The results show that rather than decreasing emissions, green supply chain management has contributed to increased emissions in both nations. Additionally, economic growth and renewable energy have led to higher emission levels in both countries. Financial development increases emissions in China, while no significant association is found for India. Based on these findings, the study suggests that policymakers in China and India should implement economic policies emphasizing strict ecological standards.
records.abstract_cn: 绿色供应链管理涉及将环保实践整合到供应链运营中，以遏制碳排放并促进可持续性。本研究探讨了绿色供应链管理和可再生能源对碳排放的影响，同时考虑了金融发展和外国直接投资的作用。利用1990年至2022年的数据，对中国和印度进行了比较分析。鉴于数据的非平稳性、非线性和非正态分布，研究采用了核正则化最小二乘法。结果表明，绿色供应链管理并未减少排放，反而导致了两国排放的增加。此外，经济增长和可再生能源也导致了两国排放水平的上升。金融发展增加了中国的排放，而在印度未发现显著关联。基于这些发现，研究建议中国和印度的政策制定者应实施强调严格生态标准的经济政策。

records.title_en: Conditional threshold effects of stock market volatility on crude oil market volatility
records.title_cn: 股票市场波动率对原油市场波动率的条件阈值效应
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we analyze conditional threshold effects of stock market volatility on crude oil market volatility. We use Conditional Threshold Autoregression (CoTAR), a novel extension of TAR from a constant threshold to a time-varying threshold. The conditional threshold is specified as an empirical quantile of recent realizations of a threshold variable. This specification is expected to match investors’ relative perception of financial risk. The target variable is monthly realized volatility (RV) measures of the West Texas Intermediate, and the threshold variable is monthly RV measures of the S&P 500 Index. Our rolling window out-of-sample analysis indicates that the predictive ability of CoTAR is at least on par with TAR for all cases considered, and significantly better than TAR for some cases. The superiority of CoTAR is pronounced when the target variable is a downside RV measure. This is a useful finding which helps market participants and policymakers better control downward risks.
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了股票市场波动率对原油市场波动率的条件阈值效应。我们使用条件阈值自回归（CoTAR），这是TAR从恒定阈值到时变阈值的一种新颖扩展。条件阈值被设定为阈值变量近期实现值的经验分位数。该设定预期与投资者对金融风险的相对感知相匹配。目标变量是西德克萨斯中质原油的月度已实现波动率（RV）度量，阈值变量是标普500指数的月度RV度量。我们的滚动窗口样本外分析表明，在所有考虑的情况下，CoTAR的预测能力至少与TAR相当，并且在某些情况下显著优于TAR。当目标变量为下行RV度量时，CoTAR的优越性尤为明显。这一发现有助于市场参与者和政策制定者更好地控制下行风险。

records.title_en: Does international coordinated industrial policy stimulate regional low-carbon aviation development? Evidence from CORSIA and the APEC developing economies
records.title_cn: 国际协调产业政策能否刺激区域低碳航空发展？来自 CORSIA 和 APEC 发展中经济体的证据
records.abstract_en: For Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) developing economies that are experiencing rapidly growing carbon emissions in the aviation industry, the effectiveness of their participation in an international coordination framework will be crucial for future decision-making and regional carbon reduction. Our paper investigates the effectiveness of participation in the Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation (CORSIA) framework on carbon emissions reduction in the aviation industries of APEC developing economies. Based on high-frequency daily panel data from the year 2017 to 2023, such effectiveness is examined through the difference in differences (DID) model and the time-varying DID model. Our baseline results show that CORSIA failed to reduce the aviation carbon emission by inducing reverse incentives among the APEC developing economies. Surprisingly, the pilot activities before officially joining in CORSIA are more effective in emission reduction. Mechanism analysis reveals that the insufficient green innovation in the aviation sector, subsidies for fossil fuels, and changes in airline circumstances are key mechanisms that effect this reverse incentive. Our period heterogeneity analysis suggests that the CORSIA mechanism exhibits short- and long-term ineffectiveness, while the emissions reduction effect is significant only in the medium term. Furthermore, country and airline level heterogeneity tests show that CORSIA exerts stronger reverse incentives in economies with higher per capita income, while higher carbon emissions and carbon capture and storage capabilities or more mature aviation industries can alleviate this reverse incentive. Our findings place valuable policy implications that balancing the development of the aviation innovation and industry, and reducing fossil fuel subsidies are expected to enhance the long-term effectiveness of the CORSIA mechanism.
records.abstract_cn: 对于航空业碳排放快速增长的亚太经合组织（APEC）发展中经济体来说，其参与国际协调框架的有效性对于未来决策和区域碳减排至关重要。我们的论文调查了参与国际航空碳抵消和减排计划 (CORSIA) 框架对 APEC 发展中经济体航空业碳减排的有效性。基于2017至2023年的高频每日面板数据，通过差异中的差异（DID）模型和时变DID模型检验了这种有效性。我们的基线结果表明，CORSIA 未能通过在 APEC 发展中经济体中诱导反向激励来减少航空碳排放。令人惊奇的是，正式加入CORSIA之前的试点活动在减排方面效果更为明显。机制分析表明，航空业绿色创新不足、化石燃料补贴以及航空公司环境变化是影响这种反向激励的关键机制。我们的周期异质性分析表明，CORSIA机制在短期和长期都表现出无效性，而减排效果仅在中期显着。此外，国家和航空公司层面的异质性测试表明，CORSIA对人均收入较高的经济体施加更强的反向激励，而较高的碳排放和碳捕获和存储能力或更成熟的航空业可以减轻这种反向激励。我们的研究结果具有宝贵的政策意义，平衡航空创新和产业的发展以及减少化石燃料补贴有望增强 CORSIA 机制的长期有效性。

records.title_en: Better green financial instrument: Government green fund and corporate new energy technology innovation
records.title_cn: 更优的绿色金融工具：政府绿色基金与企业新能源技术创新
records.abstract_en: Previous literature mostly discusses debt-based green financial instruments like green credit and green bond, ignoring the key role of the government green fund (GGF), an important equity-based financing tool, in promoting corporate new energy technology innovation (NETI). This study employs panel data from Chinese A-share listed companies from 2010 to 2022 to empirically examine the impact of GGF on NETI. The results indicate that, following the GGF investment, the number of patent applications for corporate new energy technology significantly increases, suggesting that the GGF can effectively promote corporate NETI. Mechanism analysis reveals that the GGF influences corporate NETI through two pathways: the transformation of external financing model and the allocation of internal R&D resources. Heterogeneity analysis shows that the incentive effect of GGF is more pronounced in corporations with lower institutional shareholding ratios and in regions with more abundant venture capital resources. Additionally, the GGF has achieved better outcomes in promoting NETI in fields such as solar energy, biomass energy, and smart grids. The findings of this study offer policy recommendations for government investment in scientific green investment and the advancement of China's green financial market.
records.abstract_cn: 以往文献多讨论债务型绿色金融工具如绿色信贷和绿色债券，忽视了政府绿色基金（GGF）这一重要的股权型融资工具在促进企业新能源技术创新（NETI）中的关键作用。本研究利用2010年至2022年中国A股上市公司的面板数据，实证检验了GGF对NETI的影响。结果表明，在GGF投资后，企业新能源技术专利申请数量显著增加，表明GGF能有效促进企业NETI。机制分析揭示，GGF通过两条路径影响企业NETI：外部融资模式的转变和内部研发资源的配置。异质性分析显示，在机构持股比例较低的企业和风险资本资源更丰富的地区，GGF的激励效应更为显著。此外，GGF在太阳能、生物质能和智能电网等领域促进NETI方面取得了更好的成效。本研究的发现为政府投资科学绿色投资以及推进中国绿色金融市场提供了政策建议。

records.title_en: The Environmental Kuznets Curve Revisited: A Spatial Panel Model with Heterogeneous Coefficients
records.title_cn: 环境库兹涅茨曲线再探：一个具有异质性系数的空间面板模型
records.abstract_en: This paper revisits the Environmental Kuznets Curve (EKC) hypothesis through the lens of spatial econometrics to analyse the relationship between income and emissions of CO, CO2, and CH4 in Swedish municipalities from 2015 to 2021. The study leverages recent developments in spatial econometric methods to relax the homogeneity assumption found in earlier EKC models. The analysis identifies an inverted U-shaped relationship between income and emissions across numerous municipalities: 182 for CO, 128 for CO2, and 158 for CH4 out of 285. The study highlights the importance of spatial econometric models in capturing nuanced income-emissions relationships and spatial spillover effects, often neglected in non-spatial models. Policy implications indicate that economic growth alone may not be enough to lower emissions in all municipalities, highlighting the need for targeted strategies that account for local economic and environmental conditions.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过空间计量经济学的视角重新审视环境库兹涅茨曲线（EKC）假说，分析2015年至2021年间瑞典各市收入与CO、CO2和CH4排放之间的关系。研究利用空间计量经济学方法的最新进展，放宽了早期EKC模型中的同质性假设。分析发现，在285个市中，许多市的收入与排放之间呈倒U型关系：CO有182个，CO2有128个，CH4有158个。研究强调了空间计量经济模型在捕捉细微的收入-排放关系和空间溢出效应方面的重要性，而这些在非空间模型中往往被忽视。政策含义表明，仅靠经济增长可能不足以降低所有市的排放，凸显了考虑当地经济和环境条件的针对性策略的必要性。

records.title_en: Cross-border cannibalization: Spillover effects of wind and solar energy on interconnected European electricity markets
records.title_cn: 跨境蚕食：风能和太阳能对互联欧洲电力市场的溢出效应
records.abstract_en: The average per-MWh revenue, or market value, of wind and solar energy tends to fall with increasing market share, as is now evident across European electricity markets. At the same time, these markets are becoming more interconnected. In this paper, we empirically study cross-border effects on the value of renewable energy: On one hand, interconnection is a flexibility resource that allows to export energy when it is locally abundant, benefitting renewables. On the other hand, wind and solar patterns are correlated between countries, so neighboring supply adds to the local one to depress domestic prices. We estimate both effects, using spatial panel regression on electricity market data from 2015 to 2023 from 30 European bidding zones. We find that domestic wind and solar value is not only depressed by domestic, but also by neighboring renewables expansion. The better interconnected a market is, the smaller the effect of domestic but the larger the effect of neighboring renewables. While wind value is stabilized by interconnection, the data suggest that solar value is not. These results can be used to estimate the impact of simultaneous domestic and neighboring capacity expansion: If wind market share increases both at home and in neighboring markets by one percentage point, the value factor of wind energy is reduced by just above 1 percentage point. For solar, this number is almost 4 percentage points.
records.abstract_cn: 风能和太阳能的平均每兆瓦时收入（即市场价值）往往随着市场份额的增加而下降，这在欧洲电力市场中现已显而易见。与此同时，这些市场正变得更加互联。在本文中，我们实证研究了跨境效应对可再生能源价值的影响：一方面，互联是一种灵活性资源，允许在本地能源丰富时出口能源，从而惠及可再生能源。另一方面，各国之间的风能和太阳能模式具有相关性，因此邻国的供应会叠加到本地供应上，压低国内价格。我们使用2015年至2023年30个欧洲竞价区域的空间面板回归估计了这两种效应。我们发现，国内风能和太阳能的价值不仅受到国内可再生能源扩张的抑制，也受到邻国可再生能源扩张的抑制。一个市场的互联程度越高，国内可再生能源的影响越小，而邻国可再生能源的影响越大。虽然风电价值通过互联得到稳定，但数据显示太阳能价值并未如此。这些结果可用于估计国内外同时扩张产能的影响：如果风电市场份额在国内和邻国市场均增加一个百分点，风电的价值因子将减少略高于1个百分点。对于太阳能，这一数字接近4个百分点。

records.title_en: The impact of geopolitical risks on the renewable energy transition
records.title_cn: 地缘政治风险对可再生能源转型的影响
records.abstract_en: Given the frequency of geopolitical events and the urgency of responding to climate change, it is essential to explore the impact of geopolitical risk (GPR) on renewable energy transition (RET). Based on panel data for 41 countries from 2000 to 2021, this paper analyzes the impact and mechanism of GPR on RET. The results show that an increase in GPR accelerates RET across countries, a conclusion that still holds after a series of robustness tests, such as instrumental variable regressions, the exclusion of the effects of other shocks, and replacing the explanatory and explained variables. Second, oil rent, openness, and technological innovation are the mechanisms by which GPR affects RET. Specifically, lower oil rents, lower levels of openness, and higher levels of technological innovation are the preconditions for GPR to drive RET. Finally, for different types of renewable energy, the effects produced by GPR are, in descending order, solar, biomass, and hydropower, but the effect of GPR on wind energy is not significant. In addition, the impact of GPR on RET is more pronounced in countries that are more ecologically disadvantaged and more dependent on foreign countries for energy. The findings show the relationship between GPR and RET and can help the government formulate policies related to renewable energy development.
records.abstract_cn: 鉴于地缘政治事件的频繁性以及应对气候变化的紧迫性，探讨地缘政治风险（GPR）对可再生能源转型（RET）的影响至关重要。基于2000年至2021年41个国家的面板数据，本文分析了GPR对RET的影响及其机制。结果表明，GPR的增加加速了各国的RET，这一结论在经过一系列稳健性检验后依然成立，包括工具变量回归、排除其他冲击的影响以及替换解释变量和被解释变量。其次，石油租金、开放程度和技术创新是GPR影响RET的机制。具体而言，较低的石油租金、较低的开放程度和较高的技术创新水平是GPR推动RET的前提条件。最后，对于不同类型的可再生能源，GPR产生的影响按降序排列为太阳能、生物质能和水力发电，但GPR对风能的影响不显著。此外，GPR对RET的影响在生态更为脆弱和对外能源依赖程度更高的国家中更为显著。研究结果揭示了GPR与RET之间的关系，有助于政府制定与可再生能源发展相关的政策。

records.title_en: Employer Screening and Optimal Unemployment Insurance
records.title_cn: 雇主筛选与最优失业保险
records.abstract_en: Field experiments show that employers are less likely to consider long-term unemployed job seekers for interviews. We study the implications for optimal unemployment insurance. Based on a structural model of job search and recruitment, estimated with German data, we analyse the optimal two-tier unemployment system. We find that screening makes the optimal initial benefit level 4 percentage points higher and the potential benefit duration seven months longer. Using an extended Baily–Chetty formula, we study the mechanisms through which screening affects the consumption smoothing gain and moral hazard cost of providing unemployment insurance and highlight the role of the externality from endogenous firm behaviour.
records.abstract_cn: 实地实验表明，雇主不太可能考虑长期失业的求职者进行面试。我们研究了这对最优失业保险的影响。基于一个用德国数据估计的求职与招聘结构模型，我们分析了最优的两级失业制度。我们发现，筛选使得最优初始福利水平高出4个百分点，潜在福利持续时间延长七个月。利用扩展的Baily-Chetty公式，我们研究了筛选通过何种机制影响提供失业保险的消费平滑收益和道德风险成本，并强调了内生企业行为外部性的作用。

records.title_en: Maternal Investments in Children: The Role of Expected Effort and Returns
records.title_cn: 母亲对子女的投资：预期努力与回报的作用
records.abstract_en: We investigate the importance of subjective expectations of returns to and effort costs of the two principal investments that mothers make in newborns: breastfeeding and stimulation. We find heterogeneity across mothers in rural Pakistan in expected effort costs and expected returns for outcomes in the cognitive, socio-emotional and health domains, and that this contributes to explaining heterogeneity in investments. We find no significant differences across women in preferences for child developmental outcomes. We simulate the impact of alternative policies on investments. Our findings highlight the relevance of interventions designed to address maternal depression and reduce perinatal fatigue alongside interventions that increase perceived returns to investments.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了母亲在新生儿身上进行的两种主要投资——母乳喂养和刺激——的预期回报和努力成本的主观预期的重要性。我们发现，在巴基斯坦农村地区，母亲们在认知、社会情感和健康领域的结果预期努力成本和预期回报方面存在异质性，并且这有助于解释投资中的异质性。我们发现女性在儿童发展结果的偏好上没有显著差异。我们模拟了替代政策对投资的影响。我们的发现强调了旨在解决母亲抑郁和减少围产期疲劳的干预措施，以及提高投资感知回报的干预措施的相关性。

records.title_en: The Road to Crime: An Unintended Consequence of the Interstate Highway System
records.title_cn: 通往犯罪之路：州际公路系统的一个意外后果
records.abstract_en: The necessity to overhaul national infrastructure has become one of the key issues of US domestic policy in recent years. While the benefits of infrastructure spending are often straightforward, its unintended consequences are less well understood. This paper studies the impact of transportation infrastructure on local crime, focusing on the construction of the Interstate Highway System, the largest public works project in US history. Using a staggered difference-in-differences design and a county-by-year panel dataset spanning all US counties between 1960 and 1993, we find that a highway opening in a county led to an 8% rise in total index crime. This effect is driven by property crime (burglary, larceny and motor vehicle theft), although some evidence suggests an increase in violent crime as well. Exploring potential mechanisms, we show that the positive effect of highways on crime is concentrated in counties with low pre-existing stock of police resources where increased connectivity may have raised the returns to crime. Moreover, we find that highway construction induced higher local employment, average firm size and the local population size, thus increasing the returns to criminal activity, and ultimately the risk of victimisation in the newly connected counties.
records.abstract_cn: 近年来， overhaul 国家基础设施的必要性已成为美国国内政策的关键问题之一。虽然基础设施支出的益处往往显而易见，但其意外后果却鲜为人知。本文研究了交通基础设施对地方犯罪的影响，重点关注美国历史上最大的公共工程项目——州际公路系统的建设。利用交错双重差分设计以及覆盖1960年至1993年间美国所有县级的县级年度面板数据集，我们发现，一个县内高速公路的开通导致总体指数犯罪率上升了8%。这一效应主要由财产犯罪（入室盗窃、盗窃和机动车盗窃）驱动，尽管也有部分证据表明暴力犯罪有所增加。在探索潜在机制时，我们表明，高速公路对犯罪的正面效应集中在警察资源存量较低的县，这些地区连通性的增强可能提高了犯罪的回报。此外，我们发现，高速公路建设带动了当地就业、平均企业规模和当地人口规模的增加，从而提高了犯罪活动的回报，并最终增加了新连通县居民受害的风险。

records.title_en: Unpacking Social Capital
records.title_cn: 解析社会资本
records.abstract_en: We use novel survey data from Italy to shed light on key questions regarding the measurement of social capital and the use of social capital indicators for empirical work. Our data cover a sample of over 600,000 respondents interviewed between 2000 and 2015. We identify four distinct components of social capital—(i) social participation, (ii) political participation, (iii) general trust and (iv) trust in institutions—and examine how they relate to each other. We then study how each dimension of social capital relates to various socio-economic factors, both at the individual and aggregate levels, and to various proxies of social capital commonly used in the literature. Finally, building on previous work, we investigate to what extent different dimensions of social capital predict differences in key economic, political and health outcomes. Our findings support the view that social capital is a multi-faceted object with multiple dimensions that, while related, are distinct from each other. Future work should take such multi-dimensionality into account and carefully consider what measure of social capital to use.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用来自意大利的新颖调查数据，就社会资本测量及社会资本指标在实证研究中的应用等关键问题进行了探讨。我们的数据涵盖了在2000年至2015年间受访的超过600,000名受访者样本。我们识别出社会资本的四个不同组成部分——(i)社会参与、(ii)政治参与、(iii)普遍信任及(iv)对机构的信任——并考察它们之间的相互关系。随后，我们研究了社会资本的每个维度如何与个人及总体层面的各种社会经济因素，以及文献中常用的各种社会资本代理指标相关联。最后，基于先前的研究，我们探讨了社会资本的不同维度在多大程度上预测了关键经济、政治和健康结果的差异。我们的发现支持了这样一种观点：社会资本是一个多层面的对象，具有多个维度，这些维度虽相互关联，但彼此又有所区别。未来的研究应考虑到这种多维性，并仔细斟酌应使用何种社会资本衡量指标。

records.title_en: Local exposure to refugees changed attitudes to ethnic minorities in the Netherlands
records.title_cn: 当地接触难民改变了荷兰人对少数民族的态度
records.abstract_en: We investigate the effect of exposure to refugees on locals’ preferences with regard to ethnic minorities using individual-level panel data from the Netherlands. The data combine self-reported preferences with administrative data on the residential locations of the locals and the refugees. The study period is marked by a sudden inflow of refugees in some neighbourhoods. We find that individuals living close to newly installed refugee facilities developed a more positive attitude towards ethnic minorities and became less supportive of anti-immigration parties compared to individuals living farther away. An investigation of mechanisms suggests that the local effect is due to contact between residents and refugees.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用荷兰的个体层面面板数据，研究接触难民对当地人对少数民族偏好的影响。数据将自我报告的偏好与关于当地人和难民居住地点的行政数据相结合。研究期间以某些社区突然涌入难民为特征。我们发现，与居住在较远地方的个体相比，居住在新建难民设施附近的个体对少数民族形成了更积极的态度，并且对反移民政党的支持度降低。对机制的研究表明，当地效应是由于居民与难民之间的接触所致。

records.title_en: Earnings Responses to Even Higher Taxes
records.title_cn: 对更高税收的收入反应
records.abstract_en: We exploit a recent Swedish tax reform, implying higher marginal tax rates for the top 5% of the earnings distribution, to learn about earnings responses to higher taxes. Using a simple and graphical cross-sectional method, we estimate an earnings elasticity of 0.16, evaluated four years after the reform. Our analysis indicates that the response is driven by adjustments in wage rates, and not by changes to hours, job switches or income shifting. We interpret the magnitude and preciseness of the response using a realistically calibrated simulation model in which people face uncertain marginal tax rates due to earnings dynamics.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用瑞典最近的一次税收改革，该改革对收入分布前5%的人群提高了边际税率，以了解收入对更高税收的反应。使用一种简单且图形化的横截面方法，我们估计了改革四年后的收入弹性为0.16。我们的分析表明，这种反应是由工资率的调整驱动的，而非工作时间的变化、工作转换或收入转移。我们使用一个现实校准的模拟模型来解释反应的幅度和精确性，在该模型中，人们因收入动态而面临不确定的边际税率。

records.title_en: Public Good Superstars: A Lab-in-the-Field Study of Wikipedia
records.title_cn: 公共物品巨星：维基百科的实地实验研究
records.abstract_en: Many field public goods are provided by a small number of contributors: the ‘superstars’ of their respective communities. This paper focuses on Wikipedia, one of the largest online volunteering platforms. Over nine consecutive years, we study the relationship between social preferences—reciprocity, altruism and social image—and field cooperation. Wikipedia editors are quite prosocial on average, and superstars even more so. But while reciprocal and social image preferences strongly relate to contribution quantity among casual editors, only social image concerns continue to predict differences in contribution levels between superstars. In addition, we find that social image–driven editors—both casual and superstars—contribute lower-quality content on average. Evidence points to a perverse social incentive effect, as quantity is more readily observable than quality on Wikipedia.
records.abstract_cn: 许多实地公共物品由少数贡献者提供：即各自社区中的“巨星”。本文聚焦于维基百科，这是最大的在线志愿平台之一。在连续九年的时间里，我们研究了社会偏好——互惠、利他和社会形象——与实地合作之间的关系。维基百科编辑平均而言相当亲社会，而巨星更是如此。但是，虽然互惠和社会形象偏好与普通编辑的贡献数量密切相关，但只有社会形象关注继续预测巨星之间贡献水平的差异。此外，我们发现，受社会形象驱动的编辑——无论是普通编辑还是巨星——平均贡献的内容质量较低。证据指向一种反常的社会激励效应，因为在维基百科上，数量比质量更容易被观察到。

records.title_en: Trade and Domestic Policies under Monopolistic Competition
records.title_cn: 垄断竞争下的贸易与国内政策
records.abstract_en: Should trade agreements constrain domestic policies? We analyse this question using a model with monopolistic competition and constant-elasticity-of-substitution demand. We develop a welfare decomposition to show that welfare changes induced by trade and domestic policies can be decomposed into consumption and production efficiencies and terms-of-trade effects. We analyse the reasons to sign trade agreements and compare shallow and deep trade agreements, modelled according to GATT-WTO rules. Under monopolistic competition, unlike deep trade agreements, shallow agreements with market access commitments may not achieve efficiency because terms of trade can be improved without reducing market access by increasing the set of foreign firms selling domestically.
records.abstract_cn: 贸易协议是否应约束国内政策？我们使用一个具有垄断竞争和不变替代弹性需求模型来分析这一问题。我们发展了一个福利分解，表明贸易和国内政策引起的福利变化可以分解为消费效率、生产效率以及贸易条件效应。我们分析了签署贸易协议的原因，并比较了根据GATT-WTO规则建模的浅层和深层贸易协议。在垄断竞争下，与深层贸易协议不同，具有市场准入承诺的浅层协议可能无法实现效率，因为可以通过增加在国内销售的外国企业集合来改善贸易条件，而不减少市场准入。

records.title_en: ‘They Never had a Chance’: Unequal Opportunities and Fair Redistributions
records.title_cn: “他们从未有过机会”：不平等机会与公平再分配
records.abstract_en: A meritocratic fairness ideal typically asserts that income inequality is justifiable if it arises from differences in performance rather than mere luck. In this study, we present experimental evidence that reveals how merit judgements are influenced by the sources of performance differentials, while holding fixed the underlying impact on incentives to perform. Drawing inspiration from real-world factors that create inequality, we investigate unequal opportunities in education and employment that impact performance. Contrary to some earlier findings suggesting that merit judgements are unaffected by unequal circumstances, our study demonstrates that individuals’ redistributive behaviour is responsive to both the nature and extent of these unequal opportunities. This research thus provides fresh insights into the nuanced factors that motivate people to endorse income redistribution.
records.abstract_cn: 精英主义的公平理想通常主张，如果收入不平等源于表现差异而非纯粹运气，则是合理的。在本研究中，我们提供了实验证据，揭示了在保持对表现激励的潜在影响不变的情况下， merit 判断如何受到表现差异来源的影响。借鉴现实世界中造成不平等的因素，我们调查了影响表现的教育和就业中的不平等机会。与早期一些认为 merit 判断不受不平等环境影响的发现相反，我们的研究表明，个体的再分配行为对这些不平等机会的性质和程度均有响应。因此，本研究为促使人们支持收入再分配的细微因素提供了新的见解。

records.title_en: Transitory Income Windfalls and Charitable Giving: Evidence from Norwegian Register Data, 1993–2021
records.title_cn: 暂时性收入意外之财与慈善捐赠：来自挪威登记数据的证据，1993-2021
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the impact of unearned, transitory income shocks on charitable giving using Norwegian administrative data. We exploit the random timing and size of lottery wins and our long time period (1993–2021) to estimate both short- and longer-term impacts. We find no meaningful effect of small windfalls. Yet, windfalls exceeding $10,000 induce a long-lasting increase in the likelihood to donate, the absolute level of donations and the share of annual income donated (conditional on donating). We show that this is consistent with individuals thinking of large transitory income shocks as a long-term addition to their annual income.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用挪威行政数据研究非劳动所得、暂时性收入冲击对慈善捐赠的影响。我们利用彩票中奖的随机时间和金额以及我们长期的时间跨度（1993-2021）来估计短期和长期影响。我们发现小额意外之财没有显著影响。然而，超过$10,000的意外之财会持久地增加捐赠的可能性、捐赠的绝对水平以及（在捐赠条件下）年收入中捐赠的比例。我们表明，这与个人将大额暂时性收入冲击视为其年收入的长期增加是一致的。

records.title_en: Entrepreneurial Reluctance: Talent and Firm Creation in China
records.title_cn: 创业回避：中国的才能与企业创建
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the correlation between cognitive ability and firm creation. Drawing on administrative college admission data and firm registration records in China, we investigate who had created firms by their mid-thirties. We find a clear pattern of entrepreneurial reluctance: given the same backgrounds, individuals with higher college entrance exam scores are less likely to create firms. Through an exploration of firm performance, alternative career trajectories and variations across regions, we propose an explanation: the ability represented by exam scores is useful across occupations, yet higher-scoring individuals are attracted to waged jobs, particularly those of the state sector.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了认知能力与企业创建之间的相关性。利用中国的行政大学录取数据和公司注册记录，我们调查了到三十多岁时谁创建了企业。我们发现了一个明显的创业回避模式：在相同背景下，高考成绩较高的个体创建企业的可能性较低。通过对企业绩效、替代职业轨迹和地区差异的探索，我们提出了一种解释：考试分数所代表的能力在各职业中都有用，但高分个体更倾向于受薪工作，尤其是国有部门的工作。

records.title_en: Malleability of Preferences for Honesty
records.title_cn: 诚实偏好的可塑性
records.abstract_en: Reporting private information is a key part of economic decision-making. A recent literature has found that many people have a preference for honest reporting, contrary to usual economic assumptions. In this paper, we investigate whether preferences for honesty are malleable and what determines them. We experimentally measure preferences for honesty in a sample of children. As our main result, we provide causal evidence on the effect of the social environment by randomly enrolling children in a year-long mentoring programme. We find that, about four years after the end of the programme, mentored children are significantly more honest.
records.abstract_cn: 报告私人信息是经济决策的关键部分。近期的文献发现，与通常的经济学假设相反，许多人有诚实报告的偏好。在本文中，我们研究了诚实偏好是否具有可塑性及其决定因素。我们在儿童样本中通过实验测量了诚实偏好。作为主要结果，我们通过随机将儿童纳入为期一年的辅导项目，提供了社会环境影响的因果证据。我们发现，在项目结束约四年后，接受辅导的儿童显著更加诚实。

records.title_en: Acceptance of Inequality Between Children: Large-Scale Experimental Evidence from China and Norway
records.title_cn: 儿童间不平等的接受度：来自中国和挪威的大规模实验证据
records.abstract_en: In a novel large-scale experiment, we study how adults in two societies, Shanghai (China) and Norway, make real distributive decisions involving children. We find that acceptance of inequality between children increases with the ages of the children, is affected by the source of inequality and the cost of redistribution, and is lower than acceptance of inequality between adults. We document a large cross-societal difference in inequality acceptance: adults in Shanghai implement twice as much inequality between children compared with adults in Norway. Finally, we show that the willingness to accept inequality between children is predictive of attitudes to child policies.
records.abstract_cn: 在一项新颖的大规模实验中，我们研究了两个社会——上海（中国）和挪威——的成年人如何做出涉及儿童的真实的分配决策。我们发现，对儿童间不平等的接受度随儿童年龄的增长而增加，受到不平等来源和再分配成本的影响，并且低于对成人间不平等的接受度。我们记录了在跨社会差异上的显著差异：上海的成年人实施的儿童间不平等程度是挪威成年人的两倍。最后，我们表明，接受儿童间不平等的意愿可以预测对儿童政策的态度。

records.title_en: Finance and Green Growth: A Comment on De Haas and Popov (2023)
records.title_cn: 金融与绿色增长：对De Haas和Popov（2023）的评论
records.abstract_en: De Haas and Popov (2023) used a forty-eight-country, sixteen-industry and twenty-six-year panel to test how the size and structure of a country’s financial sector affect CO|$_2$| emissions. This comment revisits the results by correcting two coding errors: failing to cluster the SEs and improperly implementing the generalised method of moments (GMM) estimator. Robust SEs are only significant at 10%, while the magnitudes of the GMM results are reduced by a factor of 2 to 4.1 There are inconsistencies between how SEs are calculated in the scripts provided by De Haas and Popov (2023), and how they are described in the main text. For their country panel, the authors stated that the SEs are clustered at the country level. However, in their script, the authors either only adjusted the SEs to account for heteroscedasticity or did not make any SE adjustments. The SEs in Table A1 in Appendix A are clustered at the country level for the first four columns, and account for heteroscedasticity for the GMM estimator. Compared to the results in Table 2 of De Haas and Popov (2023), the precision of the coefficients of interest is reduced. The results are now either statistically insignificant or only significant at the 10% level.
records.abstract_cn: De Haas和Popov（2023）使用了四十八个国家、十六个行业和二十六年的面板数据，来检验一个国家金融部门的规模和结构如何影响CO2排放。本评论通过纠正两个编码错误来重新审视其结果：未能对标准误进行聚类，以及不正确地实施广义矩估计（GMM）估计方法。稳健标准误仅在10%水平上显著，而GMM结果的幅度缩小了2到4.1倍。在De Haas和Popov（2023）提供的脚本中，标准误的计算方式与其正文中的描述存在不一致之处。对于其国家面板，作者声称标准误在国家层面聚类。然而，在其脚本中，作者要么只对异方差性进行了标准误调整，要么根本没有进行标准误调整。附录A中表A1的标准误在前四列按国家层面聚类，并对GMM估计器考虑了异方差性。与De Haas和Popov（2023）表二的结果相比，感兴趣系数的精度有所下降。结果现在要么在统计上不显著，要么仅在10%水平上显著。

records.title_en: A Reply to Listo, Saberian and Thivierge (2023)
records.title_cn: 对 Listo、Saberian 和 Thivierge 的回复 (2023)
records.abstract_en: We thank Ariel Listo, Soodeh Saberian and Vincent Thivierge for their careful replication of De Haas and Popov (2023)–using the replication data, code and instructions that we made available at the time of publication and after the usual checks by the Journal's data editor. Here we provide our response to the issues that Listo et al. (2023) bring up. ‘For their country panel, the authors mention in the text that they cluster their standard errors at the country level. However, in their script they either only adjusted their standard errors to account for heteroskedasticity or did not make standard error adjustments.’ This refers to page 642 of the published article where, when introducing the exploratory country-level regression framework, we wrote ‘We cluster the standard errors by country’. At the same time, we wrote in the notes to Table 2 (page 648 of the published article) that the reported SEs in this table are heteroscedasticity robust (as far as the non-generalized method of moments (GMM) results are concerned). While the latter is accurate, the text on page 642 is not. This is an unfortunate and inadvertent oversight, which results from tables being updated during the review process without us fully bringing the related text in line. We should have checked the consistency between the text and the table notes more carefully. Having said that, while definitely regrettable, we believe that the implications of this inconsistency are limited for two reasons. First, the main takeaway from Table 2 is robust to clustering the SEs at the country level. Also, when we include China (see Section 5 below), the point estimate on ‘Equity Share’ has a p-value of .10 in the OLS specification and of .06 in the IV specification. When correctly specifying the GMM model (see Section 2 below), the p-value in this GMM specification is .11.1 Second, we always presented the evidence in Table 2 as suggestive and as a first exploratory step in the data analysis. As we wrote on page 650, ‘[...] we consider these country-level regressions mainly as a first exploratory step in our analysis [...]’. Regarding the GMM case, the answer lies in the claim in the next paragraph of Listo et al. (2023):
records.abstract_cn: 我们感谢 Ariel Listo、Soodeh Saberian 和 Vincent Thivierge 仔细复制了 De Haas 和 Popov (2023)——使用了我们在出版时提供的复制数据、代码和说明，并经过了期刊数据编辑的常规检查。在这里，我们对 Listo 等人提出的问题做出回应。 (2023) 提出。 “对于他们的国家小组，作者在文本中提到他们将标准误差集中在国家层面。然而，在他们的脚本中，他们要么只调整标准误差以考虑异方差性，要么没有进行标准误差调整。”这是指已发表文章的第642页，在介绍探索性国家级回归框架时，我们写道“我们按国家对标准误差进行聚类”。同时，我们在表二（已发表文章的第648页）的注释中写道，该表中报告的SE是异方差稳健的（就非广义矩方法（GMM）结果而言）。虽然后者是准确的，但页面 642 上的文本却不准确。这是一个不幸且无意的疏忽，这是由于我们在审核过程中更新了表格而没有完全使相关文本保持一致所致。我们应该更仔细地检查文本和表注之间的一致性。话虽如此，虽然确实令人遗憾，但我们认为这种不一致的影响是有限的，原因有两个。首先，表 2 的主要结论对于在国家层面对社会企业进行聚类是稳健的。此外，当我们包括中国时（参见下面的 5 节），“股权份额”的点估计在 OLS 规范中的 p 值为 .10，在 IV 规范中为 .06。当正确指定 GMM 模型时（请参阅下面的第 2 节），此 GMM 规范中的 p 值为 .11.1 其次，我们始终将表 2 中的证据作为提示和数据分析中的第一个探索性步骤提供。正如我们在650页上所写，“[...]我们认为这些国家层面的回归主要是我们分析中的第一步探索性步骤[...]”。关于GMM案，答案就在Listo等人下一段的主张中。 （2023）：

records.title_en: Cap‐and‐Trade and Carbon Tax Meet Arrow–Debreu
records.title_cn: 总量控制与交易和碳税相遇 Arrow-Debreu
records.abstract_en: We propose two general equilibrium models, quota equilibrium, and emission tax equilibrium. Government specifies quotas or taxes on emissions, and then refrains from further action. All results remain valid regardless of how government chooses its emissions target. Quota equilibrium exists; the allocation of emission property rights impacts the distribution of welfare. If the only externality arises from total net emissions, quota equilibrium is Pareto optimal among all feasible outcomes with the same total net emissions. For certain tax rates, emission tax equilibrium may not exist. Every quota equilibrium can be realized as an emission tax equilibrium and vice versa. However, different quota prices may arise in equilibrium from a single quota, and different emission levels may arise in equilibrium from a single tax rate. This leads to inequivalence between quota and emission tax equilibria.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出二一般均衡模型、配额均衡和排放税均衡。政府规定排放配额或征税，然后避免采取进一步行动。无论政府如何选择排放目标，所有结果仍然有效。存在配额平衡；排放权的分配影响福利的分配。如果唯一的外部性来自总净排放量，则配额均衡在具有相同总净排放量的所有可行结果中是帕累托最优。对于某些税率，排放税均衡可能不存在。每个配额均衡都可以作为排放税均衡来实现，反之亦然。然而，在单一配额的均衡中可能会产生不同的配额价格，在单一税率的均衡中可能会产生不同的排放水平。这导致配额和排放税平衡之间的不平等。

records.title_en: Choices and Outcomes in Assignment Mechanisms: The Allocation of Deceased Donor Kidneys
records.title_cn: 分配机制的选择和结果：死者捐肾的分配
records.abstract_en: While the mechanism design paradigm emphasizes notions of efficiency based on agent preferences, policymakers often focus on alternative objectives. School districts emphasize educational achievement, and transplantation communities focus on patient survival. It is unclear whether choice‐based mechanisms perform well when assessed based on these outcomes. This paper evaluates the assignment mechanism for allocating deceased donor kidneys on the basis of patient life‐years from transplantation (LYFT). We examine the role of choice in increasing LYFT and compare realized assignments to benchmarks that remove choice. Our model combines choices and outcomes in order to study how selection affects LYFT. We show how to identify and estimate the model using instruments derived from the mechanism. The estimates suggest that the design in use selects patients with better post‐transplant survival prospects and matches them well, resulting in an average LYFT of 9.29, which is 1.75 years more than a random assignment. However, the maximum aggregate LYFT is 14.08. Realizing the majority of the gains requires transplanting relatively healthy patients, who would have longer life expectancies even without a transplant. Therefore, a policymaker faces a dilemma between transplanting patients who are sicker and those for whom life will be extended the longest.
records.abstract_cn: 虽然机制设计范式强调基于代理人偏好的效率概念，但政策制定者通常关注替代目标。学区强调教育成就，移植社区则关注患者的生存。目前尚不清楚基于选择的机制在根据这些结果进行评估时是否表现良好。本文评估了根据患者移植生命年（LYFT）分配已故供体肾脏的分配机制。我们研究了选择在增加 Lyft 中的作用，并将已实现的任务与消除选择的基准进行比较。我们的模型结合了选择和结果，以研究选择如何影响 Lyft。我们展示了如何使用从该机制派生的工具来识别和估计模型。估计表明，使用的设计选择了移植后生存前景较好的患者，并将其很好地匹配，导致平均 LYFT 为 9.29，比随机分配多 1.75 年。然而，最大总 LYFT 为 14.08。实现大部分成果需要移植相对健康的患者，即使不进行移植，他们的预期寿命也会更长。因此，政策制定者在移植病情较重的患者和那些能够延长生命的患者之间面临着两难境地。

records.title_en: People Are More Moral in Uncertain Environments
records.title_cn: 人们在不确定的环境中更加道德
records.abstract_en: We conduct a series of experiments and document a robust behavioral pattern whereby people behave more morally in uncertain environments than degenerate deterministic ones. We show that this pattern is weakened when the moral implication of behavior is diminished or when uncertainty pertains to others rather than oneself. These findings are incompatible with standard models that respect dominance. We propose a mechanism based on the anxiety aspect of uncertain environments whereby people act morally as if their moral behavior can help deliver a better outcome. We further delve into the complexity aspect of uncertainty to arrive at a more comprehensive understanding of these findings.
