records.abstract_cn: 我们进行了一系列实验并记录了一种稳健的行为模式，在这种模式下，人们在不确定的环境中比在退化的确定性环境中表现得更加道德。我们表明，当行为的道德含义减弱或不确定性涉及他人而不是自己时，这种模式就会减弱。这些发现与尊重主导地位的标准模型不相容。我们提出了一种基于不确定环境的焦虑方面的机制，人们在这种机制中采取道德行为，就好像他们的道德行为可以帮助实现更好的结果一样。我们进一步深入研究不确定性的复杂性，以便对这些发现有更全面的理解。

records.title_en: Estimating Candidate Valence
records.title_cn: 估计候选价
records.abstract_en: We estimate valence measures of candidates running in U.S. House elections from data on vote shares. Our identification and estimation strategy builds on ideas developed for estimating production functions, allowing us to control for possible endogeneity of campaign spending and sample selection of candidates due to endogenous entry. We find that incumbents have substantially higher valence measures than challengers running against them, resulting in about 3.5 percentage‐point differences in the vote share, on average. Eliminating differences in the valence of challengers and incumbents results in an increase in the winning probability of a challenger from 6.5% to 12.1%. Our measure of candidate valence can be used to study various substantive questions of political economy. We illustrate its usefulness by studying the source of incumbency advantage in U.S. House elections.
records.abstract_cn: 我们根据投票份额数据估算参加美国众议院选举的候选人的效价指标。我们的识别和估计策略建立在为估计生产函数而开发的想法之上，使我们能够控制竞选支出和由于内生进入而导致的候选人样本选择的可能内生性。我们发现，现任者的效价衡量指标远高于与他们竞争的挑战者，导致平均投票份额存在约 3.5 个百分点的差异。消除挑战者和现任者效价的差异会导致挑战者的获胜概率从 6.5% 增加到 12.1%。我们对候选人效价的衡量可以用来研究政治经济学的各种实质性问题。我们通过研究美国众议院选举中现任优势的来源来说明其有用性。

records.title_en: The Impact of Incarceration on Employment, Earnings, and Tax Filing
records.title_cn: 监禁对就业、收入和纳税的影响
records.abstract_en: We study the effect of incarceration on wages, self‐employment, and taxes and transfers in North Carolina and Ohio using two quasi‐experimental research designs: discontinuities in sentencing guidelines and random assignment to judges. Across both states, incarceration generates short‐term drops in economic activity while individuals remain in prison. As a result, a year‐long sentence decreases cumulative earnings over five years by 13%. Beyond five years, however, there is no evidence of lower employment, wage earnings, or self‐employment in either state, as well as among defendants with no prior incarceration history. These results suggest that upstream factors, such as other types of criminal justice interactions or pre‐existing labor market detachment, are more likely to be the cause of low earnings among the previously incarcerated, who we estimate would earn just $5000 per year on average if spared a prison sentence.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用二准实验研究设计：量刑指南的不连续性和法官的随机分配，研究了北卡罗来纳州和俄亥俄州监禁对工资、自营职业、税收和转移的影响。在这两个州，监禁会导致经济活动短期下降，而个人仍被监禁。因此，长达一年的刑期会使 五 年的累积收入减少 13%。然而，在五年之后，没有证据表明这两个州以及没有任何监禁历史的被告的就业、工资收入或自营职业较低。这些结果表明，上游因素，例如其他类型的刑事司法互动或先前存在的劳动力市场脱离，更有可能是先前被监禁者收入低的原因，我们估计，如果免于监禁，他们平均每年只能赚取5000美元。

records.title_en: Double Robust Bayesian Inference on Average Treatment Effects
records.title_cn: 对平均治疗效果的双重稳健贝叶斯推理
records.abstract_en: We propose a double robust Bayesian inference procedure on the average treatment effect (ATE) under unconfoundedness. For our new Bayesian approach, we first adjust the prior distributions of the conditional mean functions, and then correct the posterior distribution of the resulting ATE. Both adjustments make use of pilot estimators motivated by the semiparametric influence function for ATE estimation. We prove asymptotic equivalence of our Bayesian procedure and efficient frequentist ATE estimators by establishing a new semiparametric Bernstein–von Mises theorem under double robustness; that is, the lack of smoothness of conditional mean functions can be compensated by high regularity of the propensity score and vice versa. Consequently, the resulting Bayesian credible sets form confidence intervals with asymptotically exact coverage probability. In simulations, our method provides precise point estimates of the ATE through the posterior mean and delivers credible intervals that closely align with the nominal coverage probability. Furthermore, our approach achieves a shorter interval length in comparison to existing methods. We illustrate our method in an application to the National Supported Work Demonstration following LaLonde (1986) and Dehejia and Wahba (1999).
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种关于无混杂因素下平均治疗效果（ATE）的双稳健贝叶斯推理程序。对于我们的新贝叶斯方法，我们第一调整条件均值函数的先验分布，然后纠正所得 ATE 的后验分布。这两种调整都利用了由 ATE 估计的半参数影响函数驱动的导频估计器。我们通过在双重鲁棒性下建立新的半参数 Bernstein-von Mises 定理，证明了贝叶斯过程和高效频率主义 ATE 估计器的渐近等价性；也就是说，条件均值函数缺乏平滑性可以通过倾向得分的高度规律性来补偿，反之亦然。因此，所得的贝叶斯可信集形成具有渐近精确覆盖概率的置信区间。在模拟中，我们的方法通过后验平均值提供 ATE 的精确点估计，并提供与标称覆盖概率紧密一致的可信区间。此外，与现有方法相比，我们的方法实现了更短的间隔长度。我们在 LaLonde（1986）以及 Dehejia 和 Wahba（1999）之后的国家支持工作示范中应用了我们的方法。

records.title_en: On (Constrained) Efficiency of Strategy‐Proof Random Assignment
records.title_cn: 关于策略证明随机分配的（受限）效率
records.abstract_en: We study random assignment of indivisible objects among a set of agents, when each agent is to receive one object and has strict preferences over the objects. Random Serial Dictatorship (RSD) satisfies equal treatment of equals, ex post efficiency, and strategy‐proofness. Answering a longstanding open question, we show that RSD is not characterized by those properties—there are other mechanisms satisfying equal treatment of equals, ex post efficiency, and strategy‐proofness which are not welfare‐equivalent to RSD. On the other hand, we show that RSD is not Pareto dominated by any mechanism that is (i) strategy‐proof and (ii) boundedly invariant. Moreover, the same holds for all mechanisms that are ex post efficient, strategy‐proof, and boundedly invariant: no such mechanism is dominated by any other mechanism that is strategy‐proof and boundedly invariant.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究当每个智能体要接收 一 对象并且对对象有严格偏好时，在一组智能体之间随机分配不可分割的对象。随机串行独裁（RSD）满足平等对待、事后效率和策略验证性。在回答一个长期悬而未决的问题时，我们表明 RSD 并不具有这些属性——还有其他满足平等对待、事后效率和策略证明性的机制，这些机制与 RSD 并不等同于福利。另一方面，我们证明 RSD 不被任何 (i) 策略证明和 (ii) 有界不变的机制所支配。此外，这同样适用于所有事后有效、策略证明和有限不变的机制：没有这样的机制被任何其他策略证明和有限不变的机制所支配。

records.title_en: Feedback Design in Dynamic Moral Hazard
records.title_cn: 动态道德风险中的反馈设计
records.abstract_en: We study the joint design of dynamic incentives and performance feedback for an environment with a coarse (all‐or‐nothing) measure of performance, and show that hiding information from the agent can be an optimal way to motivate effort. Using a novel approach to incentive compatibility, we derive a two‐phase solution that begins with a “silent phase” where the agent is given no feedback and is asked to work non‐stop, and ends with a “full‐transparency phase” where the agent stops working as soon as a performance threshold is met. Hiding information leads to greater effort, but an ignorant agent is also more expensive to motivate. The two‐phase solution—where the agent's ignorance is fully frontloaded—stems from a “backward compounding effect” that raises the cost of hiding information as time passes.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在具有粗略（全有或全无）绩效衡量的环境中动态激励和绩效反馈的联合设计，并表明向代理隐藏信息可能是激励努力的最佳方式。使用一种新颖的激励相容方法，我们得出了一个二阶段解决方案，该解决方案以“静默阶段”开始，在该阶段中，代理没有得到任何反馈，并被要求不间断地工作，并以“完全透明阶段”结束，在该阶段中，一旦达到性能阈值，代理就会停止工作。隐藏信息会带来更大的努力，但激励无知的代理人的成本也更高。 二阶段的解决方案——智能体的无知被完全前置——源于“向后复合效应”，随着时间的推移，隐藏信息的成本会增加。

records.title_en: A Quest for Knowledge
records.title_cn: 对知识的探索
records.abstract_en: Is more novel research always desirable? We develop a model in which knowledge shapes society's policies and guides the search for discoveries. Researchers select a question and how intensely to study it. The novelty of a question determines both the value and difficulty of discovering its answer. We show that the benefits of discoveries are nonmonotone in novelty. Knowledge expands endogenously step‐by‐step over time. Through a dynamic externality, moonshots—research on questions more novel than what is myopically optimal—can improve the evolution of knowledge. Moonshots induce research cycles in which subsequent researchers connect the moonshot to previous knowledge.
records.abstract_cn: 更多新颖的研究总是可取的吗？我们开发了一个模型，让知识塑造社会政策并指导对发现的探索。研究人员选择一个问题以及研究它的强度。问题的新颖性决定了发现其答案的价值和难度。我们表明，发现的好处在新颖性方面是非单调的。随着时间的推移，知识会逐步内生扩展。通过动态的外部性，登月计划（对比短视最优问题更新颖的问题进行研究）可以改善知识的进化。登月计划引发了研究周期，随后的研究人员将登月计划与之前的知识联系起来。

records.title_en: Comparative Statics With Adjustment Costs and the Le Chatelier Principle
records.title_cn: 具有调整成本的比较静态分析和勒夏特列原理
records.abstract_en: We develop a theory of monotone comparative statics for models with adjustment costs. We show that comparative‐statics conclusions may be drawn under the usual ordinal complementarity assumptions on the objective function, assuming very little about costs: only a mild monotonicity condition is required. We use this insight to prove a general Le Chatelier principle: under the ordinal complementarity assumptions, if short‐run adjustment is subject to a monotone cost, then the long‐run response to a shock is greater than the short‐run response. We extend these results to a fully dynamic model of adjustment over time: the Le Chatelier principle remains valid, and under slightly stronger assumptions, optimal adjustment follows a monotone path. We apply our results to models of saving, production, pricing, labor supply, and investment.
records.abstract_cn: 我们为具有调整成本的模型开发了单调比较静态理论。我们表明，比较静态的结论可以在目标函数的通常序数互补假设下得出，对成本的假设很少：只需要温和的单调性条件。我们利用这一见解来证明一般的勒夏特列原理：在序数互补假设下，如果短期调整受到单调成本的影响，那么对冲击的长期反应大于短期反应。我们将这些结果扩展到随时间变化的完全动态调整模型：勒夏特列原理仍然有效，并且在稍强的假设下，最优调整遵循单调路径。我们将研究结果应用于储蓄、生产、定价、劳动力供应和投资模型。

records.title_en: Uniform Priors for Impulse Responses
records.title_cn: 脉冲响应的统一先验
records.abstract_en: There has been a call for caution regarding the standard procedure for Bayesian inference in set‐identified structural vector autoregressions on the grounds that the common practice of using a uniform prior over the set of orthogonal matrices induces a non‐uniform prior for individual impulse responses or other quantities of interest. This paper challenges this call by formally showing that when the focus is on joint inference, the uniform prior over the set of orthogonal matrices is not only sufficient but also necessary for inference based on a uniform joint prior distribution over the identified set for the vector of impulse responses. In addition, we show how to conduct inference based on a uniform joint prior distribution for the vector of impulse responses.
records.abstract_cn: 有人呼吁谨慎对待集合识别的结构向量自回归中贝叶斯推理的标准程序，因为在正交矩阵集上使用均匀先验的常见做法会导致个体脉冲响应或其他感兴趣的量产生非均匀先验。本文对这一呼吁提出了挑战，正式表明，当重点是联合推理时，正交矩阵集上的均匀先验不仅足够，而且对于基于脉冲响应向量的已识别集合上的均匀联合先验分布的推理来说也是必要的。此外，我们还展示了如何基于脉冲响应向量的均匀联合先验分布进行推理。

records.title_en: A Comment on: “Autoregressive Conditional Duration: A New Model for Irregularly Spaced Transaction Data”
records.title_cn: 对“自回归条件持续时间：不规则间隔交易数据的新模型”的评论
records.abstract_en: Based on the GARCH literature, Engle and Russell (1998) established consistency and asymptotic normality of the QMLE for the autoregressive conditional duration (ACD) model, assuming strict stationarity and ergodicity of the durations. Using novel arguments based on renewal process theory, we show that their results hold under the stronger requirement that durations have finite expectation. However, we demonstrate that this is not always the case under the assumption of stationary and ergodic durations. Specifically, we provide a counterexample where the MLE is asymptotically mixed normal and converges at a rate significantly slower than usual. The main difference between ACD and GARCH asymptotics is that the former must account for the number of durations in a given time span being random. As a by‐product, we present a new lemma which can be applied to analyze asymptotic properties of extremum estimators when the number of observations is random.
records.abstract_cn: 基于 GARCH 文献，Engle 和 Russell (1998) 为自回归条件久期 (ACD) 模型建立了 QMLE 的一致性和渐近正态性，并假设久期的严格平稳性和遍历性。使用基于更新过程理论的新颖论点，我们表明他们的结果在持续时间具有有限期望的更强要求下成立。然而，我们证明，在平稳和遍历持续时间的假设下，情况并非总是如此。具体来说，我们提供了一个反例，其中 MLE 是渐近混合正态的，并且收敛速度明显慢于平常。 ACD 和 GARCH 渐进之间的主要区别在于，前者必须考虑给定时间跨度内随机的持续时间数量。作为副产品，我们提出了一个新的引理，可用于分析观测数量随机时极值估计量的渐近性质。

records.title_en: Seeking or ignoring ethical certifications in consumer choice
records.title_cn: 消费者选择中寻求或忽视道德认证
records.abstract_en: Consumers often encounter, and claim to care about, ethical information concerning the products they purchase. Across three studies, we investigate how the accessibility of this information impacts choice. When consumers must seek out product attribute information, the impact of ethical certifications (Fairtrade and Organic) is diminished relative to other attributes. Both positive and negative framing of certifications increase their impact on choice relative to neutral frames, with negative frames having the strongest effect. However, in contrast to theories of information demand that would predict more willful ignorance of negatively framed content, negative framing has the same impact regardless of information accessibility. Together, our findings suggest that having to seek ethical certification information leads to a small reduction in the use of certifications to guide choice, but that affective framing has a larger impact on the weight placed on certifications in consumer choices regardless of the accessibility of information.
records.abstract_cn: 消费者经常遇到并声称关心他们所购买产品的道德信息。在三项研究中，我们调查了这些信息的可获取性如何影响选择。当消费者必须主动寻找产品属性信息时，道德认证（公平贸易和有机）的影响相对于其他属性有所减弱。与中性框架相比，正面和负面的认证框架都增加了其对选择的影响，其中负面框架的效果最强。然而，与信息需求理论预测的负面框架内容会被更多故意忽视相反，负面框架的影响不因信息可获取性而异。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，必须寻求道德认证信息会导致认证在指导选择中的使用略有减少，但情感框架对消费者选择中认证权重的更大影响，无论信息可获取性如何。

records.title_en: Biotechnology or bioeconomy: Six of one and half a dozen of the other?
records.title_cn: 生物技术还是生物经济：半斤八两？
records.abstract_en: Different views and definitions pertain to the concept of bioeconomy. Few propose a workable definition enabling scholars and decision makers to identify analyze and manage the bioeconomy. Two technological delineations based on patent IPC codes delimitate a bioeconomy based on biotechnology inventions or based on a broader set of technologies. The two definitions are applied to two samples of firms, one with biotech firms and one with biorefineries that are considered by scholars as core to the bioeconomy. The relevance of these definitions for identifying the innovation practices of bioeconomy companies and reporting on their development of sustainable activities is assessed.
records.abstract_cn: 关于生物经济的概念存在不同的观点和定义。很少有人提出一个可行的定义，使学者和决策者能够识别、分析和管理生物经济。基于专利IPC代码的两种技术划分，界定了一种基于生物技术发明的生物经济，或基于更广泛技术集合的生物经济。这两种定义被应用于两个企业样本，一个包含生物技术公司，另一个包含生物精炼厂，这些企业被学者视为生物经济的核心。评估了这些定义在识别生物经济公司创新实践及其可持续发展活动报告方面的相关性。

records.title_en: Water markets and water rebounds: China's water rights trading policy
records.title_cn: 水市场与水回弹：中国水权交易政策
records.abstract_en: Water markets aim to achieve water conservation and efficient allocation through market transactions. However, the presence of water rebounds may counteract this effect. Water markets and water rebounds have a complex interaction that has not been adequately explored in current studies. This study fills this research gap by developing an analytical framework connecting water markets and water rebounds and scrutinizing the causal linkage between them and the potential mechanisms involved within the context of China's water rights trading (WRT) policy. The findings have the potential to significantly impact water management strategies. We argue that water markets and water rebound mitigation—which is frequently linked with the capacity of water markets to improve water quality—are causally related. Furthermore, deploying water markets may also slow technological progress, resulting in reduced water efficiency and hence, an indirect mitigation of water rebounds. Lastly, the impact of water markets on water rebounds varies according to water availability and socioeconomic levels.
records.abstract_cn: 水市场旨在通过市场交易实现节水与高效配置。然而，水回弹的存在可能抵消这一效果。水市场与水回弹之间存在复杂的相互作用，而当前研究对此尚未充分探讨。本研究通过构建一个连接水市场与水回弹的分析框架，并审视它们之间的因果联系及潜在机制，在中国水权交易（WRT）政策的背景下填补了这一研究空白。研究结果有可能对水管理策略产生重大影响。我们认为，水市场与水回弹缓解——这通常与水市场改善水质的能力相关联——之间存在因果关系。此外，部署水市场也可能减缓技术进步，导致水效率降低，从而间接缓解水回弹。最后，水市场对水回弹的影响因水资源可用性和社会经济发展水平而异。

records.title_en: Do voluntary sustainability standards improve socioeconomic and ecological outcomes? Evidence from Ghana's cocoa sector
records.title_cn: 自愿性可持续标准能否改善社会经济和生态结果？来自加纳可可部门的证据
records.abstract_en: Voluntary sustainability standards offer potential for sustainable development by improving the livelihoods of smallholder farmers while conserving biodiversity. However, their overall implications remain poorly understood, as studies have mostly focused on assessing their effects on single sustainability dimensions. Here, we use an interdisciplinary approach to understand the simultaneous effects of sustainability standards (e.g. Fairtrade, Rainforest Alliance, Cocoa Life) on socioeconomic and ecological outcomes in Ghana's cocoa sector. Our study is based on a rich dataset comprising household data from 814 smallholder cocoa-producing households from five major cocoa regions and ecological data from 119 cocoa plots. Results from the endogenous switching regression approach suggest that sustainability standards have positive effects on socioeconomic outcomes such as cocoa yield, net cocoa income and returns to land. However, using generalized linear mixed effects models, we do not find any significant associations with ecological outcomes related to vegetation structure and animal diversity. Our results indicate that sustainability standards in Ghana's cocoa sector lead to socioeconomic benefits but not to ecological benefits for the plot environment. Nevertheless, yield increases do not come at the expense of biodiversity. We conclude that sustainability standards have the potential to improve socioeconomic outcomes, without significantly creating trade-offs with ecological outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 自愿性可持续标准通过改善小农户的生计同时保护生物多样性，为可持续发展提供了潜力。然而，其总体影响仍知之甚少，因为研究大多集中在评估其对单一可持续性维度的影响。在此，我们采用跨学科方法，以理解可持续标准（如公平贸易、雨林联盟、可可生命）对加纳可可部门社会经济和生态结果的同步影响。我们的研究基于一个丰富的数据集，包括来自五个主要可可产区的814个小农户可可生产家庭的家庭数据和来自119个可可地块的生态数据。内生转换回归方法的结果表明，可持续标准对可可产量、净可可收入和土地回报等社会经济结果具有积极影响。然而，使用广义线性混合效应模型，我们未发现与植被结构和动物多样性相关的生态结果有任何显著关联。我们的结果表明，加纳可可部门的可持续标准带来了社会经济利益，但对地块环境没有生态利益。尽管如此，产量增加并不以牺牲生物多样性为代价。我们得出结论，可持续标准有潜力改善社会经济结果，而不会显著与生态结果产生权衡。

records.title_en: Can improving climate change perception lead to more environmentally friendly choices? Evidence from an immersive virtual environment experiment
records.title_cn: 改善气候变化感知能否带来更环保的选择？来自沉浸式虚拟环境实验的证据
records.abstract_en: Rational decision theory assumes that individuals have perfect knowledge of the consequences of their choices and actions. However, this assumption often fails to align with reality, particularly in the context of environmental degradation, where the impacts of actions can be distant in both time and space. Will an enhanced perception of those impacts encourage pro-environmental choices?
records.abstract_cn: 理性决策理论假设个体对其选择和行动的后果拥有完全的知识。然而，这一假设往往与现实不符，特别是在环境退化背景下，行动的影响可能在时间和空间上都很遥远。增强对这些影响的感知是否会促进环保选择？

records.title_en: Climate change: What do we do about it? Economic issues regarding agricultural adaptation and mitigation
records.title_cn: 气候变化：我们该如何应对？关于农业适应与减缓的经济问题
records.abstract_en: Climate change will undoubtedly affect many aspects of the agricultural sector as a driver of impacts, as a force stimulating adaptation to limit or exploit climate change impacts, and as a focal point for mitigation opportunities to reduce its extent. Sectoral participants will react by undertaking a variety of adaptation and mitigation actions. Adaptation is largely inevitable but may require public action to either provide public goods or support private adaptation. Agriculture will also play an important role in mitigating climate change, as in cases it can provide low‐cost net greenhouse gas reductions. This paper will discuss the economic and physical characteristics of adaptation and mitigation actions that can be taken in the agricultural sector plus introduce some analysis results and possible directions. Clearly, across these areas, economists will find rich areas for economic inquiry.
records.abstract_cn: 气候变化无疑将影响农业部门的许多方面，既是影响的驱动因素，也是刺激适应以限制或利用气候变化影响的力量，同时还是减少其程度的减缓机会的焦点。部门参与者将通过采取各种适应和减缓行动来应对。适应在很大程度上是不可避免的，但可能需要公共行动来提供公共物品或支持私人适应。农业在减缓气候变化方面也将发挥重要作用，因为在某些情况下，它可以提供低成本的净温室气体减排。本文将讨论农业部门可采取的适应和减缓行动的经济和物理特征，并介绍一些分析结果和可能的方向。显然，在这些领域，经济学家将找到丰富的经济研究领域。

records.title_en: The capitalization of property rights to groundwater
records.title_cn: 地下水产权的资本化
records.abstract_en: There is limited empirical evidence on the value of formal property rights to natural resources when they are not transferable, and there is regulatory uncertainty about enforcement. This paper takes a hedonic approach to understanding how three core features of groundwater property rights—access, allocation, and seniority—are capitalized into agricultural land values in the High Plains Aquifer region of Kansas. We find that groundwater access rights confer an average land value premium of 71%, or $1445/acre in 2019 dollars. Water rights having larger allocations and more seniority are more highly valued in the land market. The seniority effect is small but is consistent with more junior rights facing greater regulatory risk of curtailment. Taken together, these results suggest that the land market capitalizes constraints to groundwater pumping provided by groundwater property rights. We use our empirical estimates to quantify the distributional costs of modifying existing patterns of pumping, a common challenge of groundwater management organizations seeking to improve the sustainability of extraction.
records.abstract_cn: 关于不可转让的自然资源正式产权价值，以及监管执行存在不确定性的情况下，实证证据有限。本文采用特征价格方法，理解地下水产权的三个核心特征——获取权、分配量和优先权——如何资本化到堪萨斯州高平原含水层地区的农业土地价值中。我们发现，地下水获取权赋予土地平均价值溢价为71%，即2019年美元计价的$1445/英亩。拥有更大分配量和更高优先权的水权在土地市场中价值更高。优先权效应虽小，但与较新的权利面临更大的削减监管风险一致。综合来看，这些结果表明土地市场将地下水产权对抽水施加的限制资本化。我们利用实证估计来量化修改现有抽水模式的分配成本，这是寻求提高开采可持续性的地下水管理组织面临的常见挑战。

records.title_en: Structural transformation without industrialization? Evidence from Tanzanian consumers
records.title_cn: 无工业化的结构转型？来自坦桑尼亚消费者的证据
records.abstract_en: Export‐oriented industrialization was central to many Asian countries' structural transformation processes, but many African countries are bypassing industrialization, and the prospects for competing in global manufacturing markets are poor. Alternative structural transformation pathways all rely on domestic markets, and thus understanding their trajectories requires uncovering consumer preferences. Using detailed household expenditures data from a nationally representative panel survey in Tanzania, I estimate a flexible, stylized consumer demand system. I recover estimates of expenditure elasticities of demand for goods, services, and food in the aggregate, along with price elasticities of demand, identified using within‐household variation in prices and expenditures. I find that, across the expenditures distribution and in both rural and urban areas, consumer preferences are service facing. In particular, I show that (1) consumers sharply increase spending on services relative to goods and food as incomes increase; (2) demand for services in the aggregate is somewhat sensitive to changes in service prices; and (3) food, goods, and services are substitutes for each other. On one hand, a high propensity to consume the types of services that generate large local economic growth multipliers is consistent with driving growth in service sector employment. However, sustained growth in the long run may be limited because these services are low productivity and nontradable, and domestic markets are size constrained.
records.abstract_cn: 出口导向型工业化曾是许多亚洲国家结构转型过程的核心，但许多非洲国家正在绕过工业化，且在全球制造业市场竞争的前景不佳。替代性的结构转型路径都依赖于国内市场，因此理解其轨迹需要揭示消费者偏好。利用坦桑尼亚一项具有全国代表性的面板调查中的详细家庭支出数据，我估计了一个灵活、风格化的消费者需求系统。我恢复了商品、服务和食品在总体上的需求支出弹性估计，以及需求价格弹性，这些弹性通过家庭内部价格和支出的变动来识别。我发现，在支出分布的两端以及农村和城市地区，消费者偏好都倾向于服务。具体而言，我表明（1）随着收入增加，消费者相对于商品和食品大幅增加服务支出；（2）总体上对服务的需求对服务价格的变化有一定敏感性；以及（3）食品、商品和服务彼此互为替代品。一方面，高消费倾向倾向于消费那些能产生较大地方经济增长乘数的服务类型，这与推动服务业就业增长相一致。然而，长期持续增长可能受限，因为这些服务生产率低且不可贸易，且国内市场规模受限。

records.title_en: Integration of the US cannabis market
records.title_cn: 美国大麻市场的一体化
records.abstract_en: I examine the degree to which markets for cannabis are integrated using semiparametric models of spatial price linkages among US states. US attitudes toward the use of cannabis have evolved and, at the same time, laws restricting its use have been eliminated in many states. Cannabis presents the case of a unique commodity for which any interstate trade is explicitly illegal. A voluminous empirical literature has examined spatial arbitrage, trade, and market integration. Most of these studies utilize linear time series regression models. More recent work has considered increasingly more nonlinear models of market integration. I utilize fully nonlinear semiparametric generalized additive models to evaluate the spatial integration of US cannabis markets. The results confirm important nonlinearities in price relationships. Nonlinear price transmission elasticities are derived from the nonparametric modeling results. The results suggest that California cannabis markets are largely integrated with states across the nation. I find that California, which is a leading cannabis exporter, plays a price leadership role. Production of cannabis in California far exceeds the amount that can be legally grown and sold, and much of this cannabis is exported to other states. Colorado, a second primary cannabis market, generally operates in isolation from cannabis markets in other states. The likely mechanism integrating cannabis markets is the thriving trade in illegal cannabis, which has long preceded recent state‐level legislative actions that have legalized cannabis use.
records.abstract_cn: 我使用半参数模型研究美国各州之间大麻市场的空间价格联系，以考察市场一体化程度。美国对大麻使用的态度已经演变，同时，许多州取消了限制其使用的法律。大麻是一种特殊商品，任何州际贸易都明确非法。大量实证文献研究了空间套利、贸易和市场一体化。这些研究大多使用线性时间序列回归模型。最近的研究越来越多地考虑市场一体化的非线性模型。我使用完全非线性的半参数广义加性模型来评估美国大麻市场的空间一体化。结果证实了价格关系中存在重要的非线性。从非参数建模结果中推导出非线性价格传递弹性。结果表明，加利福尼亚州的大麻市场在很大程度上与全国各州一体化。我发现，作为主要大麻出口州的加利福尼亚州扮演着价格领导者的角色。加利福尼亚州的大麻产量远远超过合法种植和销售的数量，其中大部分大麻出口到其他州。科罗拉多州作为第二个主要大麻市场，通常与其他州的大麻市场隔离。整合大麻市场的可能机制是非法大麻的繁荣贸易，这远早于最近各州立法行动将大麻使用合法化。

records.title_en: Farm‐saved seed, royalty rates, and innovation in plant breeding
records.title_cn: 农户留种、特许权使用费率与植物育种创新
records.abstract_en: Seed innovation is one major factor for improving agricultural productivity. For some self‐pollinated varieties, such as wheat, farmers have the option to buy certified seed from seed dealers or to use their own farm‐saved seed. Historically, farmers could use farm‐saved seeds for free, which led to reduced incentives to innovate for private breeding companies. In recent decades, several countries have established different royalty systems for farm‐saved seeds to favor research investment. We developed a theoretical model to compare these different systems. We compared six stylized systems by analyzing their impact on incentives to innovate, as well as production efficiencies at both the seed and agricultural production levels. Our findings indicate that royalty systems allowing for a certain proportion of farm‐saved seeds result in improved welfare. The systems that lead to the highest total welfare levels are those in which the royalty level on farm‐saved seeds is regulated. This includes systems where the royalty is either directly defined by a regulator (as in the French or UK systems) or imposed to match the royalty level of the certified seeds (as in the Australian system). The Australian system performs better under high research costs. Conversely, under low research costs, the best system is either the French or the UK system, depending on the relative cost of producing farm‐saved seeds versus certified seeds. In conclusion, it is possible to design efficient royalty systems to create and produce innovation, in a context where farmers can self‐produce this innovation.
records.abstract_cn: 种子创新是提高农业生产力的主要因素之一。对于某些自花授粉品种，如小麦，农民可以选择从种子经销商处购买认证种子，或使用自家留种的种子。历史上，农民可以免费使用留种，这导致私营育种公司的创新激励降低。近几十年来，一些国家建立了不同的留种特许权使用费制度以促进研究投资。我们开发了一个理论模型来比较这些不同的制度。我们通过分析六种典型制度对创新激励以及种子和农业生产层面的生产效率的影响，对其进行了比较。我们的研究结果表明，允许一定比例留种的特许权使用费制度能够改善福利。导致总福利水平最高的制度是那些对留种特许权使用费率进行监管的制度。这包括特许权使用费由监管机构直接定义（如法国或英国制度）或强制与认证种子特许权使用费率相匹配（如澳大利亚制度）的制度。澳大利亚制度在高研究成本下表现更好。相反，在低研究成本下，最佳制度是法国或英国制度，具体取决于生产留种与认证种子的相对成本。总之，在农民可以自行生产这种创新的背景下，设计有效的特许权使用费制度以创造和生产创新是可能的。

records.title_en: External costs of water pollution in the drinking water supply sector
records.title_cn: 饮用水供应部门水污染的外部成本
records.abstract_en: Nitrate pollution from agricultural production is a major threat to water resources worldwide. This study quantifies the consequences of groundwater nitrate pollution for the drinking water supply sector by estimating the effect of groundwater nitrate pollution on the costs of water utilities. In doing so, we contribute to the estimation of the external costs of agricultural nonpoint pollution associated with drinking water supply. Empirical evidence is based on fixed effects regressions using large panel data sets on water supply companies and groundwater sampling sites in Germany. Local nitrate pollution at the abstraction plant is approximated using spatial interpolation. Our findings reveal that water suppliers incur substantial costs through groundwater nitrate pollution in terms of increased treatment and total costs. The estimated cost elasticities range from 0.048 to 0.052 for treatment costs and up to 0.019 for total costs. For an average firm, these estimates imply annual increases in treatment and total costs of €39,000 and €116,000, respectively, for a 10 milligrams per liter increase in groundwater nitrate concentrations.
records.abstract_cn: 农业生产中的硝酸盐污染是对全球水资源的主要威胁。本研究通过估算地下水硝酸盐污染对水务公司成本的影响，量化了地下水硝酸盐污染对饮用水供应部门的后果。为此，我们为估算与饮用水供应相关的农业非点源污染的外部成本做出了贡献。实证证据基于固定效应回归，使用了关于德国供水公司和地下水采样点的大型面板数据集。取水厂当地的硝酸盐污染通过空间插值法近似得出。我们的研究结果表明，供水商因地下水硝酸盐污染而承担了可观的成本，表现为处理成本和总成本的增加。估计的成本弹性范围在处理成本方面为0.048至0.052，在总成本方面高达0.019。对于一家平均规模的企业，这些估计意味着地下水硝酸盐浓度每增加10毫克/升，年处理成本和总成本分别增加€39,000和€116,000。

records.title_en: Double cropping as an adaptation to climate change in the United States
records.title_cn: 美国作为气候变化适应的双季种植
records.abstract_en: A warming climate expands the frost‐free season, plausibly allowing for increased cropping intensity in temperate regions. This paper assesses the potential of multiple cropping to offset the projected negative effects of climate change on agricultural yields in the United States. We use cross‐sectional variation in observed land cover, soil characteristics, and climate to estimate farmers' propensity to double‐crop winter wheat with soybeans. Our estimates imply that under current economic conditions, a 3°C warming would result in an increase of 2.1 percentage points in the share of current soybean area double cropped, primarily driven by expansions in cooler regions. A fixed‐effects panel model of county yields further indicates that yields of double‐cropped soybeans are about 12% lower than those of single‐cropped soybeans. Accounting for changes in cropping intensity and attendant effects on soybean yields, we project that at current prices, a 3°C warming would induce a shift in cropping intensity that increases revenue from soy systems by 1.3% overall, offsetting only a small fraction of the revenue impacts of predicted yield declines.
records.abstract_cn: 气候变暖延长了无霜期，似乎允许温带地区增加种植强度。本文评估了多季种植抵消气候变化对美国农业产量预期负面影响的潜力。我们利用观测到的土地覆盖、土壤特征和气候的横截面变异来估计农民对冬小麦与大豆双季种植的倾向。我们的估计表明，在当前经济条件下，升温3°C将导致当前大豆面积中双季种植的比例增加2.1个百分点，主要受较凉爽地区扩张的驱动。县级产量的固定效应面板模型进一步表明，双季大豆的产量比单季大豆低约12%。考虑到种植强度的变化及其对大豆产量的伴随影响，我们预测在当前价格下，升温3°C将引起种植强度的转变，使大豆系统的收入总体增加1.3%，仅抵消了预期产量下降对收入影响的一小部分。

records.title_en: Cost misperception and voting for public goods
records.title_cn: 成本误感知与公共品投票
records.abstract_en: Public good provision is often determined through referendums by voters, who weigh benefits against costs. However, perceptions of benefits and costs may be incorrect, which could in turn lead to voter error and misallocation of public goods. Using real‐world referendums, we evaluate voter perceptions of the private costs of providing public goods by conducting three exit polls of New England voters and an online survey of California voters. By comparing cost perceptions to actual tax incidence, we find pervasive evidence that voters misperceive costs. Fewer than 20% of voters in our samples reported perceived costs within 25% of estimated actual costs. These findings are unsurprising given the ubiquity of opaque language explaining the financial consequences of public good referendums. In addition, our analysis suggests that actual costs have no statistical bearing on voter choice, but at least in the New England sample, voter approval is affected by perceived costs. Thus, a substantial proportion of voters are making decisions based in part on inaccurate costs, which in some cases lead to people voting against their preferences and potential misallocation of public funds. Further, researchers who match voter approval with estimated actual cost are unlikely to obtain accurate cost responsiveness or valuation estimates.
records.abstract_cn: 公共品供给通常通过选民投票决定，选民会权衡收益与成本。然而，对收益和成本的感知可能是错误的，这进而可能导致选民错误和公共品配置不当。利用现实世界中的公投，我们通过对新英格兰选民进行三次出口民调和加州选民进行在线调查，评估了选民对提供公共品的私人成本的感知。通过将成本感知与实际税收负担进行比较，我们发现了选民普遍误感知成本的证据。在我们的样本中，只有不到20%的选民报告的成本感知在估计实际成本的25%以内。鉴于解释公共品公投财务后果的语言普遍不透明，这些发现并不令人意外。此外，我们的分析表明，实际成本对选民选择没有统计上的影响，但至少在新英格兰样本中，选民批准受到感知成本的影响。因此，相当比例的选民在做出决策时部分基于不准确的成本，这在某些情况下导致人们投票违背自身偏好以及公共资金的潜在配置不当。进一步地，将选民批准与估计实际成本相匹配的研究人员不太可能获得准确的成本响应性或估值估计。

records.title_en: Evaluating the impact of the fourth round of China's poverty alleviation program
records.title_cn: 评估中国第四轮扶贫计划的影响
records.abstract_en: This study evaluates the impact of China's fourth round of the poverty alleviation program, which targeted 14 contiguous destitute areas containing 680 counties and a population of 240 million. From 2012 to 2019, China allocated a total of 813.6 billion yuan (US$126.1 billion), primarily to economic development programs within these 14 areas. Using county‐level data from 2006 to 2019, our difference‐in‐differences and difference‐in‐discontinuities estimates suggest that the program increased GDP per capita in the 14 areas by over 45% from 2012 to 2019, with substantial gains observed in both the agricultural and nonagricultural sectors. Our preferred estimates suggest that the rate of return to the program ranged from 155.8% to 165.8%. Using data from over 14,500 rural households from 2006 to 2015, we find that the program significantly elevated rural income and reduced rural poverty. Although the income growth of extremely poor households was driven more by agricultural income growth, the income growth of relatively poor households primarily resulted from nonagricultural sources.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究评估了中国第四轮扶贫计划的影响，该计划针对14个连片特困地区，涵盖680个县和240百万人口。从2012年到2019年，中国共投入813.6亿元人民币（约合126.1亿美元），主要用于这些14个地区的经济发展项目。利用2006年至2019年的县级数据，我们的双重差分和断点差分估计表明，该计划使14个地区的人均GDP在2012年至2019年间增长了超过45%，农业和非农业部门均取得了显著增长。我们的首选估计显示，该计划的回报率在155.8%至165.8%之间。利用2006年至2015年超过14,500户农村家庭的数据，我们发现该计划显著提高了农村收入并减少了农村贫困。尽管极端贫困家庭的收入增长更多由农业收入增长驱动，但相对贫困家庭的收入增长主要来源于非农业部门。

records.title_en: Pesticide regulatory heterogeneity, foreign sourcing, and global agricultural value chains
records.title_cn: 农药监管异质性、国外采购与全球农业价值链
records.abstract_en: Regulations on the production and consumption of goods are very heterogeneous across countries. Whereas the effects of regulations on exports are well known, the responses of importers to heterogeneous and frequently changing country‐specific regulations are not well understood. We combine Swiss firm‐level import customs transaction data with country‐product‐year‐specific maximum residue limits to investigate the effect of pesticide regulatory heterogeneity on firm‐level imports and assess the moderating role of firm size and global value chain participation. Relying on a global sourcing model, we find that regulatory heterogeneity reduces imports but less so in larger and diversified firms. Participating in global value chains also improves firms' flexibility toward heterogeneous regulation. Business diversification—although reducing the gains from trade and scale—could help firms cope with heterogeneous international regulations.
records.abstract_cn: 各国对商品生产和消费的监管存在很大异质性。尽管监管对出口的影响已广为人知，但进口商对异质且频繁变化的国家特定监管的反应尚未得到充分理解。我们将瑞士企业层面的进口海关交易数据与特定国家-产品-年份的最大残留限量相结合，研究农药监管异质性对企业层面进口的影响，并评估企业规模和全球价值链参与的调节作用。基于全球采购模型，我们发现监管异质性减少了进口，但在规模较大且多元化的企业中影响较小。参与全球价值链也提高了企业对异质性监管的灵活性。业务多元化——尽管减少了贸易和规模收益——可能有助于企业应对异质的国际监管。

records.title_en: Farmers as prosumers: Evidence from cadmium‐contaminated rice in China
records.title_cn: 农民作为产消者：来自中国镉污染大米的证据
records.abstract_en: We study farmer responses in rice production and consumption to China's cadmium‐contaminated rice (CCR) event in 2013. We show that the CCR event reduced both rice production and consumption but did not significantly affect the quantity and price of rice sold by farmers in areas affected by cadmium pollution. Households with young children reduced their rice production and consumption by a larger amount than others, whereas the responses are reversed for households with elderly people. The decrease in rice production was mainly driven by the decrease in farmers' consumption of self‐produced rice instead of through price or income channels, indicating that farmers are prosumers who make production decisions not purely to maximize profit but also to satisfy their own consumption needs. Farmers being prosumers helped promote production side responses to new information about food safety.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了农民对2013年中国镉污染大米事件的生产和消费反应。我们表明，镉污染大米事件减少了水稻生产和消费，但并未显著影响镉污染地区农民出售水稻的数量和价格。有幼儿的家庭减少的水稻生产和消费量大于其他家庭，而有老年人的家庭的反应则相反。水稻生产的减少主要是由于农民对自产大米消费的减少，而非通过价格或收入渠道，这表明农民是产消者，其生产决策并非纯粹为了利润最大化，也为了满足自身的消费需求。农民作为产消者有助于促进对食品安全新信息的生产侧反应。

records.title_en: Short‐run subsidies and long‐run willingness to pay: Learning and anchoring in an agricultural experiment in Ethiopia
records.title_cn: 短期补贴与长期支付意愿：埃塞俄比亚农业实验中的学习与锚定效应
records.abstract_en: We study how temporary provision of an agricultural innovation at zero cost affects long‐run demand for that innovation. Our experimental design enables us to distinguish between an “anchoring effect” of subsidies and a “learning effect.” We document large and persistent anchoring and learning effects. For the innovation that we consider, an integrated pest management (IPM) package for Ethiopian smallholder farmers, the learning effect dominates the anchoring effect, so temporary subsidized provision promotes long‐run technology diffusion.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了以零成本临时提供农业创新如何影响对该创新的长期需求。我们的实验设计使我们能够区分补贴的“锚定效应”和“学习效应”。我们记录了显著且持久的锚定效应和学习效应。对于我们考虑的创新，即针对埃塞俄比亚小农的综合害虫管理（IPM）套餐，学习效应主导了锚定效应，因此临时补贴提供促进了长期技术扩散。

records.title_en: Geographical indications and welfare: Evidence from US wine demand
records.title_cn: 地理标志与福利：来自美国葡萄酒需求的证据
records.abstract_en: A systematic component of wine quality is believed to depend on the geoclimatic factors of its production conditions. This belief has long motivated the development of geographical indications for wines. American viticulture areas (AVAs) represent the most common geographic identifier firms use to differentiate their products in the United States. In this paper we contribute new empirical evidence on the effectiveness and impact of GIs by studying consumers' valuation of US wine appellations within a structural model of wine demand. The model is rooted in the discrete‐choice framework, under the basic premise that observable information concerning wine attributes is credible and key to consumers' choices. Specifically, we develop a two‐level, nested‐logit model featuring many wine products and characteristics—including wine type, brands, and varietals, in addition to geographic origin. The model is estimated using NielsenIQ Consumer Panel data over the 2007–2019 period. We find that US consumers place a relatively high value on wines' geographic origins, distinct from the value of brand and varietal information, as documented by their marginal willingness to pay estimates. Furthermore, a counterfactual experiment shows significant welfare impacts from information about the geographic origin of wines. Over the period of interest, the welfare gain attributable to US geographic origin designation is estimated at about $5.37 billion, with wine producers and retailers capturing ~78% of this surplus. Virtually all consumer welfare gains are due to product differentiation and increased product variety enabled by information about the wine's origin.
records.abstract_cn: 葡萄酒质量的系统性组成部分被认为依赖于其生产条件的地理气候因素。这一信念长期以来推动了葡萄酒地理标志的发展。美国葡萄栽培区域（AVAs）是美国企业用来区分其产品的最常见的地理标识。在本文中，我们通过研究消费者在葡萄酒需求结构模型中对美国葡萄酒产区的估值，为地理标志的有效性和影响提供了新的实证证据。该模型基于离散选择框架，基本前提是有关葡萄酒属性的可观察信息是可信的，并且对消费者的选择至关重要。具体来说，我们开发了一个两级嵌套logit模型，涵盖了许多葡萄酒产品和特征——包括葡萄酒类型、品牌和品种，以及地理来源。该模型使用NielsenIQ消费者面板数据在2007-2019年期间进行估计。我们发现，美国消费者对葡萄酒的地理来源赋予相对较高的价值，这与品牌和品种信息的价值不同，正如他们的边际支付意愿估计所记录的那样。此外，一个反事实实验显示，关于葡萄酒地理来源的信息对福利有显著影响。在关注期间，归因于美国地理来源指定的福利收益估计约为5.37亿美元，其中葡萄酒生产商和零售商获取了约78%的剩余。几乎所有消费者福利收益都归因于产品差异化和由葡萄酒来源信息带来的产品种类增加。

records.title_en: Weather shocks affect trade policy: Evidence from preferential trade agreements
records.title_cn: 天气冲击影响贸易政策：来自优惠贸易协定的证据
records.abstract_en: We show that weather shocks affect government trade policy decisions. We exploit variation in rainfall during the growing season within and across countries to show that weather shocks impact agricultural output and trade. Using information on tariff cuts by commodity from preferential trade agreements signed between 1995 and 2014, we then show that weather shocks that happen during the negotiation period correlate strongly with the size of tariff cuts. When weather shocks increase (decrease) a country's capacity to produce a given crop, its government negotiates a smaller (larger) tariff cut. These results are consistent with a political economy trade model with sector‐specific inputs in which the government places more weight on producers relative to consumers in its objective function. They also reveal that governments update their beliefs about domestic agricultural production capacity in response to weather shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明天气冲击影响政府贸易政策决策。我们利用生长季节内和国家间降雨量的变化来显示天气冲击影响农业产出和贸易。利用1995年至2014年间签署的优惠贸易协定中按商品划分的关税削减信息，我们进一步表明，谈判期间发生的天气冲击与关税削减幅度密切相关。当天气冲击增加（减少）一个国家生产特定作物的能力时，其政府谈判的关税削减幅度较小（较大）。这些结果与一个具有部门特定投入的政治经济贸易模型一致，在该模型中，政府在其目标函数中对生产者的权重高于消费者。它们还揭示，政府会根据天气冲击更新其对国内农业生产能力的信念。

records.title_en: Surviving Bad News: Health Information without Treatment Options
records.title_cn: 在坏消息中生存：无治疗选项的健康信息
records.abstract_en: When there is no treatment available for a life-threatening disease, providing personal health information could lead to despair or fatalistic behaviors resulting in negative health outcomes. We document this possibility utilizing an experiment in Malawi that randomized incentives to learn HIV testing results in a context where antiretroviral treatment was not yet available. Six years after the experiment, among HIV-positive individuals, those who learned their status were 23 percentage points less likely to survive than those who did not, with effects persisting after 15 years. Receiving an HIV-positive diagnosis resulted in riskier health behaviors, greater anxiety, and higher discount rates. (JEL D83, D91, I12, I18, O12)
records.abstract_cn: 当一种危及生命的疾病没有可用的治疗方法时，提供个人健康信息可能导致绝望或宿命论行为，从而产生负面健康结果。我们利用马拉维的一项实验记录了这种可能性，该实验在抗逆转录病毒治疗尚不可用的背景下，随机分配了了解HIV检测结果的激励措施。实验六年后，在HIV阳性个体中，那些了解自己状况的人比未了解的人存活可能性低23个百分点，这种影响在15年后仍然持续。接受HIV阳性诊断导致了更冒险的健康行为、更高的焦虑和更高的贴现率。(JEL D83, D91, I12, I18, O12)

records.title_en: When Big Data Enables Behavioral Manipulation
records.title_cn: 当大数据实现行为操纵时
records.abstract_en: We build a model of online behavioral manipulation driven by AI advances. A platform dynamically offers one of n products to a user who slowly learns product quality. User learning depends on a product’s “glossiness,” which captures attributes that make products appear more attractive than they are. AI tools enable platforms to learn glossiness and engage in behavioral manipulation. We establish that AI benefits consumers when glossiness is short-lived. In contrast, when glossiness is long-lived, behavioral manipulation reduces user welfare. Finally, as the number of products increases, the platform can intensify behavioral manipulation by presenting more low-quality, glossy products. (JEL C55, D83, D91, L86)
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个由人工智能进步驱动的在线行为操纵模型。平台动态地向一个缓慢学习产品质量的用户提供n种产品之一。用户学习取决于产品的“光泽度”，这捕捉了使产品看起来比实际更具吸引力的属性。人工智能工具使平台能够学习光泽度并进行行为操纵。我们确定，当光泽度短暂存在时，人工智能对消费者有利。相反，当光泽度长期存在时，行为操纵会降低用户福利。最后，随着产品数量的增加，平台可以通过提供更多低质量、高光泽度的产品来加强行为操纵。（JEL C55, D83, D91, L86）

records.title_en: Money (Not) to Burn: Payments for Ecosystem Services to Reduce Crop Residue Burning
records.title_cn: 金钱（不）燃烧：减少作物秸秆焚烧的生态系统服务付费
records.abstract_en: We test whether payments for ecosystem services (PES) can curb the highly polluting practice of crop residue burning in India. Standard PES contracts pay participants after verification that they met a proenvironment condition (clearing fields without burning). We randomize paying a portion of the money up front and unconditionally to address liquidity constraints and farmer distrust, which may undermine the standard contract’s effectiveness. Incorporating partial up-front payment into the contract increases compliance by 10 percentage points, which is corroborated by satellite-based burning measurements. The cost per life saved is $3,600–$5,400. The standard PES contract has no effect on burning. (JEL D86, O13, Q12, Q15, Q18, Q53, Q58)
records.abstract_cn: 我们测试生态系统服务付费（PES）是否能遏制印度高度污染的作物秸秆焚烧行为。标准的PES合同在验证参与者满足环保条件（不清烧而清理田地）后支付款项。我们随机将部分款项提前无条件支付，以解决流动性约束和农民不信任问题，这些问题可能削弱标准合同的有效性。将部分预付款纳入合同使合规率提高了10个百分点，这得到了基于卫星的焚烧测量的证实。每条挽救生命的成本为3,600至5,400美元。标准的PES合同对焚烧没有影响。（JEL D86, O13, Q12, Q15, Q18, Q53, Q58）

records.title_en: Does Turnover Inhibit Specialization? Evidence from a Skill Survey in Peru
records.title_cn: 人员流动是否抑制了专业化？来自秘鲁技能调查的证据
records.abstract_en: We design, pilot, and field a new survey of job skills in Peru to investigate human capital differences between poor and rich countries. Peruvian jobs have markedly more uniform skill profiles than jobs in the United States. On the other hand, matching frictions are no more severe than in the United States, and recruiting technology is largely equivalent as well. We propose a stylized model in the O-ring tradition, in which a labor demand preference for unspecialized workers can endogenously arise when there is uncertainty about labor availability. (JEL J22, J23, J24, J41, J46, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们设计、试点并实地开展了一项针对秘鲁工作技能的新调查，以研究穷国与富国之间的人力资本差异。秘鲁的工作技能画像比美国的工作更为统一。另一方面，匹配摩擦并不比美国更严重，招聘技术也大体相当。我们提出了一个基于O型环传统的简化模型，在该模型中，当劳动力供给存在不确定性时，对非专业化工人的劳动需求偏好可以内生地产生。(JEL J22, J23, J24, J41, J46, O15)

records.title_en: Promotions and Productivity: The Role of Meritocracy and Pay Progression in the Public Sector
records.title_cn: 晋升与生产率：公共部门中的任人唯贤与薪酬递进的作用
records.abstract_en: We study promotion incentives in the public sector. In collaboration with Sierra Leone’s Ministry of Health, we introduce exogenous variation in the meritocratic nature of promotions from health worker to supervisor positions and in health workers’ perceptions of pay progression upon promotion. Ten months later, our findings reveal that meritocracy leads to a 22 percent increase in health workers’ productivity. Greater perceived pay progression in a meritocratic system boosts productivity by 23 percent, whereas in a less meritocratic system, it decreases productivity by 27 percent. We show that this reduction is consistent with a negative morale effect. (JEL C93, H51, I11, J24, J31, M51, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究公共部门的晋升激励。与塞拉利昂卫生部合作，我们在从卫生工作者晋升至主管职位的任人唯贤性质以及卫生工作者对晋升后薪酬递进的感知中引入了外生变异。十个月后，我们的研究结果显示，任人唯贤导致卫生工作者的生产率提高了22%。在任人唯贤的体系中，更高的感知薪酬递进使生产率提高了23%，而在较不任人唯贤的体系中，它却使生产率降低了27%。我们表明，这种降低与消极士气效应一致。(JEL C93, H51, I11, J24, J31, M51, O15)

records.title_en: Induced Innovation, Inventors, and the Energy Transition
records.title_cn: 诱导创新、发明人与能源转型
records.abstract_en: We study how individual inventors respond to incentives to work on “clean” electricity technologies. Using natural gas price variation, we estimate output and entry elasticities of inventors and measure the medium-term impacts of a price increase mirroring the social cost of carbon. We find that the induced clean innovation response primarily comes from existing clean inventors. New inventors are less responsive on the margin than their average contribution to clean energy patenting would indicate. Our results strengthen the rationale for government intervention to expedite the energy transition. (JEL L94, O31, O34, Q35, Q42, Q55)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究个体发明人如何响应从事“清洁”电力技术的激励。利用天然气价格变动，我们估计了发明人的产出和进入弹性，并衡量了反映碳社会成本的价格上涨的中期影响。我们发现，诱导的清洁创新响应主要来自现有的清洁发明人。新发明人在边际上的响应程度低于其平均贡献于清洁能源专利所显示的水平。我们的结果加强了政府干预以加速能源转型的理由。（JEL L94, O31, O34, Q35, Q42, Q55）

records.title_en: The High-Frequency Effects of Dollar Swap Lines
records.title_cn: 美元互换额度的高频效应
records.abstract_en: We study the effects of dollar swap lines using high-frequency responses in asset prices around policy announcements. News about expanded dollar swap lines causes a reduction in liquidity premia, compression of deviations from covered interest parity, and depreciation of the dollar. Equity prices rise and the VIX falls, while the response of long-term government bond prices is mixed. The cross section of high-frequency responses implies that swap lines affect the dollar factor or the price of risk. Our findings are qualitatively consistent with models relating the supply of dollar liquidity to the broader economy. (JEL E43, E44, E58, F31, G12, G13, G15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用政策公告期间资产价格的高频反应来研究美元互换额度的效应。关于扩大美元互换额度的消息导致流动性溢价下降，抵补利率平价偏差收窄，以及美元贬值。股票价格上涨，VIX指数下跌，而长期政府债券价格的反应则不一。高频反应的横截面表明，互换额度影响美元因子或风险价格。我们的发现在性质上与将美元流动性供给与更广泛经济联系起来的模型一致。(JEL E43, E44, E58, F31, G12, G13, G15)

records.title_en: Community Engagement with Law Enforcement after High-Profile Acts of Police Violence
records.title_cn: 高曝光警察暴力事件后社区与执法部门的互动
records.abstract_en: We document a sharp rise in gunshots coupled with declining 911 call volume across 13 major US cities in the aftermath of the murder of George Floyd. National survey data also indicate that victims of crime became less likely to report their victimization to law enforcement due to mistrust of police. Our results suggest that high-profile acts of police violence may erode community engagement with law enforcement and highlight the call-to-shot ratio as a natural measure of attitudes toward the police. (JEL H76, K42)
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了在乔治·弗洛伊德被杀后，美国13个主要城市的枪声显著增加，同时911报警电话数量下降。全国调查数据也表明，犯罪受害者因对警察的不信任而报告受害情况的意愿降低。我们的结果表明，高曝光的警察暴力行为可能会削弱社区与执法部门的互动，并强调报警与枪声比率作为衡量对警察态度的自然指标。(JEL H76, K42)

records.title_en: Land Rental Markets: Experimental Evidence from Kenya
records.title_cn: 土地租赁市场：来自肯尼亚的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Do land market frictions cause misallocation in agriculture? In a field experiment in western Kenya, we randomly subsidize owners to rent out land. Induced rentals mostly persist after the subsidy ends and increase output and value added, consistent with misallocation. Gains from trade arise from renters choosing higher-value crops, having higher productivity, and adopting more nonlabor inputs, while renters use similar quantities of labor as owners. Induced rentals are not those with the largest predicted gains, underlining the importance of the joint distribution of gains and frictions, with frictions arising from search, risk, and learning.
records.abstract_cn: 土地市场摩擦是否会导致农业错配？在肯尼亚西部的一项田野实验中，我们随机补贴业主出租土地。诱导租金大多在补贴结束后持续存在，并增加产出和附加值，这与分配不当一致。贸易收益来自于承租人选择更高价值的作物、具有更高的生产率以及采用更多的非劳动力投入，而承租人使用与业主相似数量的劳动力。诱导租金并不是那些预测收益最大的租金，这强调了收益和摩擦联合分配的重要性，其中摩擦来自搜索、风险和学习。

records.title_en: Do Ordeals Work for Selection Markets? Evidence from Health Insurance Auto-Enrollment
records.title_cn: 考验对于选拔市场有用吗？健康保险自动投保的证据
records.abstract_en: Are application hassles, or "ordeals," an effective way to limit public program enrollment? We provide new evidence by studying (removal of) an auto-enrollment policy for health insurance, adding an extra step to enroll. This minor ordeal has a major impact, reducing enrollment by 33 percent and differentially excluding young, healthy, and economically disadvantaged people. Using a simple model, we show adverse selection—a classic feature of insurance markets—undermines ordeals' standard rationale of excluding low-value individuals since they are also low-cost and may not be inefficient. Our analysis illustrates why ordeals targeting is unlikely to work well in selection markets.
records.abstract_cn: 申请麻烦或“考验”是限制公共项目招生的有效方式吗？我们通过研究（删除）健康保险自动投保政策提供了新的证据，增加了额外的投保步骤。这一小小的考验却产生了重大影响，导致 33% 入学人数减少，并有差别地排除年轻、健康和经济弱势群体。使用一个简单的模型，我们展示了逆向选择（保险市场的一个典型特征）破坏了排除低价值个体的考验的标准原理，因为它们也是低成本的并且可能不是低效的。我们的分析说明了为什么考验目标不太可能在精选市场中发挥良好作用。

records.title_en: Mortgage Pricing and Monetary Policy
records.title_cn: 抵押贷款定价和货币政策
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how central bank policies influence mortgage pricing in the United Kingdom. It shows that lenders price discriminate by offering two-part tariffs of interest rates and origination fees, and during unconventional monetary policies like the Funding for Lending Scheme, lenders reduced interest rates while increasing fees. Using a model of mortgage demand and lender competition, we find that central bank policies increased mortgage lending. Additionally, banning origination fees would reduce lending, as fees help lenders capture surplus while allowing them to price discriminate across borrowers with different sensitivities to rates and fees.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了英国央行政策如何影响抵押贷款定价。它表明，贷款机构通过提供 二 部分的利率和发起费来实行价格歧视，并且在贷款融资计划等非常规货币政策期间，贷款机构在提高费用的同时降低了利率。使用抵押贷款需求和贷款人竞争模型，我们发现央行政策增加了抵押贷款。此外，禁止发起费将减少贷款，因为费用有助于贷款人获取盈余，同时允许他们对利率和费用敏感度不同的借款人进行价格歧视。

records.title_en: Internationalizing Like China
records.title_cn: 像中国一样国际化
records.abstract_en: We empirically characterize how China is internationalizing its bond market by staggering the entry of different types of foreign investors into its domestic market and propose a dynamic reputation model to explain this strategy. Our framework rationalizes China's strategy as trying to build credibility as a safe issuer while reducing the cost of capital flight. We use our framework to shed light on China's response to episodes of capital outflows.
records.abstract_cn: 我们根据经验描述了中国如何通过错开不同类型的外国投资者进入其国内市场来实现其债券市场的国际化，并提出了一个动态声誉模型来解释这一策略。我们的框架合理化了中国的战略，即试图建立作为安全发行人的信誉，同时降低资本外逃成本。我们利用我们的框架来阐明中国对资本外流事件的反应。

records.title_en: Ownership Concentration and Strategic Supply Reduction
records.title_cn: 股权集中和战略供应减少
records.abstract_en: We explore the implications of ownership concentration for the recently concluded incentive auction that repurposed spectrum from broadcast TV to mobile broadband usage in the United States. We document significant multilicense ownership of TV stations. We show that in the reverse auction, in which TV stations bid to relinquish their licenses, multilicense owners have an inventive to withhold some TV stations to drive up prices for their remaining TV stations. Using a large-scale valuation and simulation exercise, we find that this strategic supply reduction increases payouts to TV stations by between 13.5 percent and 42.4 percent.
records.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了所有权集中度对最近结束的激励拍卖的影响，该拍卖将美国的频谱从广播电视重新调整为移动宽带使用。我们记录了电视台的重要多许可证所有权。我们表明，在电视台竞标放弃其许可证的逆向拍卖中，多许可证所有者有一种创造性的做法，可以扣留一些电视台，以抬高其剩余电视台的价格。通过大规模估值和模拟练习，我们发现这种战略性供应减少使电视台的支出增加了 13.5% 和 42.4% 之间。

records.title_en: The Decline of Too Big to Fail
records.title_cn: “太大而不能倒”的衰落
records.abstract_en: For globally systemically important banks (GSIBs) with US headquarters, we find significant reductions in market-implied probabilities of government bailout after the Global Financial Crisis (GFC), along with roughly 170 percent higher wholesale debt financing costs for these banks after controlling for insolvency risk. Since the GFC, bank creditors appear to expect much larger losses in the event that a GSIB approaches insolvency. In this sense, we estimate a decline of "too big to fail."
records.abstract_cn: 对于总部位于美国的全球系统重要性银行（GSIB），我们发现全球金融危机（GFC）后政府救助的市场隐含概率显着降低，并且在控制破产风险后，这些银行的批发债务融资成本大约170%更高。自全球金融危机以来，银行债权人似乎预计，如果 GSIB 濒临破产，损失会更大。从这个意义上说，我们估计下降是“太大而不能倒”。

records.title_en: How Competitive Is the Stock Market? Theory, Evidence from Portfolios, and Implications for the Rise of Passive Investing
records.title_cn: 股票市场的竞争力如何？理论、投资组合证据以及对被动投资兴起的影响
records.abstract_en: The conventional wisdom in finance is that competition is fierce among investors: if a group changes its behavior, others adjust their strategies such that nothing happens to prices. We estimate a demand system with flexible strategic responses for institutional investors in the US stock market. When less aggressive traders surround an investor, she adjusts by trading more aggressively. However, this strategic reaction only counteracts two-thirds of the impact of the initial change in behavior. In light of these estimates, the rise in passive investing over the last 20 years has made the demand for individual stocks 11 percent more inelastic.
records.abstract_cn: 金融界的传统观点是，投资者之间的竞争非常激烈：如果一个群体改变其行为，其他群体就会调整策略，以使价格不会发生任何变化。我们为美国股市的机构投资者预估了一个具有灵活策略反应的需求体系。当投资者周围的交易者不那么积极时，她会通过更积极地交易来进行调整。然而，这种战略反应只能抵消 二 最初行为变化影响的三分之一。根据这些估计，过去 20 几年中被动投资的增加使得对个股 11% 的需求更加缺乏弹性。

records.title_en: Corruption as a Local Advantage: Evidence from the Indigenization of Nigerian Oil
records.title_cn: 腐败作为地方优势：来自尼日利亚石油本土化的证据
records.abstract_en: Multinationals in the extractive sectors of weak states face resource theft by armed groups. Criminality is often abetted by state corruption, even though firms are willing to pay for protection. I study indigenization in Nigeria's oil sector, which increased local firms' participation substantially. Despite lower quality, local firms increase output by reducing oil theft. A bargaining model illustrates that political connections align law enforcement incentives, solving commitment problems. Data on law enforcement raids show that local firms receive preferential protection. Connections to military elites drive the local advantage. The aggregate gains from indigenization are at most between 2.3 and 5.7 percent of GDP.
records.abstract_cn: 弱国采掘业的跨国公司面临武装团体的资源盗窃。尽管企业愿意支付保护费用，但国家腐败往往会助长犯罪行为。我研究尼日利亚石油行业的本土化，这大大提高了当地公司的参与度。尽管质量较低，但当地公司通过减少石油盗窃来增加产量。讨价还价模型表明，政治关系可以调整执法激励，解决承诺问题。执法突击检查的数据显示，当地企业受到优先保护。与军事精英的联系推动了当地的优势。本土化带来的总收益最多介于 GDP 的 2.3 和 5.7% 之间。

records.title_en: Unjust energy transition: Vignettes from the COPs, climate finance and a coal hotspot
records.title_cn: 不公正的能源转型：来自缔约方大会、气候融资和煤炭热点地区的片段
records.abstract_en: As we move from dependence on fossil fuels towards zero carbon renewables, ‘just transition’ promises to leave no one behind. This paper has two objectives. First, it traces the trajectory of justice claims in the lead-up to the just transition agenda. Second, it explores unfolding just transition measures in the climate-vulnerable Global South. To pursue the first objective, I adopt a historical and political approach. I demonstrate the contested nature of environmental and climate justice claims that preceded just transition. Typically led by communities dependent on land, water, and the environmental commons for livelihoods and life, place-based struggles pushed against dispossession by developmental, modernist states and business. From the 1990 s, with the growing imprint of the climate crisis, states and businesses have increasingly entered the climate solutions arena. At multilateral climate fora such as the UN COPs, states, along with businesses, and finance and technology firms, hold the mantle of just transition today. In this upscaled context, justice concerns play out around the distribution of climate finance, especially from the traditionally polluting Global North to the South. Pursuant of the second objective of the research, and drawing on interview-based data, the paper traces the largest climate finance partnership between North and South: coal-dependent Indonesia’s Just Energy Transition Partnership. In the shaping of Indonesia’s JETP, justice is a tagline. The focus is on energy as investment opportunity—for the scheme’s international funders, and the recipient country. The trajectory of justice from ground–up environmental and climate justice struggles to multilateral climate fora and high-profile North-South just transition programmes shows elitization and depoliticization. It is no surprise that a South-based Just Energy Transition Partnership is far from bringing everybody along. Contributing to critical climate and energy studies, the paper spans scale, space, and time in its interrogation of the unjust energy transition.
records.abstract_cn: 随着我们从依赖化石燃料转向零碳可再生能源，“公正转型”承诺不让任何人掉队。本文有两个目标。首先，它追溯了公正转型议程之前正义主张的轨迹。其次，它探讨了气候脆弱全球南方正在展开的公正转型措施。为实现第一个目标，我采用了历史和政治方法。我展示了在公正转型之前就已存在的环境和气候正义主张的争议性。通常由依赖土地、水和环境公域维持生计和生活的社区主导，基于地方的斗争抵制了发展型、现代主义国家和企业的剥夺。从1990年代起，随着气候危机影响的加深，国家和企业越来越多地进入气候解决方案领域。在联合国缔约方大会等多边气候论坛上，国家与企业、金融和技术公司一起，如今主导着公正转型。在这一升级的背景下，正义问题围绕气候融资的分配展开，特别是从传统上污染的全球北方到南方的分配。为追求研究的第二个目标，并基于访谈数据，本文追溯了南北之间最大的气候融资伙伴关系：依赖煤炭的印度尼西亚的公正能源转型伙伴关系。在印度尼西亚JETP的形成过程中，正义是一个口号。重点是能源作为投资机会——对该计划的国际资助者和受援国而言。正义从自下而上的环境和气候正义斗争到多边气候论坛以及高调的南北公正转型计划的轨迹，显示了精英化和去政治化。毫不奇怪，一个南方的公正能源转型伙伴关系远未让所有人参与进来。本文为批判性气候和能源研究做出贡献，跨越尺度、空间和时间，审视不公正的能源转型。

records.title_en: The BRI in Pakistan’s power sector: From initial success to structural challenges
records.title_cn: 中巴经济走廊在巴基斯坦电力部门：从初步成功到结构性挑战
records.abstract_en: As part of the Belt & Road Initiative (BRI), Chinese actors have invested substantial resources in infrastructure projects in developing countries. Many of these projects are now operational. However, there is limited discussion of the factors contributing to the implementation of projects or the subsequent difficulties faced by Chinese actors during operations. This paper addresses this gap using a case study of Chinese investment in Pakistan’s power sector under the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor (CPEC). It uses the strategic action field (SAF) framework to analyse the interplay of Chinese and local actors in Pakistan’s power sector. Using in-depth qualitative interviews, it shows that Chinese and Pakistani cooperation in the power sector is marked by convergence and contestation. The early stages of the SAF were characterised by the convergence between Chinese and Pakistani elite interests, resulting in significant investment. Chinese investors enjoyed greater bargaining power at this stage and received multiple institutionalised concessions from the host country at the rule-setting stage. As projects became operational, increasing contestation culminated in an inversion of the field’s power dynamics. Various factors precipitated this inversion, including high-level political changes in Pakistan, which elevated opposition political leaders who were excluded from the SAF at the negotiation stage and questioned the field’s rules. Pakistan’s economic challenges further exacerbated problems as the host country sought to renegotiate the long-term agreements to reduce the returns for Chinese-financed power plants and alter financing terms. Though the host government has been unable to change the agreements, it has reneged on implementing the critical rules safeguarding the interests of Chinese investors. Chinese investors face diminishing leverage when dealing with host country governments that do not enforce rules underpinning investment due to the sticky nature of infrastructure investments and the Chinese state’s geopolitical interests.
records.abstract_cn: 作为“一带一路”倡议（BRI）的一部分，中国行为体在发展中国家的基础设施项目中投入了大量资源。许多项目现已投入运营。然而，关于项目实施的促成因素或中国行为体在运营期间面临的后续困难的讨论有限。本文通过中巴经济走廊（CPEC）下中国在巴基斯坦电力部门投资的案例研究来填补这一空白。它采用战略行动场域（SAF）框架分析中国与当地行为体在巴基斯坦电力部门的互动。通过深入的定性访谈，研究表明中巴在电力部门的合作以趋同与竞争为特征。SAF的早期阶段以中巴精英利益的趋同为特点，导致了大量投资。在此阶段，中国投资者享有更大的议价能力，并在规则制定阶段获得了东道国的多项制度化让步。随着项目投入运营，日益加剧的竞争最终导致场域权力动态的逆转。多种因素促成了这一逆转，包括巴基斯坦高层政治变动，这使得在谈判阶段被排除在SAF之外的反对派政治领导人地位上升，并对场域的规则提出质疑。巴基斯坦的经济挑战进一步加剧了问题，因为东道国试图重新谈判长期协议，以减少中国资助的电力厂的回报并改变融资条款。尽管东道国政府未能改变协议，但它已违背了执行保护中国投资者利益的关键规则。由于基础设施投资的粘性特征和中国国家的地缘政治利益，中国投资者在与不执行支撑投资规则的东道国政府打交道时，其影响力正在减弱。

records.title_en: Gender differences in the adequacy of poverty-targeted food assistance programs
records.title_cn: 贫困定向食品援助项目的性别差异充分性研究
records.abstract_en: We assess the degree to which a food voucher program for refugees in Lebanon adequately meets the nutritional needs of female- versus male-headed households. In a natural experiment in which some households received an unconditional cash transfer in addition to a food voucher, we analyze spending on food, food consumption, and food coping behaviors that results from the additional cash. The food voucher program increases food purchases, consumption, and dietary diversity, and reduces food coping strategies. Households who receive the additional cash transfer continue spending more on food and continue to increase food consumption. These latter effects are concentrated in female-headed households, indicating that the food voucher benefit level fell short either in providing for these families’ nutritional needs or in meeting their food consumption preferences despite the fact that they were assessed as equally impoverished by a proxy means test used to target the program. These results imply that social assistance programs concerned with addressing a specific type of deprivation could take into account differences in the incidence of that deprivation when setting benefit levels.
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估了黎巴嫩难民食品券项目在多大程度上充分满足女户主家庭与男户主家庭的营养需求。在一项自然实验中，部分家庭在获得食品券之外还收到了无条件现金转移，我们分析了额外现金对食品支出、食品消费以及食品应对行为的影响。食品券项目增加了食品购买、消费和膳食多样性，并减少了食品应对策略。收到额外现金转移的家庭继续增加食品支出，并持续提高食品消费。这些后续效应集中在女户主家庭中，表明食品券的福利水平要么未能充分满足这些家庭的营养需求，要么未能符合其食品消费偏好，尽管通过用于项目瞄准的代理经济状况测试，这些家庭被评估为同等贫困。这些结果表明，关注解决特定类型匮乏的社会援助项目在设定福利水平时，应考虑该匮乏发生率上的差异。

records.title_en: Women’s work, never done, now paid: Assessing Tamil Nadu’s Urimai Thogai scheme
records.title_cn: 女性的工作，永无止境，如今有偿：评估泰米尔纳德邦的乌里迈·托盖计划
records.abstract_en: Since 2021, a radical new social experiment is underway in India. Political parties across the ideological spectrum have rolled out unconditional cash transfers targeting nearly 90 million women ostensibly for female empowerment but with an eye on electoral success. This article seeks to understand one such scheme in the state of Tamil Nadu, namely, the Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai scheme rolled out in 2023. This scheme promises women satisfying certain criteria an unconditional cash transfer of Rs. 1000 per month in recognition of their unpaid domestic and care work. There has been a robust debate amongst feminists and scholars of the welfare state alike on whether such schemes operationalised through direct bank transfers are truly empowering. A preliminary qualitative study of the scheme shows that the transfer did not disincentivise women from pursuing education or entering paid employment. While women could not readily associate the scheme with a recognition of their unpaid work, they felt being seen by the state and were in turn appreciative of what they perceived as the state’s role in furthering gender equality. They also demonstrated a keen awareness of the gendered division of labour and a desire to change it. The scheme contributed to their financial well-being, dignity and peace of mind where they often relied on men for even small amounts of money. With adequate messaging on the value of women’s unpaid work and the creation of jobs that women desire, the scheme has the potential to not only realise the goals of SDG 5.4 (recognise, reduce and redistribute women’s unpaid domestic and care work) but also to reconfigure the marital bargain and the social contract between women and the state.
records.abstract_cn: 自2021年以来，印度正在进行一项激进的新社会实验。各意识形态光谱上的政党推出了针对近90百万女性的无条件现金转移，表面上是为了女性赋权，但着眼于选举成功。本文旨在理解泰米尔纳德邦的一项此类计划，即于2023年推出的卡拉伊格纳·马加利尔·乌里迈·托盖计划。该计划承诺满足特定标准的女性每月获得Rs. 1000的无条件现金转移，以认可她们的无偿家务和照料工作。在女权主义者和福利国家学者之间，对于通过直接银行转账实施的此类计划是否真正赋权，存在激烈的辩论。对该计划的初步定性研究表明，这种转移并未阻碍女性追求教育或进入有偿就业。虽然女性不能轻易将计划与对其无偿工作的认可联系起来，但她们感到被国家看见，并反过来对她们认为国家在促进性别平等方面所扮演的角色表示赞赏。她们还表现出对性别分工的敏锐意识以及改变它的愿望。该计划促进了她们的经济福祉、尊严和内心平静，因为她们常常在即使小额金钱上也依赖男性。通过充分传达女性无偿工作价值的讯息，并创造女性渴望的工作，该计划不仅有潜力实现可持续发展目标5.4（承认、减少和重新分配女性的无偿家务和照料工作）的目标，还有潜力重新配置婚姻契约和女性与国家之间的社会契约。

records.title_en: From displacement to statehood: The ecological and political metamorphosis of Accompong marronage
records.title_cn: 从流离失所到国家建构：阿孔庞马龙人的生态与政治蜕变
records.abstract_en: This study explores Accompong marronage as a form of displacement ecology, showing how the Maroons of Accompong in Jamaica have adapted their strategies for autonomy and resistance from the colonial period to today. Descendants of formerly enslaved Africans and Indigenous Taíno, the Accompong Maroons embody resilience, evolving from military resistance against colonial forces to modern ecological stewardship, state-making, and legal advocacy. Central to their current struggle is their opposition to bauxite mining in Cockpit Country—ancestral land they aim to protect. This conflict reflects broader issues of sovereignty, land rights, and the Maroons’ right to safeguard lands with historical and cultural significance. By applying the concept of marronage metamorphosis, this study situates Accompong’s resistance within displacement ecology, examining how communities actively resist displacement and reshape their environments to sustain autonomy and cultural continuity. These histories of Maroon self-determination provide valuable insights into contemporary struggles for land and identity. It emphasizes the importance of understanding displacement not as an isolated event but as an ongoing process intertwined with historical legacies and contemporary challenges.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨阿孔庞马龙人作为一种流离失所生态的形式，展示了牙买加阿孔庞的马龙人如何从殖民时期至今调整其自治与抵抗策略。作为曾被奴役的非洲人和原住民泰诺人的后裔，阿孔庞马龙人体现了韧性，从对殖民势力的军事抵抗演变为现代的生态管理、国家建构和法律倡导。他们当前斗争的核心是反对在科克皮特国家进行铝土矿开采——这是他们旨在保护的祖传土地。这一冲突反映了主权、土地权利以及马龙人保护具有历史和文化意义的土地的权利等更广泛的问题。通过应用马龙人蜕变的概念，本研究将阿孔庞的抵抗置于流离失所生态的框架内，考察社区如何积极抵抗流离失所并重塑其环境以维持自治和文化连续性。这些马龙人自决的历史为当代土地与身份的斗争提供了宝贵的见解。研究强调，理解流离失所不应将其视为孤立事件，而应视为一个与历史遗产和当代挑战交织的持续过程。

records.title_en: Reassessing transformation pathways: Global trends in rural household farm and non-farm livelihood strategies with a spotlight on Sub-Saharan Africa
records.title_cn: 重新评估转型路径：全球农村家庭农业与非农业生计策略趋势——聚焦撒哈拉以南非洲
authors: Ana Paula De la O Campos
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates how household income strategies evolve amidst ongoing structural transformation in lower and middle-income countries, with a particular focus on Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA). We examine whether rural households in developing countries follow the expected livelihood pathways that have historically accompanied structural transformation. Given the divergent trends suggested by previous studies in SSA, we also explore which livelihood pathways might offer greater poverty reduction potential in SSA and other developing regions. Using a harmonized dataset from 41 countries and 103 nationally representative surveys, we analyze participation in various income-generating activities and the impact on household income and welfare. This study characterizes income specialization or diversification within households and estimates the relationship between each income source and overall per capita household income as well as the correlation between different livelihood pathways and poverty reduction across expenditure levels. Our findings reveal highly diversified income strategies globally. However, countries in SSA show greater specialization in on-farm income-generating activities compared to Rest of the World (ROW) countries at similar levels of GDP per capita. This divergence raises questions about the nature of structural change in SSA and suggests different transformation pathways, notably towards self-employment in the services sector and less towards non-agricultural wage employment. The study has significant policy implications, highlighting SSA’s emerging different path in structural transformation, which highlight the need for rural development strategies that both enhance the productivity of on-farm income sources as well as growth of the off-farm rural economy.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在中低收入国家持续的结构转型过程中，家庭收入策略如何演变，特别关注撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）。我们考察了发展中国家的农村家庭是否遵循历史上伴随结构转型的预期生计路径。鉴于先前关于SSA的研究显示出的不同趋势，我们还探讨了哪些生计路径可能在SSA和其他发展中地区具有更大的减贫潜力。利用来自41个国家和103项全国代表性调查的协调数据集，我们分析了参与各种创收活动的情况及其对家庭收入和福利的影响。本研究刻画了家庭内部的收入专业化或多样化，并估计了每种收入来源与人均家庭总收入之间的关系，以及不同生计路径与各支出水平下减贫之间的相关性。我们的研究结果显示，全球范围内收入策略高度多样化。然而，与人均GDP水平相似的世界其他地区（ROW）国家相比，SSA国家在农业创收活动上表现出更高的专业化程度。这种差异引发了对SSA结构变革性质的质疑，并暗示了不同的转型路径，特别是倾向于服务业中的自雇就业，而非农业以外的工资就业。该研究具有重要的政策含义，强调了SSA在结构转型中呈现出的不同路径，这凸显了农村发展战略的需求，既要提高农业收入来源的生产率，也要促进农村非农经济的增长。

records.title_en: Patronage networks and multitasking incentives: Evidence from local officials’ responses to public crises in China’s centralized bureaucracy
records.title_cn: 庇护网络和多任务激励：来自中国中央集权官僚机构地方官员对公共危机反应的证据
records.abstract_en: Multitasking agency problems affect government performance. While governments can give high-level authorities discretion to monitor agents’ multitasking performance, such “top-down” control could foster patronage-based relations throughout hierarchies, compounding multitasking problems. However, little research has examined the relationship between multitasking and patronage. We argue that patronage induces agents to prioritize tasks where their superiors face heightened “top-down” pressures while downplaying other tasks. Exploiting the staggered adoption of Community Stringent Measures (CSMs) across Chinese cities, we compare Chinese local officials’ COVID-19 responses based on city officials’ patronage connections to provincial superiors, who oversaw their performance and faced pressures to contain infections. CSMs in connected cities more substantially reduced virus infections compared to unconnected cities, but generated more pronounced human mobility reduction and citizen discontent, potentially hindering economic development and social stability. Our findings suggest that agents’ multitasking incentives are shaped by patronage connections within the centralized hierarchy.
records.abstract_cn: 多任务机构问题影响政府绩效。虽然政府可以赋予高层当局自由裁量权来监控特工的多任务表现，但这种“自上而下”的控制可能会在整个层次结构中促进基于庇护的关系，从而加剧多任务问题。然而，很少有研究探讨多任务处理和赞助之间的关系。我们认为，庇护会促使代理人优先处理上级面临更大“自上而下”压力的任务，同时淡化其他任务。利用中国各城市错开采取的社区严格措施（CSM），我们根据城市官员与省级上级的关系来比较中国地方官员的新冠病毒19反应，省级上级监督他们的表现并面临控制感染的压力。与未联网城市相比，联网城市的 CSM 更大幅度地减少了病毒感染，但造成了更明显的人员流动减少和公民不满，可能阻碍经济发展和社会稳定。我们的研究结果表明，代理人的多任务激励是由中心化等级制度内的赞助关系决定的。

records.title_en: How do banks respond to violence?
records.title_cn: 银行如何应对暴力？
records.abstract_en: In this article, we investigate how banks are exposed to violence and how they respond to it. Specifically, we investigate how non-performing loans and customers’ demand for liquidity react to violence. Then, we assess the impact of violence on banks’ liquidity and loan maturity. For this purpose, we mobilize data from 1222 banks located in 88 countries among the most exposed to violence in Africa, Asia, and the Middle East from 1997 to 2021. Our analysis shows that the existence and intensity of violence lead to an increase in non-performing loans and cash withdrawals by banks’ customers. Furthermore, violence leads to a reduction in credit volume through the increase of the cost of credit and preference for very short-term loans. Finally, in response to violence, banks diversify their sources of income to offset the decline in lending activity and preserve their profitability. Overall, our study documents the impact of violence on banks.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究了银行如何暴露于暴力以及它们如何应对暴力。具体来说，我们调查了不良贷款和客户流动性需求如何对暴力做出反应。然后，我们评估了暴力对银行流动性和贷款期限的影响。为此，我们利用了来自非洲、亚洲和中东地区最易受暴力影响的88个国家中的1222家银行从1997年到2021年的数据。我们的分析表明，暴力的存在和强度导致银行客户的不良贷款和现金提取增加。此外，暴力通过增加信贷成本和偏好极短期贷款，导致信贷量减少。最后，为应对暴力，银行多元化其收入来源，以抵消贷款活动的下降并保持盈利能力。总体而言，我们的研究记录了暴力对银行的影响。

records.title_en: Effective community mobilization: Evidence from Mali
records.title_cn: 有效的社区动员：来自马里的证据
records.abstract_en: Experts argue that the adoption of healthy sanitation practices, such as hand washing and latrine use, requires focusing on the entire community rather than individual behaviors. According to this view, one limiting factor in ending open defecation lies in the capacity of the community to collectively act toward this goal. Each member of a community bears the private cost of contributing by washing hands and using latrines, but the benefits through better health outcomes depend on whether other community members also opt out of open defecation. We rely on a community-based intervention carried out in Mali as an illustrative example (Community-Led Total Sanitation or CLTS). Using a series of experiments conducted in 121 villages and designed to measure the willingness of community members to contribute to a local public good, we investigate the process of participation in a collective action problem setting. Our focus is on two types of activities: (1) gathering of community members to encourage public discussion of the collective action problem, and (2) facilitation by a community champion of the adoption of individual actions to attain the socially preferred outcome. In games, communication helps raise public good provision, and both open discussion and facilitated ones have the same impact. When a community member facilitates a discussion after an open discussion session, public good contributions increase, but there are no gains from opening up the discussion after a facilitated session. Community members who choose to contribute in the no-communication treatment are not better facilitators than those who choose not to contribute.
records.abstract_cn: 专家认为，采用健康的卫生习惯，如洗手和使用厕所，需要关注整个社区而非个体行为。根据这一观点，结束露天排便的一个限制因素在于社区集体行动以实现这一目标的能力。社区中的每个成员都承担着通过洗手和使用厕所做出贡献的私人成本，但通过改善健康结果获得的收益取决于其他社区成员是否也选择放弃露天排便。我们以在马里进行的一项基于社区的干预作为示例（社区主导的全面卫生或CLTS）。利用在121个村庄进行的一系列实验，这些实验旨在衡量社区成员对地方公共物品贡献的意愿，我们研究了在集体行动问题情境下的参与过程。我们关注两类活动：（1）召集社区成员以鼓励对集体行动问题进行公开讨论，以及（2）由社区倡导者促进采纳个人行动以实现社会偏好的结果。在博弈中，沟通有助于提高公共物品供给，公开讨论和促进式讨论具有相同的影响。当社区成员在公开讨论环节后促进讨论时，公共物品贡献增加，但在促进式讨论后开放讨论没有额外收益。在无沟通处理中选择贡献的社区成员并不比选择不贡献的人更能成为好的促进者。

records.title_en: Compound exposure: Climate change, vulnerability and the energy-extractives nexus in the Pacific
records.title_cn: 复合暴露：太平洋地区的气候变化、脆弱性与能源-采掘业关联
records.abstract_en: A global push for an energy transition to combat climate change is fuelling demand for energy transition minerals and metals (ETMs) needed for renewable energy-systems. As the primary solution to our planetary problem, the energy transition helps to enlarge the extractive industries and increases the pressure to extract ETMs from places already acutely exposed climate change, like the Pacific Islands region. In this paper we develop the concept of compound exposure to examine the combined effects of extraction and climate change in the Pacific. Drawing from a global dataset of ETM projects, we have created a first-of-kind sub-set of ETM projects in the Pacific, mapped against indicators of environmental, social, governance and climate vulnerability for the places where those projects are located. We found higher levels of situated vulnerability around ETM projects in the Pacific compared to global results. A rush for the resources in the Pacific will compound the consequences of climate change and the multiple stressors associated with resource extraction and will enlarge exposure to harm. We argue that extractivist solutions to climate change work to close off other pathways and amplify the worst effects of compound exposure in the Pacific, and beyond.
records.abstract_cn: 全球为应对气候变化而推动能源转型，正加剧对可再生能源系统所需的能源转型矿产和金属（ETMs）的需求。作为解决我们地球问题的主要方案，能源转型有助于扩大采掘业，并增加了从已经严重暴露于气候变化的地区（如太平洋岛屿地区）开采ETMs的压力。在本文中，我们提出了复合暴露的概念，以考察太平洋地区采掘活动与气候变化的综合效应。基于全球ETM项目数据集，我们创建了太平洋地区ETM项目的首个专门子集，并将其与这些项目所在地的环境、社会、治理和气候脆弱性指标进行映射。我们发现，与全球结果相比，太平洋地区ETM项目周围的情境脆弱性水平更高。对太平洋地区资源的争夺将加剧气候变化后果与资源开采相关的多重压力，并扩大受害风险。我们认为，应对气候变化的采掘主义解决方案会关闭其他路径，并放大太平洋地区及其他地区复合暴露的最严重影响。
