records.abstract_cn: 直升机撒钱的经济学从根本上与货币模型中的价格水平决定相关。在具有内在无价值货币的框架中，发行者的负债定义了记账单位，并独特地赋予发行者实施直升机撒钱和摆脱流动性陷阱的能力。虽然传统的直升机撒钱要求财政部与中央银行之间的合作——其中中央银行关键地担保财政部债务——但我们证明，直升机撒钱也可以由政府或私人货币发行者独立有效执行，无需财政部参与。

records.title_en: Benchmarking benchmarks
records.title_cn: 基准的基准
records.abstract_en: Financial benchmarks such as LIBOR underpin the pricing of trillions of dollars of contracts around the world. We evaluate the quality of benchmark prices using a state-space model to separate information from noise. Applying the method to LIBOR benchmarks and their replacements, we find that alternative reference rates (ARRs) are less noisy in four of the five currencies. However, the USD ARR is considerably more noisy, resulting in billions of dollars of noise-related wealth transfers between contract counterparties. We show that benchmark reforms such as expanding the reference market and using a trimmed mean can reduce noise in ARRs.
records.abstract_cn: 金融基准如LIBOR支撑着全球数万亿美元合约的定价。我们使用状态空间模型将信息与噪声分离，以评估基准价格的质量。将该方法应用于LIBOR基准及其替代品，我们发现替代参考利率（ARRs）在五种货币中的四种中噪声较小。然而，美元ARR的噪声显著更大，导致合约对手方之间数十亿美元的噪声相关财富转移。我们表明，扩大参考市场和使用修剪均值等基准改革可以减少ARRs中的噪声。

records.title_en: Main Street’s Pain, Wall Street’s Gain
records.title_cn: 主街之痛，华尔街之得
records.abstract_en: We propose a fiscal policy expectations mechanism. When bad macro news arrives (in our study, when initial jobless claims (IJC) are higher than expected), investors may expect more generous government spending and drive up aggregate stock prices through the expected cash flow channel. Using a time-series sample from January 2013 to March 2021, we find that this phenomenon emerges when newspapers mention fiscal policy more. In the cross section, firms expected to receive more government spending – through stimulus supports during COVID-19 or procurement contracts before 2020 – exhibit higher individual stock returns when bad IJC shocks arrive.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种财政政策预期机制。当不利的宏观新闻到来时（在我们的研究中，即当首次申请失业救济人数（IJC）高于预期时），投资者可能预期政府支出将更加慷慨，并通过预期现金流渠道推高整体股价。利用从2013年一月至2021年三月的时间序列样本，我们发现当报纸更多地提及财政政策时，这一现象会出现。在横截面上，预期获得更多政府支出的公司——无论是通过COVID-19期间的刺激支持还是2020年前的采购合同——在不利的IJC冲击到来时，表现出更高的个股回报。

records.title_en: Can everyone tap into the housing piggy bank? Racial disparities in access to home equity
records.title_cn: 每个人都可以使用住房存钱罐吗？获得房屋净值方面的种族差异
records.abstract_en: We document large racial disparities in the ability of homeowners to access their accumulated housing wealth. Minority homeowners are significantly more likely to have their mortgage equity withdrawal (MEW) product applications rejected than White homeowners, and the unconditional disparities are significantly larger than those found in prior studies that focused on purchase and rate/term refinance loans. Had Black homeowners faced the same MEW denial rate as White homeowners in our sample period we show they would have extracted an additional $11.2 billion in housing equity, or almost 25% of the total amount of actual equity extracted. Controlling for key underwriting variables significantly narrows the racial disparities, with the Black–White gap falling by nearly 85%, and the Hispanic-White gap falling by more than 75%. Credit scores and debt-to-income ratios are the most important factors explaining the gaps, while differences in loan-to-value ratios contribute only modestly. “Residual” disparities after conditioning on observable underwriting factors are large and vary significantly across lenders. A battery of tests suggests that differences in unobserved underwriting factors are unlikely to fully explain the residual disparities, which tend to be larger in geographic areas characterized by more racial animus.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了房主获取其积累的住房财富的能力存在巨大的种族差异。与白人房主相比，少数族裔房主的抵押贷款权益提款（MEW）产品申请被拒绝的可能性要大得多，而且无条件差异明显大于之前专注于购买和利率/定期再融资贷款的研究中发现的差异。如果黑人房主在我们的样本期内面临与白人房主相同的 MEW 拒绝率，我们表明他们将额外提取 11.2 十亿美元的住房净值，或几乎 25% 实际提取的净值总额。控制关键承保变量显着缩小了种族差异，黑人与白人之间的差距下降了近 85%，西班牙裔与白人之间的差距下降了超过 75%。信用评分和债务与收入比率是解释差距的最重要因素，而贷款与价值比率的差异则贡献不大。以可观察的承保因素为条件后的“剩余”差异很大，并且不同贷方之间差异很大。一系列测试表明，未观察到的承保因素的差异不太可能完全解释剩余的差异，在种族敌意较多的地理区域，这种差异往往更大。

records.title_en: Investor demand, firm investment, and capital misallocation
records.title_cn: 投资者需求、企业投资与资本错配
records.abstract_en: Fluctuations in investor demand significantly affect firms’ valuation and access to capital. To quantify their real effects, we develop a dynamic investment model, incorporating both the demand and supply sides of capital. Strong investor demand relaxes financial constraints and facilitates equity issuance and investment, while weak demand encourages opportunistic share repurchases, crowding out investment. We estimate the model using indirect inference, matching the endogenous relationship between investor demand and firm policies. Our estimation reveals that demand fluctuations are important drivers of firm-level investment and economy-wide capital misallocation, accounting for 26.9% of dispersion in MPK and 23.4% of productivity losses.
records.abstract_cn: 投资者需求的波动显著影响企业的估值和资本获取能力。为量化其实际影响，我们构建了一个动态投资模型，同时纳入资本的供需双方。强劲的投资者需求放松了融资约束，促进了股票发行和投资，而疲弱的需求则鼓励机会主义的股票回购，挤出投资。我们使用间接推断法估计模型，匹配投资者需求与企业政策之间的内生关系。我们的估计显示，需求波动是企业层面投资和整个经济资本错配的重要驱动因素，分别解释了MPK离散度的26.9%和生产率损失的23.4%。

records.title_en: Fintech entry, lending market competition, and welfare
records.title_cn: 金融科技进入、贷款市场竞争与福利
records.abstract_en: We provide a spatial framework to study competition between banks and fintechs in the lending market and examine the impact on investment and welfare. Based on the key differences between banks and fintechs, we derive results consistent with the empirical evidence available. We find that fintechs with inferior monitoring efficiency can successfully enter because of their superior flexibility in pricing and that higher bank concentration leads to higher fintech loan volume. If fintechs and banks have similar funding costs, fintech borrowers pay lower loan rates and have higher default rates than bank borrowers with similar characteristics; however, the result will flip if fintechs have much higher funding costs than banks. The advantage of fintechs in offering convenience can also induce them to charge higher loan rates than banks. Fintech entry will improve welfare if fintechs have high monitoring efficiency and inter-fintech competition intensity is intermediate. Fintech entry may induce banks’ exit and reduce investment; however, it will increase investment if inter-fintech competition is intense enough.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一个空间框架来研究银行与金融科技在贷款市场上的竞争，并考察其对投资和福利的影响。基于银行与金融科技之间的关键差异，我们得出了与现有实证证据一致的结果。我们发现，监控效率较低的金融科技因其在定价上的更高灵活性而能够成功进入市场，且银行集中度越高，金融科技贷款量越大。如果金融科技与银行的融资成本相似，那么具有相似特征的借款人中，金融科技借款人的贷款利率更低，但违约率更高；然而，如果金融科技的融资成本远高于银行，这一结果将发生逆转。金融科技在提供便利性方面的优势也可能使其收取高于银行的贷款利率。当金融科技具有高监控效率且金融科技间竞争强度处于中等水平时，金融科技的进入将改善福利。金融科技的进入可能导致银行退出并减少投资；然而，如果金融科技间的竞争足够激烈，则会增加投资。

records.title_en: The retail execution quality landscape
records.title_cn: 零售执行质量格局
records.abstract_en: We demonstrate that off-exchange (wholesaler) executions provide significant cost savings to retail investors. Wholesaler concentration has raised regulatory concerns; however, we show that the largest wholesalers offer the lowest costs due to economies of scale. The entry of a new large wholesaler reduces incumbent scale economies, resulting in higher execution costs. Most retail brokers route to multiple wholesalers and actively monitor their performance, rewarding those offering lower execution costs with more volume. While retail investors benefit from the current landscape across all stocks, those trading small stocks benefit the most.
records.abstract_cn: 我们证明，场外（批发商）执行为散户投资者带来了显著的成本节约。批发商的集中引发了监管担忧；然而，我们表明，由于规模经济，最大的批发商提供最低的成本。新的大型批发商的进入减少了现有批发商的规模经济，导致执行成本上升。大多数零售经纪商将订单路由至多个批发商，并积极监控其表现，将更多交易量奖励给提供较低执行成本的批发商。尽管散户投资者在当前格局下从所有股票中受益，但交易小盘股的投资者受益最多。

records.title_en: Understanding the strength of the dollar
records.title_cn: 理解美元强势
records.abstract_en: We attribute variation in the strength of the U.S. dollar and its covariance with other currencies to economic primitives using a global asset demand system. We take global investor savings, asset supply, and monetary policy as exogenous primitives, and show how these variables explain dollar exchange rate behavior. Prior to the global financial crisis, global savings and demand shifts explain dollar depreciation, whereas post-crisis they explain dollar appreciation. Interest rates and cross-border bank loans explain short-term fluctuations in the dollar, but decline in significance over longer horizons. When explaining the dollar factor structure, we find that global savings explain common variations across dollar exchange rates, whereas investor demand shifts account for cross-sectional heterogeneity in dollar betas.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用全球资产需求系统，将美元强势的变化及其与其他货币的协方差归因于经济原始要素。我们将全球投资者储蓄、资产供给和货币政策视为外生原始要素，并展示这些变量如何解释美元汇率行为。在全球金融危机之前，全球储蓄和需求变动解释了美元贬值，而危机后它们则解释了美元升值。利率和跨境银行贷款解释了美元的短期波动，但在较长时期内其显著性下降。在解释美元因子结构时，我们发现全球储蓄解释了美元汇率间的共同变动，而投资者需求变动则解释了美元贝塔值的横截面异质性。

records.title_en: Strategic digitization in currency and payment competition
records.title_cn: 货币与支付竞争中的战略性数字化
records.abstract_en: We model the competition between digital forms of fiat money and private digital money. Countries digitize their currencies–by upgrading existing or launching new payment systems (including CBDCs)–to compete with foreign fiat currencies and private digital money. A pecking order emerges: less dominant currencies digitize earlier, reflecting a first-mover advantage; dominant currencies delay digitization until they face competition; the weakest currencies forgo digitization. However, delayed digitization allows private digital money to gain widespread adoption, eventually weakening fiat money’s role. We highlight how geopolitical considerations, stablecoins, and interoperability between fiat and private digital money shape the dynamics of currency competition.
records.abstract_cn: 我们模拟了法定货币的数字形式与私人数字货币之间的竞争。各国通过升级现有支付系统或推出新支付系统（包括央行数字货币）来实现货币数字化，以与外国法定货币和私人数字货币竞争。一种层级秩序应运而生：较不占主导地位的货币更早实现数字化，反映了先发优势；占主导地位的货币则推迟数字化，直到面临竞争；最弱的货币则放弃数字化。然而，推迟数字化使私人数字货币得以广泛采用，最终削弱法定货币的作用。我们强调了地缘政治考量、稳定币以及法定货币与私人数字货币之间的互操作性如何塑造货币竞争的动态。

records.title_en: Reaching for yield: Evidence from households
records.title_cn: 追逐收益：来自家庭的证据
records.abstract_en: The literature has documented “reaching for yield”—the phenomenon of investing more in risky assets when interest rates drop—among institutional investors. We analyze detailed transaction data from a large brokerage firm to provide direct field evidence that individual investors also exhibit this behavior. Consistent with models of portfolio choice with labor income, reaching for yield is more pronounced among younger and less-wealthy individuals. Consistent with prospect theory, reaching for yield is more pronounced when investors are trading at a loss. Finally, we observe and discuss the phenomenon of “reverse reaching for yield.”
records.abstract_cn: 文献记录了机构投资者在利率下降时增加对风险资产投资的“追逐收益”现象。我们分析了一家大型经纪公司的详细交易数据，提供了个人投资者也表现出这种行为的直接实地证据。与包含劳动收入的资产组合选择模型一致，追逐收益在年轻且财富较少的个体中更为显著。与前景理论一致，当投资者亏损交易时，追逐收益更为明显。最后，我们观察并讨论了“反向追逐收益”的现象。

records.title_en: Central bank liquidity reallocation and bank lending: Evidence from the tiering system
records.title_cn: 中央银行流动性再配置与银行贷款：来自分层准备金制度的证据
records.abstract_en: We document that the reallocation of central bank reserves towards banks with higher liquidity needs fosters credit supply. Exploiting the ECB's tiered reserve remuneration system for identification, we show that this system encouraged banks with low reserve holdings to obtain more reserves through the money market. Concomitantly, these banks reduced their securities holdings and extended more credit. We estimate that the reallocation of one euro of reserves towards banks with ex ante low reserve holdings resulted in an increase in credit supply of about 15 cents.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了中央银行准备金向流动性需求较高的银行再配置会促进信贷供给。利用欧洲中央银行的分层准备金报酬制度进行识别，我们表明该制度鼓励准备金持有量较低的银行通过货币市场获取更多准备金。与此同时，这些银行减少了证券持有并增加了信贷发放。我们估计，将一欧元准备金向事前准备金持有量较低的银行再配置，会导致信贷供给增加约15欧分。

records.title_en: How Credit Cycles across a Financial Crisis
records.title_cn: 金融危机中的信贷周期如何演变
records.abstract_en: We analyze the behavior of credit and output in financial crises using data on credit spreads and credit growth. Crises are marked by a sharp rise in credit spreads, signaling sudden shifts in expectations. The severity of a crisis can be predicted by the extent of credit losses (spread increases) and financial sector fragility (precrisis credit growth). This interaction is a key feature of crises. Postcrisis recessions are typically severe and prolonged. Notably, precrisis spreads tend to drop to low levels while credit growth accelerates, indicating that credit supply expansions often precede crises. The 2008 crisis aligns with these patterns.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用信贷利差和信贷增长的数据，分析了金融危机中信贷和产出的行为。危机以信贷利差的急剧上升为标志，预示着预期的突然转变。危机的严重程度可以通过信贷损失（利差扩大）和金融部门脆弱性（危机前信贷增长）的程度来预测。这种相互作用是危机的一个关键特征。危机后的衰退通常严重且持久。值得注意的是，危机前的利差往往降至低水平，而信贷增长加速，表明信贷供给扩张常常先于危机发生。2008年的危机与这些模式相符。

records.title_en: Banks, Low Interest Rates, and Monetary Policy Transmission
records.title_cn: 银行、低利率与货币政策传导
records.abstract_en: I study how the secular decline in interest rates affects banks' intermediation spreads and credit supply. Following a permanent decrease in rates, bank lending may rise initially but contracts in the long run. As lower rates compress deposit spreads even well above the zero lower bound, banks' retained earnings, equity, and lending fall until loan spreads have risen enough to offset the reduction in deposit spreads. A higher inflation target can support bank lending at the cost of higher liquidity premia. I find support for the model's predictions in U.S. aggregate and bank‐level data.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了利率的长期下降如何影响银行的中介利差和信贷供给。在利率永久性下降之后，银行贷款可能最初上升，但长期内会收缩。由于较低的利率压缩存款利差，即使在远高于零下限的情况下，银行的留存收益、股本和贷款也会下降，直到贷款利差上升足以抵消存款利差的减少。更高的通胀目标可以支持银行贷款，但代价是更高的流动性溢价。我在美国总体和银行层面的数据中找到了支持模型预测的证据。

records.title_en: Collusion in Brokered Markets
records.title_cn: 经纪市场中的合谋
records.abstract_en: High commissions in the U.S. residential real estate agency market pose a puzzle for economic theory because brokerage is not a concentrated industry. We model brokered markets as a game in which agents post prices for customers and then choose which other agents to work with. We show that there exists an equilibrium in which each agent conditions working with other agents on those agents' posted prices. Prices can therefore be meaningfully higher than the competitive level (for a fixed discount factor), regardless of the number of agents. Thus, brokered markets can remain uncompetitive even with low concentration and easy entry.
records.abstract_cn: 美国住宅房地产代理市场的高佣金对经济理论构成了一个谜团，因为经纪行业并非集中型行业。我们将经纪市场建模为一个博弈，其中代理人向客户发布价格，然后选择与其他哪些代理人合作。我们证明存在一个均衡，在该均衡中，每个代理人根据其他代理人发布的价格来决定是否与其合作。因此，价格可以显著高于竞争水平（在固定贴现因子下），无论代理人数量多少。因此，即使集中度低且进入容易，经纪市场也可能保持非竞争性。

records.title_en: How Much Does Racial Bias Affect Mortgage Lending? Evidence from Human and Algorithmic Credit Decisions
records.title_cn: 种族偏见对抵押贷款的影响有多大？来自人工与算法信贷决策的证据
records.abstract_en: We assess racial discrimination in mortgage approvals using confidential data on mortgage applications. Minority applicants tend to have lower credit scores and higher leverage, and are less likely to receive algorithmic approval from race‐blind automated underwriting systems (AUS). Observable applicant‐risk factors explain most of the racial disparities in lender denials. Further, exploiting the AUS data, we show there are risk factors we do not observe, and these factors at least partially explain the residual 1 to 2 percentage point denial gaps. We conclude that differential treatment plays a more limited role in generating denial disparities than previous research suggests.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用抵押贷款申请的机密数据评估抵押贷款审批中的种族歧视。少数族裔申请人往往信用评分较低、杠杆率较高，且不太可能获得种族盲目的自动化承保系统（AUS）的算法批准。可观察的申请人风险因素解释了贷款机构拒绝中大部分的种族差异。此外，利用AUS数据，我们表明存在我们未观察到的风险因素，这些因素至少部分解释了剩余的1至2个百分点的拒绝差距。我们得出结论，与先前研究相比，差别待遇在产生拒绝差异方面的作用更为有限。

records.title_en: Social Security and Trends in Wealth Inequality
records.title_cn: 社会保障与财富不平等趋势
records.abstract_en: Recent influential work finds large increases in inequality in the United States based on measures of wealth concentration that notably exclude the value of social insurance programs. This paper shows that top wealth shares have not changed much over the last three decades when Social Security is properly accounted for. This is because Social Security wealth increased substantially from $7.2 trillion in 1989 to $40.6 trillion in 2019 and now represents nearly 50% of the wealth of the bottom 90% of the wealth distribution. This finding is robust to potential changes to taxes and benefits in response to system financing concerns.
records.abstract_cn: 近期有影响力的研究发现，基于财富集中度的衡量指标，美国的财富不平等显著加剧，但这些指标明显排除了社会保险项目的价值。本文表明，当适当计入社会保障时，顶层财富份额在过去三十年间变化不大。这是因为社会保障财富从1989年的7.2万亿美元大幅增加至2019年的40.6万亿美元，目前约占财富分布底层90%人群财富的近50%。这一发现对于因应系统融资问题而可能发生的税收和福利变化具有稳健性。

records.title_en: Excess Capacity, Marginal q , and Corporate Investment
records.title_cn: 过剩产能、边际q与企业投资
records.abstract_en: Theory posits that when managers anticipate excess capacity, average q becomes a biased estimator of marginal q as the potential for underutilizing new capital reduces the marginal benefit of investing. After correcting for this source of measurement error, the explanatory power of Tobin's q substantially improves in time‐series and cross‐sectional regressions as well as in out‐of‐sample tests. These findings, together with a secular erosion in capacity utilization, help explain why corporate investment rates have been declining for decades despite average q increasing significantly. Our analysis indicates that economic rigidities have contributed to the persistent erosion in capacity utilization.
records.abstract_cn: 理论认为，当管理者预期到过剩产能时，平均q作为边际q的估计量会产生偏差，因为新资本利用不足的可能性降低了投资的边际收益。在纠正了这一测量误差来源后，Tobin's q的解释力在时间序列和横截面回归以及样本外测试中均显著提高。这些发现，连同产能利用率的长期侵蚀，有助于解释为何尽管平均q显著上升，企业投资率却持续下降数十年。我们的分析表明，经济刚性导致了产能利用率的持续侵蚀。

records.title_en: In Too Deep: The Effect of Sunk Costs on Corporate Investment
records.title_cn: 深陷其中：沉没成本对企业投资的影响
records.abstract_en: Sunk costs are unrecoverable costs that should not affect decision making. I provide evidence that firms systematically fail to ignore sunk costs and that this leads to significant investment distortions. In fixed‐exchange‐ratio stock mergers, aggregate market fluctuations after parties enter into a binding merger agreement induce plausibly exogenous variation in the final acquisition cost. These quasi‐random cost shocks strongly predict firms' commitment to an acquired business following deal completion, with an interquartile cost increase reducing subsequent divestiture rates by 8% to 9%. Consistent with an intrapersonal sunk cost channel, distortions are concentrated in firm‐years in which the acquiring CEO is still in office.
records.abstract_cn: 沉没成本是不可回收的成本，不应影响决策。我提供的证据表明，企业系统性地未能忽视沉没成本，这导致了显著的投资扭曲。在固定换股比率股票并购中，双方达成具有约束力的合并协议后，整体市场波动引起了最终收购成本的合理外生变化。这些准随机的成本冲击强烈预测了企业在交易完成后对收购业务的承诺，四分位距成本增加使后续剥离率降低8%至9%。与个人内部沉没成本渠道一致，扭曲集中在收购CEO仍在任的企业年度中。

records.title_en: Intrahousehold Disagreement about Macroeconomic Expectations
records.title_cn: 家庭内部关于宏观经济预期的分歧
records.abstract_en: This paper highlights the simple fact that households typically consist of multiple members who may hold divergent views, a fact that existing approaches to measuring and modeling household macroeconomic expectations largely abstract from. Using unique data on the macroeconomic expectations of both spouses, I document substantial intrahousehold disagreement about inflation, economic recessions, and stock market returns. I further show that household asset allocation decisions are shaped by disagreement between spouses about future stock returns, and a preregistered randomized survey experiment confirms the causal impact of such disagreement on portfolio choice.
records.abstract_cn: 本文强调了一个简单的事实，即家庭通常由可能持有不同观点的多个成员组成，而现有测量和建模家庭宏观经济预期的方法在很大程度上忽略了这一事实。利用关于夫妻双方宏观经济预期的独特数据，我记录了在通货膨胀、经济衰退和股票市场回报方面家庭内部存在显著的分歧。我进一步表明，家庭资产配置决策受到配偶之间关于未来股票回报分歧的影响，并且一项预注册的随机调查实验证实了这种分歧对投资组合选择的因果影响。

records.title_en: In the Red: Overdrafts, Payday Lending, and the Underbanked
records.title_cn: 赤字之中：透支、发薪日贷款与缺乏银行服务的人群
records.abstract_en: The reordering of transactions from “high‐to‐low” is a controversial bank practice thought to maximize fees paid by low‐income customers on overdrawn accounts. We exploit a series of class‐action lawsuits that mandated that some banks cease the practice. Using alternative credit bureau data, we find that after banks cease high‐to‐low reordering, low‐income individuals reduce payday borrowing, increase consumption, realize long‐term improvements in financial health, and gain access to lower‐cost loans in the traditional financial system. These findings suggest that aggressive bank practices can create demand for alternative financial services and highlight an important link between the traditional and alternative financial systems.
records.abstract_cn: 将交易从“高到低”重新排序是一种有争议的银行做法，被认为旨在最大化低收入客户在透支账户上支付的费用。我们利用一系列集体诉讼，这些诉讼要求一些银行停止这种做法。使用替代信用局数据，我们发现，在银行停止高到低重新排序后，低收入个体减少了发薪日借款，增加了消费，实现了财务状况的长期改善，并在传统金融体系中获得了更低成本的贷款。这些发现表明，激进的银行做法可能创造对替代金融服务的需求，并突显了传统与替代金融体系之间的重要联系。

records.title_en: Conflicting Priorities: A Theory of Covenants and Collateral
records.title_cn: 冲突的优先级：契约与抵押品理论
records.abstract_en: We develop a theory of secured debt, unsecured debt, and debt with anti‐dilution covenants. We assume that, as in practice, covenants convey the right to accelerate if violated, but the new secured debt retains its priority even if issued in violation of covenants. We find that such covenants are nonetheless useful: They provide state‐contingent financing flexibility, balancing over‐ and underinvestment incentives. The optimal debt structure is multilayered, combining secured and unsecured debt with and without covenants. Our results are consistent with observations about debt structure, covenant violations, and waivers. They speak to a policy debate about debt priority.
records.abstract_cn: 我们发展了一个关于有担保债务、无担保债务以及带有反稀释条款的债务的理论。我们假设，如同实践中那样，契约赋予在违约时加速到期的权利，但即使新发行的有担保债务违反了契约，其优先级仍然保留。我们发现，尽管如此，这类契约仍然是有用的：它们提供了状态依存的融资灵活性，平衡了过度投资和投资不足的激励。最优债务结构是多层次的，结合了有担保和无担保债务，且有的带契约，有的不带。我们的结果与关于债务结构、契约违约和豁免的观察一致。它们涉及关于债务优先级的政策辩论。

records.title_en: Auctions versus Negotiations: The Role of the Payment Structure
records.title_cn: 拍卖与谈判：支付结构的作用
records.abstract_en: We investigate a seller's strategic choice between optimally structured negotiations with fewer bidders and an auction with more competing bidders when payments can have a contingent component, as is common in mergers and acquisitions (M&A), patent licensing, and employee compensation. The key factor favoring negotiations is that it allows the seller to set her preferred payment structure—that is, the revenue‐maximizing mix of cash and contingent pay; reserve prices are of secondary importance. Negotiations are more likely to dominate if synergies increase in bidders' productivity types (as with acquirer‐target complementarities in M&A). Higher dispersion and magnitude of bidders' private valuations also favor negotiations.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了当支付可以包含或有成分时，卖方在优化结构的谈判（竞标者较少）与拍卖（竞标者更多）之间的战略选择，这在并购（M&A）、专利许可和员工薪酬中很常见。支持谈判的关键因素是，它允许卖方设定其偏好的支付结构——即现金与或有支付的收入最大化组合；保留价格的重要性次之。如果协同效应随竞标者的生产率类型增加（如并购中收购方与目标公司的互补性），谈判更可能占优。竞标者私人估值更高的离散度和幅度也倾向于谈判。

records.title_en: Raising Capital from Investor Syndicates with Strategic Communication
records.title_cn: 通过战略沟通从投资者辛迪加筹集资本
records.abstract_en: An entrepreneur makes offers to multiple investors to fund a project that requires a minimum investment. Concerned about other investors' decisions, each investor strategically communicates information about the project to others. When investors have conflicts of interest, those with contractually stronger incentives to invest attempt to persuade others to invest. Depending on the project's ex ante quality, the entrepreneur may promise investors different returns to create conflicts of interest and induce persuasion, or may promise investors an identical return to align their interests and induce truthful communication. The paper illustrates a new motivation for syndication and hierarchy within syndicates.
records.abstract_cn: 企业家向多位投资者发出要约，以资助一个需要最低投资额的项目。考虑到其他投资者的决策，每位投资者会战略性地向他人传达关于项目的信息。当投资者之间存在利益冲突时，那些合同上具有更强投资激励的投资者会试图说服他人投资。根据项目的事前质量，企业家可能向投资者承诺不同的回报以制造利益冲突并诱导说服，或者可能向投资者承诺相同的回报以协调他们的利益并诱导真实沟通。本文阐述了辛迪加及其内部层级结构的新动机。

records.title_en: Attention, coordination, and bounded recall
records.title_cn: 注意力、协调与有限回忆
records.abstract_en: I consider a class of strategic interactions under asymmetric information in which, prior to finalizing their actions (consumption, production, or investment decisions), agents choose the attention to allocate to a large number of information sources about exogenous events that are responsible for their payoffs (the underlying fundamentals). I study what type of payoff interdependencies contribute to inefficiency in the allocation of attention. I then compare the results for the benchmark of perfect recall (in which the agents remember the content of individual sources) to those for bounded recall (in which the agents are unable to keep track of the influence of individual sources on posterior beliefs). More generally, the analysis illustrates the implications (for attention and usage of information) of a certain form of bounded rationality whereby the summary statistic the agents recall from the sources they pay attention to is distorted away from the optimal action towards the Bayesian projection of the exogenous fundamentals over the signals received.
records.abstract_cn: 我考虑了一类在不对称信息下的战略互动，其中，在最终确定其行动（消费、生产或投资决策）之前，代理人选择将注意力分配给大量关于外生事件（其收益的根本基础）的信息来源。我研究了哪种类型的收益相互依赖会导致注意力分配的低效率。然后，我将完美回忆基准（代理人记住个别来源的内容）的结果与有限回忆（代理人无法跟踪个别来源对后验信念的影响）的结果进行比较。更一般地，分析说明了某种形式的有限理性的含义（对注意力和信息使用的影响），即代理人从他们关注的信息来源中回忆的汇总统计量偏离了最优行动，而趋向于外生基础在收到的信号上的贝叶斯投影。

records.title_en: Overborrowing, underborrowing, and macroprudential policy
records.title_cn: 过度借贷、借贷不足与宏观审慎政策
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we revisit the scope for macroprudential policy in production economies with pecuniary externalities and collateral constraints. We study competitive equilibria and constrained-efficient equilibria and examine the extent to which the gap between the two depends on the production structure and the policy instruments available to the planner. We argue that macroprudential policy is desirable regardless of whether the competitive equilibrium features more or less borrowing than the constrained-efficient equilibrium. In our quantitative analysis, macroprudential taxes on borrowing turn out to be larger when the government has access to ex-post stabilization policies.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们重新审视了具有金钱外部性和抵押约束的生产经济中宏观审慎政策的适用范围。我们研究了竞争均衡和约束有效均衡，并考察了两者之间的差距在多大程度上取决于生产结构和政策制定者可用的政策工具。我们认为，无论竞争均衡相对于约束有效均衡是借贷更多还是更少，宏观审慎政策都是可取的。在我们的定量分析中，当政府能够实施事后稳定政策时，对借贷征收的宏观审慎税会更大。

records.title_en: Intermediation as rent extraction
records.title_cn: 中介作为租金提取
records.abstract_en: This paper shows that intermediation in asset markets may emerge exclusively because of rent extraction motives. Among dealers with heterogeneous bargaining skills, those with superior skills become intermediaries and constitute the core of the trading network, while those with inferior skills constitute the periphery. Intermediation is privately profitable because agents with superior bargaining skills can take positions and unwind them in the future at a better price than others could. Intermediation arises endogenously despite being socially worthless and the resources invested in bargaining skills are wasted. Using a dataset on the Indonesian interbank market, we document that prices vary with the centrality of buyers and sellers in a way that is uniquely consistent with our theory.
records.abstract_cn: 本文表明，资产市场中的中介可能纯粹因租金提取动机而出现。在议价技能异质的交易商中，技能较优者成为中介并构成交易网络的核心，而技能较劣者则构成外围。中介具有私人盈利性，因为议价技能较优的代理人能够建立头寸并在未来以优于他人的价格平仓。尽管中介在社会上毫无价值，且投资于议价技能的资源被浪费，中介仍内生地出现。利用印度尼西亚银行间市场的数据集，我们记录了价格随买卖双方中心性的变化，这种变化与我们的理论唯一一致。

records.title_en: Intertemporal allocation with unknown discounting
records.title_cn: 未知折现下的跨期分配
records.abstract_en: We consider the problem faced by a durable-good monopolist who can allocate a single good at any time, but is uncertain of a buyer's values and temporal preferences for receiving the good. We derive conditions under which it is optimal for the monopolist to ignore the uncertainty about the buyer's discount factor and allocate immediately via a single first-period price. Under one condition, the seller optimally offers a single first-period price if she would weakly raise this price upon learning that the buyer cannot be too impatient (Corollary 2). A related condition states that the single first-period price is optimal if buyer types with higher discount factors have stochastically higher values (Corollary 3). These conditions also apply when sellers face ambiguity regarding the buyer's discount factor. Our results provide a novel justification for ignoring heterogeneous discount factors when the seller is incompletely informed about buyer's temporal preferences.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个耐用品垄断者面临的问题，他可以在任何时间分配单一商品，但不确定买方的价值以及接收该商品的时间偏好。我们推导出条件，在这些条件下，垄断者忽略关于买方折现因子的不确定性并立即通过单一首期价格进行分配是最优的。在一种条件下，如果卖方在得知买方不可能过于不耐烦时会微弱地提高这一价格，那么卖方最优地提供单一首期价格（推论2）。一个相关条件表明，如果具有较高折现因子的买方类型具有随机较高的价值，则单一首期价格是最优的（推论3）。这些条件也适用于卖方对买方折现因子存在模糊性的情况。我们的结果为在卖方对买方时间偏好不完全知情时忽略异质性折现因子提供了新的理由。

records.title_en: Two-player rationalizable implementation
records.title_cn: 双人理性化实施
records.abstract_en: The paper characterizes the class of two-player social choice functions implementable in rationalizable strategies under complete information.
records.abstract_cn: 本文刻画了在完全信息下，可通过理性化策略实施的双人社会选择函数的类别。

records.title_en: Beliefs and the net worth trap
records.title_cn: 信念与净值陷阱
records.abstract_en: We develop a tractable framework to explore how beliefs about long-term economic growth shape macroeconomic and financial stability. By modeling belief distortions among productive capital users, we provide an analytical characterization of a novel phenomenon termed the “net worth trap”, wherein overly optimistic or pessimistic beliefs among productive agents prevent them from rebuilding wealth, causing permanent inefficiencies. A procyclical swing in beliefs reduces or exacerbates the instability, indicating that the type of belief when the economy is vulnerable has important consequences on financial stability and macroeconomic dynamics.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个易于处理的框架，探讨关于长期经济增长的信念如何塑造宏观经济和金融稳定性。通过对生产性资本使用者信念扭曲的建模，我们提供了一种被称为“净值陷阱”的新现象的分析特征，其中生产性主体的过度乐观或悲观信念阻止他们重建财富，导致永久性的低效率。信念的顺周期波动会减少或加剧不稳定性，表明当经济脆弱时信念的类型对金融稳定和宏观经济动态具有重要影响。

records.title_en: Personalized pricing, network effects, and commitment
records.title_cn: 个性化定价、网络效应与承诺
records.abstract_en: Big data and data technology have facilitated the widespread adoption of personalized pricing practices. While price personalization enables firms to extract greater rent from consumers, it often reduces price transparency, which can negatively impact firm profits in situations involving consumer coordination. In such contexts, a firm's commitment to pricing strategies can become essential for restoring profitability. We explore several commitment devices available to firms and discuss their implications. These devices include delegating pricing decisions to a manager who prioritizes consumer surplus, leveraging existing networks as signals for later consumers or to build reputation, and implementing uniform pricing or price caps in response to regulatory restrictions.
records.abstract_cn: 大数据和数据技术促进了个性化定价实践的广泛采用。虽然价格个性化使企业能够从消费者那里获取更多租金，但它往往降低了价格透明度，在涉及消费者协调的情况下可能对企业利润产生负面影响。在这种背景下，企业对定价策略的承诺对于恢复盈利能力变得至关重要。我们探讨了企业可用的几种承诺机制，并讨论了它们的影响。这些机制包括将定价决策委托给优先考虑消费者剩余的经理，利用现有网络作为后续消费者的信号或建立声誉，以及实施统一定价或价格上限以应对监管限制。

records.title_en: Trade Policy, Exchange Rates, and the Globalization Surge of the 1990s
records.title_cn: 贸易政策、汇率与1990年代的全球化浪潮
records.abstract_en: The decision by developing countries to open up their economies to foreign trade and investment in the 1980s and 1990s was a momentous event in world history. How and why did this trade policy revolution take place? Most accounts of trade politics stress domestic interest groups or trade agreements as driving policy changes, but these explanations fail in this period. This paper notes that many import restrictions were imposed for balance of payments purposes, as a way of avoiding a devaluation and protecting foreign exchange reserves from depletion under fixed exchange rates. A shortage of foreign exchange in the mid-1980s forced countries, under the guidance of economists, to shift to a more flexible exchange rate system that boosted export earnings and made import controls unnecessary for payments balance. Just as seen during the Great Depression, the exchange rate regime was a key factor in a country’s trade policy.
records.abstract_cn: 发展中国家在1980年代和1990年代决定向外国贸易和投资开放其经济，是世界历史上的一个重大事件。这场贸易政策革命是如何以及为何发生的？大多数关于贸易政治的论述强调国内利益集团或贸易协定是推动政策变化的因素，但这些解释在这一时期并不适用。本文指出，许多进口限制是为了国际收支目的而实施的，作为在固定汇率下避免货币贬值和保护外汇储备免于枯竭的一种方式。1980年代中期外汇短缺迫使各国在经济学家指导下转向更灵活的汇率制度，这增加了出口收入，并使进口管制不再为收支平衡所必需。正如在大萧条期间所见，汇率制度是一国贸易政策的关键因素。

records.title_en: Dissecting the Sinews of Power: International Trade and the Rise of Britain’s Fiscal-Military State, 1689–1823
records.title_cn: 解析权力之筋：国际贸易与英国财政-军事国家的兴起，1689-1823
records.abstract_en: We evaluate the role of taxes on overseas trade in the development of imperial Britain’s fiscal-military state. Influential work, for example, Brewer’s Sinews of Power , attributed increased fiscal capacity to the taxation of domestic, rather than traded, goods: excise revenues, coarsely associated with domestic goods, grew faster than customs revenues. We construct new historical revenue series disaggregating excise revenues from traded and domestic goods. We find substantial growth in revenue from traded goods, accounting for over half of indirect taxation around 1800. This challenges conventional wisdom, attributing the development of the British state to domestic factors. International factors mattered, too.
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估了海外贸易税收在大英帝国财政-军事国家发展中的作用。有影响力的研究，例如布鲁尔的《权力之筋》，将财政能力的增强归因于对国内商品而非贸易商品的征税：与国内商品粗略相关的消费税收入增长快于关税收入。我们构建了新的历史收入序列，将消费税收入从贸易商品和国内商品中分解出来。我们发现来自贸易商品的收入显著增长，在1800年左右占间接税的一半以上。这挑战了传统观点，即英国国家的发展归因于国内因素。国际因素也很重要。

records.title_en: Social Mobility in the Long Run: An Analysis of Tongcheng, China, 1300 to 1900
records.title_cn: 长期社会流动性：中国桐城分析，1300至1900
records.abstract_en: This study examines intergenerational mobility in China over 6 centuries using unique genealogical data on father-son pairs from 7 clans in Tongcheng County. Covering 18 generations and approximately 40,000 individuals, the analysis spans a broad set of social classes, from ordinary people to jinshi degree holders. The findings indicate that although social mobility was slow to change, mobility nonetheless underwent a sizable increase during the seventeenth century. The timing of the trends corroborates a number of key changes that affected mobility for commoners and for the highly educated elites. The results also show that intergenerational mobility and inequality are negatively correlated in the time series, a pattern previously observed in cross-sectional studies and commonly known as the Great Gatsby curve.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究利用来自桐城县7个氏族的父子配对独特家谱数据，考察了中国横跨6个世纪间的代际流动。该分析涵盖18代人、约40,000人，跨越从普通百姓到进士出身者的广泛社会阶层。研究结果表明，尽管社会流动性变化缓慢，但在十七世纪期间流动性仍然出现了相当大的增长。这些趋势的时间点印证了影响平民和受过高等教育精英流动性的若干关键变化。结果还显示，代际流动与不平等在时间序列上呈负相关，这一模式先前在横截面研究中观察到，通常被称为“了不起的盖茨比曲线”。

records.title_en: What Happened to the Incomes of the Rich during the Great Levelling? Evidence from Swedish Individual-Level Data, 1909–1950
records.title_cn: 大均衡时期富人的收入发生了什么？来自瑞典个人层面数据的证据，1909-1950年
records.abstract_en: We use individual-level income data from archived taxation lists to study top-income earners in Sweden from 1909 to 1950. Using information on 21,055 individual taxpayers in two elite areas in greater Stockholm, we show that top incomes fell in real terms over this period, at a stable pace without obvious connection to the Great Depression or the world wars. The peak of inequality was related to the early stages of a globalized economy with Schumpeterian entrepreneurial profits; the decline was related to sharpened competition, driving down profits, as well as increased regulation, expansion of education, and eroded position of professionals.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用来自存档税务清单的个人层面收入数据，研究了1909年至1950年间瑞典的高收入者。通过斯德哥尔摩大区两个精英地区的21,055名个体纳税人的信息，我们表明在此期间，高收入实际值有所下降，且下降速度稳定，与大萧条或两次世界大战无明显关联。不平等的高峰与全球化经济早期阶段的熊彼特式企业家利润相关；而下降则与竞争加剧导致利润下降、监管加强、教育扩展以及专业人士地位削弱有关。

records.title_en: Bank Lending and Deposit Crunches during the Great Depression
records.title_cn: 大萧条时期的银行贷款与存款紧缩
records.abstract_en: Bank distress was a defining feature of the Great Depression in the United States. Most banks, however, weathered the storm and remained in operation throughout the contraction. We show that surviving banks cut lending when depositors withdrew funds en masse during panics. This panic-induced decline in lending explains about one-third of the reduction in aggregate commercial bank lending between 1929 and 1932, more than twice as much as attributed to the failure of banks.
records.abstract_cn: 银行困境是美国大萧条的一个显著特征。然而，大多数银行经受住了风暴，在整个经济收缩期间持续运营。我们表明，在恐慌期间，当存款人大量提取资金时，幸存的银行削减了贷款。这种由恐慌引起的贷款下降，解释了1929年至1932年间商业银行总贷款减少的大约三分之一，这一比例是银行倒闭所导致减少量的两倍多。

records.title_en: Who Wins and Loses in a Bubble? Evidence from the British Bicycle Mania
records.title_cn: 泡沫中的赢家与输家：来自英国自行车狂热的证据
records.abstract_en: How do different types of investors perform during financial bubbles? Using a rich archival source, we explore investor performance during the British bicycle mania of the 1890s. We find that directors and employees of cycle companies reduced their holdings substantially during the crash. Those holding shares after the crash were generally not from groups stereotypically thought of as naïve, but gentlemen living near a stock exchange, who had sufficient time, money, and opportunity to engage in speculation. Our findings suggest that the investors most at risk of losing during a bubble are those prone to familiarity and overconfidence biases.
records.abstract_cn: 不同类型的投资者在金融泡沫期间表现如何？利用丰富的档案资料，我们探讨了1890年代英国自行车狂热期间投资者的表现。我们发现，自行车公司的董事和员工在崩盘期间大幅减少了持股。崩盘后仍持有股份的人通常并非刻板印象中的天真群体，而是居住在证券交易所附近、有足够时间、金钱和机会进行投机的绅士。我们的研究结果表明，在泡沫期间最易遭受损失的投资者是那些倾向于熟悉度和过度自信偏差的人。

records.title_en: Growing, Shrinking, and Long-Run Economic Performance: Historical Perspectives on Economic Development
records.title_cn: 增长、收缩与长期经济表现：经济发展的历史视角
records.abstract_en: Although long-run economic performance has improved primarily through a decline in the rate and frequency of shrinking rather than through an increase in the rate of growing, most analysis of economic development has focused on increasing the rate of growing. We examine the forces making for a reduction in the rate of shrinking. The main proximate factors considered are (1) structural change, (2) technological change, (3) demographic change, and (4) stabilization policy. We conclude by considering institutions and institutional change as the key ultimate factors behind the reduction in shrinking, showing how they operate through political stability.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管长期经济表现的改善主要通过收缩率和收缩频率的下降而非增长率的提高来实现，但大多数经济发展分析都聚焦于提高增长率。我们考察了促使收缩率下降的力量。考虑的主要直接因素包括（1）结构变化，（2）技术变化，（3）人口变化，以及（4）稳定政策。最后，我们考虑制度和制度变迁作为收缩减少背后的关键最终因素，展示它们如何通过政治稳定性发挥作用。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: To go electric or to burn coal? A randomized field experiment of informational nudges
records.title_cn: 选择电力还是燃烧煤炭？信息助推的随机实地实验
records.abstract_en: Coal heating in residential homes is an important source of indoor air pollution, leading to detrimental health effects. We conduct a randomized field experiment in northern China using three types of SMS campaigns targeting three potential biases that may hinder the adoption of electric heating: Cost SMS campaign, designed to address the overestimation of electricity expenses; Health SMS campaign, aimed at addressing the underestimation of health damage associated with coal heating; and Social Comparison SMS campaign, intended to inform households about the popularity of electric heating. We find that the Cost SMS backfires: it instead leads to a substantial reduction in electric heating. This can be attributed to salience bias induced by the Cost SMS, which drew heightened attention to the cost of electricity. The Health SMS is ineffective for households that underestimate the health damage of coal heating. Social Comparison SMS is only effective for a small proportion of households who were concerned about their neighbors’ heating choices. Overall, our findings suggest that SMS campaigns targeting these biases are largely ineffective, and caution should be exercised when applying plausible nudge interventions. The findings also suggest that households may be motivated to maintain their beliefs and resist paternalistic interventions.
records.abstract_cn: 住宅燃煤供暖是室内空气污染的重要来源，导致有害的健康影响。我们在中国北方进行了一项随机实地实验，使用三种短信活动针对可能阻碍采用电供暖的三种潜在偏见：成本短信活动，旨在解决对电费的高估；健康短信活动，旨在解决对燃煤供暖相关健康损害的低估；以及社会比较短信活动，旨在告知家庭电供暖的普及情况。我们发现成本短信适得其反：它反而导致电供暖大幅减少。这可归因于成本短信引起的显著性偏见，该短信使人们对电费成本更加关注。健康短信对低估燃煤供暖健康损害的家庭无效。社会比较短信仅对一小部分关注邻居供暖选择的家庭有效。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，针对这些偏见的短信活动在很大程度上无效，在应用看似合理的助推干预时应谨慎行事。研究结果还表明，家庭可能有意维持其信念并抵制家长式干预。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: “Size-dependent” environmental regulations and spatial labor allocation
records.title_cn: “规模依赖型”环境规制与空间劳动力配置
records.abstract_en: Rich evidence shows that the large and more developed cities in China (as in many other countries) enforce stricter environmental regulations. On one hand, stringent regulations have negative impacts on the local labor market, leading to labor outflow into small cities with lower productivity and “dirtier” industrial structure. On the other hand, better environment quality (as a result of the regulations) is also an attraction for domestic immigrants. This paper is the first to use a quantitative spatial model to study the consequences of spatially “size-dependent” urban environmental policies. We find that higher aggregate productivity and fewer total emissions can be simultaneously achieved by reducing the existing “size-dependent” variation of environmental regulations in China. Moreover, to meet a given overall abatement target, urging the largest cities to further tighten the regulations may do the most damage to the economy.
records.abstract_cn: 丰富证据表明，中国（以及许多其他国家）的大城市和较发达城市执行更严格的环境规制。一方面，严格规制对当地劳动力市场产生负面影响，导致劳动力流向生产率较低、产业结构“更脏”的小城市。另一方面，更好的环境质量（作为规制的结果）也吸引国内移民。本文首次使用定量空间模型研究空间上“规模依赖型”城市环境政策的后果。我们发现，通过减少中国现有环境规制的“规模依赖型”差异，可以同时实现更高的总生产率和更少的总排放。此外，为达到给定的总体减排目标，敦促最大城市进一步收紧规制可能对经济造成最大损害。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: The value of cleaner waterways: Evidence from the Black-and-Odorous water program
records.title_cn: 清洁水道的价值：来自黑臭水体治理项目的证据
records.abstract_en: This study investigates the economic impacts of cleaning up heavily polluted waterways in urban neighborhoods. We leverage the Black-and-Odorous water program, a major urban environmental campaign in China, as a natural experiment to identify the causal impact of cleaner waterways on local housing prices, housing supply, and business growth. Implemented in 2016, the program remediated heavily polluted waterways in China’s 36 most developed cities. Using a difference-in-differences estimator, we find that the program mainly benefits properties within 1 mile of cleaned-up waterways: These properties saw a 2.3 % appreciation in market value after the program. Beyond the impacts on the housing market, we identify two novel mechanisms associated with community revitalization following pollution management and examine their implications for housing prices. First, new real estate developments near treated waterways are more likely to offer high-end units after the program. Second, service businesses flourish in neighborhoods near cleaned waterways, indicating a commercial rejuvenation of these areas.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了城市社区中重度污染水道清理的经济影响。我们利用中国一项重大城市环境运动——黑臭水体治理项目作为自然实验，以识别清洁水道对当地房价、住房供应和商业增长的因果影响。该项目于2016年实施，对中国36个最发达城市的重度污染水道进行了修复。使用双重差分估计法，我们发现该项目主要惠及清理水道1英里范围内的房产：这些房产在项目后市场价值上涨了2.3%。除了对住房市场的影响外，我们还确定了与污染治理后社区复兴相关的两个新机制，并考察了它们对房价的影响。首先，项目后处理水道附近的新房地产开发更可能提供高端单元。其次，服务型企业在清洁水道附近的社区蓬勃发展，表明这些地区的商业复兴。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Air pollution and the housing market: Evidence from Germany’s Low Emission Zones
records.title_cn: 空气污染与住房市场：来自德国低排放区的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies whether air quality improvements from driving restrictions are valued in the housing market, using comprehensive data on real estate prices in Germany. For identification, we exploit the staggered introduction of Low Emission Zones (LEZs) across German cities, restricting inner-city access for emission-intensive vehicles. We find that air quality improvements are reflected by roughly 2 percent higher apartment rents. The results are primarily driven by earlier LEZ implementations in areas with relatively higher pre-intervention pollution levels and in areas less dependent on cars. Our findings have important implications for planned changes to the emission intensity of the vehicle fleet, underscoring the potential implications of transitioning to cleaner transportation systems.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用德国房地产价格的综合数据，研究驾驶限制带来的空气质量改善是否在住房市场中得到体现。为识别因果效应，我们利用了德国各城市低排放区（LEZs）的分阶段引入，这些区域限制了高排放车辆进入市中心。我们发现，空气质量改善反映在公寓租金大约高出2%上。结果主要由早期实施低排放区且在干预前污染水平相对较高以及汽车依赖度较低的地区驱动。我们的发现对计划中的车辆排放强度变化具有重要意义，强调了向更清洁交通系统过渡的潜在影响。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Effects of temperature exposures on early childhood cognitive development and home environment
records.title_cn: 温度暴露对幼儿认知发展和家庭环境的影响
records.abstract_en: Daily exposure to suboptimal temperature with inadequate protection can undermine children’s development, but evidence is limited in the range of temperature and the set of developmental outcomes. Using a unique panel study in disadvantaged rural communities, we find that children’s exposures to low temperature undermine cognitive development during early childhood. In addition, caregiver–child interactions and material investments are lower for households exposed to low temperature, highlighting their limited capacity to adapt and the potential for persistent effects on children’s long-term outcomes through home environment. Our findings show the need to account for a broad range of temperature variations when promoting children’s development, and propose home environment as a novel policy channel to counter the negative temperature effects on children.
records.abstract_cn: 每日暴露于不适宜温度且缺乏充分保护可能损害儿童的发展，但关于温度范围和发育结果集合的证据有限。利用一项针对贫困农村社区的独特面板研究，我们发现儿童暴露于低温会损害幼儿期的认知发展。此外，暴露于低温的家庭中，照护者与儿童之间的互动和物质投资较低，这凸显了其适应能力有限，以及通过家庭环境对儿童长期结果可能产生的持续影响。我们的研究结果表明，在促进儿童发展时需要考虑广泛的温度变化，并提出家庭环境作为应对温度对儿童负面影响的新的政策渠道。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: The impact of real-time energy consumption feedback on residential gas and electricity usage
records.title_cn: 实时能源消耗反馈对住宅燃气和电力使用的影响
records.abstract_en: We implemented a Randomized Controlled Trial to estimate the impact of real-time energy consumption feedback on residential energy use. A random half of the participant households were offered an energy consumption monitor that uses smart-meter data to relay real-time information on energy use. The feedback resulted in natural gas and electricity savings of, respectively, 6.9 and 2.2 percent; the total amount of energy consumed was reduced by 5.8 percent. We probe the underlying mechanisms by means of a survey and find suggestive evidence that the display’s main impact is via raising the salience of the costs of using energy.
records.abstract_cn: 我们实施了一项随机对照试验，以评估实时能源消耗反馈对住宅能源使用的影响。随机一半的参与家庭被提供了能源消耗监测器，该监测器利用智能电表数据实时传递能源使用信息。反馈导致天然气和电力分别节省了6.9和2.2%%；总能源消耗量减少了5.8%%。我们通过调查探究了潜在机制，并发现提示性证据表明，该显示器的主要影响是通过提高能源使用成本的显著性来实现的。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Resource windfalls, connectivity, and political polarization
records.title_cn: 资源意外之财、连通性与政治极化
records.abstract_en: Can natural resource windfalls polarize political opinions? We find that, in societies with heightened political engagement (connectivity), the answer is in the affirmative. Resource windfalls spark public debates over their usage. A model of contest over public opinion predicts that under high societal connectivity resource-induced public debates lead to elevated polarization by allowing extremists unbridled control over the discourse. Employing detailed individual-level U.S. data on political opinions covering several decades, we first confirm that active participation in the political discourse is associated with more extreme (polarized) opinions. Second, we test the model’s predictions by examining the impact of plausibly exogenous variations in states’ connectivity levels and resource windfalls on individuals’ political opinions. Our baseline estimates show that a one standard deviation of resource windfalls induces a 4% increase in the affective polarization of individuals residing in high connectivity states. Our results shed light on hitherto overlooked adverse effects of natural resource abundance, as well as on the dynamics of political polarization.
records.abstract_cn: 自然资源意外之财能否使政治观点极化？我们发现，在政治参与度（连通性）较高的社会中，答案是肯定的。资源意外之财引发关于其使用的公共辩论。一个关于公共舆论争夺的模型预测，在高社会连通性下，资源引发的公共辩论通过允许极端分子无约束地控制话语，导致极化加剧。利用涵盖数十年的美国个体层面政治观点详细数据，我们首先确认，积极参与政治话语与更极端（极化）的观点相关。其次，我们通过考察各州连通性水平和资源意外之财的看似外生变化对个体政治观点的影响来检验模型的预测。我们的基线估计显示，一个标准差资源意外之财导致高连通性州居民的情感极化增加4%%。我们的结果揭示了迄今被忽视的自然资源丰富的不利影响，以及政治极化的动态。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Welfare losses from wildfire smoke: Evidence from daily outdoor recreation data
records.title_cn: 野火烟雾造成的福利损失：来自每日户外休闲数据的证据
records.abstract_en: Wildfire smoke pollution is growing in the western United States. Estimates of health impacts from smoke are numerous, but few revealed preference estimates of its damages exist. We study a setting where individuals are directly exposed to smoke and where avoidance behavior is measured with high frequency: outdoor recreation. We combine millions of administrative campground reservation records with satellite data on wildfire, smoke, and air pollution. The data allow us to model sequential recreation decisions under evolving information using a novel control function approach. We estimate wildfire smoke reduces welfare by $107 per person per trip. These damages are larger when campgrounds are affected by consecutive days of smoke. Back-of-the-envelope calculations imply 21.5 million outdoor recreation visits in the western United States are affected by smoke every year, with annual welfare losses of $2.3 billion. These findings contribute to a growing body of evidence on the costs of wildfire smoke.
records.abstract_cn: 野火烟雾污染在美国西部日益严重。关于烟雾对健康影响的估计众多，但对其损害的直接偏好估计却很少。我们研究了一个个体直接暴露于烟雾且规避行为以高频方式测量的场景：户外休闲。我们将数百万条行政露营地预订记录与野火、烟雾和空气污染的卫星数据相结合。这些数据使我们能够利用一种新颖的控制函数方法，在信息不断演变的情况下对连续的休闲决策进行建模。我们估计野火烟雾使每人每次旅行的福利减少$107美元。当露营地连续多日受到烟雾影响时，这些损害更大。粗略计算表明，美国西部每年有21.5百万次户外休闲访问受到烟雾影响，年度福利损失达$2.3十亿美元。这些发现为关于野火烟雾成本的日益增多的证据做出了贡献。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Household landfill diversion and the impact on methane emissions
records.title_cn: 家庭垃圾分流及其对甲烷排放的影响
records.abstract_en: Food waste accounts for approximately 8% of total global greenhouse emissions. Expanding organics diversion (composting) programs is a common solution for reducing methane emissions from landfills, which are primarily caused by organics. This study explores the staggered implementation of a curbside organics program expansion and finds that households increase their diversion behavior by 45%; however, the program costs per household are nine times greater than the social benefit of avoided methane. The cost/ton of carbon dioxide equivalent emissions (CO2e) avoided is then estimated across the United States for these programs. The median organics program expansion would cost $478/ton of CO2e avoided. However, this estimate has substantial heterogeneity because some municipalities, particularly large cities, are served by landfills with methane capture, resulting in the largest potential methane producers having among the lowest methane emissions per household. The findings suggest that current organics program designs may be difficult to justify solely on climate grounds.
records.abstract_cn: 食物垃圾约占全球温室气体排放总量的8%。扩大有机物分流（堆肥）项目是减少垃圾填埋场甲烷排放（主要由有机物引起）的常见解决方案。本研究探讨了路边有机物项目扩展的分阶段实施情况，发现家庭的分流行为增加了45%；然而，每户的项目成本是避免甲烷排放的社会效益的九倍。随后，估算了这些项目在美国各地避免的每吨二氧化碳当量排放（CO2e）的成本。有机物项目扩展的中位数成本为每吨避免的CO2e $478。然而，这一估计存在显著的异质性，因为一些城市，特别是大城市，由配备甲烷捕获设施的垃圾填埋场服务，导致最大的潜在甲烷生产者每户的甲烷排放量却最低。研究结果表明，仅从气候角度出发，当前的有机物项目设计可能难以证明其合理性。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: The path to net zero emissions
records.title_cn: 通往净零排放之路
records.abstract_en: To reach the goals of the Paris agreement, net carbon emissions must be reduced to zero by the second half of this century. To achieve this, some kind of carbon dioxide removal (CDR) is needed. The paper gives an analysis of the interaction between extraction of fossil energy resources and CDR. If there is sufficient capacity for storing captured carbon, it will be optimal to have a period of negative net emissions. In this case cumulative extraction will not depend on climate costs, but will be higher the lower is the cost of CDR at low levels of CDR.
records.abstract_cn: 为实现巴黎协定的目标，净碳排放必须在本世纪下半叶降至零。要实现这一目标，需要某种形式的二氧化碳移除（CDR）。本文分析了化石能源资源开采与CDR之间的相互作用。如果封存捕获碳的能力充足，那么出现一段净排放为负的时期将是最优的。在这种情况下，累计开采量将不依赖于气候成本，但在CDR水平较低时，CDR成本越低，累计开采量越高。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Effects of air pollution on labor supply: Evidence from Japan
records.title_cn: 空气污染对劳动力供给的影响：来自日本的证据
records.abstract_en: We empirically examine the effects of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) pollution on labor supply based on data from Japan, a country in which the PM2.5 level is generally low to moderate. PM2.5 can adversely affect health and cause affected workers to reduce labor supply, whereas workers and firms can take reactive measures to mitigate labor supply losses. We aim to investigate the causal effects of PM2.5 pollution, managing potential endogeneity of PM2.5 pollution by using nationally representative panel data and utilizing two exogenous phenomena: thermal inversion events and transboundary pollution transport from the Asian continent. The results robustly show that increases in PM2.5 levels decrease monthly labor hours. Even moderate levels of PM2.5 pollution affect labor supply on a national scale. Our findings are related to current international discussions on low-to-moderate levels of air pollution.
records.abstract_cn: 我们基于日本的数据实证检验了细颗粒物（PM2.5）污染对劳动力供给的影响，日本是一个PM2.5水平普遍较低至中等的国家。PM2.5可能对健康产生不利影响，并导致受影响的工人减少劳动力供给，而工人和企业可以采取应对措施以减轻劳动力供给损失。我们旨在调查PM2.5污染的因果效应，通过使用具有全国代表性的面板数据并利用两种外生现象来控制PM2.5污染的潜在内生性：热逆温事件和来自亚洲大陆的跨界污染传输。结果稳健地表明，PM2.5水平的增加会减少每月劳动小时数。即使是中等水平的PM2.5污染也会在全国范围内影响劳动力供给。我们的发现与当前关于低至中等水平空气污染的国际讨论相关。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Does freight structure transformation improve air quality?–Evidence from China's “shifting freight from truck to rail” policy
records.title_cn: 货运结构调整是否改善了空气质量？——来自中国“公转铁”政策的证据
records.abstract_en: China proactively reshaped its freight system to combat air pollution from the transportation sector. This paper focuses on the “Shifting Freight from Truck to Rail” (SFTR) policy, and examines the environmental consequences of expanding railway transport system while curbing heavy trucks in road freight. Combine the high-frequency air pollution data with meteorology data, utilizing the augmented regression discontinuity in time-series (RDiT), we found that the implementation of SFTR led to a respective decrease of 13.9 %, 12.5 %, and 4.2 % in the concentrations of PM2.5, PM10, and NO2 in the Bohai Rim region. Our empirical findings withstand an alternative specification of generalized difference-in-differences (DiD) method and a series of robustness checks. Preliminary calculations indicate that the health and economic output benefits of SFTR in the Bohai Rim region amount to approximately $24.99 billion, with the cost of expanding freight railway infrastructure and firms’ compliance cost totaling $4.05 billion.
records.abstract_cn: 中国积极重塑其货运系统以应对交通运输部门造成的空气污染。本文聚焦于“公转铁”（SFTR）政策，考察了在限制公路货运中重型卡车的同时扩展铁路运输系统的环境后果。结合高频空气污染数据与气象数据，利用增强的时间序列断点回归（RDiT）方法，我们发现SFTR的实施导致环渤海地区PM2.13.9%、PM10和NO2浓度分别下降了12.5%、4.2%和5。我们的实证结果在广义双重差分（DiD）方法的替代设定及一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。初步计算表明，SFTR在环渤海地区的健康和经济产出效益约为24.99亿美元，而扩展货运铁路基础设施及企业合规成本总计为4.05亿美元。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: From Low Emission Zone to academic track: Environmental policy effects on educational achievement in elementary school
records.title_cn: 从低排放区到学术轨道：环境政策对小学教育成就的影响
records.abstract_en: Do long-term improvements in air quality influence children’s educational outcomes? This paper investigates the impact of Low Emission Zones (LEZs), which restrict access to designated areas for emission-intensive vehicles, on the educational achievement of elementary school students in Germany. Using school-level data from North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany’s most populous state, we exploit the staggered introduction of LEZs since 2008 with a difference-in-differences approach. LEZ implementations increase transition rates to the academic track in secondary education by approximately one percentage point, or 2.4 percent. We validate this finding using more aggregated district-level data across all of Germany. Our findings imply sizable educational co-benefits of reductions in air pollution.
records.abstract_cn: 长期空气质量改善是否影响儿童的教育成果？本文研究了低排放区（LEZs）对德国小学生教育成就的影响，低排放区限制高排放车辆进入指定区域。利用德国人口最多的州——北莱茵-威斯特法伦州的学校层面数据，我们采用双重差分法，利用自2008年以来低排放区的分阶段引入。低排放区的实施使中学学术轨道的升学率提高了约一个百分点，即2.4%。我们使用德国全国范围内更聚合的地区层面数据验证了这一发现。我们的研究结果表明，减少空气污染带来了可观的教育协同效益。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Contracting for Coordination
records.title_cn: 协调的契约设计
records.abstract_en: A principal contracts with agents to achieve coordination. Multiple equilibria can in general arise under given contract offers, and the principal wishes to maximize her payoff guarantee across equilibrium outcomes. I discuss recent work on contracting for coordination using a simple, unifying framework. The analysis reveals how the principal’s concern for strategic uncertainty shapes optimal contracts, with implications for discrimination and inequality between agents. I adapt the framework to various settings—including contractible actions, hidden actions, and hidden information—and highlight the relevance of contracting for coordination in applications—including adoption and investment, team incentives, and goods with network externalities.
records.abstract_cn: 委托人通过与代理人签订契约来实现协调。在给定的契约报价下，通常可能出现多重均衡，而委托人希望最大化其在均衡结果中的支付保证。我利用一个简单且统一的框架讨论了近期关于协调契约设计的研究。分析揭示了委托人对战略不确定性的关注如何塑造最优契约，并对代理人之间的歧视和不平等产生影响。我将该框架应用于多种情境——包括可契约行动、隐藏行动和隐藏信息——并强调协调契约设计在应用中的相关性——包括采用与投资、团队激励以及具有网络外部性的商品。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Economic Growth in a Cooperative Economy
records.title_cn: 合作经济体中的经济增长
records.abstract_en: We develop and formalise an equilibrium concept for a dynamic economy in which production takes place in worker cooperatives. The concept rules out allocations of workers to cooperatives in which a worker in one cooperative could move to a different cooperative and make both herself and the existing workers in the receiving cooperative better off. It also rules out allocations in which workers in a cooperative would be made better off by some of the other workers leaving. We also provide a minimum-information equilibrium-selection criterion, which refines our equilibrium concept. We illustrate the application of our concept and refinement in the context of an overlapping-generation economy with specific preferences and technology. The cooperative economy follows a dynamic path qualitatively similar to the path followed by a capitalist economy, featuring gradual convergence to a steady state with constant output. However, the cooperative economy features a static inefficiency, in that, for a given aggregate capital stock, firm size is smaller than what a social planner would choose. On the other hand, the cooperative economy cannot be dynamically inefficient and could accumulate capital at a rate that is higher or lower than the capitalist economy. As a result, steady-state income per worker could be higher or lower in the cooperative economy. We also present an illustrative calibration, which quantitatively compares steady-state incomes and welfare in a cooperative and in a capitalist economy.
records.abstract_cn: 我们为一个动态经济体发展并形式化了一个均衡概念，在该经济体中，生产发生在工人合作社中。该概念排除了工人分配到合作社的配置，即一个合作社中的工人可以转移到另一个不同的合作社，并同时使自己和接收合作社中的现有工人变得更好。它还排除了合作社中的工人因其他一些工人离开而变得更好的配置。我们还提供了一个最小信息均衡选择标准，该标准细化了我们的均衡概念。我们在一个具有特定偏好和技术的重叠代经济体的背景下，说明了我们的概念和细化的应用。合作经济体遵循一条动态路径，在性质上类似于资本主义经济体所遵循的路径，其特征是逐渐收敛到产出恒定的稳态。然而，合作经济体存在静态无效率，即对于给定的总资本存量，企业规模小于社会计划者所选择的规模。另一方面，合作经济体不可能动态无效率，并且可能以高于或低于资本主义经济体的速度积累资本。因此，合作经济体中每个工人的稳态收入可能更高或更低。我们还提供了一个说明性校准，该校准定量比较了合作经济体和资本主义经济体中的稳态收入和福利。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: A Simple Theory of Deep Trade Integration
records.title_cn: 深度贸易整合的简单理论
records.abstract_en: Which countries should aim for regulatory cooperation, and to what extent should they pursue it? We develop an imperfectly competitive trade model that accounts for differences in technology and regulatory preferences regarding local consumption externalities across countries. Each country sets unique product standards, and firms incur costs when tailoring products to different markets. Trade occurs when the benefits of comparative advantages outweigh the desire for asymmetric regulations. Our findings indicate that regulatory cooperation, defined as the cooperative setting of standards, is most advantageous for countries with moderate differences in regulatory preferences. Shallow integration, however, falls short of achieving the optimal planner’s solution. Countries with strong comparative advantages in distinct externality-generating goods can pursue deeper regulatory cooperation through mutual regulatory concessions. Additionally, when regulatory preferences are highly dispersed, international cooperation tends to form regulatory blocs.
records.abstract_cn: 哪些国家应该追求监管合作，以及它们应该在多大程度上进行合作？我们开发了一个不完全竞争的贸易模型，该模型考虑了各国在技术和对本地消费外部性的监管偏好上的差异。每个国家设定独特的产品标准，企业在为不同市场定制产品时会产生成本。当比较优势的好处超过对不对称监管的渴望时，贸易就会发生。我们的研究结果表明，监管合作，即标准的合作设定，对于监管偏好差异适中的国家最为有利。然而，浅层整合无法达到最优规划者的解决方案。在特定产生外部性的商品上具有强大比较优势的国家可以通过相互监管让步来追求更深层次的监管合作。此外，当监管偏好高度分散时，国际合作倾向于形成监管集团。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Life Out of the Shadows: the Impacts of Regularization Programs on the Lives of Forced Migrants
records.title_cn: 走出阴影：正规化项目对被迫移民生活的影响
records.abstract_en: We examine the well-being effects of a regularization program offered to half a million Venezuelan forced migrants in Colombia. We collected data on more than 2000 such migrants and compared the well-being of those who arrived in Colombia before and after the date that defined program eligibility. Since this date was announced ex-post and was unknown to the public, we could credibly evaluate the program’s impact. We find that program beneficiaries experienced large improvements in well-being, including consumption per capita (a gain of 48%), monthly labor income (an increase of 22%), and health status (an increment of 1.2 standard deviations). These positive outcomes largely stemmed from improved access to services, particularly the social protection system, subsidized healthcare system, and financial services. We also find that the fiscal costs incurred by the Colombian government for a regularized migrant household are lower than those for an irregular migrant household.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了哥伦比亚向五十万委内瑞拉被迫移民提供的正规化项目所带来的福祉效应。我们收集了超过2000名此类移民的数据，并比较了在决定项目资格日期之前和之后抵达哥伦比亚的移民的福祉。由于该日期是事后宣布且不为公众所知，我们能够可信地评估该项目的影响。我们发现，项目受益者在福祉方面经历了大幅改善，包括人均消费（增长48%）、月劳动收入（增加22%）以及健康状况（增加1.2个标准差）。这些积极结果主要源于服务获取的改善，特别是社会保障体系、补贴医疗体系和金融服务。我们还发现，哥伦比亚政府为正规化移民家庭承担的财政成本低于非正规移民家庭。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: False Narratives and Political Mobilization
records.title_cn: 虚假叙事与政治动员
records.abstract_en: We present an equilibrium model of politics in which political platforms compete over public opinion. A platform consists of a policy, a coalition of social groups with diverse intrinsic attitudes to policies, and a narrative. We conceptualize narratives as subjective models that attribute a commonly valued outcome to (potentially spurious) postulated causes. When quantified against empirical observations, these models generate a shared belief among coalition members over the outcome as a function of its postulated causes. The intensity of this belief and the members’ intrinsic attitudes to the platform’s policy determine the extent to which the coalition is mobilized. Only platforms that generate maximal mobilization prevail in equilibrium. Our equilibrium characterization demonstrates how false narratives can be detrimental to the commonly valued outcome, and how political fragmentation leads to their proliferation. The false narratives that emerge in equilibrium have a flavor of “scapegoating:” They attribute good outcomes to the exclusion of social groups from ruling coalitions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个政治均衡模型，其中政治平台在公众舆论上进行竞争。一个平台由政策、具有不同内在政策态度的社会群体联盟以及叙事组成。我们将叙事概念化为主观模型，这些模型将共同重视的结果归因于（可能虚假的）假定原因。当根据经验观察进行量化时，这些模型在联盟成员中产生关于结果作为其假定原因函数的共享信念。这种信念的强度以及成员对平台政策的内在态度决定了联盟被动员的程度。只有产生最大动员的平台才能在均衡中胜出。我们的均衡特征描述展示了虚假叙事如何对共同重视的结果有害，以及政治碎片化如何导致其扩散。均衡中出现的虚假叙事具有“替罪羊”的特征：它们将好的结果归因于将社会群体排除在执政联盟之外。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Bank Capital Regulation in a Zero Interest Environment
records.title_cn: 零利率环境下的银行资本监管
records.abstract_en: How does the zero lower bound on deposit rates (ZLB) affect how banks respond to capital regulation? I study this question in a model in which households value the liquidity services of deposits yet do not accept negative deposit rates. When deposit rates are constrained by the ZLB, tight capital requirements disproportionately hurt franchise values and are therefore less effective in curbing excessive risk taking. The model delivers a novel rationale for “interest-dependent” capital regulation that is optimally laxer when the ZLB binds and tighter when the ZLB is slack but may bind in the future.
records.abstract_cn: 存款利率的零下限（ZLB）如何影响银行对资本监管的反应？我在一个模型中研究这个问题，其中家庭重视存款的流动性服务，但不接受负存款利率。当存款利率受到零下限约束时，严格的资本要求会不成比例地损害特许经营权价值，因此在遏制过度风险承担方面效果较差。该模型为“利率依赖型”资本监管提供了一个新颖的理由，即在零下限约束时监管最优地更为宽松，而在零下限宽松但未来可能约束时监管更严格。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: The (Un)Importance of Inheritance
records.title_cn: 遗产的（非）重要性
records.abstract_en: Transfers from parents—either in the form of gifts or inheritances—have received much attention as a source of inequality. This paper uses administrative data for the population of Norway to examine the share of the Total Inflows (defined as the capitalized sum of net labor income, government transfers, and gifts and inheritances received over the period) accounted for by capitalized gifts and inheritances. Consistent with other work, we find that there is much inequality in the receipt of gifts and inheritances. However, gifts and inheritances represent a small share of Total Inflows; this is true across the distribution of Total Inflows, as well as at all levels of net wealth. Gifts and inheritances are only an important source of income flows among those who have very wealthy parents. Additionally, gifts and inheritances have very little effect on the distribution of Total Inflows, suggesting that inheritance taxes may do little to mitigate inequality.
records.abstract_cn: 来自父母的转移——无论是赠与形式还是遗产形式——作为不平等的一个来源受到了广泛关注。本文利用挪威人口的行政数据，考察了资本化赠与和遗产在总流入（定义为该期间净劳动收入、政府转移以及收到的赠与和遗产的资本化总和）中所占的份额。与其他研究一致，我们发现赠与和遗产的接收存在很大的不平等。然而，赠与和遗产在总流入中占比较小；这在总流入的分布中以及所有净财富水平上均成立。赠与和遗产仅在父母非常富有的群体中是重要的收入流来源。此外，赠与和遗产对总流入的分布影响甚微，这表明遗产税可能对缓解不平等作用不大。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Price Setting and Price Stickiness: A Behavioral Foundation of Inaction Bands
records.title_cn: 价格设定与价格粘性：不作为带的行为基础
records.abstract_en: This paper puts forward a behavioral theory of price setting where managers maximize perceived profits following a process of mental accounting. The theory predicts a pricing rule that is similar to—but crucially different from—that of a standard menu-cost theory: There is an inaction band, but there are two rather than just one target prices, depending on whether the firm updates its price upwards or downwards. The calibrated model replicates two patterns of price microdata that standard menu-cost models have difficulty accounting for: (i) the distribution of price changes has both small and large price changes and (ii) the hazard function of price changes is downward sloping initially, that is, firms that have just recently changed their price have a higher probability of changing it again, while this probability becomes constant thereafter.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种价格设定的行为理论，其中管理者通过心理账户过程最大化感知利润。该理论预测了一种定价规则，该规则与标准菜单成本理论的规则相似但关键不同：存在一个不作为带，但有两个而非一个目标价格，取决于企业是向上还是向下更新其价格。校准模型复现了标准菜单成本模型难以解释的价格微观数据的两种模式：（i）价格变化的分布既有小幅也有大幅的价格变化，（ii）价格变化的危险函数最初是向下倾斜的，即刚刚改变价格的企业再次改变价格的可能性更高，而此后这一概率变得恒定。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Application Barriers and the Socioeconomic Gap in Child Care Enrollment
records.title_cn: 申请障碍与儿童保育入学中的社会经济差距
records.abstract_en: Why are children with lower socioeconomic status (SES) substantially less likely to be enrolled in child care? We study whether barriers in the application process work against lower-SES children—the group known to benefit strongest from child care enrollment. In an RCT in Germany with highly subsidized child care ($N=607$), we offer treated families information and personal assistance for applications. We find substantial, equity-enhancing effects of the treatment, closing half of the large SES gap in child care enrollment. Increased enrollment for lower-SES families is likely driven by altered application knowledge and behavior. We discuss scalability of our intervention and derive policy implications for the design of universal child care programs. (JEL: I21, J13, J18, J24, C93)
records.abstract_cn: 为什么社会经济地位（SES）较低的儿童入读儿童保育的可能性显著更低？我们研究申请过程中的障碍是否对低SES儿童不利——这一群体已知从儿童保育入学中获益最大。在德国一项高度补贴儿童保育的随机对照试验（RCT）中（$N=607$），我们为处理组家庭提供信息和申请方面的个人协助。我们发现处理效应显著且增强了公平性，缩小了儿童保育入学中巨大的SES差距的一半。低SES家庭入学率的提高可能由申请知识和行为的改变所驱动。我们讨论了我们干预措施的可扩展性，并为普及儿童保育项目的设计提出了政策启示。（JEL: I21, J13, J18, J24, C93）

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Export-Led Decay: The Trade Channel in the Gold Standard Era
records.title_cn: 出口导向的衰退：金本位时代的贸易渠道
records.abstract_en: Flexible exchange rates can facilitate price adjustments that buffer macroeconomic shocks. We test this hypothesis using adjustments to the gold standard during the Great Depression. Using novel monthly data on city-level economic activity, sectoral employment, and export data, we show that American exporting cities were significantly affected by changes in bilateral exchange rates. We calibrate a general equilibrium model to obtain aggregate effects from cross-sectional estimates. We show that the trade channel deepened the Great Depression and was a key driver of the economic recovery in 1933.
records.abstract_cn: 灵活汇率可以促进价格调整，从而缓冲宏观经济冲击。我们利用大萧条期间回归金本位制的调整来检验这一假设。利用关于城市层面经济活动、部门就业和出口的新颖月度数据，我们表明美国出口城市受到双边汇率变化的显著影响。我们校准了一个一般均衡模型，以从横截面估计中获得总体效应。我们表明，贸易渠道加深了大萧条，并且是1933年经济复苏的关键驱动因素。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Monetary policy and credit flows: A tale of two effective lower bounds
records.title_cn: 货币政策与信贷流动：两个有效下限的故事
records.abstract_en: This paper evaluates the quantitative effects of monetary policy on credit flows. Using Compustat data and a factor-augmented vector autoregression where monetary policy shocks are identified via an external instrument, we show that monetary policy promotes long-term credit creation while delaying or preventing long-term credit destruction. In parallel, it reduces short-term credit creation and destruction, effectively reallocating credit toward longer maturities. Focusing on two effective lower bound periods, we show that monetary policy prompted a reshuffling of credit toward financially constrained firms, notably small, young, and high-default-probability firms. Our findings underscore the effectiveness of monetary policy in steering credit toward financially constrained firms and stimulating future economic activity near the effective lower bound.
records.abstract_cn: 本文评估了货币政策对信贷流动的量化效应。利用Compustat数据和因子增强向量自回归模型，其中货币政策冲击通过外部工具识别，我们表明货币政策促进了长期信贷创造，同时延迟或阻止了长期信贷的破坏。与此同时，它减少了短期信贷的创造和破坏，有效地将信贷重新配置到更长期限。聚焦于两个有效下限时期，我们表明货币政策促使信贷向财务受限企业重新洗牌，尤其是小型、年轻和高违约概率的企业。我们的发现强调了货币政策在引导信贷流向财务受限企业以及刺激有效下限附近未来经济活动方面的有效性。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Sentiment-driven speculation in financial markets with heterogeneous beliefs: A machine learning approach
records.title_cn: 异质信念下金融市场中的情绪驱动投机：一种机器学习方法
records.abstract_en: We study an heterogenous asset pricing model in which different classes of investors coexist and evolve, switching among strategies over time according to a fitness measure. In the presence of boundedly rational agents, with biased forecasts and trend following rules, we study the effect of two types of speculation: one based on fundamentalist and the other on rational expectations. While the first is only based on knowledge of the asset underlying dynamics, the second takes also into account the behavior of other investors. We bring the model to data by estimating it on the Bitcoin Market with two contributions, relying on methods from Machine Learning. First, we construct the Bitcoin Twitter Sentiment Index (BiTSI) to proxy a time varying bias. Second, we propose a new method based on a Neural Network, for the estimation of the resulting heterogeneous agent model with rational speculators. We show that the switching finds support in the data and that while fundamentalist speculation amplifies volatility, rational speculation has a stabilizing effect on the market.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个异质资产定价模型，其中不同类别的投资者共存并演化，根据适应度度量随时间在策略之间切换。在存在有限理性代理人、有偏预测和趋势跟踪规则的情况下，我们研究了两种投机类型的影响：一种基于基本面分析，另一种基于理性预期。前者仅基于对资产潜在动态的知识，后者还考虑其他投资者的行为。我们通过将其应用于比特币市场的数据进行估计，并借助机器学习方法做出两项贡献。首先，我们构建了比特币推特情绪指数（BiTSI）作为时变偏差的代理变量。其次，我们提出了一种基于神经网络的新方法，用于估计包含理性投机者的异质代理人模型。我们表明，策略切换在数据中得到了支持，并且虽然基本面投机放大了波动性，但理性投机对市场具有稳定作用。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Fiscal policy under secular stagnation: An optimal pump-priming strategy
records.title_cn: 长期停滞下的财政政策：最优泵启动策略
records.abstract_en: How can a depressed economy escape a permanent liquidity trap, such as to restore full employment? This can be achieved through a temporary, but massive, fiscal stimulus to overheat the economy such as to raise the inflation anchor. Despite the substantial cost of overheating the economy, this pump-priming policy is typically optimal. The lack of fiscal space cannot prevent the government from pump priming the economy through fiscal policy.
records.abstract_cn: 一个萧条的经济如何能摆脱永久性流动性陷阱，例如恢复充分就业？这可以通过临时但大规模的财政刺激来实现，以使经济过热，从而提高通胀锚。尽管过热经济成本巨大，但这种泵启动政策通常是最优的。财政空间的缺乏不能阻止政府通过财政政策来泵启动经济。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Coinvestment games under uncertainty
records.title_cn: 不确定性下的联合投资博弈
records.abstract_en: There are many business situations in which investments by a supplier and a producer (“coinvestments”) are both necessary for either of them to grasp a business opportunity. For instance, better quality tanks are needed to manufacture reliable hydrogen-powered vehicles. One of these two firms may be more willing to invest, but the cautionary attitude of the other delays the coinvestment. We model supply-chain interactions in a classical tractable way to derive the firms' net present values (NPVs) upon coinvestment and determine their Nash equilibrium investment (timing) strategies. Firms coinvest when the real option of the weaker firm is ‘deep in the money.’ These business situations are likely to be affected by evolving market circumstances, in particular due to changes in the demand dynamics or endogenous decision (by, say, the supplier) to conduct research and development (R&D). We investigate related model extensions, which confirm the robustness of our key result.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多商业情境中，供应商和生产者（“联合投资”）的投资对于任何一方抓住商业机会都是必要的。例如，需要更高质量的储罐来制造可靠的氢动力汽车。这两家公司中的一家可能更愿意投资，但另一方的谨慎态度会延迟联合投资。我们以经典的可处理方式建模供应链互动，以推导出联合投资时公司的净现值（NPV），并确定其纳什均衡投资（时机）策略。当较弱公司的实物期权“深度实值”时，公司会进行联合投资。这些商业情境可能受到不断变化的市场环境的影响，特别是由于需求动态的变化或（例如，由供应商）进行研发（R&D）的内生决策。我们研究了相关的模型扩展，这些扩展证实了我们关键结果的稳健性。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Monetary policy, labor force participation, and wage rigidity
records.title_cn: 货币政策、劳动力参与率与工资刚性
records.abstract_en: To understand the role of monetary policy in determining the labor force participation rate, we present empirical evidence for Japan and the US. The data suggests that labor force participation declines in Japan but temporarily increases in the US in response to a monetary tightening. To inspect the mechanism, we develop and estimate a New Keynesian model of endogenous labor force participation decisions incorporating wage rigidity. We find that the opposite response of labor force participation can be attributed to a difference in the degree of wage rigidity. Counterfactual analysis based on the estimated models shows that the large-scale monetary easing in recent years helped boost the labor force participation rate in Japan, while its effect was almost neutral in the US.
records.abstract_cn: 为了理解货币政策在决定劳动力参与率中的作用，我们提供了日本和美国的相关实证证据。数据表明，面对货币紧缩，日本的劳动力参与率下降，而美国则暂时上升。为了探究其机制，我们开发并估计了一个包含内生劳动力参与决策和工资刚性的新凯恩斯主义模型。我们发现，劳动力参与率的相反反应可归因于工资刚性程度的差异。基于估计模型的反事实分析显示，近年来的大规模货币宽松政策有助于提高日本的劳动力参与率，而在美国其效果几乎中性。

records.title_en: Assessing political bias and value misalignment in generative artificial intelligence
records.title_cn: 评估生成式人工智能中的政治偏见与价值错位
records.abstract_en: Our analysis reveals a concerning misalignment of values between ChatGPT and the average American. We also show that ChatGPT displays political leanings when generating text and images, but the degree and direction of skew depend on the theme. Notably, ChatGPT repeatedly refused to generate content representing certain mainstream perspectives, citing concerns over misinformation and bias. As generative AI systems like ChatGPT become ubiquitous, such misalignment with societal norms poses risks of distorting public discourse. Without proper safeguards, these systems threaten to exacerbate societal divides and depart from principles that underpin free societies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们的分析揭示了ChatGPT与普通美国人之间令人担忧的价值错位。我们还表明，ChatGPT在生成文本和图像时表现出政治倾向，但偏斜的程度和方向取决于主题。值得注意的是，ChatGPT多次拒绝生成代表某些主流观点的内容，理由是担心错误信息和偏见。随着像ChatGPT这样的生成式AI系统变得无处不在，这种与社会规范的错位构成了扭曲公共话语的风险。如果没有适当的保障措施，这些系统可能会加剧社会分裂，并偏离支撑自由社会的原则。
