The loss in wage income is the result of substantial occupational downgrading, lower hourly wages, and a reduction in working hours. Family migrants who immigrate into a recession draw on migrant and family networks to mitigate the negative labor market effects. As a result, they take up occupations with higher concentrations of fellow countrypeople. They are also more likely to reside with family members, potentially reducing their geographical mobility.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了到达时的经济状况如何影响美国家庭担保移民的经济融入。我们的识别策略利用了家庭担保移民签证的漫长等待时间，这使得移民决策与到达时的经济状况脱钩。到达时失业率每上升一个百分点，短期年工资收入下降百分之四，长期下降百分之二。工资收入的损失是显著的职业降级、较低的小时工资和工作时间减少的结果。在经济衰退期移民的家庭移民利用移民和家庭网络来减轻负面的劳动力市场效应。因此，他们从事的行业中同胞集中度更高。他们也更可能与家庭成员同住，这可能降低了他们的地理流动性。

records.title_en: The Search for Good Jobs: Evidence from a Six-Year Field Experiment in Uganda
records.title_cn: 寻找好工作：来自乌干达一项为期六年的田野实验的证据
records.abstract_en: There are 420 million young people in Africa today, and only one in three has a regular salaried job. We study how two common labor market interventions—vocational training and matching—affect the job search behavior of young workers. We do so by means of a field experiment tracking young job seekers for 6 years in Uganda’s main cities. Vocational training amplifies the job seekers’ initial optimism, leading them to search more intensively and toward high-quality firms. Adding matching has the opposite effect, plausibly because of low callback rates. These differences affect labor market outcomes in the long run.
records.abstract_cn: 当今非洲有420亿年轻人，其中只有三分之一拥有正规的带薪工作。我们研究两种常见的劳动力市场干预措施——职业培训和匹配——如何影响年轻工人的求职行为。我们通过在乌干达主要城市对年轻求职者进行为期6年的田野实验来实现这一目标。职业培训增强了求职者最初的乐观情绪，促使他们更密集地搜索，并倾向于高质量的企业。增加匹配则产生相反的效果，可能是因为回电率较低。这些差异在长期内影响劳动力市场结果。

records.title_en: Occupational Licensing and Labor Market Fluidity
records.title_cn: 职业许可与劳动力市场流动性
records.abstract_en: We show that occupational licensing has significant negative effects on labor market fluidity, defined as cross-occupation mobility, and positive effects on wage growth. We find that occupational licensing represents a barrier to entry for both nonemployed workers and employed ones. The effect is more prominent for employed workers than those entering from nonemployment. We also find that average wage growth is higher for licensed workers than nonlicensed workers. We find significant heterogeneity in the licensing effect across different occupation groups. These results hold across various data sources, time spans, and indicators of being licensed.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，职业许可对劳动力市场流动性（定义为跨职业流动性）具有显著的负向影响，对工资增长具有正向影响。我们发现，职业许可对非就业工人和就业工人而言都构成进入障碍。这种影响对就业工人而言比从非就业状态进入的工人更为显著。我们还发现，持证工人的平均工资增长高于非持证工人。我们发现，在不同职业群体之间，许可效应存在显著的异质性。这些结果在不同的数据来源、时间跨度和持证指标下均成立。

records.title_en: Drivers of the global financial cycle
records.title_cn: 全球金融周期的驱动因素
records.abstract_en: Building on literature focused on the role of U.S. monetary policy in driving the global financial cycle, we quantify the relative importance of different shocks in an estimation framework that simultaneously identifies multiple shocks without timing or sign restrictions. Our analysis reveals significant roles for (i) U.S. corporate bond spreads, particularly the excess bond premium component, (ii) U.S. bank leverage, and (iii) the U.S. term premium. We additionally document a feedback loop that leads to significant amplification effects: widening U.S. corporate bond spreads trigger broad declines in global asset prices, which in turn lead to further tightening of U.S. spreads.
records.abstract_cn: 基于聚焦于美国货币政策在驱动全球金融周期中作用的文献，我们在一个同时识别多种冲击而不施加时间或符号限制的估计框架中，量化了不同冲击的相对重要性。我们的分析揭示了以下因素的显著作用：(i) 美国公司债券利差，尤其是超额债券溢价部分，(ii) 美国银行杠杆，以及 (iii) 美国期限溢价。我们还记录了一个导致显著放大效应的反馈循环：美国公司债券利差的扩大引发全球资产价格的广泛下跌，这反过来又导致美国利差的进一步收紧。

records.title_en: Reshoring, automation, and labor markets under trade uncertainty
records.title_cn: 贸易不确定性下的回流、自动化与劳动力市场
records.abstract_en: We study the implications of trade uncertainty for reshoring, automation, and U.S. labor markets. Rising trade uncertainty creates incentives for firms to reduce exposure to foreign suppliers by moving production and distribution processes to domestic producers. However, we argue that reshoring does not necessarily bring jobs back to the home country or boost domestic wages, especially when firms have access to labor-substituting technologies such as automation. Automation improves labor productivity and facilitates reshoring, but it can also displace jobs. Furthermore, automation poses a threat that weakens the bargaining power of unskilled workers in wage negotiations, depressing their wages and raising the skill premium and wage inequality. Our model predictions are in line with industry-level empirical evidence.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了贸易不确定性对回流、自动化和美国劳动力市场的影响。贸易不确定性的上升激励企业通过将生产和分销流程转移至国内生产商来减少对外国供应商的暴露。然而，我们认为回流并不必然将工作岗位带回母国或提升国内工资，尤其是当企业能够使用如自动化等劳动替代技术时。自动化提高了劳动生产率并促进了回流，但也可能取代工作岗位。此外，自动化构成一种威胁，削弱了非技术工人在工资谈判中的议价能力，压低其工资并提高了技能溢价和工资不平等。我们的模型预测与行业层面的经验证据相符。

records.title_en: Monetary unions with heterogeneous fiscal space
records.title_cn: 财政空间异质性的货币联盟
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a multi-country Heterogeneous-Agent New Keynesian (HANK) model of a monetary union with ex-ante heterogeneity in legacy public debt across member states. We calibrate the model to the euro area and show that, following symmetric aggregate shocks, the systematic monetary policy reaction induces heterogeneous national outcomes, driven by differences in fiscal space. This generates a trade-off between union-wide macroeconomic stabilization and cross-country synchronization of economic activity for the central bank. We characterize a possibility frontier between union-wide inflation stability and cross-country synchronization, which is traced out by varying the degree of the central bank’s hawkishness towards inflation. We study the role of deficit caps, fiscal and political unions, and augmented Taylor rules as instruments to navigate the stabilization–synchronization trade-off.
records.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个多国异质性主体新凯恩斯（HANK）模型，用于分析一个成员国之间历史公共债务存在事前异质性的货币联盟。我们将模型校准至欧元区，并表明，在对称的总量冲击下，系统性的货币政策反应会引发各国不同的国内结果，这由财政空间的差异所驱动。这为中央银行带来了联盟范围内宏观经济稳定与跨国经济活动同步性之间的权衡。我们刻画了联盟范围内通胀稳定性与跨国同步性之间的可能性边界，该边界通过改变中央银行对通胀的鹰派程度来描绘。我们研究了赤字上限、财政联盟和政治联盟，以及增强型泰勒规则作为应对稳定-同步权衡的工具的作用。

records.title_en: Reprint of: Inequality and optimal monetary policy in the open economy
records.title_cn: 重印：开放经济中的不平等与最优货币政策
records.abstract_en: We study optimal monetary policy in a tractable Small Open Economy Heterogeneous-Agent New Keynesian (SOE-HANK) model in which households face uninsured idiosyncratic risk and unequal bond-market access. We derive conditions under which optimal policy in our SOE-HANK economy entails domestic producer price stability, extending the ”open-economy divine coincidence” result of Galí and Monacelli (2005) beyond the Representative-Agent benchmark (SOE-RANK). Away from those conditions, inefficient fluctuations in consumption inequality generate monetary policy tradeoffs. Under plausible calibrations for the trade elasticities, the elasticity of intertemporal substitution, and the cyclicality of income risk, the central bank stabilizes output and the exchange rate more than in SOE-RANK.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个易于处理的小型开放经济异质性代理人新凯恩斯（SOE-HANK）模型中研究最优货币政策，其中家庭面临未保险的异质性风险和不同的债券市场准入。我们推导了在SOE-HANK经济中，最优政策需要国内生产者价格稳定的条件，将Galí和Monacelli（2005）的“开放经济神圣巧合”结果扩展到代表性代理人基准（SOE-RANK）之外。偏离这些条件时，消费不平等的低效波动会产生货币政策权衡。在贸易弹性、跨期替代弹性和收入风险周期性的合理校准下，中央银行比SOE-RANK更稳定产出和汇率。

records.title_en: Reprint of: Regional trade policy uncertainty
records.title_cn: 重印：区域贸易政策不确定性
records.abstract_en: Higher trade policy uncertainty has recessionary effects on U.S. states. To demonstrate this, we first build a novel empirical measure of regional trade policy uncertainty based on the volatility of national import tariffs at the sectoral level and on the sectoral composition of imports in U.S. states. We find that a state that is more exposed to an unanticipated increase in tariff volatility suffers from a larger drop in real GDP and employment than the average U.S. state. We then build a two-region open-economy model and find that the precautionary saving behavior is the main driver of the recession, although this effect is reinforced by high exposure to import tariffs. The feedback effect resulting from trade connections with the Foreign country primarily influences the persistence of these dynamics.
records.abstract_cn: 更高的贸易政策不确定性对美国各州具有衰退效应。为证明这一点，我们首先基于国家进口关税在部门层面的波动性以及美国各州进口的部门构成，构建了一个新颖的区域贸易政策不确定性的实证度量。我们发现，一个对关税波动意外增加暴露程度更高的州，其实际GDP和就业的下降幅度大于美国平均州。随后，我们构建了一个两区域开放经济模型，并发现预防性储蓄行为是衰退的主要驱动因素，尽管这一效应因对进口关税的高暴露而得到加强。与外国贸易联系产生的反馈效应主要影响这些动态的持续性。

records.title_en: Reprint of: Demographics and real interest rates across countries and over time
records.title_cn: 重印：各国及跨时期的 demographics 与实际利率
records.abstract_en: We explore implications of demographic trends for real interest rates across countries and over time in a tractable multicountry model with imperfect capital mobility. We calibrate it to examine how the interaction of international financial integration and both domestic and foreign demographics shapes low-frequency movements in a country’s real rate. In more financially integrated countries, real rates are more sensitive to global developments than to domestic factors. We estimate panel error-correction models relating real rates to various drivers, imposing some structure informed by the model. Empirical results confirm global factors and domestic demographics are robust determinants of real rates. Alternative specifications highlight the importance of accounting for time-varying financial integration and a broad set of real rate drivers. Both model and empirical results suggest demographic trends explain a meaningful share of the global decline in real rates. Given projections, demographics should continue to exert downward pressure on real rates.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个具有不完全资本流动性的可处理多国模型中，探讨人口结构趋势对各国及跨时期实际利率的影响。我们校准该模型，以考察国际金融一体化与国内外人口结构的相互作用如何塑造一国实际利率的低频变动。在金融一体化程度更高的国家，实际利率对全球发展的敏感度高于对国内因素的敏感度。我们估计了将实际利率与各种驱动因素联系起来的面板误差修正模型，并施加了由模型提供的一些结构约束。实证结果证实，全球因素和国内人口结构是实际利率的稳健决定因素。替代规格强调了考虑时变金融一体化和广泛实际利率驱动因素的重要性。模型和实证结果均表明，人口结构趋势解释了全球实际利率下降的相当大一部分。根据预测，人口结构应继续对实际利率施加下行压力。

records.title_en: Do investor differences impact monetary policy spillovers to emerging markets?
records.title_cn: 投资者差异是否影响货币政策对新兴市场的溢出效应？
records.abstract_en: We re-examine monetary policy spillovers to Emerging Market Economies (EME) in the form of capital flow reversals, using sectoral-level securities holdings data for Euro Area investors. In response to a surprise monetary tightening, active investors such as investment funds re-balance their portfolios away from EME, while more passive, long term investors such as insurance funds and banks exhibit no significant reaction on average. For active investors, the reallocation out of EME appears stronger under synchronized monetary tightening between the Fed and the ECB. However, these investors may even inject more capital to EME securities when the monetary tightening surprises contain positive news about the Euro Area economy. Issuers’ monetary–fiscal stability may explain the heterogeneous impact of these spillovers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用欧元区投资者的部门级证券持有数据，重新审视了货币政策对新兴市场经济体（EME）的资本流动逆转形式的溢出效应。面对意外的货币紧缩，活跃投资者如投资基金将其投资组合从EME重新平衡出去，而更为被动、长期投资者如保险基金和银行平均而言没有显著反应。对于活跃投资者而言，在美联储和欧洲央行同步货币紧缩的情况下，从EME的再配置似乎更为强烈。然而，当货币紧缩的意外包含有关欧元区经济的正面消息时，这些投资者甚至可能向EME证券注入更多资本。发行者的货币-财政稳定性可能解释这些溢出效应的异质性影响。

records.title_en: Reprint of: Global banking and macroeconomic stability. Liquidity, control, and monitoring
records.title_cn: 重印：全球银行业与宏观经济稳定。流动性、控制与监督
records.abstract_en: We study how the organizational structure of global banks shapes their impact on macroeconomic stability. We develop a two-country dynamic general equilibrium model in which global banks can either delegate loan monitoring to local affiliates or exert control over affiliates’ monitoring activities, hiring loan officers centrally. Moreover, we allow global banks to transfer liquidity between parents and local affiliates through internal capital markets. We show that global banks with a centralized business model (with loan officers hired centrally by the parent and an intense use of internal capital markets) help mitigate the impact of financial shocks on the host economy. However, they may become a destabilizing factor following real shocks that hit the quality of firms’ investments. The model predictions are consistent with bank-level evidence from a large set of countries that host global bank affiliates.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究全球银行的组织结构如何影响其对宏观经济稳定的作用。我们构建了一个两国动态一般均衡模型，在该模型中，全球银行可以将贷款监督委托给当地分支机构，或者通过集中雇佣信贷员来控制分支机构的监督活动。此外，我们允许全球银行通过内部资本市场在母行与当地分支机构之间转移流动性。我们表明，采用集中化商业模式（由母行集中雇佣信贷员并密集使用内部资本市场）的全球银行有助于缓解金融冲击对东道国经济的影响。然而，在影响企业投资质量的实际冲击之后，它们可能成为不稳定因素。模型预测与大量设有全球银行分支机构的国家的银行层面证据一致。

records.title_en: Customer data access and fintech entry: Early evidence from open banking
records.title_cn: 客户数据访问与金融科技进入：开放银行的早期证据
records.abstract_en: Open banking (OB) empowers bank customers to share their financial transaction data with fintechs and other banks. New cross-country data shows 49 countries adopted OB policies, privacy preferences predict policy adoption, and adoption spurs fintech entry. UK microdata shows that OB enables: (i) consumers to access both financial advice and credit; (ii) SMEs to establish new lending relationships. In a calibrated model, OB universally improves welfare through entry and product improvements when used for advice. When used for credit, OB promotes entry and competition by reducing adverse selection, but higher prices for costlier or privacy-conscious consumers partially offset these benefits.
records.abstract_cn: 开放银行（OB）使银行客户能够与金融科技公司及其他银行共享其金融交易数据。新的跨国数据显示，49个国家采用了开放银行政策，隐私偏好预测了政策的采用，且采用促进了金融科技的进入。英国微观数据显示，开放银行使得：（i）消费者能够获得金融咨询和信贷；（ii）中小企业能够建立新的借贷关系。在一个校准模型中，当开放银行用于咨询时，通过进入和产品改进普遍提高了福利。当用于信贷时，开放银行通过减少逆向选择促进了进入和竞争，但对成本较高或注重隐私的消费者收取更高的价格部分抵消了这些好处。

records.title_en: Innovation and capital
records.title_cn: 创新与资本
records.abstract_en: Using a regime change in the commercialization of university innovation in 1980 that strongly increased university incentives to patent and license discoveries, we document that an increase in the supply of commercializable innovation attracts venture capital investment to the region. The Bayh-Dole Act shifted ownership of intellectual property stemming from federally-funded research from the federal government to universities, spurring technology transfer into the local area. Because universities have different technological strengths, each local area surrounding a university experienced an increase after 1980 in commercializable innovation relevant to particular sets of industries which differed widely across university counties. Comparing industries within a county that were more versus less related to the local university's innovative strengths, we show that venture capital dollars after 1980 flowed systematically towards geographic areas and industries affected most by the sudden influx of commercializable innovation from universities. These results persist even when controlling for ex ante geographic and industry distributions of corporate patenting and prior venture financing. The findings support the notion that increased supply of commercializable innovation serves to draw private capital investment to a region.
records.abstract_cn: 利用1980年大学创新商业化制度变革，该变革显著增强了大学申请专利和许可发现的激励，我们记录了商业化创新供给的增加吸引了风险资本投资到该地区。《拜杜法案》将联邦资助研究产生的知识产权所有权从联邦政府转移给大学，促进了技术向当地转移。由于大学具有不同的技术优势，每所大学周边地区在1980年后都经历了与特定行业相关的商业化创新的增加，这些行业在不同大学县之间差异很大。通过比较县内与当地大学创新优势相关程度较高和较低的行业，我们表明1980年后的风险资本资金系统地流向受大学商业化创新突然涌入影响最大的地理区域和行业。即使在控制企业专利的事前地理和行业分布以及先前风险融资的情况下，这些结果仍然存在。研究结果支持了商业化创新供给增加有助于吸引私人资本投资到该地区的观点。

records.title_en: Payments and privacy in the digital economy
records.title_cn: 数字经济中的支付与隐私
records.abstract_en: We propose a model of lending, payments choice, and privacy in the digital economy. While digital payments enable merchants to sell goods online, they reveal information to their lender. Cash guarantees anonymity, but limits distribution to less efficient offline venues. In equilibrium, merchants trade off the efficiency gains from online distribution (with digital payments) and the informational rents from staying anonymous (with cash). While new technologies can reduce the privacy concerns associated with digital payments, they also redistribute surplus from the lender to merchants. Hence, privacy enhancements do not always improve welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个关于数字经济中借贷、支付选择和隐私的模型。虽然数字支付使商家能够在线销售商品，但它们向商家的贷款人透露了信息。现金保证匿名性，但限制了向效率较低的线下场所的分销。在均衡状态下，商家在在线分销（通过数字支付）的效率收益与保持匿名（通过现金）的信息租金之间进行权衡。虽然新技术可以减少与数字支付相关的隐私担忧，但它们也将剩余从贷款人重新分配给商家。因此，隐私增强并不总是改善福利。

records.title_en: Data sales and data dilution
records.title_cn: 数据销售与数据稀释
records.abstract_en: We explore indicators of market power in a data market. Markups cannot measure competition, because most data products’ marginal cost is zero, making the markup infinite. Yet, data monopolists may not exert monopoly power because they cannot commit to restricting data sales to future customers. This limited commitment and strategic substitutability of data undermine sellers’ monopoly power. But data subscriptions restore this monopoly power. Evidence from online data markets supports the model’s insight that subscriptions indicate market power. Model and evidence reveal that data subscriptions are better for consumers because they sustain the incentive to invest in high-quality data.
records.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了数据市场中市场势力的指标。加成率无法衡量竞争，因为大多数数据产品的边际成本为零，使得加成率无限大。然而，数据垄断者可能不会行使垄断势力，因为他们无法承诺限制向未来客户销售数据。这种有限承诺和数据的战略替代性削弱了卖方的垄断势力。但数据订阅恢复了这种垄断势力。来自在线数据市场的证据支持模型的见解，即订阅表明市场势力。模型和证据表明，数据订阅对消费者更有利，因为它们维持了投资于高质量数据的激励。

records.title_en: Collateral value uncertainty and mortgage credit provision
records.title_cn: 抵押品价值不确定性与抵押贷款供给
records.abstract_en: Houses with higher value uncertainty receive less mortgage credit: mortgages backed by these houses are more likely to be rejected, have higher interest rates, and have lower loan-to-price ratios. The relationship between house value uncertainty and credit availability is driven partly by a classic channel in which uncertainty lowers debt recovery rates, and partly by a novel channel where more uncertain appraisals make regulatory constraints on loan size more likely to bind. We build a structural model to quantify the effects of each channel, and show how a shift toward computerized asset appraisals could influence credit access.
records.abstract_cn: 价值不确定性较高的房屋获得的抵押贷款较少：以这些房屋为抵押的贷款更可能被拒绝，利率更高，贷款与价格比率更低。房屋价值不确定性与信贷可得性之间的关系部分由经典渠道驱动，即不确定性降低了债务回收率，部分由新渠道驱动，即更不确定的评估使得贷款规模的监管约束更可能生效。我们构建了一个结构模型来量化每种渠道的影响，并展示了向计算机化资产评估转变如何影响信贷获取。

records.title_en: Screening using a menu of contracts: A structural model for lending markets
records.title_cn: 利用合同菜单进行筛选：贷款市场的结构模型
records.abstract_en: When lenders screen borrowers using a menu, they generate a contractual externality by rendering the composition of their competitors’ borrowers worse. Using data from the UK mortgage market and a structural model of screening with endogenous menus, this paper quantifies the impact of asymmetric information on equilibrium contracts and welfare. Counterfactual simulations show that, because of the externality, there is too much screening along the loan-to-value dimension. The deadweight loss, expressed in borrower utility, is equivalent to an interest rate increase of 30 basis points (a 15% increase) on all loans.
records.abstract_cn: 当贷款人使用菜单筛选借款人时，他们通过使竞争对手的借款人构成变得更差，产生了一种合同外部性。利用英国抵押贷款市场的数据和具有内生菜单的筛选结构模型，本文量化了信息不对称对均衡合同和福利的影响。反事实模拟显示，由于这种外部性，在贷款价值比维度上存在过度筛选。以借款人效用表示的无谓损失，相当于所有贷款利率上升30个基点（增加15%）。

records.title_en: The return of return dominance: Decomposing the cross-section of prices
records.title_cn: 回报主导地位的回归：分解价格横截面
records.abstract_en: What explains cross-sectional dispersion in stock valuation ratios? We find that 75% of dispersion in price–earnings ratios is reflected in differences in future returns, while only 25% is reflected in differences in future earnings growth. This holds at both the portfolio-level and the firm-level. We reconcile these conclusions with previous literature which has found a strong relation between prices and future profitability. Our results support models in which the cross-section of price–earnings ratios is driven mainly by discount rates or mispricing rather than future earnings growth. Evaluating six models of the value premium, we find that most models struggle to match our results; however, models with long-lived differences in risk exposure or gradual learning about parameters perform the best. The lack of earnings growth differences at long horizons provides new evidence in favor of long-run return predictability. We also show a similar dominance of predicted returns for explaining the dispersion in return surprises.
records.abstract_cn: 什么解释了股票估值比率中的横截面离散度？我们发现，市盈率离散度的75%反映在未来回报的差异中，而仅有25%反映在未来盈利增长的差异中。这一结论在投资组合层面和公司层面均成立。我们将这些结论与先前文献中发现的股价与未来盈利能力之间的强关系进行了调和。我们的结果支持那些认为市盈率横截面主要由贴现率或错误定价而非未来盈利增长驱动的模型。在评估六个价值溢价模型时，我们发现大多数模型难以匹配我们的结果；然而，具有长期风险暴露差异或参数渐进学习的模型表现最佳。长期视野中盈利增长差异的缺乏为长期回报可预测性提供了新证据。我们还展示了预测回报在解释回报意外离散度方面的类似主导地位。

records.title_en: Rules versus discretion in capital regulation
records.title_cn: 资本监管中的规则与自由裁量权
records.abstract_en: We study capital regulation in a dynamic model for bank deposits. Capital regulation addresses banks’ incentive for excessive leverage that dilutes depositors, but preserves some dilution to reduce bank defaults. We show theoretically that capital regulation is subject to a time inconsistency problem. In a model with non-maturing deposits where optimal withdrawals make deposits endogenously long-term, we find commitment to have important effects on the optimal level and cyclicality of capital adequacy. Our results call for a systematic framework that limits capital regulators’ discretion.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了银行存款动态模型中的资本监管。资本监管旨在解决银行过度杠杆化稀释存款人利益的激励问题，但同时保留一定程度的稀释以减少银行违约。我们从理论上证明，资本监管面临时间不一致性问题。在存款非到期且最优取款使存款内生地长期化的模型中，我们发现承诺对资本充足率的最优水平和周期性具有重要影响。我们的研究结果呼吁建立一个限制资本监管者自由裁量权的系统性框架。

records.title_en: Trust as an entry barrier: Evidence from FinTech adoption
records.title_cn: 信任作为进入壁垒：来自金融科技采纳的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the role of trust in incumbent lenders (banks) as an entry barrier to emerging FinTech lenders in credit markets. The empirical setting exploits the outbreak of the Wells Fargo scandal as a negative shock to borrowers’ trust in banks. Using a difference-in-differences framework, I find that increased exposure to the Wells Fargo scandal leads to an increase in the probability of borrowers using FinTech as mortgage originators. Utilizing political affiliation to proxy for the magnitude of trust erosion in banks in a triple-differences specification, I find that, conditional on the same exposure to the scandal, a county experiencing a greater erosion of trust has a larger increase in FinTech share relative to a county experiencing less of an erosion of trust. Estimating treatment effect heterogeneity using generic machine learning inference suggests that borrowers with the greatest decrease in trust in banks and the greatest increase in FinTech adoption have similar characteristics.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了借款人对现有银行（银行）的信任作为新兴金融科技贷款机构进入信贷市场的进入壁垒的作用。实证设置利用了富国银行丑闻爆发作为借款人对银行信任的负面冲击。使用双重差分框架，我发现对富国银行丑闻的暴露增加导致借款人使用金融科技作为抵押贷款发起人的概率增加。利用政治派别作为银行信任侵蚀程度的代理变量，在三重差分规范中，我发现，在相同的丑闻暴露条件下，信任侵蚀程度更大的县相对于信任侵蚀程度较小的县，金融科技份额增加更多。使用通用机器学习推断估计处理效应异质性表明，对银行信任下降最大和金融科技采纳增加最大的借款人具有相似的特征。

records.title_en: The value of privacy and the choice of limited partners by venture capitalists
records.title_cn: 隐私的价值与风险投资家对有限合伙人的选择
records.abstract_en: We study how information disclosure concerns shape the choice of limited partners (LPs) by venture capitalists (VCs). Late-2002 court rulings prevented public LPs from providing confidentiality to investment managers. The best-performing VCs, but not other managers, responded by excluding public LPs from their new funds. Lost access reduced public LP returns by $1.6 billion relative to $14 billion of their VC commitments. Legislation reducing disclosure, contracts limiting information access, and added fund-of-funds intermediaries helped restore access. These changes focused on protecting portfolio company information, highlighting the importance of proprietary information for VC investing and the potential costs of transparency.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究信息披露关切如何影响风险投资家（VCs）对有限合伙人（LPs）的选择。2002年末的法院裁决禁止公共有限合伙人向投资经理提供保密性。表现最佳的风险投资家，而非其他经理，通过将公共有限合伙人排除在新基金之外来回应。失去准入使公共有限合伙人的回报相对于其风险投资承诺的1.6亿美元减少了14亿美元。减少披露的立法、限制信息获取的合同以及增加的基金中的基金中介帮助恢复了准入。这些变化侧重于保护投资组合公司的信息，突显了专有信息对风险投资的重要性以及透明度的潜在成本。

records.title_en: Global volatility and firm-level capital flows
records.title_cn: 全球波动性与企业层面的资本流动
records.abstract_en: We study the impact of global volatility on the equity portfolio flows of institutional investors worldwide. Aggregate equity allocations of institutional investors decrease during periods of high volatility, both in developed and, even more strongly, in emerging markets. Our granular portfolio-level data allows us to uncover disaggregated investor responses that are an order of magnitude larger than aggregate estimates, and are dominated by discretionary (investor-driven) component of flows. We further show that periods of high volatility are associated with portfolio rebalancing by institutional investors from small-cap to large-cap stocks. Finally, institutional flows have significant impact on future firm stability, measured by their volatility and liquidity. Our findings are consistent with the economic mechanism in which investors with heterogeneous information capacity are learning about assets with different information rents.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了全球波动性对全球机构投资者股票组合流动的影响。在高波动时期，机构投资者的总体股票配置减少，这在发达市场以及新兴市场中更为显著。我们细粒度的组合层面数据揭示了比总体估计大一个数量级的分类投资者反应，并且这些反应主要由自由裁量（投资者驱动）的流动成分主导。我们进一步表明，高波动时期与机构投资者从小盘股向大盘股的投资组合再平衡相关。最后，机构流动对未来企业稳定性有显著影响，这种稳定性通过其波动性和流动性来衡量。我们的发现与具有异质信息能力的投资者正在学习具有不同信息租金的资产的经济机制相一致。

records.title_en: LTCM Redux? Hedge fund Treasury trading, funding fragility, and risk constraints
records.title_cn: LTCM重现？对冲基金国债交易、融资脆弱性与风险约束
records.abstract_en: We exploit the 2020 Treasury market shock to analyze how external and internal constraints impact arbitrageurs. Using regulatory filings, we find that hedge funds reduced arbitrage activities and increased cash holdings, despite stable credit and low contemporaneous redemptions. Creditors’ regulatory and liquidity constraints were not propagated to hedge funds through repo—Treasury arbitrageurs’ predominant financing source. Fund-creditor borrowing data reveal more regulated dealers provided, and more important clients received, disproportionately higher funding. Value-at-risk reported by funds suggests internal risk constraints were binding. Our results support theoretical predictions that arbitrageur risk constraints and precautionary liquidity management can amplify market instability even when contemporaneous financing remains resilient.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用2020年国债市场冲击来分析外部和内部约束如何影响套利者。通过监管申报文件，我们发现对冲基金减少了套利活动并增加了现金持有，尽管信贷稳定且同期赎回较少。债权人的监管和流动性约束并未通过回购——国债套利者的主要融资来源——传导至对冲基金。基金-债权人借贷数据显示，受监管更多的交易商提供了，且更重要的客户获得了，不成比例的更高融资。基金报告的风险价值表明内部风险约束具有约束力。我们的结果支持理论预测，即套利者的风险约束和预防性流动性管理即使在同期融资保持韧性时也可能加剧市场不稳定性。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Regime-specific exchange rate predictability
records.title_cn: 制度特定的汇率可预测性
records.abstract_en: We study temporary phases of exchange rate predictability in a two-regime threshold predictive regression framework allowing for persistent predictors. Regime switches are triggered by an observable transition variable which relates to media news, expectations, uncertainty and global financial conditions. As predictors for G7 currencies and effective US-Dollar exchange rates, we study various interest rate spreads, yield curve factors, uncertainty measures and deviations from fundamental exchange rate parities. Besides established uncertainty measures, we use a wide range of measures for media coverage and construct uncertainty measures from survey data as transition variables for the activation of the predictability regime. Our results emphasize that short recurring phases of significant predictability are characterized by nonlinear patterns. Phases of predictability are triggered by increased media coverage and high uncertainty with interest rate dynamics emerging as the most important predictor. We find broadly similar results for a contemporaneous threshold analysis where our regressors are allowed to affect the exchange rate in the same period. From a theoretical point of view, we argue that our empirical results are useful for the empirical identification of scapegoat effects and that media coverage and uncertainty affect the exchange rate via the heterogeneity of private signals and the precision of public signals.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个允许持久预测变量的双制度阈值预测回归框架中研究汇率可预测性的暂时阶段。制度切换由可观测的转换变量触发，该变量与媒体新闻、预期、不确定性和全球金融状况相关。作为G7货币和有效美元汇率的预测变量，我们研究了各种利率差、收益率曲线因子、不确定性度量以及与基本汇率平价的偏离。除了已有的不确定性度量，我们使用广泛的媒体覆盖度量，并从调查数据中构建不确定性度量作为可预测性制度激活的转换变量。我们的结果强调，显著可预测性的短期重复阶段以非线性模式为特征。可预测性阶段由媒体覆盖增加和高不确定性触发，利率动态成为最重要的预测变量。我们在同期阈值分析中发现大致相似的结果，其中我们的回归变量被允许在同一时期影响汇率。从理论角度来看，我们认为我们的实证结果对于经验识别替罪羊效应是有用的，并且媒体覆盖和不确定性通过私人信号的异质性和公共信号的精确性影响汇率。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: All models are wrong but all can be useful: Robust policy design using prediction pools
records.title_cn: 所有模型都是错的，但所有模型都可能有用：使用预测池进行稳健政策设计
records.abstract_en: We study the design of monetary policy rules robust to model uncertainty using a novel methodology. In our application, policymakers choose the optimal rule by attaching weights to a set of well-established DSGE models with varied financial frictions. The novelty of our methodology is to compute each model's weight based on their relative forecasting performance. Our results highlight the superiority of predictive pools over Bayesian model averaging and the need to combine models when none can be deemed as the true data generating process. In addition, we find that the optimal across-model robust policy rule exhibits attenuation, and nests a price level rule which has good robustness properties. Therefore, the application of our methodology offers a new rationale for price-level rules, namely the presence of uncertainty over the nature of financial frictions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一种使用新颖方法论设计对模型不确定性稳健的货币政策规则。在我们的应用中，政策制定者通过给一组具有不同金融摩擦的成熟DSGE模型赋予权重来选择最优规则。我们方法论的新颖之处在于根据每个模型的相对预测表现来计算其权重。我们的结果凸显了预测池相对于贝叶斯模型平均的优越性，以及在没有任何模型可被视为真实数据生成过程时组合模型的必要性。此外，我们发现最优跨模型稳健政策规则表现出衰减特征，并包含一个具有良好稳健性属性的价格水平规则。因此，我们方法论的应用为价格水平规则提供了新的理由，即金融摩擦性质存在不确定性。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Continuous-time persuasion by filtering
records.title_cn: 通过滤波进行连续时间说服
records.abstract_en: We frame dynamic persuasion in a partial observation stochastic control Leader-Follower game with an ergodic criterion. The Receiver controls the dynamics of a multidimensional unobserved state process. Information is provided to the Receiver through a device designed by the Sender that generates the observation process. The commitment of the Sender is enforced. We develop this approach in the case where all dynamics are linear and the preferences of the Receiver are linear-quadratic. We prove a verification theorem for the existence and uniqueness of the solution of the HJB equation satisfied by the Receiver's value function. An extension to the case of persuasion of a mean field of interacting Receivers is also provided. We illustrate this approach in two applications: the provision of information to electricity consumers with a smart meter designed by an electricity producer; the information provided by carbon footprint accounting rules to companies engaged in a best-in-class emissions reduction effort. In the first application, we link the benefits of information provision to the mispricing of electricity production. In the latter, we show that even in the absence of information cost, it might be optimal for the regulator to blur information available to firms to prevent them from coordinating on a higher level of carbon footprint to reduce their cost of reaching a below average emission target.
records.abstract_cn: 我们将动态说服构建为一个具有遍历准则的部分观测随机控制领导者-跟随者博弈。接收者控制一个多维未观测状态过程的动态。信息通过发送者设计的设备提供给接收者，该设备生成观测过程。发送者的承诺得到强制执行。我们在所有动态均为线性且接收者偏好为线性二次的情况下发展了这一方法。我们证明了接收者价值函数所满足的HJB方程解的存在性和唯一性的验证定理。我们还提供了对交互接收者平均场说服情况的扩展。我们在两个应用中说明了这一方法：电力生产者设计的智能电表向电力消费者提供信息；碳足迹核算规则向参与最佳类别减排努力的公司提供信息。在第一个应用中，我们将信息提供的收益与电力生产的错误定价联系起来。在后一个应用中，我们表明，即使在没有信息成本的情况下，监管者模糊提供给企业的信息可能是最优的，以防止它们协调在更高的碳足迹水平上，从而降低达到低于平均水平排放目标的成本。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Financial conditions, business cycle fluctuations and growth-at-risk
records.title_cn: 金融状况、商业周期波动与增长风险
records.abstract_en: We augment a quantile vector autoregressive model with the interquartile range of economic growth, a robust proxy for volatility, to assess the relative importance of financial conditions and economic risk in affecting the business cycle. We find that economic risk displays an asymmetric effect on economic growth distribution, very much similar to financial conditions: they substantially increase growth-at-risk, but have limited impact on upside potential. We also document that the asymmetric impact of economic risk depends on the state of the economy and is substantially amplified in times of high economic risk, while remaining subdued in tranquil times.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在分位数向量自回归模型中加入了经济增长的四分位距，作为波动性的稳健代理变量，以评估金融状况和经济风险在影响商业周期中的相对重要性。我们发现，经济风险对经济增长分布表现出非对称效应，与金融状况非常相似：它们显著增加了增长风险，但对上行潜力的影响有限。我们还记录了经济风险的非对称影响取决于经济状态，并在经济风险高企时期显著放大，而在平静时期则保持低迷。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Dynamic trading strategies for storage
records.title_cn: 存储的动态交易策略
records.abstract_en: We consider a dynamic model of an oligopolistic market with demand shocks, in which a storage unit buys and sells over time subject to a capacity constraint. To make progress in this stochastic game with constraints, we restrict attention to simple heuristics, and we can characterize the optimal policy of a storage unit in this restricted class of strategies. The heuristics, the exogenous stochastic process and the capacity constraint interact to induce rich dynamics. The optimal policy is sensitive to the nature of demand shocks and to storage capacity. For a fixed capacity, the storage unit internalizes its unilateral market power; it acts like a monopolist on its arbitrage spread. We uncover a new phenomenon that we call continuation risk. It is a corollary of market power and induces the optimal capacity to be interior even absent investment cost. We discuss some implications.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个具有需求冲击的寡头垄断市场的动态模型，其中存储单元在容量约束下随时间进行买卖。为了在这个带约束的随机博弈中取得进展，我们将注意力限制在简单启发式策略上，并能够刻画存储单元在此受限策略类别中的最优政策。启发式策略、外生随机过程与容量约束相互作用，产生了丰富的动态特性。最优政策对需求冲击的性质和存储容量敏感。对于固定容量，存储单元内化其单边市场力量；它在其套利价差上表现得像垄断者。我们发现了一个新现象，称之为持续风险。它是市场力量的推论，并导致最优容量即使在无投资成本的情况下也是内部的。我们讨论了一些启示。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Intergenerational income mobility and income taxation
records.title_cn: 代际收入流动性与所得税
records.abstract_en: We study the impact of income taxation on intergenerational income correlation. We estimate a life cycle dynastic model and conduct counterfactual analysis to observe the effects of various tax regimes. Compared to a no tax environment, a flat tax regime reduces the correlation only by one percentage points. If the flat tax regime provides child benefits, the correlation additionally declines by four percentage points. Finally, if the taxes are progressive, the reduction, which is due to the increase in the fertility rate (quantity) and the decrease in the educational outcome of children (quality), is highly significant (seven percentage points).
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了所得税对代际收入相关性的影响。我们估计了一个生命周期王朝模型，并进行反事实分析以观察各种税收制度的效果。与无税环境相比，单一税率制度仅将相关性降低了一个百分点。如果单一税率制度提供儿童福利，相关性额外下降四个百分点。最后，如果税收是累进的，由于生育率（数量）的增加和儿童教育成果（质量）的下降，相关性的降低非常显著（七个百分点）。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Patent policy, invention and innovation in the theory of Schumpeterian growth
records.title_cn: 专利政策、发明与创新：熊彼特增长理论视角
records.abstract_en: I develop an endogenous growth model that separates firm decisions to invent, patent, and commercialize new innovations. I use the model to examine how multiple dimensions of patent policy impact economic growth by shaping these relative incentives. I pay particular attention to the role of patenting requirements that dictate how far along the development process an inventor must progress to obtain a patent. The model formalizes how strengthening such requirements generates competing effects on economic growth; stronger requirements reduce ex ante research incentives by increasing the expected cost of patenting, but increase ex post incentives to fully develop patented inventions into commercial innovations by decreasing the additional cost associated with commercialization. Overall, my analysis supports the use of stronger patenting requirements as an effective policy tool to improve economic outcomes by shifting incentives away from invention in the pursuit of patents and towards the development of commercial innovations.
records.abstract_cn: 我构建了一个内生增长模型，将企业发明、申请专利和商业化新创新的决策分离开来。我利用该模型考察专利政策的多个维度如何通过塑造这些相对激励来影响经济增长。我特别关注专利申请要求的作用，这些要求规定了发明者在获得专利前必须推进到开发过程的哪个阶段。该模型形式化了加强此类要求如何对经济增长产生竞争性效应；更强的要求通过增加专利申请的预期成本来降低事前研究激励，但通过减少与商业化相关的额外成本来增强事后将已获专利的发明充分开发为商业创新的激励。总体而言，我的分析支持将更强的专利申请要求作为有效的政策工具，通过将激励从追求专利的发明转向商业创新的开发，以改善经济成果。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Do search costs explain persistent investment in active mutual funds?
records.title_cn: 搜索成本能否解释主动型共同基金的持续投资？
records.abstract_en: Active funds, though losing market share since the 1990s, make up nearly half of all mutual funds but charge more without better performance. We analyze fund data and a search model, highlighting the impact of search costs and active fund preferences. From 1993 to 2018, reduced search costs expanded the market and heightened competition, while a preference shift from active to passive funds increased the latter's market share. However, investors who choose active funds, facing higher search costs, and continue to show a strong preference for them, allow these funds to keep charging higher fees.
records.abstract_cn: 主动型基金自1990年代以来市场份额不断下降，但仍占所有共同基金的近一半，且收费更高而业绩并未更优。我们分析了基金数据和搜索模型，强调了搜索成本和主动型基金偏好的影响。从1993年到2018年，搜索成本的降低扩大了市场并加剧了竞争，而偏好从主动型转向被动型基金则增加了后者的市场份额。然而，选择主动型基金的投资者面临更高的搜索成本，并继续表现出对它们的强烈偏好，这使得这些基金能够持续收取更高的费用。

records.title_en: Winners and losers of generative AI: Early Evidence of Shifts in Freelancer Demand
records.title_cn: 生成式人工智能的赢家与输家：自由职业者需求变化的早期证据
records.abstract_en: We examine how ChatGPT has changed the demand for freelancers in jobs where generative AI tools can act as substitutes or complements to human labor. Using BERTopic we partition job postings from a leading online freelancing platform into 116 fine-grained skill clusters and with GPT-4o we classify them as substitutable, complementary or unaffected by LLMs. Our analysis reveals that labor demand increased after the launch of ChatGPT, but only in skill clusters that were complementary to or unaffected by the AI tool. In contrast, demand for substitutable skills, such as writing and translation, decreased by 20–50% relative to the counterfactual trend, with the sharpest decline observed for short-term (1-3 week) jobs. Within complementary skill clusters, the results are mixed: demand for machine learning programming grew by 24%, and demand for AI-powered chatbot development nearly tripled, while demand for novice workers declined in general. This result suggests a shift toward more specialized expertise for freelancers rather than uniform growth across all complementary areas.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了ChatGPT如何改变了在生成式人工智能工具可以作为人类劳动的替代品或互补品的职业中对自由职业者的需求。利用BERTopic，我们将来自一家领先的在线自由职业平台的职位发布划分为116个细粒度技能集群，并使用GPT-4o将它们分类为可替代、互补或不受大语言模型影响。我们的分析显示，ChatGPT发布后劳动力需求有所增加，但仅限于与AI工具互补或不受其影响的技能集群。相比之下，对于可替代技能（如写作和翻译）的需求相对于反事实趋势下降了20-50%，其中短期（1-3周）工作的下降最为显著。在互补技能集群内部，结果不一：机器学习编程的需求增长了24%，AI驱动的聊天机器人开发需求几乎翻了三倍，而新手工人的需求普遍下降。这一结果表明，自由职业者的需求正转向更专业的专长，而非在所有互补领域均匀增长。

records.title_en: Doing good in the digital world
records.title_cn: 在数字世界中行善
records.abstract_en: Though digital interactions between people have become more commonplace and sophisticated, behavior in digital settings remains underresearched. A distinctive feature of the digital world is the ability to calibrate or withhold one’s identifier: a person can be identified by a string of letters, an avatar, their real name, or even nothing at all. Moreover, that digital identifiers allow a person to mask their physical identity also makes it difficult to attribute digital actions to a physical person, even when the actions are observed. I embed these two features in a laboratory experiment where subjects play a finitely repeated, linear public goods game. Treated subjects are identified in one of three ways—by their photograph, by a random number, or by a self-designed cartoon avatar—and their individual choices are revealed and either attributed to, or decoupled from, their identifier. In line with the previous literature, identifying subjects and increasing the precision of attribution increases contributions relative to a baseline condition without identifiers or revealed individual choices. Remarkably, the treatment effect is robust to less precise identifiers and attribution: contributions increase significantly even when subjects are identified by numbers and their individual contributions are revealed, but decoupled from, those numbers.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管人与人之间的数字互动已变得更加普遍和复杂，数字环境中的行为研究仍然不足。数字世界的一个显著特征是能够校准或隐藏个人标识符：一个人可以通过一串字母、一个头像、真实姓名，甚至完全不显示任何信息来被识别。此外，数字标识符允许个人掩盖其物理身份，这也使得将数字行为归因于具体个人变得困难，即使这些行为被观察到。我将这两个特征嵌入到一个实验室实验中，受试者参与一个有限重复的线性公共品博弈。受试者通过三种方式之一被识别——通过照片、随机数字或自行设计的卡通头像——并且他们的个人选择被揭示，并与他们的标识符相关联或脱钩。与先前文献一致，识别受试者并提高归因精度相对于无标识符或未揭示个人选择的基线条件增加了贡献。值得注意的是，处理效应对于较不精确的标识符和归因是稳健的：即使受试者通过数字被识别且其个人贡献被揭示但与这些数字脱钩，贡献也显著增加。

records.title_en: Brigandage and the political legacy of monarchical legitimacy in Southern Italy
records.title_cn: 南意大利的匪患与君主制合法性的政治遗产
records.abstract_en: Political legitimacy plays a pivotal role in securing the effectiveness and longevity of a governing system, yet it can be eroded by the way rulers handle popular uprisings. This paper studies whether a historical shock in the legitimacy of monarchic rule can have long-term, intergenerational consequences on political attitudes. The unification of Italy ignited a violent reaction against the new ruler in its southern provinces known as the “Great Brigandage”. We use fixed effects regressions with a wide set of controls and an instrumental variable approach based on military suitability of the terrain in order to show that, ceteris paribus, municipalities exposed to brigandage in the 1861–1870 period had lower turnout in the 1946 Institutional Referendum and were significantly less likely to vote for the survival of the monarchy. Heterogeneity analysis leveraging a spatial discontinuity in martial law suggests that anti-monarchic sentiment likely stemmed from the collective memory of brigandage repression. We interpret our findings as evidence that latent preferences toward political systems are endogenously shaped by historical events and can be brought to the surface by changes in the institutional environment.
records.abstract_cn: 政治合法性在确保治理体系的有效性和持久性方面发挥着关键作用，但它可能因统治者处理民众起义的方式而受到侵蚀。本文研究君主统治合法性的历史冲击是否会对政治态度产生长期的、代际相传的后果。意大利统一在其南部省份引发了对新统治者的暴力反抗，即所谓的“大匪患”。我们使用带有广泛控制变量的固定效应回归，以及基于地形军事适宜性的工具变量方法，以表明在其他条件相同的情况下，在1861-1870年期间遭受匪患的市镇在1946年制度公投中的投票率较低，并且显著不太可能投票支持君主制的存续。利用戒严令的空间不连续性进行的异质性分析表明，反君主情绪可能源于对匪患镇压的集体记忆。我们将我们的发现解释为，对政治体系的潜在偏好是由历史事件内生塑造的，并且可以通过制度环境的变化而浮出水面。

records.title_en: In or out? Crowding effects in public goods with private gifts: Evidence from crowdfunding
records.title_cn: 进还是出？公共品与私人赠礼中的拥挤效应：来自众筹的证据
records.abstract_en: How do cumulative contributions influence subsequent giving to public goods that offer private gifts? While prior research has examined contribution dynamics in fundraising, the role of excludability — the property of preventing noncontributors from accessing the good — remains largely unexplored. We use comprehensive data from a reward-based crowdfunding platform to show that the excludability of a project significantly shapes its contribution pattern. We introduce two novel measures of excludability: one based on a good’s inherent characteristics and another derived from the geographic distribution of backer-project distances. Our analysis reveals that more excludable goods (such as local projects and tangible products) exhibit stronger crowding-in effects, whereas less excludable ones (such as global projects and journalism) experience crowding-out effects. Although crowdfunding platforms systematically highlight cumulative contributions, our findings suggest that fundraisers should emphasize this information, particularly for excludable goods, but not for the least excludable ones.
records.abstract_cn: 累计贡献如何影响后续对提供私人赠礼的公共品的捐赠？虽然先前的研究已经考察了筹款中的贡献动态，但排他性——即阻止非贡献者获取该物品的属性——的作用在很大程度上仍未得到探索。我们利用来自一个奖励型众筹平台的全面数据，表明项目的排他性显著塑造了其贡献模式。我们引入了两种新的排他性度量：一种基于物品的内在特征，另一种来源于支持者-项目距离的地理分布。我们的分析揭示，更具排他性的物品（如本地项目和实物产品）表现出更强的挤入效应，而排他性较弱的物品（如全球项目和新闻业）则经历挤出效应。尽管众筹平台系统性地突出累计贡献，我们的发现表明，筹款者应强调这一信息，特别是对于排他性物品，但对于排他性最弱的物品则不应如此。

records.title_en: Coalitions for sustainable consumption: Understanding the emergence of shared ownership in an Agent-Based Model
records.title_cn: 可持续消费的联盟：理解基于主体的模型中共享所有权的出现
records.abstract_en: Sharing ownership of goods, like cars or drills, used by a single owner for a small fraction of their life-time, can mitigate environmental impacts. But are consumers ready to give up individual property rights on underutilised goods? We propose a simple model to study conditions favouring consumers purchasing a private good in coalition rather than individually. By exploring the model parameter space, encompassing characteristics and preferences of heterogeneous consumers, those of the private good and of a public service that offers the same service of the good, we identify the emergence of shared ownership. It predominantly occurs under niche conditions: among lower-income consumers with above-average demand, especially when the shared good is relatively small and purchasable in small coalitions — which have lower coordination challenges. Shared ownership reduces the net number of goods in an economy and production-related environmental impact, even in the absence of consumers’ sustainability concerns. Policies reducing the relative price of the shared purchase accelerate the transition to a more sustainable shared consumption. However, we do not find any impact of shared ownership in reducing inequality in accessing goods.
records.abstract_cn: 共享商品的所有权，如汽车或钻头，这些商品在单个所有者手中仅使用其寿命的一小部分，可以减轻环境影响。但消费者是否准备好放弃对未充分利用商品的个人财产权？我们提出了一个简单模型来研究消费者以联盟而非个人形式购买私人商品的条件。通过探索模型参数空间，涵盖异质性消费者的特征和偏好、私人商品以及提供相同服务的公共服务的特征，我们识别出共享所有权的出现。它主要在利基条件下发生：在需求高于平均水平的低收入消费者中，尤其是当共享商品相对较小且可以小规模联盟购买时——这些联盟的协调挑战较低。共享所有权减少了经济中商品的总数和与生产相关的环境影响，即使消费者没有可持续性关切。降低共享购买相对价格的政策加速了向更可持续的共享消费的过渡。然而，我们没有发现共享所有权在减少获取商品的不平等方面有任何影响。

records.title_en: Different norms of sexual activity and consent seeking among college students: Social identity and statistical discrimination
records.title_cn: 大学生性行为和同意寻求的不同规范：社会认同和统计歧视
records.abstract_en: Preventing sexual assault on university campuses is rooted in promoting the adoption and practice of seeking consent. Using identity theory and a factorial vignette survey experiment, we test for the presence of implicit differences in appropriateness ratings based on context, gender, race and sexual orientation and, in aggregate, differences in social norms that govern college students’ sexual interactions. We provide a simple theoretical framework of statistical discrimination where the social norms for identical actions are predicted to differ because the appropriateness of actions is imperfectly observed and evaluators hold beliefs about underlying propensities of appropriate action that are rooted in identity. Our results show that context significantly alters perceptions of appropriate behavior and that heterosexual male actions are viewed as systematically less socially appropriate. We validate our findings with a post-study questionnaire which reveals that beliefs regarding appropriateness ratings are largely driven by the perceived rates of sexual assault among the represented population by the vignette narrator. The paper advances the study of norms rooted in identity and presents an identity-based theoretical framework that provides intuition for how such a differences may arise.
records.abstract_cn: 防止大学校园性侵犯的根源在于促进征求同意的采用和实践。利用身份理论和阶乘小插曲调查实验，我们测试了基于背景、性别、种族和性取向的适当性评级是否存在隐性差异，以及总体上管理大学生性互动的社会规范的差异。我们提供了一个简单的统计歧视理论框架，其中相同行为的社会规范预计会有所不同，因为行为的适当性未被完全观察到，并且评估者对植根于身份的适当行为的潜在倾向持有信念。我们的研究结果表明，环境显着改变了对适当行为的看法，异性恋男性的行为被认为系统性地不太适合社会。我们通过研究后调查问卷验证了我们的发现，该调查显示，关于适当性评级的信念很大程度上是由小插曲叙述者所代表的人群中性侵犯的感知率驱动的。本文推进了对植根于身份的规范的研究，并提出了一个基于身份的理论框架，为这种差异如何产生提供了直觉。

records.title_en: Can gender and race dynamics in performance appraisals be disrupted? The case of social influence
records.title_cn: 绩效评估中的性别与种族动态能否被打破？社会影响的案例
records.abstract_en: We document gender and race dynamics in performance evaluations in a multi-national company, examining the impacts of a feature of the performance appraisal process: managers’ knowledge of employees’ self-evaluations. Generally, (White) women were rated higher than men and people of color were rated lower than White employees. Women of color gave themselves the lowest self-ratings. When self-evaluations were unavailable due to a quasi-exogenous shock, manager and self-ratings were less correlated. However, gender and race gaps remained unchanged as managers anchored on previous years’ ratings. Based on suggestive evidence, women of color without an employment history benefitted from their self-ratings not being shared.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了一家跨国公司绩效评估中的性别与种族动态，考察了绩效评估过程的一个特征的影响：管理者对员工自我评估的了解。总体而言，（白人）女性的评分高于男性，有色人种员工的评分低于白人员工。有色人种女性给自己的自我评分最低。当由于准外生冲击而无法获得自我评估时，管理者评分与自我评分的相关性降低。然而，性别和种族差距保持不变，因为管理者锚定于前几年的评分。基于提示性证据，没有工作历史的有色人种女性因自我评估未被分享而受益。

records.title_en: Moral preferences over health-wealth trade-offs
records.title_cn: 健康与财富权衡中的道德偏好
records.abstract_en: Using a choice experiment we analyze moral preferences over fatalities and jobs losses due to the pandemic in Italy, the UK and the US. We find that the participants’ utility function is mostly driven by health outcomes, and that respondents’ stable traits (such as political orientation or risk aversion) influence attitudes more than their personal experiences with the consequences of the pandemic. A structural estimation also displays, surprisingly, aversion to diversification among these two bads. Moreover, policy responses look misaligned with estimated preferences. Italy adopted more stringent containment measures, while Italian respondents display a relatively weaker pro-health attitude.
records.abstract_cn: 通过一项选择实验，我们分析了意大利、英国和美国因疫情导致的死亡与失业问题上的道德偏好。我们发现参与者的效用函数主要由健康结果驱动，并且受访者的稳定特质（如政治倾向或风险厌恶）比他们个人经历疫情后果的经验更能影响态度。一项结构估计还出人意料地显示出对这些两种不良结果的多样化厌恶。此外，政策回应似乎与估计的偏好不一致。意大利采取了更严格的遏制措施，而意大利受访者则表现出相对较弱的亲健康态度。

records.title_en: How scary is the risk of automation? Evidence from a large-scale survey experiment
records.title_cn: 自动化风险有多可怕？来自大规模调查实验的证据
records.abstract_en: Technological advancements have always shaped labor markets; however, emerging AI innovations like ChatGPT are now putting occupations previously considered "safe" from technological substitution at significant risk of automation. This study examines individuals' willingness to pay to reduce automation risk, using a discrete-choice experiment conducted with nearly 6000 participants. Results reveal that respondents accept a salary reduction of almost 20 % of the Swiss median annual gross wage to reduce their automation risk by 10 percentage points or, conversely, demand a 20 % risk premium to accept an equivalent increase in automation risk. Interestingly, the study finds that WTP for risk reduction increases with higher baseline automation risk levels, contrary to patterns observed in other contexts. While preferences are generally homogeneous, differences exist between demographic groups. Men, younger and risk-tolerant individuals, and those with higher education show lower willingness to pay for reduced automation risk. By having respondents express preferences for hypothetical children, the study also explores potential gender biases, finding no significant differences in willingness to pay for reduced automation risk, educational degrees, hierarchical position, or wage based on the child's gender.
records.abstract_cn: 技术进步一直塑造着劳动力市场；然而，像ChatGPT这样的新兴人工智能创新现在正使那些先前被认为“安全”于技术替代的职业面临显著的自动化风险。本研究通过一项涉及近6000名参与者的离散选择实验，考察了个人为降低自动化风险而愿意支付的金额。结果显示，受访者接受减少相当于瑞士年工资中位数近20%的薪资，以将其自动化风险降低10个百分点；或者相反，要求20%的风险溢价以接受同等程度的自动化风险增加。有趣的是，研究发现，降低风险的支付意愿随着基线自动化风险水平的升高而增加，这与在其他情境中观察到的模式相反。尽管偏好总体上是同质的，但不同人口群体之间存在差异。男性、较年轻且风险容忍度高的个体，以及受教育程度较高者，对降低自动化风险的支付意愿较低。通过让受访者表达对假设子女的偏好，研究还探讨了潜在的性别偏见，发现基于子女性别，在降低自动化风险的支付意愿、教育程度、职位层级或工资方面没有显著差异。

records.title_en: Trade and the rise of ancient Greek city-states
records.title_cn: 贸易与古希腊城邦的兴起
records.abstract_en: In this paper, I examine the role of comparative advantage in the rise of city-states. After compiling a new dataset on ancient Greece and the natural environment, I provide evidence that the spatial covariance of natural vegetation endowments amongst potential trading partners is important for explaining the development of silver coin money, battles, and city-state formation. I also provide statistical evidence against “key factors” previously emphasized. These findings are consistent with a general model of comparative advantage that I develop, which clarifies how the spatial covariance of factor endowments affects multiple development outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我考察了比较优势在城邦兴起中的作用。在编制了一个关于古希腊和自然环境的新数据集后，我提供的证据表明，潜在贸易伙伴之间自然植被禀赋的空间协方差对于解释银币货币的发展、战争和城邦形成具有重要意义。我还提供了针对先前强调的“关键因素”的统计证据。这些发现与我提出的一个一般比较优势模型相一致，该模型阐明了要素禀赋的空间协方差如何影响多种发展结果。

records.title_en: Firm consolidation and labor market outcomes
records.title_cn: 企业合并与劳动力市场结果
records.abstract_en: Using rich administrative data from the Netherlands, we study the consequences of firm consolidation for workers. For workers at acquired firms, takeovers are associated with a 8.5% drop in employment at the consolidated firm and a 2.6% drop in total labor income. These effects persist even four years after the takeover and are consistent with job losses driven by involuntary separations. Few takeovers change labor market concentration meaningfully. Instead, restructuring at consolidating firms is likely to be an important mechanism behind our findings. Specifically, workers with skills that are already present at acquirers are less likely to be retained and overtime hours and part-time work are reduced.
records.abstract_cn: 利用荷兰丰富的行政数据，我们研究了企业合并对工人的影响。对于被收购企业的工人而言，收购与合并后企业就业率下降8.5%和总劳动收入下降2.6%相关。这些效应在收购后四年依然持续，并且与由非自愿离职导致的失业情况一致。很少有收购会显著改变劳动力市场集中度。相反，合并企业的重组可能是我们发现背后的重要机制。具体来说，技能在收购方中已经存在的工人更不可能被保留，加班时间和兼职工作减少。

records.title_en: Making up for harming others — An experiment on voluntary compensation behavior
records.title_cn: 弥补对他人的伤害——关于自愿补偿行为的实验
records.abstract_en: We investigate in a controlled laboratory setting to what extent buyers are willing to offset negative consumption externalities. In one treatment dimension, we vary whether the externality associated with a purchase is irreversible or can be reduced ex post by a voluntary payment. In a second treatment dimension, we induce diffusion of harm among harmed subjects and diffusion of responsibility among buyers by separately varying the matching of buyers and harmed subjects. We find that subjects are, on average, willing to compensate for their negative externalities and that this willingness is sensitive to the surplus from buying. Yet, experimental buyers are highly heterogeneous, with some never compensating. While the introduction of voluntary compensation significantly reduces externalities, the net externality still remains high across all treatments. Diffusion of responsibility tends to reduce the size of compensation and to increase overall net externalities in the main experiment. An additional control treatment reveals that under diffusion of responsibility among buyers, patterns of conditional cooperation seem to drive compensation in the present setting: the amount paid for compensation increases with higher beliefs about the compensation by other buyers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在受控实验室环境中调查了买家在多大程度上愿意抵消负面消费外部性。在一个处理维度上，我们变化购买相关的外部性是不可逆的还是可以通过自愿支付事后减少。在第二个处理维度上，我们通过分别变化买家与受害者的匹配方式，诱导了受害者之间的伤害扩散和买家之间的责任扩散。我们发现，平均而言，受试者愿意为其负面外部性进行补偿，并且这种意愿对购买盈余敏感。然而，实验买家高度异质，有些人从不补偿。虽然引入自愿补偿显著减少了外部性，但在所有处理中，净外部性仍然很高。责任扩散倾向于减少补偿规模，并在主要实验中增加总体净外部性。一个额外的对照处理揭示，在买家之间的责任扩散下，条件合作模式似乎在当前环境中驱动补偿：支付的补偿金额随着对其他买家补偿的更高信念而增加。

records.title_en: Gender Gaps in the Federal Reserve System
records.title_cn: 联邦储备系统中的性别差距
records.abstract_en: To better understand the stalled progress of women in economics, we construct new data on women’s representation and research output in one of the largest policy institutions—the Federal Reserve System. We document a slight increase in women’s representation over the past 20 years, in line with academic trends. We also document a significant gender gap in research output, including for years in which economists have greater domestic responsibilities, but nearly absent gender gaps in policy output and career progression. This work complements existing research on women in academia, allowing a more comprehensive examination of progress in the economics profession.
records.abstract_cn: 为了更好地理解女性在经济学领域进展停滞的现象，我们构建了关于女性在最大政策机构之一——联邦储备系统中的代表性和研究产出的新数据。我们记录了在过去20年中女性代表性的轻微增长，这与学术趋势一致。我们还记录了研究产出中显著的性别差距，包括在经济学家承担更多家庭责任的年份，但在政策产出和职业晋升方面几乎不存在性别差距。这项工作补充了现有关于学术界女性的研究，使得对经济学职业进展的考察更为全面。

records.title_en: Environmental policies with green network effect and price discrimination
records.title_cn: 具有绿色网络效应和价格歧视的环境政策
records.abstract_en: We consider a duopolistic market in which a green firm competes with a brown rival, and both firms offer vertically differentiated products. Consumers are heterogeneous both in their willingness to pay for hedonic quality and in their environmental concern. The latter is positively related to the green firm’s market share, giving rise to a green network effect. We characterize how price and quality schedules are set and how consumers sort between the two firms at the market equilibrium. When considering pollution from both consumption and production, we compute total welfare and evaluate the impact of different environmental policies. Our analysis demonstrates that efficiency can be achieved through a uniform emission tax, which restores the optimal differential between firms’ intrinsic qualities. Notably, we find that a discriminatory subsidy, which decreases with the willingness to pay for intrinsic quality, re-establishes the optimal sorting of consumers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个双寡头市场，其中一家绿色企业与一家棕色竞争对手竞争，两家企业均提供垂直差异化产品。消费者在支付意愿（针对享乐质量）和环境关注度方面存在异质性。后者与绿色企业的市场份额正相关，从而产生绿色网络效应。我们刻画了市场价格和质量计划的设定方式，以及市场均衡中消费者如何在两家企业之间进行选择。在考虑消费和生产两方面污染时，我们计算总福利并评估不同环境政策的影响。我们的分析表明，通过统一的排放税可以实现效率，该税种恢复了企业内在质量之间的最优差异。值得注意的是，我们发现，一种随内在质量支付意愿递减的歧视性补贴，能够重新建立消费者的最优选择。

records.title_en: Jumping the queue: An experimental study on cultural differences in bribing attitudes among Greeks and Germans
records.title_cn: 插队：希腊人和德国人行贿态度文化差异的实验研究
records.abstract_en: We examine how queuing processes in public service provision influence individuals' propensity to engage in bribery. We introduce the queue-jumping game, distinguishing between queue-jumping bribes (to advance one's position) and counter-bribes (to maintain one's position when threatened by queue-jumping). Participants from Greece and Germany, countries with different levels of perceived corruption, played the game in monocultural and intercultural groups. Our findings reveal that in monocultural settings, Greek participants initially exhibited higher bribery rates than German participants, driven primarily by more frequent queue-jumping. However, these cultural differences diminished over repeated interactions, suggesting strategic adaptation. Crucially, analysis indicates that bribing to queue-jump incurs a substantially higher moral cost than counter-bribing for both nationalities. Furthermore, Greek participants perceived counter-bribing as significantly more socially inappropriate than their German counterparts, helping explain the higher initial rates of queue-jumping among Greek participants. In intercultural groups, we found only limited evidence of minority participants adjusting behavior towards majority norms, although minorities consistently earned less regardless of nationality.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究公共服务提供中的排队过程如何影响个人的贿赂倾向。我们介绍插队游戏，区分插队贿赂（以提升自己的地位）和反贿赂（在受到插队威胁时维持自己的地位）。来自希腊和德国这两个腐败程度不同的国家的参与者在单一文化和跨文化群体中玩游戏。我们的研究结果表明，在单一文化环境中，希腊参与者最初表现出比德国参与者更高的贿赂率，这主要是由于更频繁的插队。然而，这些文化差异随着反复的互动而消失，这表明战略适应。至关重要的是，分析表明，对于两国来说，行贿插队所带来的道德成本远高于反行贿。此外，希腊参与者认为反贿赂明显比德国参与者更不适合社会，这有助于解释希腊参与者最初插队的比例较高。在跨文化群体中，我们只发现少数群体参与者根据多数群体规范调整行为的证据有限，尽管无论国籍如何，少数群体的收入始终较低。

records.title_en: Implementing efficiency with equality
records.title_cn: 实现效率与公平并重
records.abstract_en: We consider the implementation of efficiency with minimum inequality in a large population model of negative externalities. Formally, the model is one of tragedy of the commons with the aggregate strategy at the efficient state being lower than at the Nash equilibrium. A planner can restore efficiency by imposing an externality equivalent tax and then redistributing the tax revenue as transfers to lower inequality. We characterize the payment scheme that minimizes inequality, as measured by the Gini coefficient, at the efficient state subject to incentive compatibility and budget balance. We then construct a mechanism that implements efficiency with minimum inequality in dominant strategies. We also show that minimizing inequality at the efficient state maximizes the minimum payoff at efficiency. However, it is not equivalent to implementing the Rawlsian social choice function.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑在负外部性的大规模人口模型中，以最小不平等实现效率的实施问题。形式上，该模型是公地悲剧模型，其中有效状态下的总体策略低于纳什均衡状态下的总体策略。规划者可以通过征收外部性等价税来恢复效率，然后将税收收入作为转移支付进行再分配，以降低不平等。我们刻画了在激励相容和预算平衡约束下，以基尼系数衡量的有效状态下最小化不平等的支付方案。随后，我们构建了一个在占优策略下以最小不平等实现效率的机制。我们还表明，在有效状态下最小化不平等会最大化效率状态下的最低收益。然而，这并不等同于实施罗尔斯主义社会选择函数。

records.title_en: Covid19 and consumer animus towards Chinese products: Evidence from Amazon data
records.title_cn: 新冠疫情与消费者对中国产品的敌意：来自亚马逊数据的证据
records.abstract_en: We tracked all facemasks sold on Amazon from Sep. 2019 to Sep. 2020 and analyzed seller-generated product information as well as user-generated reviews. Using a fully dynamic event study we found the average user rating of a facemask dropped significantly following the first consumer review or question and answer stating it was made in China, but not of other countries. This drop expanded in the first three weeks after the identification of Chinese products but then gradually faded out within twelve weeks. The U-shape post identification is explained by a review’s direct (its own rating) and indirect (other consumers’ ratings) impact on average rating and was driven by Chinese products with high reputation. By analyzing consumer reviews, we provided strong evidence that the drop in average rating was driven by consumer animus to China and Chinese products rather than product quality or shipping.
records.abstract_cn: 我们追踪了从2019年九月至2020年九月在亚马逊上销售的所有口罩，并分析了卖家生成的产品信息以及用户生成的评论。通过使用完全动态事件研究，我们发现，在首次消费者评论或问答指出产品为中国制造后，口罩的平均用户评分显著下降，但其他国家制造的产品则没有此现象。这一下降在中国产品被识别后的前三周内扩大，但在十二周内逐渐消退。识别后的U型形态可通过评论对平均评分的直接（其自身评分）和间接（其他消费者评分）影响来解释，并且这一现象由高声誉的中国产品驱动。通过分析消费者评论，我们提供了强有力的证据表明，平均评分的下降是由消费者对中国及中国产品的敌意驱动的，而非产品质量或运输问题。

records.title_en: Minimum wage and labor self-funded training: evidence from China
records.title_cn: 最低工资与劳动力自费培训：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: We examine the impact of minimum wage increases on labor self-funded training by first constructing a theoretical model that explores the effects under both perfectly and imperfectly competitive market conditions. We then empirically analyze the impact using data on training enterprise registrations and household spending on training. Theoretically, we find an increase in the minimum wage is expected to suppress demand for low-skilled labor, leading affected workers to engage in self-funded training to compete for a limited number of job positions. Empirically, a minimum wage increase significantly boosts the number of newly registered training enterprises and household expenditures on skill training. Mechanism analysis reveals that a higher minimum wage increases labor costs for enterprises, leading them to raise skill requirements during recruitment, thereby encouraging job market participants to pursue self-funded skill training.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过首先构建一个理论模型来考察最低工资上涨对劳动力自费培训的影响，该模型探讨了在完全竞争和不完全竞争市场条件下的效应。然后，我们利用培训企业注册和家庭培训支出的数据进行了实证分析。理论上，我们发现最低工资的上涨预期会抑制对低技能劳动力的需求，导致受影响的工人参与自费培训以竞争有限的工作岗位。实证上，最低工资的上涨显著增加了新注册培训企业的数量和家庭技能培训支出。机制分析显示，较高的最低工资增加了企业的劳动力成本，促使他们在招聘时提高技能要求，从而鼓励就业市场参与者追求自费技能培训。

records.title_en: Contextualizing child labor reforms: Education policy, legal bans, and female child labor in rural South India
records.title_cn: 童工改革的情境化：教育政策、法律禁令与印度南部农村女童劳动
records.abstract_en: The prevailing consensus in the economics literature suggests that child labor laws are generally ineffective. However, this view often overlooks the broader policy context that shapes such reforms. India's 2012 Child Labor Amendment Act emerged after a period of significant reform aimed at improving girls' education, particularly through the 2009 education reforms. This paper sustains that these reforms potentially altered societal perceptions regarding the marginal value of girls' education, while the Child Labor Act highlighted the hazards of child labor in agriculture. Together, these measures may have created a more favorable environment for reducing rural female child labor. Using panel data from Young Lives and a triple difference-in-difference methodology, this study documents a significant reduction in female child labor in rural India. The findings highlight the importance of contextualizing legal reforms and emphasize the need for nuanced assessments to better understand their heterogeneous outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 经济学文献中的主流共识认为，童工法律通常效果不佳。然而，这一观点往往忽视了塑造此类改革的更广泛政策背景。印度的2012年《童工修正法案》是在旨在改善女童教育的重大改革时期之后出台的，特别是通过2009年的教育改革。本文认为，这些改革可能改变了社会对女童教育边际价值的看法，而《童工法》则凸显了农业中童工的危险。这些措施共同可能为减少农村女童劳动创造了更有利的环境。利用Young Lives的面板数据和三重差分法，本研究记录了印度农村女童劳动的显著减少。研究结果强调了将法律改革置于情境中的重要性，并强调需要进行细致评估以更好地理解其异质性结果。

records.title_en: Speaking differently: How dialect affects E-government adoption
records.title_cn: 说不同的语言：方言如何影响电子政务的采纳
records.abstract_en: Leveraging the novel and comprehensive Chinese Business Environment Survey data spanning 2019 to 2023, this paper identifies dialect difference as a significant yet unexplored determinant of electronic government (E-government) services adoption. Our theoretical model posits that dialect-induced language barriers elevate uncertainty about the time (effort) required for successful online administrative interactions, raising the likelihood of procedural failures and thus deterring enterprise engagement with E-government platforms. Exploiting the establishment of the Data Administration Bureau as an exogenous policy shock, we empirically find that, following the intervention, regions predominantly speaking local dialects were 5.1 % less likely to adopt E-government services—equivalent to approximately 5.9 million fewer enterprise users—relative to Mandarin-speaking regions. This effect is significant after controlling for conventional confounding factors such as social networks and cultural clustering, and remains robust across alternative specifications and validation checks. Our findings shed lights on frictions in government digitalization, implying welfare improvements from mitigating dialect-related access constraints.
records.abstract_cn: 利用覆盖2019年至2023年的新颖且全面的中国商业环境调查数据，本文识别出方言差异是电子政府（电子政务）服务采纳的一个显著但尚未探索的决定因素。我们的理论模型认为，方言引起的语言障碍增加了对成功在线行政互动所需时间（努力）的不确定性，提高了程序失败的可能性，从而阻碍了企业参与电子政务平台。利用数据管理局的设立作为外生政策冲击，我们实证发现，在干预之后，主要使用当地方言的地区采纳电子政务服务的可能性比普通话地区低5.1%，相当于减少了约5.9百万企业用户。在控制了诸如社会网络和文化聚类等常规混淆因素后，这一效应仍然显著，并且在替代规格和验证检查中保持稳健。我们的发现揭示了政府数字化中的摩擦，暗示缓解方言相关的访问限制可以带来福利改善。

records.title_en: Melting pot: Linguistic diversity and collaboration
records.title_cn: 熔炉：语言多样性与合作
records.abstract_en: Collaboration is essential for scientific progress, but forming cooperative relationships in multilingual environments is not well understood. Using a unique dataset of Chinese inventors, this study examines how linguistic diversity influences inventor collaboration. We find that inventors in multilingual settings are more likely to collaborate, a result robust to various endogeneity tests and robustness checks. Multilingual environments facilitate collaboration by providing access to heterogeneous knowledge and lowering search costs for collaborators. We also find that promoting a common language (Putonghua) helps mitigate communication barriers in linguistically diverse societies. Further analysis reveals that multilingual environments encourage inventors to expand their collaborative networks primarily by establishing new partnerships without significantly displacing existing collaborations. Moreover, inventors in multilingual environments are more likely to produce high-impact patents, enhancing their companies’ innovation performance. Overall, these findings highlight the advantage multilingual environments provide in combining diverse knowledge and emphasize the importance of reducing search and communication frictions.
records.abstract_cn: 合作对于科学进步至关重要，但在多语言环境中形成合作关系尚未得到充分理解。利用中国发明家的独特数据集，本研究考察了语言多样性如何影响发明家合作。我们发现，在多语言环境中的发明家更有可能进行合作，这一结果在各种内生性检验和稳健性检查中均保持稳健。多语言环境通过提供获取异质性知识的途径和降低合作者的搜索成本来促进合作。我们还发现，推广共同语言（普通话）有助于缓解语言多样性社会中的沟通障碍。进一步分析显示，多语言环境鼓励发明家主要通过建立新的伙伴关系来扩展其合作网络，而不会显著取代现有的合作。此外，多语言环境中的发明家更有可能产生高影响力的专利，从而提升其公司的创新绩效。总体而言，这些发现强调了多语言环境在整合多样化知识方面的优势，并强调了减少搜索和沟通摩擦的重要性。

records.title_en: Hometown favoritism and intra-regional trade barriers under decentralization: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 地方保护主义与分权下的区域内贸易壁垒：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: Decentralization management in inter-jurisdictional contexts requires careful consideration. This article highlights the potential for hometown favoritism to undermine decentralization practices. China established its ambitious social credit system in the highway construction sector in 2009, where local rating agencies are responsible for the grading of firms’ social credit ratings. Using a unique dataset spanning 2010–2022, we find that local firms can achieve higher social credit ratings, helping them meet more bidding requirements. Local firms are less likely to be downgraded, and those with stronger local cultural and economic ties receive higher ratings. Hometown favoritism in credit ratings is particularly pronounced for eponymous firms, less important and lower-quality construction projects, and it varies over time, increasing during periods of poor economic performance. Further evidence suggests that local firms win more bids, although changes in local ratings are less predictive of securing new bids. These findings underscore the previously unexplored role of hometown favoritism in creating trade barriers under decentralization.
records.abstract_cn: 跨辖区背景下的分权管理需要仔细考量。本文强调了地方保护主义可能削弱分权实践的风险。中国于2009年在高速公路建设领域建立了其宏大的社会信用体系，其中地方评级机构负责对企业社会信用评级进行打分。利用覆盖2010-2022年的独特数据集，我们发现本地企业能够获得更高的社会信用评级，从而帮助它们满足更多的投标要求。本地企业被降级的可能性较小，而那些与本地文化和经济联系更紧密的企业则获得更高的评级。信用评级中的地方保护主义在同名企业中尤为显著，对于次要和低质量的建设项目也是如此，并且这种保护主义随时间变化，在经济表现不佳时期有所加剧。进一步的证据表明，本地企业赢得了更多的投标，尽管本地评级的变化对获得新投标的预测能力较弱。这些发现强调了地方保护主义在分权下形成贸易壁垒中此前未被探索的作用。

records.title_en: The impact of a public voucher for the arts
records.title_cn: 公共艺术代金券的影响
records.abstract_en: We provide novel evidence on the impact of a public voucher scheme for cultural consumption. The voucher was introduced in Italy in 2016 for citizens aged 18 years old. We use repeated cross-sections from the annual household survey ‘Aspects of Daily Life’ for the period 2013–2019 and combine Entropy Balancing with Difference-in-Difference estimation to assess the voucher causal effect on cultural consumption. We find a significant impact of the cultural voucher in fostering participation in cinema, non-classic concerts and reading books and online/e-books, with the effect driven by lower SES individuals. Overall, estimated effects suggest a less-than-total crowding out of public resources. The voucher also generated some spillover effects at the household level, and, in the case of cinema, resulted in a sustained higher consumption, even after the financial support terminated.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于公共代金券计划对文化消费影响的新证据。该代金券于2016年在意大利推出，面向年满18岁的公民。我们使用2013-2019年期间年度家庭调查“日常生活方面”的重复横截面数据，结合熵平衡与双重差分估计来评估代金券对文化消费的因果效应。我们发现文化代金券在促进电影、非古典音乐会以及阅读书籍和在线/电子书参与方面具有显著影响，且这一效应由社会经济地位较低的个体驱动。总体而言，估计效应表明公共资源的挤出效应不完全。该代金券还在家庭层面产生了一些溢出效应，并且在电影方面，即使在财政支持终止后，也导致了持续更高的消费水平。

records.title_en: The demand for complete and incomplete punishment institutions to promote cooperation
records.title_cn: 完整与不完整惩罚制度的需求及其促进合作的作用
records.abstract_en: We use an experiment to study the demand for complete and incomplete formal punishment institutions and their ability to promote cooperation. Complete punishment institutions are implemented by the whole group and bind everyone. Incomplete punishment institutions are implemented by a subgroup and bind only the members of this subgroup. We distinguish between strictly incomplete institutions, in which only one subgroup can bind itself while the remaining individuals are unbound, and potentially incomplete institutions, in which two subgroups can bind themselves independently and separately in different institutions, potentially binding everyone. Theoretically, the demand for such formal punishment institutions should depend only on the benefit of cooperation within the group or subgroup bound by the institution. However, we hypothesize and the experimental results confirm that, in the case of incomplete punishment institutions, the benefit of cooperation has a much smaller impact on the demand than in complete punishment institutions. Instead, individuals’ cooperativeness and coordination between the subgroups become important determinants.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过实验研究完整与不完整正式惩罚制度的需求及其促进合作的能力。完整惩罚制度由整个群体实施并约束所有人。不完整惩罚制度由子群体实施，仅约束该子群体的成员。我们区分严格不完整制度，即只有一个子群体可以约束自身，而其余个体不受约束；以及潜在不完整制度，即两个子群体可以在不同制度中独立且分别约束自身，可能约束所有人。理论上，对此类正式惩罚制度的需求应仅取决于制度所约束的群体或子群体内合作的收益。然而，我们假设并通过实验结果证实，在不完整惩罚制度的情况下，合作收益对需求的影响远小于完整惩罚制度。相反，个体的合作性以及子群体之间的协调成为重要决定因素。

records.title_en: House price expectations and household spending— A survey-based experiment
records.title_cn: 房价预期与家庭支出——一项基于调查的实验
records.abstract_en: I conduct a survey-based experiment to study the causal effect of house price expectations on individuals’ spending decisions. In the experiment, respondents are randomly divided into two groups to receive different professional forecasts of house prices. Exploiting this information treatment as an exogenous source of variation in house price expectations, I show that a one percentage point increase in expected nationwide house price growth over the next 12 months leads to about a 0.4 percentage point increase in intended total household spending growth over the same period. I show that this effect is likely driven by an expected increase in housing wealth and that individuals consider the increase in housing wealth as relaxing their borrowing constraints.
records.abstract_cn: 我进行了一项基于调查的实验，以研究房价预期对个人支出决策的因果效应。在实验中，受访者被随机分为两组，接受不同的专业房价预测。利用这一信息处理作为房价预期变化的外生来源，我表明，未来12个月全国房价预期增长率每增加一个百分点，会导致同期家庭总支出预期增长率增加约0.4个百分点。我表明，这一效应很可能由预期住房财富增加所驱动，并且个人将住房财富的增加视为放松其借贷约束。

records.title_en: Why do some nudges work and others not?
records.title_cn: 为什么有些助推有效，而其他的无效？
records.abstract_en: While nudges have recently gained popularity, many nudging interventions fail, and the effects of successful ones are often short-lived. We conjecture that the success of a nudge depends on how it interacts with the underlying economic incentives that determine the payoff-maximizing behavior of the decision-maker. For example, in the domain of tax compliance, a nudge is likely to be effective only if it is financially optimal for the taxpayer to pay the tax. To test our conjecture, we run a multi-period experiment in which we manipulate tax audit probability and nudge participants to report their income. In addition, we vary how often the nudge appears to test whether more frequent nudging increases long-run compliance. We observe that the first application of a nudge has a positive immediate effect on income reporting, irrespective of whether it is optimal to comply or not. However, subsequent nudges increase income reporting only if the nudge is aligned with the taxpayer’s incentives. More frequent nudging in the direction opposite to incentives yields no effects on long-run compliance. Policy implications are discussed.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管助推近年来受到欢迎，但许多助推干预措施未能奏效，且成功干预的效果往往短暂。我们推测，助推的成功取决于其如何与决定决策者最大化收益行为的基础经济激励相互作用。例如，在税收遵从领域，只有当纳税人在财务上最优选择是缴纳税款时，助推才可能有效。为检验我们的推测，我们进行了一项多期实验，操纵税务审计概率并助推参与者报告其收入。此外，我们改变助推出现的频率，以测试更频繁的助推是否能提高长期遵从度。我们观察到，助推的首次应用对收入报告有即时的正向效果，无论遵从是否是最优选择。然而，后续的助推仅在助推与纳税人的激励一致时才会增加收入报告。与激励方向相反的更频繁助推对长期遵从度无效果。讨论了政策含义。

records.title_en: Temporal framing of tax stimuli and household consumption
records.title_cn: 税收刺激和家庭消费的时间框架
records.abstract_en: We conduct a large-scale survey experiment with clients of a major German retail bank to examine whether the temporal framing of a tax stimulus as a permanent positive income shock affects consumption behavior. The income shock derives from the abolishment of the German solidarity surcharge on personal income taxes. Participants are randomly assigned to receive information about their additional disposable income in one of three formats: Euros per month (control), Euros per year (yearly treatment), or Euros per ten-year period (10-yearly treatment). We survey participants before the abolishment of the solidarity surcharge and find a statistically and economically significant impact of temporal framing on the intended use of the tax cut. The yearly and 10-yearly treatment groups’ average intended share of the tax cut for spending is 8.0 and 9.4 percentage points lower and for saving is 5.4 and 6.3 percentage points higher compared to the control group. A follow-up survey, six months after the tax rebate came into effect, reveals that participants largely adhered to their intentions, unless the increase in disposable income was diminished by other regulation changes. Those exposed to the yearly and 10-yearly treatments report having spent 7.0 and 8.4 percentage points less and report having saved 7.7 and 8.2 percentage points more relative to the control group. Treatment effects are particularly pronounced for larger tax cuts and among participants with low financial literacy and low cognitive reflection, who are more susceptible to the temporal framing of the rebate.
records.abstract_cn: 我们对德国一家大型零售银行的客户进行了一项大规模调查实验，以研究税收刺激作为永久性正收入冲击的时间框架是否会影响消费行为。收入冲击源于德国个人所得税团结附加费的取消。参与者被随机分配以三种格式之一接收有关其额外可支配收入的信息：每月欧元（对照）、每年欧元（每年治疗）或每十年欧元（10-每年治疗）。我们在废除团结附加费之前对参与者进行了调查，发现时间框架对减税的预期用途产生了统计上和经济上的重大影响。与对照组相比，每年和10每年的治疗组支出减税的平均预期份额降低了8.0和9.4个百分点，储蓄的平均预期份额提高了5.4和6.3个百分点。退税生效六个月后的一项后续调查显示，参与者基本上坚持了自己的意图，除非可支配收入的增长因其他监管变化而减少。那些接受每年和10每年治疗的人报告说，与对照组相比，花费减少了7.0和8.4个百分点，并报告节省了7.7和8.2个百分点。对于更大规模的减税，以及在金融知识和认知反思较低的参与者中，治疗效果尤其明显，他们更容易受到退税的时间框架的影响。
