As a consequence, her risk preferences need only exhibit betweenness allowing for behavior that can accommodate Allais‐type paradoxes.
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入并分析期望平衡不确定效用（EBUU）理论。一个先验和一个平衡结果集效用刻画了EBUU决策者。以参考值或“平衡值”为条件，后者为每个结果集赋予一个效用。决策者将每个行动与其包络，即包含该行动的从状态到结果集的最小可测映射，联系起来。然后，她（隐含地）根据使其相关包络的期望平衡效用为零的平衡值来对行动排序。因此，她的风险偏好只需表现出中间性，从而允许能够容纳阿莱型悖论的行为。

records.title_en: The hazards and benefits of condescension in social learning
records.title_cn: 社会学习中屈尊的危害与益处
records.abstract_en: In a misspecified social learning setting, agents are condescending if they perceive their peers as having private information that is of lower quality than it is in reality. Applying this to a standard sequential model, we show that outcomes improve when agents are mildly condescending. In contrast, too much condescension leads to worse outcomes, as does anti‐condescension.
records.abstract_cn: 在误设的社会学习环境中，若主体认为同伴拥有质量低于实际情况的私人信息，则他们是屈尊的。将此应用于标准序贯模型，我们表明，当主体轻度屈尊时，结果会得到改善。相反，过度屈尊会导致更差的结果，反屈尊亦然。

records.title_en: Randomized collective choices based on a fractional tournament
records.title_cn: 基于分数锦标赛的随机化集体选择
records.abstract_en: An extension rule assigns to each fractional tournament x (specifying, for every pair of social alternatives a and b , the proportion x ab of voters who prefer a to b ) a random choice function y (specifying a collective choice probability distribution for each subset of alternatives), which chooses a from { a , b } with probability x ab . There exist multiple neutral and stochastically rationalizable extension rules. Both linearity (requiring that y be an affine function of x ) and independence of irrelevant comparisons (asking that the probability distribution on a subset of alternatives depend only on the restriction of the fractional tournament to that subset) are incompatible with very weak properties implied by stochastic rationalizability. We identify a class of maximal domains, which we call sequentially binary , guaranteeing that every fractional tournament arising from a population of voters with preferences in such a domain has a unique admissible stochastically rationalizable extension.
records.abstract_cn: 一个扩展规则将每个分数锦标赛x（指定对于每对社会备选方案a和b，偏好a胜过b的投票者比例x_ab）映射到一个随机选择函数y（指定每个备选方案子集上的集体选择概率分布），该函数以概率x_ab从{a,b}中选择a。存在多个中性且随机理性化的扩展规则。线性性（要求y是x的仿射函数）和无关比较独立性（要求备选方案子集上的概率分布仅取决于分数锦标赛在该子集上的限制）都与随机理性化所隐含的非常弱的性质不相容。我们识别了一类极大域，我们称之为序贯二元，它保证了在这样一个域中具有偏好的投票者群体所产生的每一个分数锦标赛都有唯一一个可行的随机理性化扩展。

records.title_en: Gradual learning from incremental actions
records.title_cn: 从增量行动中逐步学习
records.abstract_en: We introduce a collective experimentation problem where a continuum of agents choose the timing of irreversible actions under uncertainty and where public feedback from the actions arrives gradually over time. The leading application is the adoption of new technologies. The socially optimal expansion path entails an informational trade‐off where acting today speeds up learning but postponing capitalizes on the option value of waiting. We contrast the social optimum to the decentralized equilibrium where agents ignore the social value of information they generate. We show that the equilibrium can be obtained by assuming that agents ignore the future actions of other agents, which lets us recast the complicated two‐dimensional problem as a series of one‐dimensional problems.
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一个集体实验问题，其中连续统的代理人在不确定性下选择不可逆行动的时间，并且来自行动的公共反馈随时间逐渐到达。主要应用是新技术的采用。社会最优扩张路径涉及一种信息权衡：今天行动加速学习，但延迟则利用等待的期权价值。我们将社会最优与分散均衡进行对比，在分散均衡中，代理人忽略他们产生的信息的社会价值。我们表明，该均衡可以通过假设代理人忽略其他代理人的未来行动来获得，这使我们能够将复杂的二维问题重新表述为一系列一维问题。

records.title_en: In the shadow of shadow banking: A liquidity perspective
records.title_cn: 在影子银行的阴影下：流动性视角
records.abstract_en: Liquidity requirements for commercial banks improve risk‐sharing for depositors. Nevertheless, shadow banks, issuing securities with lower liquidity, operate outside such regulatory constraints. In an economy featuring shadow banks with a constant level of liquidity for shadow bank securities, higher liquidity requirements lead to a reduction in aggregate liquidity provision, owing to regulatory arbitrage incentives. Conversely, when the liquidity of shadow bank securities decreases with the market share of shadow banks, the incentive for regulatory arbitrage is reduced and, thus, higher liquidity requirements could enhance aggregate liquidity provision.
records.abstract_cn: 对商业银行的流动性要求改善了储户的风险分担。然而，影子银行发行的证券流动性较低，且不受此类监管约束。在影子银行证券流动性水平恒定的经济体中，由于监管套利激励，更高的流动性要求会导致总体流动性供给减少。相反，当影子银行证券的流动性随影子银行市场份额的增加而下降时，监管套利的激励减弱，因此更高的流动性要求可能增强总体流动性供给。

records.title_en: Reputation building under uncertain monitoring
records.title_cn: 不确定监控下的声誉建立
records.abstract_en: We study the standard reputation model with a long‐run (LR) player facing a sequence of short‐run (SR) opponents, with one difference: the SR players are uncertain about the monitoring structure, while the LR player knows it. We construct examples where the standard reputation result breaks down: Even if there is a possibility that the LR player is a commitment type who always plays the action to which he wants to commit, there exist “bad” equilibria in which the LR player gets payoffs substantially lower than his commitment payoffs. In contrast, if there is the possibility of dynamic commitment types who switch between “signaling” actions that help the SR players learn the monitoring structure and “collection” actions that are desirable for payoffs, our main theorem shows that a sufficiently patient LR player obtains payoffs of at least the commitment payoffs in each state in every equilibrium.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究标准的声誉模型，其中有一个长期（LR）参与人面对一系列短期（SR）对手，但有一个区别：SR参与人不确定监控结构，而LR参与人知道监控结构。我们构造了标准声誉结果失效的例子：即使存在一种可能性，即LR参与人是一个总是采取他想要承诺的行动的承诺类型，也存在“坏”均衡，其中LR参与人获得的收益远低于其承诺收益。相反，如果存在动态承诺类型的可能性，这些类型在帮助SR参与人学习监控结构的“信号”行动和有利于收益的“收集”行动之间切换，我们的主要定理表明，在每一个均衡中，一个足够有耐心的LR参与人在每个状态下获得的收益至少为承诺收益。

records.title_en: Repeated trade with imperfect information about previous transactions
records.title_cn: 关于先前交易的不完美信息下的重复交易
records.abstract_en: This paper studies repeated trade with noisy information about previous transactions. A buyer has private information about his willingness to pay, which is either low or high, and buys goods from different sellers over time. Each seller observes a noisy history of signals about the buyer's previous purchases and sets a price. We compare the cases where previous prices are observable to sellers with the case where they are not. We show that, in both cases, more signal precision is counterbalanced in equilibrium by less separation between types, either because (1) sellers offer discounted prices more often, which are accepted by both types, or (2) the buyer with a high valuation rejects high prices with a higher probability. The effect on welfare and efficiency of making prices observable depends on the signal precision: When the signal is imprecise, making prices public strengthens the discounting mechanism, improving efficiency and buyer welfare; when the signal is precise, making prices public activates the rejection mechanism, and efficiency and buyer welfare may decrease. Independently of price observability, the buyer tends to benefit from a more precise signal about previous purchases.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究在关于先前交易的噪声信息下的重复交易。一个买方拥有关于其支付意愿的私人信息，该意愿要么低要么高，并随时间从不同的卖方购买商品。每个卖方观察到关于买方先前购买行为的带噪声的信号历史，并设定价格。我们比较了先前价格对卖方可观察的情况与不可观察的情况。我们证明，在两种情况下，更多的信号精度在均衡中被类型之间更小的分离所抵消，要么因为（1）卖方更经常提供折扣价格，这些价格被两种类型都接受，要么因为（2）具有高估值的买方以更高概率拒绝高价格。使价格可观察对福利和效率的影响取决于信号精度：当信号不精确时，公开价格加强了折扣机制，提高了效率和买方福利；当信号精确时，公开价格激活了拒绝机制，效率和买方福利可能会下降。与价格可观察性无关，买方往往从关于先前购买的更精确的信号中受益。

records.title_en: Dynamic assignment without money: Optimality of spot mechanisms
records.title_cn: 无货币的动态配置：现货机制的最优性
records.abstract_en: We study a large market model of dynamic matching with no monetary transfers and a continuum of agents who have to be assigned items at each date. When the social planner can only elicit ordinal agents' preferences, we prove that under a mild regularity assumption, incentive compatible and ordinally efficient allocation rules coincide with spot mechanisms. The latter specify “virtual prices” for items at each date and, for each agent, randomly select a budget of virtual money at the beginning of time. When the social planner can elicit cardinal preferences, we prove that under a similar regularity assumption, incentive compatible and Pareto efficient mechanisms coincide with spot menu of random budgets mechanisms. These are similar to spot mechanisms except that, at the beginning of time, each agent chooses within a menu, a distribution over budget of virtual money.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个无货币转移的动态匹配大市场模型，其中有一个连续统的代理人，他们必须在每个日期被分配物品。当社会计划者只能引导代理人的序数偏好时，我们证明在温和的正则性假设下，激励相容且序数有效的配置规则与现货机制重合。后者为每个日期的物品指定“虚拟价格”，并且在初始时间，为每个代理人随机选择一个虚拟货币预算。当社会计划者能够引导基数偏好时，我们证明在类似的正则性假设下，激励相容且帕累托有效的机制与随机预算的现货菜单机制重合。这些机制与现货机制类似，除了在初始时间，每个代理人在一个菜单内选择虚拟货币预算上的一个分布。

records.title_en: On the limitations of data‐based price discrimination
records.title_cn: 论基于数据的价格歧视的局限性
records.abstract_en: The classic third degree price discrimination (3PD) model requires the knowledge of the distribution of buyer valuations and the covariate to set the price conditioned on the covariate. In terms of generating revenue, the classic result shows that 3PD is at least as good as uniform pricing. What if the seller has to set a price based only on a sample of observations from the underlying distribution? Is it still obvious that the seller should engage in 3PD? This paper sheds light on these fundamental questions. In particular, the comparison of the revenue performance between 3PD and uniform pricing is ambiguous overall when prices are set based on samples. This finding is in the nature of statistical learning under uncertainty: a curse of dimensionality, but also other small sample complications.
records.abstract_cn: 经典的三级价格歧视（3PD）模型要求了解买方估值的分布和协变量，以便在给定协变量的条件下设定价格。就产生收入而言，经典结果表明3PD至少与统一定价一样好。如果卖方只能基于来自潜在分布的一个观测样本来设定价格呢？卖方是否仍然显然应该实施3PD？本文阐明了这些基本问题。特别是，当价格基于样本设定时，3PD与统一定价之间的收入表现比较总体上是模糊不清的。这一发现本质上属于不确定性下的统计学习：维度灾难，而且还有其他小样本复杂性问题。

records.title_en: Dynamic economics with quantile preferences
records.title_cn: 分位数偏好下的动态经济学
records.abstract_en: This paper studies a dynamic quantile model for intertemporal decisions under uncertainty, in which the decision maker maximizes the τ ‐quantile of the stream of future utilities, for τ ∈ (0,1). We present two sets of contributions. First, we generalize existing results in directions that are important for applications. In particular, the sets of choices and random shocks are general metric spaces, either connected or finite. Moreover, the future state is not exclusively determined by the agent's choice, but can also be influenced by shocks. Under these generalizations, we establish the principle of optimality, show that the corresponding dynamic problem yields a value function, and under suitable assumptions, this value function is concave and differentiable. Additionally, we derive the corresponding Euler equation. Second, we illustrate the usefulness of this approach by studying two prominent dynamic economics models. The first deals with intertemporal consumption with one asset. We obtain closed‐form expressions for the value function, the optimal asset allocation and consumption, as well as for the consumption path. These closed‐form solutions allow us to obtain useful comparative statics that shed light on how consumption and savings respond to increase in risk aversion, impatience, and interest rates. For the second model, we discuss a quantile‐based version of the job‐search model with uncertainty.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个不确定性下跨期决策的动态分位数模型，其中决策者最大化未来效用流的τ分位数，τ ∈ (0,1)。我们提出两组贡献。首先，我们以对应用重要的方向推广了现有结果。特别地，选择集合和随机冲击是一般度量空间，要么是连通的，要么是有限的。此外，未来状态并非仅由代理人的选择决定，还可能受到冲击的影响。在这些推广下，我们建立了最优性原理，表明相应的动态问题产生一个值函数，并且在适当假设下，该值函数是凹的和可微的。此外，我们推导了相应的欧拉方程。其次，我们通过研究两个著名的动态经济学模型来说明这种方法的实用性。第一个处理具有一种资产的跨期消费。我们获得了值函数、最优资产配置和消费以及消费路径的闭式表达式。这些闭式解使我们能够获得有用的比较静态分析，从而揭示消费和储蓄如何响应风险厌恶、不耐烦和利率的上升。对于第二个模型，我们讨论了基于分位数的带有不确定性的工作搜寻模型版本。

records.title_en: The Hedging Channel of Exchange Rate Determination
records.title_cn: 汇率决定的套期保值渠道
records.abstract_en: We propose the currency hedging channel that connects countries’ external imbalances to their exchange rate behavior. We present a model in which investors increase their currency hedging during periods of financial distress in proportion to their net foreign asset exposure. This behavior coupled with constrained financial intermediation explains observed relationships between gradually adjusting external imbalances and volatile spot and forward exchange rates. We find empirical support for the hedging channel in both the conditional and unconditional moments of exchange rates, option prices, and countries’ uses of Federal Reserve swap lines.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了货币套期保值渠道，该渠道将国家的外部失衡与其汇率行为联系起来。我们提出了一个模型，在该模型中，投资者在金融困境期间根据其净外国资产敞口按比例增加货币套期保值。这种行为加上受限的金融中介，解释了逐渐调整的外部失衡与波动的即期和远期汇率之间观察到的关系。我们在汇率的条件和非条件矩、期权价格以及各国对美联储互换额度的使用中，找到了套期保值渠道的实证支持。

records.title_en: Real Consequences of Shocks to Intermediaries Supplying Corporate Hedging Instruments
records.title_cn: 企业套期保值工具供应中介冲击的实际后果
records.abstract_en: I show that shocks to financial intermediaries supplying hedging instruments to corporations have real effects. I exploit a quasi-natural experiment in South Korea in 2010, where regulations required banks to hold enough capital for taking foreign exchange derivatives (FXD) positions. Using variation in exposure to this regulation across banks, I find that the regulation caused a reduction in FXD supply, leading to a significant decline in exports for firms contracting derivatives with more exposed banks. Results indicate the crucial role of intermediaries in allocating risks through derivatives provision and establish a causal relationship between financial hedging and real economic outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 我展示了向企业提供套期保值工具的金融中介所受到的冲击具有实际效应。我利用了韩国在2010年的一项准自然实验，当时法规要求银行在持有外汇衍生品头寸时保持足够的资本。利用不同银行对该法规暴露程度的差异，我发现该法规导致了外汇衍生品供应的减少，进而使得与暴露程度较高的银行签订衍生品合约的企业出口显著下降。结果表明，中介在通过衍生品供应分配风险中扮演关键角色，并确立了金融套期保值与实际经济结果之间的因果关系。

records.title_en: Long-Term Investors, Demand Shifts, and Yields
records.title_cn: 长期投资者、需求变动与收益率
records.abstract_en: I exploit a Dutch reform in the regulatory discount curve that makes the liabilities of pension funds and insurance companies (P&Is) more sensitive to changes in 20-year interest rates but less so to longer maturity rates. Following the reform, P&Is reduced their longest maturity bond holdings but increased those with 20-year maturities, steepening the long end of the yield curve. Using the reform as a shock to identify price elasticities of demand at the sector level based on holdings across maturity buckets and time, I show that banks are more price elastic than other investors and absorb demand shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 我利用荷兰监管贴现曲线的改革，该改革使得养老金和保险公司的负债对20年期利率的变化更为敏感，而对更长期限利率的敏感度降低。改革后，养老金和保险公司减少了最长期限的债券持有，但增加了20年期债券的持有，从而陡化了收益率曲线的长端。利用该改革作为冲击，基于不同期限区间和时间的持有量来识别部门层面的需求价格弹性，我表明银行比其他投资者更具价格弹性，并吸收了需求冲击。

records.title_en: Duration-Based Valuation of Corporate Bonds
records.title_cn: 基于久期的公司债券估值
records.abstract_en: We decompose corporate bond and equity index returns into duration-matched government bond returns and the excess returns over this duration-matched counterfactual, which we term duration-adjusted returns. Compared with previously used excess return definitions (ie, returns in excess of Treasury bills), our decomposition leads to markedly different return patterns and asset pricing implications. In particular, we find that investment-grade bonds earn a small credit risk premium, comparable in magnitude to the convenience yield, and that duration adjustment resolves the CAPM’s failure to price corporate bonds. These findings highlight the importance of adjusting for nonstationary interest rate environments in asset pricing tests.
records.abstract_cn: 我们将公司债券和股票指数回报分解为久期匹配的政府债券回报以及相对于这一久期匹配反事实的超额回报，我们称之为久期调整回报。与先前使用的超额回报定义（即相对于国库券的回报）相比，我们的分解导致了显著不同的回报模式和资产定价含义。特别是，我们发现投资级债券赚取较小的信用风险溢价，其规模与便利收益相当，并且久期调整解决了CAPM无法对公司债券定价的问题。这些发现强调了在资产定价测试中调整非平稳利率环境的重要性。

records.title_en: Capital Investment, Equity Returns, and Aggregate Dynamics in Oligopolistic Production Economies
records.title_cn: 寡头垄断生产经济体中的资本投资、股票收益与总体动态
records.abstract_en: We analyze effects of tacit collusion in a dynamic general equilibrium model of oligopolistic sectors with capital investment and real frictions. Through their effects on equilibrium- and off-equilibrium stock prices, fundamental shocks affect incentives for defection from tacit collusion, amplifying the interaction between the real economy and financial markets as well as firms’ risk exposure. The model implies ambiguous relationship between industry concentration and equity returns depending on operating leverage, which helps reconcile conflicting evidence in the literature. We find quantitative and empirical support for novel theoretical predictions regarding the effects of concentration on returns and investment.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个具有资本投资和实际摩擦的寡头垄断部门动态一般均衡模型中分析了默契合谋的影响。通过其对均衡和非均衡股票价格的影响，基本面冲击影响了对默契合谋背叛的激励，放大了实体经济与金融市场之间的相互作用以及企业的风险暴露。该模型暗示行业集中度与股票收益之间的关系取决于经营杠杆，这有助于调和文献中的矛盾证据。我们为关于集中度对收益和投资影响的新颖理论预测找到了数量和经验上的支持。

records.title_en: Dynamic Market Making with Asymmetric Information and Market Power
records.title_cn: 不对称信息与市场力量下的动态做市
records.abstract_en: We study the dynamics of trading volume and bid-ask spread using a multiperiod trading model with oligopolistic market makers. Traders smooth out their trading even though they are not strategic, and thus trading persists after the arrival of information or liquidity shocks. Traders act quickly on their private information while postponing hedging trades until later periods. The market power of market makers enables them to widen bid-ask spreads when trading incentives are heightened. Consequently, both trading volume and bid-ask spread may exhibit U-shaped patterns. Our model calibration aligns with the empirical intraday patterns observed in bid-ask spreads and trading volumes. (JEL D53, D61, D82, G12, G14, G18)
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过一个具有寡头做市商的多期交易模型研究交易量和买卖价差的动态变化。交易者即使不是策略性的，也会平滑其交易，因此交易在信息或流动性冲击到达后持续存在。交易者迅速利用其私人信息行动，而将对冲交易推迟到后期。做市商的市场力量使他们能够在交易激励增强时扩大买卖价差。因此，交易量和买卖价差都可能呈现U型模式。我们的模型校准与观察到的买卖价差和交易量的日内经验模式一致。(JEL D53, D61, D82, G12, G14, G18)

records.title_en: The Brand Premium
records.title_cn: 品牌溢价
records.abstract_en: We highlight the limitations of using cumulative advertising expenses as an input measure of brand value. Using two output measures—Interbrand’s data and a novel text-based measure—we find that an equal-weighted portfolio of top brands yields an annual abnormal return of 3%. The excess returns are driven by companies that develop their brands internally. Intangible factors proposed in the literature have no explanatory power for the premium. Analysts underestimate the future earnings of top brands, leading to significant excess returns following earnings announcements. We find no abnormal returns associated with the input measure of brand value. (JEL G4, G12, G14, M41)
records.abstract_cn: 我们强调了使用累计广告费用作为品牌价值投入指标的局限性。采用两种产出指标——Interbrand的数据和一种新颖的基于文本的度量——我们发现，顶级品牌等权重投资组合的年化异常回报率为3%。超额回报由内部开发品牌的公司驱动。文献中提出的无形因素对溢价没有解释力。分析师低估了顶级品牌的未来收益，导致盈利公告后出现显著的超额回报。我们发现与品牌价值投入指标相关的异常回报不存在。(JEL G4, G12, G14, M41)

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Immigration Lottery Design: Engineered and Coincidental Consequences of H-1B Reforms
records.title_cn: 移民抽签设计：H-1B改革的工程化与巧合性后果
records.abstract_en: The H-1B Visa Reform Act of 2004 dictates an annual allocation of 85,000 visas with 20,000 reserved for advanced-degree applicants. We represent the main requirements of this legislation as formal axioms and characterize visa allocation rules consistent with the axioms. Despite the precise number reserved, we show that the range of implementations satisfying these axioms can change the allocation of advanced-degree visas by as much as 14,000 in an average year. Of all rules satisfying these axioms, the 2019 rule imposed by executive order is most favorable to advanced-degree holders. However, two earlier modifications resulted in larger changes, possibly unintentionally.
records.abstract_cn: 《2004年H-1B签证改革法案》规定每年分配85,000个签证，其中20,000个预留给高级学位申请人。我们将该立法的主要要求表示为形式化公理，并刻画符合这些公理的签证分配规则。尽管预留了精确的数量，我们表明满足这些公理的实施方案范围在平均年份中可使高级学位签证的分配变化多达14,000个。在所有满足这些公理的规则中，2019年通过行政命令实施的规则对高级学位持有者最为有利。然而，两次更早的修改导致了更大的变化，这可能是无意为之的。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: The Intellectual Spoils of War? Defense R&D, Productivity, and International Spillovers
records.title_cn: 战争的知识战利品？国防研发、生产率与国际溢出效应
records.abstract_en: We examine the impact of government funding for R&D—and defense-related R&D in particular—on privately conducted R&D and its ultimate effect on productivity growth. We estimate longitudinal models that relate privately funded R&D to lagged government-funded R&D using industry-country level data from OECD countries and firm level data from France. To deal with the potentially endogenous allocation of government R&D funds, we use changes in predicted defense R&D as an instrumental variable. In many OECD countries, expenditures for defense-related R&D represent by far the most important form of public subsidies for innovation. In both datasets, we uncover evidence of “crowding in” rather than “crowding out,” as increases in government-funded R&D for an industry or a firm result in significant increases in private sector R&D in that industry or firm. On average, a 10% increase in government-financed R&D generates a 5% to 6% additional increase in privately funded R&D. We also find evidence of international spillovers, as increases in government-funded R&D in a particular industry and country raise private R&D in the same industry in other countries. Finally, we find that increases in private R&D induced by increases in defense R&D result in productivity gains.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了政府研发资金——特别是国防相关研发——对私人研发的影响及其对生产率增长的最终效应。我们使用来自OECD国家的行业-国家层面数据和法国的企业层面数据，估计了将私人资助研发与滞后的政府资助研发联系起来的纵向模型。为了处理政府研发资金可能存在的内生性分配问题，我们使用预测的国防研发变化作为工具变量。在许多OECD国家，国防相关研发支出是公共创新补贴中迄今为止最重要的形式。在这两个数据集中，我们发现了“挤入”而非“挤出”的证据，因为政府资助研发的增加会导致该行业或企业的私人部门研发显著增加。平均而言，政府资助研发增加10%会带来私人资助研发额外增加5%至6%。我们还发现了国际溢出效应的证据，即特定行业和国家的政府资助研发增加会提高其他国家同行业的私人研发。最后，我们发现由国防研发增加所引致的私人研发增加会带来生产率收益。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: The Impact of Covid-19 on Productivity
records.title_cn: Covid-19 对生产力的影响
records.abstract_en: We analyze the impact of Covid-19 on productivity using data from an innovative monthly firm survey that asks for quantitative impacts of Covid-19 on inputs and outputs. We find that total factor productivity (TFP) fell by up to 6% during 2020–2021. The overall impact combined large reductions in ‘within-firm’ productivity, with offsetting positive ‘between-firm’ effects as less productive sectors, and less productive firms within them, contracted. Despite these large pandemic effects, firms’ post-Covid forecasts imply surprisingly little lasting impact on aggregate TFP. We also see significant heterogeneity over firms and sectors, with the greatest impacts in those requiring extensive in-person activity.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用一项创新性月度公司调查的数据分析了 Covid-19 对生产力的影响，该调查要求了解 Covid-19 对投入和产出的定量影响。我们发现，2020-2021期间全要素生产率（TFP）下降了6%。总体影响包括“公司内部”生产率的大幅下降，以及生产率较低的部门及其内部生产率较低的企业收缩所抵消的“公司间”积极影响。尽管有这些巨大的流行病影响，但令人惊讶的是，企业在新冠疫情后的预测表明，对总 TFP 的持久影响微乎其微。我们还看到不同公司和行业存在显着的异质性，其中影响最大的是那些需要大量面对面活动的行业。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Racial Segregation in Housing Markets and the Erosion of Black Wealth
records.title_cn: 住房市场中的种族隔离与黑人财富的侵蚀
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how the expansion of segregated neighborhoods eroded black wealth in prewar American cities. Using a novel sample of matched addresses, we find that over a single decade rental prices soared by roughly 50% on city blocks that transitioned from all white to majority black. Meanwhile, pioneering black families paid a 28% premium to buy a home on a majority white block, after which their homes lost 10% of their value. These findings strongly suggest that segregated housing markets cost black families much of the gains associated with moving north during the Great Migration.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了战前美国城市中隔离社区的扩张如何侵蚀了黑人财富。利用一个新颖的匹配地址样本，我们发现，在仅仅十年间，从全白人转变为黑人占多数的城市街区，租金价格飙升了约50%。与此同时，先驱黑人家庭在购买白人占多数的街区房屋时支付了28%的溢价，之后他们的房屋价值损失了10%。这些发现强烈表明，隔离的住房市场使黑人家庭失去了大迁徙期间北迁所获得的大部分收益。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: On the Economic Consequences of Mass Shootings
records.title_cn: 论大规模枪击事件的经济后果
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we investigate the economic consequences of mass shootings. We find that shootings have negative effects on targeted counties’ economies. Estimates using three different comparison groups yield similar results. Examining the mechanisms, we find that residents of targeted areas: (i) develop pessimistic views of financial and local business conditions; and (ii) are more likely to report poor mental health, which hinders usual activities such as work, suggesting that shootings lead to decreases in productivity. Further, we find that greater national media coverage of shootings exacerbates their local economic consequences.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究了大规模枪击事件的经济后果。我们发现枪击事件对目标县的经济有负面影响。使用三个不同比较组的估计结果相似。通过考察机制，我们发现目标地区的居民：（i）对金融和当地商业状况形成悲观看法；（ii）更可能报告心理健康状况不佳，这妨碍了如工作等日常活动，表明枪击事件导致生产力下降。此外，我们发现全国媒体对枪击事件的更多报道加剧了其当地经济后果。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: What Happens to Workers at Firms that Automate?
records.title_cn: 企业自动化对工人有何影响？
records.abstract_en: We estimate the impact of firm-level automation on individual worker outcomes by combining Dutch microdata with a direct measure of automation expenditures covering all private nonfinancial sector firms. Using a novel difference-in-differences event-study design leveraging lumpy investment, we find that automation increases the probability of incumbent workers separating from their employers. Workers experience a five-year cumulative wage income loss of 9% of one year’s earnings, driven by decreases in days worked. These adverse impacts of automation are larger in smaller firms, and for older and middle-educated workers. By contrast, no such losses are found for firms’ investments in computers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过将荷兰微观数据与覆盖所有私营非金融部门企业的自动化支出直接度量相结合，估计了企业层面自动化对个体工人结果的影响。利用一种新颖的、基于块状投资的双重差分事件研究设计，我们发现自动化增加了在职工人与雇主分离的概率。工人经历五年累计工资收入损失，相当于一年收入的9%，这主要是由于工作天数减少所致。自动化的这些不利影响在较小企业中更为显著，且对年长和中等教育水平的工人影响更大。相比之下，企业在计算机上的投资并未发现此类损失。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Deleting a Signal: Evidence from Pre-employment Credit Checks
records.title_cn: 删除信号：来自雇佣前信用检查的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the removal of information from a market, such as a job-applicant screening tool. We characterize how removal harms groups with relative advantage in that information: typically those for whom the banned information is most precise relative to alternative signals. We illustrate this using recent bans on employers’ use of credit report data. Bans decrease job-finding rates for Black job-seekers by 3 percentage points and increase involuntary separations for Black new hires by 4 percentage points, primarily because other screening tools, such as interviews, have around 60% higher standard deviation of signal noise for Black relative to white job-seekers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了从市场中移除信息（如求职者筛选工具）的影响。我们刻画了这种移除如何损害在该信息上具有相对优势的群体：通常是那些被禁止的信息相对于替代信号对其更为精确的群体。我们利用近期对雇主使用信用报告数据的禁令来说明这一点。禁令使黑人求职者的就业率降低了3个百分点，并使黑人新员工的非自愿离职率增加了4个百分点，这主要是因为其他筛选工具（如面试）对黑人求职者的信号噪声标准差相对于白人求职者高出约60%。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Do Export Support Programs Affect Prices, Quality, Markups, and Marginal Costs? Evidence From a Natural Policy Experiment
records.title_cn: 出口支持计划是否影响价格、质量、加成率和边际成本？来自自然政策实验的证据
records.abstract_en: Firms’ success in international markets depends on their product’s quality, prices, markups, and marginal cost. However, causally identified empirical evidence for the effect of trade policies that address nontariff barriers on these mechanisms is rare. To fill this gap, we exploit a quasinatural experiment in Denmark and examine the effects of an export support policy aimed at reducing nontariff barriers to trade. We find that export support raises firm-level exports within markets. However, export support does not affect prices, quality, markups, or marginal costs. Instead, the results support trade theory predicting that firms grow in export markets by shifting demand.
records.abstract_cn: 企业在国际市场上的成功取决于其产品的质量、价格、加成率和边际成本。然而，针对解决非关税壁垒的贸易政策对这些机制影响的因果识别经验证据却很少。为填补这一空白，我们利用丹麦的一项准自然实验，考察了一项旨在减少非关税贸易壁垒的出口支持政策的效果。我们发现，出口支持提高了企业在市场内的出口水平。然而，出口支持并不影响价格、质量、加成率或边际成本。相反，结果支持了贸易理论中关于企业通过转移需求在出口市场增长的预测。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Getting the Price Right? The Impact of Competitive Bidding in the Medicare Program
records.title_cn: 定价合理吗？医疗保险计划中竞争性招标的影响
records.abstract_en: We study Medicare’s competitive bidding program for durable medical equipment. We use Medicare claims data to examine the effect on prices and utilization, focusing on continuous positive airway pressure devices for sleep apnea. We find that spending falls by 47.2% after a highly imperfect bidding mechanism is introduced. This is almost entirely driven by a 44.8% price reduction, though quantities also fall by 4.3%. To disentangle supply and demand, we leverage differential cost sharing across Medicare recipients. We measure a demand elasticity of -0.272 and find that quantity reductions are concentrated among less clinically appropriate groups.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了医疗保险对耐用医疗设备的竞争性招标计划。我们使用医疗保险索赔数据来检验其对价格和利用率的影响，重点关注睡眠呼吸暂停的持续气道正压通气设备。我们发现，在引入一个高度不完善的招标机制后，支出下降了47.2%。这几乎完全是由44.8%的价格下降驱动的，尽管数量也下降了4.3%。为了区分供给和需求，我们利用了医疗保险受益人间不同的成本分担。我们测得的需弹性为-0.272，并发现数量减少主要集中在临床适宜性较差的群体中。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Communicating through Defaults
records.title_cn: 通过默认选项进行沟通
records.abstract_en: We report the results of two laboratory experiments and a representative survey that investigate how default effects are shaped by information asymmetries and strategic incentives. We document that defaults are more informative when the interests of default setters and decision makers are more closely aligned. Decision makers’ propensity to accept defaults depends, both, on the alignment of interests and the quality of their information. In a second experiment, we demonstrate that decision makers are more likely to follow defaults than to accept (equally informative) advice. Complementary evidence from a representative survey underlines that consumers commonly perceive defaults as being set strategically.
records.abstract_cn: 我们报告了两个实验室实验和一项代表性调查的结果，这些实验和调查研究了信息不对称和战略激励如何影响默认效应。我们记录到，当默认选项设置者和决策者的利益更加一致时，默认选项更具信息性。决策者接受默认选项的倾向既取决于利益的一致性，也取决于他们信息的质量。在第二个实验中，我们证明决策者更可能遵循默认选项，而不是接受（同样信息丰富的）建议。一项代表性调查的补充证据强调，消费者通常认为默认选项是战略性地设置的。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Borrowing in an Illegal Market: Contracting with Loan Sharks
records.title_cn: 非法市场中的借贷：与高利贷者的契约
records.abstract_en: Using over 11,000 unlicensed loans to over 1,000 borrowers in Singapore, we provide basic information about an understudied market: illegal moneylending. Borrowers and lenders interact frequently and rely primarily on relational contracts to enforce their agreements. Borrowers have high discount rates, often have gambling and/or substance abuse problems, and often repay late. While lenders sometimes resort to nonfinancial punishments, the primary cost of late repayment is the compounding of a very high interest rate. Consistent with our view that lenders cannot extract all surplus, a crackdown on illegal lending raised interest rates and lowered the size of loans.
records.abstract_cn: 利用新加坡超过11,000笔未注册贷款和超过1,000名借款人的数据，我们提供了关于一个研究不足的市场——非法放贷——的基本信息。借款人和放贷人频繁互动，主要依赖关系契约来执行他们的协议。借款人有较高的折现率，常常有赌博和/或药物滥用问题，并且经常逾期还款。虽然放贷人有时会诉诸非经济惩罚，但逾期还款的主要成本是极高利率的复利。与我们认为放贷人无法提取全部剩余的观点一致，对非法放贷的打击提高了利率并降低了贷款规模。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: What Is the Active Prevalence of COVID-19?
records.title_cn: COVID-19的活跃患病率是多少？
records.abstract_en: We provide a method to track the active prevalence of COVID-19 in real time, correcting for time-varying sample selection in symptom-based testing data and incomplete tracking of recovered cases and fatalities. Our method only requires publicly available data on positive testing rates in combination with one parameter, which we estimate based on a representative randomized sample of nearly 10,000 individuals tested in Utah in May and June 2020. We validate our method using external studies in Indiana in April 2020 and two counties in Utah in March 2021. In all three locations and times, our estimates of latent prevalence are within the 95 percent confidence intervals of prevalence estimates from randomized testing. Applying our method to all 50 states, we show that true prevalence is 2–3 times higher than publicly reported.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一种实时追踪COVID-19活跃患病率的方法，该方法校正了基于症状检测数据中的时变样本选择问题，以及对康复病例和死亡病例追踪不完整的问题。我们的方法仅需要公开可得的阳性检测率数据，并结合一个参数，该参数我们基于2020年五月和六月在犹他州对近10,000人进行的代表性随机样本进行估计。我们使用2020年四月印第安纳州和2021年三月犹他州两个县的外部研究验证了我们的方法。在所有三个地点和时间点，我们对潜在患病率的估计均落在随机检测患病率估计的95%置信区间内。将我们的方法应用于所有50个州，我们发现真实患病率是公开报告数字的2-3倍。

records.title_en: Labour Market Screening and the Design of Social Insurance: An Equilibrium Analysis of the Labour Market for the Disabled
records.title_cn: 劳动力市场筛选与社会保险设计：残疾人劳动力市场的均衡分析
records.abstract_en: This article studies how firms’ screening incentives in the labour market affect the optimal design of social insurance programs and quantitatively assesses the U.S. disability policies accounting for firms’ screening of the disabled. We develop an equilibrium search model where workers with different productivities have heterogeneous preferences over non-wage benefits and firms cannot offer an employment contract that explicitly depends on worker types. In this environment, firms may use contracts to screen out a certain type of workers, distorting employment rates and contracts in equilibrium. Therefore, the optimal structure of social insurance policies depends on firms’ screening incentives. We extend and structurally estimate this framework to quantitatively understand the inefficiencies arising from firms’ incentives to screen out disabled workers and examine the optimal joint design of disability insurance (DI) and various forms of firm subsidies. We find that hiring subsidies mitigate screening distortions; at the same time, they interact with DI by reducing the labour supply disincentives it generates. The optimal policy structure leads to a considerable welfare gain by simultaneously making firm subsidies and DI benefits more generous.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了企业在劳动力市场上的筛选激励如何影响社会保险计划的优化设计，并定量评估了美国残疾政策中企业对残疾人筛选的影响。我们开发了一个均衡搜索模型，其中不同生产率的工人对非工资福利有不同的偏好，并且公司不能提供明确取决于工人类型的雇佣合同。在这种环境下，企业可能会利用合同来筛选某种类型的工人，从而扭曲就业率和合同的均衡状态。因此，社会保险政策的最优结构取决于企业的筛选激励。我们对这个框架进行了扩展和结构性估计，以定量理解企业筛选残疾工人的激励措施所带来的低效率，并研究残疾保险（DI）和各种形式的企业补贴的最佳联合设计。我们发现，招聘补贴可以缓解筛选扭曲；与此同时，它们通过减少直接投资产生的劳动力供应抑制因素来与直接投资互动。最优的政策结构通过同时使企业补贴和直接投资福利更加慷慨而带来可观的福利收益。

records.title_en: Optimal Allocation via Waitlists: Simplicity Through Information Design
records.title_cn: 通过候补名单进行优化分配：通过信息设计实现简单化
records.abstract_en: We study non-monetary markets where objects that arrive over time are allocated to unit-demand agents with private types, such as in the allocation of public housing or deceased-donor organs. An agent’s value for an object is supermodular in her type and the object quality, and her payoff is her value minus her waiting cost. The social planner’s objective is a weighted sum of allocative efficiency (i.e. the sum of values) and welfare (i.e. the sum of payoffs). We identify optimal mechanisms in the class of direct-revelation mechanisms. When the social planner can design the information disclosed to the agents about the objects, the optimal mechanism has a simple implementation: a first-come first-served waitlist with deferrals. In this implementation, the object qualities are partitioned into intervals; only the interval containing the object quality is disclosed to agents. When the planner places a higher weight on welfare, optimal disclosure policies become coarser.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究非货币市场，其中随着时间的推移到达的物体被分配给具有私人类型的单位需求代理，例如公共住房或已故捐赠器官的分配。代理对对象的价值在她的类型和对象质量上是超模块化的，她的回报是她的价值减去她的等待成本。社会规划者的目标是配置效率（即价值之和）和福利（即收益之和）的加权和。我们在直接揭示机制类别中确定了最佳机制。当社会规划者可以设计向代理披露有关对象的信息时，最佳机制有一个简单的实现：一个第一-来第一服务的带有延期的候补名单。在此实现中，对象质量被划分为区间；仅向代理公开包含对象质量的区间。当规划者对福利给予更高的重视时，最优披露政策就会变得更加粗糙。

records.title_en: Inefficient Automation
records.title_cn: 自动化效率低下
records.abstract_en: How should the government respond to automation? We study this question in a heterogeneous agent model that takes worker displacement seriously. We recognize that displaced workers face two frictions in practice: reallocation is slow and borrowing is limited. We analyze a second best problem where the government can tax automation but lacks redistributive tools to fully alleviate borrowing frictions. The equilibrium is (constrained) inefficient and automation is excessive. Firms do not internalize that automation depresses the income of automated workers early on during the transition, precisely when they become borrowing constrained. The government finds it optimal to slow down automation on efficiency grounds, even when it does not value equity. Quantitatively, the optimal speed of automation is considerably lower than at the laissez-faire. The optimal policy improves efficiency and delivers meaningful welfare gains.
records.abstract_cn: 政府应如何应对自动化？我们在一个认真考虑工人流失的异构代理模型中研究这个问题。我们认识到，失业工人在实践中面临二摩擦：重新分配缓慢且借贷有限。我们分析了一个最佳问题，即政府可以对自动化征税，但缺乏再分配工具来充分缓解借贷摩擦。这种平衡是（受限的）低效且自动化过度。企业并没有意识到，在转型初期，即当他们的借贷受到限制时，自动化会压低自动化工人的收入。政府认为，即使政府并不重视公平，但出于效率的考虑，放慢自动化速度是最佳选择。从数量上来说，自动化的最佳速度比自由放任的速度要低得多。最优政策可以提高效率并带来有意义的福利收益。

records.title_en: Private Sector Provision as an “Escape Valve”: The Mexico Diabetes Experiment
records.title_cn: 私营部门提供的“逃生阀”：墨西哥糖尿病实验
records.abstract_en: Public health systems are dominant in much of the world but often face fiscal constraints that lead to rationing of care. As a result, private sector healthcare providers could in theory beneficially supplement public systems, but evaluating the benefits of private alternatives has been challenging. We evaluate a private supplement to the free public health system for one of the world’s deadliest health problems, diabetes. We estimate enormous impacts of the private supplement, increasing the share of those treated who are under control by 69%. This effect arises through both improved treatment compliance and health behavior. We find diabetes complications fall in the short run, and that the net costs of this intervention are one-third of the gross costs. The returns to private care do not appear to reflect more productive delivery but rather more attachment to medical care, offering lessons for improving the public system.
records.abstract_cn: 公共卫生系统在世界大部分地区占主导地位，但经常面临导致护理配给的财政限制。因此，理论上，私营部门的医疗保健提供者可以有益地补充公共系统，但评估私营替代方案的好处一直具有挑战性。我们评估了对免费公共卫生系统的私人补充，以解决一世界上最致命的健康问题——糖尿病。我们估计私人补助的巨大影响，增加了受69%控制的治疗者的比例。这种效果是通过改善治疗依从性和健康行为而产生的。我们发现糖尿病并发症在短期内会下降，并且这种干预措施的净成本是总成本的一-第三。私人医疗保健的回报似乎并不反映生产效率更高，而是反映了人们对医疗保健的更多依恋，为改善公共系统提供了经验教训。

records.title_en: Adaptive Estimation and Uniform Confidence Bands for Nonparametric Structural Functions and Elasticities
records.title_cn: 非参数结构函数和弹性的自适应估计和均匀置信带
records.abstract_en: We introduce two data-driven procedures for optimal estimation and inference in nonparametric models using instrumental variables. The first is a data-driven choice of sieve dimension for a popular class of sieve two-stage least-squares estimators. When implemented with this choice, estimators of both the structural function h0 and its derivatives (such as elasticities) converge at the fastest possible (i.e. minimax) rates in sup-norm. The second is for constructing uniform confidence bands (UCBs) for h0 and its derivatives. Our UCBs guarantee coverage over a generic class of data-generating processes and contract at the minimax rate, possibly up to a logarithmic factor. As such, our UCBs are asymptotically more efficient than UCBs based on the usual approach of undersmoothing. As an application, we estimate the elasticity of the intensive margin of firm exports in a monopolistic competition model of international trade. Simulations illustrate the good performance of our procedures in empirically calibrated designs. Our results provide evidence against common parameterizations of the distribution of unobserved firm heterogeneity.
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入二数据驱动程序，使用工具变量在非参数模型中进行最佳估计和推理。 第一 是一种数据驱动的筛维选择，适用于流行的筛 二 级最小二乘估计器。当使用这种选择实现时，结构函数 h0 及其导数（例如弹性）的估计量以超范数中最快的可能（即极小极大）速率收敛。 第二 用于构建 h0 及其导数的统一置信带 (UCB)。我们的 UCB 保证覆盖一类通用的数据生成过程，并以最小最大速率（可能高达对数因子）进行合同。因此，我们的 UCB 渐近比基于通常的欠平滑方法的 UCB 更有效。作为一个应用，我们估计了国际贸易垄断竞争模型中企业出口集约边际的弹性。模拟说明了我们的程序在经验校准设计中的良好性能。我们的结果提供了反对未观察到的企业异质性分布的常见参数化的证据。

records.title_en: Information Spillovers and Sovereign Debt: Theory Meets the Eurozone Crisis
records.title_cn: 信息溢出和主权债务：理论与欧元区危机的结合
records.abstract_en: We develop a theory of information spillovers in sovereign bond markets in which investors can learn about default risk before trading in primary and secondary markets. If primary markets are structured as multi-unit discriminatory-price auctions, an endogenous winner’s curse leads to strategic complementarities in information acquisition. Shocks to default risk in one country may trigger crisis episodes with widespread information acquisition, sharp increases in the level and volatility of yields in risky countries, low and stable yields in safe countries, market segmentation, and arbitrage profits between primary and secondary markets. These predictions are consistent with the dynamics of auction informativeness during the Eurozone Sovereign Debt Crisis, which we measure using the reaction of secondary market yields to primary market yields.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了主权债券市场的信息溢出理论，投资者可以在一级和二级市场交易之前了解违约风险。如果一级市场的结构是多单位歧视性价格拍卖，那么内生的赢家诅咒就会导致信息获取方面的战略互补。 一国家违约风险冲击可能引发危机事件，信息获取广泛，风险国家收益率水平和波动性急剧上升，安全国家收益率低而稳定，市场分割，一级市场和二级市场套利利润增加。这些预测与欧元区主权债务危机期间拍卖信息的动态一致，我们使用二级市场收益率对一级市场收益率的反应来衡量。

records.title_en: Partially Linear Models under Data Combination
records.title_cn: 数据组合下的部分线性模型
records.abstract_en: We study partially linear models when the outcome of interest and some of the covariates are observed in two different datasets that cannot be linked. This type of data combination problem arises very frequently in empirical microeconomics. Using recent tools from optimal transport theory, we derive a constructive characterization of the sharp identified set. We then build on this result and develop a novel inference method that exploits the specific geometric properties of the identified set. Our method exhibits good performances in finite samples, while remaining very tractable. We apply our approach to study intergenerational income mobility over the period 1850–1930 in the U.S. Our method allows us to relax the exclusion restrictions used in earlier work, while delivering confidence regions that are informative.
records.abstract_cn: 当在二无法链接的不同数据集中观察到感兴趣的结果和一些协变量时，我们研究部分线性模型。这类数据组合问题在实证微观经济学中经常出现。使用最优传输理论中的最新工具，我们得出了尖锐识别集的建设性表征。然后，我们在此结果的基础上开发了一种新颖的推理方法，该方法利用已识别集的特定几何属性。我们的方法在有限样本中表现出良好的性能，同时保持非常易于处理。我们应用我们的方法来研究美国1850-1930期间的代际收入流动性。我们的方法使我们能够放宽早期工作中使用的排除限制，同时提供信息丰富的置信区域。

records.title_en: Too Domestic to Fail: Liquidity Provision and National Champions
records.title_cn: 过于国内而不能倒闭：流动性供应和国家冠军
records.abstract_en: Authorities’ support policies shape the location and continuation of industrial and banking activity on their soil. Firms’ locus of activity depends on their prospect of receiving financial assistance in distress and therefore on factors such as countries’ relative resilience. We predict that global firms are global in life and national in death; and that they become less global when competition is more intense, times are turbulent, and international risk sharing (say, through swap lines) weak. We analyse the competitive benefits of industrial and banking policies as well as their limitations, such as currency appreciation.
records.abstract_cn: 当局的支持政策决定了工业和银行活动在其土地上的位置和持续性。企业的活动地点取决于它们在困境中获得财政援助的前景，因此也取决于国家的相对弹性等因素。我们预测，跨国公司生时是全球性的，死时是全国性的；当竞争更加激烈、时代动荡、国际风险分担（例如通过互换额度）薄弱时，它们的全球化程度就会降低。我们分析工业和银行政策的竞争优势及其局限性，例如货币升值。

records.title_en: The Climate in Climate Economics
records.title_cn: 气候经济学中的气候
records.abstract_en: To analyse climate change mitigation strategies, economists rely on simplified climate models—so-called climate emulators—that provide a realistic quantitative link between CO2 emissions and global warming at low computational costs. In this paper, we propose a generic and transparent calibration and evaluation strategy for these climate emulators that are based on freely and easily accessible state-of-the-art benchmark data from climate sciences. We demonstrate that the appropriate choice of the free model parameters can be of key relevance for the predicted social cost of carbon. The key idea we put forward is to calibrate the simplified climate models to benchmark data from comprehensive global climate models that took part in the coupled model intercomparison project, phase 5 (CMIP5). In particular, we propose to use four different test cases that are considered pivotal in the climate science literature: two highly idealized tests to separately calibrate and evaluate the carbon cycle and temperature response, an idealized test to quantify the transient climate response, and a final test to evaluate the performance for scenarios close to those arising from economic models, and that include exogenous forcing. As a concrete example, we re-calibrate the climate part of the widely used DICE-2016, fathoming the CMIP5 uncertainty range of model responses: the multi-model mean as well as extreme, but still permissible climate sensitivities and carbon cycle responses. We demonstrate that the functional form of the climate emulator of the DICE-2016 model is fit for purpose, despite its simplicity, but its carbon cycle and temperature equations are miscalibrated, leading to the conclusion that one may want to be skeptical about predictions derived from DICE-2016. We examine the importance of the calibration for the social cost of carbon in the context of a partial equilibrium setting where interest rates are exogenous, as well as the simple general equilibrium setting from DICE-2016. We find that the model uncertainty from different consistent calibrations of the climate system can change the social cost of carbon by a factor of 4 if one assumes a quadratic damage function. When calibrated to the multi-model mean, our model predicts similar values for the social cost of carbon as the original DICE-2016, but with a strongly reduced sensitivity to the discount rate and about 1 degree less long-term warming. The social cost of carbon in DICE-2016 is oversensitive to the discount rate, leading to extreme comparative statics responses to changes in preferences.
records.abstract_cn: 为了分析气候变化缓解策略，经济学家依靠简化的气候模型（所谓的气候模拟器）以较低的计算成本提供二氧化碳排放与全球变暖之间的现实定量联系。在本文中，我们为这些气候模拟器提出了一种通用且透明的校准和评估策略，该策略基于可免费且轻松获取的来自气候科学的最先进基准数据。我们证明，自由模型参数的适当选择对于预测的碳社会成本至关重要。我们提出的关键想法是校准简化的气候模型，以参与耦合模型比对项目阶段5（CMIP5）的综合全球气候模型的基准数据。特别是，我们建议使用四在气候科学文献中被认为至关重要的不同测试用例：二高度理想化的测试来分别校准和评估碳循环和温度响应，理想化的测试来量化瞬态气候响应，以及最终的测试来评估与经济模型产生的场景相近的性能，其中包括外生强迫。作为一个具体的例子，我们重新校准了广泛使用的 DICE-2016 的气候部分，了解模型响应的 CMIP5 不确定性范围：多模型平均值以及极端但仍然允许的气候敏感性和碳循环响应。我们证明，DICE-2016 模型的气候模拟器的功能形式尽管简单，但符合目的，但其碳循环和温度方程校准错误，导致 一 可能对 DICE-2016 得出的预测持怀疑态度。我们研究了在利率为外生的部分均衡设置以及 DICE-2016 的简单一般均衡设置的背景下校准碳社会成本的重要性。我们发现，如果 一 假设二次损害函数，则气候系统不同一致校准的模型不确定性可以将碳的社会成本改变 4 倍。当校准到多模型均值时，我们的模型预测的碳社会成本值与原始 DICE-2016 相似，但对贴现率的敏感性大大降低，并且长期变暖程度降低约 1 度。 DICE-2016中碳的社会成本对贴现率过于敏感，导致对偏好变化的极端比较静态反应。

records.title_en: Good Politicians: Experimental Evidence on Motivations for Political Candidacy and Government Performance
records.title_cn: 优秀的政治家：政治候选人动机和政府绩效的实验证据
records.abstract_en: How can we motivate good politicians—those that will carry out policy that is responsive to citizens’ preferences—to enter politics? In a field experiment in Pakistan, we vary how political office is portrayed to ordinary citizens. Emphasizing prosocial motives for holding political office instead of personal returns—such as the ability to help others versus enhancing one’s own respect and status—raises the likelihood that individuals run for office and that voters elect them. A year later, the treatment improves the alignment of policy with citizens’ preferences. These effects emerge only when treatments are randomly delivered in a public setting. Taken together, the results demonstrate that how politics is perceived shapes who decides to run for office, who is elected, as well the policies that democracies deliver.
records.abstract_cn: 我们如何才能激励优秀的政治家——那些会执行响应公民偏好的政策的人——进入政坛？在巴基斯坦的一项实地实验中，我们改变了向普通公民描绘政治职位的方式。强调担任政治职务的亲社会动机而不是个人回报——例如帮助他人的能力与提高一自己的尊重和地位——增加了个人竞选公职和选民选举他们的可能性。一年后，这种待遇改善了政策与公民偏好的一致性。仅当在公共环境中随机进行治疗时，这些效果才会出现。总而言之，结果表明，人们对政治的看法影响着谁决定竞选公职、谁当选，以及民主国家实施的政策。

records.title_en: International Comovement in the Global Production Network
records.title_cn: 全球生产网络中的国际联动
records.abstract_en: This article provides a general framework to study the role of production networks in international GDP comovement. We first derive an additive decomposition of bilateral GDP comovement into components capturing shock transmission and shock correlation. We quantify this decomposition in a parsimonious multi-country, multi-sector dynamic network propagation model, using data for the G7 countries over the period 1978–2007. Our main finding is that while the network transmission of shocks is quantitatively important, it accounts for a minority of observed comovement under the estimated range of structural elasticities. Contemporaneous responses to correlated shocks in the production network are more successful at generating comovement than intertemporal propagation through capital accumulation. Extensions with multiple shocks, nominal rigidities, and international financial integration leave our main result unchanged. A combination of TFP and labour supply shocks is quantitatively successful at reproducing the observed international business cycle.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了研究生产网络在国际 GDP 联动中的作用的总体框架。我们第一将双边GDP联动分解为捕捉冲击传递和冲击相关性的组成部分。我们使用七国集团国家在1978-2007期间的数据，在一个简约的多国家、多部门动态网络传播模型中量化这种分解。我们的主要发现是，虽然冲击的网络传播在数量上很重要，但它占结构弹性估计范围内观察到的联动的一小部分。对生产网络中相关冲击的同期反应比通过资本积累进行的跨期传播更能成功地产生联动。多重冲击、名义刚性和国际金融一体化的扩展使我们的主要结果保持不变。全要素生产率和劳动力供应冲击的结合在数量上成功地再现了观察到的国际商业周期。

records.title_en: Transhumant Pastoralism, Climate Change, and Conflict in Africa
records.title_cn: 非洲的游牧放牧、气候变化和冲突
records.abstract_en: We consider the effects of climate change on seasonally migrant populations that herd livestock—i.e. transhumant pastoralists—in Africa. Traditionally, transhumant pastoralists benefit from a cooperative relationship with sedentary agriculturalists whereby arable land is used for crop farming in the wet season and animal grazing in the dry season. Rainfall scarcity can disrupt this arrangement by inducing pastoral groups to migrate to agricultural lands before the harvest, causing conflict to emerge. We examine this hypothesis by combining ethnographic information on the traditional locations of transhumant pastoralists and sedentary agriculturalists with high-resolution data on the location and timing of rainfall and violent conflict events in Africa from 1989 to 2018. We find that reduced rainfall in the territory of transhumant pastoralists leads to conflict in neighbouring areas. Consistent with the proposed mechanism, the conflicts are concentrated in agricultural areas; they occur during the wet season and not the dry season; and they are due to rainfall’s impact on plant biomass growth. Since pastoralists tend to be Muslim and agriculturalists Christian, this mechanism accounts for a sizable proportion of the rapid rise in religious conflict observed in recent decades. Regarding policy responses, we find that development aid projects tend not to mitigate the effects that we document. By contrast, the effects are reduced when transhumant pastoralists have greater power in national government, suggesting that more equal political representation is conducive to peace.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑气候变化对放牧牲畜的季节性移民人口的影响，即放牧牲畜的人口。迁徙的牧民——在非洲。传统上，游牧牧民受益于与定居农民的合作关系，即耕地在雨季用于农作物种植，在旱季用于放牧动物。降雨稀缺可能会导致牧民在收获前迁移到农田，从而破坏这种安排，从而导致冲突的出现。我们通过将游牧牧民和定居农民的传统位置的人种学信息与1989至2018非洲降雨和暴力冲突事件的位置和时间的高分辨率数据相结合来检验这一假设。我们发现，游牧牧民境内降雨量减少导致邻近地区发生冲突。与拟议的机制一致，冲突集中在农业地区；它们发生在雨季而不是旱季；这是由于降雨对植物生物量生长的影响。由于牧民往往是穆斯林，而农耕者往往是基督徒，这种机制在近几十年来观察到的宗教冲突迅速上升中占了相当大的比例。关于政策反应，我们发现发展援助项目往往不会减轻我们记录的影响。相比之下，当游牧牧民在国家政府中拥有更大权力时，其影响就会减弱，这表明更平等的政治代表权有利于和平。

records.title_en: Reservation Raises: The Aggregate Labour Supply Curve at the Extensive Margin
records.title_cn: 保留率提高：广义边际的总劳动力供给曲线
records.abstract_en: We measure desired labour supply at the extensive (employment) margin in two representative surveys of the U.S. and German populations. We elicit reservation raises: the percent wage change that renders a given individual indifferent between employment and nonemployment. It is equal to her reservation wage divided by her actual, or potential, wage. The reservation raise distribution is the nonparametric aggregate labour supply curve. Locally, the curve exhibits large short-run elasticities above 3, consistent with business cycle evidence. For larger upward shifts, arc elasticities shrink towards 0.5, consistent with quasi-experimental evidence from tax holidays. Existing models fail to match this nonconstant, asymmetric curve.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在二对美国和德国人口的代表性调查中衡量了广泛（就业）边际的理想劳动力供给。我们引出保留加薪：使特定个人在就业和非就业之间变得无所谓的工资变化百分比。它等于她的保留工资除以她的实际或潜在工资。保留加薪分布是非参数总劳动力供给曲线。就局部而言，该曲线表现出高于3的较大短期弹性，这与经济周期证据一致。对于较大的向上偏移，弧弹性收缩至 0.5，与免税期的准实验证据一致。现有模型无法匹配这条非常量、不对称的曲线。

records.title_en: Robust Implementation with Costly Information
records.title_cn: 使用昂贵的信息进行稳健的实施
records.abstract_en: We construct mechanisms that can robustly implement any desired social choice function when (1) agents may incur a cost to learn the state of the world, (2) with small probability, agents’ preferences can be arbitrarily different from some baseline known to the mechanism designer, and (3) the mechanism designer does not know agents’ beliefs and higher-order beliefs about one another’s preferences. The mechanisms we propose have a natural interpretation and do not require the mechanism designer to be able to verify the state ex post. We also establish impossibility results for stronger notions of robust implementation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建的机制可以稳健地实现任何期望的社会选择函数，当（1）代理人可能会产生学习世界状态的成本，（2）小概率，代理人的偏好可以与机制设计者已知的某些基线任意不同，以及（3）机制设计者不知道代理人的信念和关于一另一个人的偏好的高阶信念。我们提出的机制有一个自然的解释，不需要机制设计者能够事后验证状态。我们还建立了不可能的结果，以增强强有力的实施理念。

records.title_en: The Causal Impact of Socio-Emotional Skills Training on Educational Success
records.title_cn: 社会情感技能培训对教育成功的因果影响
records.abstract_en: We study the long-term effects of a randomized intervention targeting children's socio-emotional skills. The classroom-based intervention for primary school children has positive impacts that persist for over a decade. Treated children become more likely to complete academic high school and enrol in university. Two mechanisms drive these results. Treated children show fewer attention deficit/hyperactivity disorder symptoms: they are less impulsive and less disruptive. They also attain higher grades, but they do not score higher on standardized tests. The long-term effects on educational attainment thus appear to be driven by changes in socio-emotional skills rather than cognitive skills.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究针对儿童社会情感技能的随机干预的长期影响。针对小学生的课堂干预产生了持续十多年的积极影响。接受治疗的儿童更有可能完成高中学业并进入大学。 二机制驱动这些结果。接受治疗的儿童表现出较少的注意力缺陷/多动障碍症状：他们较少冲动且较少破坏性。他们也取得了更高的成绩，但他们在标准化考试中得分并不高。因此，对教育程度的长期影响似乎是由社会情感技能的变化而不是认知技能的变化驱动的。

records.title_en: Surviving Competition: Neighbourhood Shops versus Convenience Chains
records.title_cn: 在竞争中生存：社区小店与连锁便利店
records.abstract_en: Hundreds of millions of microenterprises in emerging economies face increased competition from the entry and expansion of large firms that offer similar products. This paper examines the impacts of the opening of chain-run convenience stores on one of the world’s most ubiquitous microenterprises: owner-operated shops. To address endogeneity in time and location of chains’ opening, I pair two-way fixed effects with a novel instrument that shifts the profitability of chains but not of shops at the neighbourhood level. Expanding the number of chain outlets from zero to the neighbourhood average of 6.7 stores reduces the number of shops by 15%, a decline driven not by increased shop exits but by decreased shop entries. Shops retain their sales of fresh products and keep 96% of their customers, but customers visit shops less frequently and spend less on packaged goods. Surviving shops leverage competitive advantages stemming from being owner operated, such as lower agency costs, cultivating relationships with neighbours, and offering customers informal credit. The welfare gains of convenience chains replacing shops increase with household income; the poorest households experience a welfare loss.
records.abstract_cn: 数以亿计的新兴经济体微型企业，正面临提供相似产品的大型企业进入和扩张所带来的更激烈竞争。本文研究连锁便利店开业对世界上最常见的微型企业之一——个体经营小店——的影响。为解决连锁店开业时间和地点的内生性问题，作者将双向固定效应与一种新工具变量结合起来，该工具在社区层面上影响连锁店的盈利能力，但不影响小店的盈利能力。将连锁门店数量从零扩张到社区平均水平 6.7 家，会使小店数量减少15%，这一下降并非由小店退出增加所致，而是由小店新进入减少所致。小店仍保住了鲜活商品销售，并留住了96%的顾客，但顾客到店频率更低，在包装商品上的支出也更少。存活下来的小店利用了个体经营带来的竞争优势，例如更低的代理成本、与邻里的关系网络以及向顾客提供非正式赊账。连锁便利店替代小店带来的福利增益会随家庭收入上升而增加；最贫困家庭则会遭受福利损失。

records.title_en: Estimating Equilibrium in Health Insurance Exchanges: Price Competition and Subsidy Design under the ACA
records.title_cn: 估计健康保险交易所的均衡：ACA 下的价格竞争和补贴设计
records.abstract_en: Regulations to design private yet publicly sponsored health insurance markets are increasingly adopted in many OECD countries. Here I combine data and economic theory to analyse the interaction between insurers’ competition and the design of premium subsidies in determining equilibrium outcomes. My empirical model includes adverse selection, rich heterogeneity in preferences for vertically and horizontally differentiated plans and accommodates alternative assumptions on pricing conduct. In the context of the Affordable Care Act in the U.S., I estimate the joint distribution of preferences and expected cost using Californian administrative records on 3.4 million plan choices between 2014 and 2017, combined with plan and survey data on medical claims. An empirical horse race between conduct assumptions favours oligopoly pricing over perfect competition. Considering alternative subsidy designs shows that, in equilibrium, shifting subsidy generosity toward the “young invincibles” would lower premiums for all enrolees while increasing enrolment and profits.
records.abstract_cn: 许多经合组织国家越来越多地采用设计私人但公共资助的健康保险市场的法规。在这里，我结合数据和经济理论来分析保险公司竞争与保费补贴设计之间的相互作用，以确定均衡结果。我的实证模型包括逆向选择、对纵向和横向差异化计划的偏好的丰富异质性，并适应定价行为的替代假设。在美国《平价医疗法案》的背景下，我使用加州关于 3.4 和 2014 之间 2017 百万 计划选择的行政记录，结合医疗索赔的计划和调查数据，估计了偏好和预期成本的联合分布。行为假设之间的实证赛马有利于寡头垄断定价而不是完全竞争。考虑替代补贴设计表明，在均衡状态下，将补贴慷慨转向“年轻无敌”将降低所有参保者的保费，同时增加入学率和利润。

records.title_en: One rule fits all? Heterogeneous fiscal rules for commodity exporters when price shocks can be persistent: Theory and evidence
records.title_cn: 一条规则适用于所有情况？当价格冲击可能具有持续性时，大宗商品出口国的异质性财政规则：理论与证据
records.abstract_en: This paper reevaluates the common characterization of commodity-exporting developing economies as having excessively procyclical fiscal policy. We develop a new measure of fiscal procyclicality—the marginal propensity to spend (MPS) an extra dollar of commodity revenues—which we estimate in a panel of countries and compare with optimal policy in a New Keynesian model. Empirically, fiscal policy is procyclical on average (MPS=0.25), but heterogeneous. Countries with fixed exchange rates (ER) are almost acyclical, but countries with flexible ERs are procyclical and the MPS increases with the persistence of commodity price shocks. Optimal policy in the model is similar qualitatively but differs quantitatively in some dimensions. Under fixed ERs, optimal policy is almost acyclical to stabilize the business cycle. However, under flexible ERs, monetary policy stabilizes the business cycle, so fiscal policy is procyclical because commodity price shocks are typically persistent and so should be spent by the permanent income hypothesis.
records.abstract_cn: 本文重新评估了将大宗商品出口发展中经济体普遍描述为财政政策过度顺周期的常见观点。我们开发了一种新的财政顺周期性衡量指标——额外一美元大宗商品收入的边际支出倾向（MPS）——并在一个跨国面板中对其进行估计，同时与一个新凯恩斯模型中的最优政策进行比较。实证上，财政政策平均而言是顺周期的（MPS=0.25），但存在异质性。实行固定汇率（ER）的国家几乎是非周期性的，而实行浮动汇率制的国家则是顺周期的，且MPS随大宗商品价格冲击的持续性增加而上升。模型中的最优政策在定性上相似，但在某些维度上定量上存在差异。在固定汇率制下，最优政策几乎是非周期性的，以稳定经济周期。然而，在浮动汇率制下，货币政策稳定经济周期，因此财政政策是顺周期的，因为大宗商品价格冲击通常具有持续性，根据永久收入假说，这些收入应当被支出。

records.title_en: Monetary non-neutrality in a multisector economy: The role of risk-sharing
records.title_cn: 多部门经济中的货币非中性：风险分担的作用
records.abstract_en: We show that the degree of risk-sharing among heterogeneous workers is a key determinant of monetary non-neutrality in a multisector sticky-price model. In this framework, workers are employed across different sectors, earning distinct wages. The limited ability of workers to fully insure against labor income risks results in strategic complementarity in firms' price-setting decisions with respect to aggregate shocks and strategic substitutability with respect to idiosyncratic shocks. These pricing interactions lead to sluggish adjustments of the price level in response to monetary and other aggregate shocks, causing significant fluctuations in the output gap while maintaining large responses of individual prices to idiosyncratic shocks. We illustrate these results across three stylized asset market scenarios: complete markets, non-contingent bond-only markets, and financial autarky.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，异质性工人之间的风险分担程度是多部门粘性价格模型中货币非中性的关键决定因素。在此框架下，工人在不同部门就业，赚取不同的工资。工人完全保险劳动收入风险的能力有限，导致企业定价决策中对总体冲击的战略互补性和对特质冲击的战略替代性。这些定价互动导致价格水平对货币及其他总体冲击的调整缓慢，引起产出缺口的显著波动，同时保持个体价格对特质冲击的大幅反应。我们在三种典型的资产市场情景下说明了这些结果：完全市场、仅非或有债券市场以及金融自给自足。

records.title_en: Cyclical worker flows: Cleansing vs. sullying
records.title_cn: 周期性工人流动：净化与污染效应
records.abstract_en: Do recessions speed up or impede productivity-enhancing reallocation? To investigate this question, we use U.S. linked employer-employee data to examine how worker flows contribute to productivity growth over the business cycle. We find that in expansions high-productivity firms grow faster primarily by hiring workers away from low-productivity firms. Productivity growth slows during recessions when this job ladder collapses. In contrast, layoffs at low-productivity firms disproportionately increase in recessions, which leads to an increase in productivity growth. We thus find evidence of both sullying and cleansing effects of recessions, but the timing of these effects differs. The cleansing effects are concentrated in downturns while the sullying effects linger well into the economic recovery. Our results imply that slow labor market recoveries will be more damaging to productivity growth than V-shaped recoveries due to lingering sullying effects.
records.abstract_cn: 经济衰退是加速还是阻碍了提升生产效率的重新配置？为探究此问题，我们使用美国关联雇主-雇员数据，考察工人流动如何在整个商业周期中促进生产率增长。我们发现，在扩张期，高生产率企业主要通过从低生产率企业招聘工人而实现更快增长。当这种就业阶梯崩溃时，生产率增长在经济衰退期间放缓。相反，低生产率企业的裁员在经济衰退期间不成比例地增加，这导致生产率增长上升。因此，我们找到了经济衰退既存在污染效应又存在净化效应的证据，但这两类效应的时间点不同。净化效应集中在衰退期，而污染效应则持续到经济复苏的相当长一段时间。我们的结果表明，由于持续的污染效应，缓慢的劳动力市场复苏对生产率增长的损害将比V型复苏更为严重。

records.title_en: Home construction financing and search frictions in the housing market
records.title_cn: 住房建设融资和房地产市场的搜索摩擦
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effects of financial frictions in construction on housing market dynamics. To this end, we build a search-theoretic model of the housing market in which there is endogenous entry of buyers and developers face credit constraints. We capture credit frictions by assuming that developers must search for financing before building a home à la Wasmer and Weil (2004). Our model explores a novel channel that links credit frictions faced by developers to the housing market. We calibrate the model to quantify the size of the credit channel during the 2012–2019 housing market recovery. Through a series of counterfactuals, our model predicts that the credit channel had a large impact on housing liquidity, construction, and the vacancy rate. Furthermore, it accounts for around half of the rise in prices during the 2012-2019 housing market recovery.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了建筑业金融摩擦对房地产市场动态的影响。为此，我们建立了一个住房市场的搜索理论模型，其中存在买家的内生进入，而开发商则面临信贷约束。我们通过假设开发商必须像 Wasmer 和 Weil 那样在建造房屋之前寻求融资来捕捉信贷摩擦（2004）。我们的模型探索了一种将开发商面临的信贷摩擦与房地产市场联系起来的新颖渠道。我们校准模型以量化2012-2019房地产市场复苏期间信贷渠道的规模。通过一系列反事实，我们的模型预测信贷渠道对住房流动性、建设和空置率有很大影响。此外，它约占2012-2019房地产市场复苏期间价格上涨的一半。

records.title_en: Mergers, firm size, and volatility in a granular economy
records.title_cn: 并购、企业规模与颗粒经济中的波动性
records.abstract_en: We study the firm dynamics associated with mergers and acquisitions (M&A) and their implications at the micro and macro levels. Our paper presents three main findings: (i) mergers generate a more fat-tailed firm-size distribution, thereby amplifying granular fluctuations and increasing aggregate volatility; (ii) the impact of mergers depends on strategic market power and endogenous markups; and (iii) under endogenous markups, we provide a novel characterization of the firm size-volatility relationship in which volatility declines disproportionately with size. We build a quantitative model of domestic horizontal mergers and find a sizeable impact of mergers on aggregate volatility using counterfactual analysis.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了与并购（M&A）相关的企业动态及其在微观和宏观层面的影响。我们的论文提出了三个主要发现：（i）并购导致企业规模分布更加肥尾，从而放大颗粒波动并增加总体波动性；（ii）并购的影响取决于战略市场力量和内生加成率；（iii）在内生加成率下，我们提供了企业规模-波动性关系的新特征描述，其中波动性随规模不成比例地下降。我们构建了一个国内横向并购的定量模型，并通过反事实分析发现并购对总体波动性有显著影响。

records.title_en: Migration spillovers within families: Evidence from Thailand
records.title_cn: 家庭内部的迁移溢出效应：来自泰国的证据
records.abstract_en: When a person migrates, are their family members more likely to migrate too? I estimate the causal impact of family migrant network size on migration decisions using household survey data from rural Thailand. Large but temporary labor demand shocks in a nearby city—originating from a national infrastructure program—provide plausibly exogenous variation in family members' migration decisions based on their ages at the time of the program. Among those too young to be directly impacted by the program, I find that each older family migrant increases their migration probability by about 5 percentage points. Further analysis suggests a role for better information about the destination in driving this impact. My findings imply that the short-run benefits of relieving migration constraints can underestimate the long-run benefits due to spillovers within the household.
records.abstract_cn: 当一个人迁移时，其家庭成员是否也更有可能迁移？我利用泰国农村家庭调查数据，估计了家庭移民网络规模对迁移决策的因果影响。附近城市中由全国基础设施项目引发的大规模但暂时的劳动力需求冲击，为基于家庭成员在该项目时的年龄提供了看似外生的变异。在那些年龄过小而无法直接受项目影响的个体中，我发现每增加一位年长的家庭移民，其迁移概率约增加5个百分点。进一步分析表明，关于目的地的更好信息在推动这一影响中发挥作用。我的研究结果表明，由于家庭内部的溢出效应，缓解迁移约束的短期收益可能低估了长期收益。

records.title_en: Means-tested programs and interstate migration in the United States
records.title_cn: 美国经济状况调查项目与州际迁移
records.abstract_en: This paper quantifies the impact of means-tested programs – in particular, Medicaid and Public Housing – on the interstate mobility of their beneficiaries. Simulations from a structural model with heterogeneous workers and locations show that beneficiaries' mobility falls by 17.2 percent, with the greatest reduction occurring among the poorest beneficiaries. Around half of this effect stems from the lack of federal coordination in the programs' administrations, namely, the possibility that a moving beneficiary loses transfers despite being eligible for them. A policy that eliminates this risk raises overall welfare, with 5 percent of low-income households enjoying a welfare gain of 1.1 percent.
records.abstract_cn: 本文量化了经济状况调查项目——特别是医疗补助和公共住房——对其受益者州际流动性的影响。基于包含异质性工人和地区的结构模型模拟显示，受益者的流动性下降了17.2%，其中最贫困受益者的降幅最大。这一影响中约有一半源于项目管理的联邦协调缺失，即迁移的受益者即使符合资格也可能失去转移支付。消除这一风险的政策提高了整体福利，其中5%的低收入家庭获得了1.1%的福利增益。

records.title_en: A job ladder model of executive compensation
records.title_cn: 高管薪酬的工作阶梯模型
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the impact of managerial labor market competition on executive incentive contracts. I develop a dynamic contracting model that incorporates moral hazard, search frictions, and poaching offers. The model generates a job ladder along which executives can either use outside offers to renegotiate with the current firm or transition to outside firms. I show that poaching offers generate a new source of incentives, which explains a novel empirical finding whereby larger firms give executives a higher proportion of incentive compensation.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了经理人劳动力市场竞争对高管激励合同的影响。我构建了一个动态契约模型，该模型包含了道德风险、搜索摩擦和挖角要约。模型生成了一条工作阶梯，高管可以沿此阶梯利用外部要约与当前公司重新谈判，或转向外部公司。我证明，挖角要约产生了新的激励来源，这解释了一个新的实证发现，即规模较大的公司给予高管更高比例的激励性薪酬。

records.title_en: Estimating macroeconomic models of financial crises: An endogenous regime‐switching approach
records.title_cn: 估计金融危机宏观经济模型：一种内生制度转换方法
records.abstract_en: We develop a new model of cycles and crises in emerging markets, featuring an occasionally binding borrowing constraint and stochastic volatility, and estimate it with quarterly data for Mexico since 1981. We propose an endogenous regime‐switching formulation of the occasionally binding borrowing constraint, develop a general perturbation method to solve the model, and estimate it using Bayesian methods. We find that the model fits the Mexican data well without systematically relying on large shocks, matching the typical stylized facts of emerging market business cycles and Mexico's history of sudden stops in capital flows. We also find that interest rate shocks play a smaller role in driving both cycles and crises than previously found in the literature.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个新兴市场周期与危机的新模型，其特点是偶尔具有约束力的借款约束和随机波动性，并使用墨西哥自1981年以来的季度数据对其进行估计。我们提出了偶尔具有约束力的借款约束的内生制度转换公式，开发了一种通用的扰动方法来解决该模型，并使用贝叶斯方法进行估计。我们发现该模型很好地拟合了墨西哥数据，无需系统性地依赖大冲击，符合新兴市场商业周期的典型风格化事实以及墨西哥资本流动突然停止的历史。我们还发现，利率冲击在驱动周期和危机方面的作用比先前文献中发现的要小。

records.title_en: Integrated epi‐econ assessment: Quantitative theory
records.title_cn: 综合流行病-经济评估：定量理论
records.abstract_en: Aimed at pandemic preparedness, we construct a framework for integrated epi‐econ assessment that we believe would be useful for policymakers, especially at the early stages of a pandemic outbreak. We offer theory, calibration to micro‐, macro‐, and epi‐data, and numerical methods for quantitative policy evaluation. The model has an explicit microeconomic, market‐based structure. It highlights trade‐offs, within period and over time, associated with activities that involve both valuable social interaction and harmful disease transmission. We compare market solutions with socially optimal allocations. Our calibration to Covid‐19 implies that households shift their leisure and work activities away from social interactions. This is especially true for older individuals, who are more vulnerable to disease. The optimal allocation may or may not involve lockdown and changes the time allocations significantly across age groups. In this trade‐off, people's social leisure time becomes an important factor, aside from deaths and GDP. We finally compare optimal responses to different viruses (SARS, seasonal flu) and argue that, going forward, economic analysis ought to be an integral element behind epidemiological policy.
records.abstract_cn: 旨在为流行病防范，我们构建了一个综合流行病-经济评估框架，我们认为该框架对政策制定者尤其在大流行病爆发初期会很有用。我们提供了理论、对微观、宏观和流行病数据的校准，以及用于定量政策评估的数值方法。该模型具有明确的微观经济、基于市场的结构。它强调了在涉及有价值的社会互动和有害的疾病传播的活动中，期内和跨期的权衡。我们比较了市场解决方案与社会最优配置。我们对Covid-19的校准表明，家庭将休闲和工作活动从社会互动中转移出来。对于更容易感染疾病的老年人尤其如此。最优配置可能涉及也可能不涉及封锁，并显著改变不同年龄组的时间分配。在这种权衡中，除了死亡和GDP之外，人们的社会休闲时间成为一个重要因素。最后，我们比较了对不同病毒（SARS、季节性流感）的最优反应，并认为，展望未来，经济分析应成为流行病政策的一个组成部分。

records.title_en: Prospering through Prospera: A dynamic model of CCT impacts on educational attainment and achievement in Mexico
records.title_cn: 通过Prospera实现繁荣：墨西哥有条件现金转移对教育成就和学业成绩影响的动态模型
records.abstract_en: This paper develops and estimates a dynamic model, which integrates value‐added and school‐choice models, to evaluate grade‐by‐grade and cumulative impacts of the Mexican Prospera conditional cash transfer (CCT) program on educational achievement. The empirical application advances the previous literature by estimating policy impacts on learning, accounting for dynamic selective school attendance, and incorporating both observed and unobserved heterogeneity. A dynamic framework is critical for estimating cumulative learning effects because lagged achievements are important determinants of current achievements. The model is estimated using rich nationwide Mexican administrative data on schooling progression and mathematics and Spanish test scores in grades 4–9 along with student and family survey data. The estimates show significant CCT impacts on learning and educational attainment, particularly for students from poorer households. Results show that telesecondary schools (distance learning) play a crucial role in facilitating school attendance and in fostering skill accumulation.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发并估计了一个动态模型，该模型整合了增值模型和学校选择模型，以评估墨西哥Prospera有条件现金转移（CCT）项目对教育成就的逐年和累积影响。实证应用通过估计政策对学习的影响、考虑动态选择性学校出勤，并纳入观测和未观测的异质性，推进了先前文献。动态框架对于估计累积学习效应至关重要，因为滞后的成就是当前成就的重要决定因素。该模型使用墨西哥全国范围内关于学校进展以及4-9年级数学和西班牙语测试成绩的丰富行政数据，以及学生和家庭调查数据进行估计。估计结果显示，CCT对学习和教育成就具有显著影响，特别是对来自较贫困家庭的学生。结果表明，远程中学（远程学习）在促进学校出勤和促进技能积累方面发挥着关键作用。

records.title_en: Can teaching be taught? Improving teachers' pedagogical skills at scale in rural Peru
records.title_cn: 教学可以教吗？大规模提高秘鲁农村地区教师的教学技能
records.abstract_en: We evaluate the impact of a large‐scale teacher coaching program in Peru, a context with high teacher turnover, on teachers' pedagogical skills and student learning. Previous studies find that small‐scale coaching programs can improve teaching of reading and science in developing countries. However, scaling up can reduce programs' effectiveness, and teacher turnover can erode compliance and cause spillovers onto non‐program schools. We develop a framework that defines different treatment effects when teacher turnover is present, and explains which effects can be estimated. We evaluate this teacher coaching program, exploiting random assignment of that program's expansion to 3797 rural schools in 2016. After two years, teachers assigned to the program increased their aggregate pedagogical skills by 0.20 standard deviations. The program also increased student learning; after 1 year, Grade 2 students' mathematics and reading scores increased by 0.106 and 0.075 standard deviations (of the distributions of those test scores), respectively. After three years, the cumulative effect increases slightly, to 0.114 and 0.100, respectively. One reason why these impacts are low is that some uncoached teachers moved into treated schools in years 2 and 3. Following our framework, we estimate that the impacts on students of having a “fully” coached teacher for all three years are 0.18 and 0.16 standard deviations for mathematics and reading comprehension, respectively.
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估了秘鲁大规模教师辅导计划（教师流动率高）对教师教学技能和学生学习的影响。先前的研究发现，小规模辅导项目可以改善发展中国家的阅读和科学教学。然而，扩大规模可能会降低项目的有效性，而教师流动可能会削弱合规性并导致溢出效应到非项目学校。我们开发了一个框架，定义了教师流动时的不同处理效果，并解释了可以估计哪些效果。我们评估了该教师辅导计划，利用该计划扩展到 2016 的 3797 农村学校的随机分配。两年后，分配到该项目的教师的总体教学技能提高了 0.20 个标准差。该计划还增加了学生的学习； 1年后，2年级学生的数学和阅读成绩分别增加了0.106和0.075标准差（这些测试成绩的分布）。三年后，累积效应略有增加，分别达到 0.114 和 0.100。这些影响较低的原因之一是一些未经培训的教师在2和3年进入接受过培训的学校。根据我们的框架，我们估计三年内拥有“完全”辅导的教师对学生的数学和阅读理解标准差分别为 0.18 和 0.16 标准差。

records.title_en: An ordinal approach to the empirical analysis of games with monotone best responses
records.title_cn: 单调最优反应博弈经验分析的序数方法
records.abstract_en: We develop a nonparametric and ordinal approach for testing pure strategy Nash equilibrium play in games with monotone best responses, such as those with strategic complements/substitutes. The approach makes minimal assumptions on unobserved heterogeneity, requires no parametric assumptions on payoff functions, and no restriction on equilibrium selection from multiple equilibria. The approach can also be extended in order to make inferences and predictions. Both model‐testing and inference can be implemented by a tractable computation procedure based on column generation. To illustrate how our approach works, we include an application to an IO entry game.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种非参数和序数方法，用于检验具有单调最优反应的博弈中的纯策略纳什均衡行为，例如具有战略互补/替代性的博弈。该方法对未观测到的异质性做出最小假设，不需要对支付函数进行参数假设，也不限制多重均衡中的均衡选择。该方法还可以扩展以进行推断和预测。模型检验和推断都可以通过基于列生成的易处理计算程序来实现。为了说明我们的方法如何运作，我们包含了一个应用于产业组织进入博弈的实例。

records.title_en: Econometrics of insurance with multidimensional types
records.title_cn: 多维类型保险的计量经济学
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we address the identification and estimation of insurance models where insurees have private information about their risk and risk aversion. The model includes random damages and allows for several claims, while insurees choose from a finite number of coverages. We show that the joint distribution of risk and risk aversion is nonparametrically identified despite bunching due to multidimensional types and a finite number of coverages. Our identification strategy exploits the observed number of claims as well as an exclusion restriction, and a full support assumption. Furthermore, our results apply to any form of competition. We propose a novel estimation procedure combining nonparametric estimators and GMM estimation that we illustrate in a Monte Carlo study.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究了保险模型的识别与估计问题，其中被保险人对其风险和风险厌恶拥有私人信息。该模型包括随机损失，并允许多次索赔，而被保险人从有限数量的保障中选择。我们证明，尽管由于多维类型和有限数量的保障而存在聚集现象，风险与风险厌恶的联合分布仍可非参数识别。我们的识别策略利用了观察到的索赔次数以及排除性限制和完全支持假设。此外，我们的结果适用于任何形式的竞争。我们提出了一种结合非参数估计量和GMM估计的新估计程序，并在蒙特卡洛研究中进行了说明。

records.title_en: Double robust inference for continuous updating GMM
records.title_cn: 连续更新GMM的双重稳健推断
records.abstract_en: We propose the double robust Lagrange multiplier (DRLM) statistic for testing hypotheses specified on the minimizer of the population continuous updating objective function. The (bounding) χ2 limiting distribution of the DRLM statistic is robust to both misspecification and weak identification, hence its name. The minimizer is the so‐called pseudo‐true value, which equals the true value of the structural parameter under correct specification. To emphasize its importance for applied work where misspecification and weak identification are common, we use the DRLM test to analyze: the risk premia in Adrian et al. (2014) and He et al. (2017); the structural parameters in a nonlinear asset pricing model with constant relative risk aversion.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了双重稳健拉格朗日乘数（DRLM）统计量，用于检验关于总体连续更新目标函数最小化器的假设。DRLM统计量的（有界）χ2极限分布对误设和弱识别均具有稳健性，因此得名。该最小化器即所谓的伪真值，在正确设定下等于结构参数的真值。为了强调其在误设和弱识别常见的应用工作中的重要性，我们使用DRLM检验分析了：Adrian等人（2014）和He等人（2017）中的风险溢价；以及具有常数相对风险厌恶的非线性资产定价模型中的结构参数。

records.title_en: How much do we learn? Measuring symmetric and asymmetric deviations from Bayesian updating through choices
records.title_cn: 我们学到了多少？通过选择衡量贝叶斯更新的对称与非对称偏离
records.abstract_en: Belief‐updating biases hinder the correction of inaccurate beliefs and lead to suboptimal decisions. We complement Rabin and Schrag's (1999) portable extension of the Bayesian model by including conservatism in addition to confirmatory bias. Additionally, we show how to identify these two forms of biases from choices.
