records.abstract_en: In westernised countries, food insecurity (FI) is robustly associated with low diet quality, and obesity. Grocery stores are one promising arena for interventions to facilitate purchasing of healthier, more environmentally sustainable food. However, we currently lack understanding of the barriers experienced by people living with obesity (PLWO) and FI when shopping for such food. Using an online survey (N = 583), adults residing in England or Scotland with a body mass index of ≥ 30 kg/m2 self-reported on FI, diet quality, and their experiences of shopping in a grocery store for healthy and environmentally sustainable food. Participants also ranked different grocery store interventions on their helpfulness in supporting healthier, more environmentally sustainable purchasing. Structural equation modelling revealed that greater experiences of FI were directly associated with greater experiences of barriers from the food environment (e.g., price), food preparation practices, lower healthy diet knowledge and physical ill-health. Moreover, greater experiences of FI were indirectly associated with lower diet quality via mental ill-health and greater experiences of anticipated stigma associated with being food insecure. Grocery store interventions based on price/ incentivisation were ranked most helpful in supporting healthier, more environmentally sustainable purchasing. These findings highlight the challenges faced by PLWO and with greater experiences of FI when shopping for healthy and environmentally sustainable food. Findings also underscore the need for policy development relating to price and affordability at a population-level, and for policymakers and healthcare professionals to consider how to address mental health and how to minimise anticipated stigma experienced by this vulnerable group.
records.abstract_cn: 在西方化国家，食物不安全（FI）与低饮食质量和肥胖密切相关。杂货店是促进购买更健康、更环境可持续食品的干预措施的一个有前景的场所。然而，目前我们缺乏对肥胖人群（PLWO）和FI人群在购买此类食品时所遇障碍的理解。通过一项在线调查（N = 583），居住在英格兰或苏格兰、体重指数≥ 30 kg/m2的成年人自我报告了FI、饮食质量以及他们在杂货店购买健康和环境可持续食品的经历。参与者还对不同的杂货店干预措施在支持更健康、更环境可持续购买方面的帮助程度进行了排序。结构方程模型显示，更高程度的FI经历与来自食品环境（如价格）、食品准备实践、较低的健康饮食知识和身体疾病方面的更大障碍经历直接相关。此外，更高程度的FI经历通过心理健康问题和与食物不安全相关的预期污名经历，间接与较低的饮食质量相关。基于价格/激励的杂货店干预措施在支持更健康、更环境可持续购买方面被列为最有帮助。这些发现强调了PLWO和FI经历较多人群在购买健康和环境可持续食品时所面临的挑战。研究结果还强调了在人口层面制定与价格和可负担性相关的政策的必要性，并提示政策制定者和医疗保健专业人员考虑如何解决心理健康问题以及如何最小化这一弱势群体所经历的预期污名。

records.title_en: Reporting nutritional information on wine packaging: Does it affect consumers’ choices? Evidence from a choice experiment in Italy
records.title_cn: 葡萄酒包装上的营养信息报告：是否影响消费者的选择？来自意大利选择实验的证据
records.abstract_en: At the end of 2023, EU Commission mandated the adoption of nutritional labelling on wine products. This was intended to tackle irresponsible drinking behaviour and excessive energy intake from alcohol, but the alcohol industry stakeholders have remained skeptical. In this study, we seek clarification on: (1) whether nutritional labelling on alcoholic beverages can nudge consumers toward lower alcohol and hence lower calorie choices, (2) whether it can affect consumers’ evaluations for quality attributes, and (3) whether it beneficially affects choices by those who are most vulnerable. We conduct an online Choice Experiment on Italian consumers with a between-subjects approach, to simulate pre- and post-policy scenarios and observe choices by consumers who are informed about nutritional features (i.e. calorie content) and contrast these to those by uninformed consumers (i.e. the control group). We focus on red wine since, in Italy, wine is part of the traditional food diet and, at the same time, quality attributes represent a major component of product distinctiveness. Results from a Latent Class Random Parameter Logit Model (LC-RPL) weakly support nutritional labelling being an effective nudge toward low-alcohol wines, specifically in the case of less vulnerable consumers who are health-conscious, with lower BMI, who enjoy red wine during social gatherings and don’t typically read wine labels. Nutritional labelling on wine bottles either did not affect or enhanced mWTP for quality attributes. Consumers generally valued calorie content on wine packaging. This supports the implementation of nutritional labelling policies.
records.abstract_cn: 在2023年底，欧盟委员会强制要求葡萄酒产品采用营养标签。此举旨在解决不负责任的饮酒行为和酒精导致的过量能量摄入，但酒精行业利益相关者仍持怀疑态度。在本研究中，我们寻求澄清以下问题：（1）酒精饮料上的营养标签是否能引导消费者选择低酒精因而低热量的选项，（2）它是否能影响消费者对质量属性的评价，以及（3）它是否对最脆弱群体的选择产生有益影响。我们对意大利消费者进行了一项在线选择实验，采用受试者间设计，模拟政策前后情景，并观察了解营养特征（即卡路里含量）的消费者与不了解的消费者（即对照组）的选择。我们专注于红葡萄酒，因为在意大利，葡萄酒是传统饮食的一部分，同时质量属性是产品差异化的主要组成部分。潜在类别随机参数Logit模型（LC-RPL）的结果弱支持营养标签作为引导消费者选择低酒精葡萄酒的有效推动力，特别是在那些注重健康、BMI较低、在社交聚会中享用红葡萄酒且通常不阅读葡萄酒标签的较不脆弱消费者中。葡萄酒瓶上的营养标签要么不影响，要么提高了对质量属性的边际支付意愿（mWTP）。消费者普遍重视葡萄酒包装上的卡路里含量。这支持了营养标签政策的实施。

records.title_en: Trade protection via tariff rate quota administration
records.title_cn: 关税配额管理下的贸易保护
records.abstract_en: In January 2022, the first dispute settlement panel convened under the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) ruled that administration procedures for Canadian tariff rate quotas (TRQs) on U.S. dairy products violated Canadian trade obligations. Canada subsequently published new dairy quota administration policies to comply with the ruling. Using a dataset with monthly bilateral dairy trade flows at the 6-digit level from January 2014 to October 2023, we empirically assess the economic outcomes associated with this dispute from the perspective of the U.S. dairy industry. We find that — even under Canada’s original quota administration procedures — Canadian dairy TRQ concessions represented meaningful trade liberalization relative to the pre-USMCA status quo. However, in light of Canada’s revised procedures following the panel ruling, U.S. exports to Canada experienced a substantial increase for affected dairy products. This indicates that Canada’s original quota administration procedures represented a “binding” trade restriction beyond the negotiated quota. USMCA dispute settlement procedures effectively worked to remove the barrier.
records.abstract_cn: 在2022年一月，根据《美国-墨西哥-加拿大协定》（USMCA）设立的首个争端解决专家组裁定，加拿大对美国乳制品的关税配额（TRQs）管理程序违反了加拿大的贸易义务。加拿大随后公布了新的乳制品配额管理政策以遵守该裁决。利用2014年一月至2023年十月期间月度双边乳制品贸易流量的6位码数据集，我们从美国乳制品行业的角度实证评估了这一争端相关的经济结果。我们发现，即使在加拿大原有的配额管理程序下，加拿大的乳制品关税配额减让相对于USMCA之前的现状也代表了有意义的贸易自由化。然而，鉴于专家组裁决后加拿大修订的程序，美国对加拿大的受影响乳制品出口出现了显著增长。这表明加拿大原有的配额管理程序构成了超出谈判配额的“约束性”贸易限制。USMCA争端解决程序有效地消除了这一障碍。

records.title_en: Urban food policy councils as politicized spaces: The case of Arusha, Tanzania
records.title_cn: 城市食品政策委员会作为政治化空间：坦桑尼亚阿鲁沙的案例
records.abstract_en: Informal food vendors constitute a significant portion of the workforce in Arusha, Tanzania, and play a crucial role in the local food system. Despite their importance, these vendors lack political and social agency, resulting in their underrepresentation in decision-making processes. This study explores the potential of urban food policy councils (UFPCs) to support these vendors, focusing on the Arusha Sustainable Food System Platform. Recently, the platform faced a government directive to relocate street vendors without their participation. This case study examines the platform’s response to this directive.
records.abstract_cn: 在坦桑尼亚阿鲁沙，非正规食品商贩构成了劳动力中的重要部分，并在当地食品系统中扮演关键角色。尽管他们很重要，但这些商贩缺乏政治和社会能动性，导致他们在决策过程中代表性不足。本研究探讨了城市食品政策委员会（UFPCs）支持这些商贩的潜力，重点关注阿鲁沙可持续食品系统平台。近期，该平台面临政府指令，要求在没有商贩参与的情况下迁移街头商贩。本案例研究考察了该平台对这一指令的回应。

records.title_en: Much ado about nothing? An empirical analysis of consumer behaviour in the presence of ‘dual food quality’
records.title_cn: 无事生非？‘双重食品质量’存在下的消费者行为实证分析
records.abstract_en: Marketing food products with slightly different compositions as identical across countries is a common practice in the food industry. While food companies argue that different versions reflect taste preferences, some Central and Eastern European consumers allege that multinational companies sell lower quality products using the same brand name and packaging as in Western European countries. The political attention gathered by this practice, exemplified by the dual food quality (DFQ) debate in the European Union (EU), has largely neglected how the presence of DFQ affects consumers’ purchase decisions. This study aims to help fill this gap. Additionally, it examines the impact of a policy intervention consisting of a ‘made for’ claim and the role of the brand name on consumer choices. Through online discrete-choice experiments and laboratory tasting and rating experiments in six EU countries, no systematic support is found for either the industry’s or the consumers’ arguments. Results also indicate that a policy requiring consumers to be informed about the destination market of different versions would increase consumers’ valuation of domestic products, while at the same time improving transparency and avoiding misleading consumers.
records.abstract_cn: 在食品行业中，将成分略有不同的食品产品作为相同产品在不同国家销售是一种常见做法。虽然食品公司辩称不同版本反映了口味偏好，但一些中欧和东欧消费者声称，跨国公司使用与西欧国家相同的品牌名称和包装销售质量较低的产品。这一做法引发的政治关注，以欧盟（EU）中的双重食品质量（DFQ）辩论为例，在很大程度上忽视了DFQ的存在如何影响消费者的购买决策。本研究旨在帮助填补这一空白。此外，本研究还考察了由‘专为’声明组成的政策干预的影响以及品牌名称在消费者选择中的作用。通过在六个欧盟国家进行的在线离散选择实验和实验室品尝与评分实验，未发现对行业或消费者论点的系统性支持。结果还表明，要求消费者了解不同版本目标市场的政策将提高消费者对国内产品的估值，同时提高透明度并避免误导消费者。

records.title_en: Assessing consumers’ valuation for Front-of-Package ‘Health’ labeling under FDA guidelines
records.title_cn: 评估FDA指南下消费者对包装正面“健康”标签的估值
records.abstract_en: Suboptimal diets contribute significantly to diet-related chronic diseases and mortality in the United States. To address this, Front-of-Pack (FOP) labels have been proposed to help consumers make healthier food choices. In 2022, the FDA introduced 15 potential health labels aimed at providing critical information and nudging consumers toward healthier food choices, yet the effects of these labels on consumer preferences remain ambiguous. Using the Becker–DeGroot–Marschak mechanism in a laboratory experiment, this study investigates the influence of health and taste labels, and information provision, on consumer willingness to pay (WTP) for yogurt qualifying for the FDA-endorsed health label. Findings indicate that health labels alone reduce WTP, potentially due to perceived compromises on taste and skepticism towards health claims. However, the addition of credible information regarding FDA qualification mitigates these negative effects. Exploratory subsample analyses reveal that the health label is discounted among consumers who are nutritionally knowledgeable, health-conscious, pleasure driven, and frequent label users. However, providing information about the health label mitigates this discount among the former three types of consumers. The study underscores the importance of providing credible, detailed information and targeted educational campaigns to enhance the effectiveness of health labels. These insights can inform policymakers and stakeholders in developing more effective food labeling strategies to promote healthier dietary choices and improve public health outcomes. By unraveling the nuances of how consumers respond to health and taste labels, our research offers valuable guidance for designing labeling strategies that resonate with consumer values and preferences.
records.abstract_cn: 次优饮食显著导致美国饮食相关慢性疾病和死亡率。为解决这一问题，包装正面（FOP）标签被提出以帮助消费者做出更健康的食品选择。在2022年，FDA引入了15种潜在健康标签，旨在提供关键信息并引导消费者选择更健康的食品，但这些标签对消费者偏好的影响仍不明确。本研究采用Becker-DeGroot-Marschak机制进行实验室实验，探讨健康标签、口味标签及信息提供对消费者对符合FDA认可健康标签的酸奶支付意愿（WTP）的影响。研究发现，仅健康标签会降低WTP，可能是由于消费者对口味妥协的感知及对健康声明的怀疑。然而，增加关于FDA资格的可靠信息可缓解这些负面影响。探索性子样本分析显示，健康标签在具有营养知识、健康意识、享乐驱动及频繁使用标签的消费者中被折价。但提供健康标签信息可缓解前三类消费者的折价现象。本研究强调了提供可靠、详细信息及针对性教育活动以增强健康标签有效性的重要性。这些见解可为政策制定者和利益相关者提供指导，以制定更有效的食品标签策略，促进更健康的饮食选择并改善公共健康结果。通过揭示消费者对健康和口味标签反应的细微差别，我们的研究为设计符合消费者价值观和偏好的标签策略提供了宝贵指导。

records.title_en: Analysis of the Italian regulatory framework on the welfare of aquatic organisms, with a focus on live crustaceans
records.title_cn: 意大利水生生物福利监管框架分析，重点关注活体甲壳类动物
records.abstract_en: The European Union regulatory framework for the welfare of aquatic organisms (AOW), live seafood (LSW) and live crustaceans intended for human consumption (LCW) is still in its nascent stages. Member States have tackled the subject with different regulatory approach, represented in Italy, by municipal regulations. The present study was designed to provide an overview of the municipal regulations pertaining to AOW, LSW, and LCW issued in Italy to date. A search was conducted on Google from December 2023 to March 2024 using specific keywords. The analysis of the regulations entailed the scrutiny of provisions concerning AOW and LSW during transport, maintenance, display and, additionally, LCW during stunning and slaughter. A total of 771 municipal regulations on animal welfare issued from 2001 to 2023 were collected. A total of 542 provisions concerning AOW were identified, while 234 and 181 provisions also addressed LSW and LCW, respectively. As regards LCW, specific regulations included the prohibition of the claws banding (85.1%), slaughter prior to sale (59.1%), and boiling of live crustaceans (33.1%). Conversely, the obligation to slaughter before sale (12.1%), after stunning (10.5%) and out of sight of the consumer (5%) were reported. The divergent and generally not scientifically-based nature of the regulations suggests limitations of the Italian approach in AOW, LSW and LCW management. In anticipation of the risk assessment-based revision of EU legislation on AOW, the results provide an updated basis for the drafting of national technical guidelines, including species-specific control checklists, for the monitoring of LCW along the entire supply chain.
records.abstract_cn: 欧盟关于水生生物福利（AOW）、供人食用的活海鲜（LSW）和活体甲壳类动物（LCW）的监管框架仍处于起步阶段。成员国以不同的监管方式处理该问题，在意大利表现为市政法规。本研究旨在概述意大利迄今发布的与AOW、LSW和LCW相关的市政法规。使用特定关键词在Google上从2023年十二月至2024年三月进行了搜索。对法规的分析涉及审查关于运输、维持、展示期间AOW和LSW的规定，以及击晕和屠宰期间LCW的规定。共收集了2001年至2023年间发布的771项关于动物福利的市政法规。共识别出542项涉及AOW的规定，其中234项和181项分别涉及LSW和LCW。关于LCW，具体规定包括禁止钳子捆绑（85.1%）、销售前屠宰（59.1%）和活煮甲壳类动物（33.1%）。相反，销售前屠宰（12.1%）、击晕后屠宰（10.5%）和消费者视线外屠宰（5%）的义务被报告。法规的分歧性和普遍缺乏科学依据表明意大利在AOW、LSW和LCW管理方法上的局限性。鉴于基于风险评估的欧盟AOW立法修订预期，结果为起草国家技术指南（包括物种特定控制检查表）提供了最新基础，用于监测整个供应链中的LCW。

records.title_en: Decompose food price disparities in China: Evidence from wholesale markets
records.title_cn: 分解中国食品价格差异：来自批发市场的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines regional variations in food prices in China and the underlying factors contributing to these disparities. Leveraging administrative data from agricultural wholesale markets, we construct spatial price indices and reveal consistent monthly trends in disparities. Using our proposed decomposition method, we identify livestock products, particularly beef and pork, as the main components driving regional food price differences. We examine the role of local supply–demand factors in explaining spatial food price variations and find that local gasoline prices are a significant contributor to food price disparity. A one percent increase in local gasoline prices leads to a 0.6 percent rise in local food prices and exacerbates spatial food price disparities by 0.5–1.0 percent. These results highlight the importance of considering transportation costs and regional supply–demand dynamics in understanding food price variations across regions. Our findings have implications for policy aiming to address regional food price disparities and ensure food affordability.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了中国食品价格的区域差异及其背后的影响因素。利用农产品批发市场的行政数据，我们构建了空间价格指数，并揭示了差异中一致的月度趋势。通过我们提出的分解方法，我们识别出畜产品，特别是牛肉和猪肉，是驱动区域食品价格差异的主要组成部分。我们考察了当地供需因素在解释空间食品价格变动中的作用，并发现当地汽油价格是食品价格差异的重要贡献因素。当地汽油价格每上涨百分之一，会导致当地食品价格上涨0.6%，并加剧空间食品价格差异0.5-1.0%。这些结果强调了在理解跨区域食品价格变动时考虑运输成本和区域供需动态的重要性。我们的发现对旨在解决区域食品价格差异和确保食品可负担性的政策具有启示意义。

records.title_en: Coping or hoping? Livelihood diversification and food insecurity in the COVID-19 pandemic
records.title_cn: 应对还是寄望？COVID-19疫情期间的生计多样化与粮食不安全
records.abstract_en: We examine the relationship between livelihood diversification and food insecurity amid the COVID-19 pandemic. Our analysis uses household panel data from Ethiopia, Malawi, and Nigeria in which the first round was collected immediately prior to the pandemic and extends through multiple rounds of monthly data collection during the pandemic. Using this pre- and post-outbreak data, and guided by a pre-analysis plan, we estimate conditional associations between livelihood diversification and food insecurity. Our results do not support the hypothesis that livelihood diversification correlates with household resilience. Though income diversification may serve as an effective coping mechanism for small-scale shocks, we find that for a disaster on the scale of the pandemic this strategy is not effective. Policymakers looking to prepare for the increased occurrence of large-scale disasters will need to grapple with the fact that coping strategies that gave people hope in the past may fail them as they try to cope with the future.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了COVID-19疫情期间生计多样化与粮食不安全之间的关系。我们的分析使用了来自埃塞俄比亚、马拉维和尼日利亚的家庭面板数据，其中第一轮数据在疫情爆发前立即收集，并延伸至疫情期间多轮月度数据收集。利用这些疫情前后的数据，并在预分析计划的指导下，我们估计了生计多样化与粮食不安全之间的条件关联。我们的结果不支持生计多样化与家庭韧性相关的假设。尽管收入多样化可能作为小规模冲击的有效应对机制，但我们发现，对于疫情规模级别的灾难，这一策略并不有效。寻求为日益频繁的大规模灾害做准备的政策制定者将不得不面对这样一个事实：过去给人们带来希望的应对策略，在他们试图应对未来时可能会失效。

records.title_en: Promises and uncertainties in the cultivated proteins market: Perspectives from Germany and Brazil
records.title_cn: 培养蛋白市场中的承诺与不确定性：来自德国和巴西的视角
authors: Beatrice de Freitas Martins da Silva
records.abstract_en: Cultivated meat offers an alternative to ensure food security and mitigate greenhouse gas emissions from conventional animal production. As the innovation remains in its nascent stages, policymakers require a better understanding of the market’s potential, trajectory and future development perspectives. To support policymakers in developing flexible and effective policy frameworks for cultivated meat, we analyze perspectives about the trajectory of the cultivated meat market by 2040 in a comparative study of two countries, which are both major conventional meat markets and developers of alternative protein sources: Brazil and Germany. We use the Q-methodology to identify future perspectives and examine the influence of conventional meat industry incumbents on cultivated meat governance. Our sample includes 59 stakeholders working on cultivated and conventional meat. These perspectives can aid in decision-making related to investments in technological development, improvements in the sensory attributes of cultivated products, support for entrepreneurial ecosystems and startups, product hybridization, consumer and stakeholder engagement, the development of human capital, and regulatory schemes.
records.abstract_cn: 培养肉提供了一种替代方案，以确保食品安全并减少传统动物生产产生的温室气体排放。由于该创新仍处于初期阶段，政策制定者需要更好地了解市场的潜力、发展轨迹和未来前景。为了支持政策制定者制定灵活有效的培养肉政策框架，我们在一项比较研究中分析了到2040年培养肉市场发展轨迹的视角，研究对象是两个既是传统肉类主要市场又是替代蛋白来源开发者的国家：巴西和德国。我们使用Q方法论来识别未来视角，并考察传统肉类行业现有企业对培养肉治理的影响。我们的样本包括59名从事培养肉和传统肉类的利益相关者。这些视角有助于与技术开发投资、培养产品感官属性改进、创业生态系统和初创企业支持、产品杂交、消费者和利益相关者参与、人力资本开发以及监管方案相关的决策。

records.title_en: Vulnerability of US dairy farms to extreme heat
records.title_cn: 美国奶牛场对极端高温的脆弱性
records.abstract_en: Livestock agriculture, and dairy more specifically, is threatened by climate change as extreme weather conditions become more frequent. When temperature and humidity increase above critical levels, dairy cows become heat-stressed and experience a drop in milk production. We quantify the impact of heat stress on the dairy industry throughout the Midwestern and Eastern United States in the years 2012–2016 using animal-level production data. We estimate that 1% of total annual yield is lost to heat stress, and losses are predicted to increase about 30% by 2050 on average under various climate scenarios. We provide three new insights compared to previous estimates with aggregated data. (1) Heat stress disproportionately affects milk quality, having larger impacts on farm income and nutritional value than previously estimated. (2) Small farms experience the largest losses to heat stress, suggesting they face barriers to adaptation. (3) Cows in the highest-yield production stage are the most vulnerable to heat stress in both relative and absolute terms. Our results have global implications given the prevalence of dairy as a source of income and nutrition in high- and low-income contexts. We outline ways that funds for climate-smart agriculture could be used to increase climate resilience in the dairy industry.
records.abstract_cn: 畜牧业，尤其是奶牛养殖，正受到气候变化的威胁，因为极端天气事件变得更加频繁。当温度和湿度超过临界水平时，奶牛会遭受热应激，导致产奶量下降。我们利用动物层面的生产数据，量化了2012-2016年间美国中西部和东部地区热应激对奶牛养殖业的影响。我们估计，每年总产量的1%因热应激而损失，并且在各种气候情景下，到2050年损失预计平均增加约30%。与以往使用汇总数据的估计相比，我们提供了三个新见解。（1）热应激对牛奶质量的影响不成比例地大，对农场收入和营养价值的影响比以往估计的更大。（2）小型农场因热应激遭受的损失最大，这表明它们面临适应障碍。（3）处于最高产奶阶段的奶牛在相对和绝对意义上都最容易受到热应激的影响。鉴于奶牛养殖在高低收入环境中作为收入和营养来源的普遍性，我们的结果具有全球意义。我们概述了气候智能型农业资金可用于提高奶牛养殖业气候韧性的途径。

records.title_en: Consumer support of policy measures to increase sustainability in food consumption
records.title_cn: 消费者对提高食品消费可持续性的政策措施的支持
records.abstract_en: The modern global food system is an important driver of climate change. Policy measures are one potential lever for shifting consumption towards more sustainability. Public acceptance can be a major barrier for the implementation of such measures. Thus, a profound understanding of consumers is needed to facilitate policy support. In the present study, we therefore invited 453 participants from German-speaking parts of Switzerland to participate in an online survey in which we tested 15 policy measures for their consumer acceptance. Furthermore, we explored individual predictors that contribute to policy support. Our results show that there is a difference in the support of policy measures depending on the level of intrusiveness, making less intrusive measures more accepted than more intrusive measures. Support also varied depending on the targeted product category. Measures targeting dairy and meat products tended to be less accepted than measures targeting vegetables. Using a regression analysis, we identified behaviour (i.e. meat and dairy consumption) and food sustainability knowledge as an important predictor of policy support. The findings have important implications for policymakers, as they illustrate that personal involvement is a crucial factor in policy support. Taken together, our findings can help inform future food policies to increase consumer support and thereby facilitate sustainable behaviour change.
records.abstract_cn: 现代全球食品系统是气候变化的重要驱动因素。政策措施是推动消费向更可持续方向转变的一个潜在杠杆。公众接受度可能是实施此类措施的主要障碍。因此，深入了解消费者对于促进政策支持至关重要。在本研究中，我们邀请了来自瑞士德语区的453名参与者参加一项在线调查，测试了15项政策措施的消费者接受度。此外，我们探讨了有助于政策支持的个人预测因素。我们的结果显示，政策措施的支持度因其干预程度的不同而有所差异，干预程度较低的措施比干预程度较高的措施更容易被接受。支持度也因目标产品类别而异。针对乳制品和肉类的措施往往不如针对蔬菜的措施被接受。通过回归分析，我们确定了行为（即肉类和乳制品消费）和食品可持续性知识是政策支持的重要预测因素。这些发现对政策制定者具有重要意义，因为它们表明个人参与是政策支持的关键因素。总的来说，我们的发现可以为未来的食品政策提供信息，以增加消费者支持，从而促进可持续行为改变。

records.title_en: Can differentiated value-added tax rates promote healthier diets? The case of Costa Rica
records.title_cn: 差别增值税税率能否促进更健康的饮食？哥斯达黎加的案例
records.abstract_en: In February 2023, Costa Rica reformed its basic value-added tax basket on which a reduced rate applies to “guarantee a balanced diet”. This paper assesses ex-ante the impact of the reform on nutrient availability and household spending across income groups. Price elasticities are estimated using pooled National Household Income and Expenditure Survey data and a two-step censored quadratic almost ideal demand system model accounting for price and total expenditure endogeneity. Nutritional information is derived from food composition tables. Food items are grouped by processing level as a proxy to explore differences in own- and cross-price effects between ‘healthier’ and ‘less healthy’ items. The demand for ultra-processed sweet and savoury foods is price-inelastic (−0.74 and −0.81, respectively). Lower-income households’ demand is more price-sensitive. The reform applies a reduced rate to a significant number of ultra-processed savoury food items and is associated with an increase in household purchases of calories (0.7%), sugar (0.4%), and saturated fat (1.2%). A counterfactual scenario with a basic tax basket defined based on the Pan American Health Organization nutrient profile model criteria is associated with the largest reductions in calories (−0.2%), sodium (−1.0%), and saturated fat (−0.6%), with higher benefits for lower-income households. It results in minor decreases in household spending (−0.2%). While an increasing number of countries contemplate the taxation of foods high in fat, salt, or sugar, Costa Rica is unique in mandating the consideration of nutritional aspects in determining value-added tax rates. However, the recently adopted basic tax basket may not fulfil this potential.
records.abstract_cn: 2023年二月，哥斯达黎加改革了其基本增值税篮子，对适用低税率的商品以“保障均衡饮食”。本文事前评估了该改革对不同收入群体营养素可获得性和家庭支出的影响。使用汇总的国家家庭收入与支出调查数据，并采用考虑价格和总支出内生性的两步审查二次几乎理想需求系统模型估计价格弹性。营养信息来源于食物成分表。食品按加工水平分组，作为探索‘更健康’与‘不太健康’商品之间自身和交叉价格效应差异的代理。超加工甜味和咸味食品的需求缺乏价格弹性（分别为-0.74和-0.81）。低收入家庭的需求对价格更敏感。该改革对大量超加工咸味食品适用低税率，并与家庭卡路里（0.7%）、糖（0.4%）和饱和脂肪（1.2%）购买量的增加相关。基于泛美卫生组织营养素概况模型标准定义基本税收篮子的反事实情景，与卡路里（-0.2%）、钠（-1.0%）和饱和脂肪（-0.6%）的最大减少相关，对低收入家庭带来更大益处。这导致家庭支出小幅减少（-0.2%）。虽然越来越多的国家考虑对高脂肪、高盐或高糖食品征税，但哥斯达黎加在确定增值税税率时强制考虑营养方面是独特的。然而，最近采用的基本税收篮子可能无法实现这一潜力。

records.title_en: Machine learning on national shopping data reliably estimates childhood obesity prevalence and socio-economic deprivation
records.title_cn: 基于全国购物数据的机器学习可靠估计儿童肥胖患病率与社会经济剥夺
records.abstract_en: Deprivation pushes people to choose cheap, calorie-dense foods instead of nutritious but expensive alternatives. Diseases, such as obesity, cardiovascular disease, and diabetes, resulting from these poor dietary choices place a significant burden on public health systems. Measuring nutritional insecurity is difficult to achieve at scale and so the ability to study the relationship between nutritional outcomes and deprivation at a national level is very challenging. This makes it difficult to understand the effect of new policies or track changes over time. To address this challenge, we develop a machine learning approach using massive anonymised transactional data (4 million members and 2.5 billion transactions) in partnership with the retailer The Co-operative Group UK. We engineer a series of variables related to obesogenic diets, including a new measure called ‘Calorie-oriented purchasing’. These variables help illustrate how large-scale transactional data can discriminate between neighbourhoods most affected by deprivation and childhood obesity. Through comparative assessment of machine learning approaches, we find better performance from tree-based models (Random Forest, XGBoost) with the best-achieving accuracy of 0.88 for predicting deprivation and an accuracy of 0.79 for childhood obesity. Calorie-oriented purchasing emerges as a robust predictor of deprivation and childhood obesity at the census area level. Results show this approach can help summarise nutritional insecurity, and support its spatio-temporal monitoring. We conclude with policy implications and recommend retailers adopt new measures for measuring national nutrition insecurity.
records.abstract_cn: 剥夺促使人们选择廉价、高热量的食物，而非营养丰富但昂贵的替代品。由这些不良饮食选择导致的疾病，如肥胖、心血管疾病和糖尿病，给公共卫生系统带来了沉重负担。大规模衡量营养不安全难以实现，因此在全国层面研究营养结果与剥夺之间的关系非常具有挑战性。这使得理解新政策的效果或随时间追踪变化变得困难。为应对这一挑战，我们与零售商The Co-operative Group UK合作，开发了一种机器学习方法，使用大规模匿名交易数据（4百万会员和2.5十亿笔交易）。我们设计了一系列与致肥胖饮食相关的变量，包括一项名为“卡路里导向购买”的新指标。这些变量有助于说明大规模交易数据如何区分受剥夺和儿童肥胖影响最严重的社区。通过机器学习方法的比较评估，我们发现基于树的模型（随机森林、XGBoost）表现更好，预测剥夺的最佳准确率为0.88，预测儿童肥胖的准确率为0.79。卡路里导向购买在人口普查区层面成为剥夺和儿童肥胖的稳健预测因子。结果表明，这种方法有助于总结营养不安全，并支持其时空监测。我们最后提出政策含义，并建议零售商采用新措施来衡量国家营养不安全。

records.title_en: Where to buy and what to eat: The relationship between purchasing channels and nutrient intake in Japan
records.title_cn: 在哪里购买与吃什么：日本购买渠道与营养素摄入之间的关系
records.abstract_en: Interventions in the food environment to improve nutrient intake are often proposed with the goals of reducing obesity and non-communicable diseases. Prior studies exploring relationships between the food environment and nutrient intake have assumed that most purchased food is consumed without examining direct correlations between purchasing channels and nutrient intake. This study addresses this research gap by analyzing correlations between purchasing channels, nutrient intake, and body mass index (BMI) using a unique dataset from Japan combining individual purchase records and nutrient intake data for men and women over 40 years of age. We also introduced a method to assess non-discretionary macronutrient intake ratios—proportions that remain stable across such factors as food access and demographics. Our results reveal a generally weak correlation between purchasing channels and both caloric intake and BMI; however, among individuals who are not overweight, frequent convenience store purchases were linked to lower caloric intake. We identified a non-discretionary macronutrient intake ratio, primarily carbohydrates, of approximately 3.5 % (standard error 9.7 × 10−5) in non-overweight individuals. After accounting for non-discretionary intake ratios, the correlation between purchasing channels and macronutrient intake ratios remained weak. Policies targeting discretionary nutrient intake may have potential to improve overall nutrient consumption, because factors beyond purchasing channels are more likely to influence discretionary intake.
records.abstract_cn: 旨在改善营养素摄入的食物环境干预措施通常以减少肥胖和非传染性疾病为目标。先前探讨食物环境与营养素摄入之间关系的研究假设大多数购买的食物被消费，而未直接检验购买渠道与营养素摄入之间的相关性。本研究通过使用日本独特的结合个人购买记录和40岁以上男性和女性营养素摄入数据的数据集，分析购买渠道、营养素摄入和体重指数（BMI）之间的相关性，填补了这一研究空白。我们还引入了一种方法来评估非自主性宏量营养素摄入比例——这些比例在食物获取和人口统计学等因素中保持稳定。我们的结果显示，购买渠道与热量摄入和BMI之间的相关性总体较弱；然而，在非超重个体中，频繁的便利店购买与较低的热量摄入相关。我们识别出非超重个体中非自主性宏量营养素摄入比例，主要为碳水化合物，约为3.5（标准误9.7×10−5）。在考虑非自主性摄入比例后，购买渠道与宏量营养素摄入比例之间的相关性仍然较弱。针对自主性营养素摄入的政策可能具有改善整体营养素消费的潜力，因为购买渠道以外的因素更可能影响自主性摄入。

records.title_en: What’s the Buzz? Preferences and perceptions of policies to reduce childhood energy drink consumption
records.title_cn: 喧嚣背后？减少儿童能量饮料消费政策的偏好与认知
records.abstract_en: As global energy drink sales and caffeine content have surged, so have public health concerns over childhood energy drink consumption. With limited regulatory oversight, potential adverse effects, and recent claims of targeted marketing toward children, there is a need to better understand society’s evolving relationship with energy drink markets. This study uses experimental and survey data from a national panel of 1,036 U.S. adults to assess consumer preferences and perceptions toward energy drink policies and marketing. First, we use a best-worst scaling experiment to assess preferences for energy drink labeling requirements, sales channel bans, marketing restrictions, and caffeine caps relative to the status quo. A randomized information treatment also considers how information from health agencies highlighting risks to childhood health affects policy preferences. Without this information, respondents have the strongest preference fora mandatory and prominently displayed caffeine content label. Providing information on the potential childhood health risks, however, increases the relative ranking of policies banning sales to children in retail outlets and high schools. The exploratory survey analysis then provides insights into marketing perceptions that open avenues for future research. For example, we show that it takes the average consumer more than twice as long to find the caffeine content of an energy drink than its calorie count, most consumers believe energy drink packaging is at least somewhat appealing to children, and the perceived target audience of social media marketing varies across brands. These results and the corresponding discussion provide important global policy-relevant insights as the energy drink market develops.
records.abstract_cn: 随着全球能量饮料销量和咖啡因含量的激增，公众对儿童能量饮料消费的健康担忧也随之增加。在监管有限、潜在不良影响以及近期关于针对儿童定向营销的指控背景下，有必要更好地理解社会与能量饮料市场之间不断演变的关系。本研究利用来自全国1,036名美国成年人的实验和调查数据，评估消费者对能量饮料政策和营销的偏好与认知。首先，我们使用最佳-最差标度实验来评估相对于现状，消费者对能量饮料标签要求、销售渠道禁令、营销限制和咖啡因上限的偏好。一项随机信息处理还考虑了健康机构强调儿童健康风险的信息如何影响政策偏好。在没有这些信息的情况下，受访者对强制且显著展示的咖啡因含量标签有最强的偏好。然而，提供关于潜在儿童健康风险的信息会提高禁止在零售店和高中向儿童销售政策的相对排名。探索性调查分析随后提供了对营销认知的见解，为未来研究开辟了途径。例如，我们表明，普通消费者找到能量饮料咖啡因含量所需的时间是找到其卡路里含量的两倍多，大多数消费者认为能量饮料包装至少在一定程度上对儿童有吸引力，并且社交媒体营销的感知目标受众因品牌而异。这些结果及相应的讨论为能量饮料市场发展提供了重要的全球政策相关见解。

records.title_en: How does global agricultural research and innovation cooperation influence agricultural R&I system transformation in the South? Evidence from UK-China cooperation
records.title_cn: 全球农业研究与创新合作如何影响南方农业研发与创新体系转型？来自中英合作的证据
records.abstract_en: The need for agri-food system transformation has sparked extensive debates on reconfiguring the agricultural research and innovation system (ARIS) to tackle the multidimensional and interwoven challenges present across geographies and scales. This paper highlights the emergence of China, India and Brazil, and their increasing influence on ARIS in the South. We conceptualise global agricultural R&I cooperation (ARIC) to examine how the changing nature of the cooperation between major players from the North and the South influences ARIS transformation in the South. We propose a local–global nexus (LGN) framework to reveal multiple processes involving researchers and non-academic actors for joint knowledge production and social impact across scales. We explore LGN’s feasibility through a case study of UK-China cooperation to illustrate the necessity and key factors influencing the participation of non-academic actors including smallholder farmers in ARIC. Evidence for this paper comes from a combination of primary data collected from 52 British scientists, representatives of funding agencies and entrepreneurs regarding their experiences, opinions and perceptions of ARIC through bilateral cooperation, and second sources. This paper contributes to ARIS transformation debates from three perspectives. First, it sheds new light on transformative innovation debates by adding an ARIC element for ARIS transformation in the South. Second, it enriches a “pathways approach” by delineating four pathways of ARIC, as well as top-down and bottom-up processes across various scales. Third, it offers an LGN framework for ARIC research to address the complexity, diversity and opportunities for ARIS transformation towards sustainable and equitable agri-food systems in the South.
records.abstract_cn: 农业食品系统转型的需求引发了关于重新配置农业研究与创新体系（ARIS）以应对跨地域和跨尺度的多维交织挑战的广泛讨论。本文强调了中、印、巴的崛起及其对南方ARIS日益增长的影响。我们概念化全球农业研发与创新合作（ARIC），以考察北方与南方主要参与者之间合作性质的变化如何影响南方ARIS的转型。我们提出了一个地方-全球联结（LGN）框架，以揭示涉及研究人员和非学术行动者在跨尺度联合知识生产和社会影响中的多重过程。我们通过中英合作的案例研究探讨LGN的可行性，以说明非学术行动者（包括小农户）参与ARIC的必要性和关键影响因素。本文的证据来自一手数据和二手资料的结合，一手数据收集自52位英国科学家、资助机构代表和企业家，涉及他们通过双边合作对ARIC的经验、观点和看法。本文从三个角度对ARIS转型辩论做出贡献。首先，通过为南方ARIS转型增加ARIC元素，为变革性创新辩论提供了新的视角。其次，通过描绘ARIC的四条路径以及跨尺度的自上而下和自下而上的过程，丰富了“路径方法”。第三，为ARIC研究提供了一个LGN框架，以应对南方ARIS向可持续和公平农业食品系统转型的复杂性、多样性和机遇。

records.title_en: Cutting VAT rate on food products in a high-inflation environment. Does it work out?
records.title_cn: 高通胀环境下削减食品增值税税率是否有效？
records.abstract_en: In February 2022, the Polish government reduced the VAT rate on basic food products from 5% to 0% in order to curb elevated inflation. Using multiple state-of-the-art robust estimators within a dynamic difference-in-differences approach, we estimated that the VAT rate reduction initially contributed to an average 2.1–2.8% decrease in the prices of affected products. Therefore, the immediate pass-through of the tax reduction in retail food prices was limited (only 44.0–58.2%), resulting in a 0.3–0.4 percentage point decrease in headline inflation. The effect of the VAT rate cut reached its peak within 5 months, achieving an almost full pass-through of approximately 94.6%, which led to a reduction in headline inflation by about 0.7 percentage points. We argue that the high effectiveness of the VAT reduction in Poland would not have been possible without the active role of the Office of Competition and Consumer Protection. Lowering VAT rate limited the budgetary revenues by only 0.3% GDP (value equivalent to 0.5% of private consumption), which means that it was a relatively cost-effective tool in providing relief to households in a high-inflation environment, especially for poorer consumers with a higher share of food in total expenditures.
records.abstract_cn: 2022年二月，波兰政府将基本食品的增值税税率从5%降至0%，以抑制高企的通货膨胀。采用动态双重差分方法中的多种先进稳健估计量，我们估计增值税税率下调最初使受影响产品价格平均下降2.1-2.8%。因此，税收减免在零售食品价格中的即时传导有限（仅为44.0-58.2%），导致总体通胀率下降0.3-0.4个百分点。增值税削减的效果在5个月内达到峰值，实现了约94.6%的几乎完全传导，使总体通胀率下降约0.7个百分点。我们认为，如果没有竞争与消费者保护局的积极作用，波兰增值税削减的高效性是不可能实现的。降低增值税税率仅使预算收入减少GDP的0.3%（相当于私人消费的0.5%），这意味着在高通胀环境下，这是一种相对成本效益较高的工具，为家庭提供救济，尤其是对食品支出占比较高的贫困消费者而言。

records.title_en: The effect of food price upsurges on income inequality: The richest win and the poorest lose
records.title_cn: 食品价格上涨对收入不平等的影响：最富者获益，最穷者受损
records.abstract_en: From a theoretical perspective, the ultimate effect that food price shocks may have on inequality is ambiguous. Food price shocks, indeed, generate both winners and losers and their overall impact on income distribution cannot be predicted a priori but depends on the relative magnitude of different effects. From the empirical perspective, however, the link between international food prices and income distribution is largely understudied. The present paper tries to fill the gap by analyzing a large sample of 126 developing and developed countries observed in the period 1990–2020 and studying how food price shocks are associated with changes in income distribution. The heterogeneity of the effect is investigated by means of interaction terms accounting for the food trade balance of countries and the structure of the agricultural sector, coming to three main conclusions. First, upsurging food prices increase inequality by affecting the relative income of the poorest 50 percent of the population to the advantage of richer people, especially of the richest among the rich. Second, this effect is relevant for developing countries while no clear findings emerge for high-income countries. Third, the disequalizing effect of soaring international food prices is not uniform in developing countries but largely depends on their food trade balance and some structural attributes of their agricultural sector. In this regard, food policy must reduce the domestic transmission of price shocks to poor consumers while strengthening farmers’ productive capacity and ability to cope with the shocks through better access to land, capital and productive resources.
records.abstract_cn: 从理论角度看，食品价格冲击对不平等可能产生的最终影响是不确定的。实际上，食品价格冲击既会产生赢家也会产生输家，其对收入分配的总体影响无法事先预测，而是取决于不同效应的相对大小。然而，从实证角度看，国际食品价格与收入分配之间的联系在很大程度上尚未得到充分研究。本文试图通过分析1990-2020年期间观察到的126个发展中国家和发达国家的大样本，并研究食品价格冲击如何与收入分配变化相关联，来填补这一空白。通过考虑国家食品贸易平衡和农业部门结构的交互项来研究效应的异质性，得出三个主要结论。第一，食品价格上涨通过影响最贫困的50%人口的相对收入，使较富裕人群，尤其是最富者中的最富者受益，从而加剧了不平等。第二，这种效应对发展中国家显著，而对高收入国家则没有明确的发现。第三，国际食品价格飙升的不平等效应在发展中国家并非一致，而在很大程度上取决于其食品贸易平衡和农业部门的一些结构性特征。在这方面，食品政策必须减少价格冲击对贫困消费者的国内传导，同时通过改善土地、资本和生产资源的获取来增强农民的生产能力和应对冲击的能力。

records.title_en: Self-Enforcing Environmental Agreements with the Optimal Intensity of Cooperation
records.title_cn: 最优合作强度下的自我执行环境协议
records.abstract_en: This paper analyzes international environmental agreements in three-stage games consisting of a membership subgame, the signatories’ decision on the intensity of cooperation, and an emissions subgame. Signatories may act as Stackelberg leaders or play Nash. In the Stackelberg game, the highest intensity of cooperation between signatories is optimal. In the Nash game, a moderate or the highest intensity of cooperation is optimal if emissions are strategic substitutes. In this case the equilibrium emissions and the stable coalition of the Nash game with optimal cooperation intensity are identical to the equilibrium emissions and the stable coalition of the Stackelberg game with the highest cooperation intensity. Finally, we apply our results to coalition formation games of the literature. In the applied Nash games, optimizing with respect to the cooperation intensity may enlarge the stable coalition up to the grand coalition which implements the first best.
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了由成员资格子博弈、签署国关于合作强度的决策以及排放子博弈组成的三阶段博弈中的国际环境协议。签署国可能作为斯塔克伯格领导者行动或进行纳什博弈。在斯塔克伯格博弈中，签署国之间的最高合作强度是最优的。在纳什博弈中，如果排放是战略替代品，则中等或最高的合作强度是最优的。在这种情况下，具有最优合作强度的纳什博弈的均衡排放和稳定联盟与具有最高合作强度的斯塔克伯格博弈的均衡排放和稳定联盟相同。最后，我们将我们的结果应用于文献中的联盟形成博弈。在应用的纳什博弈中，相对于合作强度进行优化可能会将稳定联盟扩大至实施最优的大联盟。

records.title_en: Thirsty for Trade: How Globalization Shapes Virtual Water Trade
records.title_cn: 渴望贸易：全球化如何塑造虚拟水贸易
records.abstract_en: We investigate the distributional implications of trade policy (import tariffs) for virtual water embodied in traded agricultural products. To do this, we undertake an econometric analysis and counterfactual simulation exercise using a structural gravity framework to quantify the impacts of (i) preferential tariff schemes and (ii) hypothetical global tariff liberalization for virtual water trade in 15 major primary agricultural commodities. We find that tariff preferences have been responsible for increased virtual water exports from developing water-scarce countries predominantly located in Africa and Asia. Conversely, tariff preferences are responsible for higher levels of virtual water imports by countries in the Americas, Europe, and the Middle East. However, we estimate that further trade liberalization would reverse this pattern and benefit many water-scarce countries in the Global South in securing their domestic water resources.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了贸易政策（进口关税）对贸易农产品中隐含的虚拟水的分配影响。为此，我们采用结构引力框架进行了计量经济分析和反事实模拟，以量化（i）优惠关税方案和（ii）假设的全球关税自由化对15种主要初级农产品虚拟水贸易的影响。我们发现，关税优惠促进了主要位于非洲和亚洲的发展中缺水国家的虚拟水出口增加。相反，关税优惠导致美洲、欧洲和中东国家的虚拟水进口水平提高。然而，我们估计，进一步的贸易自由化将逆转这一模式，并使全球南方的许多缺水国家在保障其国内水资源方面受益。

records.title_en: The ‘Climate Adaptation Problem’ in Biodiversity Conservation: The Value of Spatial Flexibility in Land Purchase
records.title_cn: 生物多样性保护中的“气候适应问题”：土地购买中空间灵活性的价值
authors: Charlotte Gerling (Brandenburg University of Technology Cottbus-Senftenberg)
Oliver Schöttker (Brandenburg University of Technology Cottbus-Senftenberg)
records.abstract_en: Existing reserve networks become less suitable as species’ ranges shift under climate change and the scarcity and value of habitats change. Reserve sites hence have to be reallocated to reflect these changing values and to remain cost-effective, but restrictions on selling reserve sites limit this adaptation. Under climate change, a novel ‘sale’ policy that provides resale flexibility by allowing increasingly less cost-effective sites to be sold to free funds for purchasing increasingly cost-effective sites may hence be preferable over a typical ‘no sale’ policy. Here, we develop a conceptual climate-ecological-economic model to examine under what conditions resale flexibility provides cost-effectiveness advantages. We find that the benefits of resale flexibility provided by the ’sale’ policy are particularly high when little funding is available for climate change adaptation. Due to this budget effect, the value of resale flexibility also decreases with increasing interest rates. The value of resale flexibility is particularly high when creating reserves for species that are highly mobile as new reserve sites may then be chosen freely (in comparison to the case that new sites have to be located in the proximity of existing reserve sites). We further examine to what extent the ‘sale’ policy reduces the permanence of habitat within a specific location (“site habitat permanence”), and identify a new trade-off: ’sale’ provides advantages for habitat types that become increasingly rare, while ’no sale’ improves site habitat permanence mainly for expanding habitat types.
records.abstract_cn: 随着气候变化下物种分布范围的变化以及栖息地稀缺性和价值的改变，现有的保护区网络变得不再适用。因此，保护区地点需要重新分配以反映这些变化的价值并保持成本效益，但对出售保护区地点的限制限制了这种适应。在气候变化下，一种新颖的“出售”政策，通过允许出售越来越不具成本效益的地点以释放资金用于购买越来越具成本效益的地点，从而提供转售灵活性，可能比典型的“不出售”政策更可取。在此，我们开发了一个概念性的气候-生态-经济模型，以检验在何种条件下转售灵活性提供成本效益优势。我们发现，“出售”政策提供的转售灵活性的好处在可用于气候适应资金很少时尤其高。由于这种预算效应，转售灵活性的价值也随着利率的上升而降低。当为高度移动的物种建立保护区时，转售灵活性的价值尤其高，因为新的保护区地点可以自由选择（与必须位于现有保护区附近的情况相比）。我们进一步检验了“出售”政策在多大程度上降低了特定地点内栖息地的持久性（“地点栖息地持久性”），并识别出一个新的权衡：“出售”对变得越来越稀有的栖息地类型有利，而“不出售”主要改善扩张栖息地类型的地点栖息地持久性。

records.title_en: Willingness to Pay for Nature Protection: Crowdfunding as a Payment Mechanism
records.title_cn: 自然保护的支付意愿：众筹作为支付机制
authors: Maria A. Cunha-e-Sá (Universidade Nova de Lisboa)
Luis Catela Nunes (Universidade Nova de Lisboa)
Margarida Ortigão (Universidade Nova de Lisboa Universidade de Lisboa)
Renato Rosa (Universidade Nova de Lisboa Faculty of Economics, Universidade de Coimbra)
Carina Vieira-da-Silva (Faculdade de Direito da Universidade de Lisboa)
records.abstract_en: In this study, we use a discrete choice experiment to elicit the willingness-to-pay (WTP) for preventing and mitigating the effects of oil spills on marine and coastal ecosystem services, along a particularly vulnerable coastal region of mainland Portugal. We used a split-sample design to analyze the differences between two payment vehicles (PV): a mandatory extra income tax and a voluntary contribution collected by a crowdfunding campaign with a provision point mechanism and a money-back guarantee. The difference between the two PVs is examined in a setting where the local population has a negative perception of the quality of institutions. We find that respondents are more willing to contribute when presented with the crowdfunding version. Also, regardless of the payment vehicle, respondents who express a mistrust in institutions are more likely to choose the status quo. These results suggest the potential of using crowdfunding to support ecosystem services’ conservation initiatives.
records.abstract_cn: 在本研究中，我们采用离散选择实验来引出对防止和减轻石油泄漏对海洋和沿海生态系统服务影响的支付意愿（WTP），研究区域位于葡萄牙大陆一个特别脆弱的沿海地区。我们使用了分裂样本设计来分析两种支付工具（PV）之间的差异：强制性附加所得税和通过众筹活动收集的自愿捐款，该众筹活动设有提供点机制和退款保证。在地方居民对机构质量持负面看法的背景下，考察了两种支付工具之间的差异。我们发现，当呈现众筹版本时，受访者更愿意贡献。此外，无论支付工具如何，对机构表示不信任的受访者更可能选择现状。这些结果表明，利用众筹支持生态系统服务保护倡议具有潜力。

records.title_en: Transaction Costs, Participation, and the Cost-Effectiveness of Reverse Auctions: Evidence from a Laboratory Experiment
records.title_cn: 交易成本、参与及反向拍卖的成本效益：来自实验室实验的证据
records.abstract_en: Reverse auctions are often recognized as a tool that can cost-effectively allocate agri-environmental program funds to support environmentally-beneficial land management practices. However, transaction costs can limit participation in auctions which limits their cost-effectiveness. We use a laboratory experiment to examine how various levels of transaction costs influence participation and bidding behavior in discriminatory-price reverse auctions in low and high budget scenarios. Our experimental results show that transaction costs limit auction participation, increase bid amounts, and reduce cost-effectiveness. The negative effect of transaction costs on participation is particularly large when the budget level is low. Using the results of our experiment, we design a simulation to investigate whether reducing transaction costs via subsidies could increase program cost-effectiveness under various conditions. We find that transaction cost subsidies increase auction cost-effectiveness; however, our study raises new questions about how these subsidies are designed and the implications for the overall costs and benefits of efforts to reduce transaction costs in reverse auctions.
records.abstract_cn: 反向拍卖常被视为一种能够以成本效益方式分配农业环境项目资金，以支持有益于环境的土地管理实践的工具。然而，交易成本可能限制拍卖参与，从而限制其成本效益。我们使用实验室实验来考察不同水平的交易成本如何影响低价和高预算情景下歧视性价格反向拍卖中的参与和投标行为。我们的实验结果表明，交易成本限制了拍卖参与，增加了投标金额，并降低了成本效益。当预算水平较低时，交易成本对参与的负面影响尤为显著。利用我们的实验结果，我们设计了一个模拟，以调查在各种条件下，通过补贴减少交易成本是否能提高项目的成本效益。我们发现，交易成本补贴提高了拍卖的成本效益；然而，我们的研究提出了关于这些补贴如何设计的新问题，以及其对减少反向拍卖中交易成本努力的总体成本和收益的影响。

records.title_en: The Amenity Value of Bicycle Infrastructure: A Hedonic Application to Greater Manchester, UK
records.title_cn: 自行车基础设施的舒适性价值：对英国大曼彻斯特的享乐主义应用
records.abstract_en: Using hedonic and spatial regressions, this paper estimates a significantly larger association between proximity to bicycle networks and property prices than previously reported. As cities face increasing challenges of congestion and pollution, many are implementing policies to integrate bicycle facilities and other active modes of transport. However, policymakers are slow to support these initiatives and remain skeptical due to the investment costs required and appropriation of limited land. Drawing on a large dataset of approximately 253,000 transactions in Greater Manchester, over a 9-year period, we find clear evidenced that a 1 km reduction in distance to the nearest bicycle network is associated with property values being around 2.8% higher, on average, and 7.7% higher in the central borough of Manchester. We also provide an applied example to rank new bicycle routes by comparing their benefit-to-cost ratios and a discussion on the property tax system.
records.abstract_cn: 利用享乐回归和空间回归，本文估计了自行车网络邻近性与房产价格之间的关联，其显著大于先前报告的结果。随着城市面临日益严重的拥堵和污染挑战，许多城市正在实施政策以整合自行车设施和其他主动交通方式。然而，政策制定者对这些举措的支持缓慢，并且由于所需的投资成本和有限土地的占用而持怀疑态度。基于大曼彻斯特约253,000笔交易的大型数据集，跨越9年时间，我们发现明确证据表明，距离最近自行车网络的距离每减少1公里，房产价值平均高出约2.8%，在曼彻斯特中心城区则高出7.7%。我们还提供了一个应用实例，通过比较效益成本比来对新自行车路线进行排序，并讨论了房产税制度。

records.title_en: Agentizing a General Equilibrium Model of Environmental Tax Reform
records.title_cn: 环境税改革的一般均衡模型的代理化
authors: Franziska Klein (Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona Mercator Research Institute on Global Commons and Climate Change Wageningen University)
Jeroen van den Bergh (Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona VU University Amsterdam VU University Amsterdam ICREA)
Joël Foramitti (Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona VU University Amsterdam)
Théo Konc (Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona Technical University of Berlin Potsdam Institute for Climate Research Impact Wageningen University and Research)
records.abstract_en: Environmental tax reform (ETR), a shift from labour to carbon taxes, has been mostly modelled using general equilibrium (GE) analysis. Since a low-carbon transition will require deep transformations, one will also have to address out-of-equilibrium dynamics and increased agent heterogeneity. Unlike GE models, agent-based models (ABMs) are well equipped to deal with this. We therefore replicate a recent GE model for ETR using an agent-based approach. This process, known as "agentization", allows assessing similarities as well as differences in policy impacts between the two modelling approaches, in turn providing a test of the robustness of the GE results. We find that the agent-based model is able to replicate many results of the general equilibrium analysis, while revealing strengths and weaknesses of both model types. We discuss concrete implementation steps and difficulties experienced in the GE-ABM translation process. We illustrate the potential of ABM by extending the model in several directions. We show that heterogeneous subsistence consumption can increase the space for combining a double dividend with an equity goal, and that overall macro-economic results can conceal important distributional impacts when green preferences and labour supply elasticities vary.
records.abstract_cn: 环境税改革（ETR），即从劳动税转向碳税，大多采用一般均衡（GE）分析进行建模。由于低碳转型需要深度变革，还必须解决非均衡动态和日益增长的代理异质性。与GE模型不同，基于代理的模型（ABMs）能够很好地处理这些问题。因此，我们采用基于代理的方法复制了一个近期的ETR一般均衡模型。这一过程称为“代理化”，允许评估两种建模方法在政策影响上的相似性和差异性，进而检验GE结果的稳健性。我们发现，基于代理的模型能够复制一般均衡分析的许多结果，同时揭示两种模型类型的优缺点。我们讨论了在GE-ABM转换过程中遇到的具体实施步骤和困难。我们通过多个方向扩展模型来展示ABM的潜力。我们表明，异质性生存消费可以扩大实现双重红利与公平目标相结合的空间，并且当绿色偏好和劳动供给弹性变化时，总体宏观经济结果可能掩盖重要的分配影响。

records.title_en: Understanding Automation’s Impact on Ecological Footprint: Theory and Empirical Evidence from Europe
records.title_cn: 理解自动化对生态足迹的影响：来自欧洲的理论与实证证据
records.abstract_en: As technological advancements continue to unfold, automation has emerged as a pivotal force in reshaping both production paradigms and lifestyles. This paper introduces a comprehensive general equilibrium framework that encapsulates both automation and ecological environment. Through comparative static analysis, it seeks to elucidate the influence of automation on the environment. Furthermore, employing 32 European nations from 2000 to 2019 as samples, this research empirically investigates the propositions using panel least squares regression alongside panel threshold regression methods. In addition, this study employs predictions generated by an LSTM model using data from 1993 to 1999 as instrumental variables to address endogeneity. The findings reveal two opposing impacts of automation on the environment: the Leisure Effect, which worsens ecological degradation, and the Conservation Effect, which improves environmental quality. When environmental awareness is high, the Conservation Effect dominates, significantly reducing the ecological footprint. Moreover, as automation technology level advances, its capacity to curtail the ecological footprint intensifies. Specifically, from the perspective of the full sample, the addition of one robot per thousand workers leads to a 0.13 unit reduction in the natural logarithm of ecological footprint; meanwhile, the suppressive effect varies by approximately 3 to 10 times before and after reaching certain thresholds of environmental awareness and technological advancement behind automation. Subsequent grouped regression analysis further elucidates that within European contexts, automation’s footprint-reducing effects are predominantly observed in nations with GDP per capita below $20,000, advanced digitalization, lower environmental dependence, reduced military spending, and strong government intervention.
records.abstract_cn: 随着技术进步的不断推进，自动化已成为重塑生产模式和生活方式的关键力量。本文引入了一个包含自动化和生态环境的综合一般均衡框架。通过比较静态分析，旨在阐明自动化对环境的影响。此外，以2000年至2019年间32个欧洲国家为样本，本研究采用面板最小二乘回归和面板门槛回归方法实证检验了相关命题。同时，本研究利用1993年至1999年数据生成的LSTM模型预测作为工具变量来处理内生性问题。研究结果揭示了自动化对环境的两方面相反影响：休闲效应加剧了生态退化，而保护效应则改善了环境质量。当环保意识较高时，保护效应占主导地位，显著减少了生态足迹。此外，随着自动化技术水平的提升，其削减生态足迹的能力也在增强。具体而言，从全样本角度来看，每千名工人增加一台机器人会导致生态足迹自然对数减少0.13个单位；同时，在达到环保意识和自动化背后技术进步的某些门槛前后，抑制效应大约相差3至10倍。随后的分组回归分析进一步阐明，在欧洲背景下，自动化的足迹削减效应主要出现在人均GDP低于20,000美元、数字化程度高、环境依赖性低、军费开支少以及政府干预强的国家中。

records.title_en: Behavioural Drivers of Cooking Energy Choice in Benin
records.title_cn: 贝宁烹饪能源选择的行为驱动因素
records.abstract_en: This paper explores the behavioural drivers of households’ cooking energy decision-making. We empirically examine the effect of time and spatial discounting on cooking energy choices using Generalised Structural Equation Modelling. We rely on the nationally representative household dataset from Benin’s Harmonised Survey on Living Conditions of Households in 2019. The findings highlight that households’ tendencies towards temporal discounting have detrimental effects on cleaner cooking energies, while spatial discounting promotes the adoption of cleaner cooking energy sources. Furthermore, we discern that the influence of time and spatial discounting varies across rural and urban areas, yielding heterogeneous effects. These findings have implications for a better understanding of the non-economic constraints that hinder the promotion of cleaner cooking energies in developing countries.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了家庭烹饪能源决策的行为驱动因素。我们使用广义结构方程模型，实证检验了时间和空间贴现对烹饪能源选择的影响。我们依赖于贝宁2019年家庭生活条件协调调查的全国代表性家庭数据集。研究结果表明，家庭对时间贴现的倾向对更清洁的烹饪能源有不利影响，而空间贴现则促进了更清洁烹饪能源的采用。此外，我们发现时间和空间贴现的影响在城乡地区有所不同，产生了异质性效应。这些发现对于更好地理解阻碍发展中国家推广更清洁烹饪能源的非经济约束具有启示意义。

records.title_en: The influence of oil investors' sentiment on inflation dynamics and uncertainty
records.title_cn: 石油投资者情绪对通胀动态与不确定性的影响
records.abstract_en: In recent years, inflation has surged significantly, and uncertainty surrounding energy prices has increased worldwide. This uncertainty, which has led to demand shocks during the post-pandemic recovery phase and has been exacerbated by recent geopolitical tensions, has impacted investor behaviour, leading to shifts in investment strategies and market sentiment. This study aimed to explore the connection between these two trends by examining whether investor sentiment related to oil markets affects inflation in the European Union (EU) utilising a comprehensive dataset and advanced econometric techniques. Our findings reveal that oil sentiment significantly affects inflation, with implications for both demand and supply dynamics. A positive relationship is observed between oil sentiment and headline Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP) inflation, and a negative relationship between oil volatility and inflation over a 12-month horizon. Additionally, our findings reveal that a model incorporating fundamentals and oil sentiment provides superior forecasting performance for EU inflation, suggesting that oil sentiment offers valuable insights into the future behaviour of EU inflation. Finally, our results demonstrate that EU inflation reacts positively and significantly to a positive oil sentiment shock only during low-sentiment periods, whereas an insignificant response is observed during high-sentiment periods. Our study highlights the importance of incorporating investor sentiment into policy frameworks, suggesting that understanding these psychological factors can enhance inflation management strategies. Overall, this research contributes to a deeper understanding of the complex interplay between investor sentiment and macroeconomic variables, offering valuable insights for policymakers and investors alike.
records.abstract_cn: 近年来，通货膨胀显著飙升，全球能源价格不确定性加剧。这种不确定性在疫情后复苏阶段引发了需求冲击，并因近期地缘政治紧张局势而加剧，影响了投资者行为，导致投资策略和市场情绪发生变化。本研究旨在通过考察石油市场相关投资者情绪是否影响欧盟（EU）通胀，利用综合数据集和先进计量经济学技术，探讨这两种趋势之间的联系。我们的研究结果显示，石油情绪显著影响通胀，对需求和供给动态均有影响。在12个月的时间跨度内，观察到石油情绪与总体消费者价格协调指数（HICP）通胀之间存在正相关关系，而石油波动性与通胀之间存在负相关关系。此外，我们的研究结果显示，包含基本面因素和石油情绪的模型对欧盟通胀提供了更优的预测表现，表明石油情绪为欧盟通胀的未来行为提供了有价值的见解。最后，我们的结果表明，仅在低情绪时期，欧盟通胀对正向石油情绪冲击的反应是正向且显著的，而在高情绪时期则观察到不显著的反应。我们的研究强调了将投资者情绪纳入政策框架的重要性，表明理解这些心理因素可以增强通胀管理策略。总体而言，本研究有助于更深入地理解投资者情绪与宏观经济变量之间的复杂相互作用，为政策制定者和投资者提供了宝贵的见解。

records.title_en: Do supply chain and digitalization Foster China's advancement in green development? An evidence from wavelet quantile regression and wavelet quantile correlation analysis
records.title_cn: 供应链与数字化是否推动了中国绿色发展进程？基于小波分位数回归和小波分位数相关分析的证据
records.abstract_en: Effective environmental technologies are crucial in addressing China's sustainability challenges, especially in green technology, green supply chains, and smart development. This study addresses the research gap in prioritizing green technologies, production or processing of goods, digital assistants, and financial mechanisms through specific policies to accelerate China's green development and strengthen its global environmental leadership. In this context, the study aims to investigate the relationships among supply chain disruptions, digitalization, remittances, research & development (R&D), and GDP on environment-related technologies in the Chinese economy by employing the wavelet quantile regression and wavelet quantile correlation analysis using quarterly data from 1995 to 2021. The results show a strong relationship among supply chain, digitalization, remittances, and R&D on environmental technology in the short term; however, these relationships tend to weaken over time. The correlation with GDP is relatively weak in the short term and strengthens only under specific long-term conditions. These findings emphasize the significance of examining both temporal and distributional aspects when assessing the influence of different factors on environmental technology. Study findings offer valuable insights for policymakers and stakeholders.
records.abstract_cn: 有效的环境技术对于应对中国的可持续性挑战至关重要，尤其是在绿色技术、绿色供应链和智能发展方面。本研究填补了通过具体政策优先发展绿色技术、商品生产或加工、数字助手和金融机制以加速中国绿色发展并增强其全球环境领导力的研究空白。在此背景下，本研究旨在利用1995年至2021年的季度数据，通过小波分位数回归和小波分位数相关分析，探讨供应链中断、数字化、汇款、研发（R&D）和GDP对中国经济中环境相关技术的影响关系。结果表明，短期内供应链、数字化、汇款和研发与环境技术之间存在强关系；然而，这些关系随时间推移趋于减弱。与GDP的相关性在短期内相对较弱，仅在特定的长期条件下增强。这些发现强调了在评估不同因素对环境技术影响时，考察时间和分布方面的重要性。研究结果为政策制定者和利益相关者提供了有价值的见解。

records.title_en: Risk factors in the formulation of day-ahead electricity prices: Evidence from the Spanish case
records.title_cn: 日前电价形成中的风险因素：来自西班牙的证据
records.abstract_en: This study investigates the dynamic connection between Spanish day-ahead electricity prices and various fundamental determinants, including average surface temperature, forecasted electricity demand, predicted renewable energy injection, natural gas futures prices and CO2 emission rights cost. Structural Dynamic Factor Models (SDFM) are employed to decompose each hourly price signal into systematic components linked to any of the fundamental indices mentioned above and unveil structural shocks moving the entire panel of variables. Empirical results indicate that Spanish day-ahead electricity prices have a strong fundamental basis; a great deal of their observed short- or long-run variations are explained by changes in temperature, load, renewable energy supply, natural gas and carbon permit cost.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了西班牙日前电价与各种基本决定因素之间的动态联系，包括平均地表温度、预测电力需求、预测可再生能源注入、天然气期货价格以及二氧化碳排放权成本。采用结构动态因子模型（SDFM）将每个小时价格信号分解为与上述任何基本指数相关的系统组成部分，并揭示推动整个变量面板的结构性冲击。实证结果表明，西班牙日前电价具有强大的基本面基础；其观察到的短期或长期变动的很大一部分可由温度、负荷、可再生能源供应、天然气和碳配额成本的变化来解释。

records.title_en: Social norms and individual climate protection activities: A survey experiment for Germany
records.title_cn: 社会规范与个人气候保护活动：一项针对德国的调查实验
records.abstract_en: Based on the well-known observation that social norms can guide individual behavior, this paper empirically examines the causal effect of related information interventions on climate protection activities, measured through incentivized donations. In our experimental setting, we distinguish between descriptive social norms by providing information about individual climate protection activities in Germany, injunctive social norms by providing information about what people in Germany think about the need for climate protection activities, and a combination of both social norms. Based on representative survey data from more than 1,600 individuals in Germany, our econometric analysis shows some weak evidence that information about both descriptive and injunctive social norms increases donations for climate protection. The decomposition of this estimated average treatment effect reveals that the corresponding treatment particularly has a significantly positive effect at the extensive margin, i.e. on the probability to donate for climate protection. These results suggest that a combined information intervention referring to both descriptive and injunctive social norms is at least able to stimulate the general willingness for climate protection.
records.abstract_cn: 基于社会规范能够引导个人行为这一众所周知的观点，本文通过实证研究考察了相关信息干预对气候保护活动的因果效应，该效应通过激励性捐赠来衡量。在我们的实验设计中，我们区分了描述性社会规范（通过提供德国个人气候保护活动的信息）、指令性社会规范（通过提供德国人对气候保护活动必要性的看法信息）以及两种社会规范的组合。基于德国超过1,600名个体的代表性调查数据，我们的计量经济分析显示，关于描述性和指令性社会规范的信息在一定程度上增加了气候保护捐赠的微弱证据。对这一估计的平均处理效应的分解表明，相应的处理在广泛边际上尤其具有显著的正效应，即对气候保护捐赠的概率有显著正向影响。这些结果表明，同时涉及描述性和指令性社会规范的组合信息干预至少能够激发对气候保护的普遍意愿。

records.title_en: Watts happening to work? The labour market effects of South Africa’s electricity crisis
records.title_cn: 停电对工作有何影响？南非电力危机的劳动力市场效应
records.abstract_en: Frequent electricity outages threaten to impede the benefits of expanded access achieved by many developing countries in recent decades. A large literature documents these negative effects, however almost none consider labour market effects. This paper merges labour force survey microdata with high-frequency electricity supply and demand data to provide the first descriptive and causal estimates of the relationships between outages and labour market outcomes in South Africa, a country characterized by frequent, severe outages referred to as load shedding. We reveal negative associations with both employment and working hours, with the former being more pronounced. Both are not evident for low outage levels but increase with outage intensity. We document significant heterogeneity across firm sizes and industries, highlighting the vulnerability of workers in small firms. Using a Difference-in-Differences design, we exploit variation induced by a unique mitigation policy in Cape Town to show that outage mitigation significantly increases both employment and working hours, but more so the former, consistent with our descriptive estimates. We do not find heterogeneous employment effects by firm size, but highlight meaningful working hours effects for workers in small firms only, again highlighting their vulnerability. No evidence of heterogeneity across industries is found, and causal effects on hourly wages or monthly earnings could not be credibly identified. Overall, this study provides evidence of the negative labour market effects of power outages in developing countries, particularly for workers in small firms, on both the extensive and intensive margins.
records.abstract_cn: 频繁的停电可能会阻碍许多发展中国家近几十年来在扩大电力接入方面所取得的成果。大量文献记录了这些负面影响，但几乎没有研究考虑劳动力市场效应。本文将劳动力调查微观数据与高频电力供需数据相结合，首次对南非停电与劳动力市场结果之间的关系进行了描述性和因果性估计。南非是一个以频繁、严重停电（称为减载）为特征的国家。我们发现停电与就业和工作时间均呈负相关，且前者更为显著。在低停电水平下，这两种效应均不明显，但随着停电强度的增加而增强。我们记录了企业规模和行业之间的显著异质性，凸显了小企业工人的脆弱性。利用双重差分设计，我们利用开普敦一项独特缓解政策所引发的变异，表明缓解停电显著增加了就业和工作时间，但前者增幅更大，这与我们的描述性估计一致。我们未发现按企业规模划分的异质性就业效应，但强调了对小企业工人而言显著的工作时间效应，这再次凸显了他们的脆弱性。未发现行业间的异质性证据，且对小时工资或月收入的因果效应无法可靠识别。总体而言，本研究提供了停电对发展中国家劳动力市场产生负面影响的证据，特别是在小企业工人中，这种影响既体现在广泛边际上也体现在集约边际上。

records.title_en: New challenges for green finance and sustainable industrialization in developing countries: A panel data analysis
records.title_cn: 发展中国家绿色金融与可持续工业化的新挑战：面板数据分析
records.abstract_en: This paper uses the fixed-effect model, the S-GMM, and the Kinky least square method to investigate the effect of green finance on sustainable industrialization for a panel of 56 developing countries over the period 2000–2021. Accordingly, we propose a per region panel data analysis of the relationship between green finance and sustainable industrialization for three different regions: Africa, Asia, and South America. Our findings show that green finance contributes positively and significantly to improving sustainable industrialization in most of the developing countries under consideration, but that the effect is more pronounced for Asia and South America. This suggests that for a robust environmental result, these developing countries should make greater use of environmentally friendly sources of finance, which can help to reorient their industries toward greater sustainability as well as fight the main economic challenges: unemployment, poverty, inequality, and social injustice.
records.abstract_cn: 本文采用固定效应模型、系统广义矩估计法（S-GMM）和Kinky最小二乘法，研究了2000-2021年间56个发展中国家的绿色金融对可持续工业化的影响。据此，我们针对非洲、亚洲和南美洲三个不同地区，提出了绿色金融与可持续工业化之间关系的分区域面板数据分析。我们的研究结果表明，在大多数所考察的发展中国家中，绿色金融对改善可持续工业化有显著的正向贡献，但这一效应在亚洲和南美洲更为明显。这表明，为了取得稳健的环境成果，这些发展中国家应更多地利用环境友好型融资来源，这有助于引导其工业向更高可持续性方向发展，并应对主要经济挑战：失业、贫困、不平等和社会不公。

records.title_en: Power plants improve local residents' wealth: A case study of Nigeria
records.title_cn: 发电厂提升当地居民财富：尼日利亚案例研究
records.abstract_en: Electricity generated from power plants and associated economic activities can be a way to improve local livelihoods in many developing countries. However, the existing evidence on the impacts of power plants on nearby residents' wealth and their mechanisms is scant and mixed at best. We examine the impacts of power plants on nearby residents' asset-based wealth using six rounds of Nigeria Demographic and Health Surveys (NDHS) and comprehensive power plant operations data in Nigeria. We find that households within 10 km of operational power plants have gained higher asset-based wealth scores by 0.2–2.7 than those located 10–20 km away. These wealth increases are most pronounced for households near larger-capacity plants and those with members in manual labor and sales/services occupations, likely driven by heightened demand during both the construction and operational phases of power plants. Additionally, we find that the likelihood of electricity access increases with power plant operations. Our results highlight the potential role of increased economic opportunities and electricity access in driving wealth gains through power plant construction and operations and offer policy insights into aligning economic advancement initiatives with the national electricity development plan for Nigeria and other developing countries.
records.abstract_cn: 发电厂产生的电力及相关经济活动可以成为许多发展中国家改善当地生计的一种途径。然而，关于发电厂对附近居民财富影响及其机制的现有证据稀少且结果不一。我们利用六轮尼日利亚人口与健康调查（NDHS）以及尼日利亚全面的发电厂运营数据，考察了发电厂对附近居民基于资产的财富的影响。我们发现，距离运营中发电厂10公里以内的家庭，其基于资产的财富得分比距离10-20公里的家庭高出0.2-2.7。这些财富增长在靠近大容量发电厂的家庭以及有成员从事体力劳动和销售/服务职业的家庭中最为显著，这可能是由于发电厂建设和运营阶段需求增加所致。此外，我们发现电力接入的可能性随着发电厂的运营而增加。我们的结果强调了增加经济机会和电力接入在通过发电厂建设和运营推动财富增长方面的潜在作用，并为尼日利亚及其他发展中国家将经济发展举措与国家电力发展计划相结合提供了政策见解。

records.title_en: Cost sharing mechanisms for carbon pricing: What drives support in the housing sector?
records.title_cn: 碳定价的成本分担机制：住房部门中什么推动了支持？
records.abstract_en: The building sector offers an important lever for reducing carbon emissions, with carbon pricing considered as one essential policy instrument to unleash this potential. Yet, carbon pricing in residential buildings faces challenges, particularly in rental housing, as the financial burden and thus the incentives to reduce carbon emissions may be distributed differently between landlords and tenants, presenting a principal–agent problem that may lead to conflict and low public support. Using extensive survey data from about 12,000 households, we analyze the support for different concepts to share the cost burden owed to carbon pricing between landlords and tenants. We particularly examine the role of perceived cost, effectiveness, and fairness and experimentally study the impact of revenue use and carbon price level on public preferences. Our results suggest that the price level and revenue use hardly affect support, whereas tenancy – and thus self-interest – as well as perceived fairness of the sharing concept strongly correlate with preferences. Overall, a sharing mechanism according to the energy efficiency of the building is the most preferred cost allocation among our participants.
records.abstract_cn: 建筑部门为减少碳排放提供了重要的杠杆，碳定价被认为是释放这一潜力的关键政策工具之一。然而，住宅建筑中的碳定价面临挑战，尤其是在租赁住房中，因为经济负担以及由此产生的减少碳排放的激励可能在房东和租户之间分配不同，呈现出一种委托-代理问题，可能导致冲突和公众支持度低。利用来自约12,000户家庭的广泛调查数据，我们分析了不同概念下房东与租户之间分担碳定价成本负担的支持情况。我们特别考察了感知成本、有效性和公平性的作用，并通过实验研究了收入使用和碳价格水平对公众偏好的影响。我们的结果表明，价格水平和收入使用对支持度影响甚微，而租赁关系——即自身利益——以及分担概念的感知公平性与偏好强烈相关。总体而言，根据建筑能效进行的分担机制是我们参与者中最受青睐的成本分配方式。

records.title_en: Supply chain digitalization and energy efficiency (gas and oil): How do they contribute to achieving carbon neutrality targets?
records.title_cn: 供应链数字化与能源效率（天然气和石油）：它们如何助力实现碳中和目标？
records.abstract_en: Considering the global awareness regarding the issue of climate change and global warming, several nations, including the United States, are focusing on achieving carbon neutrality goals. In doing so, this study examines how supply chain digitalization, green technologies, and energy efficiency influence greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions in the United States. This is the first empirical study evaluating how supply chain digitalization and energy efficiency influence GHG emissions, thus filling the gap in the literature. The study applied several quantile-based techniques, including wavelet quantile regression, quantile causality, and quantile regressions, as robustness checks used data spanning the period between 2000Q1 to 2022Q4. The results show that (i) across all periods and quantiles, a surge in supply chain digitalization intensifies GHG emissions in the United States; (ii) across all periods and quantiles, energy efficiency (oil and gas) lessens GHG emissions; (iii) across all periods and quantiles economic growth and financial globalization mitigate GHG emissions; and (iv) all the regressors can significantly predict GHG emissions. Based on these findings, policymakers in the United States should prioritize investments in green technologies and energy efficiency improvements, offering tax incentives, grants, and subsidies to businesses that adopt such practices.
records.abstract_cn: 考虑到全球对气候变化和全球变暖问题的认识，包括美国在内的多个国家正致力于实现碳中和目标。为此，本研究考察了供应链数字化、绿色技术和能源效率如何影响美国的温室气体（GHG）排放。这是首个评估供应链数字化和能源效率如何影响温室气体排放的实证研究，从而填补了文献中的空白。研究采用了多种基于分位数的技术，包括小波分位数回归、分位数因果性和分位数回归，作为稳健性检验，使用了2000Q1至2022Q4期间的数据。结果表明：（i）在所有时期和分位数上，供应链数字化的激增加剧了美国的温室气体排放；（ii）在所有时期和分位数上，能源效率（石油和天然气）减少了温室气体排放；（iii）在所有时期和分位数上，经济增长和金融全球化缓解了温室气体排放；（iv）所有回归变量均能显著预测温室气体排放。基于这些发现，美国的政策制定者应优先投资于绿色技术和能源效率改进，为采用此类实践的企业提供税收优惠、拨款和补贴。

records.title_en: The effectiveness of future financial benefits on PV adoption — Evidence from Belgium
records.title_cn: 未来财务收益对光伏采用的有效性——来自比利时的证据
records.abstract_en: We assess the effect of different incentive schemes with future financial benefits on photovoltaic (PV) adoption patterns in the residential sector for the two biggest regions of Belgium - Flanders and Wallonia. Due to variation in incentive schemes across the regions and within regions across months, we can identify the effect of changes in future benefits on adoption. We combine and compare three distinct and widely used incentive schemes for PV, namely output-based, capacity-based and net metering, which is electricity cost saving-based. We find that PV adoption in the residential sector is highly sensitive to overall future financial benefits. A one percent increase in overall benefits per kW of installed capacity increases the number of installations by around 6%. However, the different incentive schemes have varying degrees of effectiveness. In particular, capacity- and output-based incentive schemes, which directly compensate households with a fixed price per produced amount of electric energy or per installed capacity annually are around 6 percentage points more effective in fostering PV uptake than the cost saving-based net metering, which depends on future electricity prices and production. Furthermore, the average size of new installations depends on whether incentive schemes remunerate for additional capacity.
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估了不同具有未来财务收益的激励方案对比利时两个最大地区——佛兰德斯和瓦隆——住宅部门光伏（PV）采用模式的影响。由于各地区之间以及各地区内各月份激励方案的差异，我们能够识别未来收益变化对采用的影响。我们结合并比较了三种不同且广泛使用的光伏激励方案，即基于产出、基于容量和净计量，后者基于电力成本节省。我们发现住宅部门的光伏采用对整体未来财务收益高度敏感。每千瓦装机容量的整体收益每增加百分之一，安装数量增加约6%。然而，不同的激励方案具有不同程度的有效性。特别是，基于容量和基于产出的激励方案，直接以每单位产出的电能或每年每单位装机容量的固定价格补偿家庭，在促进光伏采用方面比基于成本节省的净计量方案有效约6个百分点，后者依赖于未来的电价和产量。此外，新安装的平均规模取决于激励方案是否对额外容量进行补偿。

records.title_en: How unexpected geopolitical risk affect the nonlinear spillover among energy and metal markets?
records.title_cn: 意外地缘政治风险如何影响能源与金属市场间的非线性溢出效应？
records.abstract_en: Geopolitical risk interacts with natural resource commodity markets closely and dynamically, which complicates the fluctuation spillover among those markets. We firstly uncover the overall and dynamic information spillover features among energy and metal markets, namely traditional energy, transition energy, new energy metals, precious metals, and traditional bulk metals in the nonlinear causal network constructed by combining the leave-one-out and transfer entropy methods. We then quantify the systemic significance of each sector in that network and further explore the impact of unexpected geopolitical risk in multiple-order moments on the significance of each sector during the sample period from January 4, 2011 to May 7, 2024. The results indicate that precious metals and traditional bulk metals are the two most significant sectors in the nonlinear causal network for information spillovers during the overall sample period, followed by traditional energy, new energy metals, and transition energy sectors; from a dynamic perspective, the significance of the transition energy and new energy metal sectors fluctuates with greater amplitude compared to other sectors. Regarding the impact of geopolitical risk on the significance of each sector, unexpected geopolitical risks have a more significant influence on energy and metal markets compared to generic geopolitical risks; moreover, the mean value of geopolitical risks exerts a greater effect on all sectors than its higher-order moment counterparts; all sectors except the traditional bulk metal sector, their systemic significance is sensitive to geopolitical shocks, especially above the 50th percentile. These results may offer effective references for financial risk management during the energy transition process.
records.abstract_cn: 地缘政治风险与自然资源商品市场紧密且动态地相互作用，这使得这些市场间的波动溢出效应变得复杂。我们首先在结合留一法和转移熵方法构建的非线性因果网络中，揭示了能源与金属市场（即传统能源、转型能源、新能源金属、贵金属和传统大宗金属）之间的整体和动态信息溢出特征。然后，我们量化了该网络中每个部门的系统性重要性，并进一步探讨了在样本期间（2011年一月4日至2024年五月7日）意外地缘政治风险在多阶矩上对各部门重要性的影响。结果表明，在整个样本期间，贵金属和传统大宗金属是信息溢出的非线性因果网络中最具重要性的两个部门，其次是传统能源、新能源金属和转型能源部门；从动态角度看，转型能源和新能源金属部门的重要性波动幅度大于其他部门。关于地缘政治风险对各部门重要性的影响，与一般地缘政治风险相比，意外地缘政治风险对能源和金属市场的影响更为显著；此外，地缘政治风险的均值对所有部门的影响大于其高阶矩对应项；除传统大宗金属部门外，所有部门的系统性重要性对地缘政治冲击敏感，尤其是在第50百分位以上。这些结果可能为能源转型过程中的金融风险管理提供有效参考。

records.title_en: Effects of the climate-related sentiment on agricultural spot prices: Insights from Wavelet Rényi Entropy analysis
records.title_cn: 气候相关情绪对农产品现货价格的影响：基于小波Rényi熵分析的见解
records.abstract_en: The economic impact of climate change on agriculture is complex and multifaceted, with public sentiment playing a crucial role. Public perception of climate events can significantly influence consumer behavior and investment decisions, adding uncertainty and volatility to agricultural markets. Beyond the direct effects of climate change, it is essential to understand how public reactions can shape and amplify economic consequences. This study analyzes the impact of climate-related sentiment and equity market performance on agricultural commodity spot prices using a novel approach that examines the most important intrinsic properties of time series related to their deterministic, stochastic, or chaotic behavior. We focus on the predictability of time series, applying our techniques to the spot prices of soybean, cotton, corn, wheat, coffee, and orange juice. Our method combines Rényi entropy and wavelet analysis to capture low- and high-probability events and distinguish between short-term and long-term trends. The main finding suggests that climate-related sentiment and equity market performance help to predict extreme events in long-term agricultural spot price distributions, though predictability decreases for short-term fluctuations. This has important implications with regard to forecasting models in agricultural markets.
records.abstract_cn: 气候变化对农业的经济影响是复杂且多方面的，公众情绪在其中扮演着关键角色。公众对气候事件的感知能显著影响消费者行为和投资决策，为农产品市场增添不确定性和波动性。除了气候变化的直接影响外，理解公众反应如何塑造并放大经济后果至关重要。本研究采用一种新颖的方法，分析气候相关情绪和股票市场表现对农产品大宗商品现货价格的影响，该方法考察时间序列中与其确定性、随机性或混沌行为相关的最重要的内在属性。我们关注时间序列的可预测性，将技术应用于大豆、棉花、玉米、小麦、咖啡和橙汁的现货价格。我们的方法结合了Rényi熵和小波分析，以捕捉低概率和高概率事件，并区分短期和长期趋势。主要发现表明，气候相关情绪和股票市场表现有助于预测长期农产品现货价格分布中的极端事件，尽管对短期波动的可预测性有所降低。这对农产品市场的预测模型具有重要意义。

records.title_en: Integrating renewable energy resources in electricity distribution systems—A firm-level efficiency analysis for Sweden controlling for weather conditions
records.title_cn: 将可再生能源资源整合到电力配电系统中——考虑天气条件的瑞典企业层面效率分析
records.abstract_en: Sweden is at the forefront of the transition of its energy sector to low-carbon technologies with profound consequences for both energy generation and its distribution. However, the impact of this transition on the performance of Electricity Distribution System Operators (DSOs) has not been thoroughly studied. The article addresses this gap by using a novel approach and detailed georeferenced firm-level, weather, and regional data in Sweden from 2014 to 2019. Our findings indicate that (i) an increase in the number of small-scale feeders and (ii) a higher degree of decentralized energy production (decentralization) both improve DSOs’ cost efficiencies. Additionally, we demonstrate that DSOs have adapted well to long-term weather variability. These results have significant implications for the effective implementation of renewable energy policies.
records.abstract_cn: 瑞典在其能源部门向低碳技术转型方面处于前沿，这对能源生产和分配都产生了深远影响。然而，这一转型对电力配电系统运营商（DSOs）绩效的影响尚未得到深入研究。本文通过使用一种新颖的方法以及瑞典从2014年到2019年的详细地理参考企业层面、天气和区域数据来填补这一空白。我们的研究结果表明：（i）小型馈线数量的增加和（ii）分散式能源生产（分散化）程度的提高均能改善DSOs的成本效率。此外，我们证明DSOs已很好地适应了长期天气变化。这些结果对有效实施可再生能源政策具有重要意义。
