records.abstract_cn: 中国新修订的《公司法》（2024年）将第七章的监管范围从仅限国有独资企业扩展到所有国有出资企业，并旨在通过多种措施优化其治理。这塑造了国有企业（SOEs）股权结构的改革轨迹，为通常被视为创新能力较弱的国有企业提供了在人工智能（AI）时代跟上步伐的机会。在此背景下，我们研究了股权多元化在塑造国有企业AI创新绩效中的作用。利用2007-2023年中国上市国有企业的专利和股权结构数据，我们发现股权多元化每增加1%，与国有企业次年AI专利申请量增加0.05%相关。这一积极效应通过以下途径实现：（i）减少管理层短期主义并鼓励长期战略投资，（ii）引导管理层关注AI等新兴技术，以及（iii）促进外部学习并提高创新效率。处于成长或成熟阶段、在高科技或竞争性行业运营、具有财务充足性和商业导向的国有企业从股权多元化中获益更多。此外，这种益处仅限于AI创新产出，而不影响其质量或传统创新。

records.title_en: The impact of National Volume-Based Procurement policy on healthcare expenditure and provider behavior in China
records.title_cn: 国家集中带量采购政策对中国医疗支出和医疗服务提供者行为的影响
records.abstract_en: To curb rising medical expenses, the Chinese government launched a national volume-based procurement (NVBP) policy for high-value medical consumables. This study evaluates its impact on coronary stents, the first targeted category implemented in 2021. Using inpatient records for all percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) patients in a large pilot city and a time regression discontinuity design, we examined effects on healthcare expenditures, care intensities, treatment outcomes, service volume, and treatment patterns. The results showed a significant 35.2 % decrease in average total expenditure, primarily driven by a 65.4 % reduction in medical supplies and consumables fees. However, the policy also led to unintended provider responses, including increased stents implanted per patient, a 43.3 % rise in weekly service volume, and a higher likelihood of using alternative, costlier treatment patterns. No significant impact was found on 30-day readmissions, but a slight increase in in-hospital mortality was observed. Importantly, analysis by insurance status revealed distinct provider strategies: expanding PCI volume for higher-coverage patients and increasing stent use per procedure for lower-coverage patients. Dynamic analysis indicated sustained reductions in expenditures over time, though effects on care intensities diminished after a few months. These findings suggest that while NVBP effectively reduced patient-level healthcare expenditures, it raised concerns about its broader impact on aggregate healthcare spending and provider behavior.
records.abstract_cn: 为遏制医疗费用上涨，中国政府针对高值医用耗材推出了国家集中带量采购（NVBP）政策。本研究评估了该政策对首个实施类别——冠状动脉支架的影响，该政策于2021年实施。利用某大型试点城市所有经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）患者的住院记录，并采用时间断点回归设计，我们考察了政策对医疗支出、护理强度、治疗结果、服务量和治疗模式的影响。结果显示，平均总支出显著下降35.2%，主要归因于医用耗材费用减少65.4%。然而，该政策也引发了非预期的医疗服务提供者行为，包括每位患者植入支架数量增加、每周服务量上升43.3%，以及使用替代性更高成本治疗模式的可能性增大。对30天再入院率未发现显著影响，但观察到院内死亡率略有上升。重要的是，按保险状态进行的分析揭示了不同的提供者策略：对高覆盖患者扩大PCI服务量，而对低覆盖患者增加每次手术的支架使用量。动态分析表明，支出随时间持续下降，但护理强度的影响在几个月后减弱。这些发现表明，尽管NVBP有效降低了患者层面的医疗支出，但其对总体医疗支出和医疗服务提供者行为的更广泛影响引发了担忧。

records.title_en: Budget rollover and year-end spending in China: evidence from public procurement contracts
records.title_cn: 预算结转与年末支出：来自中国政府采购合同的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper exploits the reform of China's Budget Law, which restricts the rollover of fiscal surplus across years, to examines the impact of UILI (use-it-or-lose-it) budget rules on year-end spending spikes. We analyze the universe of public procurement contracts from 2014 to 2021 and develop a method to assess contract quality. We show substantial surges in procurement contracts at the end of the year, which are more likely to be of low quality. The difference-in-difference model indicates that after the reform, local governments award 25.8 % more procurement contracts and double spending on procurement in the last month of the year. The year-end spending surges concentrate on goods and construction projects procurement, high-value contracts, and favor local suppliers. It is likely that UILI rules intensify budgetary uncertainty embedded in hierarchical allocation of fiscal fund.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用中国《预算法》改革，该改革限制了财政盈余跨年结转，来考察“用尽或失去”（UILI）预算规则对年末支出高峰的影响。我们分析了从2014年到2021年的全部政府采购合同，并开发了一种评估合同质量的方法。我们显示，年末采购合同出现大幅激增，这些合同更可能是低质量的。双重差分模型表明，改革后，地方政府在一年最后一个月授予的采购合同数量增加了25.8%，采购支出翻倍。年末支出激增主要集中在货物和建筑项目采购、高价值合同，并偏向本地供应商。UILI规则可能加剧了财政资金层级分配中固有的预算不确定性。

records.title_en: The costs of duty exemptions in processing trade
records.title_cn: 加工贸易中关税豁免的成本
records.abstract_en: We propose a theory in which developing countries may lose from using duty exemptions to encourage processing trade. Our model features that (i) processing exports have a much lower domestic value-added share (DVAS) than ordinary exports and domestic sales, and (ii) domestic production exhibits external economies of scale. Consequently, the welfare effects of duty exemptions can be decomposed into two main components: (i) the direct effect captures welfare gains through reduced input costs and access to a greater variety of imported inputs. In contrast, (ii) the market size effect reflects welfare losses due to the contraction of domestic production, driven by the reallocation of labor away from high-DVAS production to low-DVAS processing production. We then calibrate our model to the Chinese firm-level data and aggregate trade flows across 47 economies. Our counterfactual analysis shows that the welfare losses associated with the market size effect outweigh the welfare gains from the direct effect, resulting in a reduction in China’s real income.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出一个理论，在该理论中，发展中国家可能因使用关税豁免来鼓励加工贸易而遭受损失。我们的模型具有以下特征：（i）加工出口的国内增加值份额远低于普通出口和国内销售，（ii）国内生产表现出外部规模经济。因此，关税豁免的福利效应可分解为两个主要部分：（i）直接效应通过降低投入成本和获取更多种类的进口投入品来体现福利收益。相比之下，（ii）市场规模效应反映了由于国内生产收缩而导致的福利损失，这种收缩是由劳动力从高国内增加值份额生产重新配置到低国内增加值份额加工生产所驱动的。然后，我们将模型校准到中国企业层面数据和涵盖47个经济体的总体贸易流量。我们的反事实分析表明，与市场规模效应相关的福利损失超过了直接效应的福利收益，导致中国实际收入减少。

records.title_en: The impact of the host country's imports of Chinese digital products on carbon decoupling status
records.title_cn: 东道国进口中国数字产品对碳脱钩状态的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper incorporates both the carbon emission and economic development imperatives of host countries and applies the Tapio decoupling model to identify their decoupling status. Based on this assessment and in light of the evolving global landscape of digital trade, we construct a balanced panel dataset covering 176 countries from 2003 to 2020 to examine the impact of digital product imports from China—the world's largest exporter—on the green and sustainable development of other economies, as well as the underlying mechanisms. Empirical findings reveal that imports of Chinese digital products contribute to the improvement of host countries' carbon decoupling status. This positive effect operates primarily through two channels: the enhancement of green technological innovation and the increase in green total factor productivity. The effect is more pronounced among Belt and Road Initiative partner countries, nations with lower energy endowments, non-OECD members, and developing economies. Moreover, deeper integration into digital trade governance frameworks further amplifies the efficacy of Chinese digital products. The results of this paper provide theoretical references and practical insights for fully exploiting the efficacy of digital products of China, promoting the progress of green technology, and realizing the synergistic development of economic growth and environmental governance.
records.abstract_cn: 本文将东道国的碳排放与经济发展双重需求纳入考量，运用Tapio脱钩模型识别其脱钩状态。基于此评估，并结合全球数字贸易格局的演变，我们构建了一个涵盖2003年至2020年176个国家的平衡面板数据集，以检验从世界最大出口国中国进口数字产品对其他经济体绿色可持续发展的影响及其内在机制。实证发现，进口中国数字产品有助于改善东道国的碳脱钩状态。这一积极效应主要通过两条渠道发挥作用：绿色技术创新的提升和绿色全要素生产率的增长。该效应在“一带一路”倡议伙伴国、能源禀赋较低的国家、非OECD成员国以及发展中经济体中更为显著。此外，更深层次地融入数字贸易治理框架进一步增强了中国数字产品的效能。本文的研究结果为充分发挥中国数字产品的效能、促进绿色技术进步以及实现经济增长与环境治理的协同发展提供了理论参考和实践启示。

records.title_en: The effect of family size on intergenerational support for elderly parents and their life expectancy: Evidence from China’s “Later, Longer, Fewer” campaign
records.title_cn: 家庭规模对老年父母代际支持及其预期寿命的影响：来自中国“晚、稀、少”运动的证据
records.abstract_en: This study documents increased life expectancy among elderly parents in China whose adult children were exposed to the “Later, Longer, Fewer” (LLF) family planning campaign in the 1970s. We leverage the variation in policy exposure at the province, urban, and birth-cohort level to understand the extent to which the LLF campaign has affected social networks and intergenerational support for elderly parents. The plausible channels that may impact life expectancy are living arrangements, visits, and financial transfers. Using the 2011 China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study, we identify adults of childbearing age who were exposed to the LLF campaign and whose fertility was reduced. We find that greater LLF exposure increases the likelihood of the wife’s parents co-residing in her household. The increase in elderly support, however, is largely manifested through more visits and financial transfers from their sons’ families, which is unsurprising in a patrilineal society. Most gains are driven by rural households.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究记录了在中国，其成年子女在1970年代受到“晚、稀、少”（LLF）计划生育运动影响的老年父母预期寿命有所增加。我们利用省级、城市和出生队列层面的政策暴露差异，来理解LLF运动在多大程度上影响了老年父母的社交网络和代际支持。可能影响预期寿命的合理渠道包括居住安排、探望和经济转移。利用2011年中国健康与养老追踪调查，我们识别了处于生育年龄且受到LLF运动影响、生育率降低的成年人。我们发现，更大的LLF暴露增加了妻子父母与其同住的概率。然而，老年支持的增加主要通过儿子家庭的更多探望和经济转移来实现，这在父系社会中并不意外。大部分收益来自农村家庭。

records.title_en: Inside job, Chinese style: Suspicious use of public funds under fiscal pressure
records.title_cn: 内部作业，中国式：财政压力下公共资金的可疑使用
records.abstract_en: Governments usually increase taxes or cut spending to tackle deficits. In contrast, local governments in China tend to increase suspicious uses of public funds under fiscal pressure, which is not well understood. Using the reduction of agricultural tax as a revenue shock, we find that greater fiscal pressure leads to higher questionable fund use by county governments. The suspicious activities are triggered by the motivation to reallocate resources, to fields that correlate with officials' own interests like stimulating local economic growth, pursuing personal promotion as well as grabbing resources before retirement.
records.abstract_cn: 政府通常通过增税或削减支出来应对赤字。相比之下，中国地方政府在财政压力下倾向于增加公共资金的可疑使用，这一现象尚未得到充分理解。利用农业税减免作为收入冲击，我们发现更大的财政压力导致县级政府更高水平的可疑资金使用。这些可疑活动是由重新分配资源的动机引发的，资源流向与官员自身利益相关的领域，如刺激地方经济增长、追求个人晋升以及在退休前攫取资源。

records.title_en: The missing rich households and wealth polarization in 21st century China
records.title_cn: 21世纪中国缺失的富裕家庭与财富极化
records.abstract_en: This study investigates the evolution of wealth polarization throughout the 21st century, using data from the Chinese Household Income Project (CHIP) and the Top Incomes in China (TIC) database. Our findings reveal a significant increase in polarization from 2002 to 2013, followed by a period of stabilization and signs of moderation by 2018. Decomposing polarization into alienation and identification, we observe that alienation (between group inequality) continues to rise from 2002 to 2018, while identification (within group cohesion) increases until 2013 but declines thereafter. The underrepresentation of rich households leads to an underestimation of alienation and an overestimation of identification. While these counterbalancing effects contribute to higher polarization levels, they do not alter the trend during the period. However, as the mitigating effect on identification diminishes and the growing effect on alienation intensifies, it suggests potential challenges in accurately tracking future changes in wealth polarization using survey data.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究利用中国家庭收入项目（CHIP）和中国的顶层收入（TIC）数据库的数据，考察了21世纪财富极化的演变。我们的研究结果显示，从2002年到2013年，极化显著增加，随后进入稳定期，并在2018年出现缓和迹象。将极化分解为疏离感和认同感，我们观察到疏离感（组间不平等）从2002年到2018年持续上升，而认同感（组内凝聚力）在2013年前上升，之后下降。富裕家庭的代表性不足导致疏离感被低估，而认同感被高估。尽管这些相互抵消的效应导致极化水平更高，但它们并未改变该时期的趋势。然而，随着对认同感的缓解效应减弱，对疏离感的增强效应加剧，这表明使用调查数据准确追踪未来财富极化变化可能面临潜在挑战。

records.title_en: Excellent human capital or institution? Evidence from judicial reform of the judge quota system in China
records.title_cn: 优秀的人力资本还是制度？来自中国法官定额制度司法改革的证据
records.abstract_en: The recent major judicial reforms in China involve implementing a judge quota and personnel management system. To date, little is known about the impact of the reforms. Using over 14 million Chinese court judgments data from 2014 to 2018, this article evaluates the connections between qualified judges and labor specialization and judicial efficiency and quality. This study found that the judge quota reform in China has improved judicial efficiency and quality due mainly to the personnel classification management system rather than the reappointed judges. By introducing task-specific returns to specialization in the judicial system, the personnel classification management system has allowed judges to concentrate on their adjudicative tasks instead of administrative and secretarial duties and thereby improving judicial performance. Institution design plays an important role in optimizing resource allocation and improving efficiency. Implications for policy and future research are discussed.
records.abstract_cn: 中国近期重大司法改革涉及实施法官定额和人事管理制度。迄今为止，关于改革的影响知之甚少。利用14年至2014年间超过2018万份中国法院判决数据，本文评估了合格法官与劳动专业化及司法效率和质量之间的联系。研究发现，中国的法官定额改革提高了司法效率和质量，这主要归功于人员分类管理制度，而非重新任命的法官。通过在司法系统中引入任务特定的专业化回报，人员分类管理制度使法官能够专注于审判任务，而非行政和秘书职责，从而提升了司法绩效。制度设计在优化资源配置和提高效率方面发挥着重要作用。本文讨论了政策和未来研究的启示。

records.title_en: Through trials and hardships: Internal migration and locus of control among Chinese entrepreneurs
records.title_cn: 历经磨难：中国创业者的内部迁移与心理控制源
records.abstract_en: Socio-emotional skills are essential for entrepreneurial behavior and firm performance, yet little is known about how entrepreneurial traits are associated with major life events such as migration. This study investigates the relationship between internal migration experience (IME) and the locus of control (LOC) among entrepreneurs, a psychological trait with significant implications for various life and organizational outcomes. We first develop a theoretical framework to explore how migration may relate to entrepreneurs' LOC. Using nationally representative datasets from China, we compare entrepreneurs with IME who returned to their hometowns with those who have never migrated. The results show robust evidence that returnees exhibit stronger internal LOC than non-migrants, partially explaining the positive link between migration and entrepreneurial behaviors. This observed relationship is more pronounced among those who migrated earlier in life and appears weaker among individuals with prolonged migration durations. The positive association is also more evident among male entrepreneurs, those born after 1980, members of the ethnic majority, and entrepreneurs from smaller cities. Mechanism analysis further suggests that while IME is linked to health deterioration and weakened origin-based social networks, it is also associated with gains in work experience, managerial skills, cultural assimilation, and socioeconomic improvement, which contribute to strengthening internal control beliefs. Our findings underscore the relevance of internal migration for entrepreneurial behavior, particularly through the lens of socio-emotional skills, and suggest the importance of migration policies for inclusive urban development.
records.abstract_cn: 社会情感技能对于创业行为和企业绩效至关重要，但关于创业特质如何与迁移等重大生活事件相关联，目前知之甚少。本研究探讨了内部迁移经历（IME）与创业者心理控制源（LOC）之间的关系，心理控制源是一种对多种生活及组织结果具有重要影响的心理特质。我们首先构建了一个理论框架，以探究迁移可能与创业者心理控制源之间的关联。利用来自中国的全国代表性数据集，我们将有内部迁移经历并返回家乡的创业者与从未迁移的创业者进行比较。结果显示，稳健的证据表明，返乡者比未迁移者表现出更强的内控心理控制源，这在一定程度上解释了迁移与创业行为之间的正向联系。这种观察到的关系在较早年龄迁移的人群中更为显著，而在迁移持续时间较长的人群中则显得较弱。这种正向关联在男性创业者、1980年后出生者、多数族群成员以及来自较小城市的创业者中更为明显。机制分析进一步表明，虽然内部迁移经历与健康状况恶化和基于原籍地的社会网络削弱相关，但它也与工作经验、管理技能、文化融合和社会经济地位的提升相关，这些都有助于增强内部控制信念。我们的研究结果强调了内部迁移对创业行为的相关性，特别是通过社会情感技能的视角，并提示了迁移政策对包容性城市发展的重要性。

records.title_en: Urban fragmentation and innovation collaboration: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 城市碎片化与创新合作：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper measures the urban shape of Chinese prefecture-level cities and examines the impacts of its fragmentation on local innovation activity. Using a harmonized satellite nightlight dataset from 1999 to 2021, we delineate urban areas as polygons formed by adjacent bright grids at night. We decompose changes in a city's urban shape into two components: the dispersion of individual polygons, and the fragmentation characterized by the growing spatial separation between these polygons. Our empirical analysis reveals that deteriorating urban shape, which typically results in longer commutes for individuals to meet, is associated with fewer local patent grants, with urban fragmentation being the primary driver. Mechanism analysis reveals that intensified urban fragmentation disproportionately impedes collaborative innovation, primarily by elevating communication costs within inventor teams. These findings highlight the pivotal role of optimized urban spatial structures in fostering face-to-face interactions and knowledge spillovers essential for innovation ecosystems.
records.abstract_cn: 本文测量了中国地级市的城市形态，并考察了其碎片化对当地创新活动的影响。利用1999年至2021年的统一卫星夜间灯光数据集，我们将城市区域描绘为由夜间相邻亮格形成的多边形。我们将城市形态的变化分解为两个组成部分：单个多边形的分散性，以及以这些多边形之间空间分离日益增大为特征的碎片化。我们的实证分析表明，城市形态恶化（通常导致个人通勤时间更长以便会面）与当地专利授权减少相关，其中城市碎片化是主要驱动因素。机制分析显示，加剧的城市碎片化不成比例地阻碍了合作创新，主要通过提高发明者团队内部的沟通成本。这些发现强调了优化城市空间结构在促进面对面互动和知识溢出方面对创新生态系统至关重要的关键作用。

records.title_en: The effect of broadband internet on children's weight: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 宽带互联网对儿童体重的影响：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: This study employs ten-wave data from the China Health and Nutrition Survey (CHNS), covering the period from 1989 to 2015. It leverages the nationwide internet speed upgrading project launched in the early 21st century as an exogenous shock. Using this variation, we construct a difference-in-differences model to identify the causal effect of broadband internet access on children’s weight outcomes. The results show that broadband internet significantly increases the probability of children being overweight. Robustness tests support these results. The heterogeneity analysis reveals that the weights of children who are older and in urban are more affected by broadband internet. Mechanism analysis reveals that broadband internet increases children’s sedentary game activities time, decreases their physical activities time, and increases their snack intake and total energy intake. This study underscores the significance of coordinated regulation of children's gaming activities by parents, schools, communities, and the government, in order to effectively reduce children's online game time, mitigate the risk of overweight, and alleviate the economic burden associated with childhood overweight.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究利用中国健康与营养调查（CHNS）的十波数据，覆盖从1989年到2015年的时期。它利用21世纪初启动的全国性互联网速度升级项目作为外生冲击。利用这一变化，我们构建了一个双重差分模型来识别宽带互联网接入对儿童体重结果的因果效应。结果表明，宽带互联网显著增加了儿童超重的概率。稳健性检验支持这些结果。异质性分析显示，年龄较大和城市儿童的体重受宽带互联网影响更大。机制分析揭示，宽带互联网增加了儿童久坐游戏活动时间，减少了他们的体育活动时间，并增加了他们的零食摄入和总能量摄入。本研究强调了家长、学校、社区和政府协调监管儿童游戏活动的重要性，以有效减少儿童在线游戏时间，降低超重风险，并减轻与儿童超重相关的经济负担。

records.title_en: Does party organization construction improve chinese banks' stability? Evidence from a new textual index
records.title_cn: 党组织建设是否提升了中国银行的稳定性？来自新文本指数的证据
records.abstract_en: According to China's newly revised Company Law (2024), companies are required to establish Communist Party of China (CPC; also, Party) organizations because Party-related activities are crucial for banks' stability. This study innovatively constructs a textual indicator to measure the development, governance, and education of the CPC organization based on annual reports. Then, we investigate the impact of Party organization construction on bankruptcy risk in 16 publicly listed banks from 2017 to 2022. Statistical analysis reveals that banks are gradually making efforts to enhance and improve internal Party organization construction. Moreover, overall Party organization construction reduces bank failure risk by inhibiting banks from engaging in high-risk business, such as interbank and shadow banking business. Compared with the Party organization construction dimensions of development and governance, the education of Party organization can better reduce bankruptcy risk. Furthermore, this reduction effect is more pronounced for state-owned banks, bigger banks, banks with profitability pressures and under financial distress, and during the pandemic period. This study expands the study of bank failure risk from the corporate governance perspective, showing that the Party organization construction contributes to safeguarding financial stability.
records.abstract_cn: 根据中国新修订的《公司法》（2024年），公司被要求建立中国共产党（中共；亦称为党组织）组织，因为与党组织相关的活动对银行的稳定性至关重要。本研究创新性地基于年度报告构建了一个文本指标，用以衡量党组织的发展、治理和教育。随后，我们考察了党组织建设对2017年至2022年间16家上市银行破产风险的影响。统计分析显示，银行正逐步努力加强和改进内部党组织建设。此外，整体党组织建设通过抑制银行从事高风险业务（如同业和影子银行业务）来降低银行失败风险。与党组织建设的发展与治理维度相比，党组织的教育更能降低破产风险。进一步地，这种降低效应在国有银行、规模较大的银行、面临盈利压力和财务困境的银行以及疫情期间更为显著。本研究从公司治理视角扩展了银行失败风险的研究，表明党组织建设有助于维护金融稳定。

records.title_en: Political budget cycles, government size, and the allocation of public funds: Evidence from prefectures in China
records.title_cn: 政治预算周期、政府规模与公共资金分配：来自中国地级市的证据
records.abstract_en: We investigate political budget cycles in prefecture-level cities in China by leveraging cross-province variation in the timing of the Provincial Congress of the Communist Party, which is the most significant event for promoting and reappointing prefecture leaders. Our findings reveal strong evidence of a cyclical pattern, characterized by an increase in government spending leading up to the Congress, followed by a decrease afterward. This trend is particularly pronounced for infrastructure spending, which is a crucial driver of economic growth in China. Additionally, we examine China's multi-layer government hierarchy and explore heterogeneity across prefectures. Our analysis shows that these cycles are especially evident when promotion opportunities for prefecture leaders are most prominent. In terms of revenue sources, we do not observe significant cyclical patterns for in-budget revenues; however, we do find evidence of cycles in revenues from land sales, a vital source of off-budget revenues. Our study contributes to the literature by examining both the size of government and the allocation of public funds in order to uncover distinct political budget cycles at the prefecture level in China and highlighting the vertical incentives within the multi-layer government hierarchy.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用中国共产党省级代表大会时间在各省之间的差异，研究了中国地级市的政治预算周期，该代表大会是提拔和重新任命地级领导的最重要事件。我们的研究结果揭示了强烈的周期性模式证据，其特征是代表大会前政府支出增加，之后减少。这一趋势在基础设施建设支出中尤为明显，这是中国经济增长的关键驱动力。此外，我们考察了中国多层政府层级，并探索了地级市之间的异质性。我们的分析表明，当地级领导晋升机会最为突出时，这些周期尤为明显。在收入来源方面，我们没有观察到预算内收入的显著周期性模式；然而，我们确实发现了土地出让收入周期的证据，这是预算外收入的重要来源。我们的研究通过考察政府规模和公共资金分配，揭示了中国地级市层面不同的政治预算周期，并强调了多层政府层级中的纵向激励，为文献做出了贡献。

records.title_en: The nexus between digital finance and household consumption-based carbon emissions: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 数字金融与家庭消费碳排放之间的关联：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: While identifying the sources of carbon emissions has long been a critical focus for researchers and policymakers, there remains a notable gap in understanding micro-level drivers, particularly the relationship between digital finance and household consumption-based carbon emissions. Existing literature has paid limited attention to how digital finance influences this issue. To address this gap, this study investigates the effect of digital finance on household consumption-based carbon emissions and its underlying mechanisms, using Chinese household data. Our analysis reveals that the development of digital finance significantly increases household consumption-based carbon emissions, and this positive effect remains robust even after addressing potential endogeneity concerns. Furthermore, the impact of digital finance on household consumption-based carbon emissions is more prominent in China’s eastern region and rural areas. These findings provide valuable insights for formulating targeted carbon emission reduction policies in the context of digital financial development
records.abstract_cn: 尽管识别碳排放来源长期以来一直是研究人员和政策制定者关注的焦点，但在理解微观层面的驱动因素方面仍存在显著空白，特别是数字金融与家庭消费碳排放之间的关系。现有文献对数字金融如何影响这一问题关注有限。为弥补这一空白，本研究利用中国家庭数据，考察了数字金融对家庭消费碳排放的影响及其内在机制。我们的分析表明，数字金融的发展显著增加了家庭消费碳排放，即使在处理了潜在的内生性问题后，这一正向效应依然稳健。此外，数字金融对家庭消费碳排放的影响在中国东部地区和农村地区更为突出。这些发现为在数字金融发展背景下制定针对性的碳减排政策提供了有价值的见解。

records.title_en: How does non-financial firms' systemic risk affect their credit constraints? Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 非金融企业的系统性风险如何影响其信贷约束？来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: While non-financial firms (NFFs) face growing vulnerabilities and enhanced interconnectedness, their systemic risk implications remain understudied compared to those of financial institutions like banks and insurers. Going beyond the existing literature, this study focuses on the systemic risk of NFFs and further reveals its effects on these firms' credit constraints. Using firm-level systemic risk data and financial data from Chinese non-financial listed firms from 2007 to 2021, we find that higher systemic risk in NFFs reduces access to bank credit, increases borrowing costs, and shortens credit maturities, thereby leading to tighter credit constraints. Systemic risk in NFFs exacerbates credit constraints through increased information asymmetry, higher probabilities of financial distress, and risk spillovers. These findings highlight the importance of systemic risk in predicting corporate financial distress and real economic weakness and its significance in banks' assessments of corporate solvency and credit risk.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管非金融企业面临日益增长的脆弱性和增强的相互关联性，但与银行和保险公司等金融机构相比，其系统性风险的影响仍未得到充分研究。超越现有文献，本研究聚焦于非金融企业的系统性风险，并进一步揭示其对这些企业信贷约束的影响。利用2007年至2021年中国非金融上市公司的企业层面系统性风险数据和财务数据，我们发现非金融企业较高的系统性风险减少了银行信贷的获取，增加了借款成本，并缩短了信贷期限，从而导致更严格的信贷约束。非金融企业的系统性风险通过增加信息不对称、提高财务困境概率和风险溢出效应加剧了信贷约束。这些发现强调了系统性风险在预测企业财务困境和实体经济疲软方面的重要性，以及其在银行评估企业偿债能力和信用风险中的重要性。

records.title_en: The employment effects of VAT rebate efficiency: Evidence from SMEs in China
records.title_cn: 增值税退税效率的就业效应：来自中国中小企业的证据
records.abstract_en: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) are pivotal for job creation in China. This study investigates whether improving the efficiency of Value-Added Tax (VAT) rebates can promote employment in SMEs. Using firm-level data from the National Tax Survey and Chinese Customs, we find that reducing VAT rebate delays significantly increases SME employment, both on the intensive margin—by expanding employment within existing firms—and on the extensive margin—by reducing the probability of exit from export markets. Furthermore, SMEs that face greater financial constraints exhibit heightened sensitivity to VAT rebate delays. Our findings highlight the importance of streamlining VAT rebate processes, particularly for financially constrained firms, to boost employment.
records.abstract_cn: 中小企业对于中国的就业创造至关重要。本研究探讨了提高增值税退税效率是否能促进中小企业就业。利用全国税收调查和中国海关的企业层面数据，我们发现减少增值税退税延迟显著增加了中小企业就业，既在集约边际上——通过扩大现有企业的就业规模，也在扩展边际上——通过降低退出出口市场的概率。此外，面临更大融资约束的中小企业对增值税退税延迟表现出更高的敏感性。我们的发现强调了简化增值税退税流程的重要性，特别是对于融资受限的企业，以促进就业。

records.title_en: Unintended negative impact of environmental regulation on public safety: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 环境规制对公共安全的意外负面影响：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the unintended effect of air pollution regulations on public safety. Based on a city-level panel data set, we document first evidence of the causal relationship between environmental regulations and crime rate, using difference-in-differences approach. Specifically, we find that the well-known “2+26” work plan of air pollution control for Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei Atmospheric Pollution Transmission Corridor increased the incidence of intentional injury, provocation and troublemaking, dangerous driving, theft, and robbery in a statistical sense. Regarding the underlying mechanism, environmental regulations may cause substantial job displacement, which in turn triggers negative emotions and psychological distress, ultimately increasing both economically motivated and emotionally driven crimes. Our empirical results imply extra social cost of environmental regulations, which has been mostly overlooked in the literature.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了空气污染规制对公共安全的意外影响。基于城市层面的面板数据集，我们使用双重差分方法，首次记录了环境规制与犯罪率之间因果关系的证据。具体而言，我们发现著名的“2+26”京津冀大气污染传输通道空气污染治理工作方案，在统计意义上增加了故意伤害、寻衅滋事、危险驾驶、盗窃和抢劫的发生率。关于潜在机制，环境规制可能导致大量工作岗位流失，进而引发负面情绪和心理困扰，最终增加经济动机和情绪驱动的犯罪。我们的实证结果暗示了环境规制的额外社会成本，这在文献中大多被忽视。

records.title_en: Long-term care insurance policy and the development of elderly care enterprises in China
records.title_cn: 我国长期护理保险政策与养老企业发展
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the effect of Long-Term Care Insurance (LTCI) policy on the development of elderly care enterprises in China. Exploiting a policy shock and employing a difference-in-differences design, we find that the implementation of LTCI policy significantly promotes the number of new entries and survival rate of elderly care enterprises, particularly for individual businesses, enterprises in health and social work industry, and those located in eastern region. Notably, service-only LTCI policy exhibits a stronger effect on the development of elderly care enterprises than the policy combining service and cash benefits. Mechanism analysis suggests that LTCI stimulates market demand for formal care services and increases government expenditures on social security and healthcare, both of which drive the development of elderly care enterprises. We also find that LTCI policy boosts labor demand in the elderly care industry. Overall, our empirical findings suggest that LTCI can help address the shortage of long-term care services and enhance family welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了长期护理保险（LTCI）政策对中国养老企业发展的影响。利用政策冲击并采用双重差分设计，我们发现LTCI政策的实施显着促进了养老企业的新进入数量和生存率，特别是个体工商户、健康和社会工作行业企业以及东部地区的企业。值得注意的是，仅提供服务的LTCI政策对养老企业发展的影响大于服务和现金福利相结合的政策。机制分析表明，LTCI刺激了市场对正规养老服务的需求，增加了政府在社会保障和医疗保健方面的支出，从而带动了养老企业的发展。我们还发现，LTCI政策拉动了养老行业的劳动力需求。总体而言，我们的实证研究结果表明，LTCI 可以帮助解决长期护理服务短缺问题并提高家庭福利。

records.title_en: Maturity mismatch and disinvestment as transmission mechanisms: Linking economic policy uncertainty to firm performance
records.title_cn: 期限错配与投资缩减作为传导机制：经济政策不确定性对企业绩效的影响
records.abstract_en: Since the beginning of the 21st century, the global economic and political landscape has become ever-changing, leading to rising economic policy uncertainty (EPU) in China. Utilizing indicators of macro EPU and firm perception of EPU, this study analyzes panel data from Chinese A-share listed firms (2007–2022) to investigate how EPU affects firm performance. The research findings demonstrate that EPU negatively affects firm performance primarily through maturity mismatch and disinvestment. Macro-level economic policy uncertainty shapes micro-level firm perceptions and strategic responses. Furthermore, the negative impact of EPU is more pronounced for firms operating in highly concentrated industries, as well as for risk-preferred firms, non-SOEs, cross-border firms during periods of Sino–US trade friction, and decline-stage firms. Lastly, this study recommends that government agencies prioritize continuity, predictability, and transparency in implementation of economic policies. To build resilience when EPU is rising, firms should leverage information-driven strategy, optimize debt–asset structure, and enhance competitiveness.
records.abstract_cn: 自21世纪初以来，全球经济和政治格局日益变化，导致中国经济政策不确定性（EPU）上升。利用宏观EPU指标和企业对EPU的感知，本研究分析了中国A股上市公司（2007-2022年）的面板数据，以探讨EPU如何影响企业绩效。研究结果表明，EPU主要通过期限错配和投资缩减对企业绩效产生负面影响。宏观经济政策不确定性塑造了微观企业的感知和战略反应。此外，EPU的负面影响在高度集中行业中的企业、风险偏好型企业、非国有企业、中美贸易摩擦期间的跨境企业以及衰退阶段的企业中更为显著。最后，本研究建议政府机构在经济政策实施中优先考虑连续性、可预测性和透明度。为在EPU上升时增强韧性，企业应利用信息驱动战略，优化资产负债结构，并提升竞争力。

records.title_en: Econometric evaluation of the China–US trade war effects
records.title_cn: 中美贸易战影响的经济计量评估
records.abstract_en: The escalating trade war between China and the US, initiated in 2018, has significantly impacted the trade pattern of these two nations. This event can be treated as an intervention which has led to a series of retaliatory actions, resulting in substantial economic and trade frictions between the two largest economies. This paper aims to analyze the economic impacts of the trade war effects using advanced econometric techniques. Our empirical study employs panel data analysis combined with a factor model, inspired by the methodologies of Hsiao, Ching and Wan (2012) and Bai, Li and Ouyang (2014), to construct trade patterns for both China and the US. By using annual trade data from multiple countries as a control group, we construct counterfactual results for China’s and the US’s imports, exports, and trade balance, respectively. Under a nonstationary setting, the counterfactual results indicate a significant decline in China’s exports and a notable reduction in its trade surplus with the US post-2018. Meanwhile, US imports from China decreased, aligning with the trade war’s goal of reducing the trade deficit, while US exports to China unexpectedly increased, possibly influenced by the Phase One trade agreement. We also perform a dynamic permutation test on treatment effects over time, which ensures the rigor and significance of our analysis, reinforcing the reliability of the estimated effects. Finally, we conduct an empirical comparative analysis with alternative methods to demonstrate that our chosen approach is particularly well-suited to the context of this study.
records.abstract_cn: 始于2018年的中美贸易战不断升级，显著影响了两国的贸易格局。这一事件可被视为一种干预，引发了一系列报复性行动，导致这两个最大经济体之间出现严重的经济和贸易摩擦。本文旨在利用先进的经济计量技术分析贸易战影响的经济效应。我们的实证研究采用面板数据分析结合因子模型，借鉴了Hsiao, Ching和Wan（2012）以及Bai, Li和Ouyang（2014）的方法论，为中美两国构建贸易模式。通过使用多个国家的年度贸易数据作为对照组，我们分别构建了中国和美国进口、出口及贸易平衡的反事实结果。在非平稳设定下，反事实结果表明，2018年后中国出口显著下降，对美贸易顺差明显减少。同时，美国从中国的进口减少，这与贸易战减少贸易逆差的目标一致，而美国对中国的出口意外增加，可能受到第一阶段贸易协议的影响。我们还对随时间变化的处理效应进行了动态置换检验，这确保了分析的严谨性和显著性，增强了估计效应的可靠性。最后，我们与替代方法进行了实证比较分析，以证明我们选择的方法特别适合本研究的背景。

records.title_en: Narrative monetary policy expectation in China
records.title_cn: 中国叙事性货币政策预期
records.abstract_en: This study introduces a novel narrative monetary policy expectation (MPEN) index for China, constructed through the semantic analysis of more than one million economic news articles. While our MPEN aligns with macro- and micro-survey-based monetary policy expectation indicators, it offers distinct advantages, including higher frequency, timeliness, and cost-effectiveness. Employing a time-varying parameter vector autoregression model, we find that the expectation of expansionary monetary policy is associated with economic downturns or inflation declines. Furthermore, monetary policy expectation is more responsive to GDP during downturns and more sensitive to CPI during economic booms.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究通过语义分析超过一百万篇经济新闻文章，构建了一个新颖的中国叙事性货币政策预期（MPEN）指数。虽然我们的MPEN与基于宏观和微观调查的货币政策预期指标相一致，但它具有更高的频率、及时性和成本效益等独特优势。采用时变参数向量自回归模型，我们发现扩张性货币政策的预期与经济衰退或通胀下降相关。此外，货币政策预期在经济衰退期间对GDP更为敏感，而在经济繁荣期间对CPI更为敏感。

records.title_en: Recovering after natural disasters: A stabilizing role of the government
records.title_cn: 自然灾害后的恢复：政府的稳定作用
records.abstract_en: This paper explores the patterns of corporate recovery following natural disasters, with a specific focus on the government’s role in facilitating this process. Our results reveal that firms recover fast following disasters in China, with the effect being more pronounced among state-owned enterprises (SOEs). Mechanism analysis identifies the government’s direct and indirect capital injections as the primary drivers of this swift recovery, which help mitigate disruptions in corporate investments. Furthermore, this government intervention exhibits a nuanced nature. Corporate post-disaster recovery tends to be weaker (stronger) for SOEs (Non-SOEs) when local fiscal expenditure is stronger. Different government intervention methods exhibit a substitution effect. Overall, this paper underscores the noteworthy and intricate role of the government in stabilizing the economy.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了自然灾害后企业恢复的模式，特别关注政府在促进这一过程中的作用。我们的结果显示，在中国，企业在灾害后恢复迅速，这一效应在国有企业中更为显著。机制分析识别出政府的直接和间接资本注入是这种快速恢复的主要驱动力，这有助于减轻企业投资的中断。此外，这种政府干预表现出细微差别。当地方财政支出较强时，国有企业（非国有企业）的灾后恢复往往较弱（较强）。不同的政府干预方式表现出替代效应。总体而言，本文强调了政府在稳定经济中显著且复杂的作用。

records.title_en: Founder control and breakthrough innovation: Evidence from high-tech firms in China
records.title_cn: 创始人控制与突破性创新：来自中国高科技企业的证据
records.abstract_en: We examine the effect of founder control on breakthrough innovation among Chinese high-tech firms from 2008 to 2022. We measure founder control by the equity held by founders actively involved in governance and identify breakthrough innovation with Sentence-BERT (SBERT) embeddings of patent texts. We find a strong positive association between founder control and future breakthrough innovation. Using unexpected founder departures as an instrument, our identification strategy establishes a robust causal relationship. The underlying mechanisms include talent investment, internal discipline, strategic reorientation, and technological resilience. The effect is heterogeneous across founding team's size, internal structure, attributes, and tenure. Our results support a structural view of founder governance where concentrated control serves as an engine for corporate innovation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了2008年至2022年间中国高科技企业中创始人控制对突破性创新的影响。我们通过积极参与治理的创始人持有的股权来衡量创始人控制，并使用专利文本的Sentence-BERT（SBERT）嵌入来识别突破性创新。我们发现创始人控制与未来突破性创新之间存在强烈的正相关关系。利用创始人意外离职作为工具变量，我们的识别策略建立了稳健的因果关系。其潜在机制包括人才投资、内部纪律、战略重新定位和技术韧性。该效应在创始团队规模、内部结构、属性和任期方面存在异质性。我们的结果支持一种结构性创始人治理观点，即集中控制作为企业创新的引擎。

records.title_en: Adverse sentiments in the American media houses towards the Belt & Road Initiative (BRI): An analysis of the taxonomy, trend, texture, and tendency
records.title_cn: 美国媒体对“一带一路”倡议的负面情绪：分类、趋势、纹理与倾向分析
records.abstract_en: While the Chinese narrative promotes inclusive development, shared economies and sustainable futures, the American narrative highlights its negative impact on the world. This study explores whether the narratives of the leading news media in the USA emit negative sentiments towards the BRI (Belt and Road Initiative) project over the last 10 years, from the BRI's birth in 2013 to adolescence in 2023. During this period, some 3569 articles were written in the two prominent publications in the USA—The Wall Street Journal (WSJ) and Dow Jones Newswires (DJN) concerning the BRI. This study analyzed them using media theories to discern the prevailing attitudes and perceptions expressed in these articles in terms of heuristics (taxonomy, temporality, texture, and tendency). We made four discoveries related to the sentiments contextualised in the media narratives about the BRI project. First, the WSJ embeds negative sentiments in its narrative more than the DJN does. Second, the temporal line reveals that negative sentiment increased as the BRI project grew towards youth. Third, the concrete (vs abstract) texture of the narrative is more negative and WSJ is more concrete than DJN is. Fourth, the political discourse in the context (people, groups, country) reveals negative tendencies, but business discourse in the institutional/corporate contexts reveals positive tendencies. These findings offer valuable insights into the evolving perceptions and attitudes surrounding the BRI project in influential global media outlets in America, providing a nuanced understanding of how media framing (taxonomy), temporality, texture, and tendency are driving the discourse and geopolitical influence on the public mind.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管中国的叙事强调包容性发展、共享经济和可持续未来，美国的叙事则突出其对世界的负面影响。本研究探讨了在过去10年间，从“一带一路”倡议于2013年诞生到2023年步入青春期，美国主要新闻媒体是否对其项目发出了负面情绪。在此期间，美国两家知名出版物——《华尔街日报》（WSJ）和道琼斯通讯社（DJN）——共发表了3569篇关于“一带一路”倡议的文章。本研究运用媒体理论对这些文章进行了分析，以从启发式（分类、时间性、纹理和倾向）角度辨别其中表达的主流态度和认知。我们发现了与“一带一路”倡议项目媒体叙事中情绪相关的四项发现。第一，《华尔街日报》在其叙事中嵌入的负面情绪多于道琼斯通讯社。第二，时间线显示，随着“一带一路”项目向青年期发展，负面情绪有所增加。第三，叙事的具象（相对于抽象）纹理更为负面，且《华尔街日报》比道琼斯通讯社更为具象。第四，在人物、群体、国家等背景下的政治话语显示出负面倾向，但在机构/企业背景下的商业话语则显示出正面倾向。这些发现为理解美国有影响力的全球媒体对“一带一路”项目不断演变的看法和态度提供了宝贵见解，深入揭示了媒体框架（分类）、时间性、纹理和倾向如何驱动公共舆论中的话语和地缘政治影响。

records.title_en: Global value chain position, industrial policy, and bank loan allocation: Evidence from Chinese manufacturing firms
records.title_cn: 全球价值链地位、产业政策与银行贷款配置：来自中国制造企业的证据
records.abstract_en: The rapid expansion of global value chains (GVCs) has deepened interconnections among countries and regions and reshaped industrial strategies and domestic capital allocations. Using a dataset of 2600 listed manufacturing firms in China from 2005 to 2020, this study finds that firms in industries that have lower GVC positions (LGPI firms), such as new energy, aerospace, and advanced materials, obtain a greater number of bank loans, particularly medium- and long-term loans and policy bank loans. The relationship is more pronounced for firms in regional strategic pillar and technology-intensive industries, state-owned firms, and those with lower operational risks and stronger debt repayment capacity. The main mechanisms include a compensatory effect (compensation for emerging strategic firms), a strategic response effect (response to the China-U.S. trade friction), and a technological support effect (support for firm R&D and digital transformation). The economic consequence tests indicate that the higher number of bank loans allocated to LGPI firms improves their total factor productivity and innovation patent output. Collectively, our findings reveal the evolving GVC competitiveness in China's manufacturing sector and the significant role financial institutions play in strengthening these less dominant but strategically important industries.
records.abstract_cn: 全球价值链快速扩张，加深了国家和地区之间的互联互通，重塑了产业战略和国内资本配置。本研究利用2005至2020期间中国2600家上市制造业企业的数据集发现，新能源、航空航天、先进材料等全球价值链地位较低的行业（LGPI企业）的企业获得的银行贷款数量较多，尤其是中长期贷款和政策性银行贷款。对于区域战略支柱企业、技术密集型产业企业、国有企业以及经营风险较低、偿债能力较强的企业，这种关系更为明显。主要机制包括补偿效应（对新兴战略企业的补偿）、战略应对效应（应对中美贸易摩擦）和技术支撑效应（支持企业研发和数字化转型）。经济后果测试表明，分配给 LGPI 企业的银行贷款数量较多，可以提高其全要素生产率和创新专利产出。总的来说，我们的研究结果揭示了中国制造业不断变化的全球价值链竞争力，以及金融机构在加强这些不太占主导地位但具有战略重要性的行业中发挥的重要作用。

records.title_en: Automation and household conflict: How industrial robots reduce domestic violence risk
records.title_cn: 自动化与家庭冲突：工业机器人如何降低家庭暴力风险
records.abstract_en: Existing studies have extensively examined the impact of industrial robots on the labor market but have paid relatively less attention to their effects on micro-level family behavior. This paper constructs a domestic violence risk index using court judgements and finds a significant negative impact of industrial robots on domestic violence risk. A series of robustness checks validates the credibility of this conclusion. Mechanism analysis indicates that industrial robots contribute to reducing the risk of domestic violence by promoting women's economic empowerment, increasing their educational attainment, and improving psychological well-being—particularly among men. Moreover, the negative effect of industrial robots on domestic violence risk is particularly pronounced in regions with lower levels of traditional culture or economic development, as well as higher levels of population mobility and vocational training. This research sheds light on the unforeseen social consequences of industrial intelligence and provides empirical evidence for preventing domestic violence.
records.abstract_cn: 现有研究广泛考察了工业机器人对劳动力市场的影响，但对其在微观家庭行为层面的效应关注相对较少。本文利用法院判决构建家庭暴力风险指数，发现工业机器人对家庭暴力风险具有显著的负向影响。一系列稳健性检验验证了这一结论的可信度。机制分析表明，工业机器人通过促进女性经济赋权、提高其教育程度以及改善心理健康——尤其是男性的心理健康——来降低家庭暴力风险。此外，工业机器人对家庭暴力风险的负向效应在传统文化水平或经济发展水平较低、人口流动性和职业培训水平较高的地区尤为显著。本研究揭示了工业智能带来的意外社会后果，并为预防家庭暴力提供了经验证据。

records.title_en: A measure of industrial clustering: Considering relatedness and scale
records.title_cn: 产业集聚的一种度量：考虑关联性与规模
records.abstract_en: An industrial cluster is a geographic area with a concentration of large numbers of firms in related industries. However, many clustering measures, such as regional specialization and industrial concentration measures, often overlook the two core features of clusters: industrial relatedness and scale. A few recently developed measures which address both factors are limited to specific industries and do not provide a regional-level perspective. In this paper, we introduce a novel clustering index that incorporates both relatedness and scale. Taking China as an example, we demonstrate that our index significantly outperforms existing measures in predicting major industrial clusters, both in the short and long term. Additionally, we show a positive correlation between the initial level of our clustering index and subsequent local economic performance, as measured by nighttime light intensity, patent grants, and the number of new businesses.
records.abstract_cn: 产业集群是指大量相关产业的企业集中分布的地理区域。然而，许多集聚度量方法，如区域专业化和产业集中度指标，往往忽视了集群的两个核心特征：产业关联性和规模。近期开发的少数同时考虑这两个因素的度量方法仅限于特定行业，并未提供区域层面的视角。在本文中，我们引入了一种新颖的集聚指数，该指数同时纳入了关联性和规模。以中国为例，我们证明我们的指数在预测主要产业集群方面显著优于现有度量方法，无论是在短期还是长期。此外，我们展示了我们集聚指数的初始水平与后续地方经济表现之间的正相关关系，该表现通过夜间灯光强度、专利授权数和新企业数量来衡量。

records.title_en: The paradox of assistance: Chinese aid in Africa and economic expectations
records.title_cn: 援助的悖论：中国在非洲的援助与经济预期
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how exposure to Chinese development projects shapes economic expectations in Africa. We link AidData's geocoded project records to 70,060 Afrobarometer interviews from 2005 to 2023 and identify effects using a shift–share instrumental variables design that interacts movements in Chinese construction-input costs with pre-sample allocation patterns. We find that living within 25 km of an active Chinese project lowers the probability that respondents expect national economic conditions to improve and, more modestly, reduces optimism about their own living conditions. Mechanism tests show that exposure raises perceived corruption—especially of national officials—and erodes trust in the presidency, parliament, and local councils; higher perceived corruption is monotonically associated with lower economic optimism. Results are robust across alternative instrument lags, distance thresholds, and spatial-spillover controls, and they do not generalize to placebo outcomes or to analogous estimates for World Bank projects. The evidence reconciles mixed views of Chinese aid by highlighting governance signals as the channel through which localized experiences translate into both macro- and micro-oriented expectations.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了中国发展项目如何影响非洲的经济预期。我们将AidData的地理编码项目记录与2005年至2023年间70,060次非洲晴雨表访谈相关联，并利用移动份额工具变量设计来识别效应，该设计将中国建筑投入成本的变动与样本前分配模式相结合。我们发现，居住在活跃中国项目25公里范围内会降低受访者预期国家经济状况改善的概率，并且更温和地减少了对自身生活条件的乐观情绪。机制检验表明，接触项目提高了感知腐败——尤其是对国家官员的感知腐败——并削弱了对总统、议会和地方委员会的信任；更高的感知腐败与经济乐观情绪单调负相关。结果在替代工具滞后、距离阈值和空间溢出控制下均稳健，且不适用于安慰剂结果或世界银行项目的类似估计。证据通过强调治理信号作为渠道，调和了对中国援助的混合看法，即局部经历转化为宏观和微观导向的预期。

records.title_en: FinTech and consumption resilience to uncertainty shocks: Evidence from digital wealth management in China
records.title_cn: 金融科技与消费对不确定性冲击的韧性：来自中国数字财富管理的证据
records.abstract_en: Developing countries are taking advantage of FinTech tools to provide more people with convenient access to financial market investment through digital wealth management. Using COVID-19 as an uncertainty shock, we examine whether and how digital wealth management affects the resilience of consumption to shocks based on a unique micro dataset provided by Alipay, a leading Big Tech platform in China. We find that digital wealth management mitigates the response of consumption to uncertainty shocks: residents who participate in digital wealth management, especially in risky asset investments, experience a lower reduction in consumption. The mitigation effect works through two channels: those who allocate a larger proportion of risky assets in their portfolio (portfolio choice channel) and obtain a higher realized return (changes in asset prices channel) exhibit greater consumption resilience to negative shocks. Importantly, digital wealth management helps improve financial inclusion, with a more pronounced mitigation effect among residents with lower-level wealth, living in less developed areas, and those with lower-level conventional finance accessibility. We also find that digital wealth management substitutes for conventional bank credit but serves as a complement to FinTech credit in smoothing consumption during uncertainty shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 发展中国家正利用金融科技工具，通过数字财富管理为更多人提供便捷的金融市场投资渠道。利用COVID-19作为不确定性冲击，我们基于中国领先的Big Tech平台支付宝提供的独特微观数据集，考察数字财富管理是否以及如何影响消费对冲击的韧性。我们发现，数字财富管理减轻了消费对不确定性冲击的反应：参与数字财富管理的居民，尤其是参与风险资产投资的居民，消费下降幅度较小。这种缓解效应通过两个渠道发挥作用：那些在投资组合中配置更高比例风险资产（投资组合选择渠道）并获得更高实际回报（资产价格变动渠道）的居民，在面对负面冲击时表现出更强的消费韧性。重要的是，数字财富管理有助于提升金融包容性，在财富水平较低、生活在欠发达地区以及传统金融可及性较低的居民中，缓解效应更为显著。我们还发现，在不确定性冲击期间，数字财富管理替代了传统银行信贷，但与金融科技信贷互补，共同平滑消费。

records.title_en: Measuring MPC heterogeneity in China: Insights from household registration reform
records.title_cn: 中国MPC异质性测度：来自户籍改革的启示
records.abstract_en: Understanding the marginal propensity to consume (MPC), its heterogeneity among different population groups, and the influence of policy shocks on MPC is crucial for policymakers. This paper addresses these three questions using two datasets: the China Family Panel Studies (CFPS) and the China Household Finance Survey (CHFS). Extending the Euler equation method of Baker (2018), we estimate the MPC for urban residents in China, finding it ranges between 0.130 and 0.144. A comprehensive heterogeneity analysis shows that individuals with lower wealth, married status, poor health, high education, children, non-migrant status, or homeownership tend to have higher MPCs. Using the 2014 Hukou reform as a policy shock, we estimate its impact on the MPC using CHFS. Results from a difference-in-differences analysis reveal that the reform significantly increased the MPC among urban residents. We show that the influx of migrants following the Hukou reform raised urban housing prices, which increased homeowners' debt levels through wealth effects and reduced their liquid assets, ultimately raising their marginal propensity to consume.
records.abstract_cn: 理解边际消费倾向（MPC）、不同人群间的异质性以及政策冲击对MPC的影响，对政策制定者至关重要。本文利用两个数据集——中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS）和中国家庭金融调查（CHFS）——来回答这三个问题。通过扩展Baker（2018）的欧拉方程方法，我们估计了中国城市居民的MPC，发现其范围在0.130至0.144之间。一项全面的异质性分析表明，财富较低、已婚、健康状况差、教育程度高、有子女、非流动人口或拥有住房的个体往往具有更高的MPC。以2014年户籍改革作为政策冲击，我们利用CHFS数据估计了其对MPC的影响。双重差分分析的结果显示，该改革显著提高了城市居民的MPC。我们表明，户籍改革后流动人口的涌入推高了城市住房价格，通过财富效应增加了房主的债务水平并减少了其流动资产，最终提高了他们的边际消费倾向。

records.title_en: Next stop innovation: Subway stations opening and spatial agglomeration of high-tech enterprises
records.title_cn: 下一站创新：地铁站开通与高科技企业的空间集聚
records.abstract_en: The establishment and improvement of public transport systems, particularly subways, are reshaping the spatial distribution of high-tech enterprises in cities. We employed a time-varying difference-in-differences method to investigate the agglomeration of high-tech enterprises in the vicinity of 363 Beijing subway stations opened between 2000 and 2022. Our findings reveal that the opening of the subway stations resulted in a significant increase in the number of high-tech enterprises in the surrounding areas. The construction of subway lines effectively increased accessibility to the outer city and significantly enhanced innovative activities in the peripheral areas, while having no significant impact on the inner city. Subway stations connected to the original innovation center had a more pronounced effect on innovation compared to other stations.
records.abstract_cn: 公共交通系统，特别是地铁的建立和完善，正在重塑城市中高科技企业的空间分布。我们采用时变双重差分法，研究了2000年至2022年间开通的363个北京地铁站附近高科技企业的集聚情况。研究结果显示，地铁站的开通显著增加了周边地区高科技企业的数量。地铁线路的建设有效提高了对外城区的可达性，并显著增强了外围地区的创新活动，而对内城区则没有显著影响。与原始创新中心相连的地铁站相比其他站点对创新的促进作用更为明显。

records.title_en: Social norms alleviate the disadvantaged positions of elderly people in charity markets
records.title_cn: 社会规范缓解老年人在慈善市场中的弱势地位
records.abstract_en: Charitable giving is an important supplement to social insurance programs. However, potential recipients of different ages may have unequal access to charitable donations. This study uses discrete choice experiments to investigate how the age of potential recipients may affect individuals' willingness to donate, and it uses survey experiments to examine the nudge effects of social norms on individuals' preferences for donating to elderly people. The results from 1146 Chinese internet users show that a one-year increase in the age of potential recipients decreases individuals' willingness to donate by approximately 2.094 CNY. Relative to a 20-year-old potential recipient, donors' willingness to give decreases by 54.358, 98.028, and 152.862 CNY for recipients aged 45, 70, and 90, respectively. Descriptive social norms and injunctive social norms can nudge individuals' willingness to donate to elderly people, increasing the marginal willingness to pay by 1.487 and 0.803 CNY, respectively. This work documents the disadvantaged positions of elderly people in charity markets and provides insights for promoting donation to elderly people in aging societies.
records.abstract_cn: 慈善捐赠是社会保险项目的重要补充。然而，不同年龄的潜在受助者可能无法平等地获得慈善捐款。本研究采用离散选择实验来调查潜在受助者的年龄如何影响个人的捐赠意愿，并采用调查实验来检验社会规范对个人向老年人捐赠偏好的助推效应。来自1146名中国互联网用户的结果显示，潜在受助者年龄每增加一岁，个人的捐赠意愿大约减少2.094元人民币。相对于20岁的潜在受助者，捐赠者对45、70和90岁受助者的捐赠意愿分别减少54.358、98.028和152.862元人民币。描述性社会规范和指令性社会规范可以助推个人向老年人捐赠的意愿，分别使边际支付意愿增加1.487和0.803元人民币。本研究记录了老年人在慈善市场中的弱势地位，并为在老龄化社会中促进向老年人捐赠提供了见解。

records.title_en: The role of experience in climate adaptation: Evidence from a field experiment in China
records.title_cn: 经验在气候适应中的作用：来自中国实地实验的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper extends the existing individual decision-making framework of adapting to climate change by considering the effects of prior personal experience in shaping risk preferences. Conducting Prospect Theory-based “lab-in-field” risk experiments in rural areas of Xinjiang Province, we elicit Chinese farmers' risk curvature and probability bias by adopting more flexible Prelec's two-parameter probability functions. Using Bayesian approaches to estimation, we find that farmers' prior experiences not only provide information that influences the subjective distributions of future outcomes but also, by shaping farmers' personal risk preferences, affects how farmers absorb and update this information. As such, our research suggests that individual risk preferences can evolve, and the effects of personal experience on preferences exhibit distinct patterns depending on whether farmers face benefits or losses. Experiencing production damages tends to make farmers more averse to losses and increases their optimistic bias concerning personal loss risks. A policy implication of these findings is that it is crucial to reduce farmers' cognitive biases regarding their own climate-related losses and their over-reliance on personal experiences in order to make accurate risk management decisions.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过考虑先前个人经验在塑造风险偏好中的作用，扩展了现有的适应气候变化的个体决策框架。我们在新疆农村地区进行了基于前景理论的“实验室实地”风险实验，采用更灵活的Prelec双参数概率函数来揭示中国农民的风险曲率和概率偏差。使用贝叶斯方法进行估计，我们发现农民的先前的经验不仅提供了影响未来结果主观分布的信息，而且通过塑造农民的个人风险偏好，影响农民如何吸收和更新这些信息。因此，我们的研究表明，个体风险偏好可以演变，且个人经验对偏好的影响在农民面临收益或损失时表现出不同的模式。经历生产损失往往使农民更加厌恶损失，并增加他们对个人损失风险的乐观偏差。这些发现的政策含义是，减少农民对自身气候相关损失的认知偏差以及他们对个人经验的过度依赖，对于做出准确的风险管理决策至关重要。

records.title_en: Cognitive ability, non-cognitive ability and occupational attainment in China
records.title_cn: 认知能力、非认知能力与中国职业获得
records.abstract_en: We investigate the roles of cognitive and non-cognitive abilities in predicting occupational choice and earnings in China using data from the China Family Panel Studies. Cognitive ability is assessed using scores from cognitive tests, while non-cognitive ability is measured using the Big Five factors, as well as the respondents’ locus of control, and economic preferences involving risk, trust, and patience. Our findings reveal that both cognitive and non-cognitive abilities are significantly associated with occupational choice, and different occupations exhibit distinct reward patterns for these abilities. Moreover, we observe interactive effects between cognitive and non-cognitive abilities in shaping occupational earnings. While our results indicate occupation-specific patterns in the importance of cognitive and non-cognitive abilities, they also highlight the significant role of the personality trait openness to experience in predicting both occupational choices and earnings in China’s labor market.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用中国家庭追踪调查数据，研究了认知能力和非认知能力在中国职业选择与收入预测中的作用。认知能力通过认知测试得分进行评估，而非认知能力则采用大五人格因素，以及受访者的控制点、涉及风险、信任和耐心的经济偏好来衡量。我们的研究结果显示，认知能力和非认知能力均与职业选择显著相关，且不同职业对这些能力的回报模式存在差异。此外，我们观察到认知能力和非认知能力在塑造职业收入方面存在交互效应。虽然我们的结果表明认知和非认知能力的重要性具有职业特定模式，但它们也强调了人格特质开放性在中国劳动力市场中预测职业选择和收入方面的重要作用。

records.title_en: The impact of household debt on the wealth distribution and inequality in China
records.title_cn: 家庭债务对中国财富分配与不平等的影响
records.abstract_en: A recent Chinese household survey shows heterogeneous debt-to-income ratio (DIR) and debt-to-asset ratio (DAR). We analyze the cyclicality and time-lag properties of debt increment with respect to consumption and asset accumulation using econometric methods, and examine the effect of debt on wealth distribution in China by applying heterogeneous asset grids and idiosyncratic returns. The Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman problem solved with interpolation and nested-drift approaches suggests that debt relaxes the budget constraint but hinders asset accumulation among low-income/asset households, and the Gini index increases by around 0.11 in the presence of debt increment. We further demonstrate that the indirect effect of monetary policy via assets accounts for up to 20 percent of the total effect for households with high wealth endowments. However, the high DIR and DAR prevent the compensation of the indirect effect on output growth and consumption for households with low endowments, thereby decreasing the effectiveness of standard monetary policy.
records.abstract_cn: 近期一项中国家庭调查显示，债务收入比（DIR）和债务资产比（DAR）存在异质性。我们运用计量经济学方法分析了债务增量相对于消费和资产积累的周期性与时滞特性，并通过应用异质性资产网格和特质性回报考察了债务对中国财富分配的影响。采用插值和嵌套漂移方法求解的Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman问题表明，债务放宽了预算约束，但阻碍了低收入/低资产家庭的资产积累，且基尼系数在债务增量存在时上升约0.11。我们进一步证明，货币政策通过资产渠道产生的间接效应，对于高财富禀赋家庭而言，占总效应的比例高达20%。然而，高DIR和高DAR阻碍了间接效应对低禀赋家庭产出增长和消费的补偿，从而降低了标准货币政策的有效性。

records.title_en: Demolition, housing lock-in, and labor migration
records.title_cn: 拆迁、住房锁定与劳动力迁移
records.abstract_en: This study examines an underexplored question of how housing demolitions influence internal labor migration in China amid slowing population growth and growing concern over workforce mobility. Using nationally representative micro-level survey data from 2013 to 2019 and leveraging housing demolition as an exogenous shock, we examine the relationship among demolition, homeownership, and labor migration. We begin by developing a two-stage discrete choice model to analyze household migration decisions, incorporating multiple dimensions, such as social network dependence, transaction costs, and emotional attachment. Our findings reveal that housing demolition significantly reduces the homeownership rate by 4.6 percentage points and increases the probability of urban registered labor outflow from counties by 7.4 percentage points. Importantly, these effects extend to both intra-provincial and inter-provincial flows, highlighting the role of demolition in reshaping the spatial distribution of labor. Mechanism analysis indicates a dynamic process: in the short term, demolition weakens households' attachment to housing, reducing the housing lock-in effect, while in the long term, compensation creates a wealth effect that alters household assets and influences migration decisions. Heterogeneity analysis further shows that demolition disproportionately constrains younger and lower-income households with fewer assets, underscoring unequal adaptability to forced relocation.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了一个尚未充分研究的问题，即在人口增长放缓和劳动力流动性日益受到关注的背景下，住房拆迁如何影响中国国内劳动力迁移。利用2013年至2019年具有全国代表性的微观调查数据，并将住房拆迁作为外生冲击，我们考察了拆迁、住房自有与劳动力迁移之间的关系。我们首先构建了一个两阶段离散选择模型来分析家庭迁移决策，该模型纳入了社会网络依赖、交易成本和情感依恋等多个维度。研究结果显示，住房拆迁显著降低了住房自有率4.6个百分点，并将县域城市注册劳动力外流的概率提高了7.4个百分点。重要的是，这些效应同时体现在省内和省际流动中，凸显了拆迁在重塑劳动力空间分布中的作用。机制分析表明了一个动态过程：短期内，拆迁削弱了家庭对住房的依恋，减少了住房锁定效应；而长期内，补偿产生了财富效应，改变了家庭资产并影响迁移决策。异质性分析进一步显示，拆迁对资产较少的年轻和低收入家庭的约束尤为明显，凸显了在强制搬迁中适应能力的不平等。

records.title_en: Climate risk and household stock market participation
records.title_cn: 气候风险与家庭股市参与
records.abstract_en: This study examines how climate risk shapes household portfolio choice, addressing a gap in the household-finance literature that largely overlooks environmental factors. Prior work has emphasized household characteristics and socioeconomic conditions, but the role of physical climate risk remains underexplored. Using five waves (2011–2019) of the China Household Finance Survey (CHFS) matched to county-level meteorological records, we estimate a household-level panel fixed-effects model and implement an instrumental-variables strategy to identify causal effects. We document that extreme heat conditions significantly curtail participation in equity markets and shrink the fraction of household assets allocated to stocks. Our mechanism analysis indicates that climate risk operates by amplifying background risks—specifically labor-income and health risks—and by tightening household credit constraints. These findings illuminate the micro-level channels through which climate risk affects household financial behavior, highlight regressive effects on disadvantaged households, and underscore the need for climate-resilient financial policy.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨气候风险如何影响家庭投资组合选择，填补了家庭金融文献中很大程度上忽视环境因素的空白。先前的研究强调了家庭特征和社会经济条件，但物理气候风险的作用仍未得到充分探索。利用中国家庭金融调查（CHFS）2011-2019年五轮数据，与县级气象记录相匹配，我们估计了一个家庭层面的面板固定效应模型，并采用工具变量策略来识别因果效应。我们发现极端高温条件显著抑制了股市参与，并减少了家庭资产中配置于股票的比例。我们的机制分析表明，气候风险通过放大背景风险——特别是劳动收入风险和健康风险——以及收紧家庭信贷约束来发挥作用。这些发现阐明了气候风险影响家庭金融行为的微观渠道，强调了对弱势家庭的累退效应，并凸显了制定气候适应性金融政策的必要性。

records.title_en: Climbing the social ladder: Clans and intergenerational mobility in China
records.title_cn: 攀登社会阶梯：中国的宗族和代际流动
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we investigate the relationship between clans as informal institutions and upward intergenerational transmission of human capital. Using detailed father-child pairs from China, we find individuals residing in areas with stronger clans have higher probability for moving upward the social ladder. A one standard deviation increase in the number of genealogies per 10,000 people (logged) could raise the probability for moving upward the social ladder by 2.26 %. The results are further confirmed by using the distance of each prefecture's centroid to the nearest Zhu Xi academy in the Song Dynasty as an instrumental variable. In addition, informal financing within clans, legacy of prioritizing education and extensive networks of social connections based on kinship networks are three main mechanisms. Finally, daughters who lack financial investment with their schooling and job prospects in small families are more likely to benefit more from resource pooling services within clans, thereby increasing their chances for moving up the social ladder.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究了作为非正式制度的氏族与人力资本代际向上传递之间的关系。通过使用来自中国的详细父子对，我们发现居住在宗族较强地区的个体更有可能在社会阶梯上向上移动。每10,000人（已记录）的家谱数量增加一个标准差可能会使社会阶梯向上移动的概率提高2.26%。以各府县质心到最近的宋代朱熹书院的距离作为工具变量，进一步验证了结果。此外，宗族内部的非正式融资、优先教育的遗产以及基于亲属关系网络的广泛社会联系网络是三个主要机制。最后，小家庭中缺乏对学业和就业前景的经济投入的女儿更有可能从宗族内部的资源共享服务中受益更多，从而增加她们提升社会阶梯的机会。

records.title_en: Race and Economic Well-Being in the United States
records.title_cn: 美国的种族与经济福祉
records.abstract_en: We construct a measure of consumption-equivalent welfare for Black and White Americans, which incorporates life expectancy, consumption, leisure, and inequality. Based on these factors, welfare for Black Americans was 40 percent of that for White Americans in 1984 and 59 percent by 2022. There has been remarkable progress for Black Americans: The level of their consumption-equivalent welfare increased by a factor of 3.5 over the last 38 years when aggregate consumption per person only doubled. Despite this progress, the welfare gap in 2022 remains disconcertingly large at 41 percent, much larger than the 16 percent gap in consumption per person. (JEL D12, I12, I31, J15, J31, K42)
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个衡量美国黑人和白人消费等价福利的指标，该指标涵盖了预期寿命、消费、休闲和 inequality。基于这些因素，1984年黑人美国人的福利为白人美国人的40%，到2022年这一比例上升至59%。黑人美国人取得了显著进步：在过去38年中，他们的消费等价福利水平增长了3.5倍，而人均总消费仅翻了一番。尽管取得了这一进步，2022年的福利差距仍高达41%，令人不安，远大于人均消费16%的差距。(JEL D12, I12, I31, J15, J31, K42)

records.title_en: The Consumer Welfare Effects of Online Ads: Evidence from a Nine-Year Experiment
records.title_cn: 在线广告的消费者福利效应：来自一项为期九年的实验的证据
records.abstract_en: Research on the effects of online advertising on consumer welfare is limited due to challenges in running large-scale field experiments. We analyze a long-running field experiment on Facebook in which a random subset of users received no ads in their newsfeeds. Using an incentive-compatible deactivation experiment, we find no significant differences in users’ valuation of Facebook across a representative sample of 53,083 Facebook users in the ads and no ads groups. Our sample size allows for precise estimates, suggesting that either the disutility of ads is relatively small or that there are offsetting benefits, such as product discovery. (JEL C93, D12, D44, L82, M37)
records.abstract_cn: 由于开展大规模现场实验的挑战，关于在线广告对消费者福利影响的研究有限。我们分析了一项在Facebook上进行的长期现场实验，其中随机选取的一部分用户在其新闻推送中未收到任何广告。通过一项激励相容的停用实验，我们发现，在代表样本中的53,083名Facebook用户中，广告组与无广告组在用户对Facebook的估值上没有显著差异。我们的样本量允许精确估计，这表明要么广告带来的负效用相对较小，要么存在抵消性的好处，如产品发现。(JEL C93, D12, D44, L82, M37)

records.title_en: Long-Term and Lasting Impacts of Personal Initiative Training on Entrepreneurial Success
records.title_cn: 个人主动性培训对创业成功的长期持久影响
records.abstract_en: A randomized experiment in Togo found that personal initiative training for small businesses resulted in large and significant impacts for both men and women after two years. We revisit these entrepreneurs after seven years and find long-lasting average impacts of personal initiative training of $91-higher profits per month, which is larger than the two-year impacts. However, these long-term impacts are very different for men and women: The impact for men grows over time as they accumulate more capital and increase self-efficacy, whereas the impact for women is flat or declines, and capital buildup is much more limited. (JEL J16, J24, L25, L26, M53, O12, O14)
records.abstract_cn: 在多哥进行的一项随机实验发现，针对小企业的个人主动性培训在两年后对男性和女性都产生了显著且重大的影响。我们在七年后重新访问这些企业家，发现个人主动性培训的长期平均影响为每月利润高出91美元，这一影响大于两年时的效果。然而，这些长期影响在男性和女性之间存在很大差异：对男性而言，影响随时间增长，因为他们积累了更多资本并增强了自我效能感；而对女性而言，影响持平或下降，资本积累也更为有限。(JEL J16, J24, L25, L26, M53, O12, O14)

records.title_en: Sequential Sampling by Individuals and Groups: An Experimental Study
records.title_cn: 个体与群体的序贯抽样：一项实验研究
records.abstract_en: Many committees—juries, political task forces, etc.—spend time gathering costly information before reaching a decision. We report results from lab experiments focused on such dynamic information-collection processes, as in sequential hypothesis testing. We consider decisions governed by individuals and groups and compare how voting rules affect outcomes. Several insights emerge. First, average decision accuracies approximate those predicted theoretically, but these accuracies decline over time: Participants display nonstationary behavior. Second, groups generate markedly different outcomes than individuals, with majority rule yielding faster and less accurate decisions. In particular, welfare is higher when sequential information is collected in groups using unanimity. (JEL C83, D71, D72, D83)
records.abstract_cn: 许多委员会——如陪审团、政治任务小组等——在做出决定之前会花费时间收集成本高昂的信息。我们报告了针对此类动态信息收集过程的实验室实验结果，如同序贯假设检验。我们考虑由个体和群体主导的决策，并比较投票规则如何影响结果。出现了几个见解。首先，平均决策准确度接近理论预测，但这些准确度随时间下降：参与者表现出非平稳行为。其次，群体产生的结果与个体显著不同，多数规则导致更快但准确性较低的决策。特别是，当群体使用一致同意规则收集序贯信息时，福利更高。(JEL C83, D71, D72, D83)

records.title_en: Optimal Mortgage Refinancing with Inattention
records.title_cn: 忽视下的最优抵押贷款再融资
records.abstract_en: We build a model of optimal fixed-rate mortgage refinancing with fixed costs and inattention and derive a new sufficient statistic that can be used to measure inattention frictions from simple moments of the rate gap distribution. In the model, borrowers pay attention to rates sporadically, so they often fail to refinance even when it is profitable. When paying attention, borrowers optimally choose to refinance earlier than under a perfect attention benchmark. Our model can rationalize almost all errors of “omission” (refinancing too slowly) and a large fraction of the errors of “commission” (refinancing too quickly) previously documented in the data. (JEL D91, G41, G51)
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个包含固定成本和忽视的最优固定利率抵押贷款再融资模型，并推导出一个新的充分统计量，可用于从利率缺口分布的简单矩中衡量忽视摩擦。在该模型中，借款人偶尔关注利率，因此即使再融资有利可图，他们也常常未能进行再融资。当关注时，借款人会选择比完全关注基准下更早地进行再融资。我们的模型能够合理解释数据中先前记录的几乎所有“遗漏”错误（再融资过慢）以及大部分“错误行动”错误（再融资过快）。(JEL D91, G41, G51)

records.title_en: Web Search Personalization during the US 2020 Election
records.title_cn: 美国2020年选举期间的网络搜索个性化
records.abstract_en: We study the impact of web search personalization on ideological segregation in search results. We deploy 150 synthetic internet users with randomized partisan browsing preferences across 25 US cities. These users are active during the US 2020 election and its aftermath. Daily experiments in which the users enter identical election-related queries provide strong evidence for ideological segregation in search results across locations with different partisan leanings but only limited evidence for ideological segregation within location across users with different partisan browsing habits. We discuss the important role of the national and local (online) media landscape for understanding these results. (JEL D72, D83, L82, L86)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了网络搜索个性化对搜索结果中意识形态隔离的影响。我们在美国25个城市部署了150名具有随机化党派浏览偏好的合成互联网用户。这些用户在美国2020年选举及其后续期间活跃。每日实验中，用户输入相同的选举相关查询，提供了强有力的证据表明，在不同党派倾向的地区之间，搜索结果存在意识形态隔离，但在同一地区内，不同党派浏览习惯的用户之间的意识形态隔离证据有限。我们讨论了国家和地方（在线）媒体格局在理解这些结果中的重要作用。（JEL D72, D83, L82, L86）

records.title_en: Dynamics of Consumer Responses to Medical Price Changes
records.title_cn: 消费者对医疗价格变化的动态反应
records.abstract_en: How individuals respond to coinsurance rates is fundamental for insurance market design, but most existing estimates speak only to short-run responses. We exploit a unique policy experiment that increased the coinsurance rate some elderly individuals face when they are aged 70–74 but not before or after. Higher coinsurance rates have an immediate and persistent effect on health care expenditure, and a sizable share of this effect persists after age 75. We find no evidence that higher coinsurance rates affect health. These results suggest that health care utilization depends on dynamic factors other than health stock, such as habits. (JEL D12, G22, H51, I11, I12, I13, J14)
records.abstract_cn: 个人如何应对共保率是保险市场设计的基础，但大多数现有估计仅涉及短期反应。我们利用一项独特的政策实验，该实验提高了某些老年人在年龄处于70-74岁时的共保率，但在之前或之后并未如此。较高的共保率对医疗支出有即时且持续的影响，且这一影响的相当大一部分在年龄超过75岁后仍然存在。我们没有发现较高共保率影响健康的证据。这些结果表明，医疗服务的利用取决于除健康存量之外的动态因素，如习惯。(JEL D12, G22, H51, I11, I12, I13, J14)

records.title_en: Electric Vehicles and the Energy Transition: Unintended Consequences of Time-of-Use Pricing
records.title_cn: 电动汽车与能源转型：分时定价的意外后果
records.abstract_en: The growth of electric vehicles (EVs) raises new challenges for electricity systems. We implement a field experiment to assess the effect of time-of-use (TOU) pricing and managed charging on EV charging behavior. We find that while TOU pricing is effective at shifting EV charging into off-peak hours, it unintentionally induces new and larger “shadow peaks” of simultaneous charging. These shadow peaks lead to greater exceedance of local capacity constraints and advance the need for distribution network upgrades. In contrast, centrally managed charging solves the coordination problem, reducing transformer capacity requirements, and is well tolerated by consumers in our setting. (JEL C93, D91, L62, L94, Q42)
records.abstract_cn: 电动汽车的增长给电力系统带来了新的挑战。我们实施了一项实地实验，以评估分时定价和受控充电对电动汽车充电行为的影响。我们发现，虽然分时定价能有效将电动汽车充电转移到非高峰时段，但它无意中引发了新的、更大的同时充电“影子高峰”。这些影子高峰导致对当地容量约束的超出更加严重，并提前了配电网络升级的需求。相比之下，集中管理的充电解决了协调问题，降低了变压器容量需求，并且在我们的环境中得到了消费者的良好接受。(JEL C93, D91, L62, L94, Q42)

records.title_en: When Product Markets Become Collective Traps: The Case of Social Media
records.title_cn: 当产品市场成为集体陷阱：社交媒体案例
records.abstract_en: Individuals might experience negative utility from not consuming a popular product. With such externalities to nonusers, standard consumer surplus measures, which take aggregate consumption as given, fail to appropriately capture consumer welfare. We propose an approach to account for these externalities and apply it to estimate consumer welfare from two social media platforms: TikTok and Instagram. Incentivized experiments with college students indicate positive welfare based on the standard measure but negative welfare when accounting for these nonuser externalities. Our findings highlight the existence of product market traps, where active users of a platform prefer it not to exist.
records.abstract_cn: 个人可能会因不消费流行产品而体验到负面效用。由于对非用户的这种外部性，以总消费为给定的标准消费者剩余衡量标准无法适当地反映消费者福利。我们提出了一种方法来解释这些外部性，并将其应用于估计来自 二 社交媒体平台（TikTok 和 Instagram）的消费者福利。对大学生的激励实验表明，基于标准衡量标准的福利是正的，但考虑到这些非使用者外部性时，福利是负的。我们的研究结果强调了产品市​​场陷阱的存在，平台的活跃用户宁愿它不存在。

records.title_en: Supply, Demand, Institutions, and Firms: A Theory of Labor Market Sorting and the Wage Distribution
records.title_cn: 供给、需求、机构和企业：劳动力市场分类和工资分配理论
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how workforce composition, labor demand, and minimum wage jointly determine wages through their effects on worker-task assignments, firm wage premiums, and firm-worker sorting. Using an estimated model of monopsonistic local labor markets, it finds that minimum wage hikes and labor demand shocks drove the decline in Brazilian wage inequality from 1998 to 2012. While rising educational attainment compressed skill premiums within firms, it also reallocated skilled workers to high-wage firms, limiting that shock's effect on inequality. The analysis highlights interactions among exogenous factors, showing that concurrent supply and demand changes attenuated minimum wage impacts.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了劳动力构成、劳动力需求和最低工资如何通过其对工人任务分配、企业工资溢价和企业工人分类的影响来共同决定工资。使用垄断当地劳动力市场的估计模型发现，最低工资上涨和劳动力需求冲击推动巴西工资不平等从 1998 下降到 2012。虽然教育程度的提高压缩了企业内部的技能溢价，但它也将技术工人重新分配到高工资企业，限制了这种冲击对不平等的影响。该分析强调了外生因素之间的相互作用，表明同时发生的供需变化减弱了最低工资的影响。

records.title_en: Downward Rigidity in the Wage for New Hires
records.title_cn: 新员工工资刚性下降
records.abstract_en: Wage rigidity is an important explanation for unemployment fluctuations. In benchmark models wages for new hires are key, but there is limited evidence on this margin. We use wages posted on vacancies, with job and establishment information, to measure the wage for new hires. We show that our measure of the wage for new hires is rigid downward and flexible upward, in two steps. First, wages change infrequently at the job level, and fall especially rarely. Second, wages do not respond to rises in unemployment, but respond strongly to falls in unemployment. Job information is crucial for detecting downward rigidity.
records.abstract_cn: 工资刚性是失业波动的一个重要解释。在基准模型中，新员工的工资是关键，但关于这一点的证据有限。我们使用空缺职位上公布的工资以及职位和机构信息来衡量新员工的工资。我们表明，我们对新员工工资的衡量是严格向下和灵活向上的，以 二 为步长。 第一，工作层面的工资变化很少，尤其很少下降。 第二，工资不会对失业率的上升做出反应，但会对失业率的下降做出强烈的反应。工作信息对于检测向下刚性至关重要。

records.title_en: Gender Differences in Financial Advice
records.title_cn: 财务建议中的性别差异
records.abstract_en: Based on data gathered from 27,000 real-world meetings between financial advisors and clients of a large German bank, we show that advisors offer more self-serving advice to women, while men are more likely to receive sales fee rebates and less likely to be recommended expensive in-house multi-asset (IHMA) funds. Additional client and advisor surveys provide evidence consistent with statistical discrimination based on gender as a proxy for client financial sophistication, with female clients exhibiting lower financial literacy, confidence, and price sensitivity. Moreover, female advisors report less confidence in their own professional skills and engage in less discrimination than male colleagues.
records.abstract_cn: 根据 27,000 财务顾问与德国一家大型银行客户之间的真实会议收集的数据，我们发现顾问向女性提供更多自私的建议，而男性更有可能获得销售费用回扣，并且不太可能被推荐昂贵的内部多资产 (IHMA) 基金。其他客户和顾问调查提供的证据与基于性别的统计歧视相一致，作为客户财务成熟度的代表，女性客户表现出较低的金融知识、信心和价格敏感性。此外，与男性同事相比，女性顾问对自己的专业技能缺乏信心，受到的歧视也较少。

records.title_en: A Goldilocks Theory of Fiscal Deficits
records.title_cn: 财政赤字的金发姑娘理论
records.abstract_en: We develop a tractable framework for deficit and debt dynamics. A "free lunch" fiscal deficit—one that raises spending without higher future taxes—is sustainable without zero lower bound (ZLB) only when R < G − φ, where φ is the sensitivity of the interest rate to the debt level. With the ZLB, both high and low deficits can increase debt, as the latter weaken demand and reduce nominal growth at the ZLB. A rise in income inequality expands fiscal space outside the ZLB, but contracts it at the ZLB. Calibrating the model, we find little space for "free lunch" policies for the United States in 2019, but significant space for Japan.
records.abstract_cn: 我们为赤字和债务动态制定了一个易于处理的框架。 “免费午餐”财政赤字（一 可以在未来不增加税收的情况下提高支出）只有在 R < G − φ（其中 φ 是利率对债务水平的敏感性）时才可以在没有 零 下限 (ZLB) 的情况下持续。对于ZLB，高赤字和低赤字都会增加债务，因为后者会削弱需求并降低ZLB的名义增长。收入不平等的加剧扩大了零利率下限以外的财政空间，但缩小了零利率下限的财政空间。校准模型后，我们发现 2019 中美国的“免费午餐”政策空间很小，但日本的空间很大。

records.title_en: Strategic Voting in Two-Party Legislative Elections
records.title_cn: 二 党立法选举中的战略投票
records.abstract_en: I study multidistrict legislative elections with two parties and two binary dimensions of policy. Strategic voters focus on the dimension where their district is most likely to be pivotal in the legislature. Anticipating this, candidates select different policies than they would in single-district elections. The final policy is (i) uniquely pinned down by voter preferences, (ii) preferred by a majority of districts on each dimension, and (iii) a Condorcet winner if one exists. These properties are not guaranteed in single-district elections.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了 二 政党的多区立法选举和 二 政策的二元维度。战略选民关注的是他们的选区最有可能在立法机构中发挥关键作用的方面。预见到这一点，候选人选择了与单区选举不同的政策。最终政策是 (i) 由选民偏好唯一确定的，(ii) 在每个维度上得到大多数选区的偏好，以及 (iii) 如果 一 存在，则成为孔多塞获胜者。这些属性在单区选举中得不到保证。

records.title_en: Firm Responses and Wage Effects of Foreign Demand Shocks with Fixed Labor Costs and Monopsony
records.title_cn: 固定劳动力成本和垄断下外国需求冲击的企业反应和工资影响
records.abstract_en: We quantify the firm responses and real wage effects of foreign demand shocks. We use Belgian microdata to construct firm-specific measures of demand shocks, which capture that firms pass on foreign demand shocks to domestic suppliers. Our estimates of firm responses to these shocks suggest that firms face upward-sloping labor supply curves and have sizable fixed labor costs. We specify a general equilibrium model with these features to quantify the aggregate effects of simulated tariff shocks on wages. We find that ignoring fixed labor costs substantially underestimates aggregate effects on wages, whereas incorporating upward-sloping labor supply appears less consequential.
records.abstract_cn: 我们量化了外国需求冲击的企业反应和实际工资影响。我们使用比利时的微观数据来构建特定于企业的需求冲击指标，其中捕捉到企业将外国需求冲击传递给国内供应商的情况。我们对企业对这些冲击的反应的估计表明，企业面临着向上倾斜的劳动力供给曲线，并且拥有相当大的固定劳动力成本。我们指定具有这些特征的一般均衡模型来量化模拟关税冲击对工资的总体影响。我们发现，忽略固定劳动力成本大大低估了对工资的总体影响，而纳入向上倾斜的劳动力供应似乎不太重要。

records.title_en: First-Generation Elite: The Role of School Social Networks
records.title_cn: 第一-一代精英：学校社交网络的作用
records.abstract_en: High school students from non-elite backgrounds are less likely to have peers with elite-educated parents than their elite counterparts. This difference in social capital is a key driver of the high intergenerational persistence in elite education. We identify a positive elite peer effect on enrollment in elite programs and labor market earnings, then disentangle underlying mechanisms. Exploiting a lottery in assessment, a causal mediation analysis shows the overall positive peer effect reflects a positive effect on application behavior (conditional on GPA). When considering income mobility, we find that further mixing between high school elite and non-elite students could improve mobility.
