We add to this literature by showing that norm non-compliance may equally inflate the non-pecuniary loss of well-being for unemployed women. Using German panel data, we use the German division as a natural experiment to compare unemployment-related life satisfaction losses between different cohorts of East and West German women. We hypothesise that being exposed to different legal norms concerning workforce participation and different opportunity cost of working after the division shaped social identities and thus social norms around work for the two German female populations in different ways. East German women were required to work whereas West German women were expected to focus on family care. We find that East German women suffer significantly more from unemployment than West German women. This difference is driven entirely by East German females who were exclusively raised in the former GDR. We do not find such diverging patterns for German men. Our findings imply that women suffer as much as men from unemployment if socialised in the same way.
records.abstract_cn: 失业对人们生活满意度的影响超出了负面收入冲击。大量文献研究了失业的这些非货币成本，并强调了社会规范的重要性，尤其是对男性而言。我们通过表明规范不遵从可能同样加剧失业女性幸福感方面的非货币损失，为这一文献做出贡献。利用德国面板数据，我们将德国分裂作为自然实验，比较东德和西德女性不同队列中与失业相关的生活满意度损失。我们假设，分裂后关于劳动力参与的不同法律规范以及工作机会成本的不同，塑造了这两个德国女性群体围绕工作的社会身份和社会规范。东德女性被要求工作，而西德女性则被期望专注于家庭照料。我们发现，东德女性因失业遭受的痛苦显著大于西德女性。这一差异完全由在前东德独家成长的东德女性驱动。我们未在德国男性中发现这种分化模式。我们的研究结果表明，如果以相同方式社会化，女性因失业遭受的痛苦与男性一样多。

records.title_en: Performance pay for private program providers and impact on participants: A field experiment with employment services in Norway
records.title_cn: 私营项目提供者的绩效薪酬及其对参与者的影响：挪威就业服务的一项实地实验
records.abstract_en: This study examines whether performance-based pay for private employment service providers improves employment outcomes for program participants compared to traditional hourly compensation. Finding effective ways to outsource public services to external providers has the potential to improve the quality and efficiency of these services. Using a large-scale randomized controlled trial (RCT) conducted in Norway from April 2018 to December 2021, we evaluate the impact of different payment models on the performance of private firms in delivering labor market programs. A total of 4898 unemployed individuals were randomly assigned to either a treatment group (37 %), where providers received performance-based pay contingent on participants’ employment outcomes, or a control group (63 %), where providers were compensated on an hourly basis. Despite the substantial financial incentives involved, our findings reveal no significant differences in employment rates, earnings, or hours worked between the two groups. The results allow us to rule out effects on monthly earnings of ± €5 and employment effects of ± 1 percentage points after 12 months. There were no indications of heterogeneous treatment effects across different participant groups. A cost-benefit analysis suggests a supportive case for performance pay due to lower public costs, although this estimate is subject to uncertainty.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了与传统的按小时计酬相比，对私营就业服务提供者实行绩效薪酬是否能改善项目参与者的就业结果。寻找有效的方式将公共服务外包给外部提供者，有可能提高这些服务的质量和效率。利用在挪威从2018年四月至2021年十二月进行的一项大规模随机对照试验（RCT），我们评估了不同支付模式对私营企业在提供劳动力市场项目中的表现的影响。共有4898名失业个体被随机分配到治疗组（37%），其中提供者根据参与者的就业结果获得绩效薪酬，或对照组（63%），其中提供者按小时获得补偿。尽管涉及大量的财务激励，我们的研究结果显示，两组在就业率、收入或工作时间方面没有显著差异。结果使我们能够排除12个月后月收入±5欧元和就业效应±1个百分点的影响。没有迹象表明不同参与者群体之间存在异质性处理效应。成本效益分析表明，由于较低的公共成本，绩效薪酬有支持的理由，尽管这一估计存在不确定性。

records.title_en: Human after all: Occupations at the core of AI adoption
records.title_cn: 终究是人：人工智能采纳核心中的职业
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates how firms’ occupational structure shapes the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) using matched administrative data on French firms and relying on an instrumental variable Probit model. We identify ICT engineers as the only occupational group with a robust and statistically significant effect on AI adoption. This finding holds for ICT and non-ICT Services sectors, and regardless of whether AI is developed in-house or acquired externally. Our estimates suggest that closing the occupational gap between adopters and non-adopters would require approximately 215,000 additional ICT engineers, and 45,000 for the firms most exposed to AI. The results highlight the critical importance of investing in advanced digital skills to support the broader diffusion of AI technologies.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用法国企业的匹配行政数据，并依赖工具变量Probit模型，研究企业的职业结构如何影响人工智能（AI）的采纳。我们识别出ICT工程师是唯一对AI采纳具有稳健且统计显著影响的职业群体。这一发现在ICT和非ICT服务部门均成立，且无论AI是内部开发还是外部获取。我们的估计表明，缩小采纳者与非采纳者之间的职业差距大约需要新增215,000名ICT工程师，而对于最受AI影响的 firms 则需要45,000名。结果强调了投资于高级数字技能以支持AI技术更广泛传播的关键重要性。

records.title_en: Reducing the child penalty by incentivizing maternal part-time work?
records.title_cn: 通过激励母亲兼职工作来减少子女惩罚？
records.abstract_en: Governments worldwide are discussing ways to increase maternal labor market participation and to reduce the child penalty. This study analyzes the long run effects of a paid parental leave reform in Germany, a country characterized by high rates of maternal part-time employment after childbirth. The reform introduced additional financial incentives for mothers to engage in part-time work during the first two years following childbirth. Using German social security records, we exploit the fact that only mothers whose child is born in or after July 2015 are eligible for the new part-time parental leave option in a Difference-in-Differences strategy. We find that the policy increased the probability that high-income mothers return to work during the first year after child birth by 2.1–2.8 percentage points (≈ 15%–20%). However, the policy does not affect maternal employment along the extensive or intensive margin (part-time or full-time work) in the long run (i.e. up to 4.5 years after child). This indicates that while the reform successfully encourages early part-time return to work among high-income mothers, it does not significantly reduce the child penalty. However, it does also not trap mothers in part-time employment.
records.abstract_cn: 世界各国政府正在讨论增加母亲劳动力市场参与和减少子女惩罚的方法。本研究分析了德国一项带薪育儿假改革的长期效应，该国以生育后母亲兼职就业率高为特征。该改革引入了额外的财政激励，鼓励母亲在生育后的头两年从事兼职工作。利用德国社会保障记录，我们利用只有孩子在2015年七月或之后出生的母亲才有资格享受新的兼职育儿假选项这一事实，采用双重差分策略。我们发现，该政策使高收入母亲在生育后第一年内返回工作的概率增加了2.1-2.8个百分点（约15%–20%）。然而，从长期来看（即孩子出生后长达4.5年），该政策并未在广泛或密集边际（兼职或全职工作）上影响母亲的就业。这表明，尽管改革成功鼓励了高收入母亲早期兼职返回工作，但并未显著减少子女惩罚。然而，它也没有使母亲陷入兼职就业的困境。

records.title_en: Does a flexible parental leave system stimulate maternal employment?
records.title_cn: 灵活的育儿假制度能否促进母亲就业？
records.abstract_en: While many women stop working for an extended period after the birth of a child, well-designed parental leave policies can incentivize mothers to return to the labor market sooner. This study examines the effect of two recent parental leave reforms in Austria that allow parents to choose leave schemes with varying duration. Using a regression discontinuity design, we find that the introduction of more flexible scheme choices led mothers to take, on average, 1–2 months less of leave. This decrease in leave duration, however, was not accompanied by an employment increase of similar magnitude. To understand the absence of labor supply effects, we examine data on work preferences from the Austrian Microcensus. Child care duties are cited as the primary reason for not seeking work but few mothers indicate that they would start working if better access to formal childcare were available. Switching to the more flexible leave system had a minimal effect on the labor market choices of mothers, as the majority continue to prioritize child care responsibilities and do not consider nurseries as a desirable alternative. Our findings suggest that policy efforts to shorten parental leave may not be effective in the presence of strong family norms.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管许多女性在生育后长时间停止工作，但设计良好的育儿假政策可以激励母亲更早重返劳动力市场。本研究考察了奥地利最近两项育儿假改革的效果，这些改革允许父母选择不同时长的休假方案。利用断点回归设计，我们发现引入更灵活的方案选择导致母亲平均休假时间减少了1-2个月。然而，这种休假时间的减少并未伴随相应规模的就业增加。为了理解劳动力供给效应的缺失，我们考察了奥地利微观人口普查中关于工作偏好的数据。育儿责任被列为主要的不求职原因，但很少有母亲表示，如果能更好地获得正式托儿服务，她们就会开始工作。转向更灵活的休假制度对母亲的劳动力市场选择影响甚微，因为大多数人继续优先考虑育儿责任，并不认为托儿所是一个理想的替代选择。我们的研究结果表明，在强烈的家庭规范存在的情况下，缩短育儿假的政策努力可能不会有效。

records.title_en: Effects of team diversity on individual performance and voice: A field experiment of group composition by gender and language
records.title_cn: 团队多样性对个人表现与建言的影响：基于性别与语言的团队构成田野实验
records.abstract_en: We present results from a field experiment that tests the effects of varying gender and linguistic group composition on performance and on group-members’ perception that their voice is heard when completing complex collaborative work within a low scrutiny environment. We randomize individuals enrolled in a postgraduate course populated by mostly women and non-native English speakers into small teams within larger, exogenously assigned seminar groups. Groups are tasked with complex and deliberative research assignments over three months. Using administrative and survey data, we find that a higher share of women in seminar groups significantly benefits the academic performance of group members—an effect driven by a positive effect on female native English speakers — while a greater proportion of women in small teams improves non-native language speakers’ perception of being heard.
records.abstract_cn: 我们展示了一项田野实验的结果，该实验测试了在低监督环境中完成复杂协作任务时，性别和语言群体构成的变化对表现以及团队成员对其建言被倾听的感知的影响。我们将参加研究生课程（该课程以女性和非英语母语者为主）的个体随机分配到较大的、外生分配的研讨小组内的小团队中。这些小组在三个月内承担复杂且需要深思熟虑的研究任务。利用行政和调查数据，我们发现研讨小组中女性比例较高显著提升了成员的学习表现——这一效应主要由对女性英语母语者的积极影响驱动——而小团队中女性比例较高则改善了非母语语言使用者对建言被倾听的感知。

records.title_en: The composition of applicants, mismatch, and matching efficiency in the German VET market
records.title_cn: 德国VET市场中申请者构成、错配与匹配效率
records.abstract_en: Entries into firm-based vocational education and training (VET) stagnated in Germany during the 2010s and decreased by 11% between 2019 and 2020, which is likely to exacerbate future shortages of skilled workers. Against this backdrop, we study the VET market through the lens of a matching function estimated at the occupation by district level between 2013 and 2021. We employ a novel strategy to instrument for applicants and vacancies which draws on differences in local labor market conditions for different occupations. Our estimated matching elasticities for applicants and vacancies are 0.46 and 0.57, respectively. Matching efficiency shows a slight downward trend before Covid and a large drop during Covid. Using our estimates to decompose aggregate trends in matches, we find that while matching efficiency and applicants drove matches down before Covid, the increase in vacancies until 2019 stabilized the VET market. During Covid, the drop in applicants, vacancies, and matching efficiency contributed similarly to the sudden drop of matches. Furthermore, without the increase in migrants applying to VET positions, demographic change alone would have led to an even greater decline in matches already before Covid. Changes in occupational and regional mismatch did little in explaining the overall trend in matches.
records.abstract_cn: 在德国，基于企业的职业教育和培训（VET）的入职人数在2010年停滞不前，并在2019年至2020年间下降了11%，这可能加剧未来熟练工人的短缺。在此背景下，我们通过匹配函数的视角研究VET市场，该函数在2013年至2021年间按职业和地区层面进行估计。我们采用了一种新颖的策略，利用不同职业在地方劳动力市场条件的差异来为申请者和职位空缺寻找工具变量。我们估计的申请者和职位空缺的匹配弹性分别为0.46和0.57。匹配效率在新冠疫情前呈现轻微下降趋势，并在疫情期间大幅下降。利用我们的估计来分解匹配的总体趋势，我们发现，在新冠疫情前，匹配效率和申请者推动了匹配数量的下降，而直到2019年职位空缺的增加稳定了VET市场。在疫情期间，申请者、职位空缺和匹配效率的下降对匹配数量的突然下降贡献相似。此外，如果没有申请VET职位的移民增加，仅人口结构变化就会在新冠疫情前导致匹配数量更大幅度的下降。职业和地区错配的变化对匹配总体趋势的解释作用不大。

records.title_en: What determines the gender pay gap in academia?
records.title_cn: 什么决定了学术界的性别薪酬差距？
records.abstract_en: This paper focuses on two mechanisms that could explain the persistence of the gender pay gap – salary negotiations and child penalty. The academic sector is studied using administrative data from the University of Tartu, the largest university in Estonia. Data on academic staff from 2012 to 2021 have been merged with the population register and web-scraped data from Scopus. The role of negotiations is evaluated by deriving, for each academic field, their outside option earnings using administrative records of graduates, and the Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition is applied to evaluate whether men and women leverage this outside option differently in their salaries in academia. The child penalty in academia is estimated using a quasi-experimental event-study approach where we exploit the panel dimension of our data. We find that men obtain higher returns than women from the same outside option during salary negotiations. Given that men and women are subject to evaluation and wage negotiations with equal frequency in academia, we assign this gap to women being less effective negotiators. We find the child penalty for women in academia to be short-lived, resulting from a decline in working hours equal to two and a half years of full-time work spread over five years after childbirth. There is no statistically significant child penalty for women in terms of hourly wages, publications, or citations. Men, in contrast, do not experience any penalties related to children.
records.abstract_cn: 本文关注两种可能解释性别薪酬差距持续存在的机制——薪资谈判和子女惩罚。利用爱沙尼亚最大大学塔尔图大学的行政数据研究学术部门。将2012年至2021年的学术人员数据与人口登记册及从Scopus网络抓取的数据合并。通过为每个学术领域推导其外部选择收入（使用毕业生行政记录），评估谈判的作用，并应用Oaxaca-Blinder分解来评估男性和女性在学术界薪资中是否不同地利用这一外部选择。使用准实验事件研究法估计学术界的子女惩罚，其中我们利用了数据的面板维度。我们发现，在薪资谈判中，男性从相同的外部选择中获得比女性更高的回报。鉴于男性和女性在学术界接受评估和薪资谈判的频率相同，我们将这一差距归因于女性谈判效率较低。我们发现，学术界女性的子女惩罚是短暂的，源于生育后五年内工作时间减少，相当于两年半的全职工作。就小时工资、出版物或引用而言，女性没有统计上显著的子女惩罚。相比之下，男性则没有经历任何与子女相关的惩罚。

records.title_en: Parenthood and the gender gap in commuting
records.title_cn: 育儿与通勤性别差距
records.abstract_en: Childbirth raises the opportunity cost of commuting and makes it difficult for both parents to work far away from home. Using detailed Norwegian employer–employee matched register data, we show that the commuting behavior of men and women diverges immediately after childbirth and that those differences persist for at least a decade. This divergence in commuting behavior exposes mothers to more concentrated and suburban labor markets with fewer job opportunities and lower establishment quality. These findings uncover a key mechanism underlying the child penalty documented in prior work and have important implications for the design of policies seeking to address the remaining gender wage gap.
records.abstract_cn: 生育提高了通勤的机会成本，使得父母双方都难以在离家较远的地方工作。利用详细的挪威雇主-雇员匹配登记数据，我们表明男性和女性的通勤行为在生育后立即出现分化，且这些差异至少持续十年。这种通勤行为的分化使母亲们面临更集中和郊区的劳动力市场，这些市场的工作机会更少，企业质量也更低。这些发现揭示了先前研究中记录的儿童惩罚的一个关键机制，并对旨在解决剩余性别工资差距的政策设计具有重要意义。

records.title_en: The impact of increased exposure of diversity on suburban students’ outcomes: An analysis of the METCO voluntary desegregation program
records.title_cn: 多元化接触增加对郊区学生成果的影响：对METCO自愿废除种族隔离计划的分析
records.abstract_en: Over sixty years following Brown vs. Board of Education, racial and socioeconomic segregation and lack of equal access to educational opportunities persist. Across the country, voluntary desegregation busing programs aim to ameliorate these imbalances and disparities. A longstanding Massachusetts program, METCO, buses K-12 students of color from Boston and Springfield, Massachusetts to 37 suburban districts that voluntarily enroll urban students. Supporters of the program argue that it prepares students to be active citizens in our multicultural society. Opponents question the value of the program and worry it may have a negative impact on suburban student outcomes. I estimate the causal effect of exposure to diversity through the METCO program by using two types of variation: difference-in-difference analysis of schools stopping and starting their METCO enrollment and two-stage least squares analysis of space availability for METCO students. Both methods rule out substantial test score, attendance, or suspension effects of having METCO peers. Classroom ability distribution and classroom suspension rates remain similar when METCO programs start and stop. There is no negative impact on college preparation, competitiveness, persistence, or graduation.
records.abstract_cn: 在布朗诉教育委员会案之后六十多年，种族和社会经济隔离以及缺乏平等的教育机会仍然存在。全国各地的自愿废除种族隔离校车计划旨在改善这些不平衡和差距。马萨诸塞州一项长期计划METCO，将来自波士顿和马萨诸塞州斯普林菲尔德的K-12年级有色人种学生送往37个自愿招收城市学生的郊区学区。该计划的支持者认为，它培养学生成为我们多元文化社会中的积极公民。反对者质疑该计划的价值，并担心它可能对郊区学生的成果产生负面影响。我通过使用两种变异来估计通过METCO计划接触多样性的因果效应：对停止和开始其METCO注册的学校进行双重差分分析，以及对METCO学生可用空间的两阶段最小二乘分析。这两种方法都排除了拥有METCO同伴对考试成绩、出勤率或停学率的实质性影响。当METCO计划开始和停止时，课堂能力分布和课堂停学率保持相似。对大学准备、竞争力、坚持或毕业没有负面影响。

records.title_en: Recovering voice through out-of-district donations
records.title_cn: 通过跨区捐赠重获话语权
records.abstract_en: A growing share of Americans live in electorally lopsided congressional districts, potentially depressing their political participation. Unlike with voting, there are no place-based restrictions on giving, raising the question of whether individuals disengaged by lopsided home districts find voice through greater non-local giving. I explore this using the post-2010 redistricting, which reassigned individuals to more, or less, competitive districts. When an individual’s district becomes exogenously less competitive, she donates more out of district to competitive races. Givers regard non-local giving as a substitute for local political participation, increasing their out-of-district gifts by $0.40, and reducing their within-district gifts by $0.75, for every one p.p. increase in their home district’s lopsidedness.
records.abstract_cn: 越来越多的美国人生活在选举格局失衡的国会选区，这可能抑制了他们的政治参与。与投票不同，捐赠没有地域限制，这引发了一个问题：因家乡选区失衡而脱离政治的个人，是否会通过增加非本地捐赠来寻找话语权。我利用2010年后的选区重划来探讨这一问题，该重划将个人重新分配到竞争程度更高或更低的选区。当一个人的选区外生地变得竞争性减弱时，她会更多地向竞争激烈的选区进行跨区捐赠。捐赠者将非本地捐赠视为本地政治参与的替代品，家乡选区失衡程度每增加一个百分点，其跨区捐赠增加0.40美元，而区内捐赠减少0.75美元。

records.title_en: In-kind government assistance and crowd-out of charitable services: Evidence from free school meals
records.title_cn: 实物政府援助与慈善服务的挤出效应：来自免费学校餐的证据
records.abstract_en: Many community organizations provide services similar to government programs, but there is limited evidence how increased government aid affects the use and availability of charitable services. This study examines how greater access to federal nutrition assistance through schoolwide free meal programs affects food bank use within the U.S.’s largest food bank network. A 10 percent increase in access to free school meals reduces the amount of food that food banks distribute by 0.9–1.4 percent, without significantly reducing donations, fundraising activity, or the amount of food available. The reduction of food bank use is only found in areas where relatively few students previously qualified for government aid. Our findings highlight that even safety net programs that serve a specific population and offer distinct services can reduce pressures on charitable organizations, particularly in areas previously underserved by government assistance.
records.abstract_cn: 许多社区组织提供与政府项目类似的服务，但关于政府援助增加如何影响慈善服务的使用和可用性的证据有限。本研究考察了通过全校免费餐计划增加联邦营养援助的可及性如何影响美国最大食品银行网络中的食品银行使用。免费学校餐可及性增加10%，会使食品银行分发的食品量减少0.9-1.4%，而不会显著减少捐赠、筹款活动或可用食品量。食品银行使用的减少仅出现在先前符合政府援助条件的学生相对较少的地区。我们的研究结果强调，即使是为特定人群提供服务并提供不同服务的安全网项目，也能减轻慈善组织的压力，特别是在先前政府援助服务不足的地区。

records.title_en: The impact of economic opportunity on criminal behavior: Evidence from the fracking boom
records.title_cn: 经济机会对犯罪行为的影响：来自水力压裂繁荣的证据
records.abstract_en: Theory suggests crime should decrease as economic opportunities increase the returns to legal activities. However, the current literature shows crime increases when areas experience fracking, a source of increased local economic opportunity. This paper reconciles this puzzle by separating out existing residents and isolating local economic effects from changing composition. Specifically, I exploit within- and across-county variation in fracking activities in North Dakota using individual-level data on incumbent residents, mineral lease records, and criminal charges. The results rule out increases in crime for these existing residents and suggest a modest decrease. These results are consistent with theory and in contrast to the observed aggregate increases in crime from fracking, highlighting the importance of compositional changes.
records.abstract_cn: 理论表明，随着经济机会增加合法活动的回报，犯罪应当减少。然而，现有文献显示，当地区经历水力压裂（一种增加当地经济机会的来源）时，犯罪会增加。本文通过区分现有居民并隔离当地经济效应与人口构成变化，来调和这一矛盾。具体而言，我利用北达科他州水力压裂活动在县内和县间的变异，基于现有居民的个人层面数据、矿产租赁记录和刑事指控。结果排除了这些现有居民犯罪增加的可能性，并表明犯罪略有减少。这些结果与理论一致，且与观察到的水力压裂导致犯罪总体增加形成对比，突显了人口构成变化的重要性。

records.title_en: The sectoral origins of heterogeneous spending multipliers
records.title_cn: 异质支出乘数的部门起源
records.abstract_en: The aggregate spending multiplier crucially depends on the sectoral origin of government purchases. To establish this result, we characterize analytically the response of aggregate output to sector-specific government spending shocks in a tractable production-network economy, showing how it maps into various characteristics of the shocked sector. The response is larger when government spending originates in sectors with a relatively small contribution to private final demand, low markup, high labor intensity, and in those located downstream in the supply chain. We confirm these predictions and evaluate their quantitative relevance within a calibrated multi-sector model of the U.S. economy that embeds several dimensions of sectoral heterogeneity. Leveraging this model, we illustrate how differences in the sectoral composition of purchases across U.S. government levels lead to large variation in the spending multiplier. The latter ranges from 0.47 for federal defense spending, which is relatively concentrated in upstream capital-intensive manufacturing, to 0.82 for state and local spending, which is mainly oriented towards downstream labor-intensive services. Finally, we exploit heterogeneity in the sectoral composition of military spending across U.S. states to provide empirical evidence supporting our theoretical predictions.
records.abstract_cn: 总支出乘数在很大程度上取决于政府采购的部门来源。为了确定这一结果，我们分析性地描述了在易于处理的生产网络经济中总产出对特定部门政府支出冲击的反应，展示了它如何映射到受到冲击的部门的各种特征。当政府支出来自对私人最终需求贡献相对较小、加成率低、劳动强度高的部门以及位于供应链下游的部门时，反应会更大。我们证实了这些预测，并在美国经济的校准多部门模型中评估了它们的定量相关性，该模型嵌入了部门异质性的多个维度。利用这个模型，我们说明了美国政府各级采购部门构成的差异如何导致支出乘数的巨大变化。后者的范围从联邦国防支出的0.47（相对集中于上游资本密集型制造业）到州和地方支出的0.82（主要面向下游劳动密集型服务业）。最后，我们利用美国各州军事支出部门构成的异质性来提供支持我们理论预测的经验证据。

records.title_en: The full, persistent, and symmetric pass-through of a temporary VAT cut
records.title_cn: 临时增值税削减的完全、持久且对称的传导
records.abstract_en: We investigate the pass-through of a temporary value-added tax (VAT) cut on selected food products to consumer prices in Portugal. Exploiting a novel data set of daily online prices, we find that the VAT cut was fully transmitted to consumer prices, persisted throughout the policy duration, and prices returned to the pre-implementation trend after reversal. We discuss two potential mechanisms driving this result: the policy’s salience to consumers in a high-inflation environment and the decline in producer prices when implemented. We estimate that the policy reduced the inflation rate by 0.68 percentage points on impact.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了葡萄牙对选定食品临时削减增值税（VAT）向消费者价格的传导。利用每日在线价格的新数据集，我们发现增值税削减被完全传导至消费者价格，在政策期间持续存在，且价格在政策逆转后回归至实施前趋势。我们讨论了驱动这一结果的两种潜在机制：在高通胀环境下政策对消费者的显著性，以及实施时生产者价格的下降。我们估计该政策在实施时使通胀率降低了0.68个百分点。

records.title_en: Does the prospect of upward mobility undermine support for redistribution?
records.title_cn: 向上流动的前景是否会削弱对再分配的支持？
records.abstract_en: Despite substantial economic inequality in the United States, many Americans who would benefit from redistributive economic policies vote against them. This opposition could be justified by an exaggerated belief in the prospects of upward mobility. That is, people may oppose higher taxes on the largest incomes and estates because they overestimate the degree to which they would be subject to them. This research employs an experimental approach to studying Americans’ beliefs about their own prosperity and correlates these beliefs with support for redistribution. The results are not consistent with the theory that overconfidence about future prosperity impairs Americans’ support for redistribution. Instead, people report ideological stances tolerant of economic inequality and opposing redistribution, largely independent of their private economic interests.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管美国存在显著的经济不平等，许多本应从再分配经济政策中受益的美国人却投票反对这些政策。这种反对可能源于对向上流动前景的夸大信念。也就是说，人们可能反对对最高收入和遗产征收更高税收，因为他们高估了自己受这些税收影响的程度。本研究采用实验方法研究美国人对自身繁荣的信念，并将这些信念与对再分配的支持相关联。结果与关于未来繁荣的过度自信削弱美国人对再分配支持的理論不一致。相反，人们报告出容忍经济不平等并反对再分配的意识形态立场，这很大程度上独立于他们的私人经济利益。

records.title_en: Frames, incentives, and education: Effectiveness of interventions to delay public pension claiming
records.title_cn: 框架、激励与教育：延迟公共养老金领取干预措施的有效性
records.abstract_en: In many retirement income systems, people forgo a higher stream of public pension income by claiming early. This paper provides survey- and quasi-experimental evidence on how increasing financial incentives, educating individuals, and changing the framing of the claiming decision affect pension claiming and the present value of expected pension benefits. We find that all three types of interventions induce delays, but they have heterogeneous financial consequences. Educating participants about the claiming decision and life expectancy leads to claiming ages with higher pension wealth. In contrast, changing the framing of the claiming decision and strengthening financial incentives do not improve, and may even worsen, financial outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多退休收入体系中，人们因提前领取而放弃了更高额的公共养老金收入流。本文提供了基于调查和准实验的证据，研究增加财务激励、教育个人以及改变领取决策的框架如何影响养老金领取和预期养老金福利的现值。我们发现所有三类干预措施都能促使延迟领取，但它们具有异质性的财务后果。对参与者进行关于领取决策和预期寿命的教育，会导致领取年龄对应更高的养老金财富。相比之下，改变领取决策的框架和加强财务激励并不能改善，甚至可能恶化财务结果。

records.title_en: The employment effects of a means-tested guaranteed income policy
records.title_cn: 一项基于收入审查的保障性收入政策的就业效应
records.abstract_en: Through a randomized controlled trial, we study the labor market effects of a generous means-tested guaranteed income policy targeting low-income families in Barcelona. Two years into the program, beneficiaries are 22 % less likely to work compared to subjects assigned to a control group. A lower phase-out of transfers attenuates negative employment effects and reduces the government cost per euro of benefit by two-thirds. Participation elasticities for a family of four range from 0.39 to 0.49. Treatment effects persisted at least 6 months after the program ended. We find indications that effects are driven by subjects with care duties, suggesting substitution of labor for care tasks.
records.abstract_cn: 通过一项随机对照试验，我们研究了针对巴塞罗那低收入家庭的一项慷慨的、基于收入审查的保障性收入政策对劳动力市场的影响。项目实施两年后，受益者与对照组受试者相比，工作的可能性降低了22%。转移支付的逐步退出率较低，减轻了负面的就业效应，并将政府每欧元福利的成本降低了三分之二。一个四口之家的参与弹性介于0.39至0.49之间。治疗效应在项目结束后至少持续了6个月。我们发现迹象表明，这些效应是由有照护责任的受试者驱动的，这表明劳动力被替代为照护任务。

records.title_en: Tournament-style political competition and local protectionism: Theory and evidence from China
records.title_cn: 锦标赛式政治竞争与地方保护主义：来自中国的理论与证据
records.abstract_en: We argue that interjurisdictional competition in a regionally decentralized authoritarian regime distorts local politicians’ incentives in resource allocation among firms from their own city and a competing city. We develop a tournament model of project selection that captures the driving forces of local protectionism. The model robustly predicts that the joint presence of regional spillover and the incentive for political competition leads to biased resource allocations against the competing regions. Combining unique data sets, we test our model predictions in the context of government procurement allocation and firms’ equity investment across Chinese cities. We find that, first, when local politicians are in more intensive political competition, they allocate fewer government procurement contracts to firms in the competing city; second, local firms, especially local state-owned enterprises (SOEs), internalize the local politicians’ career concerns and invest less in the competing cities. Our paper provides a political economy explanation for inefficient local protectionism in an autocracy incentivized by tournament-style political competition.
records.abstract_cn: 我们认为，在区域分权的威权体制下，辖区间的竞争扭曲了地方政治家在资源配置中对待本市企业与竞争城市企业的激励。我们构建了一个项目选择的锦标赛模型，以捕捉地方保护主义的驱动因素。该模型稳健地预测，区域溢出效应与政治竞争激励的共同存在会导致资源配置偏向于不利于竞争地区的方向。结合独特的数据集，我们在政府采购分配和企业跨城市股权投资的背景下检验了我们的模型预测。我们发现，首先，当地方政治家面临更激烈的政治竞争时，他们会将更少的政府采购合同分配给竞争城市的企业；其次，本地企业，尤其是地方国有企业，会内化地方政治家的职业关切，并减少对竞争城市的投资。我们的论文为威权体制下由锦标赛式政治竞争激励导致的低效地方保护主义提供了一种政治经济学解释。

records.title_en: The graduation part II: Graduate program graduation rates
records.title_cn: 毕业（第二部分）：研究生项目毕业率
records.abstract_en: This paper documents several facts about graduate program graduation rates using administrative data covering public and nonprofit graduate students in Texas. Only 58 % of students entering a graduate program in 2004 graduated within 6 years. Between the 2004 and 2013 entering cohorts, graduate student completion rates grew by 10 percentage points. Graduation rates vary widely by field of study, ranging from an average of 81 % for law programs to 53 % for education programs. We also find large differences in graduation rates between institutions. On average, 72 % of students who entered programs in flagship public universities graduated in 6 years compared to only 57 % of those who entered programs in non-research intensive (non-R1) institutions. Graduate students who do not complete may face negative consequences due to lower average earnings and substantial levels of student debt.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用覆盖德克萨斯州公立和非营利研究生的行政数据，记录了关于研究生项目毕业率的几个事实。2004年进入研究生项目的学生中，仅有58%在6年内毕业。在2004至2013年的入学队列之间，研究生完成率增长了10个百分点。毕业率因研究领域而异，从法律项目的平均81%到教育项目的53%不等。我们还发现不同机构之间的毕业率存在较大差异。平均而言，进入旗舰公立大学项目的学生中有72%在6年内毕业，而进入非研究密集型（非R1）机构项目的学生中这一比例仅为57%。未完成学业的研究生可能因较低的平均收入和大量的学生债务而面临负面后果。

records.title_en: Intergenerational mobility in socio-emotional skills
records.title_cn: 社会情感技能的代际流动性
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the intergenerational transmission of socio-emotional skills during childhood, using data from the 1970 British Cohort Study (BCS70) in the United Kingdom. This dataset enables us to measure two dimensions of socio-emotional development: internalising and externalising skills. More importantly, we can use multiple measures of parents’ skills collected during both their childhood and their adulthood. Whereas parent–child skills are strongly related when both are measured contemporaneously, they remain correlated when both are measured in childhood, with a stronger transmission observed from mothers to their children. The BCS70 data finally enable us to estimate the correlation between the grandmother’s internalising skill and the grandchildren’s skills, after accounting for parental skills.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用英国1970年英国队列研究（BCS70）的数据，调查了儿童时期社会情感技能的代际传递。该数据集使我们能够衡量社会情感发展的两个维度：内化技能和外化技能。更重要的是，我们可以利用在父母童年期和成年期收集的多种父母技能测量指标。尽管当父母与子女的技能同时测量时，它们之间存在强烈关联，但当两者均在童年期测量时，它们仍然保持相关性，且观察到母亲向子女的传递更强。BCS70数据最终使我们能够在考虑父母技能后，估计祖母的内化技能与孙辈技能之间的相关性。

records.title_en: Facilitating police reform: Body cameras, police-involved homicides, and law enforcement outcomes
records.title_cn: 促进警务改革：随身摄像头、涉警杀人事件与执法结果
records.abstract_en: Body-worn cameras (BWCs) have emerged as a crucial reform to restore police legitimacy. However, there remains limited evidence on the conditions under which BWCs reduce use of force and affect broader agency-wide outcomes. Using a quasi-experimental event study design, I analyze data from 593 U.S. police agencies to estimate the effects of BWC adoption. I find that reductions in police-involved homicides are heterogeneous—concentrated in regions with higher prior levels of such incidents and in agencies with stricter activation requirements, with no measurable change in low-incident regions or agencies with weaker policies. This study also provides the first evidence on agency-wide outcomes, finding no significant trade-offs in overall arrest or crime rates. These findings offer insight into when BWCs are most likely to enhance police accountability and performance.
records.abstract_cn: 随身摄像头（BWCs）已成为恢复警察合法性的关键改革措施。然而，关于随身摄像头在何种条件下能减少武力使用并影响更广泛的机构层面结果，现有证据仍然有限。采用准实验事件研究设计，我分析了来自美国593个警察机构的数据，以估计采用随身摄像头的影响。我发现，涉警杀人事件的减少存在异质性——集中在此类事件先前发生率较高的地区以及激活要求更严格的机构中，而在低事件发生率地区或政策较弱的机构中则没有可测量的变化。本研究还首次提供了关于机构层面结果的证据，发现总体逮捕率或犯罪率方面没有显著的权衡。这些发现为随身摄像头最有可能增强警察问责制和绩效的条件提供了见解。

records.title_en: Private response to exclusionary welfare policy: Evidence from Italian municipalities
records.title_cn: 对排外性福利政策的私人回应：来自意大利市政的证据
records.abstract_en: Exclusionary welfare policies are among the flagship proposals in the economic agenda of the far right. Yet, there is little empirical evidence as to whether – after gaining power – such parties do indeed cut welfare provisions for immigrants. Using data on more than 6 million procurement contracts within a close-election Regression Discontinuity Design, I estimate that Italian mayors supported by the far right significantly cut welfare spending for immigrants and refugees. However, using novel data on volunteering associations, I also show that the narrow victory of a far-right coalition is followed by a 9.6 % growth in the per-capita number of local NGOs. The effect is driven by social welfare associations, which provide poverty relief and assistance to vulnerable individuals. Individual-level survey data document how the growth in volunteering is driven by left-leaning citizens with positive attitudes toward immigrants. These findings show how – following political turnovers – the non-profit sector can substitute the state in the provision of public goods that are off the agenda of incumbent policymakers.
records.abstract_cn: 排外性福利政策是极右翼经济议程中的旗舰提案之一。然而，关于这些政党在掌权后是否确实削减对移民的福利供给，实证证据寥寥。利用超过6百万份采购合同的数据，并采用接近选举的断点回归设计，我估计得到极右翼支持的意大利市长显著削减了针对移民和难民的福利支出。然而，利用关于志愿协会的新数据，我也表明极右翼联盟的微弱胜利伴随着人均本地非政府组织数量9.6%的增长。这一效应由社会福利协会驱动，这些协会提供贫困救济和对弱势个体的援助。个体层面的调查数据记录了志愿活动的增长是由对移民持积极态度的左倾公民推动的。这些发现表明，在政治更迭之后，非营利部门可以在公共品供给方面替代国家，而这些公共品不在现任政策制定者的议程上。

records.title_en: Intergenerational effect of an education stipend program on child development: Evidence from Bangladesh
records.title_cn: 教育津贴计划对儿童发展的代际效应：来自孟加拉国的证据
records.abstract_en: Human capital accumulation in early childhood is a critical stage in the life cycle for forming skills that have long-lasting economic consequences. This paper studies whether an education stipend program targeted at girls’ secondary schooling had an intergenerational impact on their children’s skills development years later. Exploiting two sources of variation in the intensity of program exposure and geographic eligibility, we find significant intergenerational gains in children’s cognitive and non-cognitive skills. Assessing potential mechanisms, we find improvement in women’s empowerment along multiple dimensions and changes in parental investments and parenting behavior conducive to child development. We detect important changes in parent–child engagement and approach to child discipline, including a change in attitude regarding the use of physical violence to address child behavioral problems. Our results highlight the importance of considering the long-term spillover effects of policy interventions designed to empower adolescent girls.
records.abstract_cn: 儿童早期的人力资本积累是生命周期中形成具有长期经济后果的技能的关键阶段。本文研究了一项针对女孩中学教育的教育津贴计划是否对其子女多年后的技能发展产生了代际影响。利用项目暴露强度和地理资格的两个变异来源，我们发现儿童认知和非认知技能方面存在显著的代际收益。在评估潜在机制时，我们发现女性赋权在多个维度上得到改善，并且父母投资和养育行为的变化有利于儿童发展。我们检测到亲子互动和儿童纪律处理方式的重要变化，包括对使用体罚解决儿童行为问题态度的改变。我们的结果强调了考虑旨在赋权青春期女孩的政策干预的长期溢出效应的重要性。

records.title_en: Provider payment incentives: Evidence from the U.S. hospice industry
records.title_cn: 提供者支付激励：来自美国临终关怀行业的证据
records.abstract_en: Combining capitation with a cap on health care providers’ average revenue can reduce allocative inefficiency. But the cap may be undercut by health care providers who churn their patient censuses. We investigate this possibility in the U.S. hospice industry, where Medicare pays hospice programs fixed daily rates but caps their average annual revenue. By leveraging variation generated by the cap’s nonlinear design and the transition between fiscal years, we find that programs on track to exceed the cap raise enrollment rates by 5.8 % and live discharge rates by 4.3 % in the fourth quarter. But this churning falls far short of eliminating their financial penalties: it amounts to 10 % of an average program’s excess revenue at most. Marginal enrollees have longer remaining lifetimes and more fragmented hospice spells on average, suggesting weaker intrinsic demand for hospice care. We discuss the cap’s implications for market structure.
records.abstract_cn: 将按人头付费与对医疗服务提供者平均收入的上限相结合，可以减少配置无效率。但这一上限可能会被那些频繁调整其患者名单的医疗服务提供者所削弱。我们在美国临终关怀行业中调查了这种可能性，在该行业中，医疗保险按日固定费率支付临终关怀项目，但对其年均收入设定上限。通过利用该上限非线性设计及财政年度转换所产生的变异，我们发现，有望超过上限的项目在第四季度将入院率提高5.8%，将活体出院率提高4.3%。但这种调整远未消除其财务处罚：它最多相当于平均项目超额收入的10%。边际入院患者平均剩余寿命更长，临终关怀期更为碎片化，表明其对临终关怀服务的内在需求较弱。我们讨论了该上限对市场结构的影响。

records.title_en: To burn a slum: Urban land conflicts and the use of arson against Favelas
records.title_cn: 焚烧贫民窟：城市土地冲突与针对贫民区的纵火行为
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the understudied phenomenon of urban land conflicts in contexts with weak enforcement of property rights. I examine, both theoretically and empirically, the use of arson as a violent tool to force slum removal from high-value land in cities. Leveraging fine-grained geocoded data, I employ panel regression and Difference-in-Differences analyses to demonstrate that the probability of slum fires dramatically increases with rising land prices. This effect is nonlinear and driven exclusively by slums situated on private lands, highlighting the role of high-powered incentives behind arson. These results illustrate how urban land conflicts can have different outcomes than their rural counterparts.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在产权执行薄弱背景下，城市土地冲突这一未被充分研究的现象。我从理论和实证两方面考察了纵火作为一种暴力工具，用于迫使城市中高价值土地上的贫民窟被拆除的情况。利用精细的地理编码数据，我采用面板回归和双重差分分析，证明贫民窟火灾的概率随着土地价格的上涨而显著增加。这种效应是非线性的，且仅由位于私人土地上的贫民窟驱动，凸显了纵火背后高能激励的作用。这些结果说明了城市土地冲突可能产生与农村土地冲突不同的结果。

records.title_en: Career expectations and outcomes: Evidence (on gender gaps) from the economics job market
records.title_cn: 职业期望与结果：来自经济学就业市场的证据（关于性别差距）
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates gender gaps in long-term career expectations and outcomes of PhD candidates in economics. For this purpose, we match rich survey data on PhD candidates (from the 2008–2010 job market cohorts) to public data on job history and publication records through 2022. We document four novel empirical facts: (1) there is a robust gender gap in career expectations, with females about 10 percentage points less likely to ex-ante expect to get tenure or publish regularly; (2) the gender gap in expectations is remarkably similar to the gap observed for academic outcomes; (3) expectations are similarly predictive of outcomes for males and females, and (4) gender gaps in expectations can explain about 22 % and 14 % of the ex-post gaps in tenure and publications, respectively. In addition, leveraging variation in relationship status at the time expectations are reported, we show that: conditional on gender, (1) expectations regarding tenure and publications do not differ systematically by relationship status, and (2) the predictive power of expectations does not differ by the relationship status of the individual.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了经济学博士候选人在长期职业期望和结果方面的性别差距。为此，我们将关于博士候选人的丰富调查数据（来自2008-2010年就业市场群体）与截至2022年的公开工作历史和发表记录数据相匹配。我们记录了四个新颖的实证事实：（1）职业期望存在稳健的性别差距，女性事先期望获得终身教职或定期发表论文的可能性约低10个百分点；（2）期望中的性别差距与观察到的学术结果差距 remarkably 相似；（3）期望对男性和女性的结果预测能力相似，以及（4）期望中的性别差距可以分别解释终身教职和发表方面事后差距的约22%和14%。此外，利用报告期望时关系状态的变化，我们表明：在控制性别的情况下，（1）关于终身教职和发表的期望不因关系状态而系统性地不同，以及（2）期望的预测能力不因个人的关系状态而异。

records.title_en: Impacts of home-care subsidies: Evidence from quasi-random assignment
records.title_cn: 居家护理补贴的影响：来自准随机分配的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the impact of subsidizing home-based long-term care on recipients’ health and the labor supply of their working-age children. We use administrative data from Israel on the universe of welfare benefit applications linked with tax records of applicants and their adult children. To address the endogeneity of benefit recipients’ health status, we instrument for benefit receipt using the leniency of randomly assigned evaluators who assess the applicant’s functional status and determine benefit eligibility. We find that for compliers—applicants who receive subsidies only from more lenient evaluators—subsidizing home-based care has large adverse effects on recipient health (+5.2 p.p. one-year mortality, 95 % CI: 1.5 to 8.9 p.p.) but no detectable effects on their children’s labor market outcomes (child labor market participation: −0.5 p.p., 95 % CI: −5.2 to +4.2 p.p.; child income: −5.5 log points, 95 % CI: −46 to +35 log points). The results are consistent with the crowd-out of self-care for the marginal recipient, highlighting the need to assess the heterogeneous effects of home-care subsidies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了补贴居家长期护理对受助者健康及其工作年龄子女劳动供给的影响。我们使用以色列行政数据，涵盖所有福利申请者及其成年子女的税务记录。为解决受助者健康状况的内生性问题，我们利用随机分配的评估员在评估申请人功能状态并决定补贴资格时的宽松程度作为补贴获得的工具变量。我们发现，对于依从者——即仅从更宽松的评估员那里获得补贴的申请人——补贴居家护理对受助者健康有较大的不利影响（一年死亡率增加+5.2个百分点，95%置信区间：1.5至8.9个百分点），但对子女的劳动力市场结果没有可检测的影响（子女劳动参与率：−0.5个百分点，95%置信区间：−5.2至+4.2个百分点；子女收入：−5.5对数点，95%置信区间：−46至+35对数点）。结果与边际受助者自我护理被挤出相一致，强调了评估居家护理补贴异质性效应的必要性。

records.title_en: Dependent insurance coverage and parental job lock: Evidence from the Affordable Care Act
records.title_cn: 受抚养人保险覆盖与父母工作锁定：来自《平价医疗法案》的证据
records.abstract_en: Coverage for dependents is a standard feature of employer-sponsored insurance. While prior work shows that employees trade off job mobility for their own coverage, less is known about the intra-family spillovers of dependent coverage on parental labor supply. We study this question using a large panel of employer-based insurance claims that links dependent enrollment to a proxy for parental job retention. We use a regression discontinuity design that exploits a sharp change in the duration of dependent eligibility by birth month under the Affordable Care Act. We find that additional dependent insurance eligibility increases both dependent take-up and parental job retention. This “job lock” effect is strongest among parents more likely to be on the margin of a job exit, for families that place higher value on dependent coverage, and employees of firms offering a broader range of insurance options.
records.abstract_cn: 受抚养人的保险覆盖是雇主提供保险的一个标准特征。虽然先前的研究表明员工会为了自己的保险覆盖而牺牲工作流动性，但关于受抚养人保险覆盖对父母劳动力供给的家庭内部溢出效应知之甚少。我们使用一个大型的基于雇主的保险索赔面板数据来研究这个问题，该数据将受抚养人的注册与父母工作保留的代理指标联系起来。我们采用回归不连续设计，利用《平价医疗法案》下按出生月份划分的受抚养人资格期限的急剧变化。我们发现，额外的受抚养人保险资格增加了受抚养人的参保率和父母的工作保留率。这种“工作锁定”效应在更可能处于离职边缘的父母、更重视受抚养人保险覆盖的家庭以及提供更广泛保险选择范围的公司的员工中最为显著。

records.title_en: Women leaders improve environmental outcomes: Evidence from crop fires in India
records.title_cn: 女性领导人改善环境成果：印度农作物火灾的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper provides the first plausibly causal evidence that women leaders improve environmental outcomes. Using a close-election regression discontinuity design, we find that the election of a female politician over a male politician decreases crop fire incidence and biomass-related particulate emissions in India. These effects are concentrated during the harvest and post-harvest months in districts that follow fire-suited cropping patterns. To understand mechanisms, we survey 424 male and female village council leaders in Punjab, the Indian state with the highest per capita incidence of crop fires. We find women leaders are more likely to consider crop fires a serious issue, weigh their impacts on child health, support regulations to decrease crop fire incidence, and implement specific crop residue management policies like private residue collection or encouraging crop residue use as fodder.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了第一个看似合理的因果证据，证明女性领导人可以改善环境成果。使用势均力敌的选举回归不连续性设计，我们发现女性政治家相对于男性政治家的当选减少了印度农作物火灾的发生率和与生物质相关的颗粒物排放。这些影响集中在采用适合防火的耕作模式的收获期和收获后月份。为了了解机制，我们对印度人均农作物火灾发生率最高的旁遮普邦的男性和女性村委会领导进行了调查424。我们发现，女性领导人更有可能认为农作物火灾是一个严重问题，权衡其对儿童健康的影响，支持减少农作物火灾发生率的法规，并实施具体的农作物残留物管理政策，例如私人残留物收集或鼓励将农作物残留物用作饲料。

records.title_en: Dynamic Pricing Regulation and Welfare in Insurance Markets
records.title_cn: 保险市场的动态定价监管和福利
records.abstract_en: While the traditional role of insurers is to provide protection against individuals’ idiosyncratic risks, insurers themselves face substantial uncertainties due to aggregate shocks. To prevent insurers from passing these aggregate risks onto consumers, governments have increasingly adopted dynamic pricing regulations, which limit insurers’ ability to change premiums over time. We evaluate dynamic pricing regulation using an equilibrium model of the US long-term care insurance market, featuring insurers’ lack of commitment and endogenous market structures. We find that stricter dynamic pricing regulation has a limited impact on improving consumer welfare, while it reduces insurer profits and increases market concentration.
records.abstract_cn: 虽然保险公司的传统作用是针对个人的特殊风险提供保护，但保险公司本身由于总体冲击而面临巨大的不确定性。为了防止保险公司将这些总体风险转嫁给消费者，政府越来越多地采用动态定价法规，这限制了保险公司随时间改变保费的能力。我们使用美国长期护理保险市场的均衡模型来评估动态定价监管，该模型的特点是保险公司缺乏承诺和内生市场结构。我们发现，更严格的动态定价监管对改善消费者福利的影响有限，但会降低保险公司的利润并提高市场集中度。

records.title_en: Combating Political Corruption with Policy Bundles
records.title_cn: 通过政策组合打击政治腐败
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we develop a dynamic model of politicians who can engage in corruption. The model provides important insights into the determinants of corruption and how to design policies to combat it. We estimate the model using data from Brazil to measure voters’ willingness to pay for various commonly proposed anticorruption policies, such as increasing audit probabilities, raising politicians’ wages, and extending term limits. We document that while audit policies effectively reduce corruption, a multipronged approach that bundles an audit policy with other policies can achieve much higher welfare gains.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们开发了一个可以参与腐败的政客的动态模型。该模型为腐败的决定因素以及如何设计打击腐败的政策提供了重要见解。我们使用巴西的数据来估计该模型，以衡量选民为各种普遍提出的反腐败政策付费的意愿，例如提高审计概率、提高政客的工资和延长任期限制。我们证明，虽然审计政策有效地减少了腐败，但将审计政策与其他政策捆绑在一起的多管齐下的方法可以实现更高的福利收益。

records.title_en: Rising Markups and the Role of Consumer Preferences
records.title_cn: 不断上涨的加价和消费者偏好的作用
records.abstract_en: We analyze the evolution of markups for consumer products in the United States from 2006 to 2019. Using detailed data on prices and quantities for products in more than 100 distinct categories, we obtain a panel of markups, marginal costs, and flexible consumer preferences. Our empirical strategy uses separate random coefficients logit models for each category and year and an assumption that firms set prices to maximize profits. We find that markups increased by about 30% on average over the sample period. We attribute this change to decreases in marginal costs and a decline in consumer price sensitivity.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了美国消费品加价从2006到2019的演变。使用超过 100 个不同类别的产品价格和数量的详细数据，我们获得了一组加价、边际成本和灵活的消费者偏好。我们的实证策略对每个类别和年份使用单独的随机系数 Logit 模型，并假设企业设定价格是为了最大化利润。我们发现，在样本期内，加价平均增加了约 30%。我们将这种变化归因于边际成本的下降和消费者价格敏感性的下降。

records.title_en: The Allocation of Incentives in Multilayered Organizations: Evidence from a Community Health Program in Sierra Leone
records.title_cn: 多层组织中的激励分配：来自塞拉利昂社区卫生计划的证据
records.abstract_en: Does the allocation of incentives across the hierarchy of an organization matter for its performance? In an experiment with a large public health organization, we find that health care provision is highly affected by how incentives are allocated between frontline workers and their supervisors. Sharing incentives equally between these two layers raises health visits by 61% compared with unilateral allocations and uniquely improves health service provision and health outcomes. We provide reduced-form and structural evidence that effort complementarities and contractual frictions drive these results and explore the implications for the optimal design of incentive policies in multilayered organizations.
records.abstract_cn: 组织层级中的激励分配对其绩效是否重要？在对一家大型公共卫生组织进行的实验中，我们发现医疗保健的提供很大程度上受到一线工人及其主管之间激励分配方式的影响。与单边分配相比，在这些二层之间平等分享激励措施可以使医疗就诊次数增加61%，并且独特地改善卫生服务的提供和健康结果。我们提供了简化形式和结构性的证据，证明努力互补性和合同摩擦推动了这些结果，并探讨了多层组织中激励政策优化设计的影响。

records.title_en: Bidding for Firms: Subsidy Competition in the United States
records.title_cn: 企业竞标：美国的补贴竞争
records.abstract_en: State and local governments in the United States compete to attract firms by offering discretionary subsidies. I use a private value English auction to model the subsidy bidding process and quantify the welfare effects of competition. The allocation of rents between states and firms depends on the heterogeneity in states’ valuations for firms and the substitutability of locations. I find that competition increases welfare by less than 5% over a subsidy ban, and states compete away the surplus, transferring all of the rents to firms. These findings dampen any interpretation of subsidy competition as an effective place-based policy.
records.abstract_cn: 美国的州和地方政府通过提供酌情补贴来竞争吸引企业。我使用私人价值英式拍卖来模拟补贴投标过程并量化竞争的福利影响。国家和企业之间的租金分配取决于国家对企业估值的异质性和地点的可替代性。我发现，与补贴禁令相比，竞争增加的福利不到5%，而各州则通过竞争消除盈余，将所有租金转移给企业。这些发现削弱了将补贴竞争视为有效的地方政策的任何解释。

records.title_en: Factor Models for Conditional Asset Pricing
records.title_cn: 有条件资产定价的因子模型
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a methodology, building on a local principal component analysis approach, for inference on the pricing ability of conditional asset pricing models designed to mitigate the effect of omitted risk factors and misspecified conditional dynamics. The methodology is designed to exploit the rich information available in large cross sections of individual stocks. Monte Carlo experiments and an empirical application demonstrate the benefits of this methodology over existing approaches.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一种基于局部主成分分析方法的方法，用于推断条件资产定价模型的定价能力，旨在减轻遗漏风险因素和错误指定的条件动态的影响。该方法旨在利用大截面个股中可用的丰富信息。蒙特卡洛实验和实证应用证明了该方法相对于现有方法的优势。

records.title_en: Soil Heterogeneity, Social Learning, and the Formation of Close-Knit Communities
records.title_cn: 土壤异质性、社会学习和紧密社区的形成
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how environmental heterogeneity influences the formation of close-knit communities. I provide support for the social learning hypothesis, which posits that diverse environmental conditions limited American farmers’ ability to learn from neighbors, weakening communal ties. I document a negative county-level association between soil heterogeneity and close-knit communities. Using individual-level data on nineteenth-century domestic migrants, I show that this association is not driven by selective in-migration and document farmers’ cultural adaptation using a difference-in-differences framework. Focusing on mechanisms, I show that soil heterogeneity slowed farmers’ agricultural learning and prompted those who depended on social networks to migrate elsewhere.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了环境异质性如何影响紧密社区的形成。我支持社会学习假说，该假说认为，多样化的环境条件限制了美国农民向邻居学习的能力，削弱了社区联系。我记录了县级土壤异质性和紧密社区之间的负相关关系。使用十九世纪国内移民的个人数据，我表明这种关联并不是由选择性的移民驱动的，并使用双重差异框架记录了农民的文化适应。我着眼于机制，表明土壤异质性减缓了农民的农业学习，并促使那些依赖社交网络的人迁移到其他地方。

records.title_en: The impact of neonatal care on moderate-risk infants: Evidence from healthcare use in the first two years of life
records.title_cn: 新生儿护理对中等风险婴儿的影响：生命最初两年医疗保健使用的证据
records.abstract_en: Advances in evidence-based neonatal care have led to large improvements in the survival rates of high-risk newborns. Yet studies have documented wide variation in the care of more prevalent moderate-risk infants, who comprise a much larger proportion of admissions to neonatal care. In this study, we build on a small literature which uses quasi-experimental design to understand the impact of neonatal care, and for the first time, examine this moderate-risk cohort of infants. We use individual-level data on the full population of births in the state of New South Wales, Australia to examine the impact of neonatal care on the healthcare use of moderate-risk infants in the first two years of life. We implement a regression discontinuity design exploiting admission protocols based on birthweight among neonatal units of three different and explicit levels of capability. Unlike previous studies, which examine differences in outcomes across the high-risk cut-off at 1500 g, our study examines differences for moderate-risk infants born near birthweight cut-offs closer to normal birth weight (2500 g). While admission to the neonatal unit jumps across the cut-off, we find modest impacts on downstream healthcare use, including both in-hospital and out-of-hospital care. However, we identify heterogeneous effects across varying capability levels. Moderate risk infants admitted to lower capability neonatal units received more cost-intensive care, resulting in reduced healthcare use following discharge from hospital, while the same was not observed for those admitted to the highest capability units. We suggest that this is due to more aggressive clinical management at lower capability units, and leave this as a priority for future research.
records.abstract_cn: 基于证据的新生儿护理的进步已大幅提高了高风险新生儿的存活率。然而，研究记录了更为普遍的中等风险婴儿护理中的广泛差异，这些婴儿在新生儿护理入院中占更大比例。在本研究中，我们基于少量使用准实验设计来理解新生儿护理影响的文献，并首次考察这一中等风险婴儿群体。我们使用澳大利亚新南威尔士州全人口出生个体层面数据，考察新生儿护理对中等风险婴儿生命最初两年医疗保健使用的影响。我们实施回归不连续设计，利用基于出生体重的新生儿病房入院协议，涉及三个不同且明确的能力水平。与以往研究考察高风险临界值1500克附近结果的差异不同，我们的研究考察接近正常出生体重临界值2500克的中等风险婴儿的差异。虽然新生儿病房入院在临界值处跳跃，我们发现对下游医疗保健使用的影响温和，包括院内和院外护理。然而，我们识别出不同能力水平下的异质性效应。入住较低能力新生儿病房的中等风险婴儿接受了更多成本密集型护理，导致出院后医疗保健使用减少，而入住最高能力病房的婴儿则未观察到同样情况。我们认为这是由于较低能力病房更积极的临床管理所致，并将其留作未来研究的优先事项。

records.title_en: Price transparency in healthcare: Bargaining incentives and patient responses
records.title_cn: 医疗保健中的价格透明度：谈判激励与患者反应
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the impact of price transparency on healthcare prices, using a natural experiment involving the gradual disclosure of medical procedure prices on a state-run website. The study finds that negotiated allowed amounts decreased by 5.1% for surgical procedures and 9.1% for radiology procedures, which have higher average allowed amounts and attracted more price requests on the website. In contrast, for lab procedures, the evidence is mixed and does not point to a clear effect. The observed reductions are primarily driven by provider–insurer negotiations rather than patient price shopping. Price reductions were consistent across all providers and insurers, regardless of whether their prices were listed on the transparency website, and extended to providers in neighboring states.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用一个自然实验，即在一个州立网站上逐步公开医疗程序价格，研究了价格透明度对医疗价格的影响。研究发现，手术程序的协商允许金额下降了5.1%，放射科程序下降了9.1%，这些程序的平均允许金额较高，并在网站上吸引了更多的价格查询。相比之下，对于实验室程序，证据混杂，并未指向明确的效果。观察到的降价主要由提供者与保险公司之间的谈判驱动，而非患者的比价购物。价格下降在所有提供者和保险公司中保持一致，无论其价格是否列在透明度网站上，并且延伸到了邻近州的提供者。

records.title_en: When women take over: Physician gender and health care provision
records.title_cn: 当女性接管：医生性别与医疗服务提供
records.abstract_en: The share of female physicians has risen in OECD countries in recent decades, but we know little about the effects of physician gender on patient health care use. We exploit quasi-random assignment of primary care providers (PCPs) to existing PCP practices and patients and estimate the causal effect of female PCPs on health care provision. Using Austrian register data and a difference-in-differences strategy, we find that female PCPs generate 15% less revenue and see 7% fewer patients than male PCPs. Shifting the focus to patient-level outcomes, we observe that health care utilization remains largely unchanged following assignment to a female physician. However, results show that patients are more likely to leave PCP practices with female successors. Our results do not support the idea that the decision to change PCP is driven by preferences against being treated by female physicians. Instead, our analysis suggests that the observed differences are partly explained by female PCPs working fewer hours, especially those facing working time restrictions. As the share of female physicians continues to rise, measures to increase work flexibility may be necessary to maintain broad access to outpatient health care.
records.abstract_cn: 近几十年来，OECD国家的女性医生比例有所上升，但我们对医生性别对患者医疗服务使用的影响知之甚少。我们利用初级保健提供者（PCP）对现有PCP诊所和患者的准随机分配，估计女性PCP对医疗服务提供的因果效应。使用奥地利注册数据并采用双重差分策略，我们发现女性PCP产生的收入比男性PCP低15%，接诊的患者少7%。将焦点转向患者层面的结果，我们观察到在分配给女性医生后，医疗服务利用基本保持不变。然而，结果显示患者更可能离开由女性继任者接管的PCP诊所。我们的结果不支持患者更换PCP的决定是由反对女性医生治疗的偏好所驱动的观点。相反，我们的分析表明，观察到的差异部分归因于女性PCP工作时间较少，尤其是那些面临工作时间限制的医生。随着女性医生比例的持续上升，可能需要采取措施提高工作灵活性，以维持门诊医疗服务的广泛可及性。

records.title_en: Legal status and voluntary abortions by immigrants
records.title_cn: 合法身份与移民妇女的自愿堕胎
records.abstract_en: We estimate the effect of granting legal status to immigrant women on voluntary abortions. We exploit the 2007 EU enlargement as an exogenous shock to legal status for Romanian and Bulgarian women, considering Italy as a destination country. Using a standard Difference-in-Differences model, we estimate a decline between 60% and 70% in voluntary pregnancy termination (VPT) rates for the new EU citizens from the two Eastern countries. We also introduce a novel framework to separate the total effect of the enlargement into a “citizenship” effect due to (legal or illegal) migrants already present in Italy and a “selection” effect due to new flows of immigrants. We show that the findings are robust to several alternative explanations. The drop in abortions points to legal status as a way to empower immigrant women.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了授予移民妇女合法身份对自愿堕胎的影响。我们利用2007年欧盟扩大作为罗马尼亚和保加利亚妇女合法身份的外生冲击，以意大利为目的地国家。使用标准的双重差分模型，我们估计这两个东欧国家的新欧盟公民的自愿终止妊娠率下降了60%至70%。我们还引入了一个新颖的框架，将扩大的总效应分解为“公民身份”效应（由于已在意大利的合法或非法移民）和“选择”效应（由于新的移民流入）。我们表明，这些发现对多种替代解释是稳健的。堕胎率的下降表明合法身份是增强移民妇女权能的一种方式。

records.title_en: Does knowing the costs of other physicians affect doctors’ referrals?
records.title_cn: 了解其他医生的费用是否会影响医生的转诊？
records.abstract_en: Patient referrals from primary care physicians (PCPs) to specialists are common in the American health care industry, but are typically made without any knowledge of relative specialist costs. In this study, I estimate the effect of providing such information to PCPs on referral patterns. Implementing a field experiment with an Independent Practice Association (IPA), I sent a list of average costs for new ophthalmology referrals to randomly chosen primary care medical practices. Using administrative referral data, I find that PCPs increased referral share to less costly ophthalmology practices during the first two months after treatment by 4.6 percentage points for each reduction in costliness rank (e.g., each rank closer to the least expensive). Effects were only found for patients for whom the PCPs had cost reduction incentives, and dissipated over the following four months. For the patients whose referrals were affected, I estimate that the expected cost to the IPA of a referral to ophthalmology fell during the first two months by about $80 (45% of pre-intervention referral cost).
records.abstract_cn: 在美国医疗行业中，初级保健医生（PCPs）向专科医生的患者转诊很常见，但通常在不知道专科医生相对费用的情况下进行。在本研究中，我估计了向初级保健医生提供此类信息对转诊模式的影响。通过与独立执业协会（IPA）实施一项实地实验，我向随机选择的初级保健医疗诊所发送了一份新眼科转诊的平均费用清单。利用行政转诊数据，我发现，在治疗后的前两个月内，初级保健医生增加了向费用较低的眼科诊所的转诊份额，每降低一个费用等级（例如，每接近最便宜的一个等级），转诊份额增加4.6个百分点。这种效应仅出现在初级保健医生有费用降低激励的患者中，并在接下来的四个月内逐渐消失。对于转诊受到影响的病人，我估计在头两个月内，IPA眼科转诊的预期费用下降了约$80（占干预前转诊费用的45%）。

records.title_en: Imprecise health beliefs and health behavior
records.title_cn: 不精确的健康信念与健康行为
records.abstract_en: This paper examines belief imprecision in the context of COVID-19, when uncertainty about health outcomes was widespread. We survey a sample of young adults a few months after the onset of the pandemic. We elicit individuals’ minimum and maximum subjective probabilities of different health outcomes, and define belief imprecision as the range between these values. We document substantial heterogeneity in the degree of imprecision across respondents, which remains largely unexplained by standard demographic characteristics. To assess the behavioral impact of imprecise beliefs, we ask beliefs about future outcomes under hypothetical scenarios that feature different levels of protective behaviors. We find that individuals who expect protective behaviors to reduce not only the subjective probability of a negative health outcome, but also the degree of imprecision associated with it, behave more protectively.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在COVID-19背景下考察了信念的不精确性，当时健康结果的不确定性普遍存在。我们在疫情爆发几个月后对一组年轻成年人进行了调查。我们引出了个体对不同健康结果的最小和最大主观概率，并将信念不精确性定义为这些值之间的范围。我们记录了受访者之间不精确程度的显著异质性，这种异质性在很大程度上无法由标准人口统计学特征解释。为了评估不精确信念的行为影响，我们询问了在具有不同保护行为水平的假设情景下对未来结果的信念。我们发现，那些预期保护行为不仅能降低负面健康结果的主观概率，还能降低与之相关的不精确程度的个体，其行为更具保护性。

records.title_en: Absence from work and lifetime smoking behavior: Evidence from European maternal leave policies
records.title_cn: 工作缺勤与终身吸烟行为：来自欧洲产假政策的证据
records.abstract_en: We provide new evidence on how child-related career interruptions affect long-term health behaviors by examining the impact of maternal leave duration on smoking habits across 14 European countries. Linking data on maternity and parental leave policies from 1960 to 2010 with survey data on mothers’ health behaviors, birth, and employment histories, we identify the effects of absence from work due to child birth on lifetime smoking in an instrumental variable framework based on within- and between-country variations in policies. We find that a one-month increase in leave duration raises the probability of a mother smoking later in life by 1.2 percentage points. Additionally, a one-month increase in child-related absence from work extends the lifetime duration of smoking by 7 months, the number of cigarettes smoked per day by 0.2 cigarettes, and the number of pack years by 0.6. We document potential non-linearities in these effects, suggesting that shorter leave durations may have a protective effect, while very long absence from work could promote harmful health behaviors. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that the observed effects are mediated by the partners’ lack of financial support around childbirth, while employment status and other socio-demographic characteristics do not play a significant role.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过考察产假时长对14个欧洲国家吸烟习惯的影响，提供了关于与子女相关的职业中断如何影响长期健康行为的新证据。将1960年至2010年的产假和育儿假政策数据与母亲健康行为、生育和就业历史的调查数据相结合，我们利用基于政策国内及跨国差异的工具变量框架，识别了因生育导致的工作缺勤对终身吸烟的影响。我们发现，产假时长每增加一个月，母亲晚年吸烟的概率提高1.2个百分点。此外，与子女相关的工作缺勤每增加一个月，终身吸烟持续时间延长7个月，每日吸烟数量增加0.2支，吸烟包年数增加0.6。我们记录了这些效应中潜在的非线性关系，表明较短的产假时长可能具有保护作用，而非常长的工作缺勤可能促进有害健康行为。异质性分析显示，观察到的效应由伴侣在生育期间缺乏经济支持所中介，而就业状况和其他社会人口特征并未发挥显著作用。

records.title_en: Regression and decomposition with ordinal health outcomes
records.title_cn: 有序健康结果的回归与分解
records.abstract_en: Although ordinal health outcome values are categories like “poor” health or “moderate” depression, they are often assigned values 1,2,3,… for convenience. We provide results on interpretation of subsequent analysis based on ordinary least squares (OLS) regression. For description, unlike for prediction, the OLS estimand’s interpretation does not require that the 1,2,3,… are cardinal values: it is always the “best linear approximation” of a summary of the conditional survival functions. Further, for Blinder–Oaxaca-type decomposition, the OLS-based estimator is numerically equivalent to a certain counterfactual-based decomposition of the survival function, again regardless of any cardinal values. Empirically, with 2022 U.S. data for working-age adults, we estimate a higher incidence of depression in the rural population, and we decompose the rural–urban difference. Including a nonparametric estimator that we describe, estimators agree that 33%–39% of the rural–urban difference is statistically explained by income, education, age, sex, and geographic region. The OLS-based detailed decomposition shows this is mostly from income.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管有序健康结果值如“差”健康或“中度”抑郁等类别，但为了方便，它们常被赋值为1、2、3等。我们提供了基于普通最小二乘（OLS）回归的后续分析解释结果。对于描述而言，与预测不同，OLS估计量的解释并不要求1、2、3等是基数数值：它始终是条件生存函数汇总的“最佳线性近似”。此外，对于Blinder–Oaxaca型分解，基于OLS的估计量在数值上等同于某种基于反事实的生存函数分解，同样与任何基数数值无关。实证上，使用2022年美国工作年龄成人数据，我们估计农村人口中抑郁发生率更高，并分解了农村与城市之间的差异。包括我们描述的非参数估计器在内，估计器一致认为，农村与城市差异的33%–39%在统计上可由收入、教育、年龄、性别和地理区域解释。基于OLS的详细分解显示，这主要来自收入。

records.title_en: The effect of e-cigarette flavor bans on tobacco use
records.title_cn: 电子烟口味禁令对烟草使用的影响
records.abstract_en: Advocates for sales restrictions on flavored e-cigarettes argue that flavors appeal to young people and lead them down a path to nicotine addiction. Using data from a variety of surveys (Youth Risk Behavior Surveys, Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance Survey, and Population Assessment of Tobacco and Health), this study is among the first to examine the effect of state and local restrictions on the sale of flavored electronic nicotine delivery system (ENDS) products on youth and young adult tobacco use. We find robust evidence that the adoption of an ENDS flavor restriction reduces short-run frequent and everyday ENDS use among youths by approximately two-to-three percentage-points. Some evidence suggests that this effect weakens after two years. We also document reductions in ENDS use among young adults aged 18-30 that appear to strengthen after two years. Finally, evidence suggests substitution from flavored ENDS to unflavored ENDS and cigarettes among certain age groups.
records.abstract_cn: 支持对调味电子烟实施销售限制的倡导者认为，口味吸引年轻人，并引导他们走向尼古丁成瘾的道路。利用多项调查数据（青少年风险行为调查、行为风险因素监测调查以及烟草与健康人口评估），本研究是首批考察州和地方对调味电子尼古丁输送系统（ENDS）产品销售限制对青少年和年轻人烟草使用影响的研究之一。我们发现强有力的证据表明，实施ENDS口味限制会使青少年短期内的频繁和日常ENDS使用率降低约二至三个百分点。一些证据表明，这一效果在两年后减弱。我们还记录了18至30岁年轻人中ENDS使用的减少，这种减少在两年后似乎有所加强。最后，证据表明某些年龄组从调味ENDS转向无味ENDS和卷烟。

records.title_en: High speed internet and the widening gender gap in adolescent mental health: Evidence from Spanish hospital records
records.title_cn: 高速互联网与青少年心理健康性别差距的扩大：来自西班牙医院记录的证据
records.abstract_en: We exploit variations in fiber optic (FTTH) deployment to assess the impact of high-speed internet access on adolescent mental health. Our findings reveal that FTTH access increases addictive Internet usage and reduces time allocated to sleep, homework, as well as social interactions with family and friends. Access to FTTH increases mental health diagnoses in hospitals and contributes to a notable rise in adolescent suicide rates, particularly among girls. As new platforms and apps gain traction among adolescents, understanding the impact of connectivity improvement becomes important. This is especially relevant given the current FTTH growth replacing older broadband technologies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用光纤到户（FTTH）部署的差异来评估高速互联网接入对青少年心理健康的影响。我们的研究结果显示，FTTH接入增加了成瘾性互联网使用，并减少了用于睡眠、家庭作业以及与家人和朋友社交互动的时间。FTTH接入增加了医院中的心理健康诊断，并导致青少年自杀率显著上升，尤其是在女孩中。随着新平台和应用在青少年中日益流行，理解连接改善的影响变得重要。鉴于当前FTTH增长正在取代较旧的宽带技术，这一点尤其相关。

records.title_en: Mental health and mortality trends in the United States
records.title_cn: 美国心理健康与死亡率趋势
records.abstract_en: This study investigates whether worsening mental health has played a significant role in the rising mortality rates experienced by some population groups in the early 21st century, a question that has gained prominence with increased attention to so-called “deaths of despair.” The main takeaway is that although declining psychological health has likely contributed to adverse mortality trends—especially among prime-age non-Hispanic Whites—its overall impact is limited and not well captured by standard definitions of “deaths of despair.” Five key findings support this conclusion. First, mental health deteriorated between 1993 and 2019 for all population groups examined. Second, these declines are associated with higher predicted death rates and help explain worsening mortality trends for prime-age non-Hispanic Whites and, to a lesser extent, non-Hispanic Blacks between 1999 and 2019. Third, while these correlations lend some support to the broader idea of “deaths of despair,” the specific causes comprising them appear to be both more expansive and different from those previously emphasized. Fourth, heterogeneity in how worsening mental distress affects mortality—rather than in mental health trends themselves—is more important in explaining Black-White disparities in its overall impact. Finally, in the primary specifications, deteriorating mental health accounts for an estimated 9 % to 29 % of the rise in mortality rates among prime-age Whites in recent years.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了心理健康状况恶化是否在21世纪初某些人群死亡率上升中发挥了重要作用，这一问题因对所谓“绝望之死”的关注增加而日益突出。主要结论是，尽管心理健康的下降可能对不利的死亡率趋势有所贡献——尤其是在壮年非西班牙裔白人中——但其总体影响有限，且未被“绝望之死”的标准定义充分捕捉。五个关键发现支持这一结论。第一，从1993年到2019年，所有被考察人群的心理健康均出现恶化。第二，这些下降与更高的预测死亡率相关，并有助于解释1999年至2019年间壮年非西班牙裔白人以及较小程度上非西班牙裔黑人的死亡率恶化趋势。第三，虽然这些相关性在一定程度上支持了“绝望之死”的更广泛概念，但构成该概念的具体死因似乎比先前强调的更为广泛且有所不同。第四，心理困扰恶化对死亡率影响的异质性——而非心理健康趋势本身的异质性——在解释黑人与白人在总体影响上的差异方面更为重要。最后，在主要规格中，心理健康恶化估计占近年来壮年白人死亡率上升的9%至29%。

records.title_en: Living alone and provider behaviour in public and private hospitals
records.title_cn: 独居和公立和私立医院的医疗服务提供者行为
records.abstract_en: Following COVID-19, hospitals in many OECD countries are under pressure to absorb backlogs accumulated due to the suspension of health services. Reductions in length of stay can generate capacity to treat patients and increase efficiency. Personal circumstances, such as living alone, can affect how long patients stay in hospital. We test whether such non-clinical factors affect care received by patients. Several countries are experiencing an increase in the number of elderly people who live alone. Patients who live alone may lack support at home leading to delayed discharges despite being clinically fit. We test whether living alone affects length of stay of publicly-funded patients treated by public and private hospitals requiring hip replacement, a common planned surgery, in England. Private providers have stronger incentives to contain costs, which could reduce the extent to which non-clinical factors such as living alone are taken into account when providers discharge patients. Using administrative data and controlling for a rich set of patient characteristics, and hospital and local supply factors, we provide evidence that living alone increases length of stay. The effect is substantive and larger for public hospitals and older patients. It is similar for patients living in urban and rural areas, and across socioeconomic status. More broadly, the study shows that non-clinical factors can affect the care received by patients.
records.abstract_cn: 在新冠肺炎疫情19之后，许多经合组织国家的医院面临着吸收因卫生服务暂停而积累的积压案件的压力。住院时间的缩短可以产生治疗患者的能力并提高效率。个人情况（例如独居）可能会影响患者住院的时间。我们测试这些非临床因素是否会影响患者接受的护理。一些国家的独居老年人数量正在增加。尽管临床状况良好，独居患者可能缺乏家中支持，导致出院延迟。我们测试了独居是否会影响英国公立和私立医院接受髋关节置换术（一种常见计划手术）的公共资助患者的住院时间。私人医疗服务提供者有更强的动机来控制成本，这可能会减少医疗服务提供者在让患者出院时考虑独居等非临床因素的程度。使用管理数据并控制丰富的患者特征以及医院和当地供应因素，我们提供了独居会增加住院时间的证据。对于公立医院和老年患者来说，效果是实质性的、更大的。对于生活在城市和农村地区以及不同社会经济地位的患者来说，情况都是相似的。更广泛地说，研究表明非临床因素会影响患者接受的护理。

records.title_en: Responsibility-sensitive welfare weights for health
records.title_cn: 健康的责任敏感福利权重
records.abstract_en: We estimate welfare weights for health to facilitate program evaluation allowing for aversion to health inequality and to health inequity by three non-health characteristics. In a UK general population sample, 569 online experiment participants distribute constrained resources to determine the health of hypothetical individuals distinguished by randomly generated resource productivity as well as sex, income and smoking (41,460 observations). We elicit beliefs about responsibility for income and smoking, and use their associations with the allocations to estimate responsibility-sensitive weights for health by those two characteristics. We find weak prioritisation of females’ health, moderate prioritisation of the health of poorer individuals and strong prioritisation of the health of non-smokers over that of smokers. Substantial aversion to health inequality lowers weights on females and non-smokers, who are health-advantaged, and raises the weight on the poor, who are health-disadvantaged. As beliefs about responsibility for income and smoking strengthen, weights on the poor decrease and weights on non-smokers significantly increase.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计健康的福利权重，以促进项目评估，允许对健康不平等和由三个非健康特征导致的健康不公平的厌恶。在英国一般人群样本中，569名在线实验参与者分配受限资源，以确定由随机生成的资源生产力以及性别、收入和吸烟状况区分的假设个体的健康（41,460个观测值）。我们引出了关于收入和吸烟责任的信念，并利用这些信念与分配的关联来估计按这两个特征划分的健康责任敏感权重。我们发现对女性健康的优先关注较弱，对较贫困个体健康的优先关注中等，对非吸烟者健康相对于吸烟者的优先关注强烈。对健康不平等的显著厌恶降低了女性和非吸烟者（健康优势群体）的权重，并提高了贫困者（健康劣势群体）的权重。随着对收入和吸烟责任信念的增强，贫困者的权重下降，而非吸烟者的权重显著增加。

records.title_en: Technology regulation reconsidered: The effects of certificate of need policies on the quantity and quality of diagnostic imaging
records.title_cn: 技术监管再思考：需求证明政策对诊断影像数量与质量的影响
records.abstract_en: Estimates of the impact of Certificate of Need (CON) laws on medical care have been inconsistent, possibly because not all CON laws apply to all services. Using an original dataset identifying imaging-related CON laws and a regression discontinuity design at state borders, we estimate the effects of CON on the use and quality of diagnostic imaging. Medicare beneficiaries in regulated states are less likely to receive any image and even less likely to receive low-value imaging than beneficiaries in unregulated states. High-value imaging is unaffected. Overall, CON for imaging reduces low-value care and leaves high-value care unchanged.
records.abstract_cn: 关于需求证明（CON）法律对医疗服务影响的估计结果一直不一致，这可能是因为并非所有CON法律都适用于所有服务。利用一个识别影像相关CON法律的原始数据集，并在州边界采用断点回归设计，我们估计了CON对诊断影像使用和质量的影响。受监管州的医疗保险受益者接受任何影像检查的可能性较低，且接受低价值影像检查的可能性甚至更低，相比之下，未受监管州的受益者则不然。高价值影像检查未受影响。总体而言，针对影像的CON减少了低价值医疗服务，同时使高价值医疗服务保持不变。

records.title_en: A change of plans: Switching costs in the procurement of health insurance
records.title_cn: 计划变更：健康保险采购中的转换成本
records.abstract_en: The provision of public health insurance through regulated markets requires a dynamic procurement of insurers over time. Using data from Medicaid managed care bids, I study the impacts of regulators’ decision to drop an insurer from the market on health care use among affected enrollees, who must switch to another health plan. Using a difference-in-differences framework, I find that after a plan is replaced, enrollees from the exiting plan have fewer visits to primary care physicians, lower utilization of prescription drugs, including those for chronic conditions, and more hospital admissions. These disruptions disproportionately affect sicker enrollees, particularly children and non-white beneficiaries. In the year following the exit, insurers’ spending on enrollees from exiting plans is 7% lower than the pre-exit baseline. Changes in provider networks and drug formularies may serve as mechanisms.
records.abstract_cn: 通过受监管市场提供公共健康保险需要随时间对保险公司进行动态采购。利用医疗补助管理护理投标数据，我研究了监管机构决定将一家保险公司从市场中剔除对受影响参保者医疗保健使用的影响，这些参保者必须转向另一个健康计划。采用双重差分框架，我发现当一个计划被替换后，来自退出计划的参保者看初级保健医生的次数减少，处方药（包括慢性病用药）的使用率降低，住院次数增加。这些干扰对病情较重的参保者影响尤为显著，特别是儿童和非白人受益者。在退出后的那一年，保险公司对来自退出计划参保者的支出比退出前基线低7%。提供者网络和药物处方的变化可能是其作用机制。

records.title_en: The Effect of E-Cigarette Taxes on Substance Use
records.title_cn: 电子烟税对物质使用的影响
records.abstract_en: Public health advocates warn that the rapid growth of legal markets for electronic nicotine delivery systems (ENDS) may generate a “gateway” to marijuana and harder drug consumption, particularly among teenagers. This study explores the effects of ENDS taxes on substance use. Analyses are based on difference-in-differences and event-study methods applied to both survey (Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System and Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System) and administrative (Treatment Episode Data Set) data. Our results imply that a one-dollar increase in ENDS taxes (2023$) is associated with a 1.0 to 1.5 percentage point decline in teen marijuana use and in co-use of ENDS and marijuana. This result is consistent with e-cigarettes and marijuana being economic complements. We also find that youth responses to ENDS taxes, in terms of their ENDS use and spillovers into marijuana use, appear to moderate over the longer term. We find no evidence that ENDS taxes affect drug treatment admissions or consumption of illicit drugs other than marijuana such as cocaine, methamphetamine, or opioids.
records.abstract_cn: 公共卫生倡导者警告说，电子尼古丁输送系统（ENDS）合法市场的快速增长可能为青少年吸食大麻和更烈性毒品打开“门户”。本研究探讨了ENDS税对物质使用的影响。分析基于双重差分和事件研究方法，应用于调查数据（青少年风险行为监测系统和行为风险因素监测系统）和行政数据（治疗事件数据集）。我们的结果表明，ENDS税每增加一美元（按2023年美元计算），青少年大麻使用以及ENDS与大麻同时使用的比例下降1.0至1.5个百分点。这一结果与电子烟和大麻在经济上具有互补性相一致。我们还发现，青少年对ENDS税的反应，就其ENDS使用及对大麻使用的溢出效应而言，在长期内似乎趋于缓和。我们没有发现ENDS税影响药物滥用治疗入院或除大麻以外的非法药物（如可卡因、甲基苯丙胺或阿片类药物）消费的证据。

records.title_en: The impact of the Female Secondary School Stipend Program on child health
records.title_cn: 女性中学助学金计划对儿童健康的影响
records.abstract_en: In this study, we examine the inter-generational effects of the 1994 Female Secondary School Stipend Program (FSSSP) on child health inputs and child health outcomes in Bangladesh. Prior studies have shown that the FSSSP significantly increased secondary schooling among rural girls. Applying a difference-in-differences model based on differential exposure to FSSSP by birth cohort and rural residence, we find that full immunization rates increased by 4.2 percentage points among children of mothers eligible for a stipend for 5 years relative to children of mothers who were not eligible, but there were no significant effects for children of mothers eligible for a stipend for only 2 years. We also find improvements in other health inputs (e.g., antenatal care) and in child health outcomes (e.g., mortality). We also explore changes in marriage, fertility, autonomy, labor supply, and media exposure, which may contribute to the observed improvements in child health.
records.abstract_cn: 在本研究中，我们考察了1994年女性中学助学金计划（FSSSP）对孟加拉国儿童健康投入和儿童健康结果的代际影响。先前的研究表明，FSSSP显著提高了农村女孩的中学教育水平。应用基于出生队列和农村居住地对FSSSP不同暴露程度的双重差分模型，我们发现，相对于母亲不符合助学金条件的儿童，符合5年助学金条件的母亲的儿童完全免疫率提高了4.2个百分点，但仅符合2年助学金条件的母亲的儿童没有显著影响。我们还发现其他健康投入（如产前保健）和儿童健康结果（如死亡率）有所改善。我们还探讨了婚姻、生育、自主权、劳动供给和媒体接触的变化，这些可能有助于观察到的儿童健康改善。

records.title_en: Back to school: The effect of school visits during COVID-19 on COVID-19 outcomes
records.title_cn: 重返校园：COVID-19期间学校访问对COVID-19结果的影响
records.abstract_en: The effects of school closures on COVID-19 transmission remain unclear, even after the conclusion of the national Public Health Emergency. We use healthcare claims data from 130 million household-week observations linked to smartphone mobility data to measure the effects of changes in county-level visits to schools on COVID-19 outcomes. We use a triple-differences approach that leverages within-county differences in exposure between families with and without school-age children and find modest impacts. We find increases in COVID-19 infection rates, with larger differences in low-income and higher COVID-19 prevalence counties.
records.abstract_cn: 学校关闭对COVID-19传播的影响仍不明确，即使在国家公共卫生紧急状态结束后也是如此。我们使用与智能手机移动数据相关联的130亿户周观察的医疗保健索赔数据，来衡量县级学校访问变化对COVID-19结果的影响。我们采用三重差分方法，利用县内有无学龄儿童家庭之间暴露差异，发现影响温和。我们发现COVID-19感染率上升，在低收入和COVID-19高流行县中差异更大。

records.title_en: Do for-profit hospitals cream-skim patients? Evidence from inpatient psychiatric care in California
records.title_cn: 营利性医院是否挑选患者？来自加利福尼亚州住院精神科护理的证据
records.abstract_en: The paper examines whether, among inpatient psychiatric admissions in California, for-profit (FP) hospitals engage in cream skimming, i.e., selecting patients for some characteristic(s) other than their need for care, which enhances the profitability of the provider. We propose a novel approach to identifying cream skimming using cost outcomes. Naïve treatment effect estimates of hospital ownership type consist of the combined effects of differential patient case mix (selection) and hospital cost containment strategies (execution). In contrast, an instrumental variable (IV) approach can control for case mix and establish the causal effects of ownership type due to its execution. We interpret the difference between the naïve and IV treatment effects to be driven by FP hospitals’ selection based on unobserved patient case mix.
