Furthermore, an innovative combination of machine learning techniques for contribution decomposition and time-varying effect analysis is introduced to identify time-varying channel effects, providing a reference for channel analysis in other studies.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究从全球系统性金融风险溢出网络的角度计算中国的净风险，并构建中国的TVP-VAR-SV模型，考察地缘政治暴露对总体系统性金融风险传染的时变效应，以及探究不同金融子市场间的异质性影响。此外，引入机器学习技术用于贡献分解与时变效应分析的创新组合，以识别时变渠道效应，为其他研究中的渠道分析提供参考。

records.title_en: “A tale of two rails”: Transportation infrastructure and technological spillovers from R&D center foreign firms
records.title_cn: “双轨记”：交通基础设施与研发中心外资企业的技术溢出
records.abstract_en: Identifying the pure technology spillover effect of foreign investment is an academic problem. The academic community also knows little about the role of transportation infrastructure in it. For the first time, this article uses the special event of R&D center foreign firms entering to explore how two completely different transportation infrastructures, high-speed rail, and subway, promote technology spillover from foreign investment within the same empirical framework. Based on city-industry-year panel data in China from 2004 to 2020, this article empirically proves that both high-speed rail and subway can promote R&D center foreign firms' technology spillover. Further analysis found that transportation infrastructure and R&D center foreign firms can jointly promote the development of China's key industries, that is, the core effect is stronger for high-tech and strategic emerging industries. This article also provides evidence about cross-city technology spillover from R&D center foreign firms. First, this article takes advantage of the special nature of R&D center foreign firms to provide new ideas for subsequent related research. Second, it empirically confirms that transportation infrastructure can promote foreign investment technology spillovers.
records.abstract_cn: 识别外资投资的纯技术溢出效应是一个学术问题。学术界对其中的交通基础设施作用也知之甚少。本文首次利用研发中心外资企业进入的特殊事件，探讨高铁和地铁这两种完全不同的交通基础设施如何在同一个实证框架内促进外资投资的技术溢出。基于中国2004年至2020年的城市-行业-年份面板数据，本文实证证明高铁和地铁都能促进研发中心外资企业的技术溢出。进一步分析发现，交通基础设施和研发中心外资企业可以共同促进中国关键产业的发展，即对高科技和战略性新兴产业的核心效应更强。本文还提供了关于研发中心外资企业跨城市技术溢出的证据。首先，本文利用研发中心外资企业的特殊性，为后续相关研究提供了新思路。其次，实证确认了交通基础设施可以促进外资投资的技术溢出。

records.title_en: Urbanization or “Townization”? Measuring the evolution of urban systems in modern China
records.title_cn: 城市化还是“镇化”？衡量中国现代城市体系的演变
records.abstract_en: The rapid urbanization in China reveals distinct regional patterns: some areas demonstrate a pattern of concentrated growth of cities (“metropolization”), while others experience the rapid proliferation of dispersed small towns (“townization”). We present a novel approach for quantifying the size of urban settlements in China using remote sensing big data. Additionally, we propose a criterion based on Zipf's law to determine the population threshold for classifying a settlement as a “metropolized settlement.” This criterion enables us to distinguish between metropolization and townization. Analysis of China's urbanization rate decomposition indicates a swift expansion of townization, whereas metropolization progresses at a more moderate pace between 2001 and 2020. Townization has predominantly driven urbanization in most regions of the North China Plain and Northeastern provinces, overshadowing metropolization. Furthermore, we examine the connection between these urbanization patterns and economic development. Empirical findings highlight a stronger association between metropolization and economic growth compared to townization.
records.abstract_cn: 中国的快速城市化揭示了显著的区域差异：一些地区呈现出城市集中增长的模式（“大城市化”），而其他地区则经历分散小城镇的迅速扩散（“镇化”）。我们提出了一种利用遥感大数据量化中国城市聚落规模的新方法。此外，我们基于齐普夫定律提出一个标准，用于确定将聚落分类为“大城市化聚落”的人口阈值。这一标准使我们能够区分大城市化与镇化。对中国城市化率分解的分析表明，镇化在2001至2020年间迅速扩张，而大城市化则以较为温和的速度推进。镇化主要推动了华北平原和东北省份大部分地区的城市化，掩盖了大城市化的影响。此外，我们考察了这些城市化模式与经济发展之间的联系。实证发现强调，与镇化相比，大城市化与经济增长之间的关联更强。

records.title_en: Broadband internet and income inequality among the floating population: Evidence from the “broadband China” strategy in China
records.title_cn: 宽带互联网与流动人口收入不平等：来自中国“宽带中国”战略的证据
records.abstract_en: Using the “Broadband China” strategy as a quasi-natural experiment, we employ the difference-in-differences model to examine the impact of broadband internet on the income inequality among the floating population based on the panel data of 35 major cities in China from 2011 to 2018. We find that broadband internet significantly widens the income inequality among the floating population. This conclusion still holds after robust tests including parallel trends, placebo, endogeneity, and treatment effects heterogeneity. The mechanism analysis indicates that broadband internet widens income gap between the high-skilled and low-skilled floating population, as well as between the urban and non-urban registered household floating population, but does not substitute for labor. Further analysis shows that broadband internet leads to skill-biased technological progress rather than routine-biased technological progress, has a greater effect on widening the income inequality among the inter-province, established and young floating population, and represents a Pareto improvement for the floating population's welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 利用“宽带中国”战略作为准自然实验，我们采用双重差分模型，基于2011年至2018年中国35个主要城市的面板数据，考察宽带互联网对流动人口收入不平等的影响。我们发现，宽带互联网显著扩大了流动人口的收入不平等。这一结论在经过平行趋势、安慰剂、内生性和处理效应异质性等稳健性检验后仍然成立。机制分析表明，宽带互联网扩大了高技能与低技能流动人口之间以及城镇户籍与非城镇户籍流动人口之间的收入差距，但并未替代劳动力。进一步分析显示，宽带互联网导致技能偏向型技术进步而非常规偏向型技术进步，对跨省、已定居和年轻流动人口的收入不平等扩大效应更大，并且对流动人口的福利而言代表了一种帕累托改进。

records.title_en: China's aid-giving modalities: Impacts on sustainable growth in China-Africa trade
records.title_cn: 中国的援助方式：对中非贸易可持续增长的影响
records.abstract_en: The paper focuses on exploring the impact of China's production-oriented aid projects on bilateral trade between China and Africa. By matching data from AidData, Eora Global MRIO, World Development Indicators (WDI), and CEPII Remote Database, regression results indicate that China's aid model significantly promotes sustainable growth in China-Africa bilateral trade. In the mechanism analysis, it is revealed that aid enhances African countries' autonomous trade capabilities across national, industrial, and product dimensions, thereby fostering the growth of bilateral trade between China and Africa, highlighting China's aid to Africa as development-oriented. Heterogeneity test results demonstrate that the positive effects of aid are more pronounced in African countries with high political stability, convergent values, and strong cooperative consensus. Unlike previous studies that overlook production-oriented aid projects, this paper delves into this dimension, offering novel insights into the effectiveness of non-standardized aid forms.
records.abstract_cn: 本文聚焦于探讨中国生产导向型援助项目对中非双边贸易的影响。通过匹配AidData、Eora全球MRIO、世界发展指标（WDI）和CEPII远程数据库的数据，回归结果表明，中国的援助模式显著促进了中非双边贸易的可持续增长。在机制分析中，揭示援助在国家、产业和产品维度上增强了非洲国家的自主贸易能力，从而促进了中非双边贸易的增长，凸显了中国对非洲援助的发展导向性。异质性检验结果表明，援助的积极效应在政治稳定、价值观趋同和合作共识强的非洲国家中更为显著。与以往忽视生产导向型援助项目的研究不同，本文深入探讨了这一维度，为非标准化援助形式的有效性提供了新颖见解。

records.title_en: Labor cost, robots, and product quality
records.title_cn: 劳动力成本、机器人与产品质量
records.abstract_en: Labor cost has rapidly increased in the past decades. However, little is known about its effect on the firm-level robot adoption, and evidence about the consequences of robot adoption on firm production is limited. Based on a novel dataset of robot adoption at the firm-level, we use geographic discontinuity design to identify that labor costs significantly increase robot adoption and further improve product quality. Our findings are robust to alternative specifications and particularly pronounced for foreign firms, and firms with low financial constraints, and general trade, and firms more dependence on unskilled labor, and firms in higher position in the value chain. When adopting robots to substitute labor, firms tend to employ (layoff) skilled (unskilled) labors, which increases expenses on employee training.
records.abstract_cn: 过去几十年中，劳动力成本迅速上升。然而，关于其对企业层面机器人采纳的影响知之甚少，且机器人采纳对企业生产后果的证据有限。基于企业层面机器人采纳的新数据集，我们利用地理断点设计识别出劳动力成本显著增加机器人采纳，并进一步提高了产品质量。我们的发现在多种规格下稳健，尤其对于外资企业、财务约束较低的企业、一般贸易企业、对非熟练劳动力依赖度较高的企业以及价值链中位置较高的企业更为显著。当采用机器人替代劳动力时，企业倾向于雇佣（解雇）熟练（非熟练）劳动力，这增加了员工培训支出。

records.title_en: Digital pathways to resilience: Assessing the impact of digitalization on agricultural production resilience in China
records.title_cn: 数字化通往韧性的路径：评估数字化对中国农业生产韧性的影响
records.abstract_en: Agricultural production, a cornerstone of human activity, is facing mounting challenges from instability and uncertainty. This study examines the impact of digitalization on the resilience of agricultural production in China, developing an innovative probabilistic framework able to assess agricultural resilience at the county level. The proposed model measures resilience as the likelihood of agricultural systems maintaining output above a defined baseline under uncertain conditions. Based on panel data of 1766 counties in China, this study reveals an inverted U-shaped relationship between digitalization and resilience. Specifically, whereas moderate digitalization enhances resilience, excessive digitalization introduces vulnerabilities. Mechanism analysis shows that digitalization drives rural income growth and optimizes factor utilization, but excessive digitalization widens income disparities and triggers resource outflows from agriculture. Results also show that new agricultural operating entities can mitigate the adverse effects of excessive digitalization by fostering collective action. These findings deepen our understanding of the complex mechanisms underlying agricultural digital transformation and offer practical insights for promoting resilience through balanced digitalization.
records.abstract_cn: 农业生产作为人类活动的基石，正面临来自不稳定性和不确定性的日益严峻挑战。本研究探讨了数字化对中国农业生产韧性的影响，开发了一种创新的概率框架，能够在县级层面评估农业韧性。所提出的模型将韧性定义为在不确定条件下农业系统维持产出高于设定基线的可能性。基于中国1766个县的面板数据，本研究揭示了数字化与韧性之间的倒U型关系。具体而言，适度的数字化增强了韧性，而过度的数字化则引入了脆弱性。机制分析表明，数字化推动农村收入增长并优化要素利用，但过度的数字化扩大了收入差距并引发农业资源外流。结果还显示，新型农业经营主体可以通过促进集体行动来缓解过度数字化的不利影响。这些发现加深了我们对农业数字化转型复杂机制的理解，并为通过平衡数字化促进韧性提供了实践见解。

records.title_en: Talent magnets in China: Can talent attraction policies catalyze digital transformation in enterprises?
records.title_cn: 中国的人才磁石：人才吸引政策能否催化企业数字化转型？
records.abstract_en: This study examines the impact of local talent attraction policies on enterprise digital transformation using a quasi-experimental design and data from A-share listed companies in China (2012–2019). Employing a difference-in-differences approach, we find that these policies significantly enhance digital transformation by improving human capital and expanding external digital resources. The effects are more pronounced in enterprises with large external executive compensation gaps, newly-appointed executive teams, younger leaders, better reputations, weaker financing constraints, and those in technology-intensive operations. Moreover, our analysis reveals that greater policy intensity, including more substantial housing or monetary subsidies, significantly promotes digital transformation. The findings highlight the importance of governmental talent management in fostering digital innovation and provide evidence for policies aimed at attracting skilled talent to boost industrial competitiveness.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究利用准实验设计及中国A股上市公司数据（2012-2019年），考察了地方人才吸引政策对企业数字化转型的影响。采用双重差分方法，我们发现这些政策通过改善人力资本和扩大外部数字资源显著促进了数字化转型。这一效应在外部高管薪酬差距大、新任命高管团队、领导者较年轻、声誉较好、融资约束较弱以及技术密集型运营的企业中更为显著。此外，我们的分析揭示，更强的政策力度，包括更实质性的住房或货币补贴，显著推动了数字化转型。研究结果强调了政府人才管理在促进数字创新中的重要性，并为旨在吸引技能人才以提升产业竞争力的政策提供了证据。

records.title_en: Geopolitics along the value chains
records.title_cn: 价值链中的地缘政治
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the intricate interplay between geopolitics and global value chains (GVCs) in shaping international trade dynamics. By developing indices of voting similarity from United Nations General Assembly data, we quantify the influence of geopolitical relationships on trade flows and economic welfare. Utilizing a structural approach grounded in the World Input–Output Database, we estimate the elasticity of geopolitics across various sectors, distinguishing between intermediate goods and final consumption. Our findings reveal significant trade and welfare implications of geopolitical relationships, highlighting how political alignment or discord influences economic outcomes across countries. Through counterfactual analyses, we explore scenarios such as the Israeli–Palestinian Conflict, the Russo–Ukrainian War, and the China–United States Trade Disputes, providing insights into how geopolitical shifts could reshape GVCs and economic performance globally. The results underscore the importance of considering geopolitical factors in trade policy and economic strategy formulation.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了地缘政治与全球价值链（GVCs）在塑造国际贸易动态中的复杂相互作用。通过从联合国大会数据中制定投票相似性指数，我们量化了地缘政治关系对贸易流动和经济福利的影响。利用基于世界投入产出数据库的结构性方法，我们估计了地缘政治在各行业间的弹性，区分了中间品和最终消费。我们的研究结果揭示了地缘政治关系对贸易和福利的重要影响，强调了政治结盟或不和如何影响各国经济结果。通过反事实分析，我们探讨了如以色列-巴勒斯坦冲突、俄乌战争以及中美贸易争端等情景，提供了地缘政治转变如何重塑全球价值链和全球经济表现的见解。结果强调了在贸易政策和经济战略制定中考虑地缘政治因素的重要性。

records.title_en: The productivity and political radicalism of the Chinese cooperative movement
records.title_cn: 中国合作化运动的生产率与政治激进主义
records.abstract_en: The productivity and political incentive of the Chinese cooperative movement are still in controversy. Theoretically, the cooperative brings both scale effect and monitoring cost, and the free exit rights reduce the monitoring cost and raise the net revenue, but the radicalism lowers the effort input and the net benefit for insufficient labor incentives. Meanwhile, the provincial leaders with lower Party ranks will behave more radically in cooperative movement for promotion incentives. Using the provincial participation rate of all kinds of cooperatives from 1950 to 1956, we find that the temporary mutual aid groups perform the same as household farming; the regular mutual aid groups, elementary cooperatives, and advanced cooperatives experience increasing output loss. The Party secretaries of alternate members and non-members behave more radically in cooperative movement and thus are more likely to be promoted than the Party secretaries of full members. We confirm that the cooperatives had already triggered a productivity decline before Great Lead Forward that was controversial between Lin(1990) and Kung (1993), and we also clarify the disputes on the political radicalism in authoritarian China between Kung and Chen(2011) and Yang et al.(2014).
records.abstract_cn: 中国合作化运动的生产率与政治激励仍存在争议。理论上，合作社既带来规模效应也带来监督成本，自由退出权降低了监督成本并提高了净收益，但激进主义因劳动激励不足而降低了努力投入和净收益。同时，党内职务较低的省级领导在合作化运动中会因晋升激励而表现得更激进。利用1950年至1956年各类合作社的省级参与率，我们发现临时互助组的表现与家庭耕作相同；常年互助组、初级合作社和高级合作社则经历了递增的产出损失。候补委员和非委员身份的省委书记在合作化运动中表现得更激进，因此比正式委员身份的省委书记更可能获得晋升。我们证实，在大跃进之前合作社已引发生产率下降，这一现象在林毅夫（1990）和龚启圣（1993）之间存在争议，同时我们也澄清了龚启圣与陈（2011）以及杨等（2014）之间关于威权中国政治激进主义的争论。

records.title_en: Housing wealth of older adults and inter-generational transfers in China
records.title_cn: 中国老年人住房财富与代际转移
records.abstract_en: Identifying the determinants and motives of adult children's transfer payments to their parents has important policy implications in a rapidly aging society. Using data from the 2015 and 2018 China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS), this study analyzes how older adults' housing wealth affects their adult children's upward financial transfer payments. Our results show that an increase in parental housing wealth significantly increases financial transfers from adult children to their parents. This effect of housing wealth is more pronounced for families with multiple adult children, particularly when there is at least one son, compared to families with only one child, suggesting competition for inheritance among adult children. This conclusion is further supported by analyses that separate the sample by the level of financial assets and by the health status of older adults.
records.abstract_cn: 识别成年子女向父母转移支付的决定因素和动机，在快速老龄化的社会中具有重要的政策含义。利用2015年和2018年中国健康与养老追踪调查（CHARLS）的数据，本研究分析了老年人住房财富如何影响其成年子女的向上财务转移支付。我们的结果表明，父母住房财富的增加显著增加了成年子女向父母的财务转移。这种住房财富效应在拥有多个成年子女的家庭中更为明显，特别是当至少有一个儿子时，与只有一个子女的家庭相比，这表明成年子女之间存在遗产竞争。这一结论通过按金融资产水平和老年人健康状况分样本的分析得到了进一步支持。

records.title_en: The green promise of digital finance: Exploring its effects and mechanisms on carbon reduction
records.title_cn: 数字金融的绿色承诺：探讨其对碳减排的影响与机制
records.abstract_en: In the digital era, whether digital finance contributes to carbon reduction is crucial for achieving global sustainable development goals. This study explores the effects and mechanisms of digital finance on carbon emissions using panel data from Chinese counties during 2014–2022. Findings show that digital finance has a positive impact on carbon reduction at the county level in China. Mechanism analysis reveals that digital finance promotes corporate green technology innovation, accelerates the market exit and clean transformation of enterprises with high pollution, high energy consumption, and high emissions (“three-high”), limits government land concessions for “three-high” industries, and improves local fiscal autonomy. These mechanisms act as important channels for reducing carbon emissions. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that digital finance has a stronger impact on carbon reduction in counties with a high level of fintech, a high degree of carbon lock-in, and low climate risk. Additionally, digital finance facilitates regional synergistic carbon reduction and the synergy between pollution and carbon reduction while enhancing ecological environment quality. Our work contributes to the literature on digital finance and green transition, and provides important implications for China and the world in tapping the potential of carbon reduction from the perspective of digital finance.
records.abstract_cn: 在数字时代，数字金融是否有助于碳减排对于实现全球可持续发展目标至关重要。本研究利用2014-2022年中国县域面板数据，探讨了数字金融对碳排放的影响及其机制。研究发现，数字金融对中国县域层面的碳减排具有积极影响。机制分析显示，数字金融促进了企业绿色技术创新，加速了高污染、高能耗、高排放（“三高”）企业的市场退出和清洁转型，限制了政府对“三高”行业的土地出让，并提高了地方财政自主权。这些机制是减少碳排放的重要渠道。异质性分析表明，在金融科技水平高、碳锁定程度高和气候风险低的县域，数字金融对碳减排的影响更为显著。此外，数字金融促进了区域协同碳减排以及污染与碳减排的协同效应，同时提升了生态环境质量。我们的工作为数字金融与绿色转型的文献做出了贡献，并从数字金融视角为中国及全球挖掘碳减排潜力提供了重要启示。

records.title_en: Presidential Address: The Economist as Designer in the Innovation Process for Socially Impactful Digital Products
records.title_cn: 主席致辞：经济学家作为具有社会影响力的数字产品创新过程中的设计师
records.abstract_en: This paper provides an economic perspective on data-driven innovation in digital products, focusing on the role of complex experiments in measuring and improving social impact. The discussion highlights how tools and insights from economics contribute to each stage of the innovation process. Key contributions include identifying problems, developing theoretical frameworks, translating goals into measurable outcomes, analyzing historical data, and estimating counterfactual outcomes. The paper also surveys recently developed tools designed to address challenges in designing and analyzing data from complex experiments.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了数字产品中数据驱动创新的经济学视角，重点关注复杂实验在衡量和改善社会影响方面的作用。讨论强调了经济学的工具和见解如何为创新过程的每个阶段做出贡献。主要贡献包括识别问题、开发理论框架、将目标转化为可衡量的结果、分析历史数据以及估计反事实结果。本文还调查了最近开发的工具，旨在解决设计和分析复杂实验数据的挑战。

records.title_en: Fragile New Economy: Intangible Capital, Corporate Savings Glut, and Financial Instability
records.title_cn: 脆弱的新经济：无形资本、企业储蓄过剩和金融不稳定
records.abstract_en: The transition toward an intangible-intensive economy reshapes financial systems by creating a self-perpetuating savings glut in the production sector. As intangibles become increasingly important, firms hoard liquidity to finance investment in intangibles of limited pledgeability. Firms' savings feed cheap leverage to financial intermediaries and allow intermediaries to bid up asset prices, which in turn encourages firms to save more for asset creation. This paper develops a macrofinance model that offers a coherent account of rising corporate savings, debt-fueled growth of intermediaries, declining interest rates, and rising asset valuation. Along these secular trends, endogenous financial risk accumulates.
records.abstract_cn: 向无形密集型经济的转型通过在生产部门造成自我延续的储蓄过剩来重塑金融体系。随着无形资产变得越来越重要，企业囤积流动性来为可质押性有限的无形资产的投资提供资金。企业的储蓄为金融中介机构提供了廉价的杠杆，并允许中介机构抬高资产价格，这反过来又鼓励企业为资产创造而储蓄更多。本文开发了一个宏观金融模型，对企业储蓄增加、债务推动的中介机构增长、利率下降和资产估值上升提供了连贯的解释。沿着这些长期趋势，内生性金融风险不断累积。

records.title_en: Trade Shocks and Credit Reallocation
records.title_cn: 贸易冲击和信贷重新分配
records.abstract_en: This paper identifies a credit-supply contraction that arises endogenously after trade liberalization. Banks with loan portfolios concentrated in sectors exposed to competition from China face an increase in nonperforming loans after China's entry into the World Trade Organization. As a result, they reduce the supply of credit to firms, irrespective of the firm's sector of operation. This cut in credit translates into lower employment, investment, and output. Through this mechanism, the financial channel amplifies the shock to firms already hit by import competition from China and passes it on to firms in sectors expected to expand upon trade liberalization.
records.abstract_cn: 本文指出了贸易自由化后内生出现的信贷供给收缩。中国加入世界贸易组织后，贷款组合集中于面临中国竞争的行业的银行将面临不良贷款增加的问题。结果，它们减少了对公司的信贷供应，无论公司的经营部门如何。信贷削减导致就业、投资和产出下降。通过这一机制，金融渠道放大了对已经受到中国进口竞争打击的企业的冲击，并将其传递给预计将在贸易自由化后扩张的行业的企业。

records.title_en: Product Differentiation and Oligopoly: A Network Approach
records.title_cn: 产品差异化和寡头垄断：网络方法
records.abstract_en: I present a new theory of oligopoly and markups in general equilibrium, based on an innovative, scalable hedonic demand system, which I take to the data for the universe of US public firms. In my model, firms compete in a network of product market rivalries that emerge endogenously out of the characteristics of the products they supply. I estimate that consumer surplus is almost three times as large as profits; decompose firm-level markups into metrics of quality-adjusted productivity and market centrality; and analyze the extent, evolution, and drivers of monopoly power in the United States between 1995 and 2021.
records.abstract_cn: 我提出了一种新的一般均衡中的寡头垄断和加价理论，该理论基于创新的、可扩展的享乐需求系统，并将其应用于美国上市公司的数据中。在我的模型中，企业在产品市场竞争网络中进行竞争，这些竞争是从它们所提供的产品的特性中内生出来的。我估计消费者剩余几乎是利润的 三 倍；将公司层面的加价分解为质量调整后的生产率和市场中心度的指标；并分析 1995 和 2021 之间美国垄断权力的程度、演变和驱动因素。

records.title_en: Weighted Linear Discrete Choice
records.title_cn: 加权线性离散选择
records.abstract_en: We introduce a new model of stochastic choice that assigns each choice option a utility, along with a salience parameter reflecting economic frictions. We characterize our model behaviorally and investigate its comparative statics properties. We show that the model generates intuitive closed-form solutions in equilibrium settings where firms can choose price, quality, and advertising. In addition, we show that the model allows for flexible substitution patterns and changes in market shares across choice sets. We demonstrate that our model can be easily identified and can outperform alternatives in demand prediction.
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一种新的随机选择模型，为每个选择选项分配一个效用，以及反映经济摩擦的显着性参数。我们从行为上表征我们的模型并研究其比较静态特性。我们表明，该模型在均衡设置下生成直观的封闭式解决方案，企业可以在其中选择价格、质量和广告。此外，我们还表明该模型允许灵活的替代模式和跨选择集的市场份额变化。我们证明，我们的模型可以轻松识别，并且在需求预测方面优于其他模型。

records.title_en: Fighting Climate Change: International Attitudes toward Climate Policies
records.title_cn: 应对气候变化：国际社会对气候政策的态度
records.abstract_en: This paper explores global perceptions and understanding of climate change and policies, examining factors that influence support for climate action and the impact of different types of information. We conduct large-scale surveys with 40,000 respondents from 20 countries, providing new international data on attitudes toward climate change and respondents' socioeconomic backgrounds and lifestyles. We identify three key perceptions affecting policy support: perceived effectiveness of policies in reducing emissions, their impact on low-income households, and their effect on respondents' households (self-interest). Educational videos clarifying policy mechanisms increase support for climate policies; those merely highlighting climate change's impacts do not.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了全球对气候变化和政策的看法和理解，研究了影响气候行动支持的因素以及不同类型信息的影响。我们对来自 40,000 国家的 20 受访者进行了大规模调查，提供了有关气候变化态度以及受访者社会经济背景和生活方式的新国际数据。我们确定了 三 影响政策支持的关键看法：减排政策的有效性、对低收入家庭的影响以及对受访者家庭的影响（自身利益）。澄清政策机制的教育视频增加了对气候政策的支持；那些仅仅强调气候变化影响的文章则没有。

records.title_en: When Money Dies: The Dynamics of Speculative Hyperinflations
records.title_cn: 当金钱消亡时：投机性恶性通货膨胀的动态
records.abstract_en: How quickly does a fiat money become valueless? I study the speculative hyperinflation equilibria of continuous-time economies with decentralized markets where money is essential. I establish necessary and sufficient conditions under which money dies in finite time. A necessary condition is that the liquidity return of money grows unbounded as the value of money approaches zero. Under CRRA preferences, the longevity of money shrinks with the money growth rate and the frequency of liquidity needs, but it increases with seller's market power. Money duration also depends on the strictness of legal restrictions and the rates of return of competing currencies.
records.abstract_cn: 法定货币多久就会变得毫无价值？我研究了连续时间经济体的投机性恶性通货膨胀均衡，该经济体具有分散的市场，其中货币至关重要。我建立了货币在有限时间内消亡的充分必要条件。一个必要条件是，随着货币价值接近 零，货币的流动性回报无限增长。在CRRA偏好下，货币寿命随着货币增长率和流动性需求频率的增加而缩短，但随着卖方市场力量的增加而增加。资金期限还取决于法律限制的严格程度和竞争货币的回报率。

records.title_en: Cultural Distance and Ethnic Civil Conflict
records.title_cn: 文化距离与民族内部冲突
records.abstract_en: Ethnically diverse countries are more prone to conflict, but why do some groups engage in conflict, while others do not? I show that civil conflict in Africa is explained by ethnic groups' cultural distance to the central government: an increase in cultural distance, proxied by linguistic distance, increases an ethnicity's propensity to fight over government power. To identify this effect, I leverage within-ethnicity variation in linguistic distance resulting from power transitions between ethnic groups over time. I provide evidence that the effects can be attributed to differences in preferences over both the allocation and the type of public goods.
records.abstract_cn: 种族多元化的国家更容易发生冲突，但为什么有些群体会发生冲突，而另一些群体却不会呢？我表明，非洲的内部冲突是由族群与中央政府的文化距离来解释的：以语言距离为代表的文化距离的增加，增加了族群争夺政府权力的倾向。为了确定这种影响，我利用了种族内部随着时间的推移权力转移而导致的语言距离差异。我提供的证据表明，这种影响可以归因于对公共物品的分配和类型的偏好差异。

records.title_en: Optimal Fiscal and Monetary Policy with Distorting Taxes
records.title_cn: 扭曲税收下的最优财政与货币政策
records.abstract_en: When government debt pays a lower return than private assets, the reasoning in Friedman’s (1969) essay on the optimal quantity of money suggests that it would be optimal to expand the debt until its return matched that on private assets. When the only other source of revenue is a distorting tax, however, this is not generally true. In a perfect foresight model, a benevolent government that can make credible commitments chooses a large gap in returns initially and high distorting taxation in the distant future. The optimal path of taxation is time inconsistent, with ever-increasing temptation to abandon the path. (JEL E23, E43, E52, E62, H20, H61, H63)
records.abstract_cn: 当政府债务的回报低于私人资产时，弗里德曼（1969）关于最优货币数量的论文中的推理表明，最优做法是扩大债务直至其回报与私人资产相匹配。然而，当唯一的其他收入来源是扭曲性税收时，这通常并不成立。在一个具有完美预见性的模型中，一个能够做出可信承诺的仁慈政府会选择在初期保持较大的回报差距，并在遥远的未来实施高扭曲性税收。最优税收路径是时间不一致的，且放弃该路径的诱惑不断增加。（JEL E23, E43, E52, E62, H20, H61, H63）

records.title_en: Terms-of-Trade Shocks are Not All Alike
records.title_cn: 贸易条件冲击并非千篇一律
records.abstract_en: Terms of trade are an inaccurate empirical proxy for how fluctuations in international prices affect the economy. To capture the relevance of terms of trade fluctuations for the domestic business cycle, the role of export and import prices needs to be analyzed separately. Using a sample of developing economies, we find that the economy’s response to a positive export price shock does not mirror the response to a negative import price shock. (JEL E23, E32, E43, F14, F44, O11)
records.abstract_cn: 贸易条件是国际价格波动影响经济的经验代理变量，但并不准确。为了捕捉贸易条件波动对国内商业周期的重要性，需要分别分析出口价格和进口价格的作用。利用发展中经济体的样本，我们发现经济对正向出口价格冲击的反应并不与对负向进口价格冲击的反应相对称。(JEL E23, E32, E43, F14, F44, O11)

records.title_en: Does Unemployment Risk Affect Business Cycle Dynamics?
records.title_cn: 失业风险是否影响经济周期动态？
records.abstract_en: In this paper, I show that the decline in consumption during unemployment depends on both liquid and illiquid wealth; that unemployment predicts illiquid asset withdrawal, primarily when households have few liquid assets; and that increased idiosyncratic unemployment risk leads to a rise in saving overall, but also to a decline in investment in illiquid assets. Motivated by these new findings, I embed endogenous unemployment risk in a two-asset, heterogeneous-agent New Keynesian model. The model is consistent with the new evidence and suggests that aggregate shocks are amplified by a flight-to-liquidity when unemployment risk rises, particularly when monetary policy is constrained. (JEL E12, E21, E24, E52, G51)
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我展示了失业期间消费的下降既取决于流动性财富也取决于非流动性财富；失业预示着非流动性资产的提取，主要发生在家庭持有少量流动性资产时；以及个体特有的失业风险增加总体上导致储蓄上升，但也导致非流动性资产投资下降。基于这些新发现，我将内生失业风险嵌入一个双资产、异质性主体的新凯恩斯模型中。该模型与新证据一致，并表明当失业风险上升时，总冲击通过流动性逃逸被放大，尤其是在货币政策受限的情况下。（JEL E12, E21, E24, E52, G51）

records.title_en: A Unified Model of Learning to Forecast
records.title_cn: 一个统一的预测学习模型
records.abstract_en: We propose a model of boundedly rational and heterogeneous expectations that unifies adaptive learning, k-level reasoning, and replicator dynamics. Level-0 forecasts evolve over time via adaptive learning. Agents revise over time their depth of reasoning in response to forecast errors, observed and counterfactual. The unified model makes sharp predictions for when and how quickly markets converge in Learning-to-Forecast Experiments, including novel predictions for individual and market behavior in response to announced events. We present experimental results that support these predictions. We apply our unified approach in the New Keynesian model to study forward guidance policy. (JEL D83, D84, E12, E31, E32, E71)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个有限理性和异质性预期的模型，该模型统一了适应性学习、k级推理和复制者动态。第0级预测通过适应性学习随时间演变。代理人根据预测误差（包括观察到的和反事实的）随时间修正其推理深度。该统一模型对学习预测实验中市场何时以及多快收敛做出了精确预测，包括对公告事件响应的个体和市场行为的新颖预测。我们提供了支持这些预测的实验结果。我们将统一方法应用于新凯恩斯模型中，以研究前瞻指引政策。（JEL D83, D84, E12, E31, E32, E71）

records.title_en: Skill Remoteness and Post-Layoff Labor Market Outcomes
records.title_cn: 技能遥远度与裁员后劳动力市场结果
records.abstract_en: Local skill remoteness captures the dissimilarity between the skill profiles of a worker’s last job and other jobs in a local labor market. Higher skill remoteness at layoff is associated with persistently lower earnings after layoff, a higher probability of changing occupation, a lower probability of being reemployed at jobs with similar skill profiles, and a higher propensity to migrate. Jobs destroyed in recessions are also more skill remote than those lost in booms. The local skill remoteness of jobs is an empirically relevant factor to explain the severity and cyclicality of displaced workers’ earnings losses and reallocation patterns. (JEL E24, E32, J24, J31, J61, J63, R23)
records.abstract_cn: 本地技能遥远度衡量的是工人最后一份工作的技能概况与当地劳动力市场中其他工作之间的差异性。裁员时技能遥远度越高，与裁员后持续较低的 earnings、更高的职业转换概率、在技能概况相似的工作中再就业的概率较低以及更高的迁移倾向相关。经济衰退期间被摧毁的工作也比繁荣时期失去的工作更具技能遥远性。工作的本地技能遥远度是解释被置换工人收入损失和重新配置模式的严重性和周期性的一个经验相关因素。(JEL E24, E32, J24, J31, J61, J63, R23)

records.title_en: Job Displacement and Earnings Losses: The Role of Joblessness
records.title_cn: 工作流失与收入损失：失业的作用
records.abstract_en: A large literature finds that workers displaced in mass layoffs experience persistent earnings losses. We find that the earnings penalty from job displacement is mediated by the length of the jobless spell after displacement. Workers who experience little or no joblessness suffer no losses on average; those who experience a prolonged period of joblessness experience large, persistent earnings losses. Job movers who experience joblessness tend to move to lower-paying firms, a phenomenon that informs our understanding of the mechanisms that generate earnings losses. We also find that jobless duration predicts earnings outcomes for separators generally, not only displaced workers. (JEL E24, J24, J31, J62, J63, J64)
records.abstract_cn: 大量文献发现，在大规模裁员中失业的工人会经历持续的收入损失。我们发现，工作流失带来的收入惩罚受到失业后无工作期间长度的影响。经历很少或没有失业的工人平均没有损失；那些经历长期失业的工人则遭受巨大且持续的收入损失。经历失业的工作转换者倾向于转向薪酬较低的企业，这一现象有助于我们理解产生收入损失的机制。我们还发现，失业持续时间可以预测离职者的收入结果，而不仅仅是针对被裁员的工人。（JEL E24, J24, J31, J62, J63, J64）

records.title_en: The Geography of Consumption and Local Economic Shocks: The Case of the Great Recession
records.title_cn: 消费地理与地方经济冲击：以大衰退为例
records.abstract_en: We estimate across-county spending flows between firms and consumers for every county in the United States, providing a new consumption link that has not been studied previously. We highlight the importance of this link by estimating the effect of changes in local housing wealth on consumption and employment from 2001 to 2019. We generally find that the effect from changes in housing wealth crosses borders to affect consumption and employment in a pattern consistent with our spending flows. However, we find potential consumers who reside outside the local commuting zone disproportionately affect local spending and employment during the Great Recession. (JEL E21, E24, E32, G51, R12, R23)
records.abstract_cn: 我们估算了美国每个县企业与消费者之间的跨县支出流，提供了一种此前未被研究的新消费联系。我们通过估算2001年至2019年间地方住房财富变化对消费和就业的影响来强调这一联系的重要性。我们普遍发现，住房财富变化的影响跨越边界，以与我们支出流一致的模式影响消费和就业。然而，我们发现，居住在当地通勤区之外的潜在消费者在大衰退期间对地方支出和就业产生了不成比例的影响。（JEL E21, E24, E32, G51, R12, R23）

records.title_en: Public Liquidity and Financial Crises
records.title_cn: 公共流动性与金融危机
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the equilibrium effect of public liquidity on financial crises. Banks borrow from households via insured deposits and partially runnable debt and suffer endogenous funding withdrawals from households in crises. Holding public liquidity alleviates banks’ liquidity problems. In equilibrium, a larger public liquidity supply reduces crisis severity and expands bank lending but crowds bank deposits and increases bank vulnerability to real shocks. The model quantitatively explains 40 percent of Treasury liquidity premium variations. Counterfactual analyses reveal that QE1 significantly improves output, 20 times larger than QE3. However, QE policies raise bank fragility against nonfinancial shocks such as COVID-19. (JEL E23, E32, E44, E52, E58, G01, G21)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了公共流动性对金融危机的均衡效应。银行通过受保存款和部分可挤兑债务从家庭借款，并在危机中遭受家庭的内生资金提取。持有公共流动性缓解了银行的流动性问题。在均衡状态下，更大的公共流动性供给降低了危机严重性并扩大了银行贷款，但挤出了银行存款并增加了银行对实际冲击的脆弱性。该模型定量解释了国债流动性溢价变异的40%。反事实分析显示，QE1显著改善产出，其效果是QE3的20倍。然而，量化宽松政策增加了银行对非金融冲击（如COVID-19）的脆弱性。(JEL E23, E32, E44, E52, E58, G01, G21)

records.title_en: Min(d)ing the President: A Text Analytic Approach to Measuring Tax News
records.title_cn: 挖掘总统：衡量税收新闻的文本分析方法
records.abstract_en: Economic agents react to signals about future tax policy changes. Consequently, estimating their macroeconomic effects requires identification of such signals. We propose a novel text analytic approach for transforming textual information into an economically meaningful time series. Using this method, we create a tax news measure from all publicly available postwar communications of US presidents. Our measure predicts the direction and size of future tax changes and contains signals not present in previously considered (narrative) measures of tax changes. We investigate the effects of tax news and find that, for long anticipation horizons, pre-implementation effects lead initially to contractions in output. (JEL D72, D82, E62, H20, H30)
records.abstract_cn: 经济主体对未来税收政策变化的信号作出反应。因此，估计其宏观经济效应需要识别此类信号。我们提出了一种新颖的文本分析方法，将文本信息转化为具有经济意义的时间序列。利用该方法，我们从美国战后所有公开的总统通讯中构建了一个税收新闻指标。该指标能够预测未来税收变化的方向和规模，并包含以往（叙事性）税收变化指标中未出现的信号。我们研究了税收新闻的影响，发现对于较长的预期期限，实施前效应最初会导致产出收缩。（JEL D72, D82, E62, H20, H30）

records.title_en: Severe Weather and the Macroeconomy
records.title_cn: 恶劣天气与宏观经济
records.abstract_en: We investigate the impact of severe weather shocks on the US macroeconomy over the past 60 years. Using a nonlinear vector autoregressive model, we find robust evidence of time-varying effects. While negligible at the beginning of the sample, the impact becomes signifi-cant at the end, where an increase in the severe weather index reduces aggregate industrial production and consumption growth rates, and raises aggregate unemployment and inflation rates. The effects are persistent for up to 20 months. Our findings suggest limited adaptation to the increased severity of weather in the United States, at least at the macroeconomic level. (JEL E21, E23, E24, E31, Q54)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了过去60年间恶劣天气冲击对美国宏观经济的影响。使用非线性向量自回归模型，我们发现了时变效应的稳健证据。虽然在样本初期影响微乎其微，但在样本末期影响变得显著，恶劣天气指数的上升降低了总体工业生产和消费增长率，并提高了总体失业率和通货膨胀率。这些效应持续长达20个月。我们的研究结果表明，美国对日益严重的天气状况的适应有限，至少在宏观经济层面是如此。（JEL E21, E23, E24, E31, Q54）

records.title_en: The High and Falling Price of Cement in Africa
records.title_cn: 非洲水泥价格的高企与回落
records.abstract_en: Prices for several intermediate inputs, including cement, are higher in developing economies—particularly in Africa. Combining recent data from the International Comparison Program with a global directory of cement firms, we estimate an industry equilibrium model to distinguish between drivers of international price dispersion: demand, costs, conduct, and entry. Developing economies feature both higher marginal costs and higher markups. African markets are not characterized by less competitive conduct and, if anything, feature lower barriers to entry. Yet the small size of many national markets limits entry and competition and explains most of the higher markups and prices. Policy implications are discussed. (JEL D24, L13, L61, O14)
records.abstract_cn: 包括水泥在内的几种中间投入品在发展中经济体——尤其是非洲——的价格较高。结合国际比较项目的最新数据与全球水泥企业名录，我们估计了一个行业均衡模型，以区分国际价格差异的驱动因素：需求、成本、行为和进入。发展中经济体既具有较高的边际成本，也具有较高的加成率。非洲市场并非以较不竞争的行为为特征，如果有的话，其进入壁垒较低。然而，许多国家市场的规模较小限制了进入和竞争，并解释了大部分较高的加成率和价格。讨论了政策含义。(JEL D24, L13, L61, O14)

records.title_en: Wind of Change? Cultural Determinants of Maternal Labor Supply
records.title_cn: 变革之风？文化对女性劳动供给的决定因素
records.abstract_en: We investigate the role of cultural norms in shaping women’s labor supply decisions after childbirth. Specifically, we are interested in the interplay between childhood socialization and adulthood environment. To that end, we leverage the setting of the German reunification when East Germany’s gender-egalitarian culture induced by socialism and West Germany’s more traditional culture were brought together. We find that East German gender norms are persistent, whereas West German ones are not. West German mothers adjust their behavior to that of their East German peers not only when immersed in East German environment but even after returning to the West. (JEL D91, J13, J16, J22, N34, Z13)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了文化规范在塑造女性生育后劳动供给决策中的作用。具体而言，我们关注童年社会化与成年环境之间的相互作用。为此，我们利用了德国统一这一背景，当时社会主义所导致的东德性别平等文化与西德更为传统的文化被结合在一起。我们发现东德的性别规范具有持续性，而西德的则不然。西德母亲不仅在东德环境中会调整其行为以与东德同龄人保持一致，甚至在返回西德后也是如此。（JEL D91, J13, J16, J22, N34, Z13）

records.title_en: Childcare, Labor Supply, and Business Development: Experimental Evidence from Uganda
records.title_cn: 儿童保育、劳动力供给与商业发展：来自乌干达的实验证据
records.abstract_en: We randomly offered a childcare subsidy, an equivalent cash grant, or both to mothers of three-to-five-year-old children. The childcare subsidy substantially increased the labor supply and earnings of single mothers, highlighting the importance of time constraints for them. Among couples, childcare did not affect mothers’ labor market outcomes but instead increased fathers’ salaried employment. At the household level, childcare led to higher income and consumption and improved child development. Cash grants positively affected mothers’ labor supply and income irrespective of the household structure, suggesting the general importance of credit constraints for women’s business development. (JEL H24, J13, J16, J22, J31, O12)
records.abstract_cn: 我们随机向三至五岁儿童的母亲提供儿童保育补贴、等额现金赠款，或两者兼有。儿童保育补贴显著增加了单身母亲的劳动力供给和收入，凸显了时间约束对她们的重要性。在夫妻家庭中，儿童保育并未影响母亲的劳动力市场结果，反而增加了父亲的受薪就业。在家庭层面，儿童保育带来了更高的收入和消费，并促进了儿童发展。现金赠款无论家庭结构如何，都对母亲的劳动力供给和收入产生了积极影响，这表明信贷约束对女性商业发展具有普遍重要性。(JEL H24, J13, J16, J22, J31, O12)

records.title_en: Sustainable Poverty Reduction through Social Assistance: Modality, Context, and Complementary Programming in Bangladesh
records.title_cn: 通过社会救助实现可持续减贫：孟加拉国的模式、背景与补充项目
records.abstract_en: Social assistance programs can increase consumption and reduce poverty, but less is known about whether these impacts are sustained after programs end or how design and context influence sustainability. Using data collected in two regions of Bangladesh four years after a randomized intervention ended, we find that combining cash transfers with complementary programming led to sustained increases in consumption and reductions in poverty. Combining food transfers with complementary programming showed similar patterns to a lesser extent. Cash alone had context-specific sustained effects; food alone had no sustained impacts. Results suggest that context, modality, and complementary programming matter for sustained impacts. (JEL D12, E21, I32, I38, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 社会救助项目可以增加消费并减少贫困，但关于这些影响在项目结束后是否持续，以及设计背景和背景如何影响可持续性，我们知之甚少。利用随机干预结束四年后在孟加拉国两个地区收集的数据，我们发现，将现金转移与补充项目相结合，导致了消费的持续增加和贫困的减少。将食品转移与补充项目相结合，显示出类似但程度较轻的模式。仅现金转移具有特定背景下的持续效应；仅食品转移则没有持续影响。结果表明，背景、模式和补充项目对持续影响至关重要。(JEL D12, E21, I32, I38, O15)

records.title_en: Do Peers Matter in the Police Academy?
records.title_cn: 警察学院中的同伴效应重要吗？
records.abstract_en: Increasing underrepresented groups’ representation in police departments is a common proposal to reduce aggressive policing. This paper documents the effects of peer composition in the Chicago police academy on officers’ future arrests by exploiting the lottery system, which provides exogenous variation in cohort composition. I find that higher shares of peers from groups that police less aggressively, such as female and older officers, reduce all officers’ future low-level arrests. Peer race matters by amplifying the effects of gender and age. Overall, the results are most consistent with peers’ preferences for less aggressive policing shifting officers’ preferences and changing future behavior. (JEL H76, J15, J16, J45, J78, K42)
records.abstract_cn: 增加警察部门中代表性不足群体的比例是减少激进警务的常见提议。本文利用抽签系统提供的队列构成外生变异，记录了芝加哥警察学院中同伴构成对警官未来逮捕行为的影响。我发现，来自较少采取激进警务的群体（如女性和年长警官）的同伴比例越高，会减少所有警官未来的低级逮捕。同伴的种族通过放大性别和年龄效应而起作用。总体而言，结果最符合同伴对较少激进警务的偏好转变了警官的偏好并改变了未来行为的解释。(JEL H76, J15, J16, J45, J78, K42)

records.title_en: The Long-Term Effects of Career Guidance in High School and Student Financial Aid: Evidence from a Randomized Experiment
records.title_cn: 高中职业指导与学生资助的长期效应：来自随机实验的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effects of a randomized control trial in which Canadian high school students were randomly invited to participate in a career guidance program during high school and/or made eligible for extra financial aid conditional on college enrollment. I use administrative records to examine the effects of the interventions on college enrollment, graduation, and income up to age 29. The guidance intervention increased students’ four-year college enrollment and graduation rates and had positive effects on individuals’ income in adulthood. The financial aid intervention had a significantly lower impact on individuals’ income in adulthood despite also increasing college enrollment. (JEL D12, I21, I22, I23, I28, J31)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一项随机对照试验的效果，在该试验中，加拿大高中生被随机邀请参加高中期间的职业指导项目和/或有资格在入学大学后获得额外经济援助。我使用行政记录来考察这些干预措施对大学入学、毕业以及至29岁收入的影响。指导干预提高了学生的四年制大学入学率和毕业率，并对个体成年后的收入产生了积极影响。经济援助干预虽然也增加了大学入学率，但对个体成年后收入的影响显著较低。(JEL D12, I21, I22, I23, I28, J31)

records.title_en: The Productivity Consequences of Pollution-Induced Migration in China
records.title_cn: 污染引发的迁移对中国生产率的影响
records.abstract_en: We quantify how pollution affects aggregate productivity and welfare in spatial equilibrium. We show that skilled workers in China emigrate away from polluted cities. These patterns are evident under various empirical specifications, such as when instrumenting for pollution using upwind power plants, or thermal inversions. Pollution changes the spatial distribution of skilled and unskilled workers, and wage returns by location. We quantify the loss in aggregate productivity due to this re-sorting by estimating a spatial equilibrium model. Counterfactual simulations show that reducing pollution increases productivity through spatial re-sorting by approximately as much as the direct health benefits of clean air. (JEL J24, J31, J61, P25, P28, Q53, R23)
records.abstract_cn: 我们量化了污染如何在空间均衡中影响总生产率和福利。我们表明，中国的技能工人会从污染严重的城市迁出。这些模式在各种实证设定下都很明显，例如使用上风电厂或热逆温作为污染的工具变量时。污染改变了技能工人和非技能工人的空间分布，以及不同地点的工资回报。我们通过估计一个空间均衡模型来量化这种重新分类导致的总生产率损失。反事实模拟显示，减少污染通过空间重新分类提高生产率，其幅度大约与清洁空气的直接健康效益相当。(JEL J24, J31, J61, P25, P28, Q53, R23)

records.title_en: Family Spillover Effects of Marginal Diagnoses: The Case of ADHD
records.title_cn: 边际诊断的家庭溢出效应：以注意力缺陷多动障碍为例
records.abstract_en: The health care system uses patient family medical history in many settings, and this practice is widely believed to improve the efficiency of health care allocation. This paper provides a counterpoint by documenting that reliance on hereditary information can amplify the misallocation of low-value care. We study Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder and show that reliance on family medical history generates a “snowball effect”—the propagation of an original marginal diagnosis to a patient’s relatives. This snowball effect raises the private and social costs of low-value care. (JEL H51, I12, I13, I18, J12, J13)
records.abstract_cn: 医疗系统在许多情境下使用患者的家族病史，这种做法被广泛认为能提高医疗资源配置的效率。本文通过记录依赖遗传信息可能加剧低价值护理的错配，提供了一个反例。我们研究注意力缺陷多动障碍，并表明依赖家族病史会产生“滚雪球效应”——即原始边际诊断向患者亲属的传播。这种滚雪球效应提高了低价值护理的私人成本和社会成本。(JEL H51, I12, I13, I18, J12, J13)
